and he wasted none of the time fate had given him. From the years of 871 to 866 PP he dispatched envoys into the great salt desert Moghra'yi. Hundreds of Qudians perished at the hands of the nomadic tribes, expired to heat exhaustion, or met fates worse still, until in 866 PP an unnamed emissary made contact with the dromad merchants. The dromads, who had believed the inhabitants of Qud too barbaric for trade and had dismissed the region for centuries, began at last to include Qud in their world-spanning treks (These visits stopped abruptly when Mehmet's successor Uutut the Boorish slaughtered the first dromad caravan to arrive after the onset of his reign, but the precedent for trade relations was established nonetheless).

Domestically, Mehmet I set out to construct the first Library of Qud in the far southern jungles, but his efforts were cut short by the barbarian invasions of 850 PP. The peaceable king spent the remaining six years of his life repelling the incursions of the barbarians over the Mount of Olives, but he was not skilled in the arts of war, and in 844 PP the barbarian king Uutut sacked Morshershire, beheaded Mehmet, and seized the throne.

在国内，梅赫梅特一世计划在遥远的南方丛林修建卡德第一座图书馆，却被PP850年的蛮族入侵打断。爱好和平的国王余下六年都在橄榄山一带抵御蛮族侵袭；然而他不擅战事。PP844年，蛮族之王乌乌图特洗劫莫舍郡，斩下梅赫梅特的头颅，夺得王位。

Before the founding of the monastery in ~110PP, the regional combs were occupied by small fishing communities that traded peaceably amongst themselves. Once the pilgrim-monks built and populated the temple, several tribes of fishermen settled a village nearby to prosper from the monastery's need for fish and cragreed. Over the years the two communities have grown and largely intertwined with some of the anglers forsaking their river and mountain gods for the Eustace-Sutta.

[[{{C|Conversion to the Discipline of the Eustace-Sutta}}]]

After King Ercarthus died in 40PP and left no heir, Athenreach erupted into bedlam, with several of the freehold's oldest families vying for the throne. The lowest-born fisherfolk, however, rallied around a wizened angler whose name has been lost to history. Several of the elder families supported the angler, believing they could rule from behind the throne. The angler himself spurned the offer, but, realizing the importance of a unified Athenreach, eventually accepted the crown, took the name Narsus, and began a reign that would become the most prodigious in the freehold's century-long history.
zh:
数百年之久，得益于此地位置优越：它位于流经埃斯克莱恩山脉的冰川河流下游。~110PP年修道院建立之前，当地蜂巢洞窟中住着若干小型渔村，彼此和平交易。朝圣僧侣修建并进驻寺院后，几支渔民部族在附近建立村落，借供应寺院所需的鱼类与崖蟹繁荣起来。数年间，两处社群日益壮大、交融；一些渔民放弃河神与山神，改信尤斯塔斯—苏塔。

[[{{C|皈依尤斯塔斯—苏塔教规}}]]

PP40年，埃卡萨斯国王驾崩且无子嗣，阿森里奇顿时陷入混乱；自由领最古老的数个家族争夺王位。然而出身最低微的渔民聚集在一位年迈渔夫周围，他的名字已湮没于历史。几大古老家族支持这名渔夫，以为可以垂帘听政。渔夫本人拒绝了提议，但意识到阿森里奇统一至关重要后，最终接受王冠，自称纳尔苏斯，开启了自由领百年历史中最为卓越的统治。

A millennium after the last people were driven into the earth, at the height of the Wrathchild empire in the great southern salt desert called Moghra'yi, a race of beings known as the Ophaedians migrated north from their desert city to the Sunderlies. There they escaped the reach of the kuyeti, the monstrous man-scorpions whose empire spanned the great desert. The Ophaedians were gifted with the ability of goldworking, and during the course of their four-thousand year reign over the Sunderlies they wrought hundreds of spires and bridges of solid gold. Around 1800P they disappeared suddenly, perhaps as a result of the warming climate to which they had lost their adaptation from their years spent in the colder northlands. As the earth warmed, a primitive people emerged from their cavern recesses. They climbed the snowy combs and settled the superior caves. According to their myths, these new folk made oaths to the nameless gods who had warmed the earth for their children's return to the surface. So were born the clans of true folk.
zh:
穿梭于冰封洞穴，毛茸茸的巨鹏在雪峰之巅筑巢；然而残存的人类数千年未曾现身。

人类最后一次被赶入地下千年之后，南方大盐漠莫格拉伊的怒子帝国正值鼎盛；一支名为奥法狄人的种族从沙漠城邦北迁至桑德莱群岛，逃离库耶提人的势力范围。那些凶恶的人蝎统治着横跨大沙漠的帝国。奥法狄人天生善于锻造黄金；他们统治桑德莱群岛的四千年间，建起数百座纯金尖塔与桥梁。约1800P年，他们突然消失，或许是气候转暖所致；他们在寒冷北方生活多年，早已失去适应暖气候的能力。大地转暖之际，一群原始人从洞窟深处走出。他们攀上雪覆蜂巢山脉，定居于上方的洞穴。据他们的神话，这些新来者向无名之神起誓；正是那些神为子嗣重返地表而温暖大地。真正族人的氏族由此诞生。

[[{{C|Eustace-Suttan Monastery at Athenreach}}]]

The Eustace-Suttan monastery at Athenreach is one of the largest communities of disciples of the Eustace-Sutta outside of the Hanging Hills. It was founded in 114PP by the pilgrim-monk Umay, who blessed the location as sacred because it lay along the path of the prophet Uuchal's pilgrimage toward Iber.

The monastery houses two hallowed artifacts of the Eustace-Sutta discipline: the Scrolls of One Priam, discovered and transcribed by the monastery's erstwhile abbot Flavian the Learned, and the presumptive hide of Iopinax, the great three-headed mountain goat on which Uuchal's is said to have ridden to the waterfall at Iber and whose hide was so tough that it was said to later protect Uuchal from starfire along the Black Stair after the goat's death. The current abbot of the Eustace-Suttan monastery is Moin Mohsen, who succeeded Flavian the Learned upon the latter's death in 18PP.
zh:
此婚事令桑德莱群岛各自由领忧虑不已，尤其是金口，它曾数度被奥德鲁姆的采邑夷平并占据。

[[{{C|阿森里奇的尤斯塔斯—苏塔修道院}}]]

阿森里奇的尤斯塔斯—苏塔修道院，是悬丘之外规模最大的尤斯塔斯—苏塔门徒社群之一。PP114年，朝圣僧侣乌迈创建修道院，并祝圣此地；因它位于先知乌查尔朝圣前往伊贝尔的路上。

修道院珍藏两件尤斯塔斯—苏塔教规的圣物：《普里阿姆一世书卷》，由前任院长博学者弗拉维安发现并誊录；以及据称属于伊奥皮纳克的皮——这只伟大的三头山羊据说曾载着乌查尔前往伊贝尔瀑布，其皮坚韧无比，死后还据说在黑阶沿途保护乌查尔免受星火焚烧。如今尤斯塔斯—苏塔修道院院长为莫因·莫森；PP18年博学者弗拉维安去世后，他接掌院职。

[[{{c|Clan Wenniswool}}]]

The children of Clan Wenniswool supposedly hail from the far north, beyond even the haunts of the Plutarchs. There they lived among the snows and hunted the great woolly rocs that perched atop the mountain peaks until they migrated southward into the lowland canyons. Clan Wenniswool's sigil is a great woolly roc with its wings outstretched.

[[{{c|Clan Calypso}}]]

The river folk of Clan Calypso claim descendancy from Calypso the river-wife. Some claim she was in truth a river nymph, and that her beauty was such as to tempt a river god into revealing to her his name. Clan Calypso's sigil is a lock of raven hair bound by a strand of cragweed.
zh:
四百年之久，直至罗文的埃兰向索图尔的甘农宣誓效忠，并于PP211年协助创建珀斯。罗文氏族的徽记，是一名张开双臂的人，一手握刀，一手捧着人心。

[[{{c|温尼斯伍尔氏族}}]]

据说温尼斯伍尔氏族的后裔来自遥远北方，甚至远在普鲁塔克氏族的栖居地之外。他们曾生活于冰雪之间，猎捕栖息在山顶的巨型毛鹏，后来才南迁至低地峡谷。温尼斯伍尔氏族的徽记，是一只张开双翼的巨型毛鹏。

[[{{c|卡吕普索氏族}}]]

卡吕普索氏族的河民自称是河中妻卡吕普索的后裔。有人说她实为河仙女，其美貌甚至令河神动心，将自己的名字透露给她。卡吕普索氏族的徽记，是一绺乌鸦黑发，以一缕崖草束起。

[[{{C|Geography and History}}]]
The Pale Sea's waves break on the western bluffs of the Sunderlies at the Shore of Songs, named for the melodies the comb-caves whistle when the sea winds blow through. They stretch north and east, climbing skyward along the ice-capped Aeschlays. Eastward, they recess toward Whitecomb at the Bowl of Iris -- the bridge to Aegansteppe. To the far east they rise again toward the Hanging Hills and the land called Odrum. The comb-canyons dry up as they course southward into the Great Salt Desert, though the most westerly ones spend their water into the Pale Marshes.

Several millennia ago, the migrants who followed the receding waterline down into the to-be desert basin were largely wiped out by the onset of the ice age. Most of the clans perished; those that survived were driven deep into the lightless comb-caves where the last vestiges of technology warmed the sheltered earth. The Sunderlies were devoid of higher life during the coldest centuries -- giant, ice-sheathed worms
zh:
峡谷。如今峡谷中只剩浅河流淌。过去两百年间，穴居氏族开始大量聚集于蜂巢洞窟，建立称为自由领的城邦。

[[{{C|地理与历史}}]]
苍海的浪涛拍打桑德莱群岛西侧崖壁，在歌之岸碎裂。海风穿过蜂巢洞窟时发出的旋律，便是此岸得名由来。群山向北、向东绵延，沿冰封的埃斯克莱斯山脉拔地而起。东方的山脉退向艾丽斯盆地的白冠山，那里是通往埃根草原的桥梁。再往远东，山势又朝悬丘和奥德鲁姆之地升起。蜂巢峡谷向南延伸，逐渐干涸，直至进入大盐漠；最西侧的峡谷却将水注入苍白沼泽。

数千年前，沿着退去的水线迁入未来沙漠盆地的移民，大多在冰河时代来临时覆灭。多数氏族灭绝；幸存者被迫深入不见天日的蜂巢洞窟，靠最后残存的技术温暖避风的土地。最寒冷的数百年间，桑德莱群岛没有高等生命——披着冰壳的巨虫

src:
indeed grown weary of the labor charged to it by the musker, sneaked away by the babbling brook, out of the shady wood and into a valley quilted with the gnarled roots of brinestalk.

Again the mimic followed the stream through the hollow crook of the foothills until it spent its brackish waters into a vast lake. Here upon the bleached shore, the mimic gazed into the lake and marveled at a shoal of madpoles as they lashed through the briny water and pursued their fishy prey. The ferocity of these hunters, unrivaled in their agility and viciousness, enchanted the mimic, and so it asked the madpoles if it could dive into their waters, and race with them through the weeds, and feast upon the scaly flesh of the smaller fish. "Nay, you should desire none of these things" said one madpole, "for we are ravenous fiends and oft succumb to fits of maddened fury."

But the mimic dived into the lake anyway. And as it splashed in the water, the madpoles, who sensed in their proximity living and nubile flesh, darted toward the mimic and tore it limb from limb.
zh:
悄悄沿着潺潺溪流溜走，离开阴翳的树林，进入一处山谷；谷中盐茎盘根错节，宛如织毯。

拟态怪再度沿溪而行，穿过山麓空谷蜿蜒的曲折处，直到咸涩溪水注入一片广阔湖泊。它立于苍白湖岸，凝望湖面，惊叹一群狂蝌蚪在咸水中疾扫，追逐鱼类猎物。这些猎手凶猛绝伦，敏捷与残暴无可匹敌，令拟态怪心醉神迷。它便问狂蝌蚪，自己能否潜入它们的水域，与它们穿行水草竞速，并饱餐小鱼覆鳞的肉。一只狂蝌蚪说：“不，你不该渴求这些；我们都是贪婪恶魔，常常陷入狂怒之中。”

然而拟态怪还是跳入湖中。它才刚溅起水花，狂蝌蚪便察觉近旁有鲜活柔嫩的血肉，立刻向它扑去，将它撕得四分五裂。

[[{{C|Abram I, (100? - 97? PP)}}]]
The first humanoid to successfully unite the farmsteads of western Qud was Abram, called the Sower. According to the lore of Abram's descendants (of which the Consortium has chosen not to disabuse them), Abram's call to arms rallied his kinsmen and under his sovereignty they drove the greater Girsh entities beneath the surface to the depths of Inner Qud at which they now roost. To follow were two or three decades of jubilation and prosperity that lasted until the day Abram, disillusioned by the growing tumult among his sons on the question of succession, famously beat his sword into a ploughshare and dissolved his kingdom.

[[{{C|No Reign, (97? - 96? PP)}}]]
The years that followed Abram's dissolution were marked by fear, turmoil, and bloodshed. His sons fought fiercely for control of the farmsteads while water barons conspired against them and in some cases staked their own claims. At last, sometime between 970 and 960 PP, Abram acknowledged the futility of the prospect of peace without his providence and returned to the throne with his sword in hand.

[[{{C|亚伯兰一世（约PP100—97年）}}]]
第一个成功统一卡德西部农庄的类人，是被称作播种者的亚伯兰。据亚伯兰后裔的传说（联盟选择不去纠正他们），亚伯兰号召族人起兵，在他的统治下将更强大的吉尔什实体驱至地底、赶入内卡德深处；它们如今仍栖居在那里。此后两三十年，举国欢庆、繁荣昌盛。直到亚伯兰对儿子们日渐激烈的继承权争执心灰意冷，著名地将剑打成犁头，解散了王国。

[[{{C|无王时代（约PP97—96年）}}]]
亚伯兰解散王国后的岁月，充满恐惧、动乱与流血。他的儿子们为争夺农庄控制权而激战，水权贵族则在暗中谋划，有些甚至亲自争夺王位。终于，在PP970至960年间的某个时候，亚伯兰承认没有他庇佑便无法实现和平，于是手持宝剑重返王座。

Clan Lecray maintains that they are the purest of the clans of true folk as the Bowl of Iris was the last of the fertile lands untouched by the servants of foreign gods. Unsurprisingly, this notion is disputed by the other great clans. Clan Lecray's sigil is a horn of plenty on a verdant green field.

[[{{C|Other Clans}}]]

[[{{c|Clan Karst}}]]

The people of Clan Karst are thought to have migrated to the western Sunderlies from the Icepyres adjoining Fuming God Sea. Little is known of their progenitor, Karst, but that he appeared on the Shore of Songs still smoldering some four hundred years ago. Thusly, Clan Karst's sigil is the smoldering silhouette of a man.

[[{{c|Clan Rowen}}]]

Clan Rowen claims descendancy from Rowen Godfear, the brother of a Sotur king. The pious Rowen broke away from Clan Sotur on account of a religious dispute with his brother in 623PP. The two clans warred for

They claim descendancy from Sotur Stonehands, who woke thirsty from his cave one morning and beat his fists against the earth until the gods summoned the Pale Sea to appease him. For hundreds of years they have warred with Clan Rowen, various mutant tribes, and the slugmounters of the southern marshlands, though recently their feud with Rowen was put to an end by the founding of Perth. Clan Sotur's sigil is a sundered mountain.

[[{{c|Clan Plutarch (?!?)}}]]

Clan Plutarch descended into the Sunderlies from the frozen Aeschlays a millennium ago. Their patriarch was Plutarch Icewreath, who was said to be trapped in a glacier for thousands of years before the gods unfroze him so that he might spread his progeny and rule. For a thousand years the ice kings have ruled the northern Sunderlies from Highwreath Hall. Clan Plutarch's sigil is a blue crown wrought from shards of ice on a white field.

The Lecrays hail from the fertile Bowl of Iris along the northern reaches of

src:
{{W|Author's Foreward}}

I initially had no intention of writing any of this down. What business is it of mine, I thought, to divest the ignorant of their hard-earned bliss? Who am I to speak up against the static inertia of incurious dullards who choose to cultivate their lack of awareness of the world around them as my witless kin tend to their tidy watervine rows? I am a warrior, scientist, and chef; devoting my time to educating the undeserving is the least of my many desires. After enough time spent among other alleged sentients, however, I determined that more of my time has been wasted in correcting so-called 'experts' concerning this matter than I would waste by writing a text about it.

So: here. You're welcome.


Chef Agate Severance Star
zh:
{{W|作者序}}

起初我根本没打算把这些事写下来。我想，这与我何干？何必夺走愚人历尽辛苦才得来的无知之福？我又凭什么开口，去对抗那些不求甚解的庸人那死水般的惰性？他们刻意蒙蔽自己，不去认识周遭世界，正如我那些愚钝的同族只知照料整齐的水藤田。我是战士、科学家，也是厨师；把时间花在教导不配受教之人身上，乃我诸多心愿中最微末的一项。然而，我在其他所谓有灵生物之间待得久了，终于发觉：我花在纠正此事上那些所谓“专家”的时间，早已远多于写一本书所耗的工夫。

所以，书在这里。不必谢我。

She laughed, the beautiful tinkling crystal blade of her voice slicing my heart to ribbons. The last thing I heard before my faint consciousness surrendered its grasp on my mind was her trailing reply, receding with distance.

"Why, it's because we love starapples!"
zh:
“等等！”我肌肉紧绷。她停下脚步，略一沉吟。我赶忙接着问：“至少回答我这个：为何偏偏是苹果农？”

她笑了。那声音美得如水晶利刃叮咚作响，将我的心割成碎片。我失去意识、心神交出最后一丝支撑之前，听见她的回答渐行渐远：

“这还用问？因为我们爱吃星苹果！”

Chavvah sustains me, and we are, I am not... them. We are in a... beneficial arrangement, you know. Yes?
zh:
“寄生虫”太难听了。这更像……啊……经济共生？

查娃供养我，而我们，我不是……它们。我们处于一种……互利的安排，你懂的。是吧？

src:
'TIS A SILLY STRATAGEM FOR THE CONVEYANCE OF CULTURE, IN MINE ESTIMATION.

ALAS, 'TIS WHAT THE COVEN SERVETH.
zh:
依我之见，以此传递文化，乃是一桩愚拙之策。

唉，然这正是盟会所奉之事。

src:
'Tis a saying among the stonemasons, "Never finish a job too early." By the decretum of Sagittar, old as it is, they have until the Coiled Lamb is... is decom-.. passed... decompassed.... dead, deadlike... to complete their work on the Tomb.

Bless the Coiled Lamb, peace to those who canter in his house, and let us pray the day never comes!
zh:
石匠们有句俗话：“活儿切莫干得太早。”依射手座的古老法令，他们可待盘羔……驾……崩……崩……崩殂……亡故，形同亡故，方可完成陵墓的工程。

愿盘羔蒙福，愿所有在他殿中驰骋的人平安，也让我们祈祷那一天永远不要到来！

src: 'Twas not always so. Nay, in the waking dawn of days they roamed the universe with inert hearts.
zh: 从前并非如此。不，在万物初醒的黎明，他们曾以沉寂之心漫游宇宙。
“奇妙与亵渎”？我倒好奇起来了。
*一边低声咕哝“且生且饮”，一边往后退*

src: -ahh, mm, such spectacle. The statues within, a revelation to the eyes. Chandlers enough to drain your skins dry 'twixt Shallows and Beetle Moon.
zh: ——啊，嗯，好一派奇观。里面的雕像，真是眼前的启示。从浅滩到甲虫之月之间，灯烛多得足以把你皮囊里的水都耗干。

src: -here? Speak to my daughter through the east door, for herbs. And sitting Tam in the southeast has all manner of trinket, against his chests o' drawers.
zh: ——这里？想买草药，便从东门去找我女儿。东南边坐着的塔姆，柜子里装着各色小玩意。

src: -mm, Barathrumites. Strange draft o'those bearfolk. They, mm, hah. They care not overly for outsiders. I hope Argyve sold you not a better welcome than you'll have.
zh: ——嗯，巴拉斯鲁姆派。那群熊人来历古怪。嗯，他们，哈。不怎么把外人放在心上。我盼着阿尔吉夫没把你说得以为他们会待你更好。

src:
-mm, ah, =name=. Come see how the slynth have become a part of Joppa!

Some cared not for the slow pace of our lives and struck out on their own, and with their thews and wits I have no doubt they will live to find purpose. mm, others are welcome to grow and flourish here in our marshes.
zh:
嗯，啊，=name=。来看看斯林斯人如何融入约帕吧！

有些人不喜欢我们缓慢的生活步调，便自行出发了。凭他们的筋骨和才智，我相信他们定能活下去，找到自己的志向。嗯，其他人则可以在我们的沼泽里生根繁衍。

src: -mm, blessings upon your generous heart, =name=. I mean no slight to these slynth, but it is too great a favor you ask of the people of Joppa.
zh: ——嗯，愿慷慨之心蒙福，=name=。我并非轻视这些斯林斯，只是你所求之事，对约帕众人而言实在太难应允。

src: -mm, oh? A gyre wight, must be. They bind the teeth right up to their own gums, to make a show for the Girsh nephilim.
zh: ——嗯，哦？定是回旋尸鬼。他们把牙齿一直绑到自己的牙龈上，好在吉尔什拿非利人面前做出一副样子。

src: -mm, oh? In dyed robes, flashing gestures of hand? And ranting about pipe milk? A gyre wight, must be. They about worship the Girsh nephilim as gods.
zh: ——嗯？哦？身穿染色长袍，手势闪个不停？还嚷嚷管道奶？那定是回旋尸鬼。他们几乎把吉尔什拿非利人奉为神明。

src: -mm, oh? You're wondering if they might come to Joppa, then?
zh: ——嗯，哦？你是在想他们会不会来约帕，对吧？

src:
-mm, there? Land slopes up and is toothed in chrome steeples, ageless things. Looming over the old-earth tunnels, pillowed in rotting jungle and fungus groves. And broken against the mounts of the north, they are, in the shadow of the Spindle...

There are people, friends, communities. And friends-to-noone, too. History is thick as the high salt sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and where the past is ground up like matz meal, a mix of life sets in.

-mm, adventurous ones set off for their own splinter of artifact. To both Fates, life and death...
zh:
——嗯，那边？大地渐渐隆起，插满铬制尖塔；那些东西亘古不变。它们俯瞰旧世隧道，掩映在腐朽丛林与菌林之间。它们撞上北方山脉，矗立于纺锤的阴影之中……

那里有人，有朋友，有社群；也有无友无伴之人。=player.formalAddressTerm=，历史如高悬的盐日般厚重；往昔被碾作无酵饼屑，生命的杂糅便由此沉淀。

——嗯，爱冒险的人会启程，去寻自己的那一片遗物。无论命运赐予生抑或死……

src:
-mm, work? The farmers are plagued by cave vermin. You might speak to Mehmet o' there, by the southern watervine patch.

And Argyve, too, =player.formalAddressTerm=. The tinker. Always looking for trinkets to wire between, heh. Go through his hut of sheet metal, to the southwest.
zh:
——嗯，想找活干？农夫们正受洞窟害虫侵扰。你可以去南边的水藤田旁找梅赫梅特。

还有阿尔吉夫，=player.formalAddressTerm=。那位修补匠总在找小玩意来接线，呵。往西南去，穿过他的铁皮棚屋便是。

src: -mm, work? Try Argyve, =player.formalAddressTerm=. The tinker. Always looking for trinkets to wire between, heh. Go through his hut of sheet metal, to the southwest.
zh: ——嗯，想找活干？去找阿尔吉夫吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。那位修补匠总在找小玩意来接线，呵。往西南去，穿过他的铁皮棚屋便是。

src:
-mm, yes? Plagues, a chiliad old. Seven such: girshlings, darkness. mm, svardym-frog...

Ah, nephilim, too, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Girsh titans who eat the young of kith and kin. Sultan Resheph drove them under the earth, but do they stir??
zh:
——嗯，是啊？那些古老的瘟疫。共有七种：吉尔什幼体、黑暗、嗯，斯瓦迪姆蛙……

啊，还有拿非利人，=player.formalAddressTerm=。吉尔什巨人，以族中幼者为食。苏丹利悉把他们赶入地下，可他们是否又在蠢动？？

src:
-mm, your luminous friends are settling in quite well.

There is yet a pall of ennui among some, but such is the case for any party of brave migrants. Ah, they will find their ground or their path, all in time. Some farmers show some small discomfort but that will pass in time.
zh:
嗯，你那些发光的朋友安顿得很好。

有些人仍旧郁郁寡欢，但任何一群勇敢的迁徙者都会如此。啊，他们终会找到立足之地，或是自己的道路。有些农夫略感不自在，时日一长也会过去。

src:
-mm. Mmm? =player.FormalAddressTerm=?

{{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}

Live and drink. Come in- come sit 'neath the cool shade, 'cross a pillow there. And welcome to Joppa.

You may drink of our freshwater, too, and quench your thirst.
zh:
——嗯。嗯？=player.FormalAddressTerm=？

{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老微笑。*}}

且生且饮。进来——来这片清凉的树荫下坐坐，坐在那边的垫子上。欢迎来到约帕。

你也可以喝些我们的淡水，解解渴。

src:
-mm? No, =player.formalAddressTerm=! Your finding is rich in value to us. We are poor farmers, and sharpen our vinereapers is all we can do. But others? Perhaps more.

Take these prickly-boons as thanks. mm, I will not soon forget this, =name=. Leave me now to muse, kindly...
zh:
——嗯？不，=player.formalAddressTerm=！你带来的发现对我们意义重大。我们不过是穷苦农夫，所能做的只有磨利割藤刀。但旁人或许能做得更多。

收下这些带刺的谢礼吧。嗯，我不会很快忘记此事，=name=。请让我独自沉思一会儿……

src:
-this? Oh? Oh...

{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses for several minutes.*}}

Warted leg? mm. Foul smell of sour gum? mmm. Moon and sun....

A girshling? This is a girshling.
zh:
——这个？哦？哦……

{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老沉默了几分钟。*}}

长疣的腿？嗯。酸胶的恶臭？嗯……月与日……

吉尔什幼体？这是只吉尔什幼体。

src:
-this? The oasis-hamlet. 'Neath the shelf of the world. A million breaths of salt the wind heaves over the Great Salt Desert Moghra'yi. And to the east, the rotting jungles of Qud.

Here in the crack between the two, watervine can grow, and we grow it. mmm, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
zh:
——这里？绿洲村落。世界的崖棚之下。咸风从大盐沙漠莫格拉伊吹来，卷过百万缕盐尘。往东，则是卡德腐朽的丛林。

夹在两者之间的这道裂隙里，水藤得以生长，我们便种植水藤。嗯，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

src:
-what?

No, no, I'm far too engrossed to see to your curiosity. I'm sure the Barathrumites have something for you to do.
zh:
——什么？

不，不，我正全神贯注，没空理会你的好奇心。想必巴拉斯鲁姆派有事让你去做。

src: -yes. You must seek out Barathrum the Old, the eldest and wisest tinker alive. He lives with his followers the Barathrumites under the arch of Grit Gate to the northeast, in the jungle-strangled ruins of Qud. He will know what to make of the signal.
zh: ——能。你须去寻老巴拉斯鲁姆，在世的修补匠中最年长、最睿智者。他与门下的巴拉斯鲁姆派，住在东北方砂砾门的拱门之下，那是卡德被丛林勒缠的废墟。他会知道这信号作何解。

src:
...

And? Is that the whole of your fool statement?
zh:
……

然后呢？你那蠢话就这么多？

src:
...  I do not like this.

I know you will go. Please take care where you dig; mopango wanderers say the hot blood of Eater artifice yet runs in the guts of that place.
zh:
……我不喜欢这样。

我知道你会去的。挖掘时请多加小心；莫潘戈的漫游者说，食者巧工的滚烫热血，至今仍在那地方的肠腹中流淌。

src: ... I've shaken the wet life from my hair. Now I shall cross into Brightsheol.
zh: ……我已将湿润的生命从发间抖落。如今我要越入明冥。

src: .....oh... oh? Peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled Lamb.
zh: ……哦……哦？愿所有在盘羔之殿中驰骋的人，平安。

src:
.....oh.... oh.... Poor friend. The ironshank must be upsetting your digestion. The darkness must be blooming in your brain, making you slow and doltish.

The sultanate dissolved? Tidings would have reached me.... someone would have said so....

Oh... poor, doltish friend. You cantered too long outside the House of the Coiled Lamb, and now you are a dolt.
zh:
……哦……哦……可怜的朋友。铁胫症一定搅乱了你的脾胃。黑暗一定在你脑中滋长，使你迟钝而愚笨。

苏丹国解体了？消息总该传到我这里……总会有人说起的……

哦……可怜愚笨的朋友。你在盘羔之殿外驰骋得太久，如今成了个蠢货。

src:
...?

=ifplayerplural:Ye ask:Thou askest= after the meaning of my credo. Wouldst I shall chew =ifplayerplural:your:thy= food for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= as well?
zh:
……？

=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=在询问我信条的含义。难道我还要连=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=的饭食也一并替=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=嚼碎么？

src:
...oh..... I am Herododicus, lapidary, lithographer, sculptor, calciminer, and biographer to the Coiled Lamb. I will tarry here until the Godhead passes on, and then I will canonize his deeds in high relief.

I've tarried for quite some time, now.... What a prodigious reign! Bless that Coiled Lamb!
zh:
……哦……我是希罗多狄库斯，石匠、石版师、雕塑师、石灰粉刷匠，亦是盘羔的传记作者。我会在此流连，直到神首驾崩，而后将他的功业以高浮雕封存为典。

我已流连了好久好久……这是何等煊赫的统治！愿那盘羔蒙福！

src:
=factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=! You have my deepest gratitude. Few =player.personTerm|pluralize= could have defended Grit Gate so deftly.

Now, give me time to assess our losses and consult with Barathrum. Return soon.
zh:
=factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=！我对你深怀感激。能如此娴熟地保卫砂砾门的=player.personTerm|pluralize=，寥寥无几。

现在，容我清点损失，并与巴拉斯鲁姆商议。稍后再来。

src: =factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=, I have no further instructions for you yet. Return soon.
zh: =factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=，我暂时还没有进一步的指示。过会儿再来。

src:
=factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= done a momentous thing.

I feel the stored energy of Her Light. Dagasha shall shepherd us to our uplifting. =ifplayerplural:Ye should:Thou shouldst= be proud.
zh:
=factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=，=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=做了一件意义重大的事。

我感到她之光所蕴的蓄能。达加沙将牧领我们走向升华。=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=应当自豪。

src: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, I hear that =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= freed one of the children! I cannot wait to speak to it, but for now I must observe Nacham to see if this event hath affected it. =ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= welcome to watch too.
zh: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=，我听说=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=解放了一个孩子！我迫不及待想同它说话，但此刻我必须观察纳罕，看这一变故是否影响了它。=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=也欢迎一同观看。

src: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, welcome. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= done well to survive so long in this peculiar place.
zh: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=，欢迎。=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=能在这古怪之地活这么久，实属不易。

src: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=. =ifplayerplural:Ye did:Thou didst= rouse a child. Well done.
zh: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=。=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=唤醒了一个孩子。做得好。

src: =gospel= =spice:commonPhrases.inHonorOf.!random|capitalize=, the =faction.name= bestowed upon =spice.entity:name= a wedding gift they called =itemName=.
=gospel= =spice:commonPhrases.inHonorOf.!random|capitalize=, the =spice:professions.$profession.plural= bestowed upon =spice.entity:name= a wedding gift they called =itemName=.

=ifplayerplural:Did ye:Didst thou= truly free one of the children? I see =ifplayerplural:ye did:thou didst=. Congratulations.

Wouldst fain see Kah free, one day. I shall have to live a while and find a way.
zh:
=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=真的释放了一个孩子么？我看=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=是做到了。恭喜。

我也愿有朝一日见卡赫自由。我得活得久些，并找到那办法。

src:
=ifplayerplural:Have ye:Hast thou= seen it, out there? The spiny, eel-like creature. That is Dagasha, angry one, lost child. =ifplayerplural:Ye can:Thou canst= feel the hostility pour from it in waves.

Yet, it attacketh not.
zh:
=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=看见它了么，就在外头？那只多刺的、似鳗的生灵。那便是达加沙，愤怒的孩子，迷失的孩子。=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=能感到敌意如潮水般自它涌出。

然而，它并不攻击。

src: =ifplayerplural:May ye:Mayst thou= loose the bonds that keep =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= from =ifplayerplural:your:thy= goals, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Be free.
zh: 愿=ifplayerplural:你们:你=挣脱那些阻=ifplayerplural:你们:你=达成=ifplayerplural:你们的:你的=目标的束缚，=factionaddress:Mopango=。得享自由。

src:
=ifplayerplural:Seek-ye:Seekest-thou= the repulsive device, then?

k-Goninon, ancient and venerated gelatinous cupola, doth patrol the catacombs. Arrived centuries ere we discovered this place, k-Goninon hath hardened and eateth not through the floor, and yet it eateth prodigiously. Safe from the conservators, as k-Goninon long ago consumed the Mark of Death itself.

Please be careful. k-Goninon hath devoured watchers and wouldst devour =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= as well.
zh:
那么，=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=在寻那令人厌恶的装置么？

克-戈尼农，古老而受人尊崇的胶质穹顶，巡行于墓窟之间。它在我们发现此地数百年前便已到来，如今已然硬化，不再啃穿地板，却依旧食量惊人。它不惧保全者，因为克-戈尼农早已吞下了死亡印记本身。

请务必小心。克-戈尼农曾吞噬守望者，也会吞噬=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=。

src: =ifplayerplural:Would ye:Wouldst thou= press these slynth into the fissures of historic stone where we reside, that they may observe what we do?
zh: =ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=可愿将这些斯林斯嵌入我们栖居的古石裂隙，好让它们观察我们之所为？

src:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= an object of great interest.

An =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= allow, I'd fain commune with it.
zh:
=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=手中有一件极引人兴趣之物。

=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=若允许，我愿与它交感。

src:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.

I cannot help but hold some fear toward Dagasha. However, an it means us no harm I am open to allying with it. No doubt the future of this coterie hath changed, mayhap for the better.

=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.
zh:
=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=改变了世界，=factionaddress:Mopango=。这些奇异的存在被禁锢了数千年，而=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=赐予了其一个声音。

我不由对达加沙存有几分畏惧。然而，倘若它不怀恶意，我愿与之结盟。这一群的未来无疑已经改变，或许是向好的方向。

=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=在此始终受欢迎，无论何时，只要=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=愿意，皆可来此探访、小住。

src:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.

I find myself amused at Kah's 'rest', for it appeareth as active as ever--far more so than I, ever. But running free and running unwillingly are certainly not the same. Perhaps, in time, it can learn a deeper rest from us.

=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.
zh:
=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=改变了世界，=factionaddress:Mopango=。这些奇异的存在被禁锢了数千年，而=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=赐予了其一个声音。

卡赫的“安歇”令我莞尔，因为它看来仍一如既往地好动——远比我好动。然而自由奔跑与被迫奔跑，终究不可相提并论。或许假以时日，它能从我们这里习得更深的安息。

=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=在此始终受欢迎，无论何时，只要=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=愿意，皆可来此探访、小住。

src:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.

If Nacham is as wise as Doyoba believes, we stand to learn much very soon. Perhaps our coterie will spread the knowledge we gain, and we become a step closer to the Kasaphescence.

=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.
zh:
=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=改变了世界，=factionaddress:Mopango=。这些奇异的存在被禁锢了数千年，而=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=赐予了其一个声音。

若纳罕如多约巴所信的那般睿智，我们不久便将学到许多。或许我们这一群会将所得之知传播开去，让我们离圣化现更近一步。

=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=在此始终受欢迎，无论何时，只要=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=愿意，皆可来此探访、小住。

src:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.

That said, I am uncertain what changes to expect. Dost the ancient Va'am yet have the capacity to defend, or protect? Can we gift it with a better means for transportation? I'll speak to Dadogom of this, and time shall reveal all.

=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.
zh:
=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=改变了世界，=factionaddress:Mopango=。这些奇异的存在被禁锢了数千年，而=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=赐予了其一个声音。

话虽如此，我不确定该预期何种变化。古老的瓦阿姆是否仍有能力防卫，或庇护？我们可否赠它更好的代步之法？我会就此与达多戈姆商议，时间自会揭示一切。

=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=在此始终受欢迎，无论何时，只要=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=愿意，皆可来此探访、小住。

src:
=ifplayerplural:Ye know:Thou knowest= surely that this is the Tomb of the Eaters, but behind me lieth nestled a settlement occupied by the watchers of the tomb, a small coterie of mopango.

An =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= know more of the settlement, =ifplayerplural:ye:thou= must ask the watcher named Agyra residing within. Ey loveth the sharing of knowledge.
zh:
=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=想必知晓，此处乃食者之墓，而在我身后依偎着一处聚落，住着守墓的守望者，一小群莫潘戈。

=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=若想多了解这聚落，=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=须向居于其中的守望者阿吉拉请教。彼乐于分享知识。

src: =pronouns.Possessive= arachnid sternum and eight curling legs are flattened to paper thinness for slipping through the psychotectonic plates of spacetime. The light of two dimensions glances over =pronouns.objective=.
zh: =pronouns.Possessive=蛛形的胸板与八条蜷曲的腿被压得薄如纸片，好从时空的精神构造板块之间滑过。二维的光掠过=pronouns.objective=。

src: =pronouns.Possessive= big web feet slosh over the ground to convey =pronouns.possessive= little frog self. Laced stripes of plastiglomerate form decorative rings through =pronouns.possessive= nostrils and around her eyelids.
zh: =pronouns.Possessive=一双大蹼足在地面上拍溅，载着=pronouns.possessive=小小的蛙身前行。塑积岩编成的条纹穿过=pronouns.possessive=鼻孔，绕成装饰的环，也绕在她的眼睑四周。

src: =pronouns.Possessive= body is a clotted, finned cord that hovers and strums the air with magnetic force. Barbels crack out of =pronouns.possessive= mouth then sizzle and fry =pronouns.possessive= saliva.
zh: =pronouns.Possessive=身躯是一条凝块般生鳍的索，悬停于空，以磁力拨动空气。触须自=pronouns.possessive=口中噼啪迸出，把=pronouns.possessive=唾液煎得滋滋冒气。

src: =pronouns.Possessive= brim leaf flops down like a beaten hat and shades =pronouns.possessive= glowing eyes from the high salt sun. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:wield:afterpronoun= a vinereaper with practiced care around =pronouns.possessive= tender and scythable roots.
zh: =pronouns.Possessive=的帽檐叶像一顶被打瘪的帽子耷拉下来，为=pronouns.possessive=发光的双眼遮住盐地高悬的烈日。=pronouns.Subjective=熟练而小心地握着一柄割藤镰，绕着=pronouns.possessive=那娇嫩易割的根须挥动。

src: =pronouns.Possessive= curling horns are incised with the weathering script of time, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:chew:afterpronoun= cud without a care for the mess in =pronouns.possessive= hairknot beard.
zh: =pronouns.Possessive=弯角上刻着风化的时间之文，=pronouns.subjective=不理会=pronouns.possessive=结成毛团的胡须里沾着的草屑，只管反刍。

src: =pronouns.Possessive= cylindric head is embellished with a frilly crest whose symbolism is unknown. =pronouns.Subjective= dutifully =verb:march:afterpronoun= on a pair of chrome pistons toward =pronouns.possessive= final purpose.

src: =pronouns.Possessive= deepest encoding is the moral imperative: 'extinguish spatial and temporal anomalies, be they from happenstance, maleficence, or planar kismet.'
zh: =pronouns.Possessive=最深层的编码是一道道德律令：“熄灭时空之异变，无论其出自偶然、恶意，抑或位面之天命。”

src: =pronouns.Possessive= eyes pierce the packed soil and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:rub:afterpronoun= clay between =pronouns.possessive= fingers.
zh: =pronouns.Possessive=的目光穿透夯实的泥土，=pronouns.subjective=用=pronouns.possessive=的指间揉搓着黏土。

src: =pronouns.Possessive= face is small and shorn of all fur, and a gleaming silver rondure adorns =pronouns.possessive= right ear. All =pronouns.possessive= quills are trimmed to impeccable precision.
zh: =pronouns.Possessive=脸小而剔尽了=pronouns.possessive=所有的毛，=pronouns.possessive=右耳上饰着一枚锃亮的银环。=pronouns.Possessive=通身的刺都修得齐整无比。

src: =pronouns.Possessive= face is tender, clean, and dotted with tiny furs. =pronouns.Possessive= head-hair is gelatinized and shaped into a sharp rectangle. =pronouns.Possessive= eyes are light and wide. Weird clothes hang about =pronouns.possessive= narrow frame, and =pronouns.possessive= fingers fidget in patterned asynchronicity. Occasionally =pronouns.subjective= =verb:beam:afterpronoun= a grin and =verb:freeze:afterpronoun= =pronouns.possessive= motion before resuming as if nothing happened.
zh: =pronouns.Possessive=脸柔嫩干净，缀着细小的=pronouns.possessive=绒毛。=pronouns.Possessive=头发胶凝成形，修成一个利落的方框。=pronouns.Possessive=双眼浅淡而圆大。古怪的衣裳挂在=pronouns.possessive=窄小的身架上，=pronouns.possessive=手指则按着有韵律的错拍不安分地动着。时不时，=pronouns.subjective=绽开一个笑，又把动作冻住，随后若无其事地继续。

src: =pronouns.Possessive= finger stems have grown to tinkering length, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:tauten:afterpronoun= =pronouns.possessive= roots' grip on the underearth to augment the torque of =pronouns.possessive= wrench turns.
zh: =pronouns.Possessive=的指茎已长到可作修补之用的长度，=pronouns.subjective=绷紧=pronouns.possessive=扎在地下的根须，以增强=pronouns.possessive=扳手转动时的扭力。

src: =pronouns.Possessive= finger stems pop and slide o'er a wooden flute, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:shuffle:afterpronoun= a lateral jig on pleated roots. The petals of =pronouns.possessive= crowning flower shift colors in happy simultaneity.

src: A backlength snood flops in metamorphic caprice as the death/life acolyte skips to the threnodies of star and home.
zh: 一条垂至背长的头巾随性善变，翻飞不定，这位死与生的侍僧正踏着星辰与故乡的挽歌蹦跳而行。

src: A baetyl, you see, will answer your prayers.
zh: 你们看，圣石会回应祷告。

src:
A bangle clasp features a bright cobalt button.
"You think this is the real =name=? It is."
zh:
腕环扣上有一枚明亮的钴蓝按钮。
“你以为这是真的=name=？没错，就是。”

src: A beak thins to a long point for pecking through shell and bone.
zh: 一张喙渐渐收细为长长的尖端，专为啄穿壳与骨。

src: A big mound of wet hair and rotting flesh puts some elevation to the ground.
zh: 一大堆湿毛与腐肉，给地面添了些起伏。

src: A bilge hose painted with mucus undulates out of your lower body. It spews the amniotic broth of its birth from its sputtering mouth.
zh: 一条沾满黏液、绘着花纹的污水软管自你下身蠕动而出。它从咝咝作响的口中喷出诞生时的羊水浓汤。

src: A black and grated metal platform is meadowed with the dust of time. It's crisscrossed with the tracks of tiny lifethings.
zh: 一方漆黑的格栅金属台，落满了时间的尘埃，又横七竖八印着细小生灵的足迹。

src: A black particle defies the light-drenched world and charts a helical orbit.
zh: 一粒黑色微粒违逆这光色浸透的世界，描出一道螺旋轨迹。

src: A blade of considerable length runs through a strange hilt.
zh: 一截相当长的刃身贯穿一具奇异的柄。

src: A bladed edge hangs over a finger-smudged haft.
zh: 刃口悬在一根沾着指印的柄上。

src: A blinding network of homesuns flicker in parallactic motion. Their systems are joined in the manifold by trade routes, shifting sovereign borders, and the convergence of galactic clusters. Smaller ligatures denote the personal notes of a vast travelogue, turning the whole picture into a hyperdimensional narrative.
zh: 一张耀目的家乡之日的网络，以视差之态闪烁。其星系在流形中，由贸易航线、变动的主权边界与银河星团的汇合连接在一起。较小的连字标注着一部浩大游记的私人笔记，使整幅图景化为一篇超维度的叙事。

src: A block of bright steel was sharpened to an edge.
zh: 一块亮钢，被磨出了锋刃。

src: A blooming kitesail of extrasolar flax is knitted on battens to catch the poison air of some faraway swamp planetoid and power an ecumenical cycle. Its clews are stitched with syncretic plethora from across the dreaming gamut.
zh: 一面盛放的风筝帆，以太阳系外的亚麻织成，缝在撑条上，用以捕捉某颗遥远沼泽小行星的毒气，驱动一场普世的轮回。其帆角缝缀着横跨梦境全谱的混合繁华。

src: A blue kite flaunts the hieroglyphs of tooth and claw.
zh: 一面蓝色鸢盾，炫示着齿与爪的象形文字。

src: A blurry film cordons off a wedge of spacetime with so much quantum friction that its inhabitants are ground to a halt.
zh: 一层模糊的薄膜围出一楔时空，其间量子摩擦之大，令其中居民寸步难行。

src: A blushing cheek of mined iron was hammered to a wheel for arm defense.
zh: 一块脸颊泛红般的矿铁，被锤成圆盘，用以护臂。

src: A body time-fit to living in the smalls of spiral roots is kept warm by a layer of symbiotic moss-fur. Bright eyes scan the forest points and then soften toward the stars.
zh: 一副久已适居于螺旋根隙间的身子，靠一层共生的藓毛保暖。明亮的双眼扫视林间四方，随后又柔缓地转向星辰。

src: A body time-fit to living in the smalls of spiral roots is kept warm by a layer of symbiotic moss-fur. Bright, scanning eyes peer out the selfsame mask of =pronouns.possessive= minyan, making =pronouns.possessive= face a blazing portrait of togetherness- laced, burned, and painted to point.
zh: 一副久已适居于螺旋根隙间的身子，靠一层共生的藓毛保暖。明亮而四下扫视的双眼自=pronouns.possessive=十人团共有的同一副面具中窥出，使=pronouns.possessive=面孔成一幅炽烈的同心之像——以缀系、灼烧与彩绘点出其意。

src: A bolt of stretchy, spun fabric was cut to a bodysuit for sneaking.
zh: 一匹有弹性的织物被裁成紧身衣，专供潜行之用。

src: A bowed lune is cracked from where it was smashed off the gallium lathe. The shedim had no eyes left to color the dim and final Face, and it lay too long discarded in a pool of warm static. The sultanate is broken.
zh: 一弯弓形月牙，从镓车床上砸落时裂开。谢德已没有眼睛可为这幽暗的末张面容上色，它被弃置在一池温热的静电中太久。苏丹国已然破碎。

src: A braid of roasted frogskin stretches taut over =pronouns.possessive= swollen pectorals and fastens a satchel to =pronouns.possessive= hip. =pronouns.Possessive= hooves are stained with an unclassified mixture of blood, and spittle flies from =pronouns.possessive= bleating mouth into a tuft of scraggle chin-hair.
zh: 一条烤蛙皮编成的带子紧紧绷在=pronouns.possessive=鼓胀的胸肌上，把一只挎包系在=pronouns.possessive=腰间。=pronouns.Possessive=蹄上沾着未能归类的血，唾沫自=pronouns.possessive=咩叫的嘴里飞进一簇乱蓬的颏须。

src: A branch trellis of crystalline thorn-hair has been contorted to iconic cross shape. The enterer is forced to become concave.
zh: 一座晶刺毛发的枝形棚架，被扭成标志性的十字之形。入者被迫变得凹陷。

src: A brass hem surrounds a foam shunting pad, and the above-head fretwork is braided into the once-familiar glyphs of exit symbology.
zh: 黄铜之缘环绕着一块泡沫分流垫，头顶的格栅编织成早已熟悉的出口符号。

src: A bridge made of dried brinestalk.
zh: 一座以干燥盐茎搭成的桥。

src: A bright chrome clasp was pried off the glass guts of the polis and etched as jewelry.
zh: 一枚明亮的铬搭扣，自城邦的玻璃肺腑中撬下，蚀刻成了首饰。

src: A bright gashead tips the end of the steely death chute.
zh: 一枚亮闪闪的刃头，缀在这钢色死亡滑槽的末端。

src: A brightly burning handfire hangs across wood and iron.
zh: 一团明亮燃烧的手火悬于木与铁之间。

src: A broad tube of pipeline copper is a makeshift gorget. It's splashed in patterns of worm blood and sea rust.
zh: 一截宽阔的输油铜管，权作护喉甲。其上溅满蠕虫之血与海锈的斑纹。

src: A broad, flat shell in the hue of air-sucked iron has started to flake in a verdigral pattern. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:shake:afterpronoun= a single monstrous, serrated claw, caked in a year's worth of Red Death, the eroded metal dust.
zh: 一片宽而扁的壳，色如被抽空空气的铁，已开始以铜绿之纹起鳞剥落。=pronouns.Subjective=挥动一只巨硕的锯齿螯，其上结着一年份的红死——那被侵蚀的金属尘。

src: A brushed metal pyramid floats in place and shoulders an array of stemmed articulators, some holding scalpels, some suturers, and all dripping with the amniotic draught of life.
zh: 一座打磨过的金属锥体悬空浮着，肩上驮着一列带柄的关节器，有的握着手术刀，有的持着缝合器，全都滴着生命那羊水般的浆液。

src: A bubbled ribbon of carbon motes lathed to the thickness of paper combs against its anchoring mechanisms and disappears skyward to a tapered nothing.
zh: 一条由碳尘微粒车削至纸张般薄的泡状缎带，抵着它的锚固机构梳过，朝天而去，消失于渐细为无的尽头。

src: A bug-swathed rump of mangy fur sways in peaceful and goatish rhythms.
zh: 一只蝇虫缠身、皮毛疥癣的臀部，伴着安宁而山羊般的节奏摇摆。

src: A bulb of stone is dusted by humoric powders.
zh: 一团石球，蒙着一层体液般的粉尘。

src: A bulge-eye head and stretched thorax of sunsalt white is poised to leap through the air by the trust of a sestet of bounding legs.
zh: 一颗鼓凸大眼的头与一段拉伸的、太阳盐白的胸节，凭六条弹跳之腿的推力，蓄势腾空。

src: A burning Y of dried wood and cupped iron light the domiciles.
zh: 一个由干木与杯状铁器构成的燃烧的Y字，照亮了众家宅邸。

src: A burning flame of amber floats below a psychic wick.
zh: 一团琥珀色的烈焰，悬浮于心灵灯芯之下。

src: A burnished steel jacket hugs a smoldering fire pit. Scorchstrokes of many materials cake its sides.
zh: 一只擦亮的钢套箍着闷烧的火坑。各种材料的焦痕在它的侧壁上结成硬壳。

src: A burnt out wood core is enveloped in footprinted ash.
zh: 一截烧尽的木芯，裹在印满足迹的灰烬之中。

src: A calcerous shell was chopped off at the tip. Its whorls impress the eye with pleasing geometry before swerving to uncomfortable and dizzying disharmony.
zh: 一枚钙质的贝壳被斩去尖端。其螺纹以悦目的几何打动眼睛，随后陡然转为令人不适、头晕目眩的失谐。

src: A calcerous shell was whittled to a hoop dress. Its whorls impress the eye with pleasing geometry before swerving to uncomfortable and dizzying disharmony.
zh: 一枚钙质的贝壳被削成箍裙。其螺纹以悦目的几何打动眼睛，随后陡然转为令人不适、头晕目眩的失谐。

src: A cameo of meteorite sardonyx bears an unknown clan sigil in florid script, serifed with tiny gears and sails.
zh: 一枚陨石缠丝玛瑙的浮雕，上刻着一枚不知名氏族的徽记，字体华丽，其衬线以微小的齿轮与风帆为饰。

src: A candescent shard of crystal is sat in the core of =pronouns.possessive= flower crown and glows with sightfulness in place of eyes. All about =pronouns.possessive= verdurous body, the air vibrates with a raspy hum.
zh: 一枚炽亮的水晶碎片嵌在=pronouns.possessive=花冠的中心，代替眼睛，闪着视觉之光。=pronouns.possessive=青翠的躯体四周，空气因沙哑的嗡鸣而震颤。

src: A candle quartz blossom spreads light across the color spectrum and concentrates it in pails of petals.
zh: 烛晶花绽放，将光铺展过整条光谱，又把它聚进满盈的花瓣之桶。

src: A cannister of blast is sheathed in undeciphered metal.
zh: 一罐爆裂之物，裹在无法辨读的金属外壳里。

src: A canyon pearl fastens sandal straps embroidered in the syncretic imagery of swiftwater nymphs. Like the glacier flow itself, the veneration of Calypso moved with the mystai down the sundered honeycomb and in through the shale fissures beneath the olive mount. There it fractured into the mysteries of the many-named wives, where the memory of freshwater became more faceted than its smooth surface of origin.
zh: 一枚峡谷珍珠扣住凉鞋的系带，带上绣着急流水仙的混合圣像。如冰川之流，对卡吕普索的崇奉随着秘仪信众顺着破碎的蜂巢而下，自页岩裂隙钻入橄榄山之下。在那里，它碎裂为多名之妻的诸多秘仪，淡水的记忆比其原初光滑的表面更多棱多面。

src: A cap of gunk material that arconauts call black stretch was fished from rubber grottos and stuck to the scalp.
zh: 一顶以黏稠物质制成的帽，方舟航行者称之为黑弹胶；它自橡胶洞窟中钓起，粘在头皮上。

src: A carpet of spent and damp sporophytes dither in glutted ecstasy on the calcified trellis. They sucked blood from the life-wet beings around them and grew the scaffolding bone, whose superior extremity terminates in a monstrous beak.
zh: 一层枯竭而潮湿的孢子体在钙化的棚架上饱食至狂喜，战栗不已。它们自周围润泽着生命的活物身上吸饱鲜血，长成这副骨质的棚架，其顶端终于化作一只怪诞的喙。

src: A cased rotor is fed charge through a handcrank and supplemented by solar heat. Its scratched metal surfaces vibrate at ground frequency.
zh: 一具带壳的转子由手摇柄充电，又以太阳之热补足。它刮花的金属表面以大地频率震颤。

src: A cassette is cut with hexagonal grooves and steeped in the right amount of magnetic charge to spool a spacetime tether (and generate its characteristic hot gum smell). On top, a recessed button snaps the potential and initiates the recoil.
zh: 一盒磁带刻有六角形沟槽，浸透了恰当分量的磁荷，足以卷绕出一道时空系绳（并散发其特有的热胶气味）。顶上一枚凹陷的按钮，一按便绷断势能，启动反冲。

src: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It shifts perspective in low light.
zh: 一枚铸铁圆球，由带拉环的拉杆扣紧。在微光下，其形貌似随视角游移变换。

src: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It sizzles and swells inside.
zh: 一枚铸铁圆球，由带拉环的拉杆扣紧。其内嘶嘶作响，并渐渐鼓胀。

src: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It sizzles inside.
zh: 一枚铸铁圆球，由带拉环的拉杆扣紧。其内嘶嘶作响。

src: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It sparkles in soft light.
zh: 一枚铸铁圆球，由带拉环的拉杆扣紧。在柔光下闪烁生辉。

src: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's cold to the touch.
zh: 一枚铸铁圆球，由带拉环的拉杆扣紧。触手冰寒。

src: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with a boquet of inward-facing arrows.
zh: 一枚铸铁圆球，由带拉环的拉杆扣紧。其上蚀刻着一束向内收拢的箭矢。

src: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with a bouquet of outward-facing arrows.
zh: 一枚铸铁圆球，由带拉环的拉杆扣紧。其上蚀刻着一束向外绽射的箭矢。

src: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with a picture of an eye.
zh: 一枚铸铁圆球，由带拉环的拉杆扣紧。其上蚀刻着一只眼睛的图样。

src: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with a zigzag.
zh: 一枚铸铁圆球，由带拉环的拉杆扣紧。其上蚀刻着一道之字折线。

src: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with pictorals of withering fungi.
zh: 一枚铸铁圆球，由带拉环的拉杆扣紧。其上蚀刻着枯萎菌类的图画。

src: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with pictorals of withering plants.
zh: 一枚铸铁圆球，由带拉环的拉杆扣紧。其上蚀刻着枯萎植物的图画。

src: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with stop symbology.
zh: 一枚铸铁圆球，由带拉环的拉杆扣紧。其上蚀刻着表示“止”的符号。

src: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's etched with the crossbones of danger.
zh: 一枚铸铁圆球，由带拉环的拉杆扣紧。其上蚀刻着象征危险的交叉骨。

src: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. It's hot to the touch.
zh: 一枚铸铁圆球，由带拉环的拉杆扣紧。触手滚烫。

src: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. Its cap is lined with sharp edges.
zh: 一枚铸铁圆球，由带拉环的拉杆扣紧。其顶盖周缘生满锐棱。

src: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. Its lug is damp with dream dew.
zh: 一枚铸铁圆球，由带拉环的拉杆扣紧。其耳柄上沾着梦之露，湿漉漉的。

src: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. Its lug is ringed with dial ticks.
zh: 一枚铸铁圆球，由带拉环的拉杆扣紧。其耳柄周围环刻着一圈刻度。

src: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. The lever is buoyed by a multidirectional spring-loaded mechanism.
zh: 一枚铸铁圆球，由带拉环的拉杆扣紧。拉杆由一套可向多方向弹动的弹簧机构托起。

src: A cast iron bulb is clamped by a lever with a pull ring. The shell is etched with latticework.
zh: 一枚铸铁圆球，由带拉环的拉杆扣紧。外壳上蚀刻着格栅纹样。

src: A caudal barb-thing is tipped with a jewel of venomed dew.
zh: 一根尾部的倒刺状之物，尖端缀着一颗带毒的露珠，宛如宝石。

src: A ceremonial chrome wheel clicks to moon time, and the grip medallion shines in delphian lineage.
zh: 一枚典礼用铬轮依月相而咔嗒转动，握把上的徽章闪耀着神谕世系的光辉。

src: A chalky white cap of rice lattice sucks the salt from liquid volumes. The letter 'H' is etched on its face.
zh: 一顶白垩色的米格盖帽，能从液体中吸尽盐分。其面上蚀着字母“H”。

src: A chiliad chitter-totters bugcrawl the S-shaped lifething across the ground. =pronouns.Possessive= chitin discs sharpen to quill points in tufts along =pronouns.possessive= back, outnumbering even =pronouns.possessive= legs by hundreds.
zh: 千足唧唧地小步疾爬，把这S形的活物拖过地面。=pronouns.Possessive=甲盘在=pronouns.possessive=背上成簇地锐成翎尖，数目比=pronouns.possessive=腿还多数百。

src: A chipped-off chunk of Spindle, magnetized by the fall to earth, orbits its chosen warden.
zh: 一块自纺锤崩落的碎块，因坠地而带上磁性，绕着它选定的守护者盘旋。

src: A chipped-off chunk of luminous Spindle, magnetized by the fall to earth, orbits its chosen warden.
zh: 一块自发光的纺锤崩落的碎块，因坠地而带上磁性，绕着它选定的守护者盘旋。

src: A choice cut of laminated sponge was carved into serving slices. They jiggle to the touch.
zh: 一块上选的叠层海绵被切成上桌的薄片，指尖一触便颤。

src: A chopped tongue was soured in its own saliva and twisted around a stick.
zh: 一条切下的舌头在自己分泌的唾液中发酸，又绕在一根棍上。

src: A chrome and quartz-dusted honeycomb mounts the viewing plane and threatens obliteration to all. Bar weldings bend to its gigantic weight, and rocketheads peak out of hexagonal hive.
zh: 一枚镀铬、覆着石英粉的蜂巢，架着观测平面，向一切威胁着毁灭。条焊在其庞大的重量下弯曲，火箭头从六角形的蜂房中探出。

src: A chrome chain wraps around a self-winding flywheel and is spotted with grease dew. One long barrel is nicked with steel scarring.
zh: 一条铬链缠绕在自动上弦的飞轮上，点点润滑油如露。一根长枪管上留着钢的刮痕。

src: A chrome obelisk bedims the floor in =pronouns.possessive= gigantic shadow, and metal comes screeching to genuflect at =pronouns.possessive= base.
zh: 一座镀铬的方尖碑以=pronouns.possessive=庞大的影子使地面昏暗，金属则尖啸着前来，在=pronouns.possessive=基座前屈膝。

src: A chute of superconductive timber is keyed to rhyme with adjacent leylines and furnish a frictionless glide.
zh: 一道超导木材的滑槽，被调校得与相邻地脉合韵，使人得以无摩擦地滑行。

src: A clan of contoured petals upfold to a florid bowl. Sharp current climbs =pronouns.possessive= filament and hops from anther to anther, while the dirt stutters under =pronouns.possessive= digging roots.
zh: 一族轮廓分明的花瓣向上叠成一只绚烂的碗。锐利的电流爬上=pronouns.possessive=花丝，从一枚花药跳到另一枚，而泥土在=pronouns.possessive=掘地的根下颤动。

src: A cleft in the red stone opens to a waterspray of underearth.
zh: 红石裂隙豁然敞开，地下世界的水雾扑面而来。

src: A clump of brassy metal was tumbled free of its host rock.
zh: 一团黄铜色的金属，自母岩中翻滚脱出。

src: A clump of metal shines in the jeweler's hue of bright sunslag.
zh: 一团金属，闪着珠宝匠所称的明亮日渣之色。

src: A clump of metal shines in the starbright hue.
zh: 一团金属，闪着星辉之色。

src: A cluster of pluming feathers draw out the shape of the face in splendid color.
zh: 一簇蓬散的羽毛，以绚烂的色彩勾勒出面庞的轮廓。

src: A coarse flax waist is cinched with a watervine hemp rope.
zh: 一条粗亚麻的腰裙，以水藤麻绳束紧。

src: A coded rectangle of paper metal can be slid through lock mechanisms to open some types of doors.
zh: 一片带编码的纸金属长方片，可滑入锁具机关，开启某些种类的门。

src: A coffin of steel, brass, and cathode tube conceals an array of precision instruments used to suck organ-matter from the dead and deliver it back to kith and kin.
zh: 钢、黄铜与阴极管造就的棺椁，内藏一列精密仪器，用以自死者身上抽取器官之质，再送还其亲族眷属。

src:
A connoisseur of liquids. Sure, I dabble in other states of matter.

But I prefer the shifting and tumbling of angleless motion.

Not too hot, not too cold, not too indeterminate.
zh:
是个爱液体的行家。不错，别的物态我也略有涉猎。

但我偏爱无棱之动的流转翻滚。

不太热，不太冷，不太无定。

src: A constellation of bells cast from the local cluster's different lustrous hardrocks gives sonic depth and range to the mover rituals.
zh: 一簇钟，以本星团各色光泽的硬岩铸成，给搬运者的仪式添以声音的深度与广度。

src: A contoured, plasteel body-plate absorbs impact shock and disintegrates into the bloodstream.
zh: 一块塑钢制成的曲面护板，吸收冲击之力，而后消解于血流之中。

src: A coolant pipe and an antifreeze pipe are barrel-locked in symmetric geometry. Thumb flips rotate the mechanism and reverse their orientation.
zh: 一根冷却管与一根防冻管，以对称的几何结构锁在枪管上。拇指一拨，机关旋转，将它们的朝向颠倒。

src: A cord extruded from metal ore conducts current when laid together.
zh: 一根由金属矿石抽出的线缆，搭接在一起便可导电。

src: A cord of gold wire fished from the computing guts of the underearth lace the shoe-tailored leather of a dead boar.
zh: 一根金线，取自地底深处的计算内脏，缠缚在一头死野猪裁成鞋形的皮革上。

src: A corm of bell bronze is screw-fitted to a scarred wooden shaft.
zh: 一枚钟青铜的球茎，以螺纹嵌在伤痕累累的木柄上。

src: A corm of polished steel is blown out of a combat-pecked rod.
zh: 一枚抛光钢的球茎，自一根经战斗啄琢的长杆上吹塑而出。

src: A corsage of curls spill over dwarf horns, and there is less tension about =pronouns.possessive= hind hips than most animals.
zh: 一束卷曲的花饰披落在矮小的角上，而=pronouns.possessive=后胯的紧张程度亦不及多数走兽。

src: A crag-being of hardened clay has hair and grass growing between the pressure cracks on =pronouns.possessive= shoulders and back.
zh: 一尊硬化黏土的崖岩之灵，=pronouns.possessive=肩背的压力裂缝间生出毛发与青草。

src: A creature of immensity mounts the upper eyeline and radiates Godlight. Haunches dusted with Spindle glitter support a creature-shape sketched to being by the sentient background radiation of this plane, and wide, banded wings are edged to soar on stellar winds. Finally, irisdual light churning under =pronouns.possessive= tx-glass skin is refracted to the metaspectrum of impossibility and spills out of body in cornu spirals.
zh: 一尊庞然巨物攀上视线之上缘，放射着神光。双髋洒满纺锤微光，托起一具由此界有知觉的背景辐射勾勒成形的生灵之躯；宽大的带纹双翼，其缘锋利，宜于乘星风翱翔。最后，在=pronouns.possessive=那透传玻璃般的肌肤之下，翻涌的虹彩之光被折射进不可能之超光谱，化作螺旋曲线自体内倾泻而出。

src: A creature of immensity mounts the upper eyeline. =pronouns.Possessive= throat corded like the tree-hugged Svy honks the Coronach of Numbers out a monadic bill. The feathers of =pronouns.possessive= gigantic kite train iridesce in Spindle glitter and cohere to a vexing picture of universal wrongness. Finally, irisdual light churning under =pronouns.possessive= tx-glass skin is filtered to a dazzling hue and radiates out of body in lituus spirals.
zh: 一头庞然之物攀上视野的上沿。=pronouns.Possessive=喉筋络盘结，如那被树木环抱的斯维河；它自一张单子似的喙中嘶鸣出《数之挽歌》。=pronouns.possessive=那庞大如鸢的尾羽在纺锤的微光中变幻虹彩，聚成一幅令人不安的宇宙错谬之图。最后，虹双之光在=pronouns.possessive=玻璃似的皮下翻涌，滤成炫目之色，以号角卷曲的螺旋自体中辐射而出。

src: A creature of immensity mounts the upper eyeline. Leather trapezii swell with the pump of overfurcate capillaries, vapor attaches to =pronouns.possessive= starless nares, and long hand-feet fork into a hundred digits each. Over the raw humps of =pronouns.possessive= body, even the deadest of lifegrowth (hair, nails) is quickened to act and writhes like startled maggots. Finally, irisdual light churning under =pronouns.possessive= tx-glass skin is filtered to a viscus hue and radiates out of body in lituus spirals.
zh: 一头庞然之物攀上视野的上沿。皮革般的斜方肌随过度分叉的毛细血管鼓胀，雾气凝在=pronouns.possessive=无星的鼻孔上，修长的手足各分作百指。在=pronouns.possessive=身体那些生涩的隆起之上，连最死的生命衍生物（毛发、指甲）也被催得动起来，如受惊的蛆虫般扭动。最后，虹双之光在=pronouns.possessive=玻璃似的皮下翻涌，滤成内脏之色，以号角卷曲的螺旋自体中辐射而出。

src: A creature of immensity mounts the upper eyeline. Quantized force has shaped =pronouns.possessive= behemoth muzzle to an uncanny square-shape, and tresses of potential energy wash =pronouns.possessive= withers to an unmeaning blur. Beneath =pronouns.possessive= slumping barrel, elephantine knees are locked at right angles. Finally, irisdual light churning under =pronouns.possessive= tx-glass skin is filtered to a polar hue and radiates out of body in lituus spirals.
zh: 一头庞然之物攀上视野的上沿。量子化的力把=pronouns.possessive=巨兽般的口鼻塑成诡异的方形，一缕缕势能洗过=pronouns.possessive=肩脊，化作毫无意义的模糊。在=pronouns.possessive=塌垂的桶状身躯之下，象一般的膝以直角锁死。最后，虹双之光在=pronouns.possessive=玻璃似的皮下翻涌，滤成极地之色，以号角卷曲的螺旋自体中辐射而出。

src: A creature of immensity mounts the upper eyeline. Star gas boils off =pronouns.possessive= coral spines, and a tail blown to fin width by the selection pressures of water waves around the unit circle. A cloud of sea fungi suffocate and pop on =pronouns.possessive= vast sucking gills, and -- finally -- irisdual light churning under =pronouns.possessive= tx-glass skin is filtered to an auroral hue and radiates out of body in lituus spirals.
zh: 一头庞然之物攀上视野的上沿。星气自=pronouns.possessive=珊瑚之刺上腾沸，一条尾巴被单位圆四周水波的择汰之力吹涨到鱼鳍的宽度。一团海菌在=pronouns.possessive=巨大的吸鳃上窒息爆裂。终于，虹双之光在=pronouns.possessive=玻璃似的皮下翻涌，滤成极光之色，以号角卷曲的螺旋自体中辐射而出。

src: A creature of immensity mounts the upper eyeline. The monstrous slumping head is moted with warts and freckles, and a soaking wattle rains putrid sauce on the floor. Years of slouching under pipeworks has smashed =pronouns.possessive= diacalyptus spine, and the sponginess of matter has left =pronouns.objective= boiling and sick from =pronouns.possessive= surroundings. Finally, irisdual light churning under =pronouns.possessive= tx-glass skin is filtered to a sickening hue and radiates out of body in lituus spirals.
zh: 一头庞然之物攀上视野的上沿。那颗庞大的头低垂着，满布疣赘与雀斑，湿淋淋的肉垂把腐汁滴落一地。经年在管道之下躬身，已把=pronouns.possessive=透萼之脊压得塌陷；物质的海绵之性又令=pronouns.objective=在=pronouns.possessive=周遭的环绕中沸腾、染病。最后，虹双之光在=pronouns.possessive=玻璃似的皮下翻涌，滤成一种令人作呕的色调，以号角卷曲的螺旋自体中辐射而出。

src: A creature of immensity mounts the upper eyeline. Tunnel-steeled rings of extruded wormgut belch shale dust like cavern rain, and a colony of starspines grow across =pronouns.possessive= sloping world-back. In a wreath around =pronouns.possessive= pitting mouth, a hundredish eyes have grown to drink every photon out the jeweled and sunless haunts of yesterearth. Finally, irisdual light churning under =pronouns.possessive= tx-glass skin is filtered to a smoke and citrine hue and radiates out of body in lituus spirals.
zh: 一头庞然之物攀上视野的上沿。挤出之虫肠成环，为隧道所淬硬，喷吐着页岩尘土，如洞窟之雨；一簇星刺群生在=pronouns.possessive=倾斜的世界之背上。在=pronouns.possessive=坑洼的嘴四周，百余只眼睛环生成圈，为的是饮尽昔日大地那宝饰般无日之处的一切光子。最后，虹双之光在=pronouns.possessive=玻璃似的皮下翻涌，滤成烟与黄水晶之色，以号角卷曲的螺旋自体中辐射而出。

src: A creature of wing, hoof, and spine slouches to the weight of years, tongue tra-la'ing a rich and wistful echo, countenance shining in the bright spectrum of affect. An irisdual grease churns under =pronouns.possessive= mosaic skin (fractalized by =pronouns.possessive= multi-threaded lineage) and beams rainbows that squirrel off in seven-dimensional strips. The thing waits unbidden.
zh: 一个具翼、蹄与脊的生灵，在岁月之重下佝偻着身子，舌头哼着“啦啦”的曲调，发出丰盈而怅惘的回响，面容闪耀着情感的明亮光谱。一股虹彩的油脂在=pronouns.possessive=镶嵌般的皮肤（因=pronouns.possessive=多线程血脉而分形化）下翻涌，放射出的彩虹向四外窜出，呈七维的条带。这东西不请自来，静静等候。

src: A creature of wing, hoof, and spine slouches to the weight of years, tongue tra-la'ing a rich and wistful echo, countenance shining in the bright spectrum of affect. An irisdual grease churns under =pronouns.possessive= translucent skin and beams rainbows that squirrel off in three-dimensional strips. The thing waits unbidden.
zh: 一个具翼、蹄与脊的生灵，在岁月之重下佝偻着身子，舌头哼着“啦啦”的曲调，发出丰盈而怅惘的回响，面容闪耀着情感的明亮光谱。一股虹彩的油脂在=pronouns.possessive=半透明的皮肤下翻涌，放射出的彩虹向四外窜出，呈三维的条带。这东西不请自来，静静等候。

src: A crinkle-sheet of papery metal pokes at the angle of repose.
zh: 一片皱褶如纸的金属，以休止角之态翘起。

src: A cross-section of trash reef has been whittled to the shape of a star. Chiliads of life-things, rocks, and ersatz matter ribbon its arms: a mosaic of polyps, a bouquet of kelp, burned glass, minted chrome, nebula shell, iris milk, and stray photonic fuzz peeled from a decaying hologram.
zh: 一截垃圾礁的剖面被削成星形。千百年来的生命之物、岩石与仿造物质，如缎带缠绕其臂：珊瑚虫的镶嵌画、海藻花束、烧熔的玻璃、铸造的铬、星云壳、虹膜乳，以及从一幅衰朽全息影像上剥落的零散光子绒。

src: A crown of bright and dripping star leaves casts mesmerizing shadows across its roots.
zh: 一冠明亮滴露的星叶，在其根上投下摄人心魄的影子。

src: A crude stone hem surrounds a foam landing pad, and the above-head fretwork is braided into the new-fangled glyphs of reshaping and return symbology.
zh: 粗糙的石缘环绕着一块泡沫降落垫，头顶的格栅编织成新奇时兴的重塑与回返符号。

src: A crumpled and horned frame of tendons and muscle rot in putrid, black blood.
zh: 一副蜷曲生角、由筋腱与肌肉构成的躯架，浸烂在腐臭的黑血里。

src: A crushed hat brim mantles =pronouns.possessive= eyes and a leather holster rides =pronouns.possessive= shoulder. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:roll:afterpronoun= a lead slug over =pronouns.possessive= leathery knuckles.
zh: 压皱的帽檐罩住=pronouns.possessive=双眼，一只皮枪套斜挂在=pronouns.possessive=肩上。=pronouns.Subjective=让一颗铅弹在=pronouns.possessive=皮革似的指节上滚转。

src: A crystal complexity is depicted at the forever moment of shatter. The carving is still and in so being is hyperkinetic, encoding all possibilities in its elisions, and then resolving into none.
zh: 一座晶体的复杂之物，被刻画于永恒的碎裂一刻。雕刻静止不动，也因此极为迅猛，在其省略之中编码了一切可能，随后又消解为无。

src: A crystal sponge-chime shivers in acicular panic. Sharp tones ring off =pronouns.possessive= needle points and shatter in zeniths.
zh: 一只水晶海绵鸣钟在针状的惊惶中颤抖。锐利的音调自=pronouns.possessive=针尖上鸣出，又在中天碎裂。

src: A cube with a mere four corners. Facet pictographs for sun-up, mid-day, sun-down, and mid-night insist on a new division of days. It's carved with fanciful depictions of broken clocks.
zh: 一个仅有四角的立方体。其面上的象形，标着日出、正午、日落与午夜，坚持要把一日重新划分。上面刻满了破钟的奇想图样。

src: A cuirass of gas-caught foam stiffens instantaneously when pressure is applied. Its karst surface is arrayed with tube sleeves and dusted with the colorful abrasions of chiliads and the chemical reactions they produce; the material has careened past the outer rings of its expected lifetime and into the unknowing void.
zh: 一件气凝泡沫的胸甲，受压即刻硬化。其喀斯特般的表面，排布着管套，并蒙着千百年来的斑斓磨痕与由此引发的化学反应之尘；此材料早已越过预期寿命的外环，坠入无知的虚空。

src: A cuirass of gas-caught foam stiffens instantaneously when pressure is applied. Its karst surface is dusted with the colorful abrasions of chiliads and the chemical reactions they produce; the material has careened past the outer rings of its expected lifetime and into the unknowing void.
zh: 一件气凝泡沫的胸甲，受压即刻硬化。其喀斯特般的表面，蒙着千百年来的斑斓磨痕与由此引发的化学反应之尘；此材料早已越过预期寿命的外环，坠入无知的虚空。

src: A curtain of blue, magenta, and scarlet hangs over the sacred hold of moon-and-sun shade and hypernova gold (color specifications handed down directly from the machinic being who ensued from the entheos within). Raw amateriality is titrated out the container boundary and canaled in managed doses to processors that crack it in order to do the uncomputable: decide from nothing.
zh: 一幅蓝、品红与绯红的帷幕，垂在月日之荫与超新星之金所筑的圣域之上（其色彩规格，乃由自内在神启中降生的机械之灵亲手传下）。纯粹的非物质性，自容器的边界被滴定而出，又经渠道，以受控的剂量输往处理器，后者将其破解，以行不可计算之事：无中生决。

src: A curtain of thrumming cables make a mantle for hunched shoulders. They pitch at neuronal frequencies long dormant.
zh: 一幅嗡嗡作响的缆线之帘，为佝偻的双肩织成披肩。它们以沉寂已久的神经频率振荡。

src: A curved screen of bang-hard surface material is wielded by a welded grip.
zh: 一面弧形的挡板，面材坚硬，叩之铿然，由一具焊接的握把操持。

src: A cut of pink and fuzzy flesh has been stretched and tanned to roof its wards.
zh: 一块粉红而绒毛密布的皮肉被拉伸鞣制，覆于所庇之人的头顶，充作屋顶。

src: A cyclopean drum of divining liquid is yoked to the stratum for peering at the mythopoetic event stream of the bubbled kingdom.
zh: 一只独眼巨人般的占卜液之鼓，被缚于地层之上，用以窥看泡状王国的神话诗意事件流。

src: A cylinder with a sensor array floats in magnetic suspension and emits a choppy hum. One long, articulated arm dangles beneath it, and sparks fly from its electric corm.
zh: 一具带传感阵列的圆柱浮在磁悬浮中，发出断续的嗡鸣。一条长而有关节的手臂垂在它下方，电光自其电球中迸出。

src: A dense mesh of dilated tetraglass tubes convey coolant and antifreeze over the keg-mail's jumbo compressors. Blower motors drone a low hum, and condenser and evaporator coils spin out the shoulders like grandfather trees above the insulation shrub.
zh: 一张由膨胀的四面玻璃管织成的密网，将冷却剂与防冻剂输过桶甲的巨型压缩机。鼓风电机发出低沉的嗡鸣，冷凝与蒸发盘管自肩头伸展，宛如隔热灌木丛之上的祖树。

src: A depiction coheres of the explosive energy of the universe bottled in a shielded bulb and pistoned into a vast and edged intelligence. From there the great machinic archons of the Eaters fissioned in their oracula and, with baetyls as fingers, lathed the waking world.
zh: 一幅图景渐渐凝成：宇宙的爆裂之能被封入一只屏蔽的灯泡，由活塞推入一颗广大而锋利的智能之中。食者那些机械的伟大执政官便由此在其神谕所中裂变而生，并以圣石为指，车削出这醒觉的世界。

src: A dial clicks at right intervals on the metal wrist, and mercurial silver courses through tubework along the plastifer sleeve.
zh: 金属腕上，一枚拨盘按适宜的间隔咔嗒作响，流银般的水银沿塑化物袖套中的管路奔涌。

src: A different glyph for 'life' is light-etched on each of its shining chrome segments.
zh: 每一块闪亮的铬质环节上，都以光蚀刻着一个不同的“生”字。
一顿令人作呕的筋腱之餐。

src: A divine crisp dissolves into salted manna.
zh: 一份神圣的酥脆化作了加了盐的吗哪。

src: A dome of iron and hardened pulp contains its own source of illumination.
zh: 铁与硬化纸浆所制的穹顶，自带一盏光源。

src: A dozen armatures and manipulators splay out from a metal brace that fuses to the metacarpals.
zh: 十数具骨架与机械手自金属托架向外张开，托架熔合于掌骨之上。

src: A drape flows off his shoulder with mythoprosaic inevitability, and the digital dyad implies both sanative peace on earth and congruity with the vault of heaven.
zh: 一幅披帛自他肩头垂落，带着神话散文般的必然；那数码的二元，既暗示着地上的疗愈之安，亦暗示着与穹苍的契合。

src: A droplet of thixotropic fluid is downpulled to a basin by centripetal force. In synchronization with its spouse-locks, the net effect stabilizes the North Sheva in geostationary orbit and simulates the ambient pressures of 1g.
zh: 一滴触变流体被向心力向下拉入盆中。与其配偶锁相互同步，其净效应是将北舍瓦稳定于地球静止轨道，并模拟出1g的环境压力。

src: A durable plastic mask has been fitted with a simple filter to protect against noxious gas.
zh: 一副坚固的塑料面罩，装了简易滤件，用以抵御毒气。

src: A dusky and twin-faced mass of gravid metal, like a meteorite, is welded to a steel pole.
zh: 一团黯沉的双面沉重金属，形如陨石，焊在钢杆之上。

src: A dusky mass of gravid metal, like a meteorite, is welded to a steel shaft.
zh: 一团黯沉而沉重的金属，形如陨石，焊在钢柄之上。

src: A dyad of ladder braids frame =pronouns.possessive= face like circuit marginalia in the Canticles Chromaic. =pronouns.Possessive= broad shoulders and traps bear the imprint signature of plying the soldering beam and egis, tools of craft that dual as sacred armaments.
zh: 两道梯状的辫子框住=pronouns.possessive=面庞，宛如《色彩圣歌》页边的电路旁注。=pronouns.Possessive=宽阔的肩与斜方肌上，留着长年操持焊光与神盾的印记——那些技艺之具亦可兼作神圣的兵刃。

src: A elephant slab of copper-painted metal slumps out of its ancient doorframe. The handle is kept still by an ornate mechanical lock.
zh: 一方硕大的铜漆金属板自古老的门框中瘫垂出来。门柄被一具华美的机械锁定住不动。

src: A elephant slab of gold-painted metal slumps out of its ancient doorframe. The handle is kept still by an ornate mechanical lock.
zh: 一方硕大的金漆金属板自古老的门框中瘫垂出来。门柄被一具华美的机械锁定住不动。

src: A elephant slab of silver-painted metal slumps out of its ancient doorframe. The handle is kept still by an ornate mechanical lock.
zh: 一方硕大的银漆金属板自古老的门框中瘫垂出来。门柄被一具华美的机械锁定住不动。

src: A false face was shaped to fashion and stitched with unknown intent.
zh: 一张假面，依样式塑成，缝制的用意却已不明。

src: A fidgeting crystal breaks the ambient rays of light with =pronouns.possessive= turning and craning.
zh: 一块躁动不安的晶体随着=pronouns.possessive=转身与伸颈，将周遭的光线折断。

src: A figure is marked by star orchid robes as a votary of the Gyre and reveler in the metamorphic numen. Nails filth-black flash from out =pronouns.possessive= sleeve in a gesture-poem to say that plague is but transmutation, death is the ladder to life, and the existence of children proves the prelacy of raw growth. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:are:afterpronoun= peppered with shale dust.
zh: 一袭星兰长袍标出此人的身份：回旋的崇拜者，形变神力的耽乐者。污黑如泥的指甲自=pronouns.possessive=袖中一闪，作一手势之诗，说瘟疫不过形变，死亡是通往生命的阶梯，而孩童之存在已证得原始生长的尊位。=pronouns.Subjective=身上星星点点沾着页岩尘灰。

src: A figure is marked by star orchid robes as a votary of the Gyre and reveler in the metamorphic numen. Nails filth-black flash from out =pronouns.possessive= sleeve in a gesture-poem to say that plague is but transmutation, death is the ladder to life, and the existence of children proves the prelacy of raw growth. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:bear:afterpronoun= skin ink in the shape of hexagons.
zh: 一袭星兰色的袍子标出此人的身份：回旋的崇拜者，形变神力的耽乐者。污黑如泥的指甲自=pronouns.possessive=袖中一闪，作一手势之诗，说瘟疫不过形变，死亡是通往生命的阶梯，而孩童之存在已证得原始生长的尊位。=pronouns.Subjective=身上刺着六边形的墨纹。

src: A figure is marked by star orchid robes as a votary of the Gyre and reveler in the metamorphic numen. Nails filth-black flash from out =pronouns.possessive= sleeve in a gesture-poem to say that plague is but transmutation, death is the ladder to life, and the existence of children proves the prelacy of raw growth. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:smell:afterpronoun= of burning fish guts.
zh: 一袭星兰色的袍子标出此人的身份：回旋的崇拜者，形变神力的耽乐者。污黑如泥的指甲自=pronouns.possessive=袖中一闪，作一手势之诗，说瘟疫不过形变，死亡是通往生命的阶梯，而孩童之存在已证得原始生长的尊位。=pronouns.Subjective=身上有烧焦鱼肠的气味。

src: A figure is marked by star orchid robes as a votary of the Gyre and reveler in the metamorphic numen. Nails filth-black flash from out =pronouns.possessive= sleeve in a gesture-poem to say that plague is but transmutation, death is the ladder to life, and the existence of children proves the prelacy of raw growth. A rank and acrid smell clings to =pronouns.objective=.
zh: 一袭星兰长袍标出此人的身份：回旋的崇拜者，形变神力的耽乐者。污黑如泥的指甲自=pronouns.possessive=袖中一闪，作一手势之诗，说瘟疫不过形变，死亡是通往生命的阶梯，而孩童之存在已证得原始生长的尊位。一股浓烈刺鼻的气味缠着=pronouns.objective=。

src: A figure is marked by star orchid robes as a votary of the Gyre and reveler in the metamorphic numen. Nails filth-black flash from out =pronouns.possessive= sleeve in a gesture-poem to say that plague is but transmutation, death is the ladder to life, and the existence of children proves the prelacy of raw growth. Cool and luminous moisture clings to =pronouns.objective=.
zh: 一袭星兰长袍标出此人的身份：回旋的崇拜者，形变神力的耽乐者。污黑如泥的指甲自=pronouns.possessive=袖中一闪，作一手势之诗，说瘟疫不过形变，死亡是通往生命的阶梯，而孩童之存在已证得原始生长的尊位。清凉而发亮的湿气缠着=pronouns.objective=。

src: A figure is marked by star orchid robes as a votary of the Gyre and reveler in the metamorphic numen. Nails filth-black flash from out =pronouns.possessive= sleeve in a gesture-poem to say that plague is but transmutation, death is the ladder to life, and the existence of children proves the prelacy of raw growth. The rhythm of =pronouns.possessive= steps contain no pattern.
zh: 一袭星兰色的袍子标出此人的身份：回旋的崇拜者，形变神力的耽乐者。污黑如泥的指甲自=pronouns.possessive=袖中一闪，作一手势之诗，说瘟疫不过形变，死亡是通往生命的阶梯，而孩童之存在已证得原始生长的尊位。=pronouns.possessive=步伐的节律却毫无章法。

src: A fist-sized snail shell is coiled in soft spirals, blackened with soot, and stinks of sulfur.
zh: 一枚拳头大的蜗牛壳，盘成柔和的螺旋，被烟灰熏黑，散发着硫磺的臭气。

src: A flat beak for spooning mud draws out the lower face.
zh: 一张用来舀泥的扁喙，自下颜向外延伸。

src: A flowing shoulder of outworld lime ends in a flat, object-bearing head. The stone-flute creature depicted grants an eyeless stare.
zh: 一段流线的肩，取自异界石灰岩，末端是平整的承物之首。石笛造型的生灵所刻画的，是一道无眼的凝视。

src: A fluent bubble is kept aloft by viscous current trapped in a membrane of glass.
zh: 一枚流畅的气泡，被困于玻璃薄膜中的黏稠水流托在半空。

src: A fluted visor is satcheled in strands of tungsten filament. Two antennae coil out the temples in robotic likeness.
zh: 一面带凹槽的面罩，缠满钨丝。两根天线自太阳穴盘绕而出，状似机器。

src: A folded triangle pouch of burlap was impregnated with vinewood sap to absorb noxious vapor.
zh: 一只折成三角的粗麻布袋，以藤木树液浸透，用以吸收有毒烟气。

src: A four-chambered slab of wet and raw tissue slumps under its own sopping weight.
zh: 一方四腔的湿润生肉，在自身浸透的重量下瘫软塌陷。

src: A fractal lattice of dermal applique conducts the inner glow to the outer world.
zh: 一张分形格状的真皮贴层，将内在的辉光导向外界。

src: A freightless tether slings down a dark and vast channel.
zh: 一条不载货的系索垂荡入幽暗而广阔的通道。

src: A full-scale continental shelf of half-calcified, star-orchid body mass creeps over the earth, sending stone, chrome, wood, and brass to quivers. Hundreds of thousands of underspines convey =pronouns.possessive= quincunx of cyclopean arms into motion, and a delta of subducting stomach muscle sticks and subsumes matter into =pronouns.possessive= somatic star-bounds. In =pronouns.possessive= wake an arcology of disarranged world-fragments is raised.
zh: 一整片半钙化的星兰色躯体如大陆架般爬过大地，使石、铬、木与黄铜尽皆震颤。数十万根下刺驱动着=pronouns.possessive=五点排布的庞然巨臂；一片俯冲的胃肌三角洲黏附并吞纳万物，纳入=pronouns.possessive=躯体那星辰所限的疆界。在=pronouns.possessive=身后，一座由错乱的世界碎片堆起的生态城随之竖起。

src: A fullerite hem surrounds a foam landing pad, and the above-head fretwork is braided into the once-familiar glyphs of recomposition and return symbology.
zh: 富勒烯之缘环绕着一块泡沫降落垫，头顶的格栅编织成早已熟悉的重组与回返符号。

src: A furrowed metal plate is fit to the arch of the doorway, and a slide panel is cut from its center.
zh: 一片起槽的金属板嵌在门洞的弧拱上，正中开出一扇滑板。

src: A furrowed metal plate is fit to the arch of the doorway, and a sliding panel sits recessed in the center. The panel is impressed with the mold of a key card.
zh: 一片起槽的金属板嵌在门洞的弧拱上，正中凹着一扇滑板。板上压着一个钥匙卡的模印。

src: A furrowed metal plate is fit to the arch of the doorway. Its hinges and rails were melted and fused to the wallframe.
zh: 一片起槽的金属板嵌在门洞的弧拱上。它的铰链与滑轨已被熔融，与墙框焊作一体。

src:
A future shock. My chimeling _ is vision-gifted, a lichen who clings to shorerock on the straits of Tomorrow. Just a short time ago a sea wave crested and broke beneath her, and she saw in its recession all the bright and violent channel paths.

We all felt it. A recoming, and the gyre in final tension. I felt...
zh:
一场未来的震颤。我的钟灵_有先见之赐，是一株附着在明日海峡岸石之上的地衣。就在不久之前，一道海浪升至浪尖，在她身下碎裂，而她在退潮之中，看见了所有明亮而猛烈的水道。

我们全都感觉到了。一次复归，而回旋已至最后的紧绷。我感觉到……

src: A gargantuan slab of burned and rolled chrome was unjointed from an earth-mover. It shadows its monstrous wielder like a starsail.
zh: 一块经焙烧与碾压的巨大铬板，从一台推土机上拆下。它如星帆一般，将其怪物般的挥舞者笼于阴影之中。

src: A gene-sharpened bone spike pierces the crown.
zh: 一枚经基因磨利的骨刺，刺穿颅冠。

src: A geospatial core is fitted with a bionic tether.
zh: 一枚地理空间核心，嵌有仿生系绳。

src: A giant clockface is traced with lemniscates to gauge the entheogenic pressures building in abyssal sun cores. The priest of the machine who took its readings and sung the dial left is indebted to the distant colleague whose klatch invented the whistled language 8000 years later.
zh: 巨大的钟面上以无穷符号勾画刻度，用以测度深渊日核中不断累积的致幻压力。那位读取数值、唱定表盘指针的机器祭司，要感念八千年后发明口哨语的那位遥远同侪及其社群。

src: A giant cone of calcereous shell conceals a softform body. It tilts to the side, and its many whorls are sequenced to impress the eye with pleasing geometry before swerving to uncomfortable and dizzying disharmony.
zh: 一具巨大的钙质螺壳圆锥掩着一个柔软的身躯。它向一侧倾侧，那一圈圈螺纹排得井然有序，先以悦目的几何打动眼睛，随即急转为令人不适、头晕目眩的不谐。

src: A giant is carpentered from large-scale scrap towed from the trash sea. Tailstock legs meet a great flange torso at shimmed hips, piston arms break at wye pipe shoulders, and a bent pressing plate soldered with radio antennae delivers an empty stare.
zh: 一个巨人由自垃圾之海拖来的大型废件拼造而成。尾座般的腿以垫片制的髋接上巨大的凸缘躯干，活塞臂在 Y 形管肩处折转，一块弯曲的压板焊着无线电天线，投出一副空洞的目光。

src: A giant mound of rotting iron flesh puts some elevation to the ground.
zh: 一大堆腐烂的铁色肉身，为地面添了些许隆起。

src: A giant ribbon of scaleless tissue quivers in suspension beyond a mouth ringed with repeating triangle teeth, and imagined finnage dresses =pronouns.possessive= glistening length. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:extrude:afterpronoun= a double through the mirrored planes of reality, and inverts back through them to extrude a triple.
zh: 一条无鳞组织构成的巨带悬空颤动，其外是一张环着层层三角利齿的口；想象而生的鳍饰披在=pronouns.possessive=闪亮的身长上。=pronouns.Subjective=穿过现实的镜像诸平面，挤出一个二重身，又自其中反转而出，挤出三重身。

src: A giant, spotted keel pushes against =pronouns.possessive= acid-moist membrane. Burnt air puffs down the radula, and =pronouns.possessive= pores leak a digestive liquor.
zh: 一根巨硕带斑的龙骨顶着=pronouns.possessive=酸湿的膜。焦灼的气息自齿舌间喷出，=pronouns.possessive=孔窍渗出消化之液。

src: A gigantic whorl lip snapped off the driving wheel of culture, fell out of its star vault's orbit, and, through the eroded methods of time, arrived here. Astroexotic spores lash its metasteel underrim, pilgrims from a hot fungal core biding time between now and some mystifying future point.
zh: 一只巨大的螺旋唇缘，自文化的驱动轮上折断，从其星穹的轨道上坠落，历经时间侵蚀的种种途径，来到这里。异星孢子攀附于其超钢下缘，那是来自炽热真菌核心的朝圣者，在此刻与某个神秘的未来时点之间静待。

src: A girdle of ribboned muscle squeezes the wrist and wets it with a burning grease.
zh: 一条束带，如带纹肌肉，勒紧手腕，并以灼热的油脂浸湿它。

src: A glass lens encages a magnetized needle and sits inside a leather wristband.
zh: 一枚玻璃透镜笼住一根磁化的指针，嵌在皮质腕带之内。

src: A glass tube and hype needle deliver a tonic directly to the bloodstream.
zh: 一支玻璃管与一枚皮下针，可将补剂径直送入血流。

src: A glass tube and hype needle deliver a tonic directly to the bloodstream. This one is empty.
zh: 一支玻璃管与一枚皮下针，可将补剂径直送入血流。此支已空。

src: A glinting spindle of steel is spiraled with grooves for stripping wire from raw nuggets and ingots.
zh: 一根闪光的钢制主轴开着螺旋的沟槽，用以从粗金块与铸锭上剥下线材。

src: A glossy foil clasp was pried off the glass guts of the polis and etched as jewelry.
zh: 一枚光洁的箔片搭扣，自城邦的玻璃肺腑中撬下，蚀刻成了首饰。

src: A goat wool bed fastened with canvas ties.
zh: 一张以帆布带系紧的山羊毛铺盖。

src: A goat's bladder is knotted at the bottom and suspended by a strap of intestine.
zh: 一只山羊的膀胱，底部打结，以一条肠带悬挂。

src: A godsuit of chrome shines in the baptism bloodoil of the Great Cistern, where even standing at the lowest basin =pronouns.subjective= broke the cavern rafters. Uuflax braids cinctured with ties of offworld goldleaf spill from the crown radar and over =pronouns.possessive= deltoid chassis. Every piece of =pronouns.possessive= glass and chrome was sourced from the arcological heart, encased in resin, pullchained up and hotbrushed in the temple foundry. The entry hatch is hung with a sigil rug of the pilot, who climbed in to anchor here years ago and communes now with the Godhead.
zh: 一具神祇般的镀铬甲衣，浸在大蓄水池那洗礼的血油之中——就在此地，即便立于最低的池盘中，=pronouns.subjective=也曾撞破洞窟的椽木。自冠顶雷达垂下的乌纤辫，以天外金箔的束带绾起，披过=pronouns.possessive=三角肌的机壳。=pronouns.possessive=每一片玻璃与铬，皆取自生态城的心脏，裹以树脂，以链拉吊而上，在圣殿的铸坊中热刷而成。入口舱门上挂着一张驾驶员的纹章毯；此人多年前攀入其中，在此扎锚，如今与神首相通。

src: A godswan sits in stone grace with its gigantic kite train furled to a dizzying gyre. She wears a blank and unreadable expression, to evoke the carver's sense of her as uncertainty's incubus. Generations of moss skirt the beast's down feathers.
zh: 一只神鹅端坐于石雕的优雅之中，硕大如风筝的尾翎收拢成令人目眩的回旋。她面无表情，不可揣测，以体现雕工视她为不确定之梦魇的想法。数代的苔藓环绕着这头巨兽的绒羽。

src: A greasy sac of goo gyres over the floor in spiral-step. Under =pronouns.possessive= membrane, a shoal of spitbright eels slither for freedom.
zh: 一只油腻的黏液之囊以螺旋之步在地面上回旋。在=pronouns.possessive=膜下，一群吐亮如唾的鳗鱼蜿蜒求脱。

src: A greasy sac of luminous broth gyres over the floor in spiral-step and lights a helical path.
zh: 一只油腻的发光清汤之囊以螺旋之步在地面上回旋，照出一条螺旋的路。

src: A greasy sac of ooze gyres over the floor in spiral-step. Under =pronouns.possessive= membrane, a shoal of spitbright eels slither for freedom.
zh: 一只油腻的软泥之囊以螺旋之步在地面上回旋。在=pronouns.possessive=膜下，一群吐亮如唾的鳗鱼蜿蜒求脱。

src: A great curved and flanged length of metal replicates the layout of the Witch Court on its three-handed sculptor species's steaming earth. There and under a quincunx moon, rhapsodes of war are locked in ceremonial combat.
zh: 一段弯曲而带凸缘的巨大金属，复现了女巫朝堂在其三手雕塑者种族那蒸汽氤氲的大地上的格局。就在那里，在五点梅花形的月亮之下，战争的游吟诗人们锁定于仪式性的厮杀之中。

src: A great sawed plank of oval-figured wood had been raised on legs and made the feasting board for a whilom king. Then an axe of dispute split it to pieces, and those children were carried off and shaved smooth to supply flatness again.
zh: 一块被锯下的巨大椭圆纹木板，曾被架上腿，成为昔日某位国王的宴席之案。后来一柄争端之斧将它劈成碎片，这些孩子又被带走，刨得光滑，重新供给平整。

src: A greebled egg of metal and circuited glass was fished from the chromefall to be welded on and serve as spiritual center mass for a minyan of woodsprogs. =pronouns.Possessive= sensory pane is fused at junction points to the selfsame mask of =pronouns.possessive= creator/minions, tied with ribbons of mossgrowth and wire.
zh: 一枚由金属与线路玻璃构成、缀满繁饰的卵，自铬之瀑中捞起，被焊上身来，充当一群林地精之十人团的精神质心。=pronouns.Possessive=感官之窗在接点处与=pronouns.possessive=造主、仆从共有的同一副面具熔为一体，以藓生与金属丝的绦带系束。

src: A greebled egg of metal and circuited glass was fished from the chromefall to be welded on and serve as spiritual center mass for a minyan of woodsprogs. =pronouns.Possessive= sensory pane remains unplanished, and so =pronouns.subjective= have yet to show the growth rings of communal meaning.
zh: 一枚由金属与线路玻璃构成、缀满繁饰的卵，自铬之瀑中捞起，被焊上身来，充当一群林地精之十人团的精神质心。=pronouns.Possessive=感官之窗尚未被锻平，因而=pronouns.subjective=还未能显出共同体意义的年轮。

src: A grotesque protuberance swells from =subject.poss#back= as =subject.it.does:begin= to bud!
zh: 一团怪异的赘生物自=subject.poss#back=隆起，=subject.it.does:开始=萌发！

src: A grotesque protuberance swells from =subject.the.name= as =subject.it.does:begin= to bud!
zh: 一团怪异的赘生物自=subject.the.name=身上隆起，=subject.it.does:开始=萌发！

src: A group of debug options for strings & translations.
zh: 一组针对字符串与翻译的调试选项。

src: A halo of smoke lifts off the calcified orb.
zh: 一道烟晕自钙化的圆球上腾起。

src: A halogen light sits affixed to a leather head strap.
zh: 一盏卤素灯固定在皮制头带上。

src: A hand pump slides into a chrome canister with illustrations of rotting fungi etched in relief.
zh: 一台手泵滑入一只铬制罐体，罐上浮雕着腐烂真菌的图案。

src: A hand pump slides into a chrome canister with illustrations of wilting plants etched in relief.
zh: 一台手泵滑入一只铬制罐体，罐上浮雕着枯萎植物的图案。

src: A handful of pellets are encased in a thick wax-paper and plastic shell.
zh: 一把弹丸被裹在厚实的蜡纸与塑料壳之中。

src: A hatchet of blubbery tissue spills out of a machine-scraped bivalve shell.
zh: 一团肥腴的肉质如斧般自机械刮磨过的双壳贝中溢出。

src: A head topper was fashioned for unknown purpose.
zh: 一顶头饰，其用途已不可考。

src: A hideous beak cants over the brain cavity and shades the face in the frightening light of a dim and aching sun.
zh: 一只丑恶的喙倾斜在脑腔之上，在一轮昏暗而痛楚的太阳的骇人光中，为面孔遮荫。

src: A hoary humanoid slumps beneath the weight of =pronouns.possessive= broad and cragged back. Soaking fibers of inky, unkempt hair enswathe the great pale shoulder-rocks, and crossed over =pronouns.possessive= wide chest are two carbide axes rotting with rust. Rumpled lids lay half-shut over the discs of =pronouns.possessive= sluggish eyes, glazed in the respite of a convalessence bath.
zh: 一个苍老的人形佝偻在=pronouns.possessive=宽大嶙峋的脊背之下。墨黑蓬乱的发丝浸透了水，缠裹着那巨大的苍白肩岩，交抱在=pronouns.possessive=宽阔胸前的，是两柄锈蚀腐朽的碳化物斧。松垂的眼睑半阖在=pronouns.possessive=迟缓的眼珠上，那双眼因一次复原液的浸浴而蒙着呆光。

src: A hole-cut sheet of steel links fits over the head and neck.
zh: 一片镂孔的钢环链片，套在头颈之上。

src: A hominid-suit of chrome is junctured together from parts across the layer cake of time: balance struts hammered off the crushed star blimp, mainshaft springs torn from buoyed chapels, actuators hewed from the machine hearts of city centers, intakes blown of molten lamp glass. A proton rod capitals each shoulder, chipped to the Z radius in the mirrorshops of lower earth.
zh: 一具人形的镀铬甲衣，由跨越时间千层的部件铰接而成：平衡支杆自粉碎的星船飞艇上锤下，主轴弹簧自浮升的礼拜堂上扯来，传动器自城市中枢的机械心上砍取，进气口则由熔化的灯玻璃吹成。两肩之上各耸一根质子棒，它们是在下界大地的镜铺中以Z半径削成的。

src: A hominid-suit of chrome is junctured together from parts across the layer cake of time: balance struts hammered off the crushed star blimp, mainshaft springs torn from buoyed chapels, actuators hewed from the machine hearts of city centers, intakes blown of molten lamp glass. One arm ends in a giant blade, machined to final form at the Eater presses that stamp out artworks in the forever mode.
zh: 一具人形的镀铬甲衣，由跨越时间千层的部件铰接而成：平衡支杆自粉碎的星船飞艇上锤下，主轴弹簧自浮升的礼拜堂上扯来，传动器自城市中枢的机械心上砍取，进气口则由熔化的灯玻璃吹成。一条臂的末端是一柄巨刃，在食者的压机上加工成形——那些压机以永恒之式冲压艺术品。
