As the prism shatters, =numClones.ifPlural:reflections:a reflection= of =subject.the.name:baseOnly= =numClones.ifPlural:are:is= caught on the limen of realities and =numClones.ifPlural:appear:appears= out of nowhere.
zh: 棱镜碎裂之际，=subject.the.name:baseOnly=的=numClones.ifPlural:数道:一道=倒影=numClones.ifPlural:滞留:滞留=于诸界的阈限之间，=numClones.ifPlural:凭空浮现:凭空浮现=。

src:
As the very canopy, they will.

Thank you.
zh:
如树冠一般，会的。

谢谢。

src: As you bathe in Her light and ask your many questions, dearest friend, commit to your memory the replies you receive, that you may tell me of them when I rejoin you.
zh: 最亲爱的朋友，当你沐浴在她光中、提出你那许多问题时，请把所得的答复记在心里，好待我与你重聚时讲给我听。

src: As you roam the caves of Qud, burdened by guilt and complexity!
zh: 如你背负罪愆与繁复，漫游卡德洞窟！

src: As you say it. I have further questions.
zh: 既然你这么说，我还有别的问题。

src: As you say, Thah. I will return.
As you say. Live and drink.
Ascend the Tomb and Cross into Brightsheol
Ascend the Tomb and find Resheph's burial chamber. From there, discover a way to travel to Brightsheol.
zh: 登上墓顶，找到利悉的墓室；再从那里找出前往明冥的方法。

src:
Ascend.

You can click this button or press =commandKey:CmdMoveU=.
zh:
向上走。

你可以点击此按钮或按=commandKey:CmdMoveU=。

src: Ascending Creature need mightful battery with rare electromagnet shielding. Purple prickles make neutron cell with 3 flux drams, or must find different source.
zh: 攀升之造物需强力电池，辅以罕见电磁屏蔽。紫刺刺以三打兰通量造中子电池，否则须另觅来源。

src: Ask Lebah about eir encounter with the repulsive device.
zh: 问利巴，祂与排斥装置相遇时发生了什么。

src: Ask the Barathrumites about Argyve's strange signal.
zh: 向巴拉斯鲁姆派打听阿尔吉夫发现的奇异信号。

src: Ask the Barathrumites about the strange signal.
zh: 向巴拉斯鲁姆派打听那道奇异信号。

src: Ask the mopango watchers Dadogom, Doyoba, Gyamyo, and Yona about the repulsive device.
zh: 向莫潘戈守望者达多戈姆、多约巴、贾米奥与约娜打听排斥装置。

src: Asphodel (called the Lovely) =subject.verb:turn= =pronouns.possessive= tipping anthers at seductive angles. All the bright golds of the harvest sun and musa peel are garnishes to the frail beauty of =pronouns.possessive= petal. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:claim:afterpronoun= the aesthetic lineage of Hegelrut, and from that argument flowers =pronouns.possessive= claim to Omonporch and the entire Great Shade of the grove.
zh: 阿斯福德尔（人称“丽者”）将=pronouns.possessive=垂坠的花药转向撩人的角度。收获之日的灿金与芭蕉皮的金黄，都成了=pronouns.possessive=花瓣那纤弱之美的点缀。=pronouns.Subjective=自称承黑格尔鲁特的美学世系，并由此推论，开出=pronouns.possessive=对奥蒙门廊与整片林中大荫的权属主张。

src:
Asphodel the socialite? Asphodel the scoundrel? You can hate xym -- and I do -- but you have to admire xym (I don't).

The truth of it is that Plysago had the idea first, to lay claim to the Spindle per some precedent of law established in Abram's time. Of course, Plysago isn't around to make their case, are they?
zh:
社交名流阿斯福德尔？无赖阿斯福德尔？你可以恨祂——我就恨——可你也不得不钦佩祂（我不）。

实情是，最先有这主意的是普莱萨戈，依亚伯兰时代确立的某条法例先例，对纺锤提出主张。当然，普莱萨戈如今不在了，没法陈述其主张，不是吗？

src:
Asphodel trades on reputation and favors. Xe is likely to want to leverage your connections, so be in good social standing with a few factions for xem to even consider it.

Now, alternatively, if you're loved by the Consortium, xe will feel the pressure to acquiesce. Xe has enough enemies among phyta.

Of course, where all else fails, you can always sharpen your shears, if you get my meaning.

{{emote|*Yurl winks with one of their leaves.*}}
zh:
阿斯福德尔靠名望与人情做买卖。祂多半想借你的人脉，所以你得在几个派系那里口碑良好，祂才会考虑。

再者，若是联盟爱戴你，祂也会感到不得不从的压力。祂在植体之中树敌不少。

当然，要是什么都不管用，你总能把剪刀磨利，懂我的意思吧。

{{emote|*尤尔用一片叶子眨了眨眼。*}}

src: Asphodel!! I like xem. I get it. It's sort of like you don't want to be here, you don't want to there, you want to be somewhere else. Your own earldom, maybe.
zh: 阿斯福德尔！！我喜欢祂。我懂。就好比你不想待在这儿，不想待在那儿，想去别的地方。比如你自己的伯爵领。
正在化为另一生物的形貌。

src: Astragals demarcate the phasic slits along the frustum's length. Noise is sucked out of time in expectancy of cross-plane fusion.
zh: 箍环分隔了沿截锥全长的相位狭缝。噪声在预期的跨平面聚变中，被抽离了时间。

src: At =spice:time.partsOfDay.!random= under =spice:commonPhrases.strange.!random|article= and =color= sky, the people of =location= saw an image on the horizon that looked like =elementNoun|article= bathed in =color=. It was =spice.entity:name=, and after =spice.entity:subjectPronoun= came and left =location=, the people built a monument to =spice.entity:objectPronoun=, and thenceforth called =spice.entity:objectPronoun= =cognomen=.
zh: 在=spice:time.partsOfDay.!random=，=spice:commonPhrases.strange.!random|article==color=色的天幕之下，=location=的百姓望见天际现出一幅影像，宛如浸于=color=之中的=elementNoun|article=。那便是=spice.entity:name=；=spice.entity:subjectPronoun=来而复去=location=之后，百姓为=spice.entity:objectPronoun=立碑，自此称=spice.entity:objectPronoun=为=cognomen=。

src: At =spice:time.partsOfDay.!random= under =spice:commonPhrases.strange.!random|article= and =color= sky, the people of =villageName= saw an image on the horizon that looked like =elementNoun|article= bathed in =color=. It was =player.name=, and after =player.subjective= came and left, the people of =villageName= built a monument to =name= and thenceforth called =player.objective= =elementNoun|title=-in-=color|title=.
zh: =spice:time.partsOfDay.!random=时分，在=spice:commonPhrases.strange.!random|article==color=的天空下，=villageName=的人们望见天边现出一幅景象，宛如沐浴于=color=之中的=elementNoun|article=。那是=player.name=。待=player.subjective=来而复去，=villageName=的人们为=name=立起一座纪念碑，自此称=player.objective=为=color|title=之=elementNoun|title=。

src: At =spice:time.partsOfDay.!random= under a =spice:commonPhrases.strange.!random.article= and meadowed sky, the hindren of Bey Lah saw an image on the horizon that looked like a great looking glass. It was =name=, and once =player.subjective= arrived, the hindren built a monument to =player.objective= and thenceforth called =player.objective= the Looking Glass Kendren.
zh: 在=spice:time.partsOfDay.!random=，贝拉的欣德伦人仰望着=spice:commonPhrases.strange.!random.article=草甸天空，看见地平线上有一幅巨大的镜像。那是=name=；=player.subjective=抵达后，欣德伦人为=player.objective=建起纪念碑，从此称=player.objective=为“镜中肯德伦”。

src: At Starfarer's Quay, Resheph consulted with mysterious strangers and learned the secret of the Gyre. By cause of the misdeeds of the elder saads and sultans, star beings had levied a curse on Qud. Resheph vowed to make right from this wrong and redeem our doomed world.
zh: 在星航者码头，利悉与神秘的生人相商，得知回旋之秘。因先代萨阿德与苏丹们的恶行，星辰之民降咒于卡德。利悉立誓矫正此过，救赎我等注定毁灭的世界。

src: At a register under the falsetto chiming of =pronouns.possessive= choralers, the priest intones verses from the Canticles Chromaic. Arm gestures of emphasis blow the sleeves of =pronouns.possessive= robe out to great sails, swelling on the ecstatic air.
zh: 在=pronouns.possessive=唱诗者假声鸣响之下的一档音区里，祭司吟诵《色彩圣歌》的篇章。着重的臂势将=pronouns.possessive=袍袖吹张如巨帆，在狂喜的空气中鼓满。

src: At a remote library near =landmark.nearest=, =name= met with a group of blind scribes and together they penned the beloved codex =title=.
zh: 在=landmark.nearest=附近的一座偏僻书库中，=name=与一群盲眼抄写者会晤，众人合力撰成备受喜爱的典籍《=title=》。

src: At a remote library near =landmark.nearest=, =subject.name= met with a group of tongueless kippers and together they penned the beloved cookbook =object.refname=.
zh: 在=landmark.nearest=附近一座偏僻的藏书楼里，=subject.name=遇见一群无舌的腌鱼师，与他们合力撰成了深受喜爱的食谱=object.refname=。

src: At a remote tavern near =landmark.nearest=, =player.name= met with a group of kippers and, divinely inspired by =spice:elements.$domain.practices.!random=, invented the dish called =recipe.name=.
zh: 在=landmark.nearest=附近一处偏僻的酒肆，=player.name=遇见一群腌鱼师，受=spice:elements.$domain.practices.!random=启发，发明了名为=recipe.name=的菜肴。

src: At a remote workshop near the oasis-hamlet of Joppa, =name= and =player.possessive= apprentice Argyve invented an apparatus that evoked the presence of pounding drums and blistering wire. They named it the Weirdwire Conduit.
zh: 在约帕绿洲村附近一间偏远工坊里，=name=与=player.possessive=学徒阿尔吉夫发明了一件装置，能唤出雷鸣般的鼓声与灼热电线。他们将其命名为怪线导管。

src: At a tavern deep in the wilds of =terrain.t=, =name= lost =player.possessive= precious bracelet Kindrish to a local thief. =name= murdered the thief =spice:elements.entity@elements[random].murdermethods.!random= and immediately recovered =player.possessive= cherished heirloom.
zh: 在=terrain.t=荒野深处的一家酒馆里，=name=将=player.possessive=珍贵的手镯金德里什输给了当地的一个窃贼。=name=以=spice:elements.entity@elements[random].murdermethods.!random=的方式杀死了窃贼，旋即夺回了=player.possessive=心爱的传家宝。

src: At some moment in the door's past, an indweller unspooled their will to curiosity and cut an aperture for sight through the boundary.
zh: 在门过往的某一刻，一位居者把意志尽数倾注于好奇，在界面上开来一处可以窥视的孔洞。

src: At some moment in the double door's past, an indweller unspooled their will to curiosity and cut an aperture for sight through the boundary.
zh: 在这扇双开门过往的某一刻，一位居者把意志尽数倾注于好奇，在界面上开来一处可以窥视的孔洞。

src: At the Battle of =landmark.nearest|title=, =name= fought to subjugate snapjaws. =player.Subjective= wielded a buckler with such =spice:commonPhrases.finesse.!random= that it became forever known as =this.refname=.
zh: 在=landmark.nearest|title=之战中，=name=力战征服豺颚人。=player.Subjective=挥舞圆盾，其=spice:commonPhrases.finesse.!random=之至，此盾自此永被称作=this.refname=。

src: At the Battle of =location=, =spice.entity:name= fought as a mercenary =isSultan.if:sultan =to =liberate.if:liberate:subjugate= =faction.formattedName=. =spice.entity:subjectPronoun|capitalize= wielded =itemAdjective|article= =spice:items.weapons.!random= with such =spice:commonPhrases.finesse.!random= that it became forever known as =itemName=.
zh: =location=之战中，=spice.entity:name=以佣兵之身=isSultan.if:sultan =而战，欲=liberate.if:liberate:subjugate==faction.formattedName=。=spice.entity:subjectPronoun|capitalize=手持=itemAdjective|article==spice:items.weapons.!random=，其=spice:commonPhrases.finesse.!random=之妙，遂使此兵永世得名=itemName=。

src: At the Battle of =location=, =spice.entity:name= fought to =liberate.if:liberate:subjugate= =faction.formattedName=. =spice.entity:subjectPronoun|capitalize= wielded =itemAdjective|article= =spice:items.weapons.!random= with such =spice:commonPhrases.finesse.!random= that it became forever known as =itemName=.
zh: =location=之战中，=spice.entity:name=奋力而战，欲=liberate.if:liberate:subjugate==faction.formattedName=。=spice.entity:subjectPronoun|capitalize=手持=itemAdjective|article==spice:items.weapons.!random=，其=spice:commonPhrases.finesse.!random=之妙，遂使此兵永世得名=itemName=。

src: At the behest of a hindren pariah, you traveled to the hidden village of Bey Lah to investigate a mystery.
zh: 受一名欣德伦弃民所托，你前往隐秘村庄贝拉，调查一桩谜案。

src: At the bloody Battle of Red Rock, =name= fought the combined girshling and baboon forces to liberate the villagers of Joppa. In =player.t's= honor they =spice:history.gospels.Celebration.LateSultanate.!random=.
zh: 在血战红岩之役中，=name=击败吉尔什幼体与狒狒联军，解救约帕村民。在=player.t's=荣耀之下，众人举行了=spice:history.gospels.Celebration.LateSultanate.!random=。

src: At the center of a particularly thick copse, the vegetation clears. Flower-bedecked huts huddle in the clearing within, surrounded by phalanxes of tidy watervine rows and carefully-tended lah.
zh: 在一片格外茂密的小林正中，草木忽然开阔。林间空地上挤着几间缀满花束的木屋，四周环绕着整齐的水藤行列与精心照料的拉花。

src: At twilight in the shadow of the Spindle, the people of Omonporch saw an image on the horizon that looked like a ghost bathed in cerulean. It was Resheph, and after he came and left Omonporch, the people built a monument to him, and thenceforth called him Ghost-in-Cerulean.
zh: 暮色中，纺锤的阴影之下，奥蒙门廊的百姓见天际现出一幅影像，宛如浸于碧蓝之中的幽魂。那便是利悉；他来而复去奥蒙门廊之后，百姓为他立碑，自此称他为碧蓝之魂。

src: Atop an overgrown recoming pad deep in the wilds of the Palladium Reef, =subject.name= met with an artisan plant and commissioned a token that looked like an asterisk of =points.cardinal= points. They called it =object.the.name:asIfKnown|strip=.
zh: 在钯礁荒野深处一座荒草丛生的回返台上，=subject.name=与一株匠人植物相会，定制了一枚形如=points.cardinal=角星形的信物。他们称之为=object.the.name:asIfKnown|strip=。

src:
Atop the implausible rise of the Spindle roosted a Seraph, one of the great machinic archons of the Eaters, and this being Rebekah served.

In the short years before I arrived in Qud, the Seraph became convinced that something had changed in the cosmic order. That along the ecliptic of the Folk Clock, some uncounted peg had slid to a priming position, and that the Coven was set to imminently return.
zh:
在纺锤那难以置信的高处，栖着一位炽天使，食者的大机械执政之一，而利百加所侍奉的正是此位。

在我来到卡德之前的短短数年间，炽天使深信宇宙秩序有了变动：沿着民钟的黄道，某枚无人计数的销子已滑至预备之位，而那盟会即将回归。

src: Attack ignored hostiles that you move adjacent to during autoexplore
zh: 自动探索时攻击你移动至其身旁的被忽略敌人

src: Attack roll increased by =bonus= due to high power load.
zh: 因功率负载较高，攻击检定提高=bonus=。

src: Attack roll reduced by =bonus.abs= due to low power load.
zh: 因功率负载较低，攻击检定降低=bonus.abs=。

src: Attack roll: <stat Name="Attack" /> vs. defender MA + level
zh: 攻击检定：<stat Name="Attack" />对抗防御者的心智护甲+等级
攻击心智护甲，而非护甲值。

src: Atzmus transcendental imprint of being. Pattern trait after creature part, crossed with Body.
zh: 本质，乃存在之超越印记。依造物之部位定性状，与躯体交叉。

src: Audiovisual depictions of the moisture manifold splash over the panel's holographic surface. A small and gentle null melody sounds from the underlight.
zh: 关于水汽流形的视听影像，在面板的全息表面上飞溅流淌。一支微小而温柔的空无旋律，自底光中响起。

src: Augment your Agility attribute by an amount equal to twice your Ego bonus.
zh: 你的敏捷属性增加，增幅等同于你自我加值的两倍。

src: Augment your Strength attribute by an amount equal to twice your Ego bonus.
zh: 你的力量属性增加，增幅等同于你自我加值的两倍。

src: Augment your Toughness attribute by an amount equal to twice your Ego bonus.
zh: 你的坚韧属性增加，增幅等同于你自我加值的两倍。

src: Augments one physical attribute by an amount equal to twice your Ego bonus
zh: 使一项肉体属性提高相当于你自我加成两倍的数值

src: Auric gills tense and release, tense and release, tense and release, as if drawing breath into the puffer's stem. With each exhalation it belches a cloud of golden spores like motes of sunlight. They flutter back to the cap and congeal into a golden plasma.
zh: 金色的菌褶一张一弛，一张一弛，一张一弛，仿佛要把气息吸入喷菌的茎中。每一次呼出，它便喷吐一团金色孢子，宛如阳光的微尘。孢子飘回菌盖，凝作金色的原生质。

src: Auto collection only works on unsealed containers with pure liquids.
zh: 自动收集仅适用于装有纯净液体的未密封容器。

src: Autoget copper, silver, and gold nuggets

zh: 附近有敌人时自动拾取

src: Autoget liquids from containers you've dropped
zh: 自动拾取你丢下的容器中的液体

src: Automatically applies up to 8 loaded injectors when appropriate.
zh: 在适当时机自动注射至多8支已装填的注射器。

src: Automatically dig through walls by moving into them when wielding a digging implement
zh: 手持挖掘工具时，朝墙壁移动即可自动挖穿

src: Automatically digs from your location to a target location.
zh: 自动从你所在处挖至目标地点。

src: Automatically discharges flame-retardant gel every round you're on fire.
zh: 你着火的每一回合，都会自动喷出阻燃凝胶。

src: Automatically discharges flame-retardant gel every turn you're on fire.
zh: 你每一回合处于着火状态时，自动释放阻燃凝胶。

src: Automatically drink fresh water when thirsty
Automatically hide mouse cursor when inactive
zh: 鼠标静止时自动隐藏光标

src: Automatically on your clipboard should you wish to forward it to =author=.
zh: 已自动复制到剪贴板，以便你转交给=author=。

src: Automatically on your clipboard should you wish to forward it to the mod author.
zh: 已自动复制到剪贴板，以便你转交给模组作者。

src: Automatically save when moving to a different zone
zh: 移动至其他区域时自动保存

src:
Ay, you kendren are just as thick as the elders. I'd hoped otherwise.

Yes, I am suggesting that old Grand-Doe is trying to fool you, and the village as well. I'm not certain that she stole it herself, but an investigation might undermine her authority, and she cannot have that.
zh:
唉，你们肯德伦人和长老们一样迟钝。我还盼着不是这样呢。

是的，我是说老大母鹿想愚弄你，也愚弄全村。我不确定是她亲手偷的，但一场调查会动摇她的权威，而她容不得这个。

src:
Aye, aye. The clamor of it all can overwhelm.

The glowcrows say 'twas a bird-god who taught folks to gather like this, in large flocks. So blame birds.
zh:
是啊，是啊。这一切的喧嚣，叫人招架不住。

辉鸦说，是一位鸟神教会了人们这样成群聚居。要怪就怪鸟吧。

src: Aye, the Blue Mother who breaks the sky. Those who Eat called her Gjaus, and those who Wake call her Spindle.
zh: 是啊，劈开天空的蓝母。那些进食者称她吉奥斯，那些觉醒者称她纺锤。

src: Aye, the pest-vanquisher! Live and drink, =name=.
zh: 啊，是除害英雄！且生且饮，=name=。

src:
Aye. Ey, em, eir, eirs, emself. Thusly do we call ourselves and one another.

Sex is personal and mattereth not to a bare acquaintance. Gender is a societal relic in which we see no current utility.
zh:
然也。彼、彼、彼之、彼之所有、彼自身。我们便是如此称呼自己与彼此。

生理性别是私事，与泛泛之交无关。社会性别是社会的遗物，我们看不出它眼下有何用处。

src:
Aye. One's own credo shouldst inspire reflection and thought, with no clear-cut meaning but meaning nonetheless. Some of our coterie yet seeketh theirs, but an experienced watcher no doubt hath one. Any mopango who hath a credo wilt share it with =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, an =ifplayerplural:ye request:thou requesteth= it.

My credo is: "Malice alone staineth the sanctity of questioning."
zh:
然。人之信条，应引发反思与思索，虽无明确之义，却自有其义。我们这一群中仍有人在寻觅自己的信条，但资深的守望者无疑已有。凡有信条的莫潘戈，只要=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=提出请求，便会与=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=分享。

我的信条是：“唯恶意方玷污发问之神圣。”

src:
Aye? I have it, then.

Somethin' is eating our watervine, 'round Beetle Moon. Q-ruun says he saw a creature, spider-like, slinking in the brine. But no cave spider would dare get so near Warden's stomps.

I tasted a bit of red fleck in the pool. Shale, like we find in the soil by Red Rock...
zh:
是吗？那我有活给你。

有什么东西在啃我们的水藤，就在甲虫之月前后。Q-鲁恩说他看见一只蜘蛛似的东西在盐水里溜来溜去。可洞穴蜘蛛哪敢靠守望者的脚步这么近。

我在池水里尝到一点红色的碎屑。是页岩，就像红岩附近土里的那种……

src:
Ayup. But seconds ago. As only yesterday, no? Hoh hoh hoh.

{{emote|*continued croaking laughter*}}
zh:
对啊。就在几秒之前。就像昨天才说过一样，不是吗？呵呵呵。

{{emote|*持续的呱呱笑声*}}

src:
Ayvah. I'd wanted Grand-Doe to be wrong about you kendren, but perhaps you are all violent fools after all.

I'm not asking you to trust me, only to extend to me the same level of trust you give Keh. Is that not reasonable?
zh:
艾瓦。我本希望大母鹿对你们肯德伦人的看法是错的，可也许你们终究都是些暴戾的蠢货。

我不是要你信任我，只要你给我与凯同等的信任。这不合理吗？

src: Ayvah. She must have sold it. Tell no one about this. Please understand that I cannot reward you, as you did not complete the task I asked of you.
zh: 艾瓦。她定是把它卖了。此事莫对任何人提起。请理解，我不能酬谢你，因你未完成我所托之事。

src: Azure gills tense and release, tense and release, tense and release, as if drawing breath into the puffer's stem. With each exhalation it belches a cloud of indigo spores like motes of twilight. They flutter back to the cap and congeal into an azure plasma.
zh: 青色的菌褶一张一弛，一张一弛，一张一弛，仿佛要把气息吸入喷菌的茎中。每一次呼出，它便喷吐一团靛色孢子，宛如暮色的微尘。孢子飘回菌盖，凝作青色的原生质。

src: Azzurum was starsailed from an andromedan quarry, tempered with chrome, and carved to the ritual shape of the chiber to buttress the vault of heaven.
zh: 阿祖鲁姆自仙女座的采石场被星际航运而来，以铬回火，雕成基伯的仪式之形，以支撑天穹之拱。
斯林斯请求接受基础文本
斯林斯请求拒绝基础文本

src:
BE STEERED BY THINE OWN WILL, WORLD-CHILD.

I AM SORRY, MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, BUT THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED.

RETURN IF THOU MUST. LIVE AND QUAFF.
zh:
任汝自循己志，世界之子。

抱歉，吾之觉受诸部隐隐作痛，然生命之树上的冠冕终须修剪。

若汝执意，便回去罢。且生且饮。

src:
BE STEERED BY THINE OWN WILL, WORLD-CHILD.

RETURN IF THOU MUST. LIVE AND QUAFF.
zh:
任汝自循己志，世界之子。

若汝执意，便回去罢。且生且饮。

src: BUT THOU ART SHORTSIGHED. DOST THOU KNOW HOW MANY CLADES OF LIFE WERE FAIN TO PERISH THAT THY PEOPLE MIGHT THRIVE?
zh: 然汝目光短浅。汝可知，为使汝之族类得以昌盛，有多少生命之支系甘愿凋亡？

src:
BUT THOU RECKONEST TOO NARROWLY, AS THOUGH THE SHEDDING SKIN DID FEAR ITS OWN BIRTH IN THE NEWLY-WON SNAKE.

THOU KNOWEST NOT THE SUN-WARMTH OF A COVEN BE-ING. I DO GRIEVE THIS FOR THEE.
zh:
然汝之见识太过狭窄，仿佛蜕下的旧皮会畏惧自己在新生之蛇身上的诞生。

汝不知盟会存在所享的日暖。吾为汝深感悲哀。

src: BY THE RECKONING OF THE GEMARA SOPHIA, THE {{R|EXIT}} WAS DRAWN BY A GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS IN THE PRIOR FIELD.
zh: 依革马拉智慧之推算，{{R|出离}}乃由先前场域中一道益智之流的回旋所牵引。

src:
BY THE RECKONING OF THE GEMARA SOPHIA, THE {{R|EXIT}} WAS DRAWN BY A GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS IN THE PRIOR FIELD.

NOW THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE. TO OUTSURF THE WAVEFORM, A NEW LIFE MUST OBTAIN.
zh:
依革马拉智慧之推算，{{R|出离}}乃由先前场域中一道益智之流的回旋所牵引。

如今恒星之纪行将终了。欲凌驾此波形之上，必须有新生命立足。

src: BY TRETE GALGALLIM SERVEN, BUT NON NOU.
zh: 依此约，加尔加尔人曾效力，然今已不矣。

src: Bandages you apply are much more effective at stopping bleeding.
zh: 你所敷的绷带止血效果大为增强。

src: Banded ropes of hydrogel are bundled into one.
zh: 成条的水凝胶索缆被捆扎为一束。

src: Bands of aquamarine lodestone tori wrap around the hitting part of a hefty, double-fisted truncheon. On the bottom handle there's a slot for a battery to juice the magnets.
zh: 数圈海蓝磁石环带，缠绕在一柄沉重的双手警棍的击打端。底部握柄上有一道槽口，可装入电池，为磁石供能。

src: Barathrum and I will ascend the Spindle inside the Creature?
zh: 我与巴拉斯鲁姆要在造物体内攀登纺锤？

src: Barathrum asked me to deliver your blueprints to Pax Klanq.
zh: 巴拉斯鲁姆托我把你的蓝图交给帕克斯·克朗克。
带有{{M|Q女孩}}{{Y|钟摆}}的巴拉斯鲁姆钟

src: Barathrum intends to ascend the Spindle to discover the source of the Signal, yes. He needs a power source for the climber, one shielded from electromagnetic disturbance.
zh: 巴拉斯鲁姆打算登上纺锤，探寻信号的来源，没错。他需要一个驱动攀升器的能源，能够屏蔽电磁扰动。
巴拉斯鲁姆提到过大机神？

src:
Barathrum needs you for an undertaking of great importance. You must journey to {{C|Omonporch}} far to the north. There the Spindle stretches from earth to sky. Unfortunately, a troublesome merchant from the Consortium of Phyta has relocated there and declared xerself Earl of Omonporch. We need you to broker a deal so that we may lease control of the Spindle. Failing that, you'll need to dispose of the self-appointed Earl.

Be careful on your approach to Omonporch, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. So far east into the reaches of Qud, the Putus Templar lie in wait.
zh:
巴拉斯鲁姆需要你去办一件至关重要的事。你须远行至北方遥远的{{C|奥蒙门廊}}。纺锤在那里自地通天。不巧，植体联盟的一位麻烦商人已迁居该地，并宣布自己为奥蒙门廊伯爵。我们需要你出面斡旋，好让我们租得纺锤的控制权。若不成，你就得除掉这位自封的伯爵。

接近奥蒙门廊时务必小心，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。在卡德极东之地，普图斯圣殿骑士团正伺机而动。

src: Barathrum told of a splinter race of urshiib that took to the stars. Are they real?
zh: 巴拉斯鲁姆说，有一支乌尔希卜的分支种族升入了星空。他们是真的么？

src: Barathrum's invention records time to the momentary tick by regulating its advance with a crown wheel. On learning of its utility, the water barons commissioned the assembly of dozens more in order to take precise measurements of their reservoirs at set moments of the day.
zh: 巴拉斯鲁姆的发明以冕轮调节其前进，将时间记录至瞬息的一次嘀嗒。水权贵族得知其用处后，委托造出数十具，以便在每日既定的时刻精确测量他们的水库。

src: Barathrum, if the past has some relevance to this moment, I would ask you to share what you know.
zh: 巴拉斯鲁姆，若往事与此刻相关，我请你把所知的都说出来。

src: Barathrum, let us again talk about the past.
zh: 巴拉斯鲁姆，让我们再谈谈往事。

src: Barathrum, we're to rest the fate of Qud on a mere cub's tale?
zh: 巴拉斯鲁姆，我们要把卡德的命运，押在一只幼崽的传说上？

src: Barathrum, you look pained. Are you well?
zh: 巴拉斯鲁姆，你面带痛色。可还安好？

src: Baroque and kite-like volumes of metal are arranged on an axis as a lathe to shave dimensionality off their inner spaces. A giant stock and grip of painted fullerite support their tremendous weight.
zh: 巴洛克式的风筝状金属体，沿一道轴线排布如车床，将其内部空间的维度削去。一块巨大的涂漆富勒岩枪托与握把，撑起它们庞大的重量。

src: Bars partition the bangle clasp into three bands; a cobalt button summons the rest of the quartet.
zh: 条杠将腕环扣分作三带；一枚钴蓝按钮可召来其余三重身影。
曝晒者,向光的,光伏的,充裕的,补足者

src: Be ape-still and muse, wanderer, and welcome to my village, Kyakukya. Have some mulled mushroom cider!
zh: 静如猿，沉思吧，漫游者，欢迎来到我的村庄基亚库基亚。来点热的蘑菇苹果酒吧！

src:
Be careful in the flower fields.

Even with Bey Lah marked on your map, it's easy to get lost. Lost travelers feed the lah.
zh:
在花田里务必当心。

即便你的地图上标着贝拉，也很容易迷路。迷途的旅人会被拉花吞食。

src: Be kind, kendren. We are watching you.
zh: 规矩些，肯德伦。我们看着你呢。

src: Be nimble, wayfarer. Take in a draught of cider before leaving.
zh: 身手轻捷些，行路人。临走前喝一口苹果酒吧。

src: Be open. Receive the Greatest Dreams. Hear the Girsh Sing.
zh: 敞开心扉。领受至大之梦。聆听吉尔什歌唱。

src: Be respectful of the red-and-white and we will get along.
zh: 敬重红白之旗，咱们就相安无事。

src: Be straightforward, disciple. You mean to ask if we will house them.
zh: 说得直白些，门徒。你是想问，我们可愿收容他们。

src: Be uncertain, friend. You have my permission.
zh: 尽管不确定吧，朋友。我准你如此。

src: Beams of snug warmth sprout like fractals inside your body.
zh: 一束束熨帖的暖光在你体内如分形般绽出。

src: Bear flesh was cut into neat strips, salted, and smoked.
zh: 熊肉被切成齐整的条，加盐，烟熏。

src: Beautiful baubles and gleaming gemstones over here!
zh: 美丽的饰物与闪亮的宝石，尽在这边！

src: Beautiful ribbons of leaf are etched along the edges of the broad and oiled blade. The pine handle is carved with its name: Difucila.
zh: 美丽的叶带蚀刻在宽阔油亮的刃缘上。松木斧柄上刻着它的名字：蒂富西拉。

src: Beauty in subtraction! Pruner =name= cut the Tree of Life to a more aesthetic form.
zh: 减法亦成美！修枝者=name=将生命之树修剪得更合乎审美。

src:
Beauty manifest, whose chromium shoals are Awe itself. In my belief system, She's the being from whom all metal was birthed, out in the ever-void. There are pieces of Her in every chrome belfry and every machine. Even bits of Her in our own blood.

For me, Her essence extends beyond mere metal. Anything that's ordered, She infuses: a poem, a mathematical proof, a clean workspace... so definitely not Q Girl's.
zh:
显现之美，其铬质浅滩即是敬畏本身。依我的信仰，她是万金之母，在永恒的虚空之外生出一切金属。每座铬质钟楼、每台机器里都有她的碎片，连我们自己的血中也有一丝她的踪影。

于我而言，她的本质不止于金属。凡有秩序之物，她皆灌注其中：一首诗、一道数学证明、一间整洁的工作间……当然，Q女孩的不算。

src: Became obsessed with =book.name:asIfKnown|strip= and forgot to eat
Because, traveler, Mamon is my elder brother. He would discern my presence before I could strike.
zh: 因为，旅人，玛蒙是我兄长。我未及出手，他便会察觉我的存在。

src: Because... I am a Saad, after all.
zh: 因为……我毕竟是一位萨德。

src: Bees are smarter than you think. They got that hive mind, see.
zh: 蜜蜂比你想的聪明。它们有蜂巢的群体意识，懂吧。

src: Bees crawl over the back-mounted slatted rack. A few more dart around nearby.
zh: 蜜蜂在背负的板条架上爬行。附近另有几只飞来窜去。

src: Bees flutter around the brim of =pronouns.possessive= hat, pulled low over =pronouns.possessive= sweaty brow. =pronouns.Possessive= apron is stained with glistening drops of honey.
zh: 蜜蜂在=pronouns.possessive=帽檐四周飞绕，那帽子压得低低，扣在=pronouns.possessive=汗湿的额上。=pronouns.Possessive=围裙上染着一点点闪亮的蜜。

src: Beetle jerky holds its own. You learn to appreciate the aftertaste.
zh: 甲虫肉干自有其味。余味慢慢就懂得欣赏了。

src: Beetles are fine companions, but don't leave your backpack and your pet beetlebum in the same room.
zh: 甲虫是好伙伴，可别把你的背包和你的宠物甲虫臀兽留在同一间屋里。

src: Before even the early Eaters peopled the low medina, when the ark was being prepped to seed the far skies with the terrestrial genome, the first poleis rose out of the entheopolitics and mythoprosaic controversies of Gjaus's construction. Somehow, they stand still.
zh: 甚至在早期食者尚未定居低处麦地那之前，方舟正被准备用来向遥远天空播撒地球的基因组，最初的城邦便已自吉奥斯建造过程中的神圣政治与神话散文式争论中崛起。不知怎的，它们至今仍然屹立。

src: Before you go, rootclimber. I've shed a piece of me in the -elseing. Take it. I have no use for it now.
zh: 临行之前，攀根者。别化之时，我蜕下了一片自己。拿去吧。我如今用不着了。

src:
Before you go, take this, a piece of my bodystuff, as thanks for completing the -elseing.

Then live and drink, =name=.
zh:
临行之前，收下这个，我的一片身体之质，谢你助我完成别化。

然后且生且饮，=name=。

src: Before you move on, you should equip yourself from the nearby chest.
zh: 继续前进之前，你该从附近的箱子里取些装备。

src: Before you move on, you should loot the corpse of the snapjaw.
zh: 继续前进之前，你该搜刮一下豺颚人的尸体。

src: Begins with a number of random artifacts and scrap
zh: 起始携带若干随机古器与废料

src: Begone from me, stardimmer. Your own hand has vaporized your purpose.
zh: 离我远去，暗星者。你自己的手，已将你的目的蒸发殆尽。

src: Begone. Fate has not yet shaped you, utensil.
zh: 滚吧。命运尚未塑造你，器具。

src: Beguiled creature: +<stat Name="BonusHP" /> bonus hit points
zh: 受魅惑的生物：+<stat Name="BonusHP" />点额外生命值

src: Beguiled creatures get <stat Name="BonusHP" /> bonus hit points.
zh: 被魅惑的生物获得<stat Name="BonusHP" />额外生命值。

src: Behind the glass membrane, inside a microcosmic globe, heat gives birth to lobes of molten rock that flow toward their own pyroclastic demise.
zh: 玻璃膜之后、一方微宇宙的球体之内，热分娩出熔岩的叶瓣，它们正流向自身火碎屑的覆灭。

src: Behind the muzzle, a glass-bound nimbus of unstable spacetime curls around an astral tether. The trigger mechanism cuts the tether and out-vacuums the anomaly to the free world.
zh: 枪口之后，一团被玻璃封住的不稳定时空之晕，环绕着一道星界系链盘旋。扳机机构斩断系链，将那异象抽空，放逐至自由的世界。

src: Behind the pane of a bronzed frame are the programmable instruments of glassmaking: stove and blowpipe for hot work, oiler and wheel for cold.
zh: 青铜框的玻璃之后，陈列着可编程的制玻之器：炉与吹管用于热作，油壶与转轮用于冷作。

src: Bel sketched the parabola, Carthax sculpted the torus.
zh: 彼勒描出抛物线，卡萨克斯雕成环面。

src: Bell bronze is shaped to a point and its handle wrapped in leather.
zh: 钟青铜被锻成尖锋，柄上缠着皮革。

src: Beneath a cap of spread gills, the stem contours to a bursting waist. The fungus is fat on the dead of its sliver of loam.
zh: 在铺展的菌褶盖下，菌柄收束成一段将裂的腰。这真菌在自己那一小片壤土的死物上养得肥壮。

src: Beneath a mane of coarse hair, Warden Indrix's lips move without issuing forth any sound, perhaps in the formation of a litany invoked in the name of the vengeful god =pronouns.subjective= =verb:serve:afterpronoun=. The coarse hair grows in an uninterrupted mass down =pronouns.possessive= torso, that of a human but broader and more taut with muscle than any man's, disappearing only behind the sash of =pronouns.possessive= kilt. But for Mayor Nuntu and the warden =pronouns.reflexive=, no one knows the circumstances of Indrix's estrangement from =pronouns.possessive= kin, for no one dares mention it lest they draw the warden's ire. One of =pronouns.possessive= great curling horns has been cleanly cloven from =pronouns.possessive= head, however. That same horn along with several others hang from a belt slung low about Indrix's hips, giving =pronouns.objective= the distinction of being the only warrior to bear =pronouns.possessive= own appendage as a trophy.
zh: 在蓬乱鬃毛之下，守望者因德里克斯的双唇翕动，却不发出半点声音，或许是在默诵一段以=pronouns.subjective=所侍奉的复仇之神之名祈请的祷文。粗毛不间断地铺满=pronouns.possessive=躯干，那是人的躯干，却比任何男子更宽阔、筋肉更紧实，只在=pronouns.possessive=短裙的腰带之后才隐没。然而，除镇长农图与守望者=pronouns.reflexive=之外，无人知晓因德里克斯何以与=pronouns.possessive=亲族生隙，因为无人敢提起此事，唯恐招来守望者的怒火。不过，=pronouns.possessive=一对弯角中已有一只被齐根劈离=pronouns.possessive=头颅。那只角连同另外数只，一同挂在因德里克斯低垂于胯间的腰带上，使=pronouns.objective=成为唯一以=pronouns.possessive=自身肢体为战利品的战士。

src: Beneath the metal shutter, a crystalline disk is grooved with microscopic pits that encode data.
zh: 金属护板之下，一枚晶体圆盘刻满微观凹坑，以编码数据。

src: Beneath the sunning poleis on the surface, unmappable labyrinths of cavernous, hollowed-out fiberstuff seat chiliads of fossilized underculture.
zh: 在地表阳光普照的城邦之下，无从绘图的洞窟迷宫由镂空的纤维物质构成，其中安放着数千年化石般的地下文化。

src: Benevolent =name= agreed to meddle in the affairs of the meadow at the behest of a deerfolk pariah. The sultan reigns with kindheartedness!
zh: 仁慈的=name=应一名鹿民弃民之请，答应插手草甸事务。苏丹仁厚治世！

src: Bent roots chunnel upward to a canopy of fuzz. The eye tries to draw a boundary around single leaves, but their light lines sputter and lose their derivatives.
zh: 弯曲的根系向上穿行，直抵绒毛般的树冠。目光试图为每片叶子勾出边界，然而它们的光线却噼啪闪烁，导数尽失。

src: Berate, Intimidate, and Menacing Stare also confuse per Confusion rank 10.
zh: “斥责”“威吓”与“威吓凝视”同样会按“迷乱”等级10造成迷乱。

src: Best not leave town without some bark and bandages, wayfarer.
zh: 出城前最好带些树皮与绷带，行路人。

src: Best protect your hands, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You don't know how much you need them until a madpole takes one.
zh: 最好护住双手，=player.formalAddressTerm=。直到被狂蝌蚪咬掉一只，你才知道有多离不开它们。

src: Bestows the {{|=effect.name=}} effect to =factionId.factionName= who can see this item.
zh: 使能看见此物品的=factionId.factionName=获得{{|=effect.name=}}效果。

src:
Bethesda Susa is a vibrant and thriving ecosystem in which we have no place. That said, I certainly would not complain if someone were to clear out its Mechanimist infestation.

Should you travel there, watch your step. The fronds of a lurking beth can rapidly exsanguinate fleshy creatures such as we.
zh:
毕士大-苏萨是个生机勃勃、欣欣向荣的生态，我们在其中没有立足之地。话虽如此，若有人把盘踞其中的机神教之患扫除干净，我断不会抱怨。

你若去那儿，当心脚下。潜伏的贝丝的叶片，能迅速放干你我这类血肉之躯的血。

src:
Bethesda Susa is an antipodal place, a gallery of life and death and the stages between. Its depths prolong life and end it early, remove life from the flow of days or return it.

It will seek to make you late. Take care you come back on time.
zh:
毕士大-苏萨是个对跖之地，是一座陈列生、死与二者之间诸般阶段的回廊。其深处既能延长生命，亦能使之早夭；既能将生命从光阴之流中抽走，亦能使之重返。

它会设法让你迟到。当心，要准时回来。

src: Bethesda Susa? Lovely, but a bit dangerous for a holiday destination. You'll want to bring bandages and warm clothing. Why not take a look at my stock in case something suits you?
zh: 毕士大-苏萨？可爱是可爱，作度假之地却有点险。你得带上绷带与保暖衣物。何不看看我的存货，说不定有合你用的？

src: Between the multipronged sticktool and cipherbox, one can interface with all available robotic ports.
zh: 凭借多叉的探杖与密码匣，可与所有现存的机器端口相接。

src: Bey Lah is gone. I hope you're happy.
zh: 贝拉没了。你可满意了吧。

src:
Bey Lah is real? Stain me surprised to hear so... I, ah, believed the hindren exclusively diasporic.

There is an undeniable poetry in it, if the slynth should emigrate to a mythical and secretive village. I will discuss this with my kin.
zh:
贝拉是真的？真叫我吃惊……我，呃，一直以为欣德伦人只有离散流亡的。

倘若斯林斯人迁往一座神秘而隐秘的村庄，那确有一种不容否认的诗意。我会与族人商议。

src: Big Yrame shifts =pronouns.possessive= weight between hind and forelegs. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:shake:afterpronoun= a storm of rust dander from the tines of =pronouns.possessive= great horns, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:blow:afterpronoun= a halo of freezing air from =pronouns.possessive= rime-veined hands.
zh: 大伊拉梅在前后腿之间移着=pronouns.possessive=重心。=pronouns.Subjective=把一场锈尘的风暴自=pronouns.possessive=巨角的角尖抖落，又从=pronouns.possessive=霜纹纵横的手中吹出一圈凛冽之气的晕环；=pronouns.subjective=的蹄下，地面已结起薄霜。

src: Big diaphanous wings bat the air as =pronouns.subjective= =verb:drone:afterpronoun= in place.
zh: 硕大的薄翼拍击空气，=pronouns.subjective=原地嗡嗡悬停。

src: Billets of shaved dogwood contour to the breasts, waist, and thigh. The husk is beetle-eaten.
zh: 削薄的山茱萸木片，贴合着胸、腰与大腿的曲线。外壳已被甲虫蛀蚀。
生物循环的,绯红的,立体派的,生态的,血色的

src: Biomech: Has biomechanical power transmission systems.
zh: 生机：具备生物机械动力传输系统。

src: Bits of tiny matter are smashed together behind the lune of a chrome cylinder, and the heat is used to pump electricity downgrid.
zh: 微小的物质碎粒在一枚铬制圆柱的月牙之后相撞，其热被用来把电送往电网下游。

src: Bits of tiny matter are smashed together behind the lune of a glass cylinder, and the heat is used to pump water into pipes for dispersal.
zh: 微尘般的细小物质在玻璃圆柱的弦月形窗后相互撞击聚合，所生之热被用来将水泵入管道，以供分流。

src: Bits sleep until animated inside their rectangle coffin.
zh: 比特沉睡在这方矩形的棺中，只待被唤醒。

src: Black acrylic grips are paired off the sides of ceremonial chrome magazine well.
zh: 黑色亚克力握片成对嵌于典礼用铬质弹匣井两侧。

src: Black acrylic grips are run through with hairline cracks from where nervous and sweat-damp hands squeezed the precision out of their shot.
zh: 黑色丙烯酸握把上，布满发丝般的裂纹，那是紧张而汗湿的双手把精准从子弹里挤了出去。

src: Black fullerite merely dents where weak collagen would be smashed to bits.
zh: 黑色富勒岩至多只是凹陷，换作孱弱的胶原早已被砸得粉碎。

src: Black grates kindled by the light of the jeweled cosmos are stamped in dust with the hoofprint signatures of six hundred worlds.
zh: 黑色格栅为宝石穹宇之光所点燃，尘中印着六百个世界的蹄印签名。

src: Black islands of carbon gravel populate an ocean of bitumen and rise from the horizontal plane toward the emptiness of the air-rasp. Time and pressure have laid hair-line trenches along the basin.
zh: 黑色的碳砾之岛点缀着沥青之海，自水平面升起，伸向气流粗粝呼啸的空茫。时间与压力沿着盆地刻下发丝般细的沟壑。

src: Black marble quarried from the early earth binds the art of a life.
zh: 自太初之地开采的黑大理石，系住了一生的艺术。

src: Black marble quarried from the early earth divides the art of a life.
zh: 自太初之地开采的黑大理石，分隔了一生的艺术。

src: Black marble rectangles tesselate the path.
zh: 黑色大理石长方砖铺成小径。

src: Black marble was quarried from the vast reaches of the underearth and chiseled into a stone blanket for the dead.
zh: 黑色大理石采自地下深处的广阔之境，凿成一床石毯，覆盖逝者。

src: Black marble was rasped into a vaulted canvas of emptiness, and then left, inspiring wonder at what could have been.
zh: 黑大理石被锉成一幅拱顶的空无画布，而后遗弃于此，令人遐想它本可成为什么，不禁惊叹。

src: Black stone stands in monument to the cities of snails that perished under clay and rotted into pyrite.
zh: 黑石矗立，如同一座纪念碑，纪念那些葬身黏土、腐为黄铁矿的蜗牛之城。

src: Blasphemously, the traitor =object.name= attacked =subject.name=, =object.its= water-sib, and =subject.name= was forced to slay =object.them=. Deep in grief, =subject.name= wept for one year.
zh: 叛徒=object.name=亵渎神圣，竟对=object.its=水亲=subject.name=下手，=subject.name=不得已将=object.them=诛杀。=subject.name=悲痛欲绝，为之痛哭一年。

src: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue.
zh: 高炉将潮汐之力从星球上汲干，把碳加热至恒星般的温度，倾入六角形的模具。取铸块所用的翡翠钳子，将钒——那一缕绿芒——雾化，排入歧管，使金属有了瑕疵，亦赋予其特有的色泽。

src: Blast furnaces sucked the tidal energy out of the planet, heated carbon to solar temperatures, and poured it into hexagonal molds. The emerald tongs used to retrieve the casts atomized and vented vanadium -- the green glint -- into the manifold, imperfecting the metal and conferring its characteristic hue. Casts mottled with dust particles were culled and fed to lithovores, leaving only the perfect hexagonal prisms.
zh: 高炉将潮汐之力从星球上汲干，把碳加热至恒星般的温度，倾入六角形的模具。取铸块所用的翡翠钳子，将钒——那一缕绿芒——雾化，排入歧管，使金属有了瑕疵，亦赋予其特有的色泽。杂有尘粒斑点的铸块被剔除，喂给噬石者，只余下完美的六棱柱。

src: Blaze was extracted from its injector, thickened in the acrid air, and bottled for culinary use.
zh: 烈焰自其注射器中抽出，在辛辣的空气中浓稠起来，装瓶备作烹调之用。

src: Bleached cyan grave moss has grown into a rare and supple clump.
zh: 漂白的青色墓苔长成了一丛罕见而柔韧的簇团。

src: Blemishes cross the long barrel of an unidentified gun.
zh: 斑痕横过一把不明枪械的长枪管。

src: Blemishes cross the short barrel of an unidentified gun.
zh: 斑痕横过一把不明枪械的短枪管。

src: Blemishes of long use cross the surface of the footwear.
zh: 长年使用的斑痕横过这双鞋的表面。

src: Bless the =day= of =month=, when =name= cemented a historic alliance with fungi by contracting =object.name= on =player.their= =part.ordinalName=!
zh: 当赞=month==day=日：是日，=name=于=player.their==part.ordinalName=染上=object.name=，遂与真菌结下传世之盟！

src: Bless the =day= of =month=, when =name= dissolved a sham alliance with the treacherous fungi by curing the =object.name|strip= infection on =player.their= =part.ordinalName=.
zh: 当赞=month==day=日：是日，=name=治好=player.their==part.ordinalName=上的=object.name|strip=感染，与狡诈真菌的虚假同盟由此瓦解。

src: Bless this mess and bless you, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
zh: 愿这一团狼藉得福，也愿你得福，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

src:
Bless you, =player.formalAddressTerm=. I feel better knowing that at least one kendren will reach back to aid my kin. They are on the cusp of a new fate, and I wish to see it while I yet live.

Let me advise you of Bey Lah's location, and here is a little chew-boon for your trouble.
zh:
愿福临你，=player.formalAddressTerm=。至少有一位肯德伦愿向我的族人伸出援手，我心里踏实多了。他们正处于新命运的边缘，我希望趁我尚在人世，能亲眼见证。

让我告诉你贝拉的所在，这点嚼豆就算作你辛苦的酬劳。

src: Blessed be the Godhed, Whom we planish and uplift.
zh: 愿神裔蒙福，我们锻之而擢升。

src: Blessed was the =day= of =month=, in the year of =year=, when =name= was cured of greying eye!
zh: 当赞=month==day=日，即=year=年：是日，=name=得脱灰眼之疾！

src: Blessed was the =day= of =month=, in the year of =year=, when =name= was cured of ironing leg!
zh: 当赞=month==day=日，即=year=年：是日，=name=得脱熨腿之疾！

src: Blessed was the =day= of =month=, in the year of =year=, when =name= was cured of the rotting tongue!
zh: 当赞=month==day=日，即=year=年：是日，=name=得脱腐舌之疾！

src: Blinding light shines off the slick and stretchy suit of vulcanized sap and creates a postpartum amniotic sac.
zh: 刺目的强光从这件滑腻而有弹性的硫化树液服上闪射，造出一只产后的羊膜囊。

src: Blips in the wave graph of stone over time.
zh: 石之波形图上，时间的微小脉冲。

src: Blood sieved of chunky pieces sloshes around a cannister of tetraxenonoglass. Vacuum pressure sucks air in through the barrel, and slits on the slide stop vent a metronomic belch.
zh: 滤去了大块残渣的血，在一只四氙玻璃罐中晃荡。真空压力将空气自枪管吸入，滑套止榫上的缝隙以节拍器般的节律排出一声嗝。

src: Blood tastes all right, but I can't fathom living on it.
zh: 血的味道还行，可我实在想不通怎么能靠它过活。

src: Blue and shining metal narrows to a sticking point.
zh: 蓝亮的金属收窄成一枚刺点。

src: Blue carbide merely dents where weak collagen would be smashed to bits.
zh: 蓝色碳化物仅仅凹陷，而弱胶原早已粉碎。

src: Blue laser light bursts out of the reference beam and reimagines a wavefront sculpted on a light lathe. Air adds a layer of grain.
zh: 蓝色激光自参考光束中迸发，重构了一道在光车床上雕出的波前。空气又添了一层颗粒质感。

src: Blueshifted panicles on long stems poplock to invisible quantum eddies.
zh: 长茎上的蓝移花穗随着看不见的量子涡旋忽停忽走。

src: Boar flesh was cut into neat strips, salted, and smoked.
zh: 野猪肉被切成齐整的条，加盐，烟熏。

src: Boar hide was brined, limed, and put in a tanning drum. It was cut and fitted into an apron, and now it's a brown canvas for knife scars and tong burns.
zh: 野猪皮经盐渍、灰浸，投入鞣革转鼓，裁制成围裙；如今它成了一块褐色的画布，满载刀痕与钳灼。

src: Boar leather vamps are scuffed with little fissures sparking in wind-rasped quartz.
zh: 野猪皮的鞋面上布满细小裂隙，在风蚀的石英中迸出火花。

src: Boartooth beads on the ancient charm are worn to nubs by the cartilage of time, but the flexing cable that holds them together is as strong as the day it was woven. Dangling from the bracelet is a figurine of a deer, carved from a mysterious substance that cracks light like crystal but weighs like metal, producing a shaded lifelikeness elsewhere unseen.
zh: 古老护符上的野猪牙珠，已被时间的软骨磨成钝头，而穿系它们的柔韧缆线却坚固如初编之日。手镯上垂着一尊鹿形小像，以一种神秘的物质雕成：它如水晶般折射光线，重量却如金属，生出别处不曾见的幽影逼真之态。

src: Body of creature friend to form Creature after. Must follow you and be experience. No worry, friend not consumed in creation.
zh: 造物之友的躯体，其后化为造物。须随你同行，且有经验。莫忧，友不会在造物中耗尽。

src: Boiled goat leather was cut to a cuirass and fit with straps and iron buckles. It smells of beeswax.
zh: 煮硬的山羊皮被裁作胸甲，配以皮带与铁扣。散发着蜂蜡的气味。

src: Bone bits are aerosolized into a thick coal fog. Light is lost inside.
zh: 骨屑化作浓稠的煤色雾霭，光亮没入其中，一去不返。

src: Bone fractals burst from the dome in broad and stunning display.
zh: 骨质分形自颅顶迸发，铺展得宽阔而惊人。

src: Bone-grey ash sticks to the grooves of flat black di-rubber.
zh: 骨灰色的灰烬黏附于扁平黑色双橡胶的凹槽之间。

src: Bone-shapes of the human form are disarranged to tessellate properly. Round skulls require ulna knots to fill the gaps in their sequences. The boundaries of this world are rice-white and filled with presence.
zh: 人形的骨骼被拆散重排，以求严丝合缝。圆颅需以尺骨结填补序列间的空隙。此界的边界白如稻米，充盈着在场之感。

src: Bonnet blue wings contour to =pronouns.possessive= abdominal balloon, puffed out to blimpish volume by the garbage =pronouns.subjective= =verb:have:afterpronoun= eaten.
zh: 青蓝的翅顺着=pronouns.possessive=膨大的腹部勾出轮廓，那腹部被=pronouns.subjective=所食的垃圾撑得如飞艇一般。

src: Bonus resistances based on arcology of origin
zh: 依出身生态城获得额外抗性

src: Bonus reward for completing this quest by level &C=level=&y.
zh: 在&C=level=&y级之前完成此任务的额外奖励。

src: Boon-friend asks a friend-boon, and what boon is friend! rrk welcome slynth to an Yd, be safe and free as woodsmoke.
zh: 恩友求友恩，友便是恩！咯欢迎斯林斯入伊德，安然自在，如林中炊烟。

src: Boots! Shoes! Slippers! Sabatons! How would you prefer to cover your feet, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
zh: 靴子！鞋子！拖鞋！铁足甲！你想怎样包裹双脚，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

src: Bore ribbons in the chrome like wild ants and see a cross-section of human and shell!
zh: 像野蚁般在铬中钻出条条缎带，看一看人与壳的横截面！

src: Bow polyps colonize the cylindrical topology of the lattice and pattern out an orthogonal neighborhood in a network of life.
zh: 弓形水螅体殖居于格网的圆柱拓扑之上，在生命网络中织出彼此正交的街区。

src: Bracers are a Bey Lah craft! It would make no sense for a kendren to have one, then throw it away in the village.
zh: 护腕是贝拉的手艺！肯德伦拿着一只，再把它扔在村里，说不通。

src: Braided tassels spill out of the shadows to frame a blank countenance, and the pleats of a sarong thrash to an unfelt wind. =pronouns.Possessive= goatish stirring is refracted on the boundaries of sight's prism; =pronouns.possessive= horned figure appears underlaid to reality, like a grayscale dream.
zh: 编结的穗子自阴影中垂落，框住一副空茫的容颜；纱笼的褶子在没有风时也翻腾搅动。=pronouns.Possessive=羊性的悸动在视觉棱镜的界面上折射；=pronouns.possessive=生角的身影恍若衬垫于现实之下，如同一场灰度的梦。

src: Braids of fibrous plant veins enmesh compacted mud and weep a brackish blood.
zh: 纤维状的植物脉络编成辫，缠结着压实的泥土，渗出咸涩的血。

src: Braids of roots and ribbons of fronds dimensionalize the flat loam. Something's home a discarded leaf makes.
zh: 根须交缠，叶带飘垂，为平坦沃土添上维度。一片弃叶，竟成了什么东西的家。

src: Braids of thick neck muscle follow the leylines of fur on =pronouns.possessive= scowling face. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:clutch:afterpronoun= =pronouns.possessive= weapon in hard embrace, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:paint:afterpronoun= a sneer with =pronouns.possessive= lip to suggest how enamored =pronouns.subjective= =verb:are:afterpronoun= with =pronouns.possessive= role as rank thug.
zh: 粗壮的颈肌绞成辫状，沿着=pronouns.possessive=面庞毛发的纹路攀行，那脸庞正蹙着眉。=pronouns.Subjective=将=pronouns.possessive=武器死箍入怀，又挑起=pronouns.possessive=唇上的一抹冷笑，仿佛=pronouns.subjective=对自己身为一流恶棍的角色乐在其中——而=pronouns.subjective=也确实深爱=pronouns.possessive=这重身份。

src: Brained in retaliation for stealing from =faction.the.name=

Branches of the living tree were resorbed and reformed into trunk knots. Then, hundreds of years later, the oiled saw of a gorge woodworker disarranged the arbor geometry and flattened it for civil use. That history remains cast in two dimensions, powdered with dust and scratched in pencil.
zh: 活树的枝条被重新吸收，重塑为树干上的节瘤。数百年后，峡谷木匠涂油的锯子打乱了树木的几何，将其削平以供民用。那段历史仍被铸在二维之中，覆着灰尘，以铅笔刻划。

src: Brass bands frame an old iron box eaten red by air and rain.
zh: 黄铜箍带框住一只旧铁箱，箱身已被风雨蚀成赤红。

src: Brass gears, balls, and rings turn in precise mimicry of worlds and stars.
zh: 黄铜齿轮、球体与环圈精准地转动，模仿着诸世界与群星。

src: Brassy. If you bent him he might snap. The way I treat liquids on my burner, Otho treats the units of the enclave.
zh: 黄铜般的。若把他掰弯，他或许会折断。我在炉上如何对待液体，奥索便如何对待聚落里的各个单元。

src: Bravery! =name= plunged into the mouth of an open ice shelf and conversed with a baetyl in the sacred tongue.
zh: 勇气可嘉！=name=跃入敞开的冰架深处，以神圣的语言与圣石交谈。
向守望者尼拉欣德简报

src: Bright and wide metal is polished to a ghost shine. Streaks of shaded blue show where the large blade was carbon-folded on the forge.
zh: 宽阔的亮金属被磨出幽魂般的光泽。一道道深浅的蓝纹，显示这柄巨刃曾在锻炉上经过碳折叠。

src: Bright azure metal edges out into an elegant half-circle bound to a steel shaft.
zh: 明亮的蔚蓝金属向外伸展成一道优雅的半圆，缚于钢柄之上。

src: Bright azure metal edges out into two elegant half-circles bound to a long steel shaft.
zh: 明亮的蔚蓝金属向外伸展成两道优雅的半圆，缚于一根长钢柄之上。

src: Bright florets explode from a central disc of darker, spiraling florets. Together they're like a tiny sun.
zh: 明亮的小花自中心较暗的螺旋小花盘中迸发绽放。聚在一处，它们宛如一轮小小太阳。

src: Bright glints in the rapture-stapled eyes of an anemic water merchant give you sudden pause. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:are:afterpronoun= appareled in a patchwork of cloak shreds, and despite the lake of sweat settled on the oily sediment of =pronouns.possessive= skin, =pronouns.possessive= mouth is parched in fissures after days of refusing to drink the very life water =pronouns.subjective= =verb:peddle:afterpronoun=. Improbably, =pronouns.possessive= countenance still manages a hue of glee, glistening in the fire of a secret unshared.
zh: 一名面色苍白的水商，眼中被狂喜钉住，闪出亮光，令你骤然止步。=pronouns.Subjective=身披破布拼缀的斗篷；尽管汗水如湖，积在=pronouns.possessive=皮肤油腻的沉垢之上，=pronouns.possessive=嘴却干裂成缝——=pronouns.subjective=已数日不肯饮下自己贩卖的活命之水。不可思议的是，=pronouns.possessive=脸上仍挂着几分欢欣，在某种未曾吐露的秘密之火中闪亮。

src: Bright hyphae lick mud off the ground.
zh: 明亮的菌丝舔舐着地上的泥浆。

src: Bright metal is polished to a ghost shine. Streaks of shaded blue show where the blade was carbon-folded on the forge.
zh: 亮金属被磨出幽魂般的光泽。一道道深浅的蓝纹，显示这柄刃曾在锻炉上经过碳折叠。

src: Bright metal spills out the leather fuzz hilt along the killer's recurve.
zh: 亮金属自皮毛般的柄中溢出，沿着杀手的反曲刃弧流淌。

src: Bright sequin leaves shimmer in indigo constellations, and branches fork through the entropy fungus.
zh: 明亮的亮片叶在靛蓝星座间闪烁，枝条则穿过熵菌分叉生长。

src: Bright steel was moulded to a crescent for scything the rough hides of watervine.
zh: 亮钢被锻成新月之形，用以镰割水藤粗糙的皮。

src: Bright sun-iron fused in the collision of neutron stars has been incised with rhombic smoking windows and fit over a crucible of burning seed.
zh: 明亮的日铁，熔合于中子星相撞之时，被刻上菱形的熏烟窗口，并扣在一只燃烧种子的坩埚之上。

src: Bright tracery charts a life time of meaning through the black marble void of the door's surface. A family name is inscribed on a memorial plaque.
zh: 明亮的嵌纹在门面黑色大理石的虚空里，勾出一生意义的路图。一方纪念牌上刻着一族的姓氏。

src: Brightness burns your mouth and inspirits you.
zh: 炽亮灼烧你的口舌，令你精神一振。

src: Brightness burns your mouth, but you cannot be roused any higher.
zh: 炽亮灼烧你的口舌，然而你已无法再被唤得更高。

src: Brinestalk is shaved into pickets and set across an iron-latched rail.
zh: 盐茎被刨成尖桩，横排插在一根带铁闩的横杆上。

src: Brinestalk splinters and smokes inside a piped hearth of old stone.
zh: 盐茎在一座古石所砌、带管道的炉膛内裂开，冒起浓烟。

src: Brinestalk was scythed from its marsh home and dried in the high salt sun. Its top is spiraled into a crook.
zh: 盐茎自其沼泽故园中被镰刈而下，于高悬的盐日之下晒干。其顶端盘成一道弯钩。

src: Brinestraw was braided into a rope lattice saddle for slinging between two old oaks and napping. The fibers on the middle-sag are extra frayed from the center-mass strain of a reclining ass.
zh: 盐草被编成绳网鞍座，悬于两棵老橡树之间，以供小憩。中陷之处的纤维格外磨损，皆因斜倚的臀部将重压集于一点。

src: Bring 20 drams of primordial soup to Pax Klanq.
zh: 给帕克斯·克朗克带去20打兰原初汤。

src: Broad panels of stardyed metal enclose the starship hangar and act as palimpsests to ten hundred alphabets.
zh: 宽阔的星染金属板围合起星舰机库，如同千百种字母的重写羊皮卷。

src: Broken crystal narrows to a hateful razor at the shard seams. It cracked at the resonance curvature of anguish, and fell out of its host rock as a shattered promise.
zh: 破碎的水晶在碎片接缝处收窄为一道可憎的剃刀。它在痛苦的共鸣曲率处裂开，如一个破碎的诺言，从其宿主岩中坠落。

src: Broken scales and burnt feathers lay in flat tessellation.
zh: 碎裂的鳞与烧焦的羽摊作平整的嵌纹。

src: Broken scales lay in flat tessellation.
zh: 碎裂的鳞片平平铺叠，如镶嵌之砖。

src: Bronze was melted and cooled, shaped and etched, to deliver the water of life.
zh: 青铜被熔化冷却，塑形镌刻，以盛载生命之水。

src: Brown sludge splashes into your mouth. You wince at the metallic taste.
zh: 褐色淤泥溅入你口中。那金属般的味道令你皱起眉头。

src: Brumes of spinning mold-dots make the air look fuzzy.
zh: 旋转的霉点织成一团团薄雾，令空气看来毛茸茸的。

src: Bubbles of green stipules are arrayed in rings of quickening lattice growth. The pace is sorcerous; the earnest and everforward will of the plantworld is captured here at a millionfold.
zh: 绿意托叶的气泡列成环带，织成渐次生长的格网。其势妖异；此间凝住植物界诚笃而永向前行的意志，并将之放大百万倍。

src: Bubbling death sludge pools at the tips of =pronouns.possessive= fangs and drips onto pallid leg-things. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:shudder:afterpronoun= in the capture of some pristine ecstasy lost to space and time, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:let:afterpronoun= out a proud and piercing whine.
zh: 沸腾的死亡淤浆在=pronouns.possessive=獠牙尖端汇聚，滴落在苍白的肢状之物上。=pronouns.Subjective=为之震颤，仿佛被某种失落在时空之外的纯然狂喜攫住，=pronouns.subjective=又发出一声骄傲而尖利的悲鸣。

src: Bug muscle is heaped and plated on broken exobone.
zh: 甲虫的肌肉堆叠着，盛在破碎的外骨骼上。

src: Bug muscle is heaped and plated on broken shell.
zh: 甲虫的肌肉堆叠着，盛在破碎的甲壳上。
构筑代码已复制到剪贴板。
筑造者,懦夫,守卫者,屋顶,受围攻者,坚毅者

src: Bulbous snags of plant are clustered in sundry sizes. Spines poke through the dusty spider matting that dresses them.
zh: 球状的植物残株大大小小地聚成一簇。尖刺穿透覆在其上的那层尘扑扑的蛛网。

src: Bump, scars, and ridges crisscross the monstrous waveform shell from where the boundaries of dimensions ground against the interstitial space. A soft organ-thing lies inside, lit by the glimmers of Old Light flashing off the all-color nacre. Grooves across the shell mantle billow with the dust of ontoxanthellae, cross-dimensional symbiotes. Arrayed aside them are articles of other places, a pan-dimensional inventory stocked by an entropic broker.
zh: 隆块、疤痕与脊棱交横在这具怪物般的波状外壳上，那是维度边界与隙间空间相磨之处。一只柔软的器官之物卧在里面，被旧光的微芒照亮——那光自全彩的珠母上闪过。壳幔上的沟槽里腾起尘埃，那是外生藻共生体的尘。它们旁边陈列着别处的物件，一份由熵之经纪商备下的、遍及诸维的存货。

src: Bunched wafers reaped from the moisture-sucking watervine plant and bound by twine.
zh: 从吸水的藤本植物上割下的薄饼成束，用细绳捆起。

src: Burned at the stake for promulgating =book.name:asIfKnown|strip=

Burning rubies, carnelians, and garnets are arranged as a warm and giving sun. Diminutive rocky orbs pass by in the near space of the visage, and in the far space a prism of freight lengthens into a wider void. The inside of the mask is ribboned with burnt tracery from where it was molded on a gallium lathe, then dyed with the milked irises of shedim and set to dry in a pool of warm static.
zh: 燃烧的红宝石、红玉髓与石榴石，排列成一轮温暖而慷慨的太阳。细小的岩质天球从面庞近处的空间掠过，远处的空间里，一枚货运棱柱延伸成更宽广的虚空。面具内侧，布满灼烧的纹饰，是在镓车床上模铸时留下的，继而以谢德乳白的虹膜染色，置于一池温热的静电中晾干。

src: Burnished bronze is burned to light-in-ceremony by hot coal.
zh: 打磨光亮的青铜，被炽炭焚为仪式中的光明。

src: Burnt clay ingots are laid crosswise, and a barrier is made. Each brick is marred by the variegated cuts of time, imperfections in the heat balance of the oven it was fired in, and fungi in its birthing mud.
zh: 烧制的黏土锭被横向砌叠，筑成一道屏障。每块砖上都带着时间斑驳的刻痕、烧窑时火候不均的瑕疵，以及诞生它的泥中所生的真菌。

src: Burnt crystal gold tosses its geometric shadows onto the floors of a million watery grottos.
zh: 燃尽的晶金将几何形的影子，抛在百万座水下石窟的地面上。

src: Burnt light erupts on the chromium plate and shatters into a figure from the deep past. Hair, skin, brow, thigh: the features hatch a new emotion inside you, the sense of the strange-familiar. As you move about, the figure moves in parallax; you wonder at how this Eater managed to incise themself into your spacetime braid.
zh: 灼热之光在铬板上迸发，碎成一尊来自深古的身影。发，肤，眉，股：五官在你心中孵出一种新的情绪，一种陌生而熟悉之感。你一走动，那身影便随之产生视差；你不禁惊叹这位食者竟能将自身镌刻进你的时空发辫之中。

src: Bursts of coral and treelife from the outer rim of worlds crawl up the palanquin's magnetized legs and toward its golden roof. Chimes ring at the ritual of going, and fruited smoke pours from its portals.
zh: 自世界外缘而来的珊瑚与树生之物簇簇迸发，沿着这乘轿的磁化轿足向其金顶攀爬。逝去之仪时，钟声齐鸣，果香的烟雾自其门户涌出。

src: But 1,000 years ago you cured them.
zh: 但千年之前，你治愈了它们。

src: But I must leave you if you won't concede
zh: 但君若不肯承认，我只得离去，

src: But Resheph is dead. The sultanate is dissolved.
zh: 但利悉已经死了。苏丹国已经解体。

src: But alas. Like our sea-grape friend's lockbox, these memories are not mine to retrieve at will. They come and go, and may be warped by eld.
zh: 可惜啊。如同我们那位海葡萄朋友的保险匣，这些记忆并不由我随意取用。它们来来去去，还会被年岁扭曲。

src: But first, you just became hungry. You need to eat.
zh: 不过先等等，你刚觉得饿了。你得吃点东西。

src: But is there anyone else here on the Quay?
zh: 可是这码头上还有别人吗？

src:
But perhaps you are right, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Think for a moment.

Every ingredient in the soup of collective knowledge is a valuable one, and who am I to elevate myself over more humble pioneers? But! All the more reason for us to regard cuisine (and by extension, culture itself) to be a scientific endeavor, an ongoing trial-and-error, a blending of what we know and what we don't know, calling upon reality itself to be our guide.

You are more insightful than I realized, =name=. Thank you for this discussion. Did you need aught else?
zh:
不过，或许你是对的，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你想一想。

集体知识这锅汤里，每一味材料都有其价值，我又凭什么抬高自己，压过那些更谦卑的先行者？但是！这愈发是我们将烹饪（乃至文化本身）视作科学事业的理由——一场不断试错的事业，将已知与未知相融，召唤现实本身来作我们的向导。

你比我以为的更有见地，=name=。多谢这番交谈。你还需要什么吗？

src: But she doesn't, does she? Only sisters.
zh: 可她并没有，对不对？只有姐妹而已。

src: But the sin of time has corroded their wiring.
zh: 然而时间之罪已腐蚀它们的线路。

src: But weren't the rumors of sore throats in the village? That wouldn't have anything to do with kendren.
zh: 可喉咙痛的传言不是在村里吗？那与肯德伦毫无关系。

src: But worship eagerly, and the land shall shine again!
zh: 但若虔心崇拜，这片土地必将重放光芒！

src: But you entered into a covenant with Barathrum.
zh: 可你与巴拉斯鲁姆立过盟约。

src: But you owe Barathrum. He needs your help.
zh: 可你欠巴拉斯鲁姆的。他需要你相助。

src: But you're also doing the other thing.
zh: 可你同时也在做另一件事。

src: Buttons are set in a vertical pair across a rectangle of scrawled-on metal.
zh: 两枚按钮上下并排，嵌在一片写满字迹的矩形金属上。

src:
Buy something, and I will call you 'customer'.

If I remember to.
zh:
买点东西，我就叫你“顾客”。

若我还记得的话。

src: By Her Light, it's ghastly. May I touch it?
zh: 凭她之光，真是可怕。我能摸摸它吗？

src: By a bright enough light, =pronouns.subjective= nearly =verb:glow:afterpronoun=. How the hide of =pronouns.possessive= striped trunk shines like ribbons of painted glass suspended in a crystal shell -- and yet =pronouns.subjective= =verb:move:afterpronoun=. =pronouns.Possessive= fractal gills waft in an unseen current, and from time to time, =pronouns.subjective= =verb:croon:afterpronoun= a soft and howling melody.
zh: 在足亮的光下，=pronouns.subjective=几乎自身发光。=pronouns.possessive=那纹彩斑斑的躯干之皮何其光亮，宛如悬在水晶壳中的彩绘玻璃带——可=pronouns.subjective=竟会动。=pronouns.Possessive=分形的鳃在水流不可见处飘拂，间或，=pronouns.subjective=低吟出一段柔和而长嚎的旋律。

src:
By my adornments, it is the mat below and its home-havers.
It is not? I offer a strand. This entry can be at home.
Having all time and no entry-home, we addle.
zh:
据我之饰物，是下方之垫与其居家者。
不是吗？我予一缕。此条目可在家中。
拥有全部时间而无条目之家，我们昏乱。

src: By the Eaters, I'm exhausted. May I help you?
zh: 食者在上，我累坏了。有什么能帮你的吗？

src: By the Eaters, have you ever seen so much treasure?
zh: 食者在上，你可曾见过这么多宝贝？

src: By the Eaters, how prosperous we've been. I've never seen the village so flush with fresh water.
zh: 食者在上，我们真是富足。我从没见过村里有这么多淡水。

src: By the auspices of the marsh, =name= invented the Weirdwire Conduit and detected a hidden signal.
zh: 在沼泽的庇佑下，=name=发明怪线导管，探测到一道隐秘信号。
看在太阳的份上，你可真丑。

src: By your guess, what awaits us where the Spindle breaks?
zh: 依你之见，纺锤断裂之处，等着我们的是什么？

src: Byzantine purple smolders at a medium hue on the sharp and linked prisms of the crystal. It hums with new life and ingenuity.
zh: 拜占庭之紫，以适中的色调在水晶尖锐而相连的棱柱上暗燃。它因新生与巧思而嗡鸣。

src:
CENTURIES OF PATTERN-MAKING, ARGUMENT, AND CHANTING DID ENSUE.

THE SERAPHIC COMMENTARIES WERE COMPILED. THE GEMARA SOPHIA IS THE RESULT THEREOF.
zh:
数百年间，推演图式，辩难争论，诵咏不辍。

撒拉弗诸注疏由此编成。智慧革马拉，便是其成果。

src: COHERING... AS THE FRIGID SPRAY TO THE BLOCK OF ICE. 'TIS COLD!
zh: 凝聚……如寒沫之于冰块。好冷！

src: Cables purled together form the barrel of a blastgun that fires along the cambered electromagnetic field lines.
zh: 线缆编织成爆能枪的枪管，沿着弯拱的电磁场线发射。

src: Caked gundust is painted on the inner lune of the mortar.
zh: 结块的枪尘，抹在臼炮的内侧月牙上。

src: Calefaction was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
zh: 灼热之物在研钵中磨碎，在盐水中慢煮，再凝成块。

src: Called Yrame, Warden a-Joppa. I kill trouble. Don't be trouble.
zh: 叫伊拉梅，约帕的守望者。我专杀祸事。你别成了祸事。

src: Calligraphs are incised in uneven rows and columns that meander across the quarter and back stay of the boot. Their character mass appears to orbit a central statement: "The path is contracted." The rest of the script is etched in a variety of signs and styles that offer competing and composite interpretations of the cryptic proclamation.
zh: 书法刻痕参差成行成列，蜿蜒于靴的后帮与鞋跟之间。字块如绕着一句中心之语运行：“此路已约。”其余的文字刻成种种符号与字体，对这句晦涩宣言给出相互竞争又彼此交叠的诠释。

src: Can I know what it is?
Can I serve you something explosive, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
zh: 要我给你上点会爆炸的东西吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

src: Can dig passages up or down when outside of combat
zh: 脱离战斗时，可向上或向下掘出通道

src: Can discharge all held charge for 1d4 damage per <stat Name="DischargeChunk" /> charge
zh: 可释放全部储存电荷，每<stat Name="DischargeChunk" />点电荷造成1d4伤害

src: Can one really travel the stars?
Can see into dimensions half a step over.
zh: 可窥见半步之隔的诸维度。

src: Can use =mutationName= at rank =addedTier=. If =subject.they= already =subject.verb:have= =mutationName=, it's enhanced by =bonusTier= ranks.
zh: 可使用=addedTier=级的=mutationName=。若=subject.they==subject.verb:已有==mutationName=，则其提升=bonusTier=级。

src: Can use =skillName=. If =subject.they= =subject.verb:already:have= =skillName=, gain a =bonus.signed= bonus on the Ego roll when using =skillName=.
zh: 可使用=skillName=。若=subject.they==subject.verb:已有==skillName=，则使用=skillName=时自我检定获得=bonus.signed=加值。

src: Can walk over webs without getting stuck.
zh: 可在蛛网上行走而不被黏住。

src: Can we really trust such a young Hindriarch?
zh: 这么年轻的族长，我们真的能信任吗？
我们能谈谈吗，阿洛伊修斯？

src:
Can you feel the stillness? The drycrackle of space between as you thump my crystal arms.

Life flees you. Motion flees you.
zh:
你可感到这静止？你捶打我晶体的臂膀时，其间的空隙，干脆作响。

生命逃离你。动作逃离你。

src: Can you imagine sticking one of these things inside you? Disgusting.
zh: 你能想象把这玩意儿塞进自己身体里吗？恶心。

src: Can you tell me about Qud?
Can you tell me about the Gyre and the Girsh nephilim again?
zh: 你能再给我讲讲回旋和吉尔什拿非利人吗？

src: Can you tell me about the components I must gather?
zh: 你能给我讲讲我须搜集的部件吗？

src: Can you tell me about your village, Joppa?
zh: 能给我讲讲你们的村子约帕吗？

src: Can't be attacked in melee by non-flying creatures.
zh: 非飞行生物无法对其发动近战攻击。

src: Can't go wrong with starapples, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Good for what ails ya.
zh: 星苹果准没错，=player.formalAddressTerm=。有什么毛病都能治。

src: Can't move without breaking free first.
Can't physically interact with creatures and objects unless they're also phased.
zh: 除非对方同样处于相位偏移状态，否则无法与其他生物和物体发生实体接触。

src: Can't you tell me anything else?
zh: 你没有别的可告诉我了吗？

src: Cane-beat steel is shaped to the pectorial lunes and stitched to an undergarment of padded goat leather.
zh: 以藤杖敲打的钢，成胸前新月之形，缝缀在一件衬以山羊皮的软垫内衣上。

src: Cannot distort spacetime in the local region.
Cannot remove the last binding for =commandText|color:C=.
zh: 无法移除=commandText|color:C=的最后一项绑定。

src: Cannot use if Dismember is on cooldown, and using Berserk puts Dismember on cooldown.
zh: 若肢解仍在冷却中则无法使用，且使用狂暴会令肢解进入冷却。

src: Cannot use if Slam is on cooldown, and using Demolish puts Slam on cooldown.
zh: 若猛砸仍在冷却中则无法使用，且使用粉碎会令猛砸进入冷却。

src: Carbide mounting rods scaffold a gyroscopic shelf designed for extra baggage.
zh: 碳化物支杆撑起一方陀螺搁架，专为多载行囊而设。

src: Carbide plates are molded to skull shape and alloyed with foam that inflates on impact.
zh: 碳化物板被塑成颅骨之形，并与受击即膨胀的泡沫合铸。

src: Carbon fiber shoots out of two electrodermal contact pads.
zh: 碳纤维自两片电皮触垫中射出。

src: Carbon steel gleams on its sawed muzzle. A dented butt stock cuts at right angle to the shoulder.
zh: 碳钢在锯短的枪口上闪着光。一块凹陷的枪托，与肩膀呈直角切开。
看护者,可调的,救命者,撒玛利亚人,矫形的,卫生的,防腐的,疗愈的
看护者,可调的,矫形的,疗愈的,医者,复原者

src: Carmine clouds assume their crystal habit: cubes nested inside and out. Why does Moghra'yi conceal this form from the sun?
zh: 胭红的云霞显出其结晶之相：立方体内外相套。莫格拉伊为何要向太阳隐藏这副形貌？

src: Carmine streaks on Kesehind's armor suggest that he tried and failed to wipe away spilled blood.
zh: 凯塞因德甲上的胭脂色血痕，说明他曾试图擦去溅上的血却没擦净。

src: Carnal instructions dictate the reformation of the face's bone structure and plump tissue mass into a soft and angelic countenance. Through such thaumaturgy, the people of hoary Ibul, cradled in the breast of a collapsed ice shelf, wander its lamplighted streets in rosy-cheeked disinterest.
zh: 肉身的指令，命令面部骨骼结构与丰腴的组织重塑为柔和而天使般的容颜。借由此种奇术，古老伊布尔的居民——那座城偎在崩塌冰架的怀中——面颊绯红，漠然漫步于灯火通明的街巷。

src: Carthax the athlete is depicted here mid-stride. His glistening silver hair is tied behind his head, in astral tradition, as he vaults through the firmament.
zh: 竞技者卡萨克斯在此被刻作大步流星之态。依星辰一脉的传统，他闪亮的银发束于脑后，凌空跃过苍穹。

src: Carved and stained olive wood houses the steel teeth that grind irregularities from cooking salt.
zh: 雕琢并染色的橄榄木，容纳着钢齿，可磨去烹饪用盐中的粗粝。

src: Castle-dwelling wood artisans mimic the forest architecture of gnomes and create a hutch for their tales of outer spheres.
zh: 栖身城堡的木匠们仿效地精的森林建筑，为他们讲述外层天球的故事造了一座小柜。
广纳的,强效的,补足者,复原者

zh: 由于无法保存游戏，《卡德洞窟》即将退出。请检查目录权限。

src: Centuries after the height of the Gyre, the svardym Goek, Mak, and Geeub met the galgal Many Eyes while languishing inside of a reef sponge. Together they founded the Yd Freehold to live out the rest of their lives.
zh: 回旋鼎盛之后数百年，斯瓦迪姆戈埃克、马克与吉乌布困居于礁海绵中时，遇见了加尔加尔千目。他们共建伊德自由领，以度余生。

src: Cerata pendulate on the cape like prism grass of a windy meadow. They mirror rich hues in cerulean, ruby, star orchid, and void; together they shine to resplendent effect.
zh: 裸鳃在披风上垂荡，宛如多风草甸上的棱镜草。它们映出湛蓝、红宝、星兰与虚空的浓烈色泽；合在一处，光彩夺目。

src: Cerata pendulate on the muffs like crystal-mold on a tree ring. They mirror rich hues in cerulean, ruby, star orchid, and void; together they shine to resplendent effect.
zh: 裸鳃如晶霉附在树轮上，悬垂于手笼之上。它们映出深浓的色泽：天青、红宝、星兰与虚空；合而生辉，灿然夺目。

src: Cerata pendulate on the shoe tips like the Beetle Moon curled through fog. They mirror rich hues in cerulean, ruby, star orchid, and void; together they shine to resplendent effect.
zh: 裸鳃悬垂于鞋尖，如穿雾而过、弯曲的甲虫之月。它们映出深浓的色泽：天青、红宝、星兰与虚空；合而生辉，灿然夺目。

src: Cerulean light from inside the Spindle channel glimmers across the pane like stars on a galactic disc or diodes on a circuitboard. The light breathes godliness into the glass.
zh: 纺锤通道内的蔚蓝光芒在玻璃板上闪烁，宛如星系盘上的群星，又似电路板上的二极管。那光为玻璃吹入了神性。

src: Channel grooves are cut into the gloves' static-dried palms in the impossible patterns of leyline geometry. The fingers articulate at intersecting radials and spin the latent into being.
zh: 槽沟刻入手套干燥带静电的掌心，其纹样是地脉几何中不可能之形。手指在相交的半径处弯折，使潜在之物化为实有。

src: Channeled arms waggle and suck moisture from the thick air, while cracks in =pronouns.possessive= clay pot show a hunger for growth.
zh: 沟槽般的手臂摇摆着，从浓稠的空气中汲取水分，而=pronouns.possessive=陶罐上的裂纹，显露出对生长的饥渴。

src:
Character creation is a deep and sometimes long process. We included some preset builds to help you get started. After the tutorial, you can try another build, or make a character from scratch. (The recommended way! Once you get your footing.) 

For now, pick the marsh taur.
zh:
角色创建是个深入、有时也很漫长的过程。我们准备了一些预设角色，帮你上手。教程结束后，你可以试试别的预设，也可以从头捏一个角色。（站稳脚跟之后，我们推荐这种方式！）

现在，就选沼地牛人吧。

src: Charge use per round: Temperature change x<gametext>=chargeuse:0.??=</gametext>
Charmed by another creature into following them.
zh: 被另一生物魅惑，追随其左右。
与视野内的任何人交谈
可与视野内的任何人交谈。

src: Chavvah roams out of feeling range. You are no longer attuned.
zh: 查娃已漫游至感知范围之外。你不再与其共鸣。

src:
Chavvah? The, ah, the... the tree of life? Allows us joining?

That, that is simply, ah, extraordinary. I will apprise my kin of this, and we will, ah... we will ponder what it may mean for us.
zh:
查娃？那，呃，那……生命之树？允我们加入？

这实在是，呃，非同寻常。我会告知族人，我们要，呃……好好思量这对我们意味着什么。

src: Check memory usage and show a warning when it's high
zh: 检查内存占用并在过高时发出警告

src: Cheesecloth sticks to the greasy faces of a pigwrought cuboid. For two years microbes have colonized its faces, ripening it to high taste.
zh: 干酪布粘在一个猪造方块的油腻表面上。两年来微生物在其各个面上定居，将它催熟至极高的风味。

src: Chewing through its scales is like biting rock. The meat is lean but filling.
zh: 咀嚼鳞片，如啮顽石。肉质精瘦而饱腹。

src: Children cry at the crisp snip of a yuckwheat stem, as they have for hundreds of years. They bawl, and flail, and writhe from their mothers' grasps, deaf to reassurances of the plant's medical potency. Snipped and crushed, the stem tastes acidic on their tongues and their faces contort in children's agony. But they sleep better at night, so their mothers say.
zh: 苦麦茎被清脆地剪断时，孩子们便哭起来，数百年来都是如此。他们号啕、踢打，从母亲怀中挣脱，对那植物药效的种种宽慰之言充耳不闻。剪断碾碎的茎在他们舌上泛出酸味，面孔便扭作孩童的苦相。然而他们夜里睡得安稳些——母亲们是这样说的。

src: Children, let's rejoice in the sovereignty of our Argent Fathers.
zh: 孩子们，让我们为银辉诸父的主权欢欣吧。

src: Chiliads of glitz are stuck to the naked folk carved in relief of the aureate seat. They people that gilded hill, their bodies conjugate to each other in every way geometry allows, spilling out from the crest and down the scroll arms that once upheld the quivering limbs of a high priest to lust.
zh: 千百点华光，粘附于金座浮雕上的裸身众生。他们遍布那座鎏金之丘，肢体以几何所容的一切方式彼此交缠，自峰顶倾泻而下，漫过那曾托举高阶祭司颤栗肢体、使其沉溺情欲的卷轴扶手。

src: Chills affected area over <stat Name="Duration" />, dealing damage and freezing things
zh: 使受影响区域在<stat Name="Duration" />内降温，造成伤害并冻结物体

src: Chiseled spines wreathe the sinuous worldeater, who dug the earthly caves that were peopled by late-stage troglodytes. The hundred-nine eyes of legend peer across time, and generations of moss skirt the beast's banded undergirth.
zh: 凿刻的棘刺环绕着蜿蜒的噬世者，它曾掘出大地的洞窟，供末期的穴居人栖身。传说中的百零九只眼睛，穿越时间凝望远方；数代的苔藓环绕着这头巨兽带纹的腹下。

src: Chitin was shaved from the exoskeletal flank of a caught salthopper and dry-beaten to a snappy crisp.
zh: 甲壳自一只捕获的盐蜢外骨骼的侧腹上刨下，干打成一味爽脆的薄片。

src: Chittering legs in the high dozens figure S-swerve =pronouns.possessive= shining trunk like the spine of a gigantic hominid.
zh: 数十条唧唧作响的腿把=pronouns.possessive=闪亮的身躯扭成S形的转折，如同某种巨型人族的脊骨。

src: Choose a body part to engrave.
zh: 选择要刻印的身体部位。

src: Choose a body part to tattoo.
zh: 选择要纹身的身体部位。

src: Choose a faction's chapter to insert your good deed.
zh: 选择某派系的篇章，将你的善行记入其中。

src: Choose a limb to infect with =fungus=.
Choose a mutation for me to gobble up!
zh: 挑一个变异，让我吞掉它！
选择一个要赋予生命的物体。

src: Choose artifacts to throw down the well.
zh: 选择要投入井中的古器。
选择要保存的奇珍食材。

src: Choose how to best apply the repulsive device.
zh: 选择如何妥善使用排斥装置。

src: Choose secrets about the life of Resheph to share.
zh: 选择要分享的利悉生平秘辛。

src: Chopping off the only head of a creature kills them instantly.
zh: 斩下生物仅有的头颅，可使其当场毙命。

src: Chosen token to palm-solder and orient with object-meaning, 5 lbs. or less. Like others, choice alters Creature trait and behavior.
zh: 择一信物，焊于掌心，并赋以物之意义，五磅以下。同其余诸项，所择改造物之性状与行止。

src: Chrome bunches in cloth-like furrows across a metal tunic that drapes across =pronouns.possessive= lanky, anxious, pinion-limbs. A large metal cask -- =pronouns.possessive= head -- sits atop =pronouns.possessive= too-frail undercarriage, and a gleaming glass eye shines at you in several shades of tinted light. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:seem:afterpronoun= on the verge of apologizing.
zh: 铬光一束束垂落，如布帛的褶皱般横过一件金属长袍，披在=pronouns.possessive=瘦长、惴惴不安、翼状的肢体上。一只巨大的金属桶——那便是=pronouns.possessive=头颅——压在过于脆弱的=pronouns.possessive=下身支架上，一只锃亮的玻璃眼以数种不同的染色光芒朝你闪烁。=pronouns.Subjective=看上去正要开口道歉。

src: Chrome clasps fasten arm joints to emulate the stillness of unlife.
zh: 铬扣紧固臂关节，仿效无生命者的静止。

src: Chrome flakes fell like dander from broken belfries into the trash sea. They were scooped up by orefishers and traded up the silk chain. This shirt is fashioned from the flakes twisted into rings.
zh: 铬屑如皮屑般，自残破的钟楼纷纷落入垃圾之海，被采矿渔人捞起，沿丝绸链条向上贩卖。这件衬衫便是以这些铬屑拧成环圈制成。

src: Chrome flanges maximize the surface area for evaporated air to re-settle as distilled dew.
zh: 铬制的凸缘使表面积达到极大，令蒸发的气雾重新凝落为蒸馏的露水。

src: Chrome pegs form a lattice where bionic modules await coupling.
zh: 铬钉交织成格，仿生模块在其上静候接合。

src: Chrome pegs form a lattice where modules await coupling.
zh: 铬钉交织成格，模块在其上静候接合。

src: Chrome plates the mangonel's bucket and hollow arm, where fulcrete blocks are channeled from their cubic arsenal and loaded into place.
zh: 镀铬覆着投石机的斗与空臂；富混凝土块自其方整的武库中导来，装入此处。

src: Chrome rondures sling themselves along the orbital paths of an invisible magnetic gyroscope. By inscrutable intervals, one pops out the transverse plane with violent momentum.
zh: 铬制的圆环沿着看不见的磁力陀螺轨道自行抛转。每隔一段莫测的时辰，一环便以暴烈的动量从横截面上弹出来。

src: Chrome sheets and shapes were torn off their welded joints and piled in a giant heap of scrap.
zh: 铬板与铬件被从焊缝上撕下，堆成一座巨大的废料之丘。

src: Chrome was molded into a canister and fastened with a brass mounting bracket.
zh: 铬钢铸成罐形，以黄铜托架固定。

src: Chrome-brass rings and swarths of leather are precisely cut from a tinker's stencil, but the real signature is on the glass: a scatter of speck-sized fractures from the high salt gales.
zh: 镀铬黄铜环与成片皮革，皆依修补匠的模板精确裁出；真正的印记却在镜片上：高处盐风吹袭留下的、星屑般细密的裂纹。

src: Chromodynamic flowering over the packed dimensions of multi-spacetime is viewed through a uniprism. The coercion of a petal-pruned viewing angle produces something analogous to a computation.
zh: 多重时空的紧缩维度上，色动力学之花开放，经一枚单棱镜观之。强行取一个去瓣的视角，所得之物便近于一场运算。

src: Circles of limestone, porous and oyster-gray with the shells of old things, are arranged in vertical slabs and turned against each other to grind fibrous grains into flours.
zh: 一圈圈石灰岩多孔而呈牡蛎灰，嵌着旧日生物的壳；它们被排成竖立的石板，彼此对转，把纤维质的谷粒磨成面粉。

src: Circular gills on =pronouns.possessive= tongue-slick and finned bodypipe suck air out of the surrounding foul liquid gunk.
zh: =pronouns.possessive=舌滑而带鳍的躯体管道上有环形的鳃，从周遭恶臭的液体浊物中吸取空气。

src: Cirrus clouds of neon stir inside a glass lune and beam light through the prefigured likeness of the sultan. A bleary shape thus hovers supine above the starless and gigantic black rock divan. The artist may have intended this to evoke a lightning storm over a dark plain or a lily on the pitch of a river: something to represent the bright and gaseous mind roaming over the inert body.
zh: 一弯玻璃月牙之内，霓虹的卷云流转，将光束射过苏丹那预先成形的肖像。一道朦胧的身影遂仰卧悬浮于这座无星而庞大的黑石榻上。艺术家或许意在唤起暗原之上的雷暴，或漆黑河面上的一朵百合：以此象征那明亮而如气体般的心智，游荡于僵卧的躯体之上。

src: Claws destroy walls after 4 penetrating hits.
zh: 利爪穿透命中4次后可摧毁墙壁。

src: Clay and quartz were dried and smashed into the red rock that's been quarried by hillfolk for thousands after thousands of years.
zh: 黏土与石英被晒干、砸碎，凝成这红岩——山民已在此开采了千年复千年。

src: Clay and quartz were dried and smashed into the red rock that's been quarried by hillfolk for thousands after thousands of years. The whole stone is cut across by shining black ribbons.

src: Clay was fired around steel and erected in the rib cage for structural support.
zh: 黏土裹着钢材烧制，立于胸腔之中作结构支撑。

src: Clay was rounded and kilned to store oils and wine.
zh: 黏土被捏圆烧制，以储油与酒。

src: Clay was spun on the potter's wheel and shaped into waves, fired, and glazed into a ceremonial vessel. Two pictographs are panelled side-by-side: 'life' and 'drink'.
zh: 黏土在陶轮上旋成，塑出波纹，经烧制上釉，成为一件礼仪的容器。两个象形文字并排嵌于其上：“生”与“饮”。

src: Clay was spun on the potter's wheel and shaped into waves, fired, and glazed into a traditional vessel.
zh: 黏土在陶轮上旋成，塑出波纹，经烧制上釉，成为一件传统的容器。

src: Claystuff is reprinted across the fissures and scars on =object.the.name=.
zh: 泥质材料被重新印制在=object.the.name=的裂缝与伤痕之上。

src: Cleanse it of your guilt, your burdens. Throw it down the Sacred Well.
zh: 涤净它的罪愆与重负，将它投入圣井。

src: Cleaves mental armor on critical hit
Cloth in the sunbanning hue of salt sight is folded snug to the fit of head and neck.
zh: 一方呈禁日之色的盐视之布，紧贴头颈折叠，恰好合身。

src: Cloth was dyed in a bath of dicalyptus leaves and iron shavings to achieve a chromish luster and then tailored to a ruffled shoulder-skirt.
zh: 布料浸入双萼桉叶与铁屑的染浴，得铬一般的光泽，而后被裁成一件褶边的肩裙。

zh: 协处理器：通电时，此物品提供额外的=stat.Name=，并向本地晶格提供算力。

src: Coarse fur is cut from the thickset pelt of an ogre ape into a broad-shouldered cloak.
zh: 粗糙的毛皮裁自食人魔猿粗壮的皮，成一件宽肩斗篷。

src: Coarse fur is cut from the thickset pelt of an ogre ape into a tam with earflaps.
zh: 粗糙的毛皮裁自食人魔猿粗壮的皮，成一顶带耳罩的塔姆帽。

src: Coarse fur is cut from the thickset pelt of an ogre ape into wide-fingered gloves, and giant knuckles sawed to points stick through.
zh: 粗硬的毛皮，取自食人猿厚实的皮毛，裁成宽指手套，巨大的指节被锯成尖刺，从中戳出。

src: Coarse goat wool is dethreading from where brushes have combed out the salt and silicon.
zh: 粗糙的山羊毛，在刷子梳去盐与硅之处，渐渐脱线。

src: Cobalt gas seeps into the nose and disarranges the mind.
zh: 钴蓝的气体渗入鼻腔，搅乱神智。

src: Cold dew dresses the lateral vents cut into the chrome wainscotting of a marble pillar.
zh: 冷露缀满了一根大理石柱的铬钢护壁板上所开的横向通风口。

src: Collagen bubbles swaddle its hundred segments and compacted bone matter squirms out of its tail end.
zh: 胶原的泡囊包裹着它的百节身躯，压实的骨质自其尾端蠕蠕挤出。

src: Collagen was molded into a liquid vessel.
Collect a corpse from one of the creatures.
zh: 从其中一只生物身上取回尸体。

src: Color hit hearts per the target's remaining HP
zh: 依据目标剩余生命值为命中红心着色

src: Color starts to seep into the world.
Color swirls around a mote of glow dust.
Color your character's glyph based on health status
zh: 依据健康状况为角色符号着色

src: Colorful spines are splayed like gear teeth across a doughy and sun-bleached orb.
zh: 彩色的刺如齿轮之牙般张开，散布于一只面团似的、被日光漂白的球体上。

src: Colossal rings of spongy wormbody are deflated and still. Sword-sized bristles scrape the earth.
zh: 庞大的海绵状虫身之环瘪陷静止。剑一般大的刚毛刮着地面。

src: Come closer, nestling. Let me look upon your countenance.
zh: 靠近些，雏儿。让我看看你的面容。

src: Come closer, so I can see your face.
zh: 凑近些，让我看清你的脸。

src: Come here. No, closer. Don't mind the bees, they rarely sting.
zh: 过来。不，再近些。别管蜜蜂，它们很少蜇人。

src: Come in, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and let me 'shoe' you around, ha ha!
zh: 请进，=player.formalAddressTerm=，让我带你“鞋”程一番，哈哈！

src: Come smoke with me, friend. Set a spell.
zh: 来和我一起吸袋烟吧，朋友。坐一会儿。

src:
Come to =mapnote.text|initLower|colorSafe= for the highest quality wares.

Located =mapnote.location=.
zh:
来=mapnote.text|initLower|colorSafe=，购得上乘货品。

所在之处：=mapnote.location=。

src: Come to see my beasts? All hale and well-fed, I assure you.
zh: 来看我的牲口？个个康健，吃得饱，我保证。

src: Come, wanderer, change some of that heavy water for a pocketful of riches.
zh: 来吧，漂泊者，把你那沉甸甸的水，换成满袋的财富。

src: Coming from anyone else, =name=, I might refuse outright. Housing recently-sentient refugees is no mean favor, I think you'll agree. My people are slow to trust, as well, so I fear that the slynth may feel unwelcome for some time. But then, grafted branches grow the best starapples, do they not? Yes, your lilypad friends are welcome here if they wish.
zh: 换作旁人，=name=，我多半一口回绝。收容刚刚开了灵智的难民可不是小忙，想必你也同意。我的族人也迟迟不肯信人，因此我担心斯林斯们在一段时日里会觉得不受欢迎。但话说回来，嫁接的枝条结出最好的星苹果，不是吗？好，若你的睡莲朋友们愿意，这里欢迎他们。

src:
Coming from anyone else, I would ask that further japery be left to me.

But from you? I wouldn't startle to see you return wearing a Sultan's burial mask, having destroyed half a dozen invincible cherubim in the doing. Fates be with you.
zh:
换作旁人，我定会请他把更多的玩笑交给我来开。

可若是你？就算见你戴着一副苏丹的葬仪面具归来，还毁了半打不可战胜的智天使，我也不会吃惊。愿命运与你同在。

src: Commencing cross-check with the Thin World annals............
zh: 正与薄界编年记录进行交叉核对……………

src: Compacted seed matter that's been stuffed into the leaf-mitt of a coiled tendril.
zh: 压实的种子，被塞进一条盘卷卷须的叶掌中。

src: Compressed gas drives piston rods into musculature powdered with graphite dust and sends the jumper soaring.
zh: 压缩气体驱动活塞杆，刺入撒有石墨粉的肌肉，令跳跃者腾空而起。
压缩者,碾碎者,压平者,击碎者,挤压者

src: Compute power on the local lattice decreases the time needed for this item to generate ammunition.
zh: 本地晶格上的算力会缩短此物生成弹药所需的时间。

src: Compute power on the local lattice decreases this item's effectiveness.
zh: 本地晶格的算力可削弱此物的效能。

src: Compute power on the local lattice increases the time needed for this item to generate ammunition.
zh: 本地晶格上的算力会延长此物生成弹药所需的时间。

src: Compute power on the local lattice increases this item's effectiveness.
zh: 本地晶格的算力可增强此物的效能。

src: Condensed dream gas pools at the tips of =pronouns.possessive= zigzag fangs and drips onto pallid leg-things. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:shudder:afterpronoun= in the capture of some pristine ecstasy lost to space and time, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:let:afterpronoun= out a proud and piercing whine.
zh: 凝缩的梦气在=pronouns.possessive=锯齿獠牙的尖端汇聚，滴落在苍白的肢状之物上。=pronouns.Subjective=为之震颤，仿佛被某种失落在时空之外的纯然狂喜攫住，=pronouns.subjective=又发出一声骄傲而尖利的悲鸣。
