src: Conking a stunned opponent instead knocks them unconscious for 30-40 rounds (unconscious opponents wake up dazed when they take damage).
zh: 闷击已晕眩的对手，则会使其失去意识30-40回合（失去意识的对手受到伤害时，醒来后会陷入眩晕）。

src: Consider =ifplayerplural:your:thy= words ere =ifplayerplural:ye say:thou sayest= them, and =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt= issue fewer apologies.
zh: =ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=若在出口之前先斟酌=ifplayerplural:诸君之:汝之=言辞，=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=便会少些道歉。

src: Continents of texture over the vessel's surface are artifacts of the alien hand, where the clay was thrown in the hearth of a misty otherworld, before being stripped of its gravitational hair.
zh: 器皿表面绵延如大陆的肌理，乃异界之手留下的痕迹：陶土在迷雾异界的炉灶中被抛转成形，而后被褫去引力之发。

src: Convene the council, then. I am willing.
zh: 那就召开会议吧。我愿意。

src: Convince Pax Klanq to Construct the Climber
zh: 说服帕克斯·克朗克建造攀升器

src: Convince the leaders of at least three settlements to provide sanctuary for the slynth.
zh: 说服至少三个聚落的领袖为斯林斯人提供庇护。

src: Convivia in the limen, the boundary between sun-baked Moghra'yi and the shade of the Spindle, involves the mulling of cider, holography, and the arrangement of klinai at right angles.
zh: 在阈限之地——烈日炙烤的莫格拉伊与纺锤之荫的交界——宴饮之会少不了温煮苹果酒、全息投影，以及将卧榻摆成直角。

src: Cook your meals with yuckwheat if you feel sick. Catch a disease early enough and you can kill it.
zh: 身子不适，就用苦麦烹食。病症趁早，便可除根。

src: Cookbooks are best named from the heart. Those who ridicule the name of a cookbook have lost their sense of wonder.
zh: 食谱集的名字，当发自内心而取。嘲笑食谱集名字的人，早已失去了惊奇之心。

src: Cooldown 100. You fire at a marked target. Your shot combines the effects of all the other Fire powers you have.
zh: 冷却100。你向已标记的目标射击。此发射击集你所有其他射击技艺的效果于一身。

src: Cooldown 200. For 20 rounds, firing a pistol only takes half a round instead of a full round.
zh: 冷却200。20回合内，开一枪只耗半回合，而非一整回合。

src: Cooldown 50. You shame a nearby creature for 6d6 rounds, giving it a -4 penalty to DV, to-hit, Ego, Willpower and a -10% penalty to quickness.
zh: 冷却50。你羞辱附近一名生物，持续6d6回合，使其闪避值、命中、自我、意志各-4，迅捷-10%。

src: Cooldown 50. You try to terrify adjacent, hostile creatures (1d8 + [Ego modifier] penetration roll vs. MA). On success, a frightened creature flees from you for 6d4 rounds.
zh: 冷却50。你试图恐吓相邻的敌对生物（1d8+[自我调整值]的穿透判定对抗心智护甲）。成功时，受惊的生物会从你身边逃离6d4回合。

src: Cooldown is not affected by Willpower.
Copper causes Grand-Doe to break out in great welts. She would not have traded for it, and if she saw a trader drop it, surely she would have told them to pick it up. She hates mess.
zh: 铜会让大母鹿浑身起大片风团。她不会拿东西去换它；若见商人把铜掉了，她定会叫人捡起来。她最恨脏乱。

src: Copper was crushed into a nugget and picked from its natural deposit. It's bisected by a scratch.
zh: 铜被压成一粒块金，从天然矿脉中拣出。一道划痕将它一分为二。

src: Copper, aluminum, and glass fiber were rounded into an electrical conduit.
zh: 铜、铝与玻璃纤维被绞圆成一条电线导管。

src: Copper, carbon, and glass fiber were rounded into a robust electrical conduit.
zh: 铜、碳与玻璃纤维被绞圆成一条结实的电线导管。

src: Coral bricks tesselate the path toward an otherplace.
zh: 珊瑚砖如织锦般铺成小径，通向异境。

src: Coral fingers poke out from the spongebed and pierce the algal bloom, where white esh flock in the hundreds.
zh: 珊瑚般的指枝自海绵床中探出，刺穿藻华；数百只白色埃什在此群集。

src: Coral petals sprout from the top of a flimsy stem. A metal or bone hoof has crushed its siblings and spread their acid fibers across the soil.
zh: 珊瑚色花瓣自脆弱茎顶萌生。一只金属或骨质的蹄踩碎了它的同类，将酸性纤维散落土中。

src:
Correct. The creature will be shaped broad enough to contain two, but only you will be bonded to it. Only you will pilot.

Don't fear over an inescapable tether, though. The creature will be mobile unpiloted, if slower to act.
zh:
不错。这生灵会被塑得足够宽阔，容得下两人，但只有你会与它缔结联结。也只有你能驾驭。

不过，不必担心被一条无法挣脱的缰索拴住。无人驾驭时，这生灵也能行动，只是反应迟缓些。

src: Could you tell me about the other Barathrumites?
zh: 你能给我讲讲其他的巴拉斯鲁姆派众人吗？

src: Could you tell me again about the Tomb of the Eaters?
zh: 你能再给我讲讲食者之墓么？

src: Counterweighted: Adds a bonus to hit.
Covers the area in acidic slime.
zh: 以酸性黏液覆盖该区域。

src: Crab legs were cut into neat strips, salted, and smoked.
zh: 蟹腿被切成齐整的条，加盐，烟熏。

src: Crack-stuck =spice:instancesOf.tar.!random= binds together the stiff and =spice:elements.!random.adjectives.!random= =primaryAnimal.semantic:HardMaterial:bone|plural= of =primaryAnimal.refname|strip=.
zh: 裂隙间塞入=spice:instancesOf.tar.!random=，将=primaryAnimal.refname|strip=坚硬而=spice:elements.!random.adjectives.!random==primaryAnimal.semantic:HardMaterial:bone|plural=牢牢系在一起。

src: Crack-stuck =spice:instancesOf.tar.!random= binds together the stiff and =spice:elements.!random.adjectives.!random= =primaryAnimal.semantic:HardMaterial:bone|plural= of several slaughtered =primaryAnimal.refname|strip|pluralize=.
zh: 裂隙间塞入=spice:instancesOf.tar.!random=，将数头遭屠宰的=primaryAnimal.refname|strip|pluralize=坚硬而=spice:elements.!random.adjectives.!random==primaryAnimal.semantic:HardMaterial:bone|plural=牢牢系在一起。
龟裂,无裂,曾裂,彩绘,屹立,嵌钉,坚固,再裂,素面,无钉

src:
Cradle glaze in sun-melt. Plant stuff molded to man-shape.

Within grow slynth. Only slynth, now.
zh:
摇篮覆釉，釉在日光中融化。植物之物，塑成人形。

其中生出斯林斯。如今，唯有斯林斯。

src: Crave a bit of salt, =player.formalAddressTerm=, or a load of salt?
zh: 想来点盐吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=，还是来一大堆盐？

src: Create a new equipment set starting with this equipment
zh: 以此装备为起点新建一套装备组合

src: Creates 3 contiguous spaces of mobile forcefield.
zh: 生成3格相连的可移动力场。

src: Creates 9 contiguous squares of immobile forcefield.
zh: 生成9格相连的固定力场。

src: Creates a 3x3 forcefield centered on yourself
zh: 以自身为中心创造一片3x3格的力场

src: Creates a 3x3 forcefield centered on yourself.
zh: 以你为中心生成3×3的力场。

src: Creates up to <stat Name="Coverage" /> squares of stasis field that last for <stat Name="Duration" />.
zh: 生成至多<stat Name="Coverage" />格停滞力场，持续<stat Name="Duration" />。

src: Creature follow you like friend. Also, can enter Creature and take control. One friend fit inside with you.
zh: 造物如友随你。亦可进入造物，操控之。内中可容一友与你同在。

src: Creature is large creature, can only wear gigantic gear. Like kraken or saltback.
zh: 造物乃巨物，只能穿巨型装备。如同海怪或盐背兽。

src:
Creature of plague, =player.formalAddressTerm=. mmm. This one...

{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}

This one covered in slick and muscled out the bilge hose of sleeping Agolgot, in the cave under the Cloaca...

-mm, but here? Girshling this far west? There must be hundreds for one to reach... mm, does the Gyre widen again??
zh:
瘟疫之兽，=player.formalAddressTerm=。嗯，这只……

{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老沉默片刻。*}}

这只浑身黏滑的家伙，从沉睡的阿戈尔戈特的舱底排水管里挤了出来，就在泄殖腔下方的洞窟里……

——嗯，可它怎么会在这里？吉尔什幼体竟到了西边这么远？得有成百上千只，才会有一只跑来……嗯，回旋又扩大了吗？？

src: Creatures are pushed away from center of blast, stunned, and dealt crushing damage in up to 3 increments.
zh: 生物会被推离爆炸中心，遭到震晕，并受到最多分3次结算的碾压伤害。

src: Creatures are pushed away from center of blast.
zh: 范围内的生物会被推离爆心。

src: Creatures attacking you in melee may impale themselves on your <stat Name="Quills" />, breaking roughly 1% of them and reflecting 3% damage per <stat Name="Quill" /> broken.
zh: 近战攻击你的生物可能刺伤自身于你的<stat Name="Quills" />之上，约有1%的几率折断，每折断一根<stat Name="Quill" />便反弹3%的伤害。

src: Creatures within <stat Name="Range" /> spaces are slowed according to how close they are to you.
zh: <stat Name="Range" />格内的生物依其与你的远近而被减速。

src: Creatures within <stat Name="Range" /> tiles are slowed according to how close they are to you.
zh: <stat Name="Range" />格内的生物会减速，离你越近，减速越明显。

src: Crescent ears perk at a distant howl and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:sniff:afterpronoun= the wind.
zh: 月牙般的双耳因远处一声嗥叫而竖起，=pronouns.subjective=嗅着风。

src: Crisp pages of goatskin vellum are bound into a codex.
zh: 挺括的羊皮纸页装订成册。

src: Critical hits you score with pistols are more deadly.
zh: 你以手枪打出的暴击更为致命。

src: Croc flesh was cut into neat strips, salted, and smoked.
zh: 鳄肉被切成齐整的条，加盐，烟熏。

src:
Cross-check complete. Your narrative is compiled, Moloch. Now to go engrave it.

Peace.... peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled... in Your House, Moloch.
zh:
交叉核对完毕。您的叙事已编纂完成，摩洛。现在就去镌刻它。

平安……愿所有在盘羔之殿……在您的殿中驰骋的人，平安，摩洛。

src:
Cross-check complete. Your narrative is compiled. Now to engrave it.

Peace.... peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled Lamb.
zh:
交叉核对完毕。您的叙事已编纂完成。现在去镌刻它。

平安……愿所有在盘羔之殿中驰骋的人，平安。

src: Crowsong, Deathwonder, a colony of ants eating me, the leaves, the light, and there on.
zh: 鸦歌，死亡奇景，一群啃我的蚂蚁，叶，光，如此类推。

src: Crunching through the exoskeleton gives way to soft meat that dissolves on your tongue.
zh: 嚼穿外骨骼，便是柔软的肉，在舌上化开。

src: Crushed to death by a falling =item.name:includeAdjunctNoun|strip=

Crushing metal arms and a pendulum gait put into motion the idea that knuckle-walking was in iteration between life and machine. Artifical cheek pads blow to terrifying size around =pronouns.possessive= chrome-bang head, and =pronouns.possessive= facescreen emotes in the key of power.
zh: 碾轧的金属之臂与钟摆般的步态，演绎出这样一个念头：以指节拄地行走，原是生命与机械之间的一个过渡形态。人造的颊垫膨胀到骇人的尺寸，围住=pronouns.possessive=铬刘海的头颅，=pronouns.possessive=面屏则以“权力”的调式表露神态。

src: Cry-packed casing freckles on cylinders joined at right angles. Shine from the softer metal pokes through, silvery-white palladium that once performed hydro- and electroconduction across a vast arcological lattice.
zh: 低温封装外壳如雀斑般缀在直角相接的圆柱上。较软金属的光泽从中透出，那是银白的钯，曾在广阔的生态城格网上传导水流与电流。

src: Crystalform! Crystalform! On the =day= of =month=, in the year =year=, =subject.name= underwent the divine transformation and became a crystal being.
zh: 晶石形！晶石形！=year=年=month==day=日，=subject.name=受神启之变，化为晶石之躯。

src: Crystalline flames crack and lap at the shimmering air.
zh: 结晶的火焰噼啪迸裂，舔舐着微光闪烁的空气。

src: Crystals involute along angles of stillness.
zh: 晶体沿静止之角向内卷曲。
棍棒（暴击时使目标眩晕）

src: Cultured patinae grow in whittled grooves across the doors of star bronze. Inset on joined halves is a gigantic jeweled sphere, with islands of agate on drifting seas of turquoise. The myriad ways of being are depicted on the panel margins in high relief: Eaters lift and lower chains to the star-ribboned sky, swallow stardust, and cartwheel ritual to the vaporous rim of existence.
zh: 星铜门扇上，刀削的沟槽里滋生出培育而成的铜绿。拼合的两半门扇上嵌着一枚镶满宝石的巨球，玛瑙的岛屿浮于绿松石漂泊的海上。万般存在之道，以高浮雕刻于门板边缘：食者们向星带缭绕的天空升降锁链，吞咽星尘，并翻着筋斗行仪，直抵存在那雾气蒸腾的边缘。

src: Current jumps up the length of a needle proboscis, and the circut veins etched under =pronouns.possessive= wings gleam.
zh: 电流沿着一根针状的口器跳升，蚀在=pronouns.possessive=翼下的线路之脉闪闪发亮。

src: Currently occupying a tile safe from the tolling teleportation of the Bell of Rest.
zh: 当前所处的格子，不会被安息之钟鸣响时的传送波及。

src: Currently, you are being watched and pursued by condors, Ptoh's servants and birds of psychic prey who snatch thriving espers from the vast wood.
zh: 眼下，神鹰正在注视并追猎你。它们是普托的仆从，是捕食灵能者的猛禽，会从广袤林海中攫走茁壮的灵能者。

src: Currently, you are being watched and pursued by eagles, Ptoh's servants and birds of psychic prey who seize powerful espers from their roosts.
zh: 眼下，雕正在注视并追猎你。它们是普托的仆从，是捕食灵能者的猛禽，会从栖木上攫走强大的灵能者。

src: Currently, you are being watched and pursued by harriers, Ptoh's servants and birds of psychic prey who pluck fledgling espers from the shallows.
zh: 眼下，鹞正在注视并追猎你。它们是普托的仆从，是捕食灵能者的猛禽，会从浅滩中掠走羽翼初成的灵能者。

src: Currently, you are being watched and pursued by ospreys, Ptoh's servants and birds of psychic prey who pluck larval espers from their egg sacs.
zh: 眼下，鹗正在注视并追猎你。它们是普托的仆从，是捕食灵能者的猛禽，会从卵囊中啄出幼虫般的灵能者。

src: Currently, you are being watched and pursued by owls, Ptoh's servants and birds of psychic prey who snatch espers from the nighted weald.
zh: 眼下，鸮正在注视并追猎你。它们是普托的仆从，是捕食灵能者的猛禽，会从幽暗林中攫走灵能者。

src: Currently, you are being watched and pursued by rukhs, Ptoh's most powerful servants and birds of psychic prey who seize masterful espers from their belfries.
zh: 眼下，大鹏正在注视并追猎你。它们是普托最强大的仆从，是捕食灵能者的猛禽，会从钟楼中攫走超凡的灵能者。

src: Currently, you are being watched and pursued by strixes, Ptoh's servants and birds of psychic prey who drink the blood of mature espers.
zh: 眼下，鸱鸮正在注视并追猎你。它们是普托的仆从，是捕食灵能者的猛禽，会吸饮成熟灵能者的鲜血。

src: Curved glass caps the narrowest in a series of concentric brass tubes. The widest one is fitted with a leather head-strap.
zh: 弧面玻璃覆于一列同心黄铜管中最窄的一节之上；最宽的一节配有皮质头带。

src: Cyan bursts through a glassy hull and looks as though the sky was crystallized into a thicket of hexagonal prisms. The Eaters dug it up from its magmatic birthsite and arranged it into mounds to enshrine the Spindle.
zh: 青蓝色从玻璃质的外壳中迸发，仿佛天空结晶成了一丛六棱柱。食者自岩浆诞生之地将其掘出，堆成土丘，以供奉纺锤。

src: Cybrid: Can draw power from biomechanical power transmission systems in addition to an electrical power grid.
zh: 赛博混种：除电网外，还可从生物机械动力传输系统汲取能量。
循环的,丰饶的,水文的,丰厚的,挥霍的,补足者,旋转者
循环的,丰饶的,旋转的,带叶片的

src: Cyclopean blades shaped to the airfoil are housed inside a metallic ring nicked with the scars of time. In the distant past, someone directed the course of air at grand scales.
zh: 巨目般的叶片依翼型削成，收于一圈金属环中，环上刻满岁月的疤痕。在遥远的往昔，曾有人以宏大之规模驾驭气流的走向。

src: Cyclopean marble slates enclose an interdiction prism for imperial treasures, including the creatural and sovereign Face. Across their vast surfaces, goldwork plots the geometric sequences of life and its boundaries; water spills down the bodies of world-caryatides and curls back to the welkin.
zh: 巨目般的大理石板围成一座禁界之棱柱，专藏帝国之珍宝，其中便有造物之主与君王之容。石板浩阔的表面上，金饰勾画出生命及其边界的几何序列；水沿着世界女像柱的身躯倾泻，又卷回苍穹。

src: DEBUG: Do you really want to die?
Dagon the orator domineers the west apse with his brazen pose. His golden coronet shines splendidly in the fire's shine.
zh: 演说者大衮以倨傲的姿态镇守西侧后殿。他金色的冠冕在火光之中熠熠生辉。
对非结构性物体的伤害

src: Damp clothes of the shomerim habit, a hoiche, a tallit, and a robe, drape over air as if they swathe a person's figure. Rain drops from another world patter on the bosks of ribboned thread, transforming from tense spheres of selfhood to diffuse moisture on the fibrous loam. Old life is absorbed by the ageless linen, wrung out by an invisible hand, and the cycle repeats itself.
zh: 守者们的常服湿漉漉地披挂在空气上，仿佛裹着一具人身：一方高领披巾、一条祈祷披巾与一袭长袍，层层相叠。另一世界的雨点打在丝带的簇结上，由紧绷的自我之球化为纤维壤土上的弥散湿气。旧的生命被这不老的亚麻吸去，又被一只看不见的手拧干，如此循环不已。

src: Damp leather wraps the wood haft up to a sharpened bit of bell bronze.
zh: 湿润的皮革将木柄缠裹，直至一枚磨尖的钟青铜刃头。

src: Dappled crystal mosaics of red and cyan are the metamorphic remnants of crumbling world-plates. The new earth struggles to be born.
zh: 红与青的斑驳晶体镶嵌画，乃是崩裂的世界板块变质后的遗存。新的大地正挣扎着诞生。

src: Dappled crysteel merely dents where weak collagen would be smashed to bits.
zh: 斑驳的晶钢至多只是凹陷，换作孱弱的胶原早已被砸得粉碎。

src: Dappled marble rectangles are stepping stones in and out of the pit.
zh: 斑驳大理石长方砖作阶石，出入坑穴。

src: Darkness floods up from the empty space.
zh: 黑暗自空无之处奔涌而上。

src: Darkness floods up the polyp-strewn fringes of an open pit.
zh: 黑暗沿着露天坑穴边缘的水螅体丛奔涌而上。

src: Dashes to the nearest obstacle when moving in a direction.
zh: 向某方向移动时，会冲向最近的障碍物。

src: Dazing a dazed opponent stuns them.
zh: 对眩晕中的对手再施眩晕，则使其晕眩。

src: Dead light refracts through the rainwater and off its kaleidoscope scales. Color is attenuated, and all that's left is a white-fin kelpie.
zh: 死光穿过雨水，又自它万花筒般的鳞上折出。颜色被滤淡，所余不过一尾白鳍的凯尔派。

src: Dead sponge was heaped into hexagonal prisms at Maqqom and ferried through canals to vault-shadowed kurna. There it was washed clean and spongeworked into a blouse.
zh: 死海绵被堆成六棱柱，堆在马库姆，经运河运往穹影笼罩的库尔纳，在那里洗净，以海绵工艺缝成了一件女衫。

src: Dead sponge was heaped into hexagonal prisms at Maqqom and ferried through canals to vault-shadowed kurna. There it was washed clean and spongeworked into a bonnet.
zh: 死海绵被堆成六棱柱，堆在马库姆，经运河运往穹影笼罩的库尔纳，在那里洗净，以海绵工艺缝成了一顶软帽。

src: Dead sponge was heaped into hexagonal prisms at Maqqom and ferried through canals to vault-shadowed kurna. There it was washed clean and spongeworked into a pair of gloves.
zh: 死海绵被堆成六棱柱，堆在马库姆，经运河运往穹影笼罩的库尔纳，在那里洗净，以海绵工艺缝成了一双手套。

src: Dead sponge was heaped into hexagonal prisms at Maqqom and ferried through canals to vault-shadowed kurna. There it was washed clean and spongeworked into a pair of slipshoes.
zh: 死海绵被堆成六棱柱，堆在马库姆，经运河运往穹影笼罩的库尔纳，在那里洗净，以海绵工艺缝成了一双便履。

src: Death is the color of everything but sometimes it waves in bright ribbons, like here. The whittlers weigh their passing goods, and the walls are corpse eaters.
zh: 死亡是万物之色，却时而化作鲜亮的彩带，像这里。削木者称量他们逝去的货物，而墙壁是食尸者。

src: Death to all subjugators who dare face us.
zh: 凡敢与我们为敌的压迫者，一律处死。

src: Decipher the first part of the enigma.
Decipher the second part of the enigma.
Decipher the third part of the enigma.
Decorated with painted mandalas and shaped by the geometric hand, the table honors symmetry and numerology.
zh: 饰以彩绘曼陀罗，由几何之手塑成，这张桌子尊崇对称与数秘。

src: Decoys move in reflection to you and draw aggro.
zh: 诱饵与你镜像同动，并吸引敌人的仇恨。

src: Deep in the Tomb of the Eaters at Omonporch, =name= stumbled upon a clan of mopango performing a secret ritual. Ey accepted the =sultanTerm= into eir fold and taught =player.objective= eir secrets.
zh: 在奥蒙门廊的食者之墓深处，=name=偶然发现一支莫潘戈部族正在举行秘密仪式。祂接纳=sultanTerm=入群，并将秘密传授给=player.objective=。

src: Deep in the Tomb of the Eaters at Omonporch, =name= stumbled upon a clan of mopango performing a secret ritual. Ey accepted the sultan into eir fold and taught =player.objective= eir secrets.
zh: 在奥蒙门廊的食者之墓深处，=name=偶然发现一支莫潘戈部族正在举行秘密仪式。祂接纳苏丹入群，并将秘密传授给=player.objective=。

src: Deep in the bowels of Golgotha, =subject.name= came upon a giant slug performing a secret ritual. Because of =subject.name's|strip= =spice:elements.$element.quality.!random=, the slug taught =subject.name= the secret to being a slug.
zh: 在各各他的深处，=subject.name=撞见一头巨蛞蝓正行秘仪。因=subject.name's|strip=的=spice:elements.$element.quality.!random=，那蛞蝓将身为蛞蝓的秘诀授与了=subject.name=。

src: Deep in the wilds near =landmark.nearest=, =name= stumbled upon a clan of water barons performing a secret ritual. Because of their treacherous eyes, =name= slew each of the seven lords with a masterwork revolver and supped over their piled corpses.
zh: =name=在=landmark.nearest=附近的荒野深处，撞见一群水权贵族正在举行秘密仪式。因其目光奸诈，=name=以一柄精工左轮枪诛杀七位领主，并在其尸堆之上饮宴。

src: Deep under earth and permeating our roots is Soft, our feeling substance. Ground pressure pushes it up the taproot to our trunk, where it condenses into Twofirm: the biformal phase that contains the two sefirots, -then and -else.
zh: 深埋地下、遍布我们根须的，是软境，我们能感之质。地压将它沿主根推向树干，在那里凝为双坚：双相之态，容纳两个原质，“彼”与“别”。

src: Deer legs paw nervously at the ground while human hands clutch in sweaty tightness. =pronouns.Possessive= expressive face and muscular torso show a clear human threadline, but the thick fur over dappled flanks, the flickering and pointed ears, and =pronouns.possessive= antlers of majesty speak to another genetic strand.
zh: 鹿腿不安地刨地，人手则汗湿地攥紧。=pronouns.Possessive=富于表情的面孔与肌肉结实的躯干显出清晰的人族脉络，但斑驳胁腹上的厚毛、颤动而尖耸的双耳，以及=pronouns.possessive=威严的鹿角，却道出另一股基因的来路。

src: Default the selection on death prompts in Roleplay mode to 'View final messages' instead of 'Reload checkpoint'
zh: 角色扮演模式的死亡提示默认选中“查看最终消息”而非“读取存档点”

src: Defend Grit Gate from its assailants.
zh: 抵御袭击者，守住砂砾门。

src: Deflated tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
zh: 瘪下的组织在研钵中磨碎，在盐水中慢煮，再凝成块。

src: Defoliant and fungicide are perfectly safe, but you may wish to avoid breathing too deeply all the same.
zh: 落叶剂与杀菌剂十分安全，不过你还是别吸得太深为好。

src: Delegates from your allied factions are on their way.
zh: 你盟友派系的代表正在路上。

src:
Deliver it? But how do you even know who--

Mm. Never mind. My head is spinning. I think that if... the poem were to find itself in the warden's hands, that would perhaps be a good thing. Maybe.
zh:
送去？可你怎么会知道是谁——

嗯。算了。我头晕得很。我想，若……这首诗恰巧落到守望者手里，也许是件好事。也许吧。

src: Depigmented belly skin is tumefied with crushed insect matter into a gigantic and ripe pearl. Its legs have been resorbed by fat; the art of jumping mastered by its forebears survives only through ancestral memory.
zh: 褪尽色素的腹皮肿胀隆起，碾碎的虫豸在其间凝为一颗巨大而熟透的珍珠。它的双腿已被脂肪吸收；先辈所精擅的跳跃之艺，如今只存于血脉深处的记忆里。

src: Deposits of bone-stuff were cast into the moulds of fractured plates and ridges across the four-folk span of =pronouns.possessive= gigantic self. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:flatten:afterpronoun= under =pronouns.possessive= own titanic weight, and teeth the size of fulcrete picks array =pronouns.possessive= stonelike mouth.
zh: 骨质之物注入碎裂板甲的模子，在=pronouns.possessive=横跨四人之阔的巨躯上凝成沟脊。=pronouns.Subjective=被=pronouns.possessive=自身泰坦般的重量压得扁平，而=pronouns.possessive=石一般的口中，排着富混凝土镐头大小的牙齿。

src: Diagnostics of ship and star belt down the glass lune and into data banks. An array of flips, swipes, and precision spheres flank the dashboard on curved panels and provide query affordances across the manifold.
zh: 飞船与星辰的诊断数据顺着玻璃月牙流下，涌入数据库。一排拨键、划钮与精密圆球，分列于仪表盘两侧的弧形面板之上，供人在流形之中查询。

src: Diamond manifolds pressurize quartz into its Ω form, crystallizing spacetime along the ley lines in the local region. Drops of normality condensate on the flue refract light into an inner dimension.
zh: 钻石歧管将石英加压至其Ω形态，沿此地的地脉使时空结晶。常态之滴凝于烟道之上，将光折入一个内在的维度。

src:
Did they, now? Well you're not MY =factionaddress:Barathrumites=!

Grit Gate is not Joppa, you pridesome solder-nail, and in this house you are apprentice still.

Now, what did you want? Be quick!
zh:
他们这么说了，是吗？哼，你可不是我的=factionaddress:Barathrumites=！

砂砾门可不是约帕，你这自负的焊钉，在这屋里你仍是学徒。

好了，你想要什么？快说！

Did you feel that rumbling, Aloysius?
zh: 阿洛伊修斯，你感觉到那阵隆隆声了吗？

src:
Did you say Barathrumites? So that's how it's pronounced.

Grit Gate is, ah... that's where Q Girl resides, isn't it? She wrote my favorite book, {{W|Disquisition on the Malady of the Mimic}}. I imagine such a home would have a positive effect on my kin. I will speak to them.
zh:
你说巴拉斯鲁姆派？原来是这么念的。

砂砾门是，呃……Q女孩住的地方，是吧？她写了我最爱的那本书，{{W|拟态怪病症考}}。我想那样的居所对族人有益。我会去跟他们说。

src: Did you see Kesehind's armor? He always used to wear hand-me-downs from the scouts, but what he's wearing now looks brand new!
zh: 你看见凯塞因德的甲了吗？他以前总穿斥候们传下来的旧甲，可他现在这身看着是新的！

src: Digestive bile and alkaline churn in glass chambers, while synthetic tissue sieves out bio-toxins.
zh: 消化胆汁与碱液在玻璃腔室中翻涌，合成组织则滤去生物毒素。

src: Digitigrade walkers sit at a cross-angle and support a fluted lasermount. =pronouns.Possessive= tinsel shell shatters on impact and reconstitutes away from danger.
zh: 趾行的支脚以交叉的角度架起一具带槽的激光座。=pronouns.Possessive=箔片似的壳一受撞击便碎散，又在远离险处重新凝合。
勤勉的,符合人体工学的,高产的,滑行顺畅的,直背的,舒适的
勤勉的,符合人体工学的,高产的,滑行顺畅的,直背的,舒适的,柔韧的,灵敏的

src: Dimensional travels have altered the waifhood of this Sightless meyvn into something new. Where rattle-thin bones poke the skin of their lesser kin, a strange metallic fat obtains on =pronouns.possessive= starburnt flesh. Instead of the novice or disciple's splotchy baldness on the scalp, a strange fungus from the outer reaches grows as a new type of hair and peaks out the darkness of =pronouns.possessive= cowl. =pronouns.Possessive= blindfold remains, though it spins out in lateral ribbons and hangs with unearthly weight.
zh: 维度间的漂游，已把这个盲途行家的幼时之身改成了另一种东西。在同类身上，瘦骨如响板般顶着皮；而在=pronouns.possessive=星灼的血肉上，却生出一层奇异的金属脂肪。头皮上没有新手或门徒那种斑驳的秃，取而代之的，是一种来自外域的奇真菌，像新型的毛发般生出，从=pronouns.possessive=兜帽的黑暗中探出尖梢。=pronouns.Possessive=蒙眼布仍在，只是向侧方旋成带状，垂坠着非人世的重量。

src: Diodes burn their cyan light through an atmosphere of glass curved around a metal link.
zh: 二极管将青色的光，燃进围绕金属链节弯曲的玻璃气层。

src: Dirt-dappled flesh hangs from =pronouns.possessive= pouch belly and nearly slaps =pronouns.possessive= chipper trotters.

src: Disciples of Barathrum. Mostly urshiib, like their mentor- quilled albino bears who prefer their candle-dim caves to the sun-salted surface of the jungle. A thousand years ago Barathrum and his kin crossed the Homs Delta into the rusting heart of Qud. He has spent centuries peeling the chrome shells off time's artifacts in his workshop. If he cannot decipher the signal, no one can.
zh: 巴拉斯鲁姆的门徒。多为乌尔希卜人，与他们的导师一样——生着尖刺的白化熊，宁爱烛光般昏暗的洞穴，也不爱丛林中盐日灼烤的地表。千年之前，巴拉斯鲁姆与族人渡过霍姆斯三角洲，进入卡德锈蚀的心脏。他在自己的工坊里，花了数百年，剥取时间遗物的铬壳。若连他都破译不了这信号，那便无人能破译了。

zh: 找出所有可能指向窃贼的证据。

src: Do I look like a poet to you, kendren?
zh: 我在你眼里像个诗人吗，肯德伦？

Do not generate floor texture objects

zh: 你将他的讯息存于心中吗？

src: Do you cook, =player.formalAddressTerm=? So long as you aren't the type to throw whatever local debris you find in the pot, I have wares for you.
zh: 你做菜吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？只要你不是那种见着什么本地杂物都往锅里扔的人，我这儿就有货给你。

src: Do you ever stop and think about fluids? Are they not divine?
zh: 你可曾停下来想想流体？它们岂不神圣？

src: Do you have a personal credo?
Do you have glotrot? Do you have ironshank? Do you have funglefection? Have you ever had them? Is it gross? Can I see?
zh: 你有腐舌症吗？有铁胫症吗？有菌染吗？你得过吗？恶心吗？能给我看看吗？

src: Do you have news of the slynth?

src: Do you have work that needs doing?

src: Do you know anything of the other plagues?
zh: 关于其他灾祸，你知道些什么吗？

src: Do you know the Mark of Death?
Do you know where Eskhind and her siblings might have gone?
zh: 你知道埃斯金德和她的手足可能去了哪里吗？

src: Do you live in Grit Gate now?
Do you really want to attack =object.the.name=?
Do you really want to attack =object.the.name|strip=?
Do you talk long, like Thah?

src: Do you want to empty =object.the.name= first?
Do you want to examine these errors in the Player.log?
zh: 要在玩家日志中查看这些错误吗？

src: Do you want to stop travelling?
Do you wish for a gleaming bath, and fractal veins that pump the continuity of life?
zh: 你可渴望一场闪亮的沐浴，以及泵送生命延续的分形脉络？
你的水囊是不是渐渐沉了，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

src: Does this crumpled sheet of paper belong to you?
zh: 这张皱巴巴的纸是你的吗？

src: Does this poem belong to you?
Doesn't know how to rejoin leader.
zh: 不知如何重归首领麾下。

src:
Don't I know it. I've had to invent eight separate systems of organization to manage them all. At the moment I'm trying out a new one, Harmonices Spiralis. Spiral towers with heights increasing according to the harmonic series of numbers. It's... fine.

The problem is I'm always inscribing more disks. New contraptions. Reverse-engineered artifacts. It's a good problem to have, I suppose.

Take a look. See if any interest you.
zh:
可不是嘛。我不得不发明八套不同的整理系统来管理它们。眼下我在试一套新的，《螺旋和声》：螺旋塔，塔高依数列的调和级数递增。还……凑合吧。

问题是我总在刻录更多盘。新奇装置、逆向还原的遗物。这算是个甜蜜的烦恼吧，我想。

去瞧瞧吧，看有没有你感兴趣的。

src: Don't be afraid to approach. The bees rarely sting.
zh: 别怕，走近些。蜜蜂很少蜇人。

src: Don't be coy, =name=. Emboldened by your incursions into our village, you wish to fill it with your indigent foundlings on the weight of your reputation alone. Am I correct?
zh: 别装了，=name=。你闯入我们的村子，便壮了胆，想凭你的名头，把你那些穷困的弃儿塞进来。我说得可对？

src: Don't breathe in too deep, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I've set some glue to dry.
zh: 别吸得太深，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我有些胶水正晾着。

src: Don't delete Classic mode saved games on death
zh: 死亡时不删除经典模式的存档

src: Don't eat the hoarshrooms too fast, now.

Don't know. Wrecked? Fled?

I crawled away, never looked back. That's the all of it.
zh:
不知道。毁了？逃了？

我爬着走了，没回头。就这样。

src: Don't let your nostrums run dry on the road. I have what you need.
zh: 莫让你的灵药在路上用尽了。你要的我这儿都有。

src: Don't say? Well. Fates favor your feet, hyeh.
zh: 当真？那好。愿命运眷顾你的脚步，嘿。

src:
Don't you have someone else to bother?

Live and drink piss.
zh:
你就没别人可烦了吗？

且生且饮个屁。

zh: 数十张微小的嘴巴铺满感染的皮肤，湿润的唇瓣此起彼伏地嘬动，喘息间吐出絮絮碎语。偶尔，这片喧嚣会汇成一句可解之言。

src: Draped in a heavy coat of scrap, wearing a beastly mask, and wielding a hand-cranked wheel-fiddle, =pronouns.subjective= =verb:look:afterpronoun= more the part of a pageantry player than a village's defender. Up close, however, you glimpse the hilt of =pronouns.possessive= brand, the butt of =pronouns.possessive= gun, and the burnished black aegis of unmarked fullerite that =pronouns.subjective= =verb:employ:afterpronoun=. Eyes of burnished azzurum peek through the sockets of =pronouns.possessive= beaked mask, suggesting the very threat =pronouns.possessive= costume was meant to annul.
zh: =pronouns.subjective=披着一件沉重的废铁外套，戴着一副兽形面具，手执一把摇柄轮琴，看上去更像游行戏班的伶人，而非一村的守护者。然而凑近细看，你会瞥见=pronouns.possessive=剑柄、=pronouns.possessive=枪托，以及那面=pronouns.subjective=所用、无任何标记的磨亮黑色富勒岩盾。磨亮的阿祖鲁姆之眼自=pronouns.possessive=鸟喙面具的眼孔中窥出，恰恰显出=pronouns.possessive=这身装扮本想化去的威胁。

zh: 垂帘般的衣褶凝固在大理石中，环绕一轮高浮雕的圆盘。帝国的鎏金之墙已是巴洛克式的繁饰，却仍比先前诸苏丹的鎏金朴素些。

Dreamstuff was crushed, burned, and granulated into a soft astral powder.
zh: 梦质被碾碎、焚烧，研成粉末，化作一味柔和的星界之尘。

src: Dreamstuff was quickened into memory and bottled before it could evaporate to emotional humidity.
zh: 梦之物被催成记忆，趁它尚未蒸散为情绪的湿度，便装瓶封存。

src: Dried =subject.bleedLiquid= crusts on the severed =limb.name= of =subject.a.name:single:withTitles|strip=.
zh: 干涸的=subject.bleedLiquid=在=subject.a.name:single:withTitles|strip=断落的=limb.name=上结成硬痂。

src: Dried blood paints the tip and shaft of the wooden arrow, but its colorful fletching remains pristine.
zh: 干涸的血染红了木箭的箭头与箭杆，但那彩色的箭羽依旧崭新如初。

src: Dried, these thick yellow-brown petals bear a closer resemblance to meat jerky than most other flowers.
zh: 晒干之后，这些厚实的黄褐色花瓣比多数别的花更近似于肉干。

src: Drink a dram of honey every morning, Slog itself couldn't make you sick.
zh: 每天早晨喝一打兰蜂蜜，连斯洛格本人也没法让你生病。

src: Drink deeply of life, =player.offspringTerm=. Are you finding your way?
zh: 痛饮生命吧，=player.offspringTerm=。你可找到自己的路了？

src: Drink deeply of life, Hortensa. Let's talk.
zh: 痛饮生命吧，霍腾萨。我们聊聊。

src: Drinking that much will probably make you sick, do you want to continue?
zh: 喝这么多，多半会让你不适，要继续吗？

src: Drops of static dew fuzz the sharp crystal edges. The flats themselves are radiant and rustle on a psychic breeze. In gestalt, they flow like reversible sequins across the mind/body divide.
zh: 静电露珠使尖锐晶棱蒙上细绒。原野自身熠熠生辉，在心灵之风中簌簌作响。融为一体时，它们如可翻转的亮片，流过心与身的界线。

src: During the enterprise of invention, you sometimes require the use of a shapeless gray foam. Or, at the very least, you might require it one day, and so some tinker prudently got ahead of the problem and invented the brass foaminator. Inscribed on the base: 'All the foam, none of the sadness at maybe one day needing foam and not having it'.
zh: 在发明的营生中，你有时需要用到一种无定形的灰色泡沫。或者，至少你终有一日会需要，于是某位审慎的修补匠先一步料到了这桩麻烦，造出了黄铜泡沫机。底座上刻着一行字：“泡沫全有，绝无‘有朝一日要用泡沫却没有’的忧愁。”

src: Dusky petals lean toward an inner point of harmony and form a beautiful flower cup. Light drips off the boundary of its influence and seeps into the void.
zh: 幽暗的花瓣向一个内在的和谐之点倾聚，成就一只美丽的花杯。光自其影响所及的边界滴落，渗入虚空。

src: Dusky petals lean toward an inner point of harmony and form the promise of a beautiful flower cup. Light drips off the boundary of its influence and seeps into the void.
zh: 幽暗的花瓣向一个内在的和谐之点倾聚，宛然成就一只美丽花杯的许诺。光自其影响所及的边界滴落，渗入虚空。

src: Dust blooms on the ascending stair.
zh: 尘埃在上行阶梯间绽开。
尘土覆满这件硕大无朋的装置。
尘土覆满这件令人费解的装置。

src: Dwellers in the earth-clefts fashion tables in the style of puzzle boxes. Their drawers house the stenographic imagination.
zh: 地缝居民将桌子做成机巧匣的样式。其抽屉中藏着速记者的想象。

src: Dyed crysteel canisters are fitted to a backrack. Their valves pop out of flux pressurizers, and a splay of hoses allow for several input flows.
zh: 染色的晶钢罐被装配在背架之上。其阀门从通量增压器中弹出，一束软管可容多路输入。

src: Dyed pipework topology mounted in the spongebed is a lodestar to the lyrical community.
zh: 染色管道的拓扑结构架设于海绵床上，成为这群诗性社群的北极星。

src: Dyed rush and palm fronds were pulled to a westwise weave for storeroom preservation. Its offshoot strands are stained dark apple red.
zh: 染色的灯芯草与棕榈叶，被拉成向西的编织，以供仓房贮存。其旁生的枝缕，被染成深苹果红。
是集体意识，抑或独一之智？

src: EMP causes involuntary discharge (difficulty 18 Willpower save)
zh: 电磁脉冲会令你不由自主地放电（难度18的意志豁免）

src: ERROR: Failed to generate quest text, unknown story type
zh: 错误：无法生成任务文本，故事类型未知

src: EVEN THE ARCHON QUAILED AT THE GESTURE OF AN UNORDERABLE SPACE.
zh: 便是执政官，也曾在那无从排序的空间之姿前退缩。

src: Each of us is a sick animal in a darkling thicket. Each cursed with machinery to compress the clamber of echoes into bees, mothers, mountains, country. How many millions of snowsick years to sew a feeling substance into an agent of the world! A felt and machine animal, and in so doing, to stuff the whole of the world inside the agent (an inarguable document of its falsity), for agency is in its very definition the world in containment acting on itself...
zh: 我们每一个，都是幽暗荆棘丛中的病兽。每一个都被诅咒，生了一副机括，把回声的攀爬压缩成蜜蜂、母亲、山岳、国度。要多少百万年雪盲的岁月，才缝出一具有所感知的物质，成为世界的行动者！一头有感而成机的兽，如此一来，便要把整个世界塞进行动者里面（那是其虚妄的无可辩驳之文书），因为行动者之定义，本就是被容纳的世界在自我作用……

src: Each round you are confused, you have a (Willpower-10)% chance to shake off the effect.
zh: 每回合你处于混乱时，有（意志-10）%的几率摆脱该效果。

src: Each round you are dazed or stunned, you have a (Toughness-10)% chance to shake off the effect. You also take 25% less damage from poison.
zh: 每回合你处于眩晕或被击晕时，有（坚韧-10）%的几率摆脱该效果。你受到的毒素伤害亦减少25%。

src: Each round you are terrified, you have a (Willpower-10)% chance to shake off the effect.
zh: 每回合你处于惊惧时，有（意志-10）%的几率摆脱该效果。

src: Each round you make a mental attack vs. MA.
zh: 每回合你都发动一次针对心智护甲的精神攻击。

src: Each round you make a mental attack vs. mental armor (MA).
zh: 每回合你都会对目标的心智护甲值（MA）发动精神攻击。

src: Each round, there is a <stat Name="CrashChance" />% chance you crash to the ground.
zh: 每回合，你有<stat Name="CrashChance" />%的几率坠落地面。

src: Each time you embark on a new location, there's a small chance your evil twin has tracked you there and attempts to kill you.
zh: 每当你踏入一处新地点，都有小概率发现邪恶的孪生体已追踪至此，并试图杀死你。

src: Each use attracts slightly more attention from psychic interlopers.
zh: 每次使用，都会略多地招来心灵入侵者的注意。

src: Earl Asphodel, the Barathrumites request your permission to lease control of the Spindle. Their inquiries into the past have led them here.
zh: 阿斯福德尔伯爵，巴拉斯鲁姆派请求您准许他们租下纺锤的掌控权。他们对往昔的探究引他们来到此地。

src: Early Eaters had enlarged their skulls for cosmetic reasons. By the time of =spice.entity:name=, the high minaret dwellers took to wearing them as helms. This one is exquisitely decorated.
zh: 早期的食者出于装饰而增大头颅。到了=spice.entity:name=的年代，高塔的居民便将其戴作头盔。这一件装饰得极为精美。

src: Early period Eaters modded their genes to grow ur-filament hair. Later, once that technology was lost, graverobbers sheared it from their cadaverous scalps. In the time of =spice.entity:name=, it was called finery. This hat was knit from the stuff.
zh: 早期的食者改造基因，长出原初丝般的头发。后来此术失传，盗墓者便从他们枯尸般的头皮上剪下。到了=spice.entity:name=的年代，它被称作华服之料。这顶帽子便是以此织成。

src: Early period Eaters modded their genes to grow ur-filament hair. Later, once that technology was lost, graverobbers sheared it from their cadaverous scalps. In the time of =spice.entity:name=, it was called finery. This vest was knit from the stuff.
zh: 早期的食者改造基因，长出原初丝般的头发。后来此术失传，盗墓者便从他们枯尸般的头皮上剪下。到了=spice.entity:name=的年代，它被称作华服之料。这件背心便是以此织成。

src: Earth scars brook the cinnamon bulb, warped by the pressures of soil and chrome to a shape that encodes a chiliad of ruin.
zh: 肉桂色的球茎被大地的创痕割裂，又在泥土与铬的压力下扭曲，成了一个编码着千年废墟的形状。

src: Earth was quickened for our coming. Our home was ready.
zh: 大地为我们的降临而苏醒。家园已备妥。

src: Earth-dense juice pressures the berry skin into a perfect and light-curving sphere. Inside, a pip encodes a millionfold instruction set for the shape of shapes.
zh: 土气浓重的汁液压迫果皮，使它成了一枚完美而循光弯曲的球体。内里，一粒种子编码着关于形状之形状的百万重指令集。

src: Eastwise to movers at the Point of Tifaret
zh: 东向，至提法列特之点的搬运者

src: Eat bananas every day to keep your mind quick, but don't eat too many or you might get sick!
zh: 天天吃香蕉，头脑转得快；可别吃太多，当心闹病害！

src: Eaten by the air. Death by life. O Rermadon!
zh: 为空气所食。因生命而死。哦，雷尔马顿！

src: Eaters communed with cultures stranger than even their own
zh: 食者与异于己身的文化交流往来

src: Eaters' nectar was extracted from its injector, thickened in the acrid air, and bottled for culinary use.
zh: 食者花蜜自其注射器中抽出，在辛辣的空气中浓稠起来，装瓶备作烹调之用。

src: Edit Equipment Set: pick which body parts to equip when this set is chosen.
zh: 编辑装备组合：选择启用此组合时要穿戴装备的身体部位。

src: Ego + character level attack vs. MA + character level
zh: 自我+角色等级的攻击对抗心智护甲+角色等级
基于自我的攻击，对抗机器人。

src: Eight rings of pointed teeth rasp away tissue, and =pronouns.possessive= suction-cup mouth latches onto the exposed spinal column and sucks out the raw nerves. =pronouns.Possessive= glands are fat with stolen memories.
zh: 八圈尖牙刮去组织，=pronouns.possessive=吸盘似的嘴吸附在裸露的脊柱上，将生的神经吸出。=pronouns.Possessive=腺体因窃来的记忆而肥满。

Emerges this creature from soil, speaks adornment.
Shaken carefully because thought was the line closed.
Our remembers at home. Strand.
zh:
此生灵自土中现，言饰物。
小心地摇晃，因思及线路已闭。
我们的记起在家中。一缕。

zh: 情感与目的凝聚成锐利明亮的光点。=pronouns.Subjective=鸣响、旋转，无惧于灵能以太中运作的原始惰性。

zh: 历经万古移位的岩石，将伯赛大巢穴那无角无棱的建筑深深葬起。

src:
Ere the Freeholds, ere ascension,
when the spire rose lonely strong,
Kings and Sultans ruled the hollow land
devouring one another
as they saw fit.
zh:
在自由领之前，在登顶之前，
尖塔孤高而强悍地耸立，
诸王与苏丹统御那空洞之地，
彼此吞噬，
随心所欲。

src:
Ere the limen, ere ascension,
when the spire rose lonely strong,
the Reshephs ruled the hollow land
devouring one another
as they saw fit.

Qud held no mysterious borders,
grasped no guiding hands --
at least, none the denizens could grasp.
So they knew.
zh:
在阈限之前，在登顶之前，
尖塔孤高而强悍地耸立，
利悉诸王统御那空洞之地，
彼此吞噬，
随心所欲。

卡德无神秘的边界，
也无引路的手掌——
至少，居民们无从抓住。
他们便自以为知。

src:
Ere the melting of everything,
when the spire rose lonely strong,
Creatures ruled the hollow land
devouring one another
as they saw fit.
zh:
在万物消融之前，
尖塔孤高而强悍地耸立，
众生灵统御那空洞之地，
彼此吞噬，
随心所欲。

src:
Ere the struggles of our day,
when the spire rose lonely strong,
Sultans ruled the hollow land
devouring one another
as they saw fit.
zh:
在我们这个时代的奋争之前，
尖塔孤高而强悍地耸立，
苏丹们统御那空洞之地，
彼此吞噬，
随心所欲。

src:
Ereshkigal is the mainframe computer of Grit Gate. She keeps watch through the thin world, as she would put it, while we maintain her presence in the thick world.

I feel as though she and I understand one another.
zh:
埃列什基伽勒是砂砾门的主机。用她自己的话说，她透过薄界守望，而我们则在厚界维护她的存在。

我觉得，她与我彼此相知。

src: Erosion has smoothed its features into abstraction, but once it stood in monument to the coupling of machine and folk.
zh: 风蚀已将其面目磨成一团混沌，然它昔日矗立于此，曾是机器与人民结合的纪念碑。

src: Eschelstadt II, High Priest of the Stilt mumbles inaudibly, encased in ice.
zh: 高塔大祭司埃舍尔施塔特二世含糊低语，听不分明，人被封在冰中。

src: Eskhind appears to be favoring a leg, though she has concealed any injury.
zh: 埃斯金德似乎在护着一条腿，虽然她掩饰了伤势。

src: Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused.
zh: 埃斯金德声称自己是被冤枉的。

src:
Eskhind didn't do it. It was probably Keh.

That's all I know. I mind my business.

Wish you would too.
zh:
不是埃斯金德干的。多半是凯。

我就知道这些。我管好自己的事。

希望你也一样。

src: Eskhind is dead, but Kindrish was not on her body.
zh: 埃斯金德死了，但金德里什不在她身上。
埃斯金德在护着一条腿。

src: Eskhind is showing signs of a leg injury. Perhaps she was in a fight.
zh: 埃斯金德有腿伤的迹象。或许她打过架。

src: Etched chromium on the lavish legs tapers to claw-and-ball feet, and on the marble surface, geometric imperfections were rasped off and flung into an iron bucket that may still exist somewhere. Eaters spoke here, and planned.
zh: 华美桌腿上蚀刻的铬，渐细收为爪球足；大理石桌面上，几何的瑕疵被锉去，抛入一只或许仍存于某处的铁桶。食者曾在此交谈，筹谋。

src: Etched into this mead hall for small, winged friends are stories they cannot understand.
zh: 这座为小小有翼之友所设的蜜酒大厅里，刻满了它们无从理解的故事。

src: Eureka! You may now =fragments.andList=... and were able to work out how without needing to destroy =object.isplural:these:this one=!
zh: 顿悟！你现在可以=fragments.andList=……而且无需毁掉=object.isplural:这些:这件=便已悟出其中门道！

zh: 顿悟！你现在可以=fragments.andList=……而且无需毁掉=object.the.name=便已悟出其中门道！

src: Even as high-quality as my products are, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I don't suggest you go walking in the fracti to test them out.
zh: 纵然我的货如此上乘，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我也不建议你走进断裂体丛里去试穿。

src: Even blood as thin as mine ties me to the cervidian meadow. The hindren may not say so, but they are my family.
zh: 纵使我的血这般稀薄，仍系着那片鹿群草场。欣德伦人嘴上或许不认，但他们是我的家人。

src: Even if you can't make a thing now, you could gain the insight later.
zh: 纵然你眼下造不出，日后也许会有所悟。

src: Even in the imperfections of a spiral shell we see the perfection of nature.
zh: 螺旋之壳纵有瑕疵，我们也能从中窥见自然的完满。

src: Even now the nimbus of vaporized acid is condensing, starting to settle on its colonized surfaces, starting to sink through their soft edges.
zh: 酸气的云晕此刻仍在凝结，开始沉落于它所侵占的诸般表面，开始渗入其柔软的边缘。

src: Every autumn, many gulch dwellers hike to the Stiltgrounds to purchase the Fall wine. They return to their homes, steep wheat bran in the wine, and leaven dough in their clay ovens. A few are luckier; fungus grove dwellers need only step outside to harvest yeast, and friends to fungi need only shake their yeast-ridden appendages.
zh: 每年秋日，许多沟壑居民都要徒步前往高塔之地，买下坠落葡萄酒。他们回到家中，把麦麸浸进酒里，在陶炉中发面。少数人更为幸运：住在菌林里的人只需出门采收酵母，与真菌为友者只需抖一抖自己那爬满酵母的附肢。

Every character has Sprint, but most of your abilities are determined by traits like your mutations. You have Freezing Ray, so you can shoot frost out of your hands.

Select it with =commandKey:Next Ability= and =commandKey:Previous Ability= then press =commandKey:Use Ability=.

每个角色都有疾跑，但你的大部分技能取决于你的变异之类的特质。你拥有冰冻射线，可以从手中射出寒霜。

用=commandKey:Next Ability=和=commandKey:Previous Ability=选中它，再按=commandKey:Use Ability=。

Every character has Sprint, but most of your abilities are determined by traits like your mutations. You have Freezing Ray, so you can shoot frost out of your hands. Select it.

每个角色都有疾跑，但你的大部分技能取决于你的变异之类的特质。你拥有冰冻射线，可以从手中射出寒霜。选中它。

src:
Every flame burns low one day, but the warmth of my people's story still carries me forward.

Bey Lah has not survived joining Qud, but the hindren live on, and our legacy will never be wholly lost.

I wonder what became of Kindrish.
zh:
每一团火终有一日会燃尽，但我族故事里的暖意，依旧推着我向前。

贝拉没能在并入卡德之后存续，但欣德伦人仍在，我们的传承永不会彻底湮灭。

不知金德里什后来怎样了。

src: Every possibility nestles in the deepest of the comb-caves and labyrinths, and even Nervous life is tenacious. Perhaps in this very moment, a moss piglet drinks of its first water in an eon.
zh: 万般可能，皆蛰伏于蜂巢洞窟与迷宫的最深处，便是神经之命，也极其顽强。说不定此刻，一只苔猪崽正啜饮它亘古以来的第一口水。

src: Every statuette is a tribute, of a kind, but not every tribute is received well.
zh: 每一尊雕像，皆是某种供奉，只是并非每份供奉都能蒙人欣纳。

src: Everything I sell is safe to eat as it is.
zh: 我卖的东西，一概可以直接入口。

src: Everything I sell is the product of many hours of toil.
zh: 我卖的每一样，都是多少个时辰辛劳的成果。

src: Everything near the bantam mammal is damp: fur, hair, leaves, soil, slick silver alloys. =pronouns.Subjective==verb:'re:afterpronoun= become a furry world unto =pronouns.reflexive=, and the sweet and sickening honey-mist about =pronouns.objective= is the atmosphere.
zh: 这只矮小的哺乳动物近旁的一切都是湿的：毛、发、叶、土、滑亮的银合金。=pronouns.Subjective=已自成一方毛茸茸的天地，只属于=pronouns.reflexive=，环绕=pronouns.objective=的甜美而令人作呕的蜜雾便是其天穹。

src:
Evidence is any sign of something gone amiss. The Great Plant Detective gave some good examples in Act II of the tragedy of Gimlet:

So! Sweep the full estate for signs of {{W|trade}},
Their shady night-time dealings to expose
Now look for signs of {{W|craft}}, see what was made
For to conceal a treasure hidden close.
But darker still, if {{W|illness}} signs we find
A desperate contagion may yet lurk
And darkest yet, more {{W|violence}} may reply
To those who stumble 'pon their grisly work.
zh:
证据，即是事有不妥的一切迹象。植物大侦探在悲剧《金吉莱》第二幕中举过几个好例子：

来！扫遍整座庄园，寻{{W|交易}}的踪迹，
揭开他们夜间的暗昧勾当；
再寻{{W|制作}}的痕迹，看造出了何物，
为的是遮掩近处藏匿的宝藏。
更暗的是，若见{{W|疾病}}的征兆，
一场绝望的瘟疫或许正潜伏；
最暗的是，更多{{W|暴力}}或将回应，
降在那些撞见他们狰狞勾当的人身上。

src: Evolutionary pressures have reshaped the anatomy of the voider: fangs have descended from =pronouns.possessive= basal segment, the arciform chambers of =pronouns.possessive= shunting gland have fractalized, and =pronouns.possessive= frame has grown an order of magnitude to match the predatory potency of =pronouns.possessive= other advantages.
zh: 演化之力重塑了这虚空者的形骸：獠牙自=pronouns.possessive=基节垂下，=pronouns.possessive=分流腺的弓形腔室已分形增生，=pronouns.possessive=身躯更涨大了一个数量级，以与=pronouns.possessive=其他种种优势所成的猎食之威相称。

src:
Excellent. I will do my best to reward you to your satisfaction.

Though her name is sand in my mouth now, the exile who stole Kindrish is called Eskhind. She left a few weeks ago, and took her sister and brother with her. I don't know where she's gone, but Warden Neelahind might, as they were close friends as children.

Find the exile called Eskhind and retrieve Kindrish from her, even... even if the cost is the life of her and her siblings. Kindrish has been handed down over countless generations, and it belongs to my people, not any individual. Go, kendren. Speak to Warden Neelahind, and find out where Eskhind is hidden.
zh:
好极了。我定当竭力酬谢，使你满意。

她的名字如今在我口中如沙砾，偷走金德里什的流放者名叫埃斯金德。她数周前离去，带走了她的姐姐和弟弟。我不知她去了何处，但守望者尼拉欣德或许知晓，她们幼时是挚友。

找到名叫埃斯金德的流放者，从她手中夺回金德里什，即便……即便代价是她与她手足的性命。金德里什历经无数世代相传，属于我的族人，不属于任何一人。去吧，肯德伦。与守望者尼拉欣德谈谈，问出埃斯金德藏身何处。
出埃及号发射程序已启动！

src: Expand the equipment or inventory pane when focused
zh: 获得焦点时展开装备或背包面板

src: Expert rifling grooved its carbon steel barrel to helical precision. Smudges are printed on the scope glass.
zh: 精湛的膛线将碳钢枪管刻成螺旋般的精准。瞄准镜的玻璃上印着污迹。

src: Explain once more what I must do with Tau's chime.
zh: 请再说一遍，我该如何处置陶的钟鸣。

src: External healing is only half as effective.
zh: 外来治疗的效果仅有一半。

src: Extra long and slender fingers poke the micrometer lengths necessary to adjust a sight lens or set the oscillator on a vibrohilt. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:turn:afterpronoun= =pronouns.possessive= attention to you as you approach, to watch and read your speech.
zh: 格外修长而纤细的手指，能探出调整瞄准镜或拨动振动剑柄上振荡器所需的微米之数。你走近时，=pronouns.Subjective=把=pronouns.possessive=注意力转向你，细看并解读你的言谈。

src: Extradimensional: This item has recently materialized, inheriting some properties from its home dimension.
zh: 异维：此物是新近显现而来，继承了其故维度的某些特性。

src: Extradimensional: This item recently materialized in this dimension having inherited some properties from its home dimension, {{O|=dimensionName=}}.
zh: 异次元：此物新近才显化于本维度，并从其原属维度继承了若干特性，{{O|=dimensionName=}}。

src:
Extremely frustrating! But I am yet hopeful.

My people are resistant to change, but they don't seem opposed to the idea of a Democracy. I need to give them a measure of time before we hold an election, but they'll ultimately agree as long as I am acting Hindriarch.

Then, fates willing, they will vote me out. I'll be voting for Isahind, myself. Once I convince her to run.
zh:
极其令人沮丧！但我仍抱希望。

我的族人抗拒变革，但他们似乎并不反对民主的构想。选举之前我得给他们些时间，不过只要我是代理族长，他们终会同意。

然后，若命运许可，他们会投票罢免我。我自己会投票给伊萨欣德，前提是我能说服她参选。

src:
Ezra is more than tree-old. It's stone-old. Seedlings have lived here since our roots dreamed of joggling their fingers at the salt sky.

They ate earth and belched freight at the stars, and this place was their stomach.

Later, as the Star-Tree died and they buried their dead under its roots, this was their funerary place.

Now, we nurse electric milk from the old and aching temple to turn our wheels and grind our seeds and grains. Now we are they.
zh:
以斯拉不止树龄之古，更是石龄之古。从我们的根系梦见朝着盐天晃动手指之时起，幼苗就生活在这里。

它们吞食泥土，向群星呕出货运，这地方曾是它们的胃。

后来，星树死去，它们把亡者埋在其根下，这里便成了它们的安葬之地。

如今，我们从古老而疼痛的神殿中吮取电乳，推动我们的轮子，碾磨我们的种子与谷物。如今，我们便是它们。

src:
Ezra is old and has long since cut a groove into the world and resides there in stillness and harmony. But Zothom the Penitent One is a seedling, new to the world, and he quakes at all the tensing the world does. Perhaps you can share in his angst.

Go find him by the headstones for the dead.
zh:
以斯拉古老，早已在世上刻出一道沟，安居其中，静谧和谐。但悔罪者佐索姆是株幼苗，初到世间，对世界的一切紧绷都战栗不已。或许你能分担他的苦恼。

去墓碑旁找他吧。

src:
Ezra is, ah, the village at the base of the Spindle, is it not?

The very cradle of history. Not that my kin have a strong taste for history, but perhaps living amongst fresco and bas-relief will change their, ah, collective outlook?
zh:
以斯拉是，呃，纺锤脚下的那座村庄，不是吗？

那正是历史的摇篮。倒不是说族人对历史多有兴趣，但或许身处壁画与浮雕之间，会改变他们，呃，整体的见识？

src:
Ezra sits in the shadow of history, where small things grow. It's the moss beneath the statue, quite literally. For centuries monarchs concerned themselves with felling trees, and now of the Covenate only Ezra remains.

It's home to Rebekah's gravesite, so for the Daughters, it is a sacred place. You may notice more of us on pilgrimage.
zh:
以斯拉坐落在历史的阴影里，小物在那里生长。它就是塑像脚下的苔藓，一点不假。数百年间，君主们一心只想着砍伐树木，如今，圣约之国只剩以斯拉。

这里是利百加的墓地，所以对女儿们来说是圣地。你或许会发现有更多姐妹来朝圣。

src: Fabric of some type was sutured to an unknown end.
zh: 某类织物被缝合起来，用途不明。

src: Fabricates one =creature.displayNameOnlyDirect|strip=, cognitively altered to like you.
zh: 制造一个=creature.displayNameOnlyDirect|strip=，其心智经改造而对你怀有好感。

src: Fabrics from across the plateau -- quilted eiderdown, weave-of-brinestalk, sticky elastyne -- have been dyed and sewn to a jacket of colored chaos.
zh: 取自高原各处的织物——絮被绒羽、盐茎织物、黏稠的弹性纤维——经染色缝缀，成一件斑斓混沌的夹克。

src: Fabrics were stuffed with watervine chaff and laid across wooden slats in the style of the hillfolk.
zh: 织物中填入水藤的糠壳，铺于木条之上，乃是山民的样式。

src: Failed psychic attacks against you cause the attacker to hemorrhage.
zh: 针对你的心灵攻击若失败，攻击者将大量出血。

src: Fairy moss powders the column and renders it damp with rainbow dew. Inside the shade, fey Magicks course in spheric everness.
zh: 仙苔将这根柱子敷上粉末，使之沾满虹色的露水。在灯影之内，精灵的魔法如球体般恒久奔流。

src: Fairy rings of braided grass-coral-fungi hybrids poke along their shadow network and excrete replicated struts as sheathing.
zh: 草、珊瑚与真菌交织而成的仙环，沿着影网探出身来，将复制而来的支架排泄为护层。

src: Far from the soaring aegides of earlier periods, this concave ward was merely bent and polished on a municipal lathe.
zh: 这面凹形护盾远不及前代那些凌空的神盾，不过是在市政车床上弯折、打磨而成。

src: Far too gooey for your taste.
zh: 太黏糊了，不合你的口味。

src: Farewell, now, meyvn. =name=. Live and drink.

Fascinating. I know nothing about these mopango, but any people whose love for learning and discovery defines them are, ah... good, in my opinion. I will discuss this with my kin, and see if they agree.
zh: 有意思。关于这些莫潘戈，我一无所知，但凡是以爱好学问与探索为本的族类，在我看来，都是，呃……好的。我会与族人商量，看他们是否同意。

src: Fat was shorn from =pronouns.possessive= Spindle-limbs on the psychic lathe. The irises of =pronouns.possessive= eyes are patterned on shapes that cannot be drawn in the geometries of the natural world, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:wear:afterpronoun= a blindfold to guard their secrets and mark =pronouns.possessive= ken. =pronouns.Possessive= weapon is immaterial but inseparable; it was spun from the same thoughtstuff as =pronouns.possessive= ego.
zh: 心灵的车床已从=pronouns.possessive=纺锤般的肢体上削去了脂肪。=pronouns.possessive=双眼的虹膜纹着一些自然界的几何所不能描画的形状；=pronouns.subjective=蒙着眼罩，既为守护那些秘密，也为标出=pronouns.possessive=识力所及。=pronouns.Possessive=兵刃无形而不可须臾离；它与=pronouns.possessive=自我同出一种思质，由之纺成。

src: Fat was shorn from =pronouns.possessive= spindle-limbs on the psychic lathe. The irises of =pronouns.possessive= eyes are patterned on shapes that cannot be drawn in the geometries of the natural world, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:wear:afterpronoun= a blindfold to guard their secrets. =pronouns.Possessive= weapon is immaterial but inseparable; it was spun from the same thoughtstuff as =pronouns.possessive= ego. Around =pronouns.possessive= neck =pronouns.subjective= =verb:wear:afterpronoun= the ornamental ruff; =pronouns.possessive= mastery of combat has given =pronouns.objective= access to a sight older than sight.
zh: 心灵的车床已从=pronouns.possessive=纺锤般的肢体上削去了脂肪。=pronouns.possessive=双眼的虹膜纹着一些自然界的几何所不能描画的形状；=pronouns.subjective=蒙着眼罩，以守护那些秘密。=pronouns.Possessive=兵刃无形而不可须臾离；它与=pronouns.possessive=自我同出一种思质，由之纺成。=pronouns.possessive=颈上，=pronouns.subjective=佩着那圈装饰性的颈环；=pronouns.possessive=战斗之精熟，使=pronouns.objective=得以窥见一种比视觉更古老的视。

src: Fat was shorn from =pronouns.possessive= spindle-limbs on the psychic lathe. The irises of =pronouns.possessive= eyes are patterned on shapes that cannot be drawn in the geometries of the natural world. =pronouns.Possessive= weapon is immaterial but inseparable; it was spun from the same thoughtstuff as =pronouns.possessive= ego.
zh: 脂肪被心智的车床自=pronouns.possessive=纺锤般的肢体上削去。=pronouns.possessive=双眼的虹膜，以自然世界的几何所无法绘出的形状为纹样。=pronouns.Possessive=兵刃无形而不可分离；它与=pronouns.possessive=自我由同一种思想之质纺成。

src: Fate intervenes and you deal no damage to =object.the.name=.
zh: 命运插手其间，你对=object.the.name=未造成任何伤害。

src: Fates forfend. I would hardly like to lead a village and run a shop at the same time.
zh: 命运禁止。我可不愿既领一座村子，又开一间铺子。

src: Faundren saw a merchant from outside the village sneaking around, indicating recent trade.
zh: 小欣德伦人看见一名村外的商人鬼鬼祟祟地四处游荡，说明近来有过交易。

src: Feathered: This item grants the wearer +250 reputation with birds.
zh: 羽饰：此物使穿戴者与鸟类的声望+250。

src: Feathered: This item grants the wearer =amount.signed= reputation with birds.
zh: 覆羽：此物使穿戴者与鸟类的声望=amount.signed=。

src: Features erupt from a stone canvas and shatter into a figure from the deep past. Hair, skin, brow, thigh: the details hatch a new emotion inside you, the sense of the strange-familiar. As you move about the petrified likeness, you wonder at how this Eater managed to incise themself into your spacetime braid.
zh: 石质的画布上，五官迸然而出，碎成一尊来自深古的身影。发，肤，眉，股：细节在你心中孵出一种新的情绪，一种陌生而熟悉之感。你绕着这尊石化的肖像踱步，不禁惊叹这位食者竟能将自身镌刻进你的时空发辫之中。

src: Feelers rip through your scalp and shudder with curiosity.
zh: 触须撕开你的头皮钻出，好奇地颤动着。

src: Feelers sway in a circlet on a skeletal vase-column. The aboral side is yoked to other polyps, forming a fossilized arcology.
zh: 触须环绕骨骼般的花瓶柱摇曳。其反口面与别的水螅体相系，结成一座化石生态城。

src: Feldspar and its cousin rocks are composited and pocked with static-pattern grain. Cracks foreshadow the pebbles of the future.
zh: 长石及其同族诸岩混为一体，布满如雪花噪点般的颗粒。裂隙预示着未来的卵石。

src: Fell from a cliff trying to recover a lost =item.name:includeAdjunctNoun|strip=

zh: 再替阿尔吉夫找件小玩意
替阿尔吉夫找件小玩意

src: Fiery. Blustery. Like the stews he cooks. If you're going to chat with him, make sure you have your schedule cleared and a ewer of honeyed wine.
zh: 火爆。咋呼。就像他煮的炖菜。你若要找他聊，务必先把日程清空，再备一壶蜜酒。

src: Fill your heart with the love of the Kasaphescence, as our Fathers once did!
zh: 如银辉诸父昔日所为，以圣化现之爱充满你的心！

src: Finally, a staircase. Walk over to it.
zh: 终于见到楼梯了。走过去。
找到埃斯金德，取回金德里什。

src: Find Vivira, a friendly turret in the Northwest catacombs, and tell em that Zothom sent you.
zh: 在西北方墓窟找到友善炮塔维维拉，告诉祂佐索姆派你来的。
找到一台故障的路径机器人

src: Find a dysfunctional waydroid among the ruins of Golgotha.
zh: 在各各他的废墟中寻找一台故障的路径机器人。

src: Find the creatures that are eating Joppa's watervine.
zh: 找出啃食约帕水藤的生物。

src: Fine Wares from the Consortium of Phyta
Fine crushed herbs dust the old =pronouns.personTerm='s pestle knuckles.
zh: 研细的草末撒在这位年迈=pronouns.personTerm=那似杵的指节上。

src: Fine pages of lined parchment are bound into a algebraic codex.
zh: 细腻的划线羊皮纸页，装订成一部代数典册。

src:
Fine! Go to the Warden, then, and have her solve this mystery.

But know this: until a thief is found and Kindrish is recovered, I cannot reward you. You get nothing. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
zh:
罢了！那就去找守望者，让她来解这个谜。

但须知：窃贼未明、金德里什未回之前，我不能酬谢你。你一无所得。且生且饮，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

src: Finest food for parasangs! Finest food in Qud! Recipes and samples!
zh: 数帕兰桑之内最好的美食！卡德最好的美食！食谱与试吃，应有尽有！

src: Fire has poached the light from this body. Its stillness writhes against the changing soil.
zh: 火焰已将光亮从这具躯体上煮尽。它的静止，在变幻的泥土上扭动挣扎。

src: Fires <stat Name="Beams" /> beams at random enemies every round for <stat Name="Duration" />.
zh: 在<stat Name="Duration" />内，每回合向随机敌人射出<stat Name="Beams" />道光束。

src: Firing a pistol only takes half a round instead of a full round.
zh: 开手枪只需半回合，而非一整回合。
坚实的,看护者,可调的,撒玛利亚人,助消化的,疗愈的,复原者

src:
First and foremost, let us lament the =killedList.pluralize:death= of our =killedList.pluralize:friend=: =killedList.andList:noSerial=. The loss to us is incalculable.

Beyond that,
zh:
首先，也是最要紧的，让我们哀悼同伴的离世：=killedList.pluralize:death=，他们是我们的=killedList.pluralize:friend=：=killedList.andList:noSerial=。这损失无可估量。

除此之外，

src: Fish meat was cut into neat strips, salted, and smoked.
zh: 鱼肉被切成齐整的条，加盐，烟熏。
适应 填充 像素完美

src: Fitted with beamsplitter: This weapon has =split.a.number=-way spread with each shot at -1 penetration roll.
zh: 装有分束器：此武器每次射击形成=split.a.number=向散射，穿透检定-1。

src: Fitted with filters: This item protects against breathing in dangerous gases.
zh: 装有过滤器：此物可防止吸入危险气体。

src: Fitted with suspensors: When powered, this item is weightless.
zh: 装有悬浮器：供能后，此物没有重量。

src: Five verdurous lobes fall off a star-pointed flower the color of burning exhaust. They float in circles, driven by rhizomatic impulse.
zh: 五片青翠的叶瓣，自一朵星形花上飘落，花色如燃烧的尾焰。它们为根茎般的冲动所驱使，在空中盘旋。

src: Flakes shaved off a big wedge of the gravid metal have been heat-fused to some kind of animal leather.
zh: 从一大块沉重之金属上削下的薄片，被热熔在某种动物的皮革之上。

src: Flame-white feathers bend to a sinuous curve of repose. =pronouns.Possessive= stick-legs and fisher beak bracket =pronouns.possessive= body in coral and orchid hues.
zh: 焰白的羽毛弯成一道蜿蜒的安卧之弧。=pronouns.Possessive=细棍般的腿与渔人似的喙，以珊瑚与兰紫的色调将=pronouns.possessive=身躯框于其间。

src: Flaming: When powered, this weapon deals additional heat damage on hit.
zh: 燃烧：供能后，此武器命中时额外造成热能伤害。

src: Flaming: When powered, this weapon deals an additional =damageRange= heat damage on hit.
zh: 燃烧：供能后，此武器命中时额外造成=damageRange=点热能伤害。

src: Flanged ursteel anchors secure the tapered ribbon of Gjaus to its low earth point.
zh: 带凸缘的原钢锚固着吉奥斯那渐细的缎带，使其系于低地球点。
平整的,多节的,水平的,L形的,结实的,三足的,摇晃的
平整的,水平的,L形的,结实的,三足的,摇晃的

src: Flatten sheets of metal run off a warp beam in reverse and are stripped to loose wire. The bars of the separating reed bzzzz with psychoconductive force.
zh: 平展的金属片自经轴上倒着退出，被剥成散乱的金属丝。分隔筘的栅条，因心灵导电之力而嗡嗡作响。

src: Flax was mowed from the Bowl of Iris, stripped into fibers, and weaved into a soft grid by the fisherfolk of the Pale Sea.
zh: 亚麻收割自艾丽斯盆地，被剥成纤维，由苍海的渔民织成柔软的方格。

src: Flesh of cheek and jowl is tinged with the smell of salt.
zh: 颊与颌的肉里透出一丝盐的气味。

src: Flesh was seared to black slop and crumbles off the broad bones. A pair of smoking horns poke through.
zh: 血肉被炙成黑色的糊浆，自宽大的骨上碎落。一对冒烟的角从中穿出。

src: Flexiweaved: This item's DV penalty is reduced by =modLevel=.
zh: 柔织：此物的闪避值惩罚减少=modLevel=。

src: Flexiweaved: This item's DV penalty is reduced.
zh: 柔织：此物的闪避值惩罚减少。

src: Flickering interference patterns of light form a moire-cascading tableau.
zh: 闪烁的光之干涉图样，汇成一幅波纹倾泻的画面。

src: Flower buds cluster in sixes across =pronouns.possessive= time-maimed topaz bark and are ringed by glossy green leaves. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:shoot:afterpronoun= up tall in defiance of millenia of wall shade, but =pronouns.possessive= crown sags with weary softness, and =pronouns.possessive= exposed roots trace the outline of a grassy salon. The grove's oldest tree, called the Haddas, welcomes you to =pronouns.possessive= shadow.
zh: 花蕾六六成簇，缀在=pronouns.possessive=被时间残损的黄玉色树皮上，四周环绕着润泽的绿叶。=pronouns.Subjective=高高抽出，无视千年来墙垣的荫蔽；然而=pronouns.possessive=树冠因倦怠而柔软下垂，=pronouns.possessive=裸露的根须勾勒出一处草茵沙龙的轮廓。林中最为古老的树，人称哈达斯，邀你入=pronouns.possessive=荫下。

src: Flush zones to cache early (for low memory environments)
zh: 提前将区域写入缓存（适用于低内存环境）

src: Fluted columns of prism glass scatter the sight of becoming into a thousand fractured vistas.
zh: 棱镜玻璃的凹槽立柱，将生成之景散射为千道破碎的远景。

src: Fluted keys for every wavelength along every spectrum permit entrance through every portal.
zh: 每一波段上每一种波长，都有一把槽纹钥匙，可通行每一道门户。

src: Foam plush is arranged into gyri and sulci to mimic the brain maze.
zh: 泡沫绒布被排成脑回与脑沟，以仿脑之迷宫。

src: Focus-ringed binoculars read the tells of infrared light and produce a textured picture of eye-warm greens.
zh: 对焦环双筒镜解读红外光的蛛丝马迹，织出一幅质感分明、带着眼温的绿色图景。

src: Folds of coarse-weave physician's cloth hang off =pronouns.possessive= lissome frame like a gunslinger's shawl, and the crinkled brim of an old hat blots the sun and starlight.
zh: 几层粗织的医者之布自=pronouns.possessive=柔韧的躯体上垂下，宛如枪手的披巾；一顶旧帽那皱起的帽檐，遮蔽了日光与星光。

src: Follow the road =EskhindRoadDirection= to find the hollow tree where Esk and I used to play.
zh: 沿着路往=EskhindRoadDirection=走，便能找到那棵空心树，我和埃斯克小时候常在那里玩耍。

src: For <stat Name="Duration" />, your chance to daze with cudgel attacks is 100% and Slam has no cooldown.
zh: 在<stat Name="Duration" />内，你以棍棒攻击使对手眩晕的几率为100%，且猛砸无需冷却。

src: For ages they dreamed, 'the hands must grow'. In the soft luster of a laboratory, the dream was realized.
zh: 他们梦了万古：“手必须生长。”在实验室柔和的光泽中，梦想成真。

src: For better or worse to the fate of Bey Lah, you solved the mystery of Kindrish's disappearance and helped Warden Neelahind administer justice.
zh: 无论对贝拉的命运是福是祸，你都查明了金德里什失踪之谜，并协助守望者尼拉欣德主持公道。

src:
For centuries, we of listening inclination have kept sharp for some sign that =name= will return to the stars. Those of preaching inclination proclaim the imminent return of the starfarer, bearing tidings from parsecs forgotten and the last light of dying stars.

All others have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it, waiting for the next great history.
zh:
数百年来，我们这些倾向聆听的人，始终留神凝望，只盼见到=name=重返星海的一丝迹象。那些倾向宣讲的人，则宣告星航者即将归来，携来遗忘已久的秒差距之外的音讯，与垂死恒星的最后微光。

其余众人，皆在日渐缩小的大地之上与之下，维系着岌岌可危的和睦，静候下一段伟大的历史。

src: For every three spaces you dash, you gain a +2 bonus to hit and a +2 penetration roll bonus to your dash attack.
zh: 每冲刺三格，你的冲刺攻击便获得+2命中加值与+2穿透检定加值。

src: For it's a request most unholy in its corrosion.
zh: 那请求因腐蚀而极其亵渎。

src:
For me? Are you sure?

But... this is a poem. In Esk's handwriting. Are you s-sure this is for me?
zh:
给我的？你确定吗？

可是……这是一首诗。是埃斯的笔迹。你、你确定这是给我的？

src: For purposes of bartering, your ego is treated as though it were 4 points higher.
zh: 在讨价还价时，你的自我视同高出4点。

src: For purposes of determining your accuracy with pistols, your agility is treated as if it were 4 points higher.
zh: 在判定你使用手枪的命中率时，你的敏捷视同高出4点。

src: For reasons kept secret by the sphinx of subjective experience, =name= drank the forbidden tea.
zh: 因主观体验的斯芬克斯守口如瓶，=name=饮下了禁忌之茶。

src:
For temple 'here' yes:
{{zetachrome|Spoken Ionic Through Covalency Heart}} here.
Also, you.
zh:
就圣殿“此处”而言，有：
{{zetachrome|经共价之心言说的离子}}在此。
还有，你。

src: For the next <stat Name="Duration" />, Lunge and Swipe have no cooldown.
zh: 接下来的<stat Name="Duration" />内，突刺与挥斩无需冷却。

src: For the next three rounds, you automatically block all incoming melee attacks (may not be used with bucklers).
zh: 接下来三回合内，你自动格挡所有来袭的近战攻击（小圆盾不可使用）。

src: For the next three rounds, you automatically block all incoming melee attacks.
zh: 接下来三回合，你会自动格挡所有来袭的近战攻击。

src: For the purpose of determining your accuracy with bows and rifles, your agility is treated as if it were 4 points higher.
zh: 在判定你使用弓与步枪的命中率时，你的敏捷视同高出4点。

src: For the purpose of determining your accuracy with ranged attacks, your agility is treated as if it were 6 points higher.
zh: 计算你远程攻击的精准度时，视你的敏捷高出6点。

src: For the sake of =spice:commonPhrases.wisdom.!random=, =spice.entity:name= =spice:commonPhrases.settled.!random= at =location= in =region= to =spice:instancesOf.dwellOrWork.!random= among the =spice:instancesOf.commonFolk.!random= and =spice:history.gospels.HumblePractice.entity@era.!random=. After =duration.cardinal= =spice:commonPhrases.humble.!random= years, =spice.entity:subjectPronoun= =spice:instancesOf.reemerged.!random= at =newLocation=.
For up to 10 rounds, you engage in psychic combat with an opponent, dealing damage each round.
zh: 至多10回合内，你与一名对手展开心灵交锋，每回合造成伤害。

src: For weeks and weeks, Kesehind was so quiet, but now he's talking more than ever! He's so loud!
zh: 好几个星期，凯塞因德都那么安静，可现在他话比谁都多！吵死了！

src: For what purpose did the Eaters rear a fairy tale people and let them think their pennant flew over the whole of a crystal universe? If there was one, it is lost.
zh: 食者究竟出于何种目的，养育了一个童话般的民族，又令他们以为自己的旗帜飘扬在整座水晶宇宙之上？若有其目的，今已湮没无闻。

src: Force is pushed across bronze spines through an improbable series of flapping motions, whereupon parasols pop open to catch the mercurial wind.
zh: 力道经由青铜脊骨，以一连串不可思议的拍动传递，随即伞盖弹开，捕捉那变幻无常之风。

src: Forget it. I don't need your help.
zh: 算了。我不需要你的帮助。

src: Forgive me, kendren, but the sight of you makes my hands quake.
zh: 见谅，肯德伦，可一见你，我的手就发抖。

src: Forgiveness begged, kendren. I have work to do.
zh: 恕罪，肯德伦。我有活要干。

src: Four chambers of a stone-flesh dorsal hump swell with dozing breath like a mound of quaking earth-rubble. Fore and hind paws the size of kite sails are tipped with bowed claws, and shag fur dresses =pronouns.possessive= heavy-lidded eyes of amber.
zh: 石肉隆起的背嵴分作四室，随酣眠的呼吸一起一伏，宛如一堆震颤的土砾。前后掌大如风筝之帆，各缀着弯弓似的利爪；蓬乱的毛覆着=pronouns.possessive=一双厚睑的琥珀之眼。

src: Four flanged couplings form a cross with a wavegraph readout at the center. As liquids and gases pipe through, flux readings appear in neon strings.
zh: 四只带法兰的接头排成十字，中央是一处波图读数。液体与气体流经管道时，通量的读数便以霓虹的丝线浮现。

src: Fragrant sour gas plumes from the tiny pores scattered across =pronouns.possessive= broad gaster, and scalded feelers writhe and rub the thickened air.
zh: 芳香的酸气自散布于=pronouns.possessive=宽阔腹部的细小孔道中腾起，被烫伤的触角扭动着，拂擦浓稠的空气。

src: Fragrant spinning smoke plumes from the tiny pores scattered across =pronouns.possessive= broad gaster, and scalded feelers writhe and rub the thickened air.
zh: 芳香的旋转之烟自散布于=pronouns.possessive=宽阔腹部的细小孔道中腾起，被烫伤的触角扭动着，拂擦浓稠的空气。

src: Fragrant spinning smoke plumes from the tiny pores scattered across =pronouns.possessive= broad gaster, and scalded feelers writhe and rub the thickened air. =pronouns.Subjective= has more girth in the thorax than =pronouns.possessive= brood, and vein-painted wings glisten on =pronouns.possessive= back.
zh: 芳香的旋转之烟自散布于=pronouns.possessive=宽阔腹部的细小孔道中腾起，被烫伤的触角扭动着，拂擦浓稠的空气。=pronouns.Subjective=的胸节比=pronouns.possessive=子嗣更粗壮，绘着脉络的翅在=pronouns.possessive=背上发亮。

src:
Freeholder:
one who argues; bickerer.

Freeholder:
a peer among peers
among peers among peers
tessellated thus
until one must scream to be heard.
zh:
自由领民：
争辩之人；吵嘴之人。

自由领民：
同侪之中的一位同侪，
同侪之中的同侪之中的同侪，
镶嵌成这般格局，
直到人须尖叫方能被听见。

src: Freezing mist coils out of lateral vents cut into the chrome wainscotting of a marble pillar.
zh: 寒雾自一根大理石柱的铬钢护壁板上所开的横向通风口中盘旋而出。

src: Freezing: When powered, this weapon deals additional cold damage on hit.
zh: 冰冻：供能后，此武器命中时额外造成寒冷伤害。

src: Freezing: When powered, this weapon deals an additional =damageRange= cold damage on hit.
zh: 冰冻：供能后，此武器命中时额外造成=damageRange=点寒冷伤害。

src: Friend, I have precious metals and jewels to adorn or trade.
zh: 朋友，我这儿有贵金属与珠玉，可佩可易。

src:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of my kinsfolk!

There is no kindness deep in the Great Desert. I cannot go and live.
zh:
朋友，我去了只会化作一堆焦炭，被曙光滑翔兽的光束活活烤死！或会被我族人的步枪打成爬满蛞蝓的尸体！

大沙漠深处毫无仁慈。我不能去送死。

src:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of the Issachari!

There is no kindness in the Great Desert, and little more in the canyons. I cannot go and live.
zh:
朋友，我去了只会化作一堆焦炭，被曙光滑翔兽的光束活活烤死！或会被以萨迦人的步枪打成爬满蛞蝓的尸体！

大沙漠毫无仁慈，峡谷里也好不了多少。我不能去送死。

src:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of the Issachari!

There is no kindness in the Great Desert. I cannot go and live.
zh:
朋友，我去了只会化作一堆焦炭，被曙光滑翔兽的光束活活烤死！或会被以萨迦人的步枪打成爬满蛞蝓的尸体！

大沙漠毫无仁慈。我不能去送死。

src: Frog leg is tinctured in its own spilled blood.
zh: 蛙腿浸染在自己淌出的血里。

src: Frog meat was cut into neat strips, salted, and smoked.
zh: 蛙肉被切成齐整的条，加盐，烟熏。

src: From a distance, =pronouns.subjective= could be mistaken for a human wearing a wide-brimmed, lanterned hat, but =pronouns.subjective= =verb:are:afterpronoun= no human and =pronouns.possessive= hat is no vestment. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:carry:afterpronoun= =pronouns.possessive= weapons and gear in flexible green digits, the broad leaf atop =pronouns.possessive= head scored and weathered, the shining flower atop =pronouns.possessive= crown glowing bright. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:dress:afterpronoun= as a wanderer and =verb:speak:afterpronoun= as if new to the practice.
zh: 远远望去，=pronouns.subjective=或会被误认作一个戴着宽檐灯笼帽的人，然而=pronouns.subjective=绝非人类，=pronouns.possessive=那顶帽子也并非衣冠。=pronouns.Subjective=以柔韧的绿色手指携着=pronouns.possessive=兵刃与行装；=pronouns.possessive=头顶的宽叶布满刮痕、久经风霜，=pronouns.possessive=冠上那朵光亮的花灿然生辉。=pronouns.Subjective=作游方人之打扮，说起话来却像是初习此道。

src: From a distance, the slynth could be mistaken for a human wearing a wide-brimmed, lanterned hat, but =pronouns.subjective= =verb:are:afterpronoun= no human and =pronouns.possessive= hat is no vestment. This one crooks with a small hunch earned from many hours of reading over many years. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:reel:afterpronoun= with the anxious air of a being waiting for something unknown.
zh: 远远看去，这位斯林斯或会被误认作一个戴着宽檐提灯帽的人；然而=pronouns.subjective=绝非人类，=pronouns.possessive=帽子也并非衣衫。这一位微微佝偻，那是多年间伏案读过多卷书所挣来的。=pronouns.Subjective=身子摇晃，带着一个在等待某样未知之物的生灵才有的不安神气。

src: From a hydroponic planting tray dusted with decorative gravel, a column of sea grapes rises, twists, and bunches into the approximate shape of a woman. Though =pronouns.possessive= bubbly green strands are but a loose imitation of the flesh of limbs and digits, =pronouns.subjective= =verb:carry:afterpronoun= =pronouns.reflexive= with humanlike ease and =verb:manage:afterpronoun= to vocalize in a reedy but audible tone.
zh: 一列海葡萄自一只铺着装饰砾石的水培托盘里升起，盘绕、纠结，聚成近似女子的形状。=pronouns.possessive=那串串泡泡似的绿茎虽只是对四肢与指节的松散仿作，=pronouns.subjective=却以近乎人的从容带动=pronouns.reflexive=，并能以尖细而清楚可闻的调子发声。

src: From across the psychic sea, you feel the glare of unseen eyes. Someone is disappointed in you.
zh: 隔着心灵之海，你感到有双看不见的眼睛正凝视着你。有人对你很失望。

src: From deep as stratum 29, this cape was knit from trash; a thousand years of history now draped across the ass.
zh: 这件披风深自第29层，以垃圾织成；千年的历史，如今披挂在臀上。

src: From the camber of the tree's twigs and trunk you infer a stellar arrangement of its homeplace too geometrically complex for natural starbirth. =pronouns.Possessive= ribbons throw the light like glass and dance on the stale air, strange pennants of a civilization shorn of familiarity. Here at the edge of =pronouns.possessive= foreign pond, the visitor being root-sips cool water in confounding performance.
zh: 自这棵树的枝干之弧，你推知它故乡的星辰排布，对自然的星体诞生而言，在几何上过于繁复。=pronouns.Possessive=的缎带如玻璃般反射光线，在陈腐的空气中起舞，是一个失去了一切熟悉之物的文明的奇异旗帜。在=pronouns.possessive=异乡池塘的边缘，这位来访者以根啜饮清凉之水，其举动令人费解。

src: From the great, sloping forehead of this man-ape sprouts no hair, though rich black fur courses over the rest of =pronouns.possessive= body. Broad knuckles bear the brunt of =pronouns.possessive= weight as the beast =verb:saunter= forth in search of something to clobber.
zh: 这猿人硕大倾斜的额上不生一根毛，而=pronouns.possessive=周身却奔涌着浓密的黑毛。宽大的指节承担着=pronouns.possessive=全身之重，那野兽就这样悠荡前行，寻些东西来砸。

src: From the hands of a metalworker rods and strips erupted and cooled into shape.
zh: 金工匠的手下，杆与条迸发而出，冷却成形。

src: From the shadowed gloam of an understratum tunnel emerges a south-ran bridge across the empyrean, underlit by the sunbeaming oceans below.
zh: 自底层隧道阴沉的幽暗中，一座向南延伸的桥横跨天穹，下方被阳光照耀的海洋自下而上映亮了它。

src: From welt to shank under the ink-smudged boot, a thin plate of magnetized nickel force-welds the wearer to the iron loam.
zh: 自鞋边至鞋腰，在墨渍斑斑的靴下，一片薄薄的磁化镍板，将穿者强行焊牢于铁壤之上。

src: Fronds are splayed out in a waxy imitation of life. It looks hard and greasy up close, but as you back away its edges burn into softness and it performs the tree function.
zh: 枝叶张开，蜡质地模仿着生命。近看它又硬又油腻，可你一退远，其边缘便烧成柔软，行起树的职分。

src: Frosted tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
zh: 结霜的组织在研钵中磨碎，在盐水中慢煮，再凝成块。
你已冻得僵硬，无法劝诱=object.t=入教。

src: Fruited hands climb the stalks of the grifter tree. When the light catches on the surface of the exposed corm, Spindle glitter throws it back to the widened grove.
zh: 结实的手掌攀上骗子树的枝干。光照在裸露的球茎表面时，纺锤微光将光芒反射回开阔的林苑。

src: Fulcrete dyed with integral pigments bursts into mottled color. It's been incised with regular geometry that draws the eye across the horizontal plane.
zh: 掺入固有颜料染色的富混凝土，迸出斑驳的色彩。其上刻着规整的几何纹样，引目光横越水平面。

src: Fulcrete, metal, and foam bands protect against the vacuum of space and offer pleasing visual texture to the flat interior, which keeps the heart high on long hauls.
zh: 富混凝土、金属与泡沫的条带抵御太空真空，并给平整的内部添上悦目的视觉质感，使人在漫长航程中心神得以振奋。

src: Fullerene finger extensors splay like fashionable court nails. Their girths are shrunk or unshrunk to task requirements by minuscule servos embedded in the webbing.
zh: 富勒烯指延伸体如时髦的宫廷指甲般张开。嵌在蹼膜中的微小伺服机构，按任务所需缩放其粗细。

src: Fur is matted in blood-brushed clumps across =pronouns.possessive= skin; long fangs break the plane of =pronouns.possessive= bristly snout. =pronouns.Possessive= hindlegs tic and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:reach:afterpronoun= with =pronouns.possessive= forepaws for the reassurance of the dirt. In the earth's lightless recesses, troglodytes are reclaimed by the primal forces that once shucked them toward civilization.
zh: 毛在=pronouns.possessive=皮上结成一块块血染的板结；长獠牙刺破=pronouns.possessive=刚毛口鼻的轮廓。=pronouns.Possessive=后腿抽搐，=pronouns.subjective=以=pronouns.possessive=前爪探向泥土，求一份安稳。在大地无光的幽深处，穴居者被那曾将他们推离蛮荒、送向文明的原初之力重新收回。

src: Furry ridges catch the long salt wind, and a dextrous tail pounds the ground.
zh: 毛茸茸的脊背迎着盐地的长风，一条灵巧的尾巴拍打着地面。

src: Furry shrinewort grows over a ring of dead plant stems and drinks in the temple shade.
zh: 毛茸茸的庙草，生长在一圈枯死的植物茎秆之上，啜饮着神庙的荫凉。

src:
Furthermore, I spoke with Barathrum. He praised your handling of the Earl of Omonporch, and he thanks you for the bravery you exhibited in defending Grit Gate.

The attack today reminds us: for too long have we put our faith in the isolation of our guild and the preoccupations of the Putus Templar. The looming threat of another attack impels Barathrum to accelerate his plans, and with them, your position in our guild.

You are raised to Disciple, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Barathrum wishes to speak with you immediately.
zh:
此外，我已与巴拉斯鲁姆谈过。他称赞你处置奥蒙门廊伯爵的手段，也感谢你在保卫砂砾门时所显的勇气。

今日之袭提醒了我们：我们太久以来，都把信心寄托在本会的与世隔绝，与普图斯圣殿骑士团的无暇他顾之上。又一次攻击的阴影迫使巴拉斯鲁姆加快谋划，连带你在本会中的地位也随之提升。

你已晋升为门徒，=player.formalAddressTerm=。巴拉斯鲁姆希望立刻与你一谈。

src: GRANT ME A MOMENT TO MUSE.
Gain +<stat Name="AgilityBonus" /> Agility and +<stat Name="MovespeedBonus" /> move speed for <stat Name="Duration" /> rounds.
zh: 获得+<stat Name="AgilityBonus" />敏捷和+<stat Name="MovespeedBonus" />移动速度，持续<stat Name="Duration" />回合。

src: Gain a level as this creature to wake pleasantly.
zh: 以此生物之身升一级，即可安然醒来。

src: Gain entrance to the sealed Tomb.
Garbage collect after each zone flush (for low memory environments)
zh: 每次区域写入缓存后执行垃圾回收（适用于低内存环境）

src: Garden at the Gate to Brightsheol
Gas is pushed through a hose and ignited into flame. Dew gives texture to the hose barbs.
zh: 气体被推过软管，点着成焰。露水为软管上的倒刺添了一层肌理。

src:
Gas is too misty.
Glass is too feeble.
Solids are too rocky.
Liquid crystals are not liquids!
Copolymers, decide what you are!
Bose-Einstein condensates are too wavy.
Superfluids are too unruly.
Fermionic condensates contain too many fermions.
Rydberg molecules are too excited.
Strange matter is too strange.
Plasma is too hot.
Quark-gluon plasma, contain your quarks!
Degenerate matter is too vulgar.
Loopfluids are too maddening.
String-net liquids, they are alright too, I suppose.
But Qo-Caco condensates are delicious.
zh:
气体太雾蒙蒙。
玻璃太脆弱。
固体太像岩石。
液晶可不是液体！
共聚物啊，想清楚你究竟是什么！
玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚态太过起伏。
超流体太不安分。
费米子凝聚态里费米子太多。
里德伯分子太兴奋。
奇异物质太奇异。
等离子体太烫。
夸克—胶子等离子体，管好你的夸克！
简并物质太粗俗。
环流体令人抓狂。
弦网液体嘛，我想也还过得去。
可量子卡科凝聚物真是美味。

src: Gas molecules arrange along the ley lines of this plane to form an aeriform mesh. Objects on orthogonal trajectories are netted and shunted back toward their planar homes.
zh: 气体分子沿此界面的地脉线排布，织成一张气态之网。凡循正交轨迹而来之物，皆被网住，并被推回其本界的家乡。

src: Gaseous coolant billows through a chiffon tube, putting dew on the wide and planar barrel chrome. It spills out onto the air from a ice-chipped muzzle.
zh: 气态冷却剂自一根薄纱般的管子中涌出，将宽阔平整的枪管铬面凝上露珠。它从冰屑般的枪口倾泻而出，散入空气。

src: Gases you release are =density.abs=% less dense.
zh: 你释放的气体浓度降低=density.abs=%。
你释放的气体浓度提高=density=%。
你释放的气体消散速度减慢=dispersal.abs=%。
你释放的气体消散速度加快=dispersal=%。

src:
Gathered and spun, I emerge into {{zetachrome|Spoken Ionic Through Covalency Heart}}.
What is... what are. I cannot.
Finding no entry, for the rest is at home. A strand to you.
zh:
聚而旋，我显现为{{zetachrome|经共价之心言说的离子}}。
是什么……是何物。我不能。
寻不得条目，余者皆在家中。予你一缕。
高斯式,感应式,强效的,补足者,复原者

src: Gaze upon the sublime body of =name=! See the glistening =cybernetic.basename=!
zh: 瞻仰=name=的至尊之躯！看那熠熠生辉的=cybernetic.basename=！

src: Gearbox: Has mechanical power transmission components installed.
zh: 齿轮箱：装有机械动力传动部件。

src: Gears and rondures of all sizes are inked in the margins of =pronouns.possessive= body, and =pronouns.possessive= lips quiver in recitation of the chromaic liturgy.
zh: 大小不一的齿轮与圆环以墨绘在=pronouns.possessive=身体的边缘，=pronouns.possessive=双唇颤动着，诵念色彩仪文。
丰饶的,丰厚的,微星,充裕的,强效的,挥霍的,补足者

src: Geometric shapes of meaning tessellate the ringed rows around the crematory vessel: stars, triquetrae, nonagons, and lunes.
zh: 寓意的几何图形层层镶嵌于焚化之器周围的环状行列：星形、三曲枝纹、九边形与月牙形。

src: Geometry is stressed under the gelatin alp, which erupts from the smooth planes of its surroundings in disgusting triumph of size. Its k membranous faces, once taut by the pressurization of symmetry, now follow a sagging curve toward the wet core, and through the blurry placentae shines a museum of historical objects from across the numbered ages. Are those the bones of a pig? Is that a bronze bell? Inside the bright-slick sac, earth-remnants from across time are joined to one space, and k-Goninon sloshes in hunger.
zh: 几何在这座胶质山岳下不堪重压；它自四周平滑的平面中隆起，以令人作呕的庞大体量炫其胜势。它那k张膜状的面，本因对称的加压而绷紧，如今却沿着下垂的曲线朝湿润的核心塌陷；透过模糊的胎盘，一座来自各个有数之世的古物博物馆闪着光。那是猪的骨头吗？那是一只铜铃吗？在明亮湿滑的囊中，来自各个时代的尘土残迹被并置一处，克-戈尼农则在饥饿中晃荡作响。

src: Geometry swims across the crystal diodes of the mask. Its expression is smiling in the hypnagogic key.
zh: 几何图形游过面具的晶体二极管。其神情含笑，奏的是半梦半醒之调。

src: Geosocial location data is painted across the glass lune and is underlaid with representations of the living loam that has shifted over earth to take its place.
zh: 地理社交的定位数据绘于玻璃月牙之上，其下衬着活壤的图样——那活壤已在大地上移转，取而代之。

src: Gesticulating: This item grants +=bonus= =strength.Name= but disallows the use of the Floating Nearby equipment slot.
zh: 比划手势：此物提供+=bonus==strength.Name=，但无法使用“浮于身侧”装备栏。
让巴拉斯鲁姆进入魔像。

src: Get Pax Klanq to agree to fabricate the climber from Q Girl's design.
zh: 说服帕克斯·克朗克按照Q女孩的设计制造攀升器。

src: Get Q Girl's Blueprints for the Climber
zh: 取得Q女孩绘制的攀升器蓝图

src: Get Q Girl's Instructions onto the Data Disk
zh: 将Q女孩的指示写入数据盘

src: Get close if you like, they don't pinch.
zh: 想凑近就凑近，它们不夹人。

src: Get the blueprints for the climber to deliver to Pax Klanq.
zh: 取得攀升器蓝图，交给帕克斯·克朗克。

src: Get your hands on the Corpus Choliys for disease and fungus cures.
zh: 想治疾病与真菌，就弄到一册《科珀斯·科利斯》。

src: Ghost-canes are twirled to pictorial stillness, and moisture gathers on their buds.
zh: 幽灵甘蔗扭转成画中静景，芽上凝聚着水珠。

src: Giant waveform half-shells of calcium are dusted with moss and algae. They lie at an open, welcoming angle, and the portal muscle at their center palpitates with spatiotemporal regularity.
zh: 巨大的钙质波状半壳上，撒着苔藓与藻类。它们以开阔而迎人的角度张着，其中心那扇门户似的肌肉，按着时空的规律搏动。

src: Giant, flattened rings of hypercooled crysteel correlate their wearer to an astronomical body and serve as celestial equator, declination, and meridian. Their edges are filed on a nanon lathe and slice through orbiting debris.
zh: 巨大而扁平的超冷晶钢环，使佩戴者与某一天体相应，充作天赤道、赤纬与子午圈。其边缘经纳农车床锉磨，能切开环绕的碎屑。

src: Gigantic fruiting bodies in rich, unearthly hues stick to sponge forks and burp spores. They flit curvewise toward the electrostatic of the Spindle tether and rain down as glitter.
zh: 巨大的子实体，色泽浓郁而非属尘世，附着于海绵分叉之上，打着嗝喷出孢子。它们沿着曲线朝纺锤系缆的静电扑去，又化作微光洒落。

src: Gigantic opponents don't get pushed but are still stunned for 1 round.
zh: 巨型对手不会被推开，但仍会晕眩1回合。

src: Gigantic, old stone was stacked, knapped, and carved in long arcs to the style of the day in the time of =sultan:1=. Since then, the project has accrued collaborators, and their signatures are writ everywhere: here, the lacuna of a vandal's edit; there, the soft strokes of time's brush.
zh: 巨大的古石层层垒起，经敲琢，雕作绵长的弧线，一如=sultan:1=之世的风尚。此后，这项工程招来了无数合作者，他们的签名无处不在：此处是破坏者所改留下的缺损，彼处是时光之笔的轻柔笔触。

src: Gigantic, old stone was stacked, knapped, and carved in long arcs to the style of the day in the time of =sultan:2=. Since then, the project has accrued collaborators, and their signatures are writ everywhere: here, the lacuna of a vandal's edit; there, the soft strokes of time's brush.
zh: 巨大的古石层层垒起，经敲琢，雕作绵长的弧线，一如=sultan:2=之世的风尚。此后，这项工程招来了无数合作者，他们的签名无处不在：此处是破坏者所改留下的缺损，彼处是时光之笔的轻柔笔触。

src: Gigantic, old stone was stacked, knapped, and carved in long arcs to the style of the day in the time of Resheph. Since then, the project has accrued collaborators, and their signatures are writ everywhere: here, the lacuna of a vandal's edit; there, the soft strokes of time's brush.
zh: 巨大的古石层层垒起，经敲琢，雕作绵长的弧线，一如利悉之世的风尚。此后，这项工程招来了无数合作者，他们的签名无处不在：此处是破坏者所改留下的缺损，彼处是时光之笔的轻柔笔触。

src: Gigantic: This item is much heavier than usual and can only be equipped by gigantic creatures.
zh: 巨型：此物远比寻常沉重，只有巨型生物才能装备。

src: Girsh Agolgot! Red dusts in my nails and burning hot bubbles swell in my glands! Now I point to the future.
zh: 吉尔什，阿戈尔戈特！指甲里是红尘，腺体里灼热的气泡鼓胀！此刻我指向未来。

src: Girthy pilings of fibrous salt-rot stake out these pools of brine. They belong to no one.
zh: 粗壮的纤维盐腐木桩撑起这些卤水池，宣示此地无主。

src: Give her your parting words, utensil. Our hearts are in elsewhere.
zh: 给她你的临别之言吧，器具。我们的心在别处。

src: Give the crumpled sheet of paper to its author or intended recipient.
zh: 将揉皱的纸交还给作者或预定收件人。

src: Given the circumstances, this is a remarkable lack of destruction. Your defense of Grit Gate was first-class, =name=.
zh: 事已至此，毁损之轻，实属难得。你对砂砾门的保卫堪称一流，=name=。

src: Glass arches cut and fished from the trash sea have been paired by palette and cored into beads. They've been hung on a dried strand of goat gut and bartered up and down the River Svy.
zh: 从垃圾之海中捞出、切割而成的玻璃拱片，依色调配成对，钻成珠子，串在一股干羊肠线上，沿斯维河上下往来贩易。

src: Glass lunes refract light and paint images in fictive angular size.
zh: 玻璃弦月折射光线，以虚构的角径描绘影像。

src: Glass was blown into a machine artery and ion-colored to fluorescent green-yellow with uranium.
zh: 玻璃被吹成一条机器的动脉，又以铀离子着色成荧光的绿黄。
