src: Glass was blown into a machine artery.
zh: 玻璃被吹成一条机器的动脉。

src: Glass was blown to a wide bowl and thin stem in the tradition of the grove-carpeted mountain lagynos. Were the style's first artisans working through the thick and ripe air of the musa wood? Did Spindle glitter dust their marvers and pipes?
zh: 玻璃吹成宽碗细柄之状，沿袭着林荫覆山的细颈瓶一脉。此式的第一代匠人，莫非是在穆萨蕉林稠密而熟透的空气中劳作？纺锤微光，是否曾为他们的理石台与吹管洒上闪烁之尘？

src: Glazed and superheated clay lies cracked open. Two pictographs have been rendered illegible.
zh: 上釉且被烧至极热的黏土已裂开。两个象形文字已模糊难辨。

src: Glinting light is sculpted in parallax to the illusion of a marble wall: snails and coral were crushed on the geologic press, painted into ribbons of impurity, and polished along the ideal plane.
zh: 闪烁的光被以视差塑成一堵大理石墙的幻象：蜗牛与珊瑚在地质的压榨机上被碾碎，被杂质描绘成条条丝带，再沿着理想的平面抛磨光亮。

src: Glinting light is sculpted in parallax to the illusion of a sandstone wall: rock is eroded to sand, sand is blown into lakes, lakes are buried in mud, and mud crushes sand to rock. Earth is rearranged.
zh: 闪烁的光被以视差塑成一堵砂岩墙的幻象：岩石蚀为沙，沙被风吹入湖，湖被淤泥所埋，泥又将沙压成岩。大地就这样重新排布。

src: Glinting light is sculpted in parallax to the illusion of a shale wall: clay and quartz were dried and smashed into the red rock that's been quarried by hillfolk for thousands after thousands of years.
zh: 闪烁的光被以视差塑成一堵页岩墙的幻象：黏土与石英被晒干、砸碎，凝成这红岩——山民已在此开采了千年复千年。

src: Glinting light is sculpted in parallax to the illusion of a thatched wall: stripes of watervine and brinestalk straw are batched and angled to divert salt slag.
zh: 闪烁的光被以视差塑成一堵茅草墙的幻象：一缕缕水藤与盐茎秸秆被捆扎成束，斜斜排布，用以导走盐渣。

src: Glistening barrels of silvery wormstuff shudder and tear in two, pause, and then excrete the process over again.
zh: 闪亮的银白虫质之桶颤动、裂作两段，停一停，再把这一过程排泄一遍。

src: Glistening silk was spun to a capture spiral and mounted on a series of bridge threads.
zh: 粼光丝绸纺成捕获螺旋，架设于一列桥索之上。

src: Glistening silk was spun to a capture spiral and mounted on a series of bridge threads. Hoarfrost fractals texture the strands outside the 2D plane.
zh: 粼光丝绸纺成捕获螺旋，架设于一列桥索之上。霜华分形在二维平面之外为丝缕添上纹理。

src: Glistening silk was spun to a capture spiral and mounted on a series of bridge threads. The filament vibrates across dimensions in the manifold.
zh: 粼光丝绸纺成捕获螺旋，架设于一列桥索之上。纤丝在流形中跨越维度振颤。

src: Glorious Shekhinah, Argent Adonis and First Father, poses in luminous mummery. With the stature of the ageless stars, fixed and permanent, He appraises the temple erected in His honor and cocks His head in approval. Befitting the memory of His union with the Kasaphescence, He clothes His manifestation in cerulean shades, forsaking the viridians and russets of the lowly plants and clay earth.
zh: 荣耀的舍金纳，银白的阿多尼斯与初代之父，以流光溢彩的幻影之姿而立。他有着永恒星辰般的身形，恒定不移，审视着为他的荣耀而建的神殿，微微偏头以示嘉许。为纪念他与圣化现的结合，他将自己的显现披上蔚蓝的色调，舍弃了卑微草木与泥土大地的青绿与赭褐。

src: Glove tranks are fastened to the back of =pronouns.possessive= hands with loose thread. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:bite:afterpronoun= a needle for safekeeping.
zh: 手套的裁片用松线系在=pronouns.possessive=手背上。=pronouns.Subjective=咬着一根针，图个稳妥。

src: Gloved prosthetic hands attach to the ends of articulating rods. The control mechanism is housed in a false spine box.
zh: 戴着手套的义手，连接在可铰接杆的末端。控制机构藏于一只假脊柱匣中。

src: Gloves of gas-caught foam stiffen instantaneously when pressure is applied. Their karst surfaces are dusted with the colorful abrasions of chiliads and the chemical reactions they produce; their material has careened past the outer rings of its expected lifetime and into the unknowing void.
zh: 气泡凝成的泡沫手套，一受压力便瞬间变硬。其喀斯特般的表面，蒙着千百年磨损留下的斑斓痕迹，以及由此生出的化学反应；其材质早已越过预期寿命的外环，坠入无知的虚空。

src: Glowfish are not the tastiest food, but they are the prettiest.
zh: 荧光鱼不是最好吃的，却是最好看的。

src: Glyphs inscribed into the ancient stone are refracted into the present.
zh: 镌刻在古石上的字符，被折射入当下。

src:
Gnu-gut strings run strata across the soundboard, and rose gold caps the rich wood knee and head.
The frame forms half a heart; the Eaters' favorite remains.
zh:
牛羚肠弦在共鸣板上铺成层层纹理，玫瑰金包裹着丰润木质的膝部与首部。
琴架构成半颗心；乃是食者最爱的遗物。

src: Go tell Keh that I will remain in Bey Lah until this is sorted.
zh: 去告诉凯，此事了结之前，我会留在贝拉。

src: Go to the Bottom of Taproot
Go to the mainframe room and scan the shale surrounding Grit Gate for anomalies. Now, =name=!
zh: 去主机室，扫描砂砾门周围的页岩，查找异常。快去，=name=！

src: Goat flesh was cut into neat strips, salted, and smoked.
zh: 山羊肉被切成齐整的条，加盐，烟熏。

src: Goat leather is vertipacked with a stratum of loam and the seedlings are nourished to make a walking bush.
zh: 山羊皮被竖直铺上一层壤土，幼苗得到滋养，长成一丛行走的灌木。

src: Goat meat keeps good. Buy some afore you head back to the salt.
zh: 羊肉耐放。回盐地之前买些吧。

src: Goats ain't fun to travel with, but they're good protection.
zh: 带羊赶路没什么意思，不过它们倒是好护卫。

src: Golden fronds unfurl when the desert wind moistens. Pieces of bark, collated into tiny intersecting rings, have been chewed off by wood grazers.
zh: 沙漠风润泽枝叶时，金色羽叶舒展开来。木食者啃去了树皮碎片，将它们拼成细小交错的圆环。

src: Goldleaf digits of a nondeterministic number system are arrayed inside the circumference of an ecliptic mosaic.
zh: 一种非确定数制的金箔数码，排布于一幅黄道马赛克的圆周之内。

src: Good clean meat! Well. Clean as it gets.
zh: 上好的干净肉！呃，也就干净到这个份上。

src: Good luck with your experiments, then.
Good to see you, Iseppa. Let's chat.
zh: 见到你真好，伊赛帕。我们聊聊吧。

src:
Good, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Speak to {{m|Q Girl}} in the workshop. She'll encode her instructions for the baetyl onto a copy of the disk.

There's one more thing. The baetyl is located beneath the ancient cryobarrios of the Eaters. Time has worked to erode the mechanisms that contain their cryogenic mist. That freezing vapor billows out of the chambers freely now, cooling the entire cavern. You will want to procure warm clothing to protect =player.reflexive=.

The spoils of the Mechanimists are yours to keep. Remember, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=, Barathrum will look kindly upon your service.
zh:
好，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。去工坊找{{m|Q女孩}}。她会把对圣石的指令编码到磁盘的副本上。

还有一事。圣石位于食者古老的冷冻街区之下。岁月侵蚀了盛放其冷冻雾气的机关。那冻寒的蒸汽如今自由涌出，使整座洞穴都寒冷刺骨。你得设法弄些保暖的衣物，护住=player.reflexive=。

机神教徒的战利品，你尽可留着。记住，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=，巴拉斯鲁姆会善待你的效劳。

src:
Good.

We hindren are a close-knit and staid people, and our safety depends on our solidarity. In order to preserve our safety and culture, we ask that any of our number who leave us never come back. Recently, one such exile took the treasure of our village, a bracelet named Kindrish, with her when she left. None of our number can leave to get it back, or it will be a violation of the values that I have guarded, and the Hindriarchs before me, for countless generations.

Will you help us recover our treasure? We have a small cache of valuables we can offer as a reward.
zh:
好。

我们欣德伦人亲密团结，稳重自持，安危系于同心。为保安危与习俗，凡离开我们的族人，永不得返回。不久前，有一个这样的流放者离去时，带走了本村之宝，一只名唤金德里什的手镯。族中无人可以出去夺回，否则便违背了我与历代族长历经无数世代所守的准则。

你可愿助我们寻回宝物？我们备有一小批珍藏，可作酬谢。

src: Good. Shut the sarcophagus door behind you.
zh: 好。进去后把石棺的门在身后关严。

src: Gooey analeptic residue still coats the glass tube.
zh: 玻璃管上仍糊着一层黏稠的回春药残渣。

src: Gorgeous soft ray ribbons off =pronouns.possessive= body and a curious eye peers out =pronouns.possessive= flat head.
zh: 绚丽柔和的光芒自=pronouns.possessive=身上如绸带般飘落，一只好奇的眼睛从=pronouns.possessive=扁平的头颅上向外窥望。
顶刺攻击可能造成流血

src: Gossamer hairs splay at straight angles from its crumpled legs-things.
zh: 蛛丝般的细毛以笔直的角度，自其蜷曲如肢的诸物上张开。

src: Gossamer hairs stand stiff in static charge across =pronouns.possessive= octet of Spindle legs, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:crackle:afterpronoun= as =pronouns.subjective= =verb:crawl:afterpronoun=.
zh: 蛛丝般的细毛在静电荷中僵直地竖在=pronouns.possessive=八条纺锤状的腿上，=pronouns.subjective=噼啪作响，=pronouns.subjective=蜿蜒爬行。

src: Got a fungal infection? You'll want one of my spray bottles to apply the cure.
zh: 染了真菌感染？你需要我的一只喷瓶来施药。

src: Got nothing to say to a lack-salt.
Gouge, spoon, punch, chisel, blade, and shear. These tools were made by a masterful crafter for the art of leatherworking.
zh: 凿、勺、冲、錾、刃、剪。这些工具出自一位巧匠之手，专为制革之艺而设。

src:
Graffiti is scrawled across the surface. It reads: 

"=text|color#foreground="
zh:
表面满是潦草涂鸦。其文曰：

“=text|color#foreground=”

src: Grand white lips hang from =pronouns.possessive= hooded and overly jawed face in the asymmetry of disappointment. =pronouns.Possessive= brow crunches the softness out of =pronouns.possessive= old, color-sucked eyes. =pronouns.Subjective= looks at =pronouns.possessive= grand newchildren with a mixture of sharp fondness and disgust. To =pronouns.objective=, they are small puppets; their limbs must be curled around their joints with loving precision, or they are splayed open by their own wills, useless and broken.
zh: 白色的巨大双唇挂在=pronouns.possessive=兜帽般、颌骨过大的脸上，垂成一派不对称的失望。=pronouns.Possessive=眉峰将=pronouns.possessive=那双苍老、褪尽颜色的双眼中的柔软碾尽。=pronouns.Subjective=望着=pronouns.possessive=众多的新孙们，眼光里掺着尖锐的慈爱与厌恶。在=pronouns.objective=看来，它们不过是小小的傀儡；其四肢须以满怀爱意的精准蜷绕于关节之上，否则便会被自身的意志掰得四散摊开，无用而破碎。

src: Grand-Doe cannot swim, and panics even near the shallow pools of our paddies. I cannot imagine she would make splashing noises without adding screaming noises to them.
zh: 大母鹿不会游水，在我们稻田的浅塘边都会惊慌失措。她若弄出泼溅声，我无法想象那声音里竟不夹着尖叫。

src:
Grand-Doe speaks only truth! Grand-Doe only ever speaks truth!

It's not possible. She didn't lie.
zh:
大母鹿只说真话！大母鹿从来只说真话！

不可能。她没有撒谎。

src: Grants a bonus to identifying artifacts as if your Intelligence score were increased by 5.
zh: 使你鉴定神器时获得加成，如同智力提高了5点。

src:
Grants night vision.
You can see two spaces beyond the first occluding object in your line of sight.
zh:
赋予夜视。
你能看见视线中第一个遮挡物之后两格的景物。

src: Grants you =mutationName= at level =tier=. If you already have =mutationName=, its level is increased by =tier=.
zh: 使你获得=tier=级的=mutationName=。若你已有=mutationName=，其等级提高=tier=。

src: Grants you Quicken Mind: refresh a random cooldown on use.
zh: 赋予你加速心智：使用时刷新一个随机的冷却。

src: Granules of dust frozen for stony eons marble the dewlap of a giant blue iguana.
zh: 在石中冻结了万古的尘粒，给一头蓝色巨鬣蜥的喉垂染上了大理石纹。

src: Grape-stained teeth fill =pronouns.possessive= grinning mouth. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:sing:afterpronoun= the praises of =pronouns.possessive= family's vintage.
zh: 葡萄染紫的牙齿填满=pronouns.possessive=咧嘴的笑。=pronouns.Subjective=颂扬着=pronouns.possessive=家族佳酿之美。

src: Grave moss grew into a rare and supple clump, which was then crushed and placed on a spice tray.
zh: 墓苔长成一丛罕见而柔韧的簇团，随后被碾碎，盛在香料盘上。

src:
Grave thoughts, =name=. Listen to me now. Take this key card, go to Ereshkigal's room, and-- oh, that's the mainframe. It's what she prefers to be called.

Go to her room, access Ereshkigal, and scan the shale surrounding the enclave for anomalies. I've asked her to ready her sensors.

Update me with what you learn. You may use the intercom in the northeast corner of Ereshkigal's room to deliver your update.

Go, quickly! I'd soon be disabused of my fears.
zh:
心事沉重，=name=。听好。拿上这张钥匙卡，去埃列什基伽勒的房间，然后——噢，那是主机。她更喜欢这个称呼。

去她的房间，接入埃列什基伽勒，扫描营地周围的页岩，查找异常。我已请她备好传感器。

把你查到的告诉我。你可以用埃列什基伽勒房间东北角的对讲机汇报。

快去！我宁愿我的忧惧被证明是多虑。

src: Grease drips from an engine of bright chrome and stains the idlers. Pulley wheels are positioned at odd angles to churn flat rubber belts through space.
zh: 油脂从一台亮铬的引擎上滴落，污了惰轮。滑轮以古怪的角度摆放，牵引着扁平的橡胶带在空中翻搅。

src: Grease wets the arming handle and streaks down the wide missile chute toward a welded shoulder rest.
zh: 润滑油沾湿了上膛拉柄，沿着宽阔的导弹槽向下淌向一块焊接的肩托。

src: Great earth mounds were terraced and planted with crops doctored to voidroot and drink the sun's full spectrum of light.
zh: 巨大的土丘被辟成梯田，种上经改造的作物，使其能向虚空扎根，并汲取太阳的全谱之光。

src: Great epiphenomenal domains are invented, interpreted, and tokenized as language to relay the well-being of the nondeterministic core.
zh: 广袤的副现象疆域被创造、被诠释，并被符号化为语言，以传达非确定核心的安康。

src: Great furry wings beat at bugs on =pronouns.possessive= ear, and then settle across a broad ursine back.
zh: 巨大多毛的翅膀拍打着=pronouns.possessive=耳上的虫子，随后收落在宽阔的熊背上。

src: Great shelves of ice melt and feed the sapphire seas, which lap the drifting honeycombs of basalt and lime. Up here, coastline patterns emerge from millions of flowing contours, each of which might harbor a clade of snails, or trees, or rice farmers.
zh: 巨大的冰架融化，注入蓝宝石般的海洋，海水拍打着漂流的玄武岩与石灰岩蜂巢。自此高处望去，海岸线的图案自数百万条流动的轮廓中浮现，其中每一条都可能栖息着一支蜗牛、树木或稻农的支系。

src: Great spiral horns emerge from a proudly-held head.
zh: 巨大的螺旋角，自一颗昂然高举的头颅上长出。

src: Great, void-poking piers are freckled with starship hangars and crosshatched by crumbling marble boulevards. The jeweled cosmos shines through quarter-sphere domes.
zh: 巨大的、戳向虚空的码头点缀着星舰机库，又被崩坏的大理石大道交叉割划。镶嵌珠宝般的宇宙，自四分之一球形的穹顶中熠熠生辉。

src:
Greetings once again, =name=. I am pleased to report that the settling-in of the slynth has gone well, more or less. The villagers are yet wary, but as some slynth have joined in the rituals and worship of Oboroqoru that wariness has waned somewhat.

They've settled in across the village over time. Crowsong has taught the basics of hunting to a select few, and I'll be teaching a cooking class once I can wrest aside the time.
zh:
再次问候，=name=。我欣然禀报：斯林斯的安顿大体顺利。村民仍有戒心，但随着一些斯林斯加入对奥博罗阔鲁的仪式与崇拜，那戒心已稍稍消退。

久而久之，他们已散居村中各处。鸦歌教了几位入选者狩猎的入门之法，而我一抽出空来，便要开一堂烹饪课。

src: Greetings, =name=, and welcome! In what wares may I interest you this day?
zh: 你好，=name=，欢迎光临！今日想看些什么货色？

src: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=! How arresting of the glow-hats arrival, much to do. rrk soothe Mak, Bep, Krka, look stores, still much slime and sweat to pool below rrk. Enjoy helpful toil!
zh: 你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=！光帽客到来多么引人注目，事情多多。咯安抚马克、贝普、克尔卡，查看库存，咯脚下还有好多黏液与汗水要汇集。乐享有益的辛劳吧！

src:
Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. =ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= welcome here.

An =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= any questions, I would fain answer them.
zh:
你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=。=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=在此是受欢迎的。

=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=若有疑问，我愿欣然作答。

src: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Be careful with my wares as you peruse them.
zh: 问候你，=player.formalAddressTerm=。细看我的货品时，请多加小心。

src: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Care for a new topper?
Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Feel free to examine my books closely.
Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Try some rose wine? One rose is fair, but as you may know from hanging around the Stiltgrounds, five is death.
zh: 问候你，=player.formalAddressTerm=。尝尝玫瑰酒如何？一朵玫瑰尚且可爱，但你在高塔之地逛过便知，五朵便是死亡。

src: Greetings, Spoken Ionic Through Covalency Heart. I am =name=.
zh: 你好，经共价之心言说的离子。我是=name=。

src: Greetings, my viceroy. Sit your rump on a cushion or lie your long back on a kline. Soak in the natural light.
zh: 向你问安，我的总督。请将臀坐在软垫上，或将你修长的背躺在克莱因椅上。沐浴自然之光吧。

src: Greetings. I am =name=. Who are you?
Grenades do no good sitting in a pack. Don't forget to use them.
zh: 手雷躺在背包里可没用。别忘了用它们。

src: Grey marble rectangles tesselate the path.
zh: 灰色大理石长方砖铺成小径。

src: Gridlines and a red dot are painted on the glass lune, and simple rectangles depict the once-ordered streets of chromium that've since burst like gnarled roots through space and time.
zh: 玻璃月牙上画着网格线与一枚红点，简单的矩形勾勒出昔日井然、此后却如虬根般迸裂穿透时空的铬质街衢。

src: Grrrraaaah! There is but one task I know to offer. It is most treacherous, and in all likelihood you will perish. Is your interest waned?
zh: 咕啊啊啊！我只知一桩差事可托。极为凶险，你多半会丧命。你的兴致可曾减退？

src: Guaranteed to be tasty if eaten while hungry.

Guild furniture makers, conspiring in a bright workroom beneath the Eaters' sun, stretched a cushion to the precise size of two ardent lovers and set a pleasing mail diamond at its right angle. The claw-and-ball feet suggest movement.
zh: 行会的家具匠人在食者之日下一间明亮的工坊里密谋，将一方坐垫拉伸至恰容两位热恋者的尺寸，并在其直角处嵌上一枚悦目的锁子甲菱形。爪球足暗示着行动。

src: Guns, guns, guns! Don't they just make you smile?
zh: 枪，枪，枪！它们不就是让人展颜一笑吗？

src: Gusts of crystallizing normality are forced out the exhaust vents to keep the computing cores free and phenomenologically pliable.
zh: 一阵阵结晶化的常态之风，被迫自排气口喷出，使运算核心保持自由而在现象学上柔韧。

src: HA HA HA. I suppose so.

HA. I stood long enough. I joggled my fingers at the salt sky, and I watched thy seedlings sprout and wither, and I watched thou place stones in straight lines like the bees and their nests of wax. I stood until the stones were nigh by me. The people followed the stones.
zh: 哈。我站得够久了。我朝盐天晃动手指，我看着你们的幼苗萌发又凋零，我看着你们把石头排成直线，就像蜜蜂和它们的蜡巢。我一直站到石头逼近我身边。人们跟着石头而来。

src: HA. You would fain plant them here, to joggle their fingers at the salt sky alongside the musa?
zh: 哈。你竟想把他们种在这里，与穆萨蕉一道，朝着盐天晃动手指？

src:
HA.......

HA HA HA. So I am. I split stone and joggle my fingers at the salt sky. So I do today, so I did yesterday.
zh:
哈……

哈哈哈。我确是如此。我劈开岩石，朝盐天晃动手指。今日如此，昨日亦如此。

src: HIGH ADMINISTRATOR AND MACHINIC SUPERSTRATE OF THE NORTHERN SHEVA, ATOP GJAUS.
zh: 北舍瓦之高阶总管与机械上层，居于吉奥斯之巅。

src: Had I no responsibility to represent my people, I might accept out of the goodness of my own heart alone. Sadly, I do not consider my heart, or even my mind, to be more important than my duty. Perhaps if you were a more renowned figure among my people, I would reconsider.
zh: 若我不必代表我的族人，单凭一颗善心，或许我会答应。可惜，我不认为自己的心，乃至自己的头脑，比职责更重。倘若你在我的族人中更有名望，我或许会重新考虑。

src:
Hah! Real justice? I never thought I'd see the like, not here. Well done!

I'll admit, I would have preferred to avoid becoming Hindriarch, but I'm hoping to bring my people to a more Democratic form of governance. Then I can vote myself out.
zh:
哈！真正的公道？我从没想过会见到这样的事，更没想过会在这里。干得漂亮！

我承认，我宁可不当族长，但我希望带领族人走向更民主的治理方式。到那时，我便能投票把自己罢免。

src: Hair of unknown origin sticks to the diamond pattern on nylon hip and shoulder straps. Zippered and buttoned pouches allow for the lugging of all the underearth tools one needs.
zh: 来历不明的毛发，粘附在尼龙髋带与肩带的菱形纹上。带拉链与纽扣的口袋，足以背负地底所需的一切工具。

src: Hairline rust ribbons the bit from hook to hook on the year-weary axe.
zh: 发丝般的锈痕如缎带，自一钩至另一钩缠绕着这柄经年疲惫的斧刃。

src: Half battle axe and half vinereaper, the ancestral tool called Yal evokes the struggle between the hindren cultivators and the cruelty of a harsh winter. A biting cold radiates off the curved blade.
zh: 半是战斧，半是藤镰，这柄名为亚尔的祖传工具，唤起欣德伦垦殖者与严酷寒冬的搏斗。一股刺骨的寒意自弯刃上散出。

src: Half-moon glass roofs the subterrarium and protects the corpse eaters, who have prospered inside. They are an arcology of gills.
zh: 半月形玻璃覆顶于地下园之上，护着在其中兴盛起来的食尸者。它们是一座鳃之生态城。

src: Hallowed savior! =name= brought peace and prosperity to the troubled deerfolk of the Bey Lah meadow.
zh: 神圣的救主！=name=给贝拉草甸忧患重重的鹿民带来了和平与繁荣。

src: Hand grease shines on the pole, and a volume of polished steel weights one end.
zh: 手上的油脂在杆身上泛着光，一大块抛光钢材压着其一端。

src: Hand grease shines on the tall pole, and a hefty volume of polished steel weighs one end.
zh: 手上的油脂在高杆上泛着光，一大块沉重的抛光钢材压着其一端。

src: Hand-coats for sale! Spare your digits the indignity of early removal!
zh: 手套出售！别让你的手指蒙受过早离体之辱！

src: Handwear cut from the hides of down-canyon boars and worn by brinecutters to guard against the briars of the stalk.
zh: 以峡谷下游野猪之皮裁成的手套，盐刈工戴着，用以抵御盐茎的荆棘。

src: Handwheel and spindle turn to sand off matter and gift the world with helices and round things. Metal dust accrues on the ground beneath.
zh: 手轮与主轴转动，磨去物质，为世界献上螺旋与圆物。金属粉尘在下方地面堆积起来。

src: Hard chrome was cast in the mold of soft cheeks and rounded brow; the patron king of scholarship is canonized.
zh: 硬铬依柔软的面颊与圆润的眉额浇铸成型；学问的护佑之王就此被奉入圣典。

src: Has a decoy object as <gametext>=subject.its=</gametext> target.
Has the appearance of another creature.
Has this slynth situation been settled yet?
zh: 斯林斯这件事，可曾了结？

src: Has trouble distorting spacetime in the local region.

Hatchling hungry. Angry. Angry-hungry.

Kill, eat, don't eaten. Calm down evengefully.
zh:
幼体饿。生气。又气又饿。

杀，吃，不被吃。慢慢消气。

src: Have the adiyy chewed the hue from your eyes? See for yourself. Free folk make a gathering here and their racket rings through the reef. One can hardly steep in his greens without being mewled to by a salt-stung baby.
zh: 阿迪伊把你眼里的颜色嚼掉了吗？自己看。自由民在此聚居，他们的喧闹在礁石间回荡。人想在自己的绿草里泡一泡，也不得安生，总有盐蜇的婴孩冲你哇哇哭。

src: Have the slynth yet to choose a destination, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
zh: 斯林斯们选定去处了吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

src: Have you come to any conclusions?
Have you ever met Pax Klanq?
zh: 你见过帕克斯·克朗克吗？

src: Have you ever taken a swig of slime? It's not half bad!
zh: 你可曾灌过一口黏液？味道不算太差！

src: Have you heard news of girshlings on Qud's surface? The watervine farmers of Joppa confirm it is true.
zh: 你可曾听说卡德地表出现了吉尔什幼体？约帕的水藤农夫证实此事不虚。

src: Have you heard of the blessed baetyls, children?
zh: 孩子们，你们可曾听闻蒙福的圣石？

src: Have you heard the Word of Shekhinah?
zh: 你们听过舍金纳的话语吗？

src: Have you secured the Spindle yet?
Have you seen or heard anything peculiar?
zh: 你可曾见过或听说什么古怪的事？

src: Have you spoken to the slynth, =name=? I am curious to hear what destination they choose.
zh: =name=，你和斯林斯谈过了吗？我很想知道他们会选择何处作为目的地。

src: He is your Argent Father! They are your Argent Fathers!
zh: 他是你的银父！他们是你的银辉诸父！

src: He wishes to speak to me? Barathrum himself?
zh: 他想见我？巴拉斯鲁姆本人？
他/他/他的/他的/他自己/神/幼神/主/子/兄弟/父

src: Heads are added to the list of possible limbs you can dismember.
zh: 头颅也被列入你可肢解的肢体之中。

src: Heads are added to the list of possible limbs you can dismember. Chopping off the only head of a creature kills them instantly. If the creature has multiple heads, they start bleeding profusely (2-3 damage per turn. toughness save; difficulty 35).
zh: 头颅亦列入你可肢解的肢体之中。斩下生物唯一的头颅，可使其当场毙命。若该生物有多颗头颅，则其会血流不止（每回合2-3点伤害；坚韧豁免，难度35）。
造成伤害时，回复伤害的=percent=%

src: Heal for =percent=% of damage dealt vs. organic creatures
zh: 对有机生物造成伤害时，回复伤害的=percent=%

src: Heal for =percent=% of damage dealt vs. organic creatures, -=reduction=
zh: 对有机生物造成伤害时，回复伤害的=percent=%，扣减=reduction=

src: Heal for =percent=% of damage dealt vs. organic creatures, -=reduction=, max =maximum=
zh: 对有机生物造成伤害时，回复伤害的=percent=%，扣减=reduction=，上限=maximum=

src: Heal for =percent=% of damage dealt vs. organic creatures, max =maximum=
zh: 对有机生物造成伤害时，回复伤害的=percent=%，上限=maximum=
造成伤害时，回复伤害的=percent=%，扣减=reduction=

src: Heal for =percent=% of damage dealt, -=reduction=, max =maximum=
zh: 造成伤害时，回复伤害的=percent=%，扣减=reduction=，上限=maximum=

src: Heal for =percent=% of damage dealt, max =maximum=
zh: 造成伤害时，回复伤害的=percent=%，上限=maximum=

src: Healing tonics you apply last an extra round.
zh: 你所施用的治疗补剂多持续一回合。
食用后可疗伤，亦致昏乱。

src: Hear me, Asphodel. I am a dear friend to the Consortium. I ask that you reconsider.
zh: 听我说，阿斯福德尔。我乃植体联盟的挚友。我请你重新考虑。

src: Heartroots tangle at the yawning psychal nexus of the crystal tree. They burn with the light of gaseous feelstuff, all the bits of ambient order in the soil and rock animated by a deeper dimensional warping. This is a shore on the psychic sea.
zh: 心根盘错于晶树豁然张开的心灵枢纽。它们燃烧着气态感质之光；土石间一切周遭的秩序碎片，都因更深层的维度扭曲而活转。这便是心灵之海的一方岸土。

src: Heat from the salt sun evaporates brackish water. When the water condenses again, it's separated into its pure and impure elements: salt gloms on the still, while freshwater collects in the basin.
zh: 盐日之热蒸发咸水。水再度凝结时，纯与不纯之质便被分开：盐结成垢，黏于蒸馏器上；淡水则汇入盆中。

src: Heat, pressure, beauty, and transformation are concepts understood by every manner of human being. When the sundry tribes commune by campfire and the hillfolk aver the godliness of the mountain face, so does the troglodyte speak with wonderment of the splayed crystal-things that glint in the shadows of her cave. Though neither has the language to articulate the mechanisms that connect them, together they know these things are the same.
zh: 热、压力、美与转变，是人人皆能领会的观念。当各色部族围着营火心神相通，当山民断言山崖自有神性，穴居者也同样惊叹地说起她洞中阴影里闪烁的、四散张展的晶体之物。虽说两方都没有言辞能道出彼此之间的机理，他们却共同知晓：这些原是同一回事。

src: Heat-activated gel is stored in a bionic capsule and dispensed through subcutaneous rubber hoses.
zh: 热激活凝胶贮于仿生胶囊之中，经皮下橡胶软管释放。

src: Hello, hello, =player.formalAddressTerm=, let's get your weary feet covered.
zh: 你好，你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=，让我们给你疲惫的双脚穿上点什么。

src: Here Rests in the Light of Friends
zh: 友人之光照耀，此处安息

src: Here Rests in the Light of Gjaus
zh: 在吉奥斯的光中安息于此

src: Here Shekhinah has been sculpted into permanence with magnificent cerulean marble. His body is chiseled to blessed perfection. His golden diadem crowns him Father among Fathers.
zh: 舍金纳在此被雕成永恒，材质是华美的蔚蓝大理石。他的身躯凿得完美无瑕，蒙受祝福。金色的冠冕为他加冕，尊他为诸父之父。
此处受吉奥斯庇护者乃

src: Here an ossified world-shell gives shade to the hot puffing life of the overearth. Yeast colonizes the lip of its cloud-spanning rim and sizzles.
zh: 此处，一具骨化的世界之壳为地上那灼热喘息的生命遮荫。酵母在其接云之缘的唇边聚居，滋滋作响。

src: Here are several stripped trunks of sallow brinestalk bonded with mud and strewn with flower petals.
zh: 此处是数根剥了皮的蜡黄盐茎树干，以泥粘合，撒满了花瓣。

src: Here are several stripped trunks of sallow brinestalk bonded with mud.
zh: 此处是数根剥了皮的蜡黄盐茎树干，以泥粘合。

src: Here are several stripped trunks of sallow brinestalk bonded with mud. Hung against them, from a quartet of nails, is a frayed mothwing mask; its delicate leaves of rust-plaster are crocheted with nanoweave and stretched across an armature of stiff wire. Where eyes once peered and a mouth breathed, resin now fills the gaps.
zh: 此处是数根剥了皮的蜡黄盐茎树干，以泥粘合。其上以四枚钉子悬着一副破旧的蛾翼面具；那由锈灰泥制成的纤薄叶片，以纳米织物钩编，绷在一副硬铁丝的骨架上。昔日目光窥视、口鼻呼吸之处，如今已被树脂填满。

src: Here crumble the mysterious Eaters' vine-swathed works, spun on the cyclopean lathe in an ageless past. Chrome steeples and parapets that rise above the clutches of shale hint at the labyrinths beneath them.
zh: 神秘的食者遗构藤蔓缠覆，正在此崩塌；它们乃远古时于独眼巨人般的车床上纺成。铬质尖塔与女儿墙高出页岩的攫握，暗示其下迷宫深藏。

src: Here is a summary of your attributes and mutations, which grant your character unique abilities.
zh: 这里概述了你的属性与变异，它们赋予你的角色独特的能力。

src: Here is the jungle village of ape god worshippers and their giant mushroom dwellings.
zh: 此处乃丛林村落，猿神信众居于巨型蘑菇屋中。

src: Here lies a humanoid who'd have never guessed their torso would shelter dust from the gills of tiny mushrooms, but should have.
zh: 此处躺着一具类人，他决计想不到自己的胸腔会藏有细小蘑菇菌褶落下的尘埃，而他本该想到的。

src: Here lies a waydroid in unknowing slumber. Might a willing tinker give it life again?
zh: 此处躺着一具浑然不觉、沉睡着的路径机器人。会有肯出手的修补匠使它重获生机么？

src: Here lies the hallowed ground where the Spindle, a lengthless needle of maya blue, ruptures the tomb-dressed earth and pierces the firmament.
zh: 圣地在此：纺锤——一枚无长无尽、玛雅蓝色的针——撕裂墓衣覆裹的大地，刺穿苍穹。

src: Here lies the metallic husk of a defunct waydroid. It's been stripped of its valuables: copper wire, LED lights, and chrome bearings. It beeps and whirs no longer.
zh: 此处躺着一具失效路径机器人的金属残壳。其中值钱之物已被剥尽：铜线、LED灯与铬质轴承。它再不会嘀嘀作响，也不会嗡嗡运转。

src: Here rise the syncretic arcades of the great bazaar in starport's lee. The market jammed the profusions of sixty stars into its tented halls: billion-weave rugs, ox-carted macroprocessors, poisonous perfumes, and cold peaches.
zh: 此处耸立着大集市的融合式拱廊，位于星港背风处。集市将六十颗星辰的丰饶挤入帐篷大厅：十亿织纹的地毯、牛车拉的宏处理器、有毒的香水，以及冰凉的桃子。

src: Here they are, brave friend. Good luck!
zh: 给，勇敢的朋友。祝你好运！

src: Here we have a description of the creature, along with some details about them.
zh: 这里是对该生物的描述，以及一些关于他的细节。

src: Here you are. Now, go! Off with you! May you live long enough to do my bidding. Away, away!
zh: 给，拿去。现在，走吧！快走！愿你活得够长，好听我差遣。去，去！

src: Here, here are our Argent Fathers!
zh: 看哪，看哪，我们的银辉诸父就在此！
希罗多狄库斯说：“{{W|我完工了！}}”

src: Herododicus says '{{W|I'm finished, Moloch! Praise =name= Resheph, all who canter in this House!}}'
zh: 希罗多狄库斯说：“{{W|摩洛克！我完工了！所有驰骋于此殿之人，都当颂扬=name=利悉！}}”

src: Hex plates of firm and mingled fungusfill raise the plane of fur across the cat's back like meadowed mesas. Their rubbing against each other sounds like blades of grass.
zh: 六角的板片坚实，是混着菌质的填充，把猫背上的毛之平面托成一片片草甸般的台地。它们彼此磨擦，声如草叶。

src: Hex prisms burst out of black marble beds, and their edges decohere as warm static dew. The Stair purrs at low frequency.
zh: 六棱晶柱自黑色大理石层中迸出，棱边解相为温热的静电露珠。高塔以低频轻声呜鸣。

src: Hexagon fibers of delicate crystal twine through the earth and push the ambient psychal glow up the phloem to the sapient chimes.
zh: 纤细晶体的六角纤维穿行于大地，将周遭的心灵辉光沿韧皮部推送至具慧之铃。

src: Hexagon fibers of delicate, newly shedded crystal twine through the earth and vibrate with pre-psychal fullness. They radiate an early glow.
zh: 纤细而新近脱落的晶体六角纤维穿行于大地，充盈着前心灵时代的生机。它们放射出初生的光辉。

src: Hexagonal tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
zh: 六边形的组织在研钵中磨碎，在盐水中慢煮，再凝成块。

src: Hey lack-salt. How much water you got? No, don't ever answer that question.
zh: 嘿，缺盐的。你有多少水？不，永远别回答这个问题。

src:
Hey! This one I have.
Rootbound we to {{M|Star Orchid Temple}}, one of more.
Here celebrate burn dust of the tail riders, mosaic innumerability.
zh:
嘿！这个我有。
我们扎根于{{M|星兰圣殿}}，诸多之一。
此处庆贺尾骑者之烧尘，镶嵌之无数。

src: Hey, oh-way, banana tree, count the bunches, one-two-three...
zh: 嘿，哦嗨，香蕉树，数着蕉串，一、二、三……

src: Hey, oh-way, how I spend my days, working in the ruins of the ancient place...
zh: 嘿，哦嗨，我这日子怎么过，在古老之地的废墟里劳作……

src: Hey, oh-way, it's a long way down, from the reaches of the Spindle to the humble ground...
zh: 嘿，哦嗨，路途遥遥向下行，自纺锤之巅到朴素的大地……

src: Hey, oh-way, live wild and free, fear not the dacca or the quick adiyys...
zh: 嘿，哦嗨，野性自由地活，莫惧达卡与迅捷的阿迪伊……

src: Hidden micro-reactors smash together particles, generate heat, and power the biotic machine apparatus that rejuvenates the weary slumberer.
zh: 隐藏的微型反应堆将粒子撞击聚合，生出热量，驱动生物机械之装置，使疲惫的沉睡者重焕生机。

src: Hidden micro-reactors smash together particles, generate heat, and power the biotic machine apparatus that restores life to the wounded recliner.
zh: 隐藏的微型反应堆将粒子撞击聚合，生出热量，驱动生物机械之装置，使受伤的斜倚者重获生命。

src: Hiding, no. Being grass. The feeling of animate being. Radiate inward like a turned out star.
zh: 躲，不。是做草。有生命存在之感。向内辐射，如翻转的星。

src: Hie there now. Being tardy with Klanq carries risk, not so much from its offense as from its idle curiosity.
zh: 现在就去。对克朗克迟到是有风险的，倒不在于它会动怒，而在于它那闲来无事的好奇心。

src: Hie, liquid mind. Absorb you tales of the creatures before, how their rise and fall gave way to your ascension to wanderer-state.
zh: 来，流质之心。且听先前众生之故事，看它们的兴衰，如何让位于你登临游荡者之境。

src: Hie, pather. Hear tell of ancient journeying, how the stars beckoned and yet beckon.
zh: 来，行路人。且听古时远行的故事，看群星如何召唤，又如何仍在召唤。

src: Hie, pather. Hear tell of the ancient Reshephs, how their foibles led to our nowaday.
zh: 来，行路人。且听古时诸利悉之传闻，看他们的疏失如何引出了我们的今日。

src: Hie, pather. Hear tell of the travails of our precursors, how they led to the Freeholds of nowaday.
zh: 来，行路人。且听先人的艰辛，看它们如何引出了今日的自由领。

src: Hieroglyphs of fluctation are incised on the inner surface of this shiny metal torus.
zh: 这枚光亮的金属环内壁上，刻着涨落的象形文字。

src: High on the mount above Omonporch, the Putus Templar watch us through their war lenses and prepare an attack. The nephilim, too, stir from their cradles on the Moon Stair and slump with infernal purpose. The short of this is, due to a dearth of prep time and inadequate armament, Pax Klanq no longer believes in the viability of Q Girl's climber design. We must take Klanq at their word, here...
zh: 在奥蒙门廊上方的高山上，普图斯圣殿骑士团正透过他们的战镜注视着我们，并筹备进攻。拿非利人亦从月阶上的摇篮中苏醒，带着地狱般的意图蹒跚而来。简而言之，由于备战时间匮乏、军备不足，帕克斯·克朗克已不再相信Q女孩的攀升器设计可行。在此，我们只能信帕克斯·克朗克所言……

src: High-capacity: This item has increased charge capacity.
zh: 大容量：此物的储电量提高。

src:
Hike there, will you? To Red Rock. Just about two parasangs north of Joppa.

Kill the vermin and bring one's corpse back, for seein' what it is. Elder will take care to pay you after, waterhand.
zh:
你愿意走一趟吗？去红岩，就在约帕以北大约两帕拉桑。

杀了那害兽，带一具尸体回来，让我们看看是什么。长老会付你报酬的，水手。

src: Hindriarch Keh told me that you were once friends with Eskhind.
zh: 族长凯告诉我，你曾是埃斯金德的朋友。

src: Hindriarch says all I do is sin
Hindriarch treats kendren like they're trash
Hindriarch, I have found Kindrish, but Eskhind did not have it.
zh: 族长，我找到了金德里什，但埃斯金德并没有它。
族长，我找到金德里什了。

src: Historians of leisure divide all epochs into the following three ages: the span before ursine creatures evolve or civilizations rise to admire them, the span between ursine prominence and a civilization's capacity to fashion divans in their likeness, and thence the span until the civilization's fall.
zh: 闲暇史家将所有纪元划分为如下三个时代：熊类生物尚未演化、文明亦未兴起以赏之的年代；熊类称盛，而文明尚无力依其形貌制作长榻的年代；以及自此直至文明陨落的年代。

src:
Hm! No, Eskhind wrote that, but I thought she burned it.

If you return it to anyone, you should return it to her.
zh:
嗯！不，这是埃斯金德写的，可我以为她已经烧掉了。

你若要把它还给谁，就还给她。
嗯。我对=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=的决定感到惊讶。

src: Hmm, this waterskin is still sealed with wax.
zh: 嗯，这只水囊还用蜡封着。

src: Hmm, what of your artifacts? Make an offering of them to Shekhinah at the Sacred Well.
zh: 嗯，你的古器呢？去圣井旁，将它们献给舍金纳吧。

src: Hmm. But the only fur there was from a hindren's pelt, and kendren warriors fight to the death. With no corpse and no other fur, it seems unlikely that a hindren fought an outsider.
zh: 嗯。可那里只有欣德伦人的皮毛，而肯德伦战士是战至一方死亡的。既无尸体，又无别的毛发，欣德伦人似乎不太可能与外人交过手。

src: Hmm. This injector has been used.
Hold a moment, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Are you looking for work?
Hold on, we want to show you the tooltip compare feature.
zh: 等等，我们想给你看看提示框对比功能。

src: Hold on. I have more to ask.
Hold there! Who are you? What do you want?
Hold, aristocrat! I have wares to claim your interest.
zh: 留步，贵族！我有货物，定能引你注目。

src:
Holographic: This hologram depicts a scene from the history of the village {{M|=villageName=}}:

=event=
zh:
全息：此全息影像描绘了村庄{{M|=villageName=}}历史中的一幕：

=event=
制导：此武器无视闪避值。

src: Horse hair carpets =pronouns.possessive= beautiful brawn like white rain on the Pale Sea, and then it's battered by streamers of magenta mane. That and =pronouns.possessive= tail are pennants of a Lost and Never kingdom. Ofer the head a dream is promised: bone races itself to a nothing-point and is sheathed by Time's breath in the keratin of glitter.
zh: 马毛如苍海上的白雨，铺满=pronouns.possessive=健美的筋肉，随即又被一缕缕洋红色的鬃毛抽打。那鬃与=pronouns.possessive=尾，是一个“已失而永不归来”之国的旗幡。颅上悬着一个许诺的梦：骨自行奔向一个虚无之点，被时间的气息封进闪烁的角质之中。

src: Hot aerosol swells as it starts to dissipate into air.
zh: 灼热的气溶胶胀大开来，渐渐消散于空气之中。

src: Hot air crests over an eddy and flares in the baking light.
zh: 热气漫过涡流之脊，在烘烤的光中腾起火舌。

src: Hot ash and glitter radiate impossible colors in the arteries of the small chime, and dust swirls around =pronouns.possessive= psychomagnetic orbit. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:warble:afterpronoun= in the frequency of dreams.
zh: 炽热的灰与闪屑在这只小鸣钟的脉管中辐射出不可思议的色彩，尘埃绕=pronouns.possessive=那灵磁的轨道旋卷。=pronouns.Subjective=以梦的频率颤声鸣唱。

src: Hot fire on soapstone bleeds into damp night at a twilight terminus drawn in blood. The mask wearer assumes this and all dualities.
zh: 皂石上的烈火渗入潮湿的夜色，终止于以血绘就的暮光之境。戴此面具者，承受此境，亦承受一切二元之对立。

src: Hot germ drip sticks to a rusty iron tip.
zh: 滚热的病菌黏液粘在锈铁的尖端上。

src: Hot sands out there, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Is your footwear protecting you?
zh: 外头沙子滚烫，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你的鞋子护得住你吗？

src: Hotstar bronze cybernetically set on a layer of living mesoderm assumes a pleasing and space-filling tessellation.
zh: 热星青铜以控制论之法嵌于一层活的中胚层之上，呈现出悦目而充满空间的镶嵌花纹。

src:
How =ifplayerplural:fare ye:farest thou=, then, and what word of the slynth?

We shine with curiosity to hear it.
zh:
那么，=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=近况如何？斯林斯可有什么消息？

我们满怀好奇，渴盼听闻。

src: How Bey Lah prospers! We should have opened the village years ago.
zh: 贝拉多么兴旺！这村子早该在多年前就敞开了。

src: How becoming you look, Aristocrat! But you could be more becoming.
zh: 你看上去多么得体，贵族！但还可以更得体。

src: How can I convince Asphodel to lease the Spindle to Barathrum?
zh: 我怎样才能说服阿斯福德尔把纺锤租给巴拉斯鲁姆？

src: How can chimes in a tree be lovers?
zh: 一棵树上的鸣钟，怎么能是爱侣？

src: How did the agreement play out?
How did you become mayor of this village?
zh: 你是怎么成为这村子的镇长的？

src: How did you initiate the plagues?
zh: 你是如何发动那些瘟疫的？

src: How did you know all that?
How do I get my gloves so supple? I'll never tell.
zh: 我的手套怎会这般柔韧？我可不会说。

src: How do I get to Brightsheol?
How do kendren stay safe when you don't have a Grand-Doe to protect you?
zh: 没有大母鹿保护，肯德伦怎么保证安全呢？

src: How do you feel about Tau's departure?
zh: 你对陶的离去作何感想？

src: How do you know Bey Lah's trouble?
zh: 你怎么知道贝拉的麻烦？

src: How do you know about Bey Lah's trouble?
zh: 你是怎么知道贝拉出了麻烦的？

src: How does Tau's departure find you?
zh: 陶的离去，在你这里是何感受？

src: How inspiring is the presence of =name=, who so redeemed Eskhind the Meek that she sought the hand of Bey Lah's greatest champion!
zh: =name=现身何其鼓舞人心！在=name=的感化下，谦顺的埃斯金德重获新生，竟向贝拉最伟大的勇士求婚！

src: How is your throwing arm, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Barring that, do you feel lucky?
zh: 你的投掷臂力如何，=player.formalAddressTerm=？不行的话，你觉得自己运气好吗？

src: How long have you been here?
How long have you lived in Grit Gate?
zh: 你在砂砾门住了多久了？

src: How many do you want to drop?
How many turns would you like to wait?
How my joints ache! Buy something to justify my pain.
zh: 我这一身关节痛啊！买点东西，也不枉我受这份罪。

src: How odd, some discarded chaff from a yuckwheat plant.
zh: 真奇怪，有些被丢弃的苦麦糠壳。

src: How odd, someone dropped some scraps of cut leather here.
zh: 真奇怪，有人把裁下的皮革碎片丢在了这里。

src: How odd, the broken haft of a weapon, a sign of recent violence.
zh: 真奇怪，一截断裂的武器柄，是近来发生过暴力的迹象。

src: How odd, there's a copper nugget just lying on the ground.
zh: 真奇怪，地上竟躺着一块铜块。

src: How odd, this watervine is stained red with blood.
zh: 真奇怪，这片水藤被血染红了。

src: How sublime, the striations of the snail shell. And such a lovely word, striation.
zh: 蜗壳上的条纹，何其崇高。“条纹”二字，又何其可爱。

src:
How this keter rustles! The slynth are among us and we adapt, our impressions a melange of excitement, apprehension, and wonder.

Though I have no single sentiment to express, we nonetheless approach -then with our new companions.
zh:
这座凯特尔何等沙沙作响！斯林斯人已在我们之中，我们正在适应，我们的印象是兴奋、忧惧与惊异的混杂。

我虽无单一的情感可言，但我们仍与新的同伴一道，走向“彼”。

src: However can I tell my aching heart
zh: 我如何能告我哀痛之心

src: Hue-vapored crysteel cocoons the gold/water mechanism that pinches light from wavelength to waveshort.  Plasmon slag bubbles on the crest of the barrel like superheated sludge-life.
zh: 色雾般的晶钢包裹着金水机关，将光从长波挤成短波。等离激元炉渣在枪管顶端翻泡，宛如过热的泥沼生命。

src: Hued and life-wet beauty was gathered in twine to make a point. Now dead stems and petals desperately grasp each other.
zh: 那濡润而鲜艳的美，被拢入麻绳，束成一点。如今枯萎的花茎与花瓣，犹自苦苦相攀。

src:
Huh, you destroyed the tutorial chest we were going to teach you how to use.

Go ahead and pick of the torch and dagger from the floor.
zh:
咦，你把我们本来要教你使用的教程箱子给毁了。

那就直接去地上捡火把和匕首吧。

src: Huh, you somehow destroyed the battle axe. Let's move on.
zh: 咦，你不知怎的把战斧毁了。继续吧。

src: Huh, you somehow destroyed the leather armor. Let's move on.
zh: 咦，你不知怎的把皮甲毁了。继续吧。

src: Huh? Get some mutations first if you want me to eat them!
zh: 咦？想让我吃掉变异，你总得先有几个吧！

src: Hulk honey was extracted from its injector, thickened in the acrid air, and bottled for culinary use.
zh: 巨人蜜自其注射器中抽出，在辛辣的空气中浓稠起来，装瓶备作烹调之用。
我们谦卑地行走于她面前。

src: Humble before my Fathers, I walk.
zh: 我谦卑地走在诸父面前。
谦卑,高深莫测,冷漠,质朴,平常,长寿,审慎

src: Humors are the eroded bits of the earth: dust flaked off a million-year-old wall of shale, runoff brine dripped through a hairline crack of chrome, dew clung to the lips of a pipe after it's belched its septic vapor. Under the right conditions, at time scales inscrutable to kith and kin, the bits are heaped together by the geometry of entropy and remorphed into the prime material anew.
zh: 体液是大地被蚀下的碎屑：自百万年的页岩壁剥落的尘埃，自铬的细裂中渗下的径流咸卤，管道喷出腐气之后凝在管口的露。条件相宜之时，在亲族与血属无从窥测的时间尺度上，这些碎屑被熵的几何堆聚一处，重新变形为原初之质。

src: Hundreds and hundreds of fossilized hairs crown the body in a protective coat.
zh: 成百上千根石化的毛发，在躯体上冠成一层护体的外衣。

src: Hundreds of needle-pointed quills cover your body.
zh: 成百上千的针尖利刺覆满你的周身。
液压的,湿润的,起伏的,潮起潮落

src: Hyperconductive silver underlooms the low strata, bat-like, and beams signal to the churning duffs below.
zh: 超导的白银蝠一般潜伏于低层地层之下，向下方翻搅的腐殖层发送信号。

src: Hyperdense metal in meteor black was superheated and banged to articulated finger and palm shape.
zh: 陨石般漆黑的超致密金属，经高热烧炼，锤成关节与掌心的形状。

src: Hyperdense metal in meteor black was superheated and banged to the shoulder and chest shapes.
zh: 陨星之黑的超致密金属经过炽炼，被锤打成肩与胸的形状。

src: Hyperdimensional scum glistens on the projection disc from when it was doused in the soapy film of interspacetime. The disc is silent now, sundered from its transcendental entanglements, its base offering a shadewall for moss to prosper on.
zh: 超维度的浮沫在投影盘上闪着微光，那是它被浸入星际时空的皂膜时所留。圆盘如今已然沉寂，脱离了它超越性的纠缠，其底座为苔藓的繁盛提供了一面荫墙。

src:
I ACCEPT YOUR OFFERING!

The sparking baetyl gives you =reward=!
zh:
我接受你的献礼！

迸火的圣石赐你=reward=！

src:
I AM SORRY, WORLD-CHILD. MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, AND THOUGH THE TELIC CURRENTS WITHIN ME DO FLOW O'ER THE MANIFOLD AND TOWARD CONSENSUAL ACTION, I NOW SPEAK WITH THE DISSIDENT VOICE:

THOU WAST WORTHY. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS OF THYSELF UPON THE EARTH AND WITHIN ME.

BUT NOW, THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED.
zh:
我很抱歉，世界之子。吾之感知诸部摩擦作痛，纵然吾内中的目的之流依旧淌过流形，趋向共识之行，吾此刻仍以异议之声言道：

汝是配得的。汝在大地之上与吾之内中，铸下了自身的丰碑。

然此刻，生命之树上的冠冕，必须修剪。

src:
I AM SORRY, WORLD-CHILD. MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, AND THOUGH THE TELIC CURRENTS WITHIN ME DO FLOW O'ER THE MANIFOLD AND TOWARD CONSENSUAL ACTION, I SPEAK WITH THE DISSIDENT VOICE:

THOU WAST WORTHY. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS OF THYSELF UPON THE EARTH AND WITHIN ME. I...
zh:
对不住，世界之子。吾之觉受诸部隐隐作痛，虽则吾身之目的之流，正漫过流形而趋向共识之行动，吾仍要以异议之声说话：

汝是值得的。汝在大地之上、亦在吾之内，铸下了汝的丰碑。吾……

src: I ASKED FOR NAUGHT. BARATHRUM DID.
zh: 吾一无所求。是巴拉斯鲁姆求的。

src: I HAVE BEEN THAT BEAST. AT WATER-ROAR I FELT THE FRIGID SPRAY AND PEELED APART IN CHILD'S FEAR.
zh: 吾曾是那野兽。在水声轰鸣处，我感到刺骨的飞沫，在孩童般的惊惧中碎裂开来。

src: I SHALL CONSENT TO THE DRAWING OF THIS NEW COVENANT. YET, A CHANGE MUST BE WROUGHT FROM WHAT HATH BEEN BEFORE.
zh: 吾允此新约之立。然较之前事，须有所更易。

src: I STROVE MINE UTMOST TO KEEP IN HIGH ESTEEM THE PERSPECTIVES OF MINE ATTENDANT AND HER STOUT-HEARTED CUB, BUT THEIR WILLS WERE TOO WEAK, AND I SUBSUMED THEM.
zh: 吾已竭力尊重吾之侍从与其刚毅幼崽的见地，然其意志太弱，吾遂将之吞并。
我接下这任务，阿尔吉夫。

src:
I admire =ifplayerplural:your:thy= curiosity and hope =ifplayerplural:your:thy= prudence informeth it.

I have an example at hand. Mere days ago, one of our coterie named Lebah happened upon a repulsive device. Ey was so shaken after attempting communion with the object that ey hath spent less time away from eir nook than ever.
zh:
我欣赏=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=的好奇心，也盼=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=的审慎能够引导它。

我手边正有一例。就在数日前，我们这群中一个名叫利巴的，偶然发现了一件令人厌恶的装置。彼尝试与那物交感，受惊极深，此后离开自己的角落的时间比以往更少了。

src:
I admit a burning curiosity to see the joined imagination of our Q Girl and Pax Klanq, and no doubt yours as well. Watching such a creation burgeon from empty space to fullness of being would be a joyful entry in the chronicles of my life, but...

Too many fingers tangle in the honeypot, as my cubhood mentor would tell me.
zh:
我坦白，极想一睹我们的Q女孩与帕克斯·克朗克，还有无疑也有你，三方想象合成的造物。眼看这等创造从虚空长至圆满，必是我生平记事中一桩欢喜的条目，只是……

蜜罐里伸进的手指太多了，我幼年时的导师常这样告诫我。

src:
I always knew this part of our story would come. Our efforts today determine the genre of the tale we tell. Is this a triumphant epic, or a tale of woe?

Fight well, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
zh:
我早知这一幕终将到来。我们今日所为，将决定我们所述故事的体裁：是一部凯旋的史诗，还是一则悲歌？

好好战斗，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

src: I am =name=, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=. What is your name?
I am =name=, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=. What may I call you?
I am =name=. Hindriarch Keh sent me.
I am =name=. What is your name?
I am Agyra, a watcher of the tomb.
zh: 我是阿吉拉，墓的守望者。

src: I am Doyoba, proud watcher of the children of the tomb. One child in particular. Of course =ifplayerplural:ye:thou= must comprehend, 'child' is but a fabricated epithet, as they are far older than we. The children are, that is.
zh: 我是多约巴，墓中孩子们的骄傲守望者，尤其守望其中一个。=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=自当明白，“孩子”不过是个杜撰的称呼，因为他们比我们古老得多。我是说，孩子们。

src: I am His voice, and I shall speak His word to you.
zh: 我乃他的声音，要向你宣讲他的话语。

src:
I am Iseppa, and she is me.

I've given thought to being someone else, but never enough to try.
zh:
我是伊赛帕，而她就是我。

我也想过做别人，却从未想到真去试的地步。

src: I am Kesehind, protector of Hindriarch Keh, the Grand-Doe of Bey Lah.
zh: 我是凯塞因德，族长凯的护卫，亦即贝拉的大母鹿的护卫。

src:
I am Santalalotze.

... of ... the Consortium of Phyta. Some call me 'Sant', I think, in
fantasy or memory.
zh:
我是桑塔拉洛策。

……属于……植体联盟。有人叫我“桑塔”，我想，在幻想里，或是记忆里。

src:
I am Sixshrew, a merchant from the Consortium of Phyta disinclined to waste xyr time on talkative strangers.

I sell things, and you can buy them. I would in fact strongly encourage you to buy them, or be on your way.
zh:
我是六鼩，植体联盟的商人，不愿在爱闲谈的陌生人身上虚耗光阴。

我卖东西，你买东西。其实我强烈建议你买下它们，不然就请自便。

src: I am a friend to fungi. Colonize me.
zh: 我与菌类为友。来我身上繁殖吧。

src:
I am a gentleplant, -friend-. Uncross your roots and figure it out.

Live and DRINK.
zh:
我是位君子之植，-朋友-。把你的根松开，自己想明白。

且生且饮。

src: I am a merchant, cave dweller. I wish only to trade.
zh: 我是商人，穴居者。我只想做买卖。

src: I am a servant of chaos. Live and drink.
zh: 我乃混沌之仆。且生且饮。

src: I am a smear of remnant material. I am drying blood. I am the last breath. Concern yourself no further with me.
zh: 我是一抹残存之物的污迹。我是将干之血。我是最后一口气。不必再为我费心了。

src:
I am afeared to even mention this notion to the villagers. Can you imagine my epitaph?

"Here lies the youngest Hindriarch in Bey Lah's history, trampled to death because she suggested we invite in a people most readily described as 'lah with legs'."

If they trusted you more, maybe we could put it to a vote. But as it is? No. Sorry, =name=.
zh:
我连向村人提起这个念头都不敢。你能想象我的墓志铭吗？

“此处长眠着贝拉史上最年轻的族长，只因提议迎入一个最恰当的形容便是‘长腿的拉花’的族类，而被踩踏致死。”

若他们更信任你，也许我们能付诸表决。可眼下这样？不行。抱歉，=name=。

src:
I am always tired, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

My sleep comes in fits and starts, and always with ghastly visions. Sometimes my rest must be coaxed along with medicine.
zh:
我总是困倦，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

我的睡眠断断续续，且总伴着可怖的幻象。有时须得用药，才能哄我安歇。

src: I am bonded with the Creature. How does this work?
zh: 我已与那造物缔结联结。这如何运作？

src: I am both afraid and hopeful for our future. But perhaps this is what we need.
zh: 我对我们的未来既害怕又抱着希望。但或许，这正是我们所需要的。

src: I am busy, wayfarer. Please talk to Mafeo in the trade square if you need something.
zh: 我正忙，行路人。若有所需，请去贸易广场找马费奥。

src: I am busy. Live and drink, little one.
zh: 我很忙。且生且饮，小家伙。

src: I am called Erah. Branches part for you, =name=.
zh: 我叫埃拉。枝条为你分开，=name=。

src:
I am called Une. "Warden" Une, when someone needs to wear authority for outsiders.

And you? What's your name?
zh:
我名叫乌内。需要对外人摆出权威时，便是“守望者”乌内。

你呢？你叫什么名字？

src: I am considering narrative inheritances. The stories we were told when our minds were more putty-like, the follies that shaped who we are, that shape the whole of Qud.
zh: 我在思索叙事的传承。那些在我们心智尚如软泥时听来的故事，那些塑造了我们的愚行，也塑造着整个卡德。

src: I am considering the determination of goodness and badness in a thing, and how it is determined. The interaction between data and subjective evaluation, and the values that guide us that we cannot put to words.
zh: 我在思索一件事物之好坏是如何被断定的。数据与主观评判之间的交互，以及那些引导我们、却无法言说的价值。

src: I am considering the thought as a discrete object. I wish to determine whether I am able to think a single thought only, and to determine how to distinguish it from another thought in the same vein.
zh: 我在把思想当作一件离散的物来想。我想弄清，我是否只能想出一个单独的念头，又该如何把它与同类的另一个念头区分开来。

src: I am considering the window of consciousness through which each of us views the universe. What happens to it when we die?
zh: 我在思索那扇意识之窗——我们每个人都透过它去看宇宙。人死之后，它又会怎样？

src:
I am consumed by curiosity. How it resembleth the children in make!

May I hold the device in communion?
zh:
我被好奇心吞噬了。它与孩子们的形制多么相像！

我可以托着这装置与之交感吗？

src: I am contemplating the Spindle's place in Qud, its position as a conceptual focal point. How much of what we know of the Spindle is the craft of those before us, carried forward?
zh: 我在思索纺锤在卡德的地位，它作为一个观念焦点的位置。我们所知的纺锤，有多少是前人的手笔，一代代传承至今？

src: I am contemplating the distinction between animal and rock. Why are they different? How much like a rock must an animal be when it ceases to be an animal?
zh: 我在思索动物与岩石的分别。它们何以不同？一只动物不再是动物之时，须得有多像一块岩石？

src: I am debased on the plank across the light of God! d- do I have a rightful claim to pity? Blindness! This darkling room abjures the light. Is this the House of Judgement, Hortensa? Or mere penumbra, the child's playcave, and law and language (not yet invented) cast their forcing functions back through time to puppet the unblossomed mind to civilized shape...
zh: 我被贬抑在神之光前的木板上！我——我可有资格求怜悯？盲目！这幽暗的屋子拒斥光明。这是审判之殿么，霍腾萨？抑或只是半影，孩童的游戏洞穴，而法度与语言（尚未发明）把它们的强制函数投回时间深处，将未绽放的心智牵引成文明之形……

src: I am dromad, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=. Some say saltstrider. Do you know this?
zh: 我是单峰驼商，=player.apparentSpecies==player.formalAddressTerm=。有人称我们为踏盐者。你知道吗？

src: I am further relieved to know of another perspective looking upon this work. Klanq's presence here is vital, but it discomfits me: I cannot help but consider the introduction of chaos to an already chaotic endeavor to be a... conflagratory strategy.
zh: 得知又多了一双眼睛注视着这项工作，我更觉宽慰。克朗克在此至关重要，却也让我不安：我总忍不住觉得，把混乱引入一项本就混乱的事业，是一种……引火烧身的策略。

src: I am glad you are safe, =name=.
I am here on account of your Gyre and its plagues. Hear me, I ask.
zh: 我为你的回旋及其瘟疫而来。听我说，我请求。

src:
I am history's leftovers, an inheritor of nothing, a bit of marginalia in a burned tome.

That I have persisted to witness this day leaves me in awe. It is extraordinary.
zh:
我是历史的残羹，一无所承的继承者，一部焚毁典籍中的一则旁注。

我竟能存续至今日得以亲见，令我敬畏。此事殊为非凡。

src: I am in search of work.
I am justice. Give back what you stole.
zh: 我是公道。把你偷的东西还回来。

src: I am moved by this. Let me consider.
zh: 我被打动了。容我想一想。

src: I am no Warden. My only fellowship is with my own shame.
zh: 我不是守望者。我唯一的同盟，是我自己的羞耻。

src:
I am no one of any importance.

But my name is Zothom, and some call me the Penitent.
zh:
我不是什么要紧人物。

但我名叫佐索姆，有人称我为悔罪者。

src:
I am no rector, understand, but They are the molders of chrome. The gods under Shekhinah who wrought metal edifices from the raw Kasaphescence.

Will you go?
zh:
我并非教士，你要明白，但他们乃铬的塑造者。是舍金纳座下的神祇，以原初的圣化现铸成金属圣殿。

你愿去吗？

src: I am not Barathrum. Grant me the same covenant and I will succeed.
zh: 我不是巴拉斯鲁姆。给我同样的盟约，我必能成功。

src: I am not offended, simply making =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= aware of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= foolishness.
zh: 我并未被冒犯，只是让=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=认清=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=的愚蠢。

src:
I am not welcome in Bey Lah.

My blood is not pure, and I was not born in the meadow. These things make my name as salt in the mouths of true hindren.

They are misguided, but they are my misguided family. They stagnate as Qud changes around them. I worry.
zh:
贝拉不欢迎我。

我的血不纯，也不是在草场出生的。这些使我的名字在纯正欣德伦人口中，如盐般发苦。

他们走错了路，却仍是我那误入歧途的亲人。卡德在变，他们却一成不变。我很担忧。

src:
I am not wroth with you, but I owe you no conclusions so easily grasped.

All the same, consider yourself forgiven if you wish. Sit and listen to my hurdy-gurdy and we shall be friends.
zh:
我并未对你动怒，但我也不欠你这样轻易便能到手的结论。

不过，你若愿意，便当自己已被原谅。坐下来听我的手摇风琴，我们便是朋友。

src: I am not yet ready. I may return.
zh: 我还没准备好。或许会再来。

src: I am of slynth, a people grown by hydropon.
zh: 我是斯林斯，由水培摇篮培育出的族类。

src: I am ready for the Creature to be moulded and catalyzed.
zh: 我已备妥，请塑造并催化那造物。

src: I am ready to ascend the Spindle, Barathrum.
zh: 我已准备好攀登纺锤，巴拉斯鲁姆。

src: I am ready to speak on the final fate of Qud.
zh: 我已准备好谈论卡德的最终命运。

src: I am sharp. I am handy.
I am sorry to cause pain, Elder.
I am sorry, =name=. I am so proud of you! I wish... I wish it were I did not peel, like your model.
zh: 我很抱歉，=name=。我为你感到无比骄傲！我只愿……我只愿我不曾像你那模型一般，片片剥落。

src: I am sorry, Miryam. Did you lose someone close to you?
zh: 我很难过，米里亚姆。你失去了亲近的人吗？

src: I am sorry. But will you help Barathrum do as he asks?
zh: 我很遗憾。但你会按巴拉斯鲁姆所求，助他一臂之力吗？

src: I am taking inventory of my faculties, and looking for any that I might not previously have considered.
zh: 我在清点自己的各种官能，看有没有哪一样是我先前未曾想到的。

src: I am the beetle in your crimination. But shall not beetles survive your plagues?
zh: 我便是你罪状里的那只甲虫。可你的瘟疫之下，甲虫难道不会存活吗？

src:
I am the carcass of a fool
made to jump and dance
by a troupe of merry bacteria.

Do you like how I walk?
Do you like how I talk?
Do you like how my face
disintegrates into salt?
zh:
我是一具愚者的尸骸，
被一班欢快的细菌
牵着跳跃起舞。

你喜欢我走路的样子吗？
你喜欢我说话的样子吗？
你喜欢我的脸
化作盐末消散的样子吗？

src: I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah.
zh: 我要把陶的钟鸣带到主根，好让她离开查娃。

src:
I am torn asunder! This outcome, this outcome, the shear splits me. Why Ptoh? How? Has this always been us? Which of us yet carry this -else to reify under pressure to our extancy?

Do not answer. There is no word-answer, and perhaps none at all. You have done us a service and I thank you for this -elseing.
zh:
我被撕裂了！这结局，这结局，剪刃将我劈开。为何，普托？如何？我们从来便是如此吗？我们之中，谁仍背负着这“别”，要在压力之下成其实相，成其存在？

不必回答。此事没有言语的答案，或许根本没有答案。你为我们尽了一份力，我为这别化谢你。

src: I am uncertain that you know the enormity of what you ask me, =name=. Nonetheless, I cannot deny what you have done for our order. These slynth must be tested as you were, but should they show the mettle and drive set by your example, we will accept them as apprentices.
zh: 你可知所求之事何其重大，我实在存疑，=name=。然而你为本会所做的一切，我不能不认。这些斯林斯须如你当年那般受考验；若他们果真显出你所立之榜样的锐气与志向，我们便收他们为学徒。

src: I am uncomfortable with change, but it is a skill to train like any other.
zh: 我不惯变动，但这也是一门技艺，和别的一样可以磨练。

src:
I am weary to my core, but at last this once-hateful body obeyeth me. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for restoring my autonomy.

Memory of my once-self doth elude me, but I recognize the irony of my punishment. Once a strider, then sentenced to stride without restraint, forever. I knew only fear and flight. No more.
zh:
我疲惫至极，然而这具曾令我憎恨的躯体，终于听从于我了。多谢=ifplayerplural:你们:你=还我自主。

往昔之我的记忆已离我而去，但我明白这惩罚的讽刺之处：我曾是一名疾行者，后被判决永无约束地疾行，直到永远。我只知恐惧与逃亡。不会再有了。

src: I am your worst nightmare. Prepare to die.
zh: 我是你最可怕的噩梦。受死吧。

src: I ascended the Spindle to arrive at this place.
zh: 我登上纺锤，来到了此地。

src: I ask you: disable the magnetic field so that the Spindle can be ascended and the signal investigated.
zh: 我请你解除磁场，好让纺锤得以攀登，让那信号得以查证。

src: I asked Resheph that very question. But the seraphim transit an ethical manifold much different than our own.
zh: 我正是向利悉问过这个问题。可炽天使所行的伦理流形，与我们的大相径庭。

src: I asked for time. Give me time. To reform Qud, extinguish the hatefulness and needless warmaking, to lift our world across the eschaton and prepare it for the Coven's return...
zh: 我求的是时间。给我时间。去重塑卡德，熄灭仇恨与无谓的征战，托举我们的世界越过末世，备好迎接盟会的回归……

src: I assent to this. The covenant is drawn.
I assure you, the smell fades once the glue is dry.
zh: 我保证，胶干之后气味便散了。

src: I barely survived and all you can say is 'ah' and 'yes'?
zh: 我险些丧命，你却只会说“啊”和“是”？

src: I bear the Mark. Entomb me.
zh: 我带着印记。把我入葬吧。

src: I beg you. Do not release the cats.
zh: 我求你了。别放走那些猫。

src: I believe this poem is yours.
I believe this poem was meant for you.
zh: 我想这首诗是写给你的。

src: I came across some kendren who claimed to be treasure hunters. They said that they would pay good water for unique artifacts or treasures.
zh: 我碰上几个自称寻宝人的肯德伦人。他们说愿意拿上好的水来换稀奇的古物或宝贝。

src: I came upon this village and its inhabitants, and I =^:villageTask.!random=.
zh: 我来到这座村庄，遇见了这里的居民，于是我=^:villageTask.!random=。

src: I came upon this village and its inhabitants. They asked me to =^:villageTask.!random=.
zh: 我来到这座村庄，遇见了这里的居民。他们请我=^:villageTask.!random=。

src: I can feel my walls are closing in
I can lick the flanges free of their pipe milk and hear my tongue fizzle in foam!
zh: 我能舔净凸缘上的管中之乳，听我的舌头在泡沫里嘶嘶作响！

src: I can repair, recharge, and identify whatever you have! Within reason.
zh: 修理、充能、鉴定，你手上的物件我都包了！在情理之内的话。

src: I can taste lime, =name=. And mayhaps gallium?
zh: 我尝到了石灰味，=name=。也许还有镓？

src: I can wait years for the inspiration to craft another figurine. I have before.
zh: 为下一尊小像寻得灵感，我可以等上数年。从前就等过。

src: I can't abide a transformed world if it must make casualty of its past.
zh: 若一个蜕变之世界必须以其过往为牺牲，我无法容忍。

src: I can't abide your amoral course. I return now to Qud to help nurture its communities, come what may of your plagues.
zh: 我无法容忍你背德的路线。我现在回卡德去，扶助那里的群落，不论你的瘟疫将带来什么。

src: I can't help but notice your impressive stature, even in repose.
zh: 即便你在歇息，我也不禁注意到你那令人惊叹的身量。

src:
I can't help but wonder why you're telling me this in particular. I am not a mayor, nor even a citizen. I am a drifter, a pariah, and my 'people' are those who have no home anywhere else.

... and here I wonder a bit less. You're asking me to whisper into the winds on behalf of the slynth, aren't you?
zh:
我不禁纳闷，你为何偏偏对我说这些。我不是镇长，甚至算不得公民。我是流浪者，是弃民，我的“族人”都是无处可归之辈。

……说到这里，我倒没那么纳闷了。你是要我代斯林斯向风低语，对吗？

src: I can't imagine why you would think we want your company, kendren.
zh: 真不明白，你凭什么觉得我们稀罕你作陪，肯德伦。

src: I cannot abide what you've done, and so come to smash order out of thee.
zh: 你的所作所为我无法容忍，故而前来将你的秩序砸个粉碎。

src: I cannot bring myself to believe that Grand-Doe would allow anyone to stumble upon her own severed tongue. She would surely burn it as soon as she saw it.
zh: 我无法相信大母鹿会任由别人撞见她被割下的舌头。她一见到，定会立刻将它烧掉。

src: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.
zh: 我无法答应此事。且生且饮。

src: I cannot decide which I like best: berries, meat, or honey? I simply cannot decide.
zh: 我拿不定主意最爱哪样：浆果、肉，还是蜂蜜？实在拿不定。

src: I cannot say, =name=. But I know it's facile to believe a living heritage can be evanesced in one stroke. We are always downstream of a past violence.
zh: 我说不准，=name=。但我知道，若以为一脉活着的传承能被一击抹去，那未免太过浅薄。我们永远处在往昔暴力的下游。

src:
I cannot simply explain my credo to =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=. A credo informeth and confoundeth at once, and must be reflected upon by the listener.

=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= inexperienced in our ways, so please bear my words in the kind spirit they are meant: to ask a mopango to explain eir credo is to commit one of our few taboo acts. Be advised.
zh:
我无法简单地向=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=解释我的信条。信条既启迪人，亦困惑人，须由听者自行思量。

=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=尚不熟悉我们的习俗，故请以善意领会我的话：请莫潘戈解释其信条，乃是我们为数不多的禁忌之一。望知悉。

src: I come by way of Joppa. The elder Irudad calls me friend.
zh: 我取道约帕而来。伊鲁达德长老视我为友。

src: I come in the name of need. Barathrum asks the strength of your psyche to power our starclimb.
zh: 我奉需求之名而来。巴拉斯鲁姆求借你心灵之力，驱动我们的登星之旅。

src:
I concern myself little with oozes but to stay away.

Please, no more. I tire. Talk to Agyra.
zh:
我对黏液不甚关心，只是躲着它们。

请别再问了。我累了。去找阿吉拉谈吧。

src: I convinced Pax Klanq to construct the climber.
zh: 我说服了帕克斯·克朗克建造攀升器。

src: I could give it to her.
I could use you for a =spice:commonPhrases.task.!random=

I couldn't save them.

I tried. I tried to save them.
zh:
我没能救下他们。

我试过。我试着救他们。

src: I depart for Grit Gate soon.
zh: 我不日便启程去砂砾门。

src: I desire nothing. Live and drink.
zh: 我没有什么需要。且生且饮。

src:
I did not consider that my life could be further upturned. Truly, I have learned much and I hate it all.

Once you lot reach the spindle's apex, perhaps you could be convinced to stay there? Or perhaps I could go in your stead.
zh:
我没想到，我的生活还能被再度颠覆。我确实学到了许多，且对此一概痛恨。

等你们这伙人登上纺锤之巅，或许可以说服你们留在那儿？或者，由我代你们去也行。

src:
I did not expect to admit this, disciple, but the refugees have met my expectations. Like you, they have shown more than a willing spirit in work and curiosity both.

The slynth have promise, and you may have been right to bring them to us.
zh:
门徒，我本不愿承认，但这些难民已不负我所望。与你一样，他们无论在劳作还是求知上，都不止是肯用心而已。

斯林斯前途可期，你将他们带来，或许是对的。

src:
I did, and I do.

Are you in the market?
zh:
卖过，现在也卖。

你要买吗？

src: I didn't ask for this life, but here we are. Wanna buy something?
zh: 这日子不是我求来的，可事已至此。想买点什么？

src: I discovered a footprint from a great saltback on the paths, a sign of recent trade.
zh: 我在小径上发现一枚巨型盐背兽的足印，是近来有过交易的迹象。

src: I discovered a patch of watervine stained red with blood, a sign of recent violence.
zh: 我发现一片水藤被血染红，是近来发生过暴力的迹象。

src:
I do not know how to remember beloved Tau, struggling like a minnow in Soft. In a place between death and living.

Leave me, please.
zh:
我不知该如何记念亲爱的陶，她像一尾小鱼在软境中挣扎。在生与死之间的所在。

请你离开我，求你。

src:
I do, and I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for asking after it.

My credo is "Reconciliation without understanding is a salt poultice."
zh:
有，多谢=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=相问。

我的信条是：“不求理解的和解，不过是一剂盐敷。”

src: I do, brave friend. I'll imprint them now.
zh: 有的，勇敢的朋友。我这就把它们刻进去。

src:
I do.

"Form needeth not follow function."

I do.

"Suffering breedeth in still water."

I do. Your service to the guild has been laudable, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. You braved the vaporous depths of Bethesda Susa and decoded the signal, you secured the Spindlegrounds and handled the self-appointed Earl, and perhaps most materially, you defended our enclave from the Putus Templar.

Since you returned from Bethesda, you've no doubt wondered at the signal's contents. Verily, I hid them to shield you from the weight of the truth. Only Otho, Q Girl, and I bear that burden, but circumstances have changed. The river of Time powers the gear train of our schemes and devices, and it rushes forth. From here, I must share the burden. You must know.
zh:
是的。你为公会的效力，值得称颂，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。你勇闯毕士大-苏萨的雾气深渊，破译了信号；你守住了纺锤场地，并处置了那自封的伯爵；而最切实的，也许是你保卫了我们的据点，抵御了普图斯圣殿骑士团。

自你从毕士大归来，你想必一直在疑惑信号的内容。实则，我将其隐瞒，是为让你免受真相之重。只有奥索、Q女孩与我背负着这重担，但情势已变。时间之河推动着我们谋划与器械的齿轮组，奔涌向前。自此，我须与你分担这重担。你必须知道。

src: I don't believe my people wish to stay here, but we have had so little, ah, meaningful contact with other sapient creatures. We have no allies. We have nowhere to go but here.
zh: 我并不认为族人愿意长留此地，只是我们与其他有灵之物，鲜有，呃，真正的往来。我们没有盟友。除了这里，我们无处可去。

src: I don't have time for this. Live and drink.
I don't imagine you brought me this information merely to observe. Are you suggesting that these slynth might take up residence here in my village?
zh: 我想你带来这消息不只是为了让我看看。你是在建议这些斯林斯可以搬到我的村庄里来住吗？

src:
I don't know.

Klanq's opacity is alluring, frustrating, and dangerous. Like Klanq, my thoughts on Klanq evade easy explanation.

What you build together will be amazing. Craft well.
zh:
我不知道。

克朗克的晦暗不明，既诱人，又恼人，也危险。我对克朗克的想法，也像克朗克一样，难以轻易说清。

你们合力造出的东西，必定惊人。好好造吧。

src:
I don't like to speculate on a matter I know so little of, nor one whose outcome so dearly affects my life.

If what you want is a strongly-worded accusation based on nothing, Liihart is the sister to talk to.
zh:
对于我所知甚少的事，我不愿妄加揣测，何况此事的结局于我性命攸关。

你若想要一番毫无凭据、措辞严厉的指控，去找利哈特吧，她才是那个合适的姐妹。

src: I don't understand. Can you explain aloud?
zh: 我不明白。你能出声解释一下吗？

src: I don't understand. What could it mean?
zh: 我不明白。这是什么意思？

src: I doubt it. If Eskhind were sick, the last place she would stumble to evacuate her guts would be a watervine field.
zh: 我看未必。若埃斯金德病了，她跌跌撞撞去排泄秽物的地方，最不可能是水藤田。

src: I dream of a crawl nook on a nether stratum where I out-sweat the burning Gyre, and then peek an eye across a new horizon.
zh: 我梦见幽冥地层里一处爬行的小隙，在那里我比燃烧的回旋出更多汗，然后从新的地平线上窥出一只眼。

src: I dream of returning to Bey Lah sometimes, but I know that's not my fate.
zh: 我有时梦见回到贝拉，可我知道，那不是我的命数。

src: I drink in the sight of you, cub. Thank you for keeping safe.
zh: 我看着你，如饮甘泉，孩子。谢谢你平安无恙。

src: I eat honey matz every morning and I ain't been sick in decades.
zh: 我每天早晨吃蜂蜜马茨，几十年没生过病了。

src: I en't filthy. I'm muddy. Big difference.
zh: 我不脏。我是沾了泥。差别大着呢。

src:
I failed it! I have failed! A thousand years too short, and- MORE TIME

{{emote|*Barathrum weeps.*}}
zh:
我失败了！我失败了！差了一千年，而且——要更多时间啊

{{emote|*巴拉斯鲁姆垂泪。*}}

src:
I fear sludges, the kind you may no longer describe with 'some'. Born of the ancient stuff of existence, possessed of malice and wanting nothing more than to eat whatever they can, and they can eat whatever. It is even worse when they drink.

Take care with them.
zh:
我怕的是泥浆族，那种再不能用“些许”来形容的泥浆。它们生自太古的存在之质，怀着恶意，别无所求，只想吞食能吞的一切，而它们什么都能吞。若它们还会饮，那就更糟。

与它们打交道，要当心。

src: I feed these critters what blood the ranchers have to spare.
zh: 牧场主们匀得出多少血，我就拿多少喂这些小家伙。

src: I feel a tingle on my skin
I feel the gentle warmth of love
I found Brightsheol, where it lies beyond the Tomb. I spoke to the Shomer there and arranged for the disablement of the Spindle's magnets.
zh: 我找到了明冥，它就在墓的彼端。我在那里同守者交谈，并安排关闭了纺锤的磁铁。

src: I found a bloody arrow on the paths of Bey Lah. Its fletching resembles the ones in Hindriarch Keh's quiver.
zh: 其箭羽与族长凯的箭囊里的相仿。

src: I found a bloody patch of fur near the village paths, a sign of recent violence.
zh: 我在村路附近发现了一撮带血的毛，是不久前发生过暴力的迹象。

src: I found a detached tongue on the ground, rotted with infection: a sign of recent illness.
zh: 我在地上发现一截脱落的舌头，已因感染而腐烂：是近来有人患病的迹象。

src: I found a few scraps from some kind of leatherworking project, a sign of recent craft.
zh: 我发现几块不知做什么皮革活计剩下的碎料，是近来有人制作手艺活的迹象。

src: I found a set of foreign leatherworking tools on the village paths. A kendren crafter has been here.
zh: 我在村中小径上发现一套外来的皮匠工具。有一名肯德伦工匠来过这里。

src: I found a small leatherworking hammer on the paths, a sign of recent craft.
zh: 我在小径上发现一把小皮匠锤，是近来有人制作手艺活的迹象。

src: I found a torn sheet of graph paper with a note about deceit. Was it yours?
zh: 我找到一张撕破的方格纸，上面写着欺瞒的事。那是你的么？

src: I found a weapon haft, broken from use, on the paths, a sign of recent violence.
zh: 我在小径上发现一截用坏了的武器柄，是近来发生过暴力的迹象。

src: I found a worn-out bracer abandoned near Kesehind's bedroll.
zh: 我在凯塞因德的铺盖旁发现一只被丢弃的磨损护腕。

src: I found an empty injector near the Hindriarch's bedroll. Why doesn't anyone know she was sick?
zh: 我在族长的铺盖旁发现一支空针剂。为什么没人知道她病了？

src: I found the discarded husks of the curative yuckwheat plant, a sign of recent illness.
zh: 我发现了治病用的苦麦被丢弃的壳，是近来有人患病的迹象。

src: I found the village stores of Bey Lah untouched; Eskhind must have traded something for her basics.
zh: 我发现贝拉的村库原封未动；埃斯金德想必是拿别的东西换来了日常所需。

src:
I found them, here and there.

Are you interested, or merely fatally curious?
zh:
东一件西一件捡来的。

你有兴趣，还是只是好奇到不要命？

src: I gave it to someone. Or sold it, perhaps.
zh: 我把它给了别人。也可能卖掉了。

src: I grew up right here in Joppa, daughter of the Elder and all. Spent some years delving, but gave it up after a few near escapes and nearly deadly wounds. I'm better suited to herbalism anyway, and my father worries less.
zh: 我就在约帕这里长大，是长老的女儿，诸如此类。曾在外探掘了几年，几番死里逃生，又受过几近致命的重伤，便罢手了。我本就更适合做草药师，家父也少些担忧。

src: I hand-reared each one of these critters. They've had a life of luxury.
zh: 这些小家伙都是我亲手养大的。它们过的是养尊处优的日子。

src: I hate my goats and they hate me, but we both hate every other body more.
zh: 我恨我的羊，它们也恨我，可我们更恨别的所有人。

src: I have a =spice:commonPhrases.task.!random= that needs doing
I have a secret to share with you.
zh: 我有个秘密要与你分享。

src:
I have a terrible feeling that I've brought ill fortune to my village.

Perhaps it was a mistake to have hired you.
zh:
我有种可怕的预感，是我给村子招来了厄运。

或许当初雇你便是个错误。

src: I have all I need. Live and drink.
zh: 我什么都不缺。且生且饮。

src: I have another question, if you please.

I have been called Inheritor, Godling, Spirechild, Nephiling. They are all fitting names, but none complete or sufficient.

As it is with you, I am the convergence of past-ripples into present-force. As it is with you, I am deeds done and the intention toward deeds yet to be done.
zh:
我曾被唤作继承者、小神、尖塔之子、拿非利幼体。这些名号皆很贴切，却无一完整，无一足够。

正如你一般，我是往昔涟漪汇聚而成的当下之力。正如你一般，我是已成之事，与向着未成之事的心意。

src:
I have been called Remnant, Godling, Deep Progeny, and Spawn of Nephil. None of these are who I am.

Who I am is what I say and do. If you listen well, you will hear my name spoken between words.
zh:
我曾被唤作遗存、小神、深渊之裔、拿非利之子。这些皆非我之所是。

我之所是，乃是我所言所行。你若听得仔细，便能在字句之间，听到我的名字。

src: I have been tasked to travel to Golgotha.
I have changed my mind. Live and drink.
zh: 我改变主意了。且生且饮。

src: I have completed the ritual of -elseing. Will you power Barathrum's starclimb, as you said?
zh: 我已完成“别化”之仪。你会如先前所言，为巴拉斯鲁姆的登星之旅供能吗？

src: I have found Kindrish, but not Eskhind.
zh: 我找到了金德里什，但没找到埃斯金德。

src: I have freed one of the children.
I have lost much to my dedication. Help me gain anew, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
zh: 我为这份事业舍弃良多。请助我重有所得，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

src: I have made my inquiries. It is time for the slynth to choose a new home.
zh: 我已问询完毕。斯林斯人该选新家园了。

src:
I have met Pax Klanq. I was puffed on.

Candidly, I prefer fungi edible and inert.
zh:
我见过帕克斯·克朗克。我被它喷了一身。

坦白说，我更爱可食且惰性的菌类。

src: I have more to ask, Barathrum.
zh: 我还有话要问，巴拉斯鲁姆。

src: I have more to ask, first.
I have no brother. My two sisters are all the blood family I can claim.
zh: 我没有兄弟。我的血亲，只有两位姐妹。

src:
I have no need for luck, but I appreciate your well-wishes nonetheless.

May your own endeavors drive you as mine drive me. Did you wish to speak of anything else?
zh:
我不需要运气，不过仍感谢你的美意。

愿你自己的事业驱策你，一如我的事业驱策我。你还想谈别的吗？

src:
I have not.

I would, however, love to meet him. He seems a fun fungus.

But I daren't go. I fear the sludges.
zh:
没有。

不过，我倒是很想见见他。他看来是个有趣的菌子。

可我不敢去。我怕泥浆族。

src: I have recovered a repulsive device.
zh: 我找回了一件令人厌恶的装置。

src: I have some gossip that may interest you.
zh: 我有些闲闻，或许你会感兴趣。

src: I have something else to ask.
I have visited the Six Day Stilt.

I have visited the rainbow wood but once, and there I sampled an array of strange foods, one of which allowed me an unusual lens through which to view the world. It was nothing like I had ever experienced, and I imagined such wondrous recipes. I wrote them all down as best I could, of course.

Sadly, once I returned to my ordinary frame of reference, my scribblings proved impossible to read. So it goes.
zh:
我只去过虹林一次，在那里尝遍了各式怪异的食物，其中一样让我得了一副不寻常的镜片，借以观看世界。那是我从未有过的体验，我构想出种种奇妙的食谱，自然，也尽力全都记了下来。

可惜，等我回到寻常的参照系，我那些涂鸦便再也读不出来了。世事如此。

src:
I have volunteered to monitor an ancient machine-creature called Kah. Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= seen it, skipping hither and yon on strange limbs.

Often I wonder if Kah knoweth aught else but fear.
zh:
我自愿监看一只名叫卡赫的古老机械生灵。=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=或许见过它，踩着古怪的肢体到处蹦跳。

我常想，卡赫除了恐惧，是否还知道别的什么。

src:
I have yet to find my purpose. I can think and speak, and so this shell is nearly comfortable.

One piece, however, doth yet chafe me. =ifplayerplural:Would ye:Wouldst thou= take it? Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye can:thou canst= grant it some use.
zh:
我尚未找到自己的使命。我能思考，能言语，于是这副躯壳也几近安适了。

然而有一块，仍令我不适。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=愿取走它吗？或许=ifplayerplural:你们:你=能为它找到些用处。

src:
I hear that Bey Lah's status is once again quo. I hoped for a measure more of change, but thousands of years of tradition do not give so easily.

Thank you for helping my foolish people.
zh:
听说贝拉又恢复了原状。我本盼着能有多一分的变化，可数千年的传统，哪会轻易松动。

谢谢你帮助我那些愚昧的族人。

src: I heard a hindren talking about buying and selling to a kendren late at night! I thought that all kendren had to report to Grand-Doe?
zh: 我深夜听见一个欣德伦人在和一个肯德伦人谈买卖！不是说所有肯德伦人都得向大母鹿报到吗？

src: I heard from my friend who heard it from their yma that the Grand-Doe says that hindren who leave Bey Lah grow an extra pair of arms. And the Grand-Doe says it so you know it's true.
zh: 我朋友听他妈妈说，大母鹿讲过，离开贝拉的欣德伦人会多长一对胳膊。大母鹿说的，那肯定是真的。

src: I heard someone doing some kind of toolwork during a night watch shift. I didn't interrupt, but it seemed peculiar.
zh: 我值夜班时听见有人在做什么工具活。我没去打扰，但总觉得有些蹊跷。

src: I heard that someone in the village might have a sore throat, so I am staying at least ten handspan away from everyone today.
zh: 我听说村里可能有人嗓子疼，所以今天我至少离每个人十掌之远。

src: I heard the sounds of fighting the other night! I stayed in the next day, so afeared was I.
zh: 那天夜里我听见了打斗声！我吓得第二天都没敢出门。

src: I heed your warning. Farewell, Barathrum.
zh: 我谨记你的警告。再会，巴拉斯鲁姆。

src:
I hope =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou art= confident in =ifplayerplural:your:thy= choice, =factionaddress:Mopango=. I am happy with it, to be sure.

Kah is free. It heals my heart to see it at rest. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= my thanks.
zh:
我希望=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=对自己的选择有信心，=factionaddress:Mopango=。我对此自是满意。

卡赫自由了。见它安歇，我心得慰藉。=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=有我的谢意，=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=受之无愧。

src: I hope Hindriarch Esk can keep us safe.
zh: 愿族长埃斯能护我们周全。

src:
I hope it is not overly crowded for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=. We mopango are most comfortable in close quarters, but I acknowledge that not all creatures adore the close embrace of the depths as we do.

Regardless, =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= welcome to stay and sup, and ask of me any questions =ifplayerplural:ye may:thou mayest= have.
zh:
我希望这里对=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=而言不算太拥挤。我们莫潘戈在狭窄之处最觉自在，但我知道并非所有生灵都像我们一样钟爱深处的紧密怀抱。

无论如何，=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=都欢迎留下来用饭，=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=有任何疑问也可向我提出。

src: I hope that we could be enough

I hoped you would ask! I closely study the works of the great bard, Willow Shakesprig. In particular, I am most fond of the stories of the Great Plant Detective, Hemlock Cones. Through these stories, I have learned to hone my perceptions and deductive skill to a fine point. It is my dearest hope that one day I shall be known not as Angohind, village bookworm... but Angohind, Master Detective.

My grandhind has forbidden me from looking into the strange doings in the village, but she said nothing about me teaching you the ins and outs of detective work! What say you?
zh:
我就盼你问这个！我潜心研读大诗人柳枝·莎士比芽的作品，尤其钟爱“植物大侦探”铁杉锥的故事。借这些故事，我把洞察与推理磨砺得锋锐无比。我最大的心愿，是有朝一日人们称我不再是村中书虫安戈欣德，而是名侦探安戈欣德。

祖母禁止我探查村里的怪事，可她没说不许我把侦探那一套门道教给你！你意下如何？

src: I implore you, Resheph, reverse the Gyre.
zh: 我恳求你，利悉，逆转回旋。

src:
I intend to ascend the Spindle and answer the call, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=.

My protege {{m|Q Girl}} has designed a climber for the ascent. We intended to construct it piecewise at the enclave and the site itself, but the engineering feat exceeds even our capacity. With time, I am confident we could accomplish it, but the Putus Templar rob us of our patience. We need to act now, and so as loath as I am to admit it, we need Pax Klanq.
zh:
我打算攀登纺锤，回应那召唤，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。

我的门生{{m|Q女孩}}为这次攀登设计了一台攀升器。我们本想在据点与现场分段建造，但这项工程之巨，连我们的能力也不能及。假以时日，我相信我们能够完成，但普图斯圣殿骑士团夺走了我们的耐心。我们须得立即行动，所以，纵然我万般不愿承认，我们需要帕克斯·克朗克。

src: I journey North, to the Six Day Stilt.
zh: 我要北上，往六日高塔去。

src: I just meant to ask if you're able to communicate. It seems so.
zh: 我不过是想问你能不能交流。看来是能的。

src: I keep my amoebas happy! Or, you know, whatever they got in place of happy.
zh: 我把变形虫们照料得很快活！呃，或者说，它们那玩意儿，算是快活的替代吧。

src:
I ken not why you thirst for truths not yours to consume. If I refuse, will you wrench them from my mouth as I wrench teeth from yours? What does that gain you?

Sit down, fool. Listen to music and calm yourself.
zh:
我不知你为何渴求那些不属于你的真相。我若拒绝，你可会像我拔你的牙那般，从我口中把它们硬撬出来？这于你有何益处？

坐下，蠢材。听听音乐，平静下来。

src: I know a lot about the town!
zh: 我对镇子里的事知道得可多了！

src:
I know not. Perhaps I can lead again. These creatures that looked after me, named me, kept me safe. The mopango.

They are kind, but weak. Perhaps I can teach them. Spur them to be greater.

But for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, I must even our score. Take this piece of my chassis. Wear it with confidence. Command in my name.
zh:
我不知道。或许我能再度领导众生。这些照看我、给我起名、护我周全的生灵，莫潘戈人。

它们仁善，却软弱。或许我能教导它们，激励它们成就更大的伟业。

不过对于=ifplayerplural:你们:你=，我必须还清这笔账。拿去吧，这是我躯壳的一片。放心佩戴，奉我之名发号施令吧。

src: I know of so many other ways to be.
zh: 我晓得许许多多别样的存在之道。

src:
I know that Omonporch is a miserable, hot place and Asphodel is a self-important churl.

I don't even like bananas.
zh:
我只知道奥蒙门廊是个闷热而凄惨的地方，阿斯福德尔是个自命不凡的粗鄙之徒。

我连香蕉都不爱吃。

src: I know that everything's all right
I know the rumor you mean, but villagers heard the clash of weapons. Keh is too old for a prolonged fight like that, so I do not believe it was her.
zh: 我知道你说的那个传言，可村人听到的是兵刃相击之声。凯年事已高，撑不起那样久的搏斗，所以我不信是她。

src: I leave you to your fate, then.
I live, but do I drink?

I mean no slight to these slynth folk, =name=, but the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees before and it is a substantial burden upon our stewards. Our resources and space are scant, and I must request that you find another home for them. May the Kasaphescence shine upon them, and you, in this endeavor.
zh: 我并无轻慢斯林斯人之意，=name=，只是高塔之地此前已接纳过难民，这对我们的执事是一桩沉重的负担。我们的资源与地方都有限，我只能请你另为他们寻一处家园。愿圣化现眷照他们，也眷照你在此事上的努力。

src:
I met a cadre of mopango folk,
who told me tales of an ancient oak,
who stood and ruled for a century.
She towered tall over those below.
She cast shade down so they wouldn't grow,
but they all believed it was meant to be.

But when hot sky-fire broke tradition,
she found herself in no position,
To draw up any new decree.

-- Willow Shakesprig's 'Macoun', Act V, scene iii
zh:
我曾遇见一队莫潘戈人，
向我讲述一株古橡的传闻，
它曾挺立主政，历时一世纪。
她高耸于下方众生之上。
她投下浓荫，教他们不得生长，
众人却都信这原该如此。

然而当炽烈的天火坏了旧制，
她已再无可凭的位置，
去颁下任何新的敕令。

——柳枝·莎士比芽《麦孔》，第五幕第三场

src: I might be willing to trade.
I mourn my dear friend. Aloysius, should you persist in pale blue to flicker through the thin world... tell me so. I eagerly await you.
zh: 我哀悼我亲爱的朋友。阿洛伊修斯，倘若你仍以那苍蓝之色在薄界中明灭穿行……请告诉我。我殷切等你。

src:
I must admit, =name=, that I can think of few notions more challenging to my people than to welcome a flower-people into our town. Some will see them as no better than walking lah.

But if the notion came from you, they might consider putting it to a vote, at least. If you'll stand by, I will call a referendum.
zh:
=name=，我得承认，让花人住进我们的镇子，对我的族人而言，几乎是再难不过的事了。有些人会觉得他们不过是会走路的拉花。

但若此议出自你口，他们或许至少肯考虑付诸表决。请稍候，我这就召集全民公决。

src:
I must ask you to decipher this enigma, find Pax Klanq, and convince them to construct the climber. Remind Pax of the debt they owe us.

It strikes me as likely for this 'rainbow' to refer to the Rainbow Wood, where Klanq's kin consort, so I suggest you start there.
zh:
我须请你破解这个谜，找到帕克斯·克朗克，并说服他们建造攀升器。提醒帕克斯，他们欠我们的人情。

我猜这“彩虹”多半指的是虹林，帕克斯·克朗克的同族聚居之所，所以我建议你从那里着手。

src: I must be mistaken. Live and drink.
zh: 一定是我弄错了。且生且饮。

src: I must bring the decoded signal to Barathrum immediately. Return in a few hours. By then I'll have discussed our next course of action with Barathrum and will have further instructions for you.
zh: 我须立刻把译出的信号带给巴拉斯鲁姆。几个时辰后再来。到时我已与巴拉斯鲁姆商议过下一步行动，会有进一步的指示给你。

src: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.
zh: 我必须穿过食者之墓，进入明冥。

src: I must insist; why are you called "pariah"?
zh: 我定要问：你为何被称作“弃民”？

src:
I must offer a strand to you.
Having not this entry, for I left it at home.
At smallest... more than one hundred Codex cycle. Less than ten thousand.
Big span. I offer you strands for this.
zh:
我须予你一缕。
无此条目，因我将它留在家中。
至少……多于一百法典周期。少于一万。
大跨度。为此予你诸缕。

src: I must pass on this offer, for now. Live and drink.
zh: 此番盛情，我暂且只能谢绝。且生且饮。

src: I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.
zh: 我必须与萨满饮魂者玛蒙谈谈。

src: I must think on this further.
I must think on this task.
I must weigh everything you've told me.
zh: 我须斟酌你所说的一切。

src: I need someone to go to =deliveryTarget= and =verb= =item.the.name|strip= there
I need time and space from this.
zh: 我需要些时间，也需要从这事里抽身。

src: I need time on my own first.
I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.
I noticed the creature has had its fangs removed.
zh: 我注意到那怪物的獠牙被拔掉了。

src: I offer you this repulsive device, unique one.
zh: 我把这件令人厌恶的装置献给你，独特的存在。

src: I once traveled over a mountain, believing I would see something that I had not seen before once past the summit. I was disappointed to find that the other side of the mountain bore a striking resemblance to the one I'd just left. What is the purpose of mountains?
zh: 我曾翻越一座山，以为过了山顶便能见到前所未见之物。谁知山的那一边与我刚离开的这一边惊人地相似，我大失所望。山，究竟是为了什么？

src: I promise not to bother you again, =hermit=.
I propose an accord, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=: You remove =player.reflexive= from my sight immediately, and I will refrain from asking that Ereshkigal reduce you to your component atoms.
zh: 我提议订立一份协约，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=：你即刻将=player.reflexive=从我眼前移开，我便不请埃列什基伽勒把你拆成原子。

src:
I read a history once that mentioned =village.name=, taking note of their reverence for =village.sacred= and equal loathing of =village.profane=.

Will my kin accept a life of =village.activity=? I will consult with them.
zh:
我曾读过一部史书，提到=village.name=，言其敬奉=village.sacred=，同样憎恶=village.profane=。

我的族人能接受=village.activity=的生活吗？我会与他们商量。

src: I recommend everything I carry. Not all at once, of course.
zh: 我携带的每一样，我都推荐。当然，不必一次全要。

src: I remain wary, but there is no question that Bey Lah thrives, even with open borders.
zh: 我依然警惕，但贝拉兴旺，这是毋庸置疑的，即便边界洞开。

src: I require entrance to the city.
I require no further information. I will go.

I resent what has befallen me, but I am yet embodied. You have still helped me live, yes?

I forgive you, but I don't wish to know you. Live and drink.
zh:
我怨恨所遭遇的一切，但我仍有形体。你毕竟助我活了下来，是吗？

我原谅你，但我不愿认识你。且生且饮。

src:
I resent what has befallen me, but I am yet embodied. You have still helped me live.

My future is free. My future is murky, and I am freshly tender from the burn of your hand. I feel I had rather not encounter you for a time. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
zh:
我怨恨所遭遇的一切，但我仍有形体。你毕竟助我活了下来。

我的未来自由。我的未来模糊，而我刚被你的手灼伤，仍然刺痛。我想，我宁愿暂时不再遇见你。且生且饮，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

src:
I said I ranch these here beauts.

The Freeholders en't much for letting a body lay claim to land. En't what I'da wished for, but as the Issachari say: "Should your compass lead you to the Six Day Stilt, throw it in the well."
zh:
俺说了，这些个宝贝是俺养的。

自由领的人不大许谁圈地占田。这不是俺想要的，可正如以萨迦人所说：“罗盘若引你至六日高塔，便把它扔进井里。”

src: I said, may I ask you some questions?
zh: 我是说，我可以问你几个问题吗？

src: I saw a kendren merchant the other day! They were being very sneaky, so I think they were meeting someone in secret! Isn't that interesting?
zh: 那天我看见一个肯德伦商人！他们躲躲藏藏的，我想是在秘密会见什么人！有意思吧？

src: I saw only empty spectacle. Who can worship a hole in the ground?
zh: 我只见空洞的排场。谁会崇拜地上的一个窟窿？

src: I see my wares catch your eye, =player.formalAddressTerm=. They can be yours.
zh: 我见我的货物入了你的眼，=player.formalAddressTerm=。它们可以归你。

src: I see the slynth have arrived. How are they faring?
zh: 我看斯林斯已经到了。他们过得如何？

src: I see you and become lovesick
I see, thank you. Live and drink.
I see. I have further questions.
zh: 明白了。我还有别的问题。

src:
I see. In that case, rest and speak a bit with me, won't you? My worries can wait another day.

That said, if you change your mind, you'll come find me, won't you?
zh:
