zh: 在=spice.entity:name=，若不举起=spice:commonPhrases.mug.!random==liquid=，并向=spice.entity:sacredThing=敬酒，则任何=spice:items.blessing.!random=皆不得=spice:commonPhrases.honored.!random=！|=id=

src: No =spice:items.blessing.!random= shall be =spice:commonPhrases.honored.!random= in =spice.entity:name= without lifting a =spice:commonPhrases.mug.!random= of =liquid=!|=id=

zh: 未找到与“=searchtext=”匹配的主动能力。

src: No additional sterilisation required, of course.
No blueprint by the name '=name=' could be found.
No blueprint by the name '=objectName=' could be found.
No body part by the name '=slot=' could be found.
zh: 找不到名为“=slot=”的身体部位。

src: No clothespress or cabinet is finished by the sunclock without a secret drawer, where children might keep their fey gifts and find them once more on the night of their death projection.
zh: 日晷旁没有哪只衣橱或柜子算得做成，除非它有一只暗屉，好让孩童藏起他们的精灵之礼，并在死亡投影之夜重新找到它们。

src: No good can come of allowing kendren into Bey Lah...
zh: 放肯德伦入贝拉，绝无好处……

src: No lie, I love my job.
No modification by the name '=modName=' could be found.
No one is there for you to syphon vim from.
zh: 附近没有可供你汲取活力的人。

src:
No one leadeth us. We mopango hold little regard for hierarchy, and our shared decisions are made through discussion, quiet consideration, and consensus.

Shouldst be otherwise?
zh:
无人统领我们。莫潘戈不重等级，我们的共同决断，皆出于讨论、静思与共识。

难道该是别的样子么？

src:
No one of fate,
no one of blood,
no one of importance,
until their return
and the realization of their future.

=name= is a temple in memory
upon which hopes are hung
and rage is borne out.

Too great to be real,
too foundational not to be,
too contradictory to have ever existed.
zh:
无关命运之人，
无关血脉之人，
无足轻重之人，
直到他们归来，
领悟了自己的未来。

=name=是记忆中的一座圣殿，
希冀悬挂其上，
愤怒由其承载。

伟大得不似真实，
根基深厚得不容虚无，
矛盾重重得仿佛从未存在。

src:
No one of fate,
no one of blood,
no one of importance,
until, suddenly, someone of all of these things.

=name= is a dream from which we cannot awaken.
zh:
无关命运之人，
无关血脉之人，
无足轻重之人，
直到忽然之间，成了集这一切于一身之人。

=name=是一场我们无法醒来的梦。

src: No parting is simple. I see you, -elser.
zh: 没有一场别离是简单的。我看见你了，别化者。

src: No parting is simple. I see you, fair -elser.
zh: 没有一场别离是简单的。我看见你了，良善的别化者。

src: No sudden moves around the Hindriarch, kendren. I am watching you.
zh: 在族长面前不许轻举妄动，肯德伦。我盯着你呢。

src: No thank you. I don't care for this job.
zh: 不了，多谢。我对这差事没兴趣。

src: No thank you. Live and drink.

No! Yes? I don't know.

Yes, I wish I burned it, but I wish I had given it. I wish I had never written it, or I had written it better, or I had simply confessed in person. I wish I had a harder heart.

I wish you would give it back, or burn it, or give it to her.
zh:
不！是的？我不知道。

是的，我希望我烧了它，可我更希望我送出了它。我希望我从没写过它，或是写得更好些，或是干脆当面坦白。我希望我的心肠更硬一些。

我希望你把它还给我，或烧掉，或交给她。

src: No, Eskhind. Take the poem. Be brave.
zh: 不，埃斯金德。拿回这首诗吧。勇敢些。

src: No, Grand-Doe is absolutely meticulous about work clutter. She wouldn't leave scraps lying about.
zh: 不，大母鹿对活计留下的杂物极其一丝不苟。她不会让碎料散落在外。

src: No, I do not have enough evidence yet.
zh: 不，我还没有足够的证据。

src: No, I took it apart or sold it or something.
zh: 没有，我把它拆了、卖了，或是怎么处理了。

src: No, I wish to return to Qud.
No, I would risk too much.

No, it can't be... how. This place. This accursed village!

This whole village be damned!
zh:
不，不可能……怎会。这地方。这被诅咒的村子！

整个村子都该遭天谴！

src: No, no, =ifplayerplural:ye know:thou knowest= not our ways and I was too harsh. I apologize, and I am not wroth with =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.
zh: 不，不，=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=不知我们的规矩，是我太过严厉。我道歉，我并不对=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=动怒。

src:
No, no, give it to Neelahind.

Esk will thank you later.
zh:
不，不，交给尼拉欣德。

埃斯过后会谢你的。

src: No, no. Eskhind makes the most of what few possessions she keeps, and if she traded a treasure for so much water, she'd never have lost track of any.
zh: 不，不。埃斯金德把自己仅有的几样家当都用到了极处；若她拿一件宝贝换了这么多水，断不会把东西弄丢。

src: No, of course it's a laboratory, I wasn't thinking.
zh: 不，当然是实验室，我刚才没多想。

src: No, that can't be it. Eskhind hates everything about watervine and keeps a wide berth from it. If her blood was spilled, it would have happened nearer to the path.
zh: 不，不会是这样。埃斯金德厌恶水藤的一切，总是远远绕着走。若她流了血，也该是在离小径更近的地方。

src: No, that's not mine. But it looks lovely!
zh: 不，这不是我的。不过看着真漂亮！

src: No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused.
zh: 没有。埃斯金德声称自己被冤枉了。

src:
No. It's not true, and I won't hear any more of your poisonous ideas, kendren. Consider the topic closed.

Do you actually have a question?
zh:
不。这不是真的，我也不想再听你那些毒害人心的念头，肯德伦。此话题到此为止。

你到底有没有问题要问？

src: No. She must have sold the artifact.
zh: 没有。她定是把古器卖掉了。

src: No. The Hindriarch lied to you.

No. Well... no, no. I don't think so.

We're just... sharing nutrients.
zh:
不。嗯……不，不。我想不是。

我们只是……分享养分。

src:
No. You are the one investigating, so my bias need not enter play. If you determine that Eskhind is guilty, I will heed your word and carry out a just sentence.

After that, I'm not sure.
zh:
不会。调查的是你，所以我的偏私无从介入。若你断定埃斯金德有罪，我会听从你的裁断，执行公正的刑罚。

此后如何，我也不知道。

src: No. You stole the treasure called Kindrish.
zh: 不。你偷的是名叫金德里什的宝物。

src:
No... Qud is fractious, and no lasting peace has obtained. I tried... for decades on decades I tried our paws on the tiller, to shim together what blossomed in the wild...

The restoration of machines, the federation of free sovranties, the nourishing rituals of salt and star, the sacred, the profane...
zh:
不……卡德纷争不休，从未有长久的和平。我试过……一连数十年，我们的爪掌握着舵柄，试图把野地里绽放的一切拼合起来……

机器的复兴，自由邦国的联合，盐与星的滋养仪式，神圣的，世俗的……

src:
No... no, I can't... and the artifact is lost?

It was all for nothing... for nothing...
zh:
没有……没有，我不能……古器就这么丢了？

这一切都是白费……白费……

src:
None hailed =name=
and =name= hailed none
but with word and blade
deed and disregard
they stood against old rule.

To push back the Gyre,
to spill of Nephil ichor
they took to the spire
and quieted the remnants.
zh:
无人向=name=致意，
=name=亦不向任何人致意，
唯以言语与刀刃，
以行止与漠视，
他们挺身对抗旧日之统治。

为逼退回旋，
为洒下拿非利之灵血，
他们登上了尖塔，
使残余者归于沉寂。

src:
None hailed =name=
and =name= hailed none
but with word and blade
deed and disregard
they stood against their kind.

To push back the Gyre,
to spill of Nephil ichor
they took to the spire
and enacted a great betrayal.

Death of impossible scale reigned
and we Nervous Ones fell,
and as the Gyre swallowed us
we sang to the last.
zh:
无人向=name=致意，
=name=亦不向任何人致意，
唯以言语与刀刃，
以行止与漠视，
他们挺身反对自己的同类。

为逼退回旋，
为洒下拿非利之灵血，
他们登上了尖塔，
行下一桩弥天大背叛。

不可思议的死亡之潮横行，
我们神经者纷纷倒下，
当回旋吞没我们，
我们高歌至最后一息。

src:
None hailed =name=
and =name= hailed none
but with word and blade
deed and disregard
they stood apart and above

To push back the Gyre,
to spill of Nephil ichor
they took to the spire
and quieted the Reshephate.
zh:
无人向=name=致意，
=name=亦不向任何人致意，
唯以言语与刀刃，
以行止与漠视，
他们独立而凌驾于众。

为逼退回旋，
为洒下拿非利之灵血，
他们登上了尖塔，
使利悉之统归于沉寂。

src: None of your abilities need refreshing.
None of your companions are nearby.
None yet. Live and drink, Thah.
Normality condensate tesselates the vertical vents cut in columns from tarnished chrome.
zh: 常态凝结物在暗淡铬钢柱上开凿的竖向通风口间铺成密密的镶嵌纹样。

src: Not a word of lie, I studied under a chef who studied under Agate Severance Star herself. That's why my recipes are the best.
zh: 句句不虚，我曾师从一位大厨，而那位大厨师从玛瑙诀别之星本人。所以我的食谱才是最好的。

src: Not all life then. But most intelligent life. Why?
zh: 那便不是所有生命，而是大多数有智慧的生命。为什么？

src: Not at this time. Live and drink.
Not like this. After all we've accomplished...
zh: 不该是这样的。我们明明已经成就了那么多……

src:
Not much of a talker. But that's not true for everyone. As long as a creature isn't hostile, you can try to chat with them.

Let's see what the beetle has for trade.
zh:
它不太会说话。不过并非人人都这样。只要生物不敌对，你就可以试着跟它攀谈。

我们看看甲虫有什么可交易的。

src: Not today, Asphodel. Live and drink.
zh: 今日不必，阿斯福德尔。且生且饮。

src: Not today. Live and drink, chronicler.
zh: 今日不了。且生且饮，编年史官。

src: Not yet, but that's not the point.
zh: 尚无结论，不过那并不要紧。

src: Not yet, friend. Live and drink.
Not yet. But I require entrance to the city for the purposes of trade.
zh: 尚未。但我需入城做买卖。

src: Not yet. How are you and Eskhind?
zh: 还没有。你和埃斯金德怎么样了？

src: Not yet. May I ask you some questions?
zh: 还没有。我可以问你几个问题吗？

src:
Not... the device. Repulsive as a key to a prison doth repulse. To know a key is to know of a prison.

Our watched children are bound, and lock swalloweth key. An =ifplayerplural:ye free:thou freest= one, three remaineth forever.

k-Goninon hath it now. An =ifplayerplural:ye seek:thou seekest=.
zh:
不……不是装置本身。令人厌恶，如同囚牢的钥匙令人厌恶。知晓钥匙，便是知晓牢笼。

我们所守望的孩子们皆被束缚，锁吞没了钥匙。=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=若释放其一，其余三者将永世被困。

克-戈尼农如今拿着它。=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=若要寻它。

src:
Note: Playing a saved game in a language other than that game's original language will result in partial and incomplete translations.

Changing language requires restart.
zh:
注意：以该存档原始语言之外的语言游玩存档，译文会残缺不全。

更改语言需要重启游戏。

src: Nothing for now. Live and drink.
Nothing is in situ, everything is in motion, and the seated must prepare for the next moment where the memory of leisure is burned in neurotic effigy. The stool abides these truths.
zh: 无物在其原处，万物皆在流转，而坐者必须为下一刻做好准备——彼时闲适的记忆将在神经质的偶像中焚毁。凳子容忍这些真理。

src: Nothing other than a pet theory of mine that the Spindle is a liquid in laminar flow.
zh: 除了我的一个私下的设想——纺锤是一种处于层流中的液体——便没有别的了。

src: Nothing sadder than a cookfire and nothing to cook over it.
zh: 没有比这更凄凉的了：灶火燃着，却无物可烹。

src: Nothing seems to happen when you hit the switch.
zh: 你按下开关，似乎什么也没有发生。

src:
Nothing short of explosives or heavy equipment could have made such a sound.

Be ready for the worst, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
zh:
除了炸药或重型器械，断难发出那般声响。

做好最坏的打算，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

src: Nothing wrong with beetle meat. Come, try it.
zh: 甲虫肉没什么不好。来，尝尝。

src: Nothing. I will return with your knickknack.
zh: 没事。我会把你的小玩意儿带回来。
要不要备些路上的口粮，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

src: Now don't you dare pop my amoeba.
zh: 你可千万别戳破我的变形虫。

src: Now don't you fret. My crabs are docile as dogs.
zh: 别慌。我的螃蟹温顺得像狗。

src: Now don't you go breaking my fence.
zh: 可别把我的篱笆弄坏了。

src: Now knowing I must go and you must stay
zh: 既知我须远行，君须留守，

src:
Now to go to the world map. Try ascending again.

Press =commandKey:CmdMoveU=.
zh:
现在去世界地图吧。再试着往上走一次。

按=commandKey:CmdMoveU=。

src:
Now to go to the world map. Try ascending again.

You can click this button or press =commandKey:CmdMoveU=.
zh:
现在去世界地图吧。再试着往上走一次。

你可以点击此按钮或按=commandKey:CmdMoveU=。

src: Now you keep your eyes off my young, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
zh: 你的眼睛离我的幼苗远点，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

src: Now, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I know you must have an eye for fashion, if you're here.
zh: 好了，=player.formalAddressTerm=，你既然来了这里，想必是有眼光的。

src: Now, matters have... evolved... in your absence. Do you choose now to learn more?
zh: 如今，在你不在的时日里，事态已……演变。你现在愿意多了解一些么？

src:
Now, our operators at Omonporch confirm that a clash with the Templar is inevitable.

This is a grim fact, but it does give space for your bond to flower. Go, become familiar with leading and piloting your creature. Return when you are ready, and we will finally go starward.
zh:
眼下，我们在奥蒙门廊的人手确认，与圣殿骑士团的冲突已不可避免。

这虽是严酷的事实，却也给你的联结留出了绽放的余地。去吧，去熟悉如何带领、驾驭你的生灵。待你准备好了便回来，我们终将向星空进发。

src:
Now, uh... hop... hop into the sarcophagus.

Safe travels.
zh:
那么，呃……请、请跳进石棺里去。

一路平安。

src: Nulling: When powered on a weapon, this item astrally burdens its target on hit. When powered on a piece of armor or shield, this item astrally burdens its wearer. Compute power on the local lattice increases the effectiveness of this effect.
zh: 归零：供能并装于武器时，此物命中后会对目标施加星界重负。供能并装于护甲或盾牌时，此物会对其穿戴者施加星界重负。本地晶格的算力可增强此效果。

src: Nulling: When powered, this armor astrally burdens its wearer. Compute power on the local lattice increases the effectiveness of this effect.
zh: 归零：供能后，此护甲会对其穿戴者施加星界重负。本地晶格的算力可增强此效果。

src: Nulling: When powered, this shield astrally burdens its wielder. Compute power on the local lattice increases the effectiveness of this effect.
zh: 归零：供能后，此盾牌会对其持有者施加星界重负。本地晶格的算力可增强此效果。

src: Nulling: When powered, this weapon astrally burdens its target on hit. Compute power on the local lattice increases the effectiveness of this effect.
zh: 归零：供能后，此武器命中时会对目标施加星界重负。本地晶格的算力可增强此效果。
呵护的,安适的,舒适的,守护者,温暖的

src: Nutwood stock parts were unscrewed in favor of starless metal. A greased pump slides shot to the chamber with minimal friction.
zh: 坚果木枪托的部件已被拆下，换作无星之金属。涂了油脂的泵柄将霰弹几无阻滞地滑送入膛。

src: O Life, O Change! Embrace us, entangle us...
zh: 噢，生命，噢，变化！拥抱我们，缠绕我们……

src: O Nephilim! Come for our star bath??
zh: 噢，拿非利人！来我们的星浴吧？？

src: O grace! =name= recovered a shard of black glass from a teeming jungle and returned it to the mechanical goat whose circuitry it powers.
zh: 啊，恩典！=name=从繁茂丛林中取回一块黑玻璃碎片，将它交还给靠其电路供能的机械山羊。

src: O praise our Argent Fathers! Kindest and wisest of all beings.
zh: 啊，赞美我们的银辉诸父！众生中至仁至智者。

src:
O to step over a line
one is not meant to cross
to parts unknown and desired!
O to be halted
by chants and weapons
and crushing shibboleth.
O coven! O not coven?
I only want to see!
zh:
噢，踏过一道
本不该跨越的线，
去往陌生而渴慕的远方！
噢，被吟唱与兵刃
与碾压人的口令
所阻拦！
噢盟会！噢非盟会？
我只是想看一看！

src: O! O! A new life obtains? You musn't shudder at old Death!
zh: 噢！噢！新生降临了？你不可对老死战栗！

src: O! Our hearts turned to stellar remnants when =name= recited an elegy for the unknown girlchild Eudoxia!
zh: 噢！当=name=为不知名的女孩欧多克西亚吟诵挽歌时，我们的心化作了恒星的残骸！

src: O! What is it? I heave... I heave the weight of ass across my crutch, but the bones are pullproof. My bones inosculate to this grotto, or rather- this grotto, this world is what my bones *are*. Can an old bear divest of his spine, leave it to mosses and the sunstrung birds?
zh: 哦！这是怎么了？我使劲……我使劲把一身重量压在拐杖上，可骨头却拔不动。我的骨头与这洞窟骨肉相连，或者说——这洞窟，这世界，便是我的骨头*所是*。一头老熊，能把脊梁卸下，留给苔藓与日光牵引的飞鸟么？

src:
O, deceit! The grueling gate I crossed on every tilt of glittering dusk. I slept in my crimeclothes and wept, did you hear?

Or could you hear only the damnable static, like me, and speak naught to the machine that belches it out. Heal none of the wounds of its grievous heart, or mine own...

O, oh... So much to bear.
zh:
哦，欺瞒！那道沉重的门，我在每一个璀璨黄昏的倾斜里都走过。我穿着罪衣入睡，哭泣，你可听见了？

抑或，你如我一般，只听得见那可恨的静电，对着喷吐它的机器，一言不发。不曾医治它那痛苦的心上任何一道伤，也不曾医治我自己的……

哦，哦……何其难承。

src: O, hallowed act! Blessed be the metallurgy!
zh: 啊，神圣之举！愿冶金术蒙福！

src: O, holy union! Blessed be thy name.
zh: 啊，圣洁的结合！愿汝名蒙福。

src:
O, she doth pale red apples by her cheek!
That cheek which doth proclaim the rite of spring,
And heretofore hath nature's grand technique,
Ne'er ripened lips so red from which to sing.
Begone, false sun! I know thee for a fraud.
Her fairest skin illuminates the day.
All gold is brass and e'ery jewel is flawed,
When set beside the sums her eyes might pay.
The Spindle, which from Omonporch ascends,
Must surely be her likeness brightly wrought,
And as a likeness, fails to apprehend,
The artless beauty that its makers sought.
Did I know love or beauty? No, for shame!
For I knew neither 'til they spoke her name.
zh:
啊，她颊边的红苹果也为之色淡！
那颊宣告着春之礼序的来临，
而造化之大工，自古及今，
也未曾染出这般可供歌唱的红唇。
去罢，虚假的太阳！我知你是诈伪。
她最白皙的肌肤照亮了白昼。
一切黄金皆铜，每颗宝石皆有瑕，
若与她双眼所能偿付的数目并置。
自奥蒙门廊而升的纺锤，
必是她明丽铸就的肖像，
而作为肖像，它终究无从领会
匠人所求的那浑然天成之美。
我可知爱或美？不，惭愧！
因我二者皆不识，直至人唤出她的名。

src: O, the thrill of coursing Change within. Each pump of the heart drives it deeper. Each breath a breath of new life.
zh: 噢，变化在体内奔流的战栗。心脏每搏动一下，便将它推得更深。每一次呼吸，都是新生的呼吸。

src: O? BUT THEN, A CHANGE MUST BE WROUGHT FROM WHAT HATH BEEN BEFORE.
zh: 噢？如此，则须自既往之途有所更易了。

src:
O? THOU ART WISE BEYOND THY STATURE.

THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE COVEN DOTH RETURN.
zh:
噢？汝之睿智，远胜汝之年岁。

恒星之纪行将终了，盟会即将归来。

src: O? What.. am I cohering? Curious! To fetch my notebook. But, o...
zh: 噢？什么……我正在凝聚？奇哉！去取我的笔记本。可是，噢……

src: ONE AGED PLAYER LIVETH STILL. WHILE BARATHRUM DOTH REMAIN UPON THE STAGE, NO PACT SHALL BE FORGED.
zh: 仍有一位年迈之角色在世。只要巴拉斯鲁姆尚留于舞台，便不会有任何盟约缔结。

src:
Objects out of place, certainly. Bey Lah produces little and sees almost no violence, so signs of the outside world should be easy to find.

You may wish to talk to the villagers, too. My people are starved for entertainment, gossip travels fast, and we are all notoriously poor liars.
zh:
必定是些不在其位的物件。贝拉产出甚少，也几乎没有暴力，所以外界的痕迹应当不难发现。

你也不妨去和村人谈谈。我的族人渴求消遣，流言传得飞快，而且我们都是出了名的拙于撒谎。

src: Obliterate all nearby members of what faction?
zh: 要消灭附近哪个派系的所有成员？

src: Oceans of hot burning wine spray foam on the monstrous orb inner, while the orb outer is pressed all over with dissolved leaves.
zh: 灼热的酒之海洋在内层巨球中喷溅泡沫，外层之球则遍压着消融的叶片。

src: Oceans reflecting the skies of a thousand fractal worlds are tucked into a geometric volume.
zh: 映照千重分形世界之天空的海洋，被收拢于一个几何体积之中。

src: Oceans reflecting the skies of a thousand fractal worlds are tucked into a geometric volume. All its rough edges have been polished to shine.
zh: 映照千重分形世界之天空的海洋，被收拢于一个几何体积之中。其粗糙的棱角皆已磨得光亮。

src: Of a sort, yes. I'm part of a branch who deify the Kasaphescence only. We believe the argent fathers to be earthly beings: important to the faith's early history but not divine.
zh: 算是吧。我属于只尊圣化现为神的一支。我们认为银辉诸父乃尘世中人：于教门初史至为要紧，却非神明。

src:
Of course it was only a matter of time before you came to speak to me.

I don't suppose I can convince you to let me tend to my duties in peace? I know nothing of interest to a wayfarer. Each of my days is like the others; I maintain and protect my children, and this is enough. If I desire conversation, there is Ereshkigal.
zh:
你迟早会来找我说话，这自然是意料中事。

我想，大概说服不了你让我安安静静料理职守吧？我没有什么值得一个远行者感兴趣的东西。我的每一天都与别的日子无异；我看护并守卫我的孩子们，这就够了。若我想找人说话，还有埃列什基伽勒。

src: Of course my eyes do not glow. You see the glint of my mask's optics.
zh: 我的眼睛当然不会发光。你看到的，是我面具光学器件的反光。

src: Of course not. Let's back up.
zh: 当然不是。我们退一步说。

src:
Offering adornment,
No entry for this.
My mat is small.
zh:
献上饰物，
无此条目。
我的垫子小。

src: Offers protection against visual flash effects. =part.statusSummary|when#notTinkering|addParens=
Offworld goldleaf spirals on the starpath.
zh: 异界的金箔在星径上盘旋。

src:
Oh dear, a mystery.

Perhaps I should have accepted Angohind's lessons after all.
zh:
哎呀，一桩谜案。

或许我当初就该接受安戈欣德的教导。

src:
Oh dear.

This is the credo by which I live my life, and =ifplayerplural:ye ask:thou asketh= "what does that mean?"

I cannot summarize such a thing for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=. It is too great, too multifaceted.
zh:
哎呀。

这是我赖以度日的信条，而=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=竟问“这是什么意思”。

我无法为=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=概括这样的东西。它太宏大，太多面。

src: Oh dear. Who dressed you, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Let me help you, please.
zh: 哎呀。是谁给你穿成这样的，=player.formalAddressTerm=？请让我来帮你。

src: Oh gross, there's a rotten tongue on the ground!
zh: 哦，真恶心，地上有一截烂舌头！

src: Oh joy, another meat-being. Please tell me you're here to buy something.
zh: 哦，真是欢喜，又来一个肉身生灵。请告诉我你是来买东西的。

src: Oh my, what a cute not-bear. Greetings, cute not-bear.
zh: 哎呀，好可爱的非熊。你好啊，可爱的非熊。

src:
Oh wow, an animal.

Congratulations for... not dying.

... wanna buy something?
zh:
哎哟，一只动物。

恭喜你……没死。

……想买点东西吗？

src:
Oh! =name=.

It makes me happy to see you.
zh:
哦！=name=。

见到你，我很高兴。

src:
Oh! A real live kendren, here in our village! Live and drink, lovely friend!

If you'd care to trade, I have a modest amount of local goods I can offer.
zh:
哦！一位活生生的肯德伦，竟然就在我们村里！且生且饮，可爱的朋友！

你若想做买卖，我这儿有些本地的小货可供挑选。

src:
Oh! Another creature. Let's look at it more closely.

When you come across something new, it's always a good idea to inspect it.
zh:
哦！又一只生物。我们仔细看看它。

遇到没见过的东西时，检视一下总是好主意。

src:
Oh! Brightsheol? The forever braid of life? The Garden Behind the High Gate? Why, you must rank among the crown echelon of machine and folk, and you must... well, you must...

Start to decompose. You must... You must be dead. Dead and entombed. The body remains, but the mind wanders...
zh:
哦！明冥？永恒的生命之辫？高门之后的花园？哎呀，你定是位列机器与众生之冠的人物，而你定是……嗯，你定是……

开始腐化。你一定……你一定是死了。死了，且已入葬。躯体犹存，心识却在游荡……

src:
Oh! Eskhind wrote that.

You should give that to Neelahind. It was supposed to go to Neelahind.
zh:
哦！这是埃斯金德写的。

你该把它交给尼拉欣德。本来就是要给尼拉欣德的。

src:
Oh! Is this what... Esk!

I could have gone years unknowing that my love for her was returned. But this is her script, and these words describe me.

Ayvah, I have to speak to her! Thank you so much, kendren.
zh:
噢！这就是……埃斯！

我本可以一生一世不知她也回应着我的爱。可这是她的笔迹，这些词句写的正是我。

艾瓦，我得去找她！非常感谢你，肯德伦。

src:
Oh! Kendren, thank you, thank you! You've done so much for us. Here is a reward for your hard work.

Um, that said, there's still the matter of finding out who stole our treasure. It'd mean a great deal if you could still help with the resolution of the case.
zh:
哦！肯德伦，谢谢你，谢谢你！你为我们做了这么多。这是对你辛劳的酬谢。

呃，话虽如此，查明谁偷了我们的宝物仍是要紧事。若你仍能助此案了结，意义重大。

src:
Oh! Well. For you to bring me this after returning me to Bey Lah...

{{emote|*she smiles.*}}

Message received, =name=. If I expect my people to face their fear of the unknown, I owe it to them to face mine.

I will confess my feelings to Neelahind, give her the poem I wrote, and accept whatever reply she has for me. Thank you again.
zh:
噢！这个嘛……你把我送回贝拉之后，竟还带来这个……

{{emote|*她笑了。*}}

心意已领，=name=。我既盼族人直面未知的恐惧，自己便也当直面心中的恐惧，以为表率。

我会向尼拉欣德表白心意，把我写的诗交给她，并接受她给我的任何答复。再次谢谢你。

src:
Oh! it looks like Warden Yrame killed Mehmet. Why, you ask?

Well, named creatures who you can perform the water ritual with, like Mehmet, generate with dynamic faction relationships. In your game, Mehmet must have been hated by the Fellowship of Wardens for some reason.
zh:
哦！看来守望者伊拉梅杀死了梅赫梅特。你问为什么？

是这样的，像梅赫梅特这样能与之行水礼的具名生物，生成时会带有动态的阵营关系。在你的这一局里，梅赫梅特想必因某种缘故被守望者同盟所憎恨。

src:
Oh, =name=! I'm so happy!

I can scarcely believe she loves me, much less that... that we could be together. But it's true. Wherever we go from now on, we go together.
zh:
哦，=name=！我好开心！

我几乎不敢相信她爱我，更别说……我们竟能在一起。可这是真的。从今往后，无论去哪里，我们都同行。

src: Oh, =petNames.andList=? I assume because of their love of =spice.entity:sacredThing=.
zh: 哦，=petNames.andList=？我想大概是因为他们热爱=spice.entity:sacredThing=吧。

src: Oh, =petName|capitalize=? I assume because of =sample.their= love of =spice.entity:sacredThing=.

Oh, I am hardly an unbiased observer, I'm afraid -- the Freehold is the only welcoming home I could ever have imagined for myself, and my home before was worse than most. I feel a freedom and responsibility here that I would know nowhere else. That no one else could ever know at all.

But bias aside, you can see for yourself that we are a collective thriving without hierarchy. I'm rightly proud to defend that.
zh:
哦，我恐怕算不得公正的旁观者——自由领是我所能想象的、唯一欢迎我的家，而我从前的家比大多数人的更糟。在这里，我感受到一种别处无从知晓的自由与责任。别人也永远无从知晓。

但抛开偏见，你自可亲眼看到，我们是一个无需等级而兴旺的集体。我理所当然地为守卫它而自豪。

src:
Oh, I am joyous to reside here.

Yd could do, mind, with some measure of hierarchy, and more infrastructure, to attract wayfarers less adventuresome than yourself. Also, Mak absolutely must cease advising that anyone enter the clam; it is not funny and someone could die.

But... the structure of friendships here is true, and sturdy! Kindly keep this exchange between us. I was mostly kidding. Somewhat kidding.
zh:
哦，能住在这里，我欣喜得很。

不过嘛，伊德还须有些许等级秩序，再添些设施，方能引来不似你这般好冒险的行旅之人。还有，马克万万不可再劝人进那只蛤里去了；那一点也不好笑，会死人的。

但是……这里的友谊结构，确实真挚而牢固！此话请只留在你我之间。我多半是在说笑。有些是在说笑。

src:
Oh, I am leaden with this knowledge. Yet am I soothed by your pilgrimage.

Moon and Sun, I feel the warmth of the Kasaphescence yet. Praise the Argent Fathers.
zh:
唉，得知此事，我心头沉重。然而你的朝圣之行仍抚慰了我。

月与日，圣化现的暖意依然尚存于我心。赞美银辉诸父。

src: Oh, I didn't notice you there. That's because I was ignoring you.
zh: 噢，我没留意到你在那儿。那是因为我一直在无视你。

src: Oh, I have such a precious vantage point on my sweet neighbor! When he achieves a moment of perfection in his craft -- a flawlessly spiraled barrel, a mound of powder measured to the grain -- he beams like the high salt sun. What a lovely smile.
zh: 哦，我有幸近观我这位可爱的邻居！每当他在手艺上臻于完美的一刻——一支旋得毫厘不差的枪管，一堆精确到颗粒的火药——他便笑得如盐空之上的高阳。多么可爱的笑容。

src:
Oh, I sell whatever sundries that meet my standards of quality, with some measure of curation. I try to ensure that my shelves carry a bit of many things, but you can count on finding more than enough ammunition and a few recoilers that can lead you back here in difficult times.

If you have anything in need of identification or repair, I can take care of that for you for a few drams as well.
zh:
噢，只要合我品质标准的杂货我都卖，也略加甄选。我尽量让货架上样样都有一点，不过弹药你尽可放心，管够；还有几只返程器，困顿之时能带你回到这里。

你若有什么需要鉴定或修理的东西，我也可代劳，收几个打兰便是。

src:
Oh, I'm fine, fine.

I simply adore being assigned this stinking backwater musa grove after decades of service, unceremoniously dumped in an office next to a fleshy tinker who works day and night, making all manner of racket through the thinnest, most conductive walls ever crafted.

What is it humans say? "Living the dreen?" Yes, I am living the dreen.
zh:
哦，我好得很，好得很。

几十年效力之后，被派来这片臭气熏天的穆萨蕉偏僻林地，被不由分说地扔进一间办公室，隔壁就住着一个昼夜不歇的血肉修补匠，隔着有史以来最薄、最导声的墙壁闹出各种喧嚣——我简直欣喜若狂。

你们人类怎么说来着？“过着美梦般的日子？”对，我正过着美梦般的日子。

src: Oh, Sheba Hagadias. She's the librarian at the cathedral of the Six Day Stilt. My water-sister and cohort in chrome.
zh: 噢，舍芭·哈加迪亚斯。她是六日高塔大教堂的藏书官。我的水姊妹，铬道上的同伴。

src: Oh, another of our dwellers. I won't speak to what Crowsong's deal is. Best you find them and ask yourself.
zh: 噢，又一位我们的居民。鸦歌是怎么回事，我不便多言。你最好自己去找祂问问。

src: Oh, do you mean this thing?

Oh, how your words rasp my soul, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You abrade me.

Let us speak no more.
zh:
唉，你的话刺痛我的灵魂，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你磨损了我。

我们不必再谈了。

src:
Oh, it changes by the hour, sometimes the minute. Preserve this, observe that, add anything, taste everything.

But the starapple of my eye, the Spindle up which I cast my ambitious gaze... is edible vapor. Food that you eat, food that you breathe. Sadly, to date the most I have managed is an herbed saline suspension. Salty air, if you will.
zh:
哦，那每个钟点都在变，有时每一分钟都在变。这个要保存，那个要观察，什么都往里加，什么都要尝。

但我心头的星苹果，我雄心勃勃向其仰望的纺锤……是可食的蒸气。一种你既吃得、也吸得的食物。可惜，迄今为止，我至多做出一种加了香草的盐溶悬浮液。算是咸味的空气吧，你若愿意这么说。

src: Oh, it is you. Stay safe.
Oh, it is you. Thank you for helping the village.
zh: 哦，是你。多谢你帮了村子。

src: Oh, it's the silver rondure. It's a mark of devotion to the Kasaphescence.
zh: 噢，那是银色圆球。是对圣化现虔信的标记。

src:
Oh, it's you. Need to rest by the fire?

It's fine, my wrath has clarified. You were never the problem. Live and drink.
zh:
噢，是你。想在火边歇歇吗？

没事，我的火气已经消了。从头到尾，问题都不在你。且生且饮。

src: Oh, look. It is a not-bear. Greetings, not-bear.
zh: 哦，瞧。是只非熊。你好，非熊。

src: Oh, no, Eskhind is deathly afraid of saltbacks. She would never get close enough to trade with a dromad merchant.
zh: 噢，不，埃斯金德怕盐背兽怕得要命。她绝不敢走近到与单峰驼商交易的地步。

src: Oh, no, that wouldn't be Kesehind. He'd sooner die of fever than choke down a single stem of yuckwheat.
zh: 噢，不，那不会是凯塞因德。他宁可烧热病死，也不肯咽下一根苦麦秆。

src: Oh, not very much. The only kendren who were allowed in the village before you are traders, and it's always a very big fuss when one comes by. It's been a while since that happened, though, so any kendren who have visited must have come in secret.
zh: 噢，不太了解。在你之前获准入村的肯德伦人只有商贩，每回有人来都要闹得很大动静。不过已经很久没有过了，所以凡来过的肯德伦人，想必都是偷偷来的。

src:
Oh, so =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast=, and what a sight. Please forgive my distance, but I am loath to touch it.

It appeareth of similar make to the children, and I believe its jaw seeketh them. Lebah claimeth that the device grants freedom, and I wonder what that freedom will look like. Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye should:thou shouldst= speak to the watchers of the children for further insight.
zh:
哦，=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=果然找到了，好一副模样。请原谅我离得远些，我实在不愿触碰它。

它的形制与孩子们相似，我想它的颚正在寻觅他们。利巴称这装置赐人自由，我不知那自由会是何等模样。或许=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=应去向孩子们的守望者请教，以求进一步的见解。

src: Oh, so it called to you, a fellow dying animal?
zh: 哦，那么它在向你呼唤，一头同样垂死的野兽？

src:
Oh, so you have! Amazing work, kendren. We owe you more than we can give, but here is what we can give nonetheless.

You are more than welcome here in Bey Lah any time.
zh:
噢，你真找回来了！干得漂亮，肯德伦。我们欠你的比我们能给的更多，不过这是我们力所能及的一点心意。

欢迎你随时到贝拉来。

src:
Oh, truly? You won't regret this, kendren, I promise! So, let's get to it!

Every mystery hinges on the detection and interpretation of evidence. As Hemlock Cones said:

Ere any prosecution can commence,
Accusers must obtain some evidence.
The solving lies in seeing and locating
Supporting clues as well as implicating.
zh:
哦，当真？你不会后悔的，肯德伦，我保证！那么，开始吧！

每桩谜案都系于证据的发现与解读。正如铁杉锥所言：

欲提控诉，先得证据在手，
指证之人，须有凭据可守。
破案之要，在于察看与寻觅，
佐证与罪证，皆当收入眼底。

src: Oh, very funny. Live and drink.

Oh, we're in but the first phase of its foundation. The church has amassed a splendid collection of scripts through the years. Glorious Shekhinah, praise be upon Him, gifted us with several caches. The eremites work day and night reproducing them in the scriptorium, and I have taken it upon myself to beseech travelers, for the rarest finds often come from the least likely places.
zh: 哦，我们才刚刚打下根基。教会多年来积攒了一批卓绝的经卷。荣耀的舍金纳，愿赞美归于祂，曾赐予我们数处藏匿的典籍。隐修士们日夜在抄经房里誊录，而我自己则担起了向旅人恳求的差事，因为最稀罕的发现，往往出自最意想不到的地方。

src:
Oh, yes. Never doubt this.

Can one return? Hmm. There's the rub.
zh:
噢，能的。莫要怀疑。

能回来吗？嗯，难就难在这里。

src:
Oh, yes. You see, years and years ago, we were studying optics in the course of our research into laser technology. Barathrum was giving a lecture to some guest attendees, and...

Oh, I'd rather not talk about it.
zh:
哦，是的。你瞧，多年以前，我们在研究激光技术的过程中钻研过光学。当时巴拉斯鲁姆正给几位来访的客人讲课，然后……

哦，我还是不提为好。

src:
Oh, yes? I see. Well.

Do you... not hunt? Or align with hunters? You reek of predation yourself. You kill, yes?

I recall no promise to become a grazing hedonist. If I am called to hunt I will hunt.
zh:
哦，是吗？我明白了。好吧。

你……不猎杀吗？或是与猎手为伍？你自己便一身捕食者的腥气。你杀戮，是吗？

我不记得许诺过要成为食草的享乐者。若有召唤，我便狩猎。

src:
Oh, you died. That's okay. It's a very common occurance in the world of Qud.

Because the tutorial drops you off in Classic mode with permadeath, your character is wiped when you die.

The good news is: you get to make a whole new character! Now with a little more knowledge than you had before.
zh:
啊，你死了。这没什么。在卡德的世界里，这是再寻常不过的事。

由于教程把角色放在开启永久死亡的经典模式下，你的人物一旦死去便会被抹除。

好消息是：你可以重新造一个全新的人物！而且这一次，你懂得比先前多了一点。

src:
Oh.

Ayvah, she-- Eskhind wrote this about... me? How my head swims at these lavish words. If she wrote this and meant it for me, she must... love me.

But it can't be. Can it?
zh:
噢。

艾瓦，她——埃斯金德写的是……我？这般华美的词句，让我头晕目眩。若她写下这些并有心赠我，那她一定是……爱着我。

可这不可能。是吗？

哦。

可是……现在怎么办？

src:
Oh.

Oh.

Did... you recover Kindrish?
zh:
哦。

哦。

你……找回金德里什了吗？

src:
Oh.

Well then, I suppose I have no insight for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.
zh:
哦。

那么，我想我无可赐教于=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=了。

src:
Oh. Are you lost, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

I don't mind that you're here, but I was not expecting anyone.
zh:
哦。你迷路了吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

你在这儿我倒不介意，只是没想到会有人来。

src:
Oh. Esk and I, we had a place... there's a path to the =EskhindRoadDirection= that leads to the remains of a lightning-struck tree, made hollow by the fire from above. It was the furthest from the village either of us had ever been, until I attended my first warden's moot.

She and I would spend time there, back then. Perhaps she is there now, but I don't dare check.
zh:
哦。埃斯克和我，我们有个地方……往=EskhindRoadDirection=有条小径，通向一棵遭雷击的树的残骸，被天上的火烧得中空。在我参加第一次守望者会盟之前，那是我们俩所到过的离村最远的地方。

那时她和我常在那里消磨时光。或许她如今就在那里，但我不敢去看。

src: Oh. It looks like you are sorting screws and fasteners.
zh: 哦。你好像在分拣螺丝和紧固件。

src:
Oh. Oh no. Yes, that's. That's mine.

I meant to burn it. I probably should have burned it. I wish I had burned it.

May I please have it back?
zh:
噢。噢，不。是的，那是……那是我的。

我本想把它烧了。我大概早该烧了它。真希望我烧了它。

能请你还给我吗？

src:
Oh. She's, well, she's a good person with strong convictions, or has always seemed so. I suppose that isn't helpful.

Esk has a good eye for detail. She hates watervine so much that she avoids the paddies and won't eat matz without lah broth to make it taste better. Umm, she's afraid of saltbacks. She's good at foraging and terrible at crafting.

I've missed her so much.
zh:
噢。她……嗯，她是个有坚定信念的好人，至少一向看来如此。我想这说不上有用。

埃斯观察入微。她那么恨水藤，所以总避着稻田，吃马茨时若无拉花汤调味便不肯下咽。呃，她怕盐背兽。她擅长采集，却拙于手工。

我好想念她。

src:
Oh. Well, yes, that's... that's a good idea. You'll help, right? My axe-arm and conviction are strong, but deduction has never been my greatest strength.

I can answer questions about the people in town, if that would be helpful.
zh:
哦。嗯，是，这……这个主意不错。你会帮忙的，对吧？我的斧臂和信念都很强，但推理从来不是我的长处。

若有帮助，我可以回答关于镇上人的问题。

src:
Oh. Yes, this does indicate that some kind of =motive.influence= transpired, and =thief.name|strip= was trying to hide it.

So what you're saying is....
zh:
哦。是了，这确实表明发生过某种=motive.influence=之事，而=thief.name|strip=一直想把它掩盖起来。

所以你的意思是……

src: Oh... oh! It's you! You are a dear friend, indeed. Of course, of course! You and your bear friends are most welcome to my Spindle.
zh: 哦……哦！是你！你果然是挚友。自然，自然！你与你的熊友，我的纺锤欢迎之至。

src: Oh? A traveler? I see you, then. Live... and drink.
zh: 哦？旅人？那么，我看见你了。且生……且饮。

src: Oh? Is it really over? I'm afraid.
zh: 哦？真的结束了吗？我好怕。

src: Oh? Oh! Do pick up the mopango recipe for bone babka while you're there, won't you? I must know how they make it so dense.
zh: 哦？哦！你去那儿时，务必替我带回莫潘戈做骨头巴布卡糕的配方，好不好？我非得弄明白，他们是怎么把它做得那样瓷实的。

src:
Oh? Oh. {{emote|*Mehmet pauses.*}}

Don't like the look o' that thing. Best bring it to Elder. Hut's northwise up the path.
zh:
哦？哦。{{emote|*梅赫梅特顿了顿。*}}

这东西看着可不妙。最好拿给长老看。他的小屋沿路往北走就到。

src: Oil smears and arc burns stripe the flesh that peeks out from under the frustum of =pronouns.possessive= habit, and the tools belted to =pronouns.possessive= waistline put a sag in =pronouns.possessive= breeches. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:are:afterpronoun= guided by the stitch of =pronouns.possessive= order's diasporic emblem, set with a magnetic needle, and pointing =pronouns.objective= toward the wild gardens beyond the wall.
zh: =pronouns.possessive=会衣的锥形体之下露出的皮肉上，划着油污与电弧的灼痕；系在=pronouns.possessive=腰间的一应器具，把=pronouns.possessive=马裤坠得松垮下垂。=pronouns.Subjective=循=pronouns.possessive=会团那散居者徽记的针脚而行——徽上嵌着一枚磁针，正把=pronouns.objective=指往墙外那些荒长的园圃。

src: Oiled and brushed mail hang across =pronouns.possessive= crooked spine and salient jaw. The color too was sucked out of =pronouns.possessive= irises by =pronouns.possessive= tangled lineage, and =pronouns.possessive= wet rosy lips catch the light and toss it back across a sharp sneer.
zh: 上过油、刷得发亮的锁甲披挂在=pronouns.possessive=弯曲的脊背与突出的下颌上。=pronouns.possessive=瞳中的颜色亦被=pronouns.possessive=纷繁的世系吸尽，=pronouns.possessive=湿润的玫瑰色双唇接住光线，又将光抛洒过一道尖刻的冷笑。

src: Oiled and brushed mail hang across =pronouns.possessive= crooked spine and salient jaw. The color too was sucked out of =pronouns.possessive= irises by =pronouns.possessive= tangled lineage, and =pronouns.possessive= wet rosy lips catch the light and toss it back across a sharp sneer. =pronouns.Possessive= chest is exploded upward in emulation of =pronouns.possessive= advanced peerage.
zh: 上油刷净的锁甲挂在=pronouns.possessive=弯曲的脊背与突出的颌骨上。=pronouns.possessive=瞳中的颜色也已被=pronouns.possessive=纠缠的血脉抽干，=pronouns.possessive=湿润的玫瑰色双唇接住光，又将其抛过一道尖锐的冷笑。=pronouns.Possessive=胸膛向上高耸，仿效=pronouns.possessive=显赫的爵阶。

src: Oiled and brushed mail hang across =pronouns.possessive= crooked spine and salient jaw. The color too was sucked out of =pronouns.possessive= irises by =pronouns.possessive= tangled lineage, and =pronouns.possessive= wet rosy lips catch the light and toss it back across a sharp sneer. =pronouns.Possessive= hands stick to the cold barrel of =pronouns.possessive= gun.
zh: 上油刷净的锁甲挂在=pronouns.possessive=弯曲的脊背与突出的颌骨上。=pronouns.possessive=瞳中的颜色也已被=pronouns.possessive=纠缠的血脉抽干，=pronouns.possessive=湿润的玫瑰色双唇接住光，又将其抛过一道尖锐的冷笑。=pronouns.Possessive=双手紧贴着=pronouns.possessive=枪身冰冷的管壁。

src: Oiled and brushed mail hang across =pronouns.possessive= crooked spine and salient jaw. The color too was sucked out of =pronouns.possessive= irises by =pronouns.possessive= tangled lineage, and =pronouns.possessive= wet rosy lips catch the light and toss it back across a sharp sneer. =pronouns.Subjective==verb:'re:afterpronoun= puffed up in emulation of =pronouns.possessive= peerage and the symbol of =pronouns.possessive= sword.
zh: 上油刷净的锁甲挂在=pronouns.possessive=弯曲的脊背与突出的颌骨上。=pronouns.possessive=瞳中的颜色也已被=pronouns.possessive=纠缠的血脉抽干，=pronouns.possessive=湿润的玫瑰色双唇接住光，又将其抛过一道尖锐的冷笑。=pronouns.Subjective=意气张扬，仿效=pronouns.possessive=爵阶与=pronouns.possessive=剑之象征。

src: Oiled and brushed mail hang across =pronouns.possessive= crooked spine and salient jaw. The color too was sucked out of =pronouns.possessive= irises by =pronouns.possessive= tangled lineage, and =pronouns.possessive= wet rosy lips catch the light and toss it back across a sharp sneer. =pronouns.Subjective==verb:'re:afterpronoun= saddled under the weight of the Holy Rhombus.
zh: 上油刷净的锁甲挂在=pronouns.possessive=弯曲的脊背与突出的颌骨上。=pronouns.possessive=瞳中的颜色也已被=pronouns.possessive=纠缠的血脉抽干，=pronouns.possessive=湿润的玫瑰色双唇接住光，又将其抛过一道尖锐的冷笑。=pronouns.Subjective=负着圣菱的重担。

src: Oily skinstuff whorls in eddies of purgatory gray and hardens to diamond at the claws. The shedim were star-toted off their god moon, bargained in one-hundred-year rituals to the machinic archons, and kept as pets. Once history lengthened down the dark well of the sultanate, they were poached to extinction for the milk of their precious irises.
zh: 油腻的皮肤之质，在炼狱灰色的涡流中盘旋，到爪尖处硬化成钻石。谢德曾被星际携运，离开其神月，经百年一度的仪式讲定，转让给机械执政官，被当作宠物豢养。待到历史沿着苏丹国的黑暗深井愈拖愈长，它们便因其珍贵虹膜中的乳汁，被偷猎至灭绝。

src: Old alps opened in the ageless past fill with a cool brine.
zh: 亘古开裂的旧高山谷地，盈满清凉卤水。

src: Old stone worked to waist height to stop spilling but not seeing.
zh: 古老的石头砌至齐腰，只拦溢流，不挡视线。

src:
Omonporch is a fine source of bananas, but I have little to say about self-appointed nobility.

Claimed authority has a heady aroma, but no broth beneath it. Let us simply appease Asphodel and leave xem to xyr fantasies.
zh:
奥蒙门廊是上好的香蕉产地，至于那自封的贵胄，我没什么可说。

自称的权威，香气扑鼻，汤底却空空如也。我们只管安抚阿斯福德尔，任其沉溺于幻想便是。

src: On =day= of =month=, at a tavern near =landmark.nearest=, =name= met with a group of kippers and, divinely inspired by =spice:elements.entity@elements[random].practices.!random=, cooked and feasted on =this.refname=.
zh: =day=，即=month=之月，=name=在=landmark.nearest=附近的一家酒馆里，会晤一群腌鱼师，受=spice:elements.entity@elements[random].practices.!random=神启，烹食了=this.refname=，大快朵颐。

src: On =day= of =month=, in the year of =year=, =name= took a vow of silence and removed =player.their= own tongue.
On a fluctuating whim converged upon Our Radiant Mother.
zh: 一念无常，便汇聚于我们光辉的母亲身旁。

src: On activation, this item obliterates all nearby members of a faction chosen from among those that existed during the time of the sultanate.
zh: 启用时，此物将消灭附近所有属于某派系的成员；派系须为苏丹国时代已存在者。

src: On my honor, =player.formalAddressTerm=, my goods are of only the highest quality and I offer a fair trade.
zh: 以我的名誉担保，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我的货只有上乘品质，买卖也公道。

src: On the =day= of =month=, =name= died peacefully and was laid to rest in the Tomb of Sultans.
zh: 于=month==day=，=name=安然离世，葬入苏丹之墓。

src: On the =day= of =month=, =name= stumbled upon the flattened remains of a vainglorious humanoid. From that day forth, =name= always kept some mechanical wings on =player.their= person.
zh: =month=月=day=日，=name=偶然发现一具虚荣自大的人形生物被压扁的残骸。自那日起，=name=始终将一对机械之翼带在=player.their=身边。

src: On the =day= of =month=, =name= uncorked the cosmic wine and imbibed the forbidden starjuice. O, the mass within!
zh: =month==day=日，=name=启开宇宙之酒，饮下禁忌的星汁。噫，其内之质何其重也！

src: On the =day= of =month=, a fallen cherub gifted his broken wings to the traveler =name=.
zh: =month=月=day=日，一位堕落的智天使将他折断的羽翼赠予旅人=name=。

src: On the =day= of =month=, you abandoned all hope.

On the =day= of =month=, you arrive at the oasis-hamlet of {{green|Joppa}}, along the far rim of {{Y|Moghra'yi, the Great Salt Desert}}.

All around you, moisture farmers tend to groves of viridian watervine. There are huts wrought from rock salt and brinestalk.

On the horizon, {{r|Qud's}} jungles strangle chrome steeples and rusted archways to the earth. Further and beyond, the fabled {{C|Spindle}} rises above the fray and pierces the cloud-ribboned sky.
zh:
=month=月=day=日，你抵达了绿洲村落{{green|约帕}}，它坐落于{{Y|莫格拉伊，大盐漠}}的远缘。

四野之中，汲水农人照料着一丛丛青翠的水藤。屋舍以岩盐与盐茎筑成。

天际线上，{{r|卡德}}的丛林将铬钢尖塔与锈蚀拱门勒入大地。更远处，传说中的{{C|纺锤}}高出纷扰之上，刺穿缀满云带的长空。

src:
On the =day= of =month=, you arrive at the village of {{g|=state.string:villageZeroName=}}.

On the horizon, {{r|Qud's}} jungles strangle chrome steeples and rusted archways to the earth. Further and beyond, the fabled {{C|Spindle}} rises above the fray and pierces the cloud-ribboned sky.
zh:
=month=月=day=日，你抵达了村庄{{g|=state.string:villageZeroName=}}。

天际线上，{{r|卡德}}的丛林将铬钢尖塔与锈蚀拱门勒入大地。更远处，传说中的{{C|纺锤}}高出纷扰之上，刺穿缀满云带的长空。

src: On the =day= of =month=, you arrived at =villageName=.
On the =day= of =month=, you scuttle down a dark shaft at the edge of a sunken trade path and arrive at a caravanserai. It's powdered in salt and dust from across the ribbon of time.
zh: =month==day=，你顺着沉没商道边缘的幽暗竖井爬下去，来到一座商队客栈。它覆满了盐与尘土，那尘土来自时光长河的彼岸。

src: On the auspicious =day= of =month=, =player.name= arrived in =villageName= and began =player.their= prodigious odyssey through Qud.
zh: =month=月=day=日，吉日，=player.name=抵达=villageName=，开始了=player.their=横贯卡德的非凡游历。

src: On the countenance, ribbons of alabaster cloud circumscribe a lapis sea and forests of jade. At the median of it all, a Spindle pierces the outer rondure and disappears beyond the composition. A second obstructed spire, what must be the Spindle's shadow, soaks up the light thrown off by the southern sky of crystal white. The inside of the mask is ribboned with burnt tracery from where it was molded on a gallium lathe, then dyed with the milked irises of shedim and set to dry in a pool of warm static.
zh: 面庞上，一道道雪花石膏般的云带，环绕着青金石的海洋与翡翠的森林。万物之中，一座纺锤刺穿外环，消失于画面之外。第二座被遮蔽的尖塔，想必是纺锤之影，吸尽了水晶白南天投下的光。面具内侧，布满灼烧的纹饰，是在镓车床上模铸时留下的，继而以谢德乳白的虹膜染色，置于一池温热的静电中晾干。

src: On the recommendation of a proselyte, you visited the merchant bazaar and grand cathedral at the Six Day Stilt.
zh: 一位传教者建议你前去，于是你拜访了六日高塔的商贩集市与大教堂。

src: On the wrist mount, echo-shaped models in three dimensions expose the structural irregularities of simple inanimate objects nearby.
zh: 腕座之上，回声形状的三维模型显出附近简单死物的结构缺陷。

src:
Once in the fullness of time there met
the Fool of the Gyre and a wanderer.
The Fool offered a tale of the Reshephs,
and the wanderer sat to hear.
zh:
在时光圆满之际，曾有
回旋愚者与一名游荡者相遇。
愚者献上一则利悉诸王的故事，
游荡者便坐下来听。

src:
Once in the fullness of time there met
the Fool of the Gyre and a wanderer.
The Fool offered stories of journeyers past
and the wanderer sat to hear.
zh:
在时光圆满之际，曾有
回旋愚者与一名游荡者相遇。
愚者献上一些往日行者的故事，
游荡者便坐下来听。

src:
Once in the fullness of time there met
the Fool of the Gyre and a wanderer.
The Fool offered stories spanning ground to sky
and the wanderer sat to hear.
zh:
在时光圆满之际，曾有
回旋愚者与一名游荡者相遇。
愚者献上自地至天的故事，
游荡者便坐下来听。

src: Once per round, when an opponent misses you with a melee attack, there's a 40% chance you make a free attack with a short blade you're wielding.
zh: 每回合一次，当对手的近战攻击未命中你时，有40%的几率以你持有的短刃发动一次免费攻击。

src: Once per turn, when an opponent misses you with a melee attack, there's a 40% chance you make a free attack with a short blade you're wielding.
zh: 每回合一次，当对手近战攻击落空时，有40%的几率以你所持的短刃免费还击一次。

src: Once quartz crystallized on the skin of a monkey bathing in the steaming pools of the subterrane. =pronouns.Subjective= was sculpted by the rasp of pressure and the hand of time, and now =pronouns.possessive= throated vowels bounce toward the ear of the void.
zh: 石英曾结晶于一只猴子身上，那猴子正沐浴于地底蒸腾的池中。压力之锉与时间之手将=pronouns.Subjective=雕琢成形，如今=pronouns.possessive=喉间的元音弹跃而出，飞向虚空之耳。

src: Once the Seraph had become convinced of the Coven's return, they reified their authority and assumed a more material role in onworld matters. The decaying sultanate was a convenient tool.
zh: 炽天使既深信盟会将归，便将其权威具象化，在世间事务中担起更实在的角色。那日渐衰朽的苏丹国，正是便利的工具。

src: Once the slynth have arrived at their new home, speak to Thah at the hydropon.
zh: 斯林斯人抵达新家后，前往水培城与塔交谈。

src:
Once, after it all burst apart,
the Fool of the Gyre met a wise jelly.
They sat in the slag of the world
and the Fool told the story of nowaday.
zh:
曾有一回，万物迸裂之后，
回旋愚者遇见一团睿智的胶冻。
他们坐在世界的熔渣之中，
愚者讲述起今日的故事。

src:
Once, in the final days of the hindriarchy, before they ended the practice, a pariah of no particular importance did find herself consigned to the gulag. Though she herself bore no honor, in her grasping hands she held the burning heart of the village champion, freely given -- for the two had fallen in love long before the heretic's conviction.

      When the jealous hindriarch discovered the missing heart of her beloved champion, she swore cruel vengeance upon the pariah. Pulling upon dark forces, she ensorcelled the pariah's ex-lover and ordered him to steal her heart again and deliver it to the hindriarch's crushing fist.

      Confronted by her ex-lover, the pariah held tight to her heart and that of the champion. Between them waged a battle of will, and the pariah was too weak to win.

      Then, at twilight in the shadow of the spindle, the hindren of Bey Lah saw an image on the horizon of justice impending. It was =name=, and upon arriving they struck the wicked hindriarch down and reunited the lovers to mend and join their hearts. After they left, the people of Bey Lah built a monument to =name=, and thenceforth called them Heartsmith.
zh:
在族长之位废止前的末年，一名无足轻重的弃民被送进了古拉格。她自己虽无荣誉在身，却用贪求的双手捧着村中冠军滚烫的心——那颗心是对方自愿交给她的，因为异端罪名成立之前，他们早已相爱。

妒心深重的族长发现她心爱的冠军之心失窃，便向弃民发誓要施以残酷报复。她召来黑暗力量，蛊惑弃民的旧情人，命他再次偷走她的心，送到族长铁掌之中。

弃民与旧情人对峙，紧紧守住自己的心，也守住冠军的心。两人展开意志之战；弃民力有不逮，终究败下阵来。

后来，黄昏时分，纺锤投下阴影，贝拉的欣德伦人看见地平线上有一道正义将临的身影。那是=name=。=name=抵达后，击倒邪恶的族长，让两位爱侣重逢，修补并连结彼此的心。=name=离开后，贝拉人民为其建起纪念碑，从此称其为“铸心者”。

src: Once-familiar paper, paint, and beads are rearranged to a beastly shape. Pale lights of Spindle color gleam in the eye sockets, and a wicked beak opens in menacing stillness. Across the visage brass chains fasten the pieces of torn innocence that craft the Murmur.
zh: 昔日熟悉的纸张、颜料与珠子，被重新排列成一副兽形。纺锤色的苍白光点在眼窝中闪烁，一张凶恶的喙在威慑的静止中张开。面庞之上，黄铜链条系着一片片撕裂的天真，拼出低语者。

src: One auspicious eve while exploring the chutes of Golgotha, =name= dreamed that =player.subjective= contracted a rotting disease and that =player.their= tongue festered and fell out. From then on, =name= vowed to always keep =player.their= tongue on =player.their= person.
zh: 某吉夕，=name=探各各他之滑槽，梦见=player.subjective=染上腐坏之疾，=player.their=舌溃烂而落。自此，=name=立誓常将=player.their=舌带于=player.their=身。

src: One auspicious evening, =name= had a dream that =player.subjective= =player.verb:were:afterPronoun= not =name= but =player.verb:were:afterPronoun= instead the =objectblueprint.name|strip= =object.name=. After a full otherlife, =player.subjective= woke from the dream in a state of deep horror.
zh: 某个吉庆之夜，=name=得一梦：=player.subjective=已非=name=，而是那=objectblueprint.name|strip==object.name=。历尽另一世之后，=player.subjective=自梦中醒来，满心深重的恐惧。

src: One auspicious evening, =name= had a dream that =player.subjective= =player.verb:were:afterPronoun= not =name= but =player.verb:were:afterPronoun= instead the =objectblueprint.name|strip= =object.name=. After a full otherlife, =player.subjective= woke from the dream in a state of deep peace.
zh: 某个吉庆之夜，=name=得一梦：=player.subjective=已非=name=，而是那=objectblueprint.name|strip==object.name=。历尽另一世之后，=player.subjective=自梦中醒来，心怀深沉的安宁。

src: One called 1-FF, who wandered in errancy out from the Tomb and was reprogrammed by the Daughter who lived and died in the rot-black box, nine Daughters ago.
zh: 有一位名叫1-FF的，从墓里漫无目的地游荡出来，被一位生死于腐黑匣中的女儿重新编程，那是九代女儿之前的事。

src: One of Bey Lah's scouts heard a fight in the watervine paddies, indicating recent violence.
zh: 贝拉的一名斥候在水藤田里听见了打斗声，说明近来发生过暴力。

src: One size fits all, =player.formalAddressTerm=. If I sell it to you, it fits.
zh: 一码通用，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我卖给你的，就合你的手。

src:
One star-ribboned night, a ray cat crossed the marshy loam and wandered into Joppa. The watervine farmers, wakened by the joyful cries of a small girl, gathered around to revel at the favorable omen and extol the generosity of the Beetle Moon. Since then, Ctesiphus =verb:have= spent =pronouns.possessive= days curled under the shade of brinestalk huts and sauntering over dirt paths. So long as =pronouns.subjective==verb:'re:afterpronoun= approached with care, =pronouns.subjective= =verb:welcome:afterpronoun= the hands of friends and strangers alike.

{{m|phosphorescent}}
zh:
一个星带横空的夜晚，一只光线猫越过沼泽的壤土，信步走进了约帕。水藤农们被一个小女孩的欢叫声惊醒，聚拢来为这吉兆欢庆，颂赞甲虫之月的慷慨。自那以后，克特西弗斯便以=pronouns.possessive=的日子在盐茎小屋的阴凉里蜷卧、在土径上闲行。只要有人小心靠近，=pronouns.subjective=便欢迎朋友与生人的手，而=pronouns.subjective=从不曾为此竖起过一根毛。

{{m|磷光}}

src: One starry evening, a babe was found swaddled with its mouth full of circuits by a group of baetyls in Red Rock. They took him into their fold and fostered him, and he became known as Resheph, the Coiled Lamb of Baetyls.
zh: 某个星夜，一群圣石在红岩发现一名襁褓婴儿，口中塞满电路。彼等将婴儿纳入门中抚养，他后来被称为利悉，圣石之盘羔。

src: One villager was frightened by sounds of fighting at night, indicating recent violence.
zh: 一名村民被夜里的打斗声吓坏了，说明近来发生过暴力。

src: One year ago, someone began broadcasting a signal from atop the Spindle. I have a recording of it here...
zh: 一年前，有人开始从纺锤之巅广播一道信号。我这里有它的录音……

src: Only a fool asketh after the meaning of a credo.
Only a great saltback could leave a print the size of a hot spring.
zh: 唯有巨大的盐背兽，才能留下如温泉般大的足印。

src: Only compatible with True Kin genotypes
Only in the Shallows' dawnstirs did I let myself think it possible. And now...
zh: 唯有在浅滩的晨曦初动之时，我才敢容自己想到此事或可成真。而如今……

src:
Only silence on the ground
met we benighted things
until the Knights Liminal
drew their lines upon the salt.

Unknowing, unseeing,
waiting only to know
who will spin us around next.
zh:
地面上唯有沉默，
迎接我等昏昧之物，
直至阈限骑士
在盐上划下他们的界线。

无知，无见，
只待知晓
下一个把我们转个圈的是谁。

src:
Only those who pay their respects to the Grave of Rebekah will know the way into the tomb.

If you make it inside, the mopango will offer you solace and knowledge, and can tell you more about the Tomb's contents.
zh:
唯有向利百加之墓致敬的人，才知道进入墓穴的路。

你若能进去，莫潘戈会给你慰藉与学识，也能告诉你墓中更多的事。

src: Onworld and inside a polyp-strewn trellis, there is a giant frog who hates you.
zh: 在地表上，息肉遍布的棚架之内，有一只巨大的青蛙恨你。

src:
Opening the ark will expose its nondeterministic core to the chamber's ambient normality and irrevocably damage Resheph. Continue?

Type =prompt= to confirm.
zh:
打开方舟会使其非决定性核心暴露于舱室环境中的常态之下，并对利悉造成不可逆的损害。是否继续？

输入=prompt=确认。

src: Opponents who are pushed through or against walls take extra weapon damage for each wall.
zh: 被推穿或撞上墙壁的对手，每道墙壁都会受到额外的武器伤害。

src: Opponents who get pushed are stunned for 1 round plus an additional round for each space pushed.
zh: 被推开的对手晕眩1回合，每被推过一格再多晕眩1回合。

src: Orbed goggles smeared with blood impart an insectoid aspect to =pronouns.possessive= face. =pronouns.Possessive= apron is stained with a rainbow of pinks, tans, and nickel -- the palette of machine and folk guts -- and spare wire shoots from =pronouns.possessive= sleeves like cuffs.
zh: 一副球面的护目镜沾满血污，给=pronouns.possessive=脸添了几分虫相。=pronouns.Possessive=围裙染着一片粉、褐与镍色交织的彩虹——那是机械与生人脏腑的色彩——备用的金属线自=pronouns.possessive=袖口探出，宛如翻边的袖头。

src: Organic matter is liquefied by the agents of decay and pressurized by tight spaces into the shapes of prismatoids. Galvanized by a cousin-instinct to hunger, the gelatin entity now extrudes itself forward in antiprism form.
zh: 腐败之力将有机质化为液体，逼仄的空间又将之压成棱柱之形。一种与饥饿同源的直觉催动着它，这团胶质之物如今以反棱柱之形向前挤出。

src: Organic matter is liquefied by the agents of decay and pressurized by tight spaces into the shapes of prismatoids. Galvanized by a cousin-instinct to hunger, the gelatin entity now extrudes itself forward in cupola form.
zh: 腐败之力将有机质化为液体，逼仄的空间又将之压成拟柱体之形。一种与饥饿同源的本能催动着它，这团胶质之物如今以穹顶之形向前挤出。

src: Organic matter is liquefied by the agents of decay and pressurized by tight spaces into the shapes of prismatoids. Galvanized by a cousin-instinct to hunger, the gelatin entity now extrudes itself forward in frustum form.
zh: 腐败之力将有机质化为液体，逼仄的空间又将之压成拟柱体之形。一种与饥饿同源的本能催动着它，这团胶质之物如今以截锥之形向前挤出。

src: Organic matter is liquefied by the agents of decay and pressurized by tight spaces into the shapes of prismatoids. Galvanized by a cousin-instinct to hunger, the gelatin entity now extrudes itself forward in prism form.
zh: 腐败之力将有机质化为液体，逼仄的空间又将之压成拟柱体之形。一种与饥饿同源的本能催动着它，这团胶质之物如今以棱柱之形向前挤出。

src: Organic matter is liquefied by the agents of decay and pressurized by tight spaces into the shapes of prismatoids. Galvanized by a cousin-instinct to hunger, the gelatin entity now extrudes itself forward in wedge form.
zh: 腐败之力将有机质化为液体，逼仄的空间又将之压成拟柱体之形。一种与饥饿同源的本能催动着它，这团胶质之物如今以楔形向前挤出。

src: Others find it difficult to tolerate you in social settings.
zh: 在社交场合，旁人难以忍受与你相处。

src:
Otho has forbidden me from requesting a sample of Klanq. I am to refrain from being puffed on, to cultivate my own!

Are we yet researchers? Is subject consent no longer adequate ethical rigor? Let Klanq puff on Dardi!
zh:
奥索禁止我向克朗克索取样本。我须得忍住不被它喷一身，好自己培养！

我们还算不算研究者？受试者同意，难道已不足以称作伦理上的严谨？让克朗克来喷达尔迪吧！

src: Otho informs me that you have a method for decoding the signal. Can you encode your instructions for the baetyl onto this disk?
zh: 奥索告诉我，你有办法解码那道信号。你能把给圣石的指令编入这张碟片吗？

src: Otho said you wished to speak with me.
Our Argent Fathers, having hardened our plasmatic Mother,
zh: 我们的银辉诸父使浆质母亲硬化，

src: Our Argent Fathers, who roamed the azure void with inert hearts,
zh: 我们的银辉诸父，曾以沉寂之心漫游碧蓝虚空，

src: Our choretime philosopher, you are mourned and celebrated. May this be the dreamless rest of which you spoke with such longing.
zh: 我们劳作时辰里的哲人，你被哀悼，也被颂扬。愿此即是你曾那般渴慕地谈起过的无梦之息。

src:
Our little sanctuary here hath a fissure in its inner walls. Find that gap and =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt= find Lebah.

Please be gentle. Ey hath ever been the most insightful reader among us, but beareth the weight of an anxious mind.
zh:
我们这小小圣所的内壁上有一道裂隙。找到那道缝隙，=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=便能找到利巴。

请温和些。彼向来是我们之中最有洞察力的读者，却背负着一颗焦虑的心。

src: Our sleepy sage. So sweet. She calms me. I sit in her room and we muse on the nature of things.
zh: 我们嗜睡的智者。那么温柔。她让我心安。我坐在她的房里，我们一同沉思万物的本性。

src: Out East? Uegh. Wouldn't go, I. Git ta Qudzu. Like as rust the pauldrons right off a-shoulders.
zh: 往东？呃。我是不去的。到了卡德葛那儿，保管锈得你肩上的护肩甲片一块块脱落。

src: Out a pristine shell of rolling citrine, frozen azure, and polished jade, the goopy neck cranes straight up and loosens a throbbing egg from =pronouns.possessive= gelatin clutch.
zh: 一只完好的壳，斑斓如流转的黄水晶、凝冻的蔚蓝与打磨的翡翠；黏稠的颈子笔直探出，自=pronouns.possessive=胶质的一窝卵中松落一枚搏动的卵。

src: Out of a gold-plated box, kaleidoscopic tiles and tones harmonize over several dimensions.
zh: 自镀金之匣中，斑斓如万花筒的砖块与音调在数个维度上相互和鸣。

src: Out of the mountain of shell a few strips of salt-coffined meat preserve.
zh: 从这山一般的壳中，尚有几条以盐为棺的肉得以留存。

src: Outside of time I found myself in a place of light. I chose to return and was made new.
zh: 在时间之外，我身处一片光明之地。我选择了回来，并得以重生。

src: Outworld hard-shelled beings were harvested from planetesimals, burned bright in the magenta exhaust of their scavengers' ships, and crushed together in astral slingshot to reentry.
zh: 外界的硬壳生灵从微行星上被收割，在拾荒者飞船品红色的尾焰中烧得通亮，又在星际的弹弓中被碾合，再度坠入大气。

src: Outworld moss clades form ribboned patterns concretizing their unknowable social dynamics. They hang in an orb from a ceiling clutch and in their starfarer landlords spark wonder.
zh: 异界的苔藓分支结成缎带般的纹路，将其不可知的社会动态具象化。它们成球悬于天花板的一束之中，在其星航者房东心中激起惊异。

src: Outworld wood of searing crimson forms the maze hedge and trellis  to an evergrowths.
zh: 异界炽红的木料，构成迷宫般的树篱，并为一株常青者搭起棚架。

src: Over there, by your workbench. Is that... Pax Klanq?
zh: 那边，你的工作台旁。那是……帕克斯·克朗克？

src: Overloaded: This item has increased performance but consumes extra charge, generates heat when used, and has a chance to break relative to its charge draw.
zh: 过载：此物性能提高，但额外耗电、使用时发热，且会依其耗电量而有几率损坏。

src: Oversized and glistening green feet pitter-patter like raindrops: quiet when alone and deafening at scale. Stirred on by a lightning-quick metabolism and shaken with thunderous pangs of hunger, =pronouns.subjective= =verb:long:afterpronoun= to grip prey in =pronouns.possessive= sticky forefeet and gnaw it to bone.
zh: 过大的、闪亮的绿色脚掌啪嗒作响，如雨滴一般：独行时静寂无声，成群时震耳欲聋。闪电般的新陈代谢催动着它，雷鸣般的饥饿摇撼着它，=pronouns.subjective=只盼以=pronouns.possessive=黏腻的前足攫住猎物，啃到见骨。

src: Ovoid spots, crimson and coral and citrine, scatter like an island chain across =pronouns.possessive= back and neck.
zh: 卵形的斑点——绯红、珊瑚、柠檬晶——如列岛般散布在=pronouns.possessive=背与颈上。

src: PERCHANCE. SOME BEETLES DOST HOP FROM LEAF TO LEAF. AND SOME DO NOT.
zh: 或许罢。有些甲虫自一叶跳至另一叶，有些则不然。

src: PETTY MORTAL! BRING ME =demand|upper=, AND I SHALL REWARD YOU WITH =reward|upper=.
zh: 渺小的凡人！为我取来=demand|upper=，我便以=reward|upper=赏你。

src:
PHANTASM'D O'RE THE THIN BOUNDARY?? 'TIS BEEN A TICK.

AND THOU, CHILD? THOU ART WHO OFF'D THE FLOW AHIND GJAUS.
zh:
幻影般越过那薄薄的界线？？已过了一瞬。

而汝，孩子？汝乃是那关断吉奥斯身后之流的人。

src: Packed into rents in the shale are spinescent shoots of blooming ivory.
zh: 页岩的裂罅中塞满了尖端带刺、开着象牙色花的嫩芽。

src: Padded: This item grants =protectionChance.a.number=% chance to prevent daze or stun effects, and it doubles the chance for the wearer to shake off daze and stun effects with the Shake It Off skill power.
zh: 衬垫：此物提供=protectionChance.a.number=%几率抵挡迷乱或眩晕效果，并使穿戴者以“振作精神”技艺摆脱迷乱与眩晕的几率翻倍。

src: Pailings of age-nicked iron stand in a row between two horizontal rails.
zh: 经年累月已有缺口的铁栅栏，排成一列，立于两道横轨之间。

src: Painted crenulations wrap around the equator of this metal vase.
zh: 彩绘的垛口纹样环绕着这只金属瓶的腰际。

src: Painted: This item is painted with a depiction of a historical event.
zh: 彩绘：此物上绘有一桩历史事件的图景。

src:
Painted: This item is painted with a scene from the life of the ancient =sultanTerm= {{magenta|=sultan=}}:

=painting=
zh:
绘饰：此物上绘有一幅取自古代=sultanTerm={{magenta|=sultan=}}生平的图景：

=painting=

src:
Painted: This object is painted with a scene from the history of the village {{M|=villageName=}}:

=event=
zh:
彩绘：此物上绘有村庄{{M|=villageName=}}历史中的一幕：

=event=

src: Pallid leg-things twitch with zoetic insistence, and a pair of fangs poke at nothing.
zh: 苍白的肢状之物抽动着，透出生机般的执拗，一对獠牙向空处乱刺。

src: Pallid leg-things twitch with zoetic insistence, and a pair of incandescent fangs poke at nothing.
zh: 苍白的肢状之物抽动着，透出生机般的执拗，一对白炽的獠牙向空处乱刺。

src: Pallid leg-things twitch with zoetic insistence, and a pair of rank fangs poke at nothing.
zh: 苍白的肢状之物抽动着，透出生机般的执拗，一对腐臭的獠牙向空处乱刺。

src: Pallid leg-things twitch with zoetic insistence, and a pair of zigzag fangs poke at nothing.
zh: 苍白的肢状之物抽动着，透出生机般的执拗，一对锯齿獠牙向空处乱刺。

src: Pallid leg-things twitch with zoetic insistence.
zh: 苍白的肢状之物抽动着，透出生机般的执拗。

src: Panes of polished glass were frosted dark and fit on a slide rail.
zh: 几片磨光的玻璃被磨砂成暗色，嵌在滑轨上。

src: Panes of see-through and polished glass are fit on a slide rail.
zh: 几片透明而磨光的玻璃嵌在滑轨上。

src: Paper made of brinestalk pulp is covered in a shaky ink scrawl. It looks like it's been crumpled and uncrumpled many times.
zh: 盐茎浆制成的纸，满布颤抖的墨迹。看上去已被揉皱又展平过许多回。

src: Papyraceous crysteel tissue sways in soft waves and aerates the carousel interior. The enclosure gives the impression of being inside an island fish.
zh: 纸质般的晶钢薄膜随柔波摇曳，为旋转舱的内部送风。这封闭空间给人一种置身岛鱼腹中的感觉。

src: Paracausal circuitry excites the structure of spacetime into a normotropic particulate.
zh: 超因果电路激扰时空之构，使之凝为正向趋化的微粒。

src: Particles blip off a probabilistic core and appear traced across discrete shells of energy.
zh: 粒子自概率之核迸出，在离散的能量壳层上显出轨迹。

src: Particles of ice rain sail in small and circular ribbons.
zh: 冰雨的微粒，在细小的环状飘带中飞舞。

src: Particles pop on a glassy placenta separating the disordered world from a great inner dome of even vaster disorder. =pronouns.Subjective= moves in a quantized foxtrot, quivering across the boundary of local spacetime and only settling somewhere when entanglement demands it.
zh: 粒子在一层玻璃般的胎盘上爆响，那胎盘隔开了失序的世界与一个更为失序的巨大内穹。=pronouns.Subjective=跳着量子化的狐步，在局域时空的边界上战栗，唯有纠缠要求它落定，它才在某处落定。

src: Particles spin in the molecular orrery of =pronouns.possessive= engine and whir against =pronouns.possessive= chrome-plated chassis. Life-lint powders the inside of =pronouns.possessive= elliptical cannon.
zh: 粒子在=pronouns.possessive=引擎的分子天体运行仪中旋转，嗡嗡地磨着=pronouns.possessive=镀铬的机壳。生命的绒屑如粉般洒满=pronouns.possessive=椭圆炮管的内部。

src: Particulate from the eons-sheared shale sticks in the fibers of goat wool. They make red freckles on the garment.
zh: 自历经万古剪削的页岩上飘落的微粒，粘附在山羊毛的纤维间，在衣上点出红色的雀斑。

src: Pass. This task is not to my liking.
Pastes and jams of various colors smear =pronouns.possessive= apron like a painter's palette. Flour dusts =pronouns.possessive= broad, dough-kneading knuckles.
zh: 各色酱料与果酱把=pronouns.possessive=围裙抹得如同一块画家的调色板。面粉撒在=pronouns.possessive=那揉面的宽大指节上。

src: Patience, Warden. I'll get to the bottom of this.
zh: 耐心些，守望者。我会查个水落石出。

src: Patinae have transformed the cyclopean bronze doors into great shelves of seafoam and coral. Lyrical death is depicted on the panels in high relief: chained cables lift inverted pyramids through a calcified village, gaseous fire, and vaults of brine. Skeleton harpists traipse across the freize, and goats chew copper bones on the cornices.
zh: 铜绿已把这对独眼巨人般的青铜门化作海沫与珊瑚的巨架。门板上以高浮雕绘出诗意的死：锁链悬起的倒金字塔穿过一座钙化的村落、气态的火焰与盐水的穹室。骷髅竖琴手在横饰带上行走，山羊在檐口上啃食铜骨。

src: Patinae have transformed the cyclopean bronze doors into great shelves of seafoam and coral. The theatre of life is depicted on the panels in high relief: palm leaves lift pyramids into the star-ribboned sky, and water pours over the lip of an oinochoe. Lovers yoke across the freize, and goats chew copper cud on the cornices.
zh: 铜绿已把这对独眼巨人般的青铜门化作海沫与珊瑚的巨架。门板上以高浮雕绘出生命的剧场：棕榈叶把金字塔托入镶着星带的天空，水自一只酒壶的口沿倾出。恋人在横饰带上相并而行，山羊在檐口上反刍铜料。

src: Patting or rolling firefighting actions are 25% as effective
zh: 拍打或翻滚灭火的效果仅为25%

src: Pax Klanq has agreed to build the climber. What now?
zh: 帕克斯·克朗克已同意建造攀升器。接下来呢？

src:
Pax Klanq is an eccentric mushroom prodigy. All their faults aside, they are a brilliant scientist and engineer, and I have little doubt that they could build the climber faster than we could. Several years have passed since we were last in contact, but they owe us a debt, and we must now collect.

Unfortunately, no one knows Pax Klanq's whereabouts. Through contacts I made over the years, I inquired as to their location. The most I was able to garner were these enigmatic instructions:

"Seek the heart of the rainbow, eat the god's flesh, and follow the Coral Path."
zh:
帕克斯·克朗克是个古怪的蘑菇神童。抛开种种毛病，他们是位出色的科学家与工程师，我毫不怀疑他们造攀升器会比我们更快。我们上次联络已是数年前，但他们欠我们一份人情，如今该讨还了。

不幸的是，无人知晓帕克斯·克朗克的下落。我通过多年来结识的门路打听他们的所在，所得至多不过这几句晦涩的指引：

“寻彩虹之心，食神之肉，循珊瑚之路而行。”

src:
Pax Klanq will mold the creature from raw bioelectrical materials. You must gather these entrails: the body as a model, the catalyst to charge the sanguine fluid, the atzmus as deistic direction, the armament for protection, and the hamsa for personality. You will bond with the creature, too, and act as its pilot. So you must speak an incantation to inscribe the connection.

You'll also need to procure the sanguine fluid itself. And, too, a power source shielded from electromagnetic attacks.
zh:
帕克斯·克朗克将用生物电原料塑造这生灵。你须采集这些脏腑：作为模型的躯体，为血红液充电的催化剂，作为神性指引的本质，用于护身的军械，以及赋予性格的护符。你还将与这生灵缔结联结，并充当它的驾驭者。所以你须诵读一道咒文，以铭刻这联结。

你还须取得那血红液本身。此外，还要一个能抵御电磁攻击的能源。
帕克斯·克朗克安好，想必如此？

src: Pay homage, lightseeker! Make an offering at the Well!
zh: 致以敬意吧，寻光者！在圣井献上供物！

src: Peace and health in the light of the Star, pilgrim. Brood with me on the life of Resheph, if you are willing.
zh: 愿平安与健康在星辰之光中与你同在，朝圣者。你若愿意，与我一同默想利悉的一生吧。

src: Peeled lagroot tuber was mashed, salted, and jarred.
zh: 剥皮的迟根块茎被捣烂，加盐，装罐。
穿透成功，判定：=roll= 最终：=result=
穿透加成：=bonus= 上限：=maxbonus= 已用：=used= 目标：=target=（穿透=pens.things:次=）

src: Perch fish leather boots, finest make. They were either stolen from the crypt of an older Eater or fashioned by a cordwainer to look like it.
zh: 鲈鱼皮革长靴，上乘之作。它们不是自某位年长食者的墓穴中盗来，便是由鞋匠仿其样式制成。

src: Perch fish leather was worn by fishworkers in the earlier sultanate, but by the time of =spice.entity:name= it was prized by gentlefolk. This pair is exquisitely crafted.
zh: 鲈鱼皮革在早期苏丹国时为渔工所穿，到了=spice.entity:name=的年代，却成了仕绅所珍。这一双做工极为精湛。

src: Perch fish nursed in the aquarium silos of a vacated sector were netted and skinned into strips. Those strips were tanned with chrome and stitched into this vest.
zh: 鲈鱼养于弃置街区的水产筒仓之中，捕网捞起，剥皮成条，又以铬鞣制，缝成了这件背心。

src: Perfect-cut chrome rotors are stacked along a generator shaft, and wide fin blades catch the fluid push and spin electric yarn.
zh: 精密切削的铬制转子沿发电机轴层层叠起，宽大的鳍叶承接流体的推力，纺出电的纱线。

src: Perhaps I shall visit. Live and drink.
zh: 也许我会去看看。且生且饮。

src: Perhaps I'm mistaken. Live and drink.
zh: 也许是我弄错了。且生且饮。

src: Perhaps being Chavvah's parasite is affecting your mind.
zh: 或许做查娃的寄生虫，影响了你的神智。

src:
Perhaps it was too much to wish that Bey Lah would change.

But Esk is happy again. That makes me feel happy too.
zh:
或许，盼着贝拉有所改变，本就是奢求。

不过埃斯又高兴起来了，我也跟着欢喜。

src: Perhaps they thought they could find =valuedOre= here.
zh: 也许他们以为能在这里找到=valuedOre=。

src:
Perhaps we are,
perhaps we are.
What wiggles in the hot soil?
Flagella?

Or could it be a tail?
zh:
或许我们是，
或许我们是。
热土中扭动的是什么？
鞭毛？

或者那是一条尾巴？

src: Perhaps we will find out. Live and drink.
zh: 或许我们会知道的。且生且饮。

src: Perhaps you should get back to it rather than hanging around my village. Warden Neelahind may be able to help you.
zh: 或许你该回去继续办差，而不是在我的村里闲逛。守望者尼拉欣德或可助你。

src:
Perhaps. My future is hazy. My future twists in the chill wind of the Gyre. I can have no faith in your vision. You understand this, yes?

I do not wish to know you.

Live and drink.
zh:
或许吧。我的未来混沌不明。我的未来在回旋的寒风中扭曲。我无法信任你的见解。你明白这一点，是吗？

我不愿认识你。

且生且饮。

src: Perpendicular to the neon azure barrel is a square-plated scope inset with a large ocular lens. The sight through the lens distorts as the gun tilts, but the vector drawn remains unchanged.
zh: 与霓虹蔚蓝的枪管垂直的，是一块方形镶板瞄具，嵌着一枚硕大的目镜。透过镜片所见的景象会随枪身倾斜而扭曲，但所绘的矢量不变。

src: Peruse my wares, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Adorn your head or heads.
zh: 请细看我的货品，=player.formalAddressTerm=。为你的头，或你的诸头，添些装饰。

src: Phase effects last twice as long.
zh: 相位效果的持续时间加倍。

src: Phase-Harmonic: This weapon can affect both in-phase and out-of-phase objects.
zh: 相位谐调：此武器既能作用于同相之物，也能作用于异相之物。

src: Phase-conjugate: This explosive shifts phase immediately before detonating.
zh: 相位共轭：此爆炸物会在引爆前一刻转换相位。

src: Phial-mother, font of solutions, your merry bubbling will be so dearly missed.
zh: 小瓶之母，溶液之泉，你那欢快的汩汩声将被深深怀念。
哲人,村长,长老,理论家,诡辩家

src: Photovoltaics are arrayed across two socketed lunes. They spin for optimal range and confer sun energy to a vacuum-cased flywheel.
zh: 光伏板排布在两枚带插孔的月牙上。它们为求得最佳角度而旋转，把太阳的能量输往一只真空外壳的飞轮。

src: Pick a direction and walk in it.
Pick your active equipment set and/or manage your equipment sets.
zh: 选择当前启用的装备组，和／或管理你的装备组。

src: Picophase transceiver arrays assemble an exquisitely detailed model of one's surroundings.
zh: 皮相位收发器阵列拼出周遭环境的精微模型。

src: Pieces of the old and aching world have been shaved off their timepoint and crushed to the vicinity of the present. A few bits of recognition remain:  lens of glass, serif of ink, acid-ate lug, and ribbon of wire.
zh: 古老而痛楚的世界，其碎片自原本的时点削下，被压挤到临近当下之处。尚可辨认者寥寥：一片玻璃镜片，一笔衬线墨迹，一枚被酸蚀的凸耳，一缕线材之带。

src: Piers of stillborn glass convey the walking thing forward with grace and dumb purpose. An astral spike of head backstabs the drift wind.
zh: 死产的玻璃栈桥以优雅与沉默的目的，将这行走之物送向前方。一根星辰般的头刺自背后刺入飘流的风。

src:
Pilgrims, drawn together by need and awe and inspiration. Tinkers and sodders and guards and scouts, alloyed under the pressure of lifeswork.

Family, like.
zh:
朝圣者，因需要、敬畏与灵感而聚在一处。修补匠、焊匠、守卫、斥候，在毕生事业的压力下熔为一体。

像一家人。

src: Pillowy fiberglass scales tense around a supporting axis. Once installed, they'll unwind and inflate under the skin.
zh: 蓬松的玻璃纤维鳞片绕着支撑轴心绷紧。植入之后，它们会在皮下舒展膨胀。

src: Pillowy neutrofoam scales tense around a supporting axis. Once installed, they'll unwind and inflate under the skin.
zh: 蓬松的中子泡沫鳞片绕着支撑轴心绷紧。植入之后，它们会在皮下舒展膨胀。

src: Pinches of opal black fur stick to the wet leg meat.
zh: 一撮撮乳光般的黑毛粘在湿漉漉的腿肉上。

src: Pink slime kneads the inner wall of a glass bottle and starts to take the shape of what's on the other side.
zh: 粉红黏液揉捏着玻璃瓶的内壁，渐渐显出瓶外之物的形状。

src: Piston-inked hands wave in accompaniment to =pronouns.possessive= falsetto chiming, meant to replicate the sound of star echo grazing the orb of Kasaphescence in the pillowy dust of space.
zh: 活塞纹样的双手随=pronouns.possessive=假声的鸣响挥动，那声音意在模仿星辰的回响擦过圣化现之球、拂过太空绵软尘埃时的响动。

src: Pits mark the blade like craters on an iron edge-world.
zh: 刃上凹坑遍布，宛如铁质边缘世界上的陨坑。

src: Pits mark the broad length of the blade like craters on an iron edge-world.
zh: 宽阔的刃身上凹坑遍布，宛如铁质边缘世界上的陨坑。

src: Pits mark the length of the blade like craters on an iron edge-world.
zh: 刃身上凹坑遍布，宛如铁质边缘世界上的陨坑。

src: Plagues bloom a thousand year then die back, shrink under the earth-sponge or move here and east. Vanta, girshling, rot die. rrk the hatchling once saw the Nephilim loom! rrk frightened and hid inside a sponge for thirty moons.
zh: 灾祸盛开千年而后凋落，缩进地海绵之下，或移来此处与东方。凡塔、吉尔什幼体，腐烂而死。咯还是幼体时，曾见拿非利人逼近！咯害怕，躲进海绵里整整三十个月。

src: Planate chutes conduct the myoelectric force and push the body through water.
zh: 平整的导管传导肌电之力，推动身躯穿行水中。

src: Planks of oak cut from the trees of a rainy beryl world are nailed into the bulkhead. Floor cushions at its base offer a plush and low view on the rainbow spines of codices, each a portal to a far-flung corner of the universe.
zh: 取自一个多雨绿柱石世界之树的橡木板，被钉在舱壁上。其脚下的地垫，让人以柔软低矮的视角，仰观一排排虹色书脊的古抄本，每一册都是通往宇宙遥远角落的门户。

src: Planks of wood are nailed together at right angles in the style of the marsh dwellers.
zh: 木板以直角钉合，乃是沼泽居民的样式。

src: Planks of wood are nailed together simply to form the austere seat.
zh: 木板被简单钉合，成就这质朴的座席。
植物种类随变异等级而异。

src: Plastic housed in grainy wood is perforated in a grid of contact points. Capacitors and inductors are fastened in the spring clips and networked with a bouquet of wire.
zh: 嵌于粗纹木中的塑料，被穿出一格格接触点。电容与电感被扣在弹簧夹中，以一束电线联成网络。

src: Plastic smoothed on a heat lathe was kneaded into a design that evokes an Eater's intuition for how a perfect ball warps spacetime around itself.
zh: 热车床磨光的塑料被揉成一种形制，令人想起食者对完美球体如何在自身周围扭曲时空的直觉。

src: Plastic white as salt bleach was contoured for ideal digestion and harmony of the humors.
zh: 白如盐漂的塑料被塑成利于消化与体液调和的形状。

src: Plastic white as salt bleach was contoured for peaceful slumber, convalescence, and realignment of the humours.
zh: 白如盐漂的塑料被塑成适于安眠、康复与体液调和的形状。

src: Plastic white as salt bleach was contoured to the posture for ideal rumination.
zh: 白如盐漂的塑料依坐姿塑成，利于最佳的沉思。

src: Platinum stitch on a field of salt white brings recognition only to the mirage-trained eyes of the Issachari. The banner has been sewn into a scarlet collar.
zh: 盐白底上的铂金针脚，唯受海市蜃楼训练的以萨迦人之眼方能辨认。这面旗帜已被缝成一条猩红的衣领。

src: Please be gentle with the parchment.
Please don't ask me where Bey Lah is. I will not tell you.
zh: 请别问我贝拉在哪儿。我不会说的。

src: Please inspect only the quality of the letters. I am not a librarian.
zh: 只请检视字迹的品质。我可不是藏书楼的管事。

src: Please knock the sand from your feet, =player.formalAddressTerm=. It gets everywhere.
zh: 请把脚上的沙子磕掉，=player.formalAddressTerm=。这东西无孔不入。

src: Please tell me about the signal again.
zh: 请再给我讲讲那个信号。

src:
Please understand that we mean no slight to =ifplayerplural:you:thee= in saying so, but what =ifplayerplural:ye ask:thou asketh= of us is too heavy a weight for =ifplayerplural:your names:thy name= to bear.

Perhaps this will change, come deed and time.
zh:
请明白，我们这么说并无轻慢=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=之意，只是=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=所求于我们的，分量太重，=ifplayerplural:诸君之名:汝之名=担当不起。

或许假以时日、凭借功绩，此事会有所改变。

src: Please, =player.formalAddressTerm=, buy a schematic. I'm sure it will be of use to you.
zh: 请买一份图纸吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我敢说它对你有用。

src: Please, =player.formalAddressTerm=, do come in. Take your time browsing my wares.
zh: 请进，=player.formalAddressTerm=，不必着急，慢慢看我的货品。

src: Plies of nest-skin swell and contract as if the thing were taking breaths. Its darkling cavities glint with larvae burning to be born.
zh: 层层巢皮鼓胀又收缩，仿佛那物在呼吸。其幽暗的腔穴中闪着幼虫的微光，急欲出生。

src: Plucked from the dirt, they live their new lives wading in the brine.
zh: 自土中拔出之后，它们的新生活便是泡在盐水里。

src: Plum-white rice hulls fizzle to the touch and their awns groan an erratic and lyrical sound.
zh: 梅白色的稻壳触之嘶嘶作响，其芒发出一阵无常而如歌的声音。

src: Plumes of noxious gas stick to the air. They crowd the lungs of wet-blooded creatures who can't extract the displaced oxygen.
zh: 毒瘴般的浓烟黏滞于空气之中，拥塞在湿血生物的肺里，因为它们无法汲取被排挤开的氧气。

src: Plumpness in the cushion is gauged to the seated thinker, lancet arches press into the playful back, and claw-and-ball feet suggest a hidden life within the piece itself. This is a chair laden with meaning.
zh: 坐垫的丰软依端坐沉思者而量度，尖拱形的靠背抵着嬉戏的脊背，爪球足暗示着器物自身隐秘的生命。这是一把意蕴深重的椅子。

src: Plutonic metal is etched with a two-dimensional projection of the rhombic dodecahedral honeycomb, allowing it to snap onto the ley lines of the local region.
zh: 冥王金属上蚀刻着菱形十二面体蜂巢的二维投影，使其得以扣合当地的地脉线。

src: Pocks sprinkle the barrel steel from a hundred salt storms. The stock is spoon carved from fibrous brinestalk in the style of the Issachari dune tribe.
zh: 数百场盐暴在枪管钢上留下麻点。枪托以纤维质的盐茎，按以萨迦沙丘部族的样式，用匙刀刻成。

src:
Poem? I detest poetry. Why would one go about learning to write only to use purposefully unclear language, choosing rhyme scheme over clarity?

Of course it's not mine. Take it back.
zh:
诗？我厌恶诗。学会写字，却偏要用含糊其辞的言语，只图押韵而不求明晰，何苦来哉？

自然不是我的。拿回去。

src:
Poem? Oh! This is a Shakespriggan sonnet, but I didn't write it--the rhymes are a bit facile, and love poems don't interest me.

I've been teaching Eskhind about sonnets, so she must have written this. But that means... oh, poor thing.
zh:
诗？哦！这是一首莎士枝体十四行诗，但不是我写的——韵脚有点太轻巧，况且情诗也引不起我的兴趣。

我一直在教埃斯金德作十四行诗，所以这必是她写的。可这样一来……哦，可怜的孩子。
请指给我你们的商人在哪儿。

src: Points of discontiguous matter flock in a crescent to a mock wind. Together they bend light across its full spectrum and blur the wearer's torso to a polychrome mess.
zh: 不连续物质的点，在假想的风中成月牙形聚拢。它们合力将光弯折出完整光谱，把穿戴者的躯干模糊成一团多彩的混乱。

src: Pointy and expressive scutes range across the broad back as a mapmade mosaic. The topography of an other-place is rendered in interdimensional keratin.
zh: 尖利而富于表情的鳞甲铺展在宽阔的背上，如一幅以地图拼成的镶嵌画。异界的山川形势，以跨维度的角质呈现。
有毒的黏稠物灼痛你的双眼。

src: Poking out of a copse of brinestalk are the unbleached bones of a human adult.
zh: 从一丛盐茎中探出的，是一具成年人类未经漂白的骨骸。

src: Poking out of a pool of coral resin are the unbleached bones of a human adult. Its remains have seeded a grove of otherworldly shrooms.
zh: 从一汪珊瑚树脂中探出的，是一具成年人类未经漂白的骨骸。其遗骸孕育出一丛异界蕈菇。

src: Polarized: The item offers protection against visual flash effects.
zh: 偏振：此物可防止视觉闪光效果的影响。

src: Polyps grow across =pronouns.possessive= torso and shoulders like a tallith; fullerite and chrome and glass pop out like fins. The eremite is a walking piece of reef.
zh: 珊瑚虫如一件祈祷披巾般生在=pronouns.possessive=躯干与双肩上；富勒烯、铬与玻璃如鱼鳍般凸出。这位隐修者是一段会行走的礁。

src: Porous skeletons of spongin poke the inverted tunnel buttes, stone-like, out to angles.
zh: 海绵质构成的多孔骨架，石一般探出倒悬的隧道丘陵，直指四方。

src: Potential is polarized into a cyanic hex mesh and keyed to its arranger. Objects of sufficient mass are blocked, but small ones fired leeward can pass through.
zh: 势能被极化为一张青蓝色的六角网，并与其布设者相系。足够质量的物体会被阻挡，但从背风处射出的小物件可以穿过。

src: Potential is polarized into a magenta hex mesh and keyed to every strata in the phasic spectrum. Objects are blocked without exception.
zh: 潜能被极化为一张品红色的六边形网格，并与相位光谱中的每一层相锁定。物体无一例外皆被阻挡。

src: Potential is polarized into a scarlet hex mesh and keyed to its arranger. Objects are blocked unless they are molecularly whitelisted.
zh: 势能被极化为一张猩红色的六角网，并与其布设者相系。除非经分子级白名单许可，所有物体皆被阻挡。

src: Pouches of Tomb scrap and cookstuff are spread and hung from this mopango's carapace. =pronouns.Possessive= countenance is full of familial care and welcoming.
zh: 这只莫潘戈的甲壳上摊挂着一袋袋墓中残片与炊事杂物。=pronouns.Possessive=面容满是亲族的关切与迎客的善意。

src: Pouring, decanting, collecting, mixing. I adore my calling.
zh: 倾倒、滗清、收集、调和。我热爱我的天职。

src: Power laser emplacements, power force projectors, overclock chromelings, and activate Rodanis Y in preparation for the Putus Templar attack.
zh: 为普图斯圣殿骑士团来袭作准备：启动激光炮台与力场投射器，让铬灵超频，并激活罗达尼斯Y。

src: Praise =village.sacred=, the slynth learn our ways and we theirs. Some do not wholly accept the depravity of =village.profane=, but their ways are born of kindness, and so =village.name= will be kind in kind.
zh: 赞美=village.sacred=，斯林斯人学着我们的习俗，我们也学着他们的。有些人并不全然接受=village.profane=之堕落，但他们的作风出自善意，那么=village.name=也将以善待善。

src: Praise Bel, shield-Father, who parts the swirling gas clouds.
zh: 赞美盾父彼勒，他分开翻涌的气云。

src: Praise Carthax, silver-haired, who dashes down the well of gravity.
zh: 赞美银发之卡萨克斯，他纵身跃入引力之井。

src: Praise Dagon, the rhetorical, who speaks truth to chrome.
zh: 赞美雄辩之大衮，他向铬诉说真理。

src: Praise Nisroch, ore-in-hand, who collides earth and star.
zh: 赞美手握矿石的尼斯洛，他使大地与星辰相撞。

src: Praise Resheph, the Above, who purifies our mercury.
zh: 赞美在上者利悉，他净化我们的水银。

src: Praise Shekhinah, first among Fathers, who lights the path of wisdom.
zh: 赞美舍金纳，众父之首，照亮智慧之路。

src: Praise be to Shekhinah! O, sovereign Fathers... at last, I am here!
zh: 赞美舍金纳！哦，威严的诸父……我终于到了！

src:
Praise be to Shekhinah, =name=, your slynth friends are hard workers and quick learners!

I can't help but feel a bit concerned at their ethic, and who in the church might take advantage of it. I hope to foster an interest in reading in them if I can, before they are taught incuriosity. Perhaps a book club?
zh:
赞美舍金纳，=name=，你那些斯林斯朋友勤勉肯干，学得又快！

我不由得有些担心他们的这份勤勉，也担心教会中有谁会利用它。我若能做到，愿趁他们尚未被教得不再好奇之前，培养他们读书的兴趣。或许可以办个读书会？

src: Praise be upon Nisroch, who shelters us stiltseekers.
zh: 赞美尼斯洛，他庇护我们这些寻塔者。

src: Precious Shem. They've such a wider view of the world than we do. What a momentous obligation we've created for ourselves, and how I wouldn't undo it!
zh: 可贵的舍姆。他们看世界，比我们开阔得多。我们给自己造下了何等重大的义务，而我又绝不愿将它撤销！

src: Precious stone was dragged from the reaches of the dreaming earth, stacked in cyclopean designs, and carved to the splendor of a thousand blooming florets. Moistureless air preserves the gilding, but time has softed its edges.
zh: 珍稀的石料自沉睡的大地深处拖出，垒成巨人式的构造，雕出千朵繁花盛放的华美。干燥无水的空气保全了鎏金，然而时光已磨软了它的棱角。

src:
Precisely. The evidence you present paints a picture that will forever hang in the halls of Bey Lah's history. Our fate is in your hands.

Hemlock Cones once said:

As like begets like in daily life
so too in mystery.
Should I paint pictures full of strife
thus violence comes to be.
If I in craft or trade should deal
then deals shall deal by troth
But if I pestilence reveal-
no honey be enough.
zh:
没错。你所呈的证据，勾勒出一幅画，将永远悬于贝拉历史的殿堂之中。我们的命运就在你手里。

铁杉锥曾说：

日常里同类相生相招，
谜案中亦是同理难逃。
若我绘出的画满是纷争，
暴力便随之而生。
若我涉足制作或交易，
交易便依誓而成立。
可若我揭出瘟疫之祸，
蜜糖再多也不足以弥补。

src: Pregenerate zone names for wish support
zh: 为许愿功能预生成区域名称

src: Present. Alone, afraid, but anticipating my return to the embrace of a collective.
zh: 在场。孤身，恐惧，但期待着回归集体的怀抱。
腌藏过的食材，烹来更佳，也更稳妥。

src: Press =commandKey:GamepadAlt= + =commandKey:Take A Step= to view the tooltip.
zh: 按=commandKey:GamepadAlt=+=commandKey:Take A Step=查看提示框。

src: Press the keyboard key to bind to =ability.name|color:w=
zh: 按下要绑定到=ability.name|color:w=的键盘按键

src: Pressure shaved a plane from the face of a quartz crystal. Chance laid it on the stone floor with tenderness.
zh: 压力自一块石英晶体的面上削出一个平面。机缘又将它温存地安放在石地上。

src: Prickles install reshaping nook in Court of Sultans at Omonporch. There, respackle Creature with one dram of sunslag. Or recall creature if lost.
zh: 刺刺在奥蒙门廊的苏丹之庭装了重塑龛。在彼处，以一打兰日渣重新修补造物。造物若遗失，亦可召回。

src: Primordial soup 20 drams. Act as Creature circulatory liquid. Catalyzed and boom! Animating substance. Electromagnets induce sinusoidal flow.
zh: 原初汤二十打兰。作造物之循环液。催化，轰！活化之质。电磁铁引正弦之流。

src: Primordial soup, to be catalyzed and ran through its arteries as the animating substance.
zh: 原初之汤，经催化后在其动脉中奔流，作为赋予其生机的物质。

src: Primrose and witchwood will boil the boundaries of sense into death-pleasure!
zh: 报春花与巫木将把感官的边界煮沸，化为死亡的欢愉！

src: Prism-studded skin was shorn from a dead monkey and sawed into a cloak.
zh: 缀满棱镜的皮，剥自一只死猴，被锯成斗篷。

src: Prism-studded skin was shorn from a dead monkey and sawed into a hat.
zh: 缀满棱镜的皮，剥自一只死猴，被锯成帽子。

src: Prism-studded skin was shorn from a dead monkey and sawed into a pair of gloves.
zh: 从一只死猴身上剥下嵌满棱镜的皮，锯开缝成一双手套。

src: Prismatic filament colonizes the cracks between the salted rot. There are meadows here, She says.
zh: 棱彩丝脉在盐腐之间的裂缝中蔓生。她说，这里有草甸。

src:
Professor Cones taught me everything about finding evidence!

Though evidence you found upon the ground may yet be sound,
If it will be sufficient is a toss-up.
Examine all your suspects and their homes and all around,
And find a witness who may dish the gossip.

You can find evidence by looking at things on the ground, but you can also look at your suspects to see if there's anything off about them. You can also ask around to see if anyone has seen or heard anything strange, and different witnesses may have different things to report.
zh:
关于寻找证据，铁杉锥教授什么都教过我！

地上所得之证，或许确凿无疑，
可是否足用，仍是半赌半疑。
嫌犯与其居所，四下细细勘验，
再寻一位证人，把闲话说个周全。

你可以查看地上的东西来找证据，也可以查看嫌疑人，看他们身上有没有什么不对劲的地方。你还可以四处打听，看有没有人见到或听到什么怪事，不同的证人，说法可能各异。

src: Prompt before drinking and moving into certain dangerous liquids
zh: 饮用或走入某些危险液体前询问

src: Prompt before moving to the world map
Prompt list of items when getting from the ground, even if there's only one
zh: 从地面拾取时列出物品供选择，即使只有一件

src: Prompt to favorite new cooking recipes
zh: 询问是否收藏新烹饪配方

src: Provide 3 drams of a pure liquid.
