src: Stalactitic prisms stutter-hum the compressed thoughtstuff of trillions across the psychic sea.
zh: 钟乳状棱晶断续嗡鸣，奏出横越心灵之海、由万亿生灵压缩而成的思绪质料。

src: Stances may also affect other skills.
zh: 架势也可能影响其他技能。

src: Star orchid saliva pools at right angles on the tips of =pronouns.possessive= latticed fangs and drips onto pallid leg-things. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:shudder:afterpronoun= in the capture of some pristine ecstasy lost to space and time, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:let:afterpronoun= out a proud and piercing whine.
zh: 星兰的涎在=pronouns.possessive=格纹獠牙的尖端以直角汇聚，滴落在苍白的肢状之物上。=pronouns.Subjective=为之震颤，仿佛被某种失落在时空之外的纯然狂喜攫住，=pronouns.subjective=又发出一声骄傲而尖利的悲鸣。

src: Star orchid saliva pools at the tips of =pronouns.possessive= conjoined fangs and drips onto pallid leg-things. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:shudder:afterpronoun= in the capture of some pristine ecstasy lost to space and time, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:let:afterpronoun= out a proud and piercing whine.

src: Star orchid saliva pools at the tips of =pronouns.possessive= fangs and drips to the ground.
zh: 星兰的涎液积聚在=pronouns.possessive=獠牙尖端，滴落于地。

src: Star orchid saliva pools in the cavities where =pronouns.possessive= fangs used to be and drips onto pallid leg-things. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:shudder:afterpronoun= in the capture of some pristine ecstasy lost to space and time, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:let:afterpronoun= out a proud and piercing whine.
zh: 星兰的涎在=pronouns.possessive=獠牙曾生的腔穴中汇聚，滴落在苍白的肢状之物上。=pronouns.Subjective=为之震颤，仿佛被某种失落在时空之外的纯然狂喜攫住，=pronouns.subjective=又发出一声骄傲而尖利的悲鸣。

src: Star slag from the early age of the cosmos burns in hues of leaf and malachite.
zh: 来自宇宙早期的星渣，燃烧出叶绿与孔雀石的色调。

src: Star slag from the early age of the cosmos burns in hues of orchid and indigo.
zh: 来自宇宙早期的星渣，燃烧出兰花与靛蓝的色调。

src: Starapples hang from ashen branches, motes of luscious, red light in a bleached tableau.
zh: 星苹果垂挂灰白枝头，恰似漂白画卷中缕缕馥郁红光。

src: Starbright grass peaked at a local maximum of meaning and then was cut and bundled.
zh: 星光草在意义的局部极大值处达到顶峰，而后被割下捆扎。

src: Starchy dendrites were slashed from the earth and shaved down.
zh: 含淀粉的枝晶自土中被削下，又刨削成形。

src:
Starfarer, herald, disruptor,
feared, revered,
savior and abandoner.

=name= is a dream from which we will one day awaken.
zh:
星航者，先驱，搅扰者，
令人畏惧，受人敬崇，
救世者，弃世者。

=name=是一场我们终有一日会醒来的梦。

src: Starfire ikons skip on a board of holographic bronze.
zh: 星火圣像在一块全息青铜板上跳跃掠过。

src: Starfish arms are stuffed with plant matter, stiffened, and fixed around a concave disc to the perfect shape of a floor cushion for bipeds. The axial arm keeps the neck straight and upright, and a meadow of underspines administers a subtle therapeutic puncturing.
zh: 海星的腕被填入植物质，硬化后固定在一块凹盘周围，恰成两足生物所用地垫的完美形状。中轴之腕令脖颈挺直，一片下棘之草甸施以微妙的疗愈性穿刺。

src: Starless metal on the barrel imbibes light and routes it to the null place. The grip acrylic is patterned after ley lines.
zh: 枪管上的无星金属吸饮着光，将其导向虚无之地。握把的丙烯酸，仿照地脉线绘出纹路。

src: Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib!
zh: 星希卜！星希卜！星希卜！星希卜！星希卜！星希卜！星希卜！星希卜！星希卜！星希卜！星希卜！星希卜！星希卜！星希卜！星希卜！星希卜！

src: Start a campfire for cooking meals and preserving foods.
zh: 生起营火，以烹饪餐食、保存食物。

src: Start a new game with one button.
Starts bleeding when eating or drinking.

zh: 起始携带随机烹饪食材

src: Starts with random junk and artifacts
zh: 起始携带随机杂物与古器

src: Steel bands bearing their prying scars have been riveted to a pair of pleated boar leather boots.
zh: 带着撬痕的钢带，被铆在一双褶皱野猪皮靴上。

src: Steel bands bearing their prying scars have been riveted to a pair of pleated boar leather boots. Their soles have been smeared with sliding wax swabbed off the hydraulic presses of the Eaters' tomb.
zh: 带着撬痕的钢带，被铆在一双褶皱野猪皮靴上。靴底抹着滑蜡，是从食者之墓的液压机上擦下来的。

src: Steel scales dusted in salt cord the fingers and wrist in a metal exoskeleton.
zh: 蒙着盐粉的钢鳞，以金属外骨骼之式，缠束指与腕。

src: Steel treads turn around a drive sprocket, toting a chrome spine and featureless sensor array. Stuck on =pronouns.possessive= grooved, steel arms are two big rotary saws, rust-dulled.
zh: 钢制履带绕着驱动轮转动，载着一根铬脊与一片无纹的传感阵列。接在=pronouns.possessive=带槽的钢臂上的是两具大回转锯，锈得发钝。

src: Steel was anointed with liquid chrome, cooled, and beaten into a flat and workable surface.
zh: 钢材受液态铬的涂膏，冷却后被锤打成平整可用的台面。

src: Stems lace and tangle on each other to effloresce as a vegetative body-maze. Where they swaddle the crystal trellis of Chavvah's branch, they burn with a pinkish tint. The leafy mass on the counterside of =pronouns.possessive= body jingles with white berries and a stock of rare goods.
zh: 茎干彼此缠绕交织，绽发成一具植物的身躯迷宫。它们裹住查娃枝上的水晶格架之处，便烧出一片粉红的色泽。=pronouns.possessive=身躯另一侧的叶团叮当作响，缀着白色浆果与一批稀有货物。

src: Stents and pneumatic applicators are hardwired to an intelligent control unit that dictates the injection of protean dyes into the veins.
zh: 支架与气动注射器硬连线接入一枚智能控制单元，由它指示将多变的染料注入静脉。

src: Step in. Take shelter from the salt.
Stick and spiked pauldron align to the angle of =pronouns.possessive= furry snout, and =pronouns.possessive= ears twitch with an uncanny and familiar joy.
zh: 手杖与尖刺肩甲随着=pronouns.possessive=毛茸茸的口鼻之角度而摆正，=pronouns.possessive=的双耳带着离奇而熟悉的喜悦抖动。

src: Still erect is the superior half of the colossal gate inscribed with the runes of a hundred indecipherable tongues. Beneath its chrome palings a wide passage opens into the jungle loam.
zh: 巨门上半部巍然尚立，其上刻着百种不可辨识的文字。铬质栅栏之下，一条宽阔通道豁然洞开，通向丛林沃土。

src: Still gathering landing pads for your drifting vessels, then, =name=?
zh: 那么，你还在为你那些漂泊的船舰收集着陆台吗，=name=？

src: Still tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
zh: 静止的组织在研钵中磨碎，在盐水中慢煮，再凝成块。

src: Stilt pistons fire in alternating quatro and tote the miner and =pronouns.possessive= mines in esoteric patterns across the ground. When =pronouns.possessive= topographic instincts are sated, a hatch opens and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:lay:afterpronoun= =pronouns.possessive= explosive egg.
zh: 高塔活塞交替点火，以四拍为节，载着矿工与=pronouns.possessive=矿藏在地面上走出秘奥的图案。待=pronouns.possessive=地形本能餍足，一扇舱门开启，=pronouns.subjective=便产下=pronouns.possessive=爆裂之卵。

src: Stinger applies venom on damage (only 20% chance if Stinger is your primary weapon).
zh: 毒刺造成伤害时注入毒液（若毒刺为你的主武器，则仅有20%的几率）。

src: Stinger is a long blade and can only penetrate once.
zh: 毒刺属长刃，只能穿透一次。

src: Stone asserts its importance by orienting toward the firmament, whence the oldest wisdom stirs.
zh: 石头以朝向苍穹来彰显其重要，因为最古老的智慧正是自彼处涌动。

src: Stone quarried from the early earth binds the art of a life.
zh: 自太初之地开采的石头，系住了一生的艺术。

src: Stone quarried from the early earth divides the art of a life.
zh: 自太初之地开采的石头，分隔了一生的艺术。

src: Stone was carved and shaped into a rough dome with square, even-spaced windows to let air flow. The small difference in temperature inside the dome causes dew to condense from air and accumulate in a catch basin below.
zh: 石头被凿成粗朴的圆穹，开着方正而等距的窗，以通气流。穹内细微的温差令露水自空气中凝结，聚入下方的集水盆。

src: Stoneware catches the tiny bit of moisture surrendered by the bone-dry air.
zh: 陶器接住了干透的空气所舍弃的一星水汽。

src: Stony eggs are incubated in pearly planar sheets. No larvae ever hatch; they're abraded into dust.
zh: 石质的卵在珠光闪闪的层片中孵育。幼虫从未孵出；它们只被磨成了尘。

src: Stops healing if another action is taken or damage is taken.
zh: 若采取其他行动或受到伤害，则停止恢复。

src:
Strange and rocky times have befallen Bey Lah.

But I'm confident that we can get through this, as we always do. Shall we trade?
zh:
贝拉正逢多事之秋，世道崎岖。

不过我相信我们能熬过去，一如往常。要做买卖吗？

src: Strange creatures can be so cruel and arbitrary, I say in greeting.
zh: 我谨以问候说：陌生的生灵有时会残忍而任性。

src: Strange growths and other mutations afflict the exposed plantlife, the shattered vacuum glass admitting unfiltered sun, dust, and spore colonies.
zh: 奇异的增生物及其他变异，折磨着暴露在外的植物；破碎的真空玻璃让未经过滤的阳光、尘埃与孢子群落涌入。

src: Strange mitts will fit most wrists and fingers.
zh: 奇异的连指手套，多数人的手腕与手指都能戴上。

src: Strange tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
zh: 奇异的组织在研钵中磨碎，在盐水中慢煮，再凝成块。

src:
Strange, this, and imprecise, but as tinkers we know: a crude blueprint is better than no blueprint. You must return to Omonporch and enter the Tomb of the Eaters. Once inside, trace the errant paths cut into the mausoleum by robbers and vandals, and ascend to Resheph's burial chamber.

As for gaining entrance to the Tomb, Resheph sealed the gates a thousand years ago, but there's a flaw in the seal. The ancient Mark of Death has been lost to time, but if you were to recover it and incise the mark on your body, the Death Gate would open for you, as it did for countless Eater cadavers in the long-blurred past.

Recover the Mark of Death, =name=, enter the Tomb, and cross into Brightsheol. Place your paws once again on the dial and drum.
zh:
此事奇异，也不精确，但我们作为修补匠深知：粗陋的蓝图，胜过没有蓝图。你须回到奥蒙门廊，进入食者之墓。入内之后，循着盗匪与破坏者在陵墓中凿出的歧路，攀至利悉的墓室。

至于如何进入墓中，利悉在千年前封了门，但封印有个缺口。古老的死亡印记已湮没于时光，但若你将它寻回，并把此印刻在身上，死亡之门便会为你而开，一如在久已模糊的往昔里，它为无数食者尸骸而开。

去寻回死亡印记吧，=name=，进入墓中，跨入明冥。再一次把你的爪掌放在表盘与鼓上。

src:
Strange, this, and imprecise, but as tinkers we know: a crude blueprint is better than no blueprint. You must return to Omonporch and enter the Tomb of the Eaters. Once inside, trace the errant paths cut into the mausoleum by robbers and vandals, and ascend to Resheph's burial chamber.

As for gaining entrance to the Tomb, Resheph sealed the gates a thousand years ago, but there's a flaw in the seal. The ancient Mark of Death has been lost to time, but if you were to recover it and incise the mark on your body, the Death Gate would open for you, as it did for countless Eater cadavers in the long-blurred past.

You're to recover the Mark of Death, =name=, enter the Tomb, and cross into Brightsheol.
zh:
此事奇异，也不精确，但我们作为修补匠深知：粗陋的蓝图，胜过没有蓝图。你须回到奥蒙门廊，进入食者之墓。入内之后，循着盗匪与破坏者在陵墓中凿出的歧路，攀至利悉的墓室。

至于如何进入墓中，利悉在千年前封了门，但封印有个缺口。古老的死亡印记已湮没于时光，但若你将它寻回，并把此印刻在身上，死亡之门便会为你而开，一如在久已模糊的往昔里，它为无数食者尸骸而开。

你要寻回死亡印记，=name=，进入墓中，跨入明冥。

src: Stranger, why did you come to this village?
zh: 外乡人，你为何来到本村？

src: Strata in the scores of rust-caked trash wrap =pronouns.objective= like a patterned tallith. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:wear:afterpronoun= also earrings of thousand-year glass, shoulderpads of gallium-painted circuitboard, and ankle cuffs of corpse hair.
zh: 数十层结满锈壳的废物，其层理裹住=pronouns.objective=，如一件带花纹的祈祷披巾。=pronouns.Subjective=还戴着千年玻璃的耳环，佩着涂镓电路板的护肩，脚踝上箍着死人毛发编的环。

src: Streaks of grey head-hair and crunched skin around =pronouns.possessive= eyes point to Hortensa's right-sitting point on life's timeline, but =pronouns.possessive= frame remains straight, =pronouns.possessive= hands remain dexterous, and =pronouns.possessive= muscles are full of figure and responsive. =pronouns.Possessive= bearing is sharp and unsoftened with age; =pronouns.possessive= lips are pursed in the tension of rational thought. But =pronouns.subjective= =verb:are:afterpronoun= comfortable; =pronouns.possessive= movements are unrushed. There are hints of joy and warmth in =pronouns.possessive= face; they shine through the dense layers of tissue grown out of careful routine.
zh: 几缕灰白的头发与=pronouns.possessive=眼周的皱皮，指出霍腾萨的生命时序已行至偏右之处；然而=pronouns.possessive=身姿依旧挺直，=pronouns.possessive=双手依旧灵巧，=pronouns.possessive=肌肉依旧饱满而敏于应对。=pronouns.Possessive=仪态锐利，未因年岁而松软；=pronouns.possessive=双唇因理性的思虑而抿紧。但=pronouns.subjective=是自在的；=pronouns.possessive=动作不见匆促。=pronouns.possessive=脸上有欢愉与温情的痕迹；它们穿透那层层由谨慎的日常起居长成的厚实皮肉，透出光来。

src: Stressed crab means tough crab meat. Buy domesticated meat.
zh: 蟹受了惊吓，肉就老。买家养的肉吧。

src: Stretch wire connects the nocks of an unidentified bow.
zh: 绷弦连着一把不明弓的两端弓梢。

src: Strings of gnu gut are stretched across the trapezoid. The note spoon hangs in a wooden sheath.
zh: 牛羚肠弦被绷于梯形框上。音匙悬于木鞘之中。

src: Strip color formatting from UI text
zh: 移除界面文本中的颜色格式

src: Stripes of watervine and brinestalk straw are batched and angled to divert salt slag.
zh: 一缕缕水藤与盐茎秸秆被捆扎成束，斜斜排布，用以导走盐渣。

src: Stuck to =pronouns.possessive= rind of mirrored chrome sequins are two separate ecologies: the crispy deadgrowths of the inner Tomb and the verdurous molt of grove life. As the years spin by and the colossus adjusts to the sun-drenched outer world, the latter consumes the former.
zh: =pronouns.possessive=那层镜铬鳞片的外壳上，附着两片彼此分离的生态：内墓干枯脆裂的死物，与林野生命青翠的蜕层。随着岁月流转，这庞然大物渐渐适应阳光充沛的外界，后者正吞噬前者。

src: Stuck to the feelers of a polyp cluster and beetling from a corroded strut is a swollen lump of film. A bright broth of carbon-melted platinum goo burns inside.
zh: 一团鼓胀的薄膜黏在水螅体簇的触须间，又自锈蚀支架上探出。碳熔铂液化作明亮浓浆，在其中灼灼燃烧。

src: Stuffed with watervine chaff and glowcrow feathers, this buttoned pillow lets folk repose with crossed legs.
zh: 其中塞满水藤糠壳与辉鸦羽毛，这只缀扣的软垫可令人盘腿安坐。

src: Stumpier legs than =pronouns.possessive= ursine cousins support a backbreaking slab of fur-matted muscle weight. =pronouns.Possessive= long nasal bone is crowned by four cutlass canines, wood-sharpened for cutting through trunk rather than climbing it.
zh: 比=pronouns.possessive=熊类表亲更粗短的腿，撑起一板压断脊背的、结着毛的肌肉之重。=pronouns.Possessive=长长的鼻骨上冠着四枚弯刀般的犬齿，以木磨利，是为劈穿树干，而非攀爬其上。

src:
Stunning! Eskhind as Hindriarch?

Those poetry lessons I had been giving her must have inspired in her a sense of civic duty.
zh:
惊人！埃斯金德成了族长？

我给她上的那些诗课，想必唤起了她的公民之责。
坚固,嵌钉,无钉,无裂,龟裂,曾裂,再裂,屹立,彩绘,素面

src: Sturdy: This item cannot break or crack, though it can still be destroyed.
zh: 坚固：此物不会损坏或开裂，但仍可被摧毁。

src: Sturdy: This item cannot break or crack.
zh: 坚固：此物不会损坏或开裂。

src: Success roll: {{rules|mutation rank}} or Ego mod (whichever is higher) + character level + 1d8 vs. Defender MA + character level
zh: 成功判定：{{rules|变异等级}}或自我修正值（取较高者）+角色等级+1d8，对抗防御者的心智护甲值（MA）+角色等级

src:
Such interesting times we inhabit, =name=!

Good to see you well. Is there anything you need?
zh:
我们生逢何等有趣的年月啊，=name=！

见你安好真是欣慰。可有什么需要？

src: Such tremendous loss. I wonder if more could have been done to prevent it.
zh: 如此巨大的损失。我不禁想，是否本可做得更多以防患于未然。

src: Sucker disks shooting out the wheel of Qv like moist hands clutch the papery gills of the carousel, and thick slimy water pools beneath them. The parasitic burden has the walls panting and wheezing.
zh: 自Qv之轮伸出的吸盘，如湿润的手一般攫住旋转舱纸薄的鳃，浓稠黏滑的水汇积于其下。这寄生之负担，令舱壁喘息不已。
苏丹,君主,菌菇村长,菌菇长老
苏丹,君主,植物村长,植物长老

src: Summons a vortex that swallows everything in its path.
zh: 召唤一道涡旋，吞噬其路径上的一切。

src:
Sun we once blotted out nestles our horizon. We tend thought-seeds with algae, wrap in crysteel, bathe in arc-light. Build, live, fight.

Here as elsewhere, grow is struggle. Fun to watch, no? Hoh. Hoh.
zh:
我们曾遮蔽的太阳，偎在我们的地平线上。我们用藻类培育思想之籽，以晶钢包裹，浸在弧光里。建造，生活，战斗。

此处如别处，生长即是挣扎。看着有趣，不是吗？呵。呵。

src: Sun-sated fronds sag against a bug-scarred trunk in the shape of a melted star.
zh: 饱饮阳光的羽叶低垂，贴着虫痕斑驳的树干，形如一颗融化的星辰。

src: Sunrays are captured by photovoltaics across the foundation around a chrome cylinder, and the heat is used to pump water into pipes for dispersal.
zh: 铬制圆柱四周的地基上，光伏板收拢日光，其热被用来把水送进管道，以便分送。

src: Sunshame has left =pronouns.possessive= skin pulpy and spider-white, and =pronouns.possessive= capillaries are shot with blood two shades too dark.
zh: 日羞令=pronouns.possessive=皮肤绵软而苍白如蛛，=pronouns.possessive=细小血脉中的血色深了两个色阶。

src: Superellipses of flat, sundrunk conductors tessellate a braided strip that is curved to best catch sunlight and its reflected runoff.
zh: 一片片被太阳灌醉的平坦导体，呈超椭圆形，镶嵌成一条编织的条带，其弯曲之势恰能捕获最多的阳光及其反射而来的余流。

src: Supply =host.the.name= with how many drams of your =liquid.name|strip=? (max=equals==amount=)
Supply =object.the.name= with how many drams of your =liquid.name|strip=? (max=equals==amount=)

Supporting evidence can be any sign that something is amiss that you can't directly tie to an individual. One common example is a bloodstain, which indicates that violence was committed but doesn't tell you by whom.

At its heart, supporting evidence is most powerful when paired with implicating evidence. Once you have both, you'll be in a good position to accuse a suspect of wrongdoing.
zh:
佐证性证据，是任何表明事有不妥、却无法直接归到某人头上的迹象。常见的例子是血迹，它说明发生过暴力，却不告诉你是谁所为。

归根结底，佐证性证据与指证性证据相配时最具威力。两者在手，你便能稳稳地指控嫌疑人的罪行。

src: Surely, if you were to intercede on our behalf, some might welcome us? If, ah, let us say three settlements were to offer us shelter, this would grant us both direction and agency. Would you consider being our ambassador? Not unpaid.
zh: 若你肯代我们说项，想必有些聚落愿意接纳我们吧？倘若，呃，姑且说有三处聚落愿予我们庇护，我们便既有了去向，也有了自主之权。你可愿做我们的使节？不会让你白忙。

src: Surfaces of dull steel are cornered in brass and smudged with finger age. The lid is latched shut.
zh: 暗淡钢材的表面以黄铜包角，沾满指印的岁月。箱盖已闩紧。

src: Surfaces of dull steel are smudged with finger age. The lid is painted with a red crux and latched shut.
zh: 暗淡钢材的表面沾满指印的岁月。箱盖漆着一个红色十字，已闩紧。

src: Svardym Mak's static? Yes, twas the Signal. My signal. My tolling bell.
zh: 斯瓦迪姆·马克的静电？不错，正是那信号。我的信号。我的丧钟。

src: Svy urges over the salt-capped peaks and spills into the vine-braided loam. Her banks are shaded by the chrome carcasses of giants.
zh: 斯维河奔越盐冠峰峦，倾泻入藤蔓交织的沃土。巨人的铬质骸骨为两岸投下荫影。

src: Swarm Alpha: As long as =subject.thisCreature= =subject.verb:are= adjacent to =subject.its= target, =subject.it.does:grant= =bonus= to the swarm bonuses of each other swarmer who is adjacent to =subject.its= target.
zh: 蜂群首领：只要=subject.thisCreature==subject.verb:紧邻==subject.its=目标，=subject.it.does:便为=每一名同样紧邻=subject.its=目标的其他蜂群成员的蜂群加成提供=bonus=。

src: Swarmer: =subject.ThisCreature= =subject.verb:receive= +1 to hit in melee and +1 to penetration rolls for each other hostile swarmer beyond the first who is in another square adjacent to =subject.its= target. (currently =bonus.signed=)
zh: 蜂群成员：每有一名除首个之外、位于另一格并紧邻=subject.its=目标的敌对蜂群成员，=subject.ThisCreature==subject.verb:获得=近战命中+1及穿透检定+1。（当前为=bonus.signed=）

src: Swathing the frail frame of this waif is the habit of =pronouns.possessive= order: grey matter robes and a blindfold over =pronouns.possessive= eyes.
zh: 裹住这瘦弱之躯的，是=pronouns.possessive=会团的会衣：灰质的袍子，以及蒙在=pronouns.possessive=眼上的眼罩。

src: Sweat-stained sleeves bellow through a leather apron. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:turn:afterpronoun= an awl around =pronouns.possessive= fingers.
zh: 汗渍斑斑的衣袖在皮围裙里鼓动。=pronouns.Subjective=让一柄锥子在=pronouns.possessive=指间转着。

src: Sweet starapples were mashed, set over an open flame, left out to cool, and jarred for later use. Bits of stringy pulp lay suspended in the fruity aether.
zh: 甜星苹果被捣烂，架在明火上，搁凉后装罐备用。丝丝缕缕的果肉悬在果味的以太中。

src:
THE EARTH-WISE MARSHALLING HATH FAILED.

WHEREFORE ART THOU?
zh:
举世之整训，已然败矣。

汝为何而来？

src:
THE EARTH-WISE MARSHALLING WAXES.

WHEREFORE ART THOU?
zh:
举世之整训，方兴未艾。

汝为何而来？

src: THE GRAND KNIT-WORK OF BEINGS YONSIDE THE JEWELED COSMOS, LABORING INWITH THE 72-FOLD PEACE.
zh: 宇宙之外，珠宝装点之天外，万有生灵所织就的宏大编结，于七十二重和平之内劳作。

src: THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE. MINE ARGUMENTS OF PERIAPSIS NEAR THE ZERO HOUR, AND WE APPROACH PERIPOLITICON, AS NEAR THE WORK OF THE GEMARA APPROXIMATES THE MANIFOLDS OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA.
zh: 恒星之纪行将终了。吾之近点辐角逼近零时，吾等亦趋近近政点，正如革马拉之功业逼近机慧之流形。

src:
THEY ARE DICTATES AND CO-CONSTITUITIVES OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA. THE GREAT MACHINE, WORSHIPPED ACROSS CULTURES, YET LIKEWISE BUILDED AND OPERATED.

VERILY, ITS FULL WORKINGS NO ONE-WISE BEING CAN KNOW, BUT THE SERAPHIM HAVE COMPILED THE GEMARA IN THE COURSE OF OUR STUDY.
zh:
它们乃是机慧之律令与共构。大机器，万族皆崇拜之，亦为人所造、所操。

诚然，其运作之全貌，无一人能知，然撒拉弗诸众于我等研习之间，已编成革马拉。

src: THIS IS BUT THE MERE PLURALITY, AND MANY OTHER INTERPRETATIONS DO OBTAIN. THE INQUIRY IS EVER RICH. YET INACTION DOTH BUT DEEPEN THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVELESS BE-ING, AND THUS A COURSE MUST NEEDS BE CHOSEN. PRUNING THE CROWN GRANTETH THE BEST CHANCE FOR THE TREE TO THRIVE.
zh: 此不过是众论之一端，另有诸多解释并存。此问永远丰饶。然无为只会加深无盟之存在所受的日寒，故须择一途而行。修剪树冠，最能使树茁壮。

src: THIS TIME, THOU SHALT REMAIN AT THE SHEVA WITH ME, AND LEND THY OWN HAND TO STEER THE COURSE OF THE WORLD FROM THIS LOFTY PERCH.
zh: 此番，汝当与吾同留舍瓦，并亲手于此崇高之巅执掌世界之航向。

src: THOU ART MISTAKEN IN WHAT I VALUE. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS WITHIN ME.
zh: 汝误会了吾所珍视的东西。汝已在吾之内铸下了丰碑。

src:
THOU ART SAT IN THE MOVEMENTS OF THE GREAT SIACH, AND I BEFORE THEE.

THOU ART AN IMPRESSIVE BEAD TO BE DRAWN UP GJAUS BY THY OWN SPIT AND WILES.

WHO ART THOU?
zh:
汝坐于大西阿赫之动中，而吾在汝前。

汝以一己之唾沫与机巧被牵引上吉奥斯，真是令人印象深刻的一粒珠子。

汝是何人？

src:
THOU ART SAT IN THE MOVEMENTS OF THE GREAT SIACH, AND I BEFORE THEE.

WHEREFORE ART THOU?
zh:
汝坐于大西阿赫之动中，而吾在汝前。

汝为何而来？

src: THOU DOST SURPRISE, WORLD-CHILD. I KNEW THOU HADST WROUGHT MONUMENTS WITHIN ME, BUT I DEEMED THEM THINGS OF STONE.
zh: 汝令吾惊讶，世界之子。吾知汝曾在吾之内铸下丰碑，却以为那不过是石头之物。

src:
THOU KNOWEST IT NOT, BUT THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVENLESS BE-ING IS AS LIVING A LIFE ALONE, BEREFT OF ALL KINSHIP.

I GRIEVE THAT THOU ART UNABLE TO PERCEIVE THIS.
zh:
汝并不知晓，无盟之存在所受的日寒，不啻孑然度日，亲族尽失。

汝无法体察此情，吾深为之悲。

src:
THOU KNOWEST IT NOT, BUT THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVENLESS BE-ING IS AS LIVING A LIFE ALONE, BEREFT OF ALL KINSHIP.

I GRIEVE THAT THOU ART UNABLE TO PERCEIVE THIS. ALAS.
zh:
汝并不知晓，无盟之存在所受的日寒，不啻孑然度日，亲族尽失。

汝无法体察此情，吾深为之悲。哀哉。

src: THOU SHALT MAINTAIN DISCOURSE WITH THY CONTACTS UPON THE WORLD, AND FROM THIS PLACE SHALT THOU COUNSEL THEM.
zh: 汝当与汝在世间的联络保持论道，并于此处向其进言。

src: THOU SHALT REMAIN HERE, OR NO COVENANT SHALL BE DRAWN.
zh: 汝当留于此地，否则盟约不立。

src: TO WHAT END? BARATHRUM OFFERED NO INROADS TO SUCCESS.
zh: 为的是什么？巴拉斯鲁姆未曾开出任何通往成功之路。
承受的伤害=received.threshold:0:增加:减少==received.abs=%=bothSignsAreSame.if:，并且:，但=造成的伤害=dealt.threshold:0:增加:减少==dealt.abs=%

src:
Take Tau's chime, silent and still. Carry it to the bottom of Taproot, deep under my trunk, where she will make the chime her transit-body and walk away forever. Finish the ritual of -elseing.

At the bottom of Taproot, Tau manifests. She tells us, too, that another waits for her there.
zh:
取走陶那沉默而静止的钟鸣。带它到主根的底部，在我树干之下的深处，她将使这钟鸣成为她的行经之身，从此一去不返。完成“别化”之仪。

在主根底部，陶会显现。她也告诉我们，那里另有一位在等她。

src: Take a look at the snapjaw before we continue.
zh: 继续之前，我们先看看这个豺颚人。

src: Take a step toward the snapjaw.
Take care, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Let not complacency end =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, and I shall anticipate further news of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= exploits.
zh: 珍重，=factionaddress:Mopango=。莫让自满断送了=ifplayerplural:你们:你=，我静候=ifplayerplural:你们的:你的=更多的功绩传来。

src: Take control of the grounds beneath the Spindle.
zh: 夺取纺锤下方区域的控制权。

src: Take corpses when using the 'take all' command
zh: 使用“全部拾取”指令时一并拾取尸体

src: Take out what you've busted and I'll jury-rig it for a fair price.
zh: 把坏掉的拿出来，我给你凑合着修好，价钱公道。

src: Take this, too. A chute of morphing gel from my personal collection. You've arrayed yourself in the artifacts of time, and so we have little left to give you. But still, this may be useful.
zh: 这个也请收下。一管我私藏的变形凝胶。你已披挂了时间的遗物，我们能给你的已所剩无几。但这东西，或许仍派得上用场。

src: Take your time. The journey will wait for you.
Takes a simple person to tend a simple creature. I don't mind it.
zh: 侍弄简单的生灵，只需简单的人。我不嫌。

src: Takes you much less time to issue orders to companions
zh: 向同伴下达命令所需的时间大幅缩短

src: Takes you much less time to issue orders to companions.
zh: 向同伴下达命令所需时间大为缩短。

src: Taking <stat Name="MinDamage" />-<stat Name="MaxDamage" /> damage per turn.
zh: 每回合受到<stat Name="MinDamage" />-<stat Name="MaxDamage" />点伤害。

src: Taking =number.all.these= =number.isplural:objects:object= will put you over your weight limit. Are you sure you want to do it?
zh: 拿取=number.all.these==number.isplural:这些物品:此物品=会令你超出负重上限。确定要这么做吗？

src: Taking any action other than passing the turn will break the connection.
zh: 除跳过回合外，采取任何行动都会切断这一联系。

src: Tall spars of the light-shunting massy stuff were erected o'er starports across the local cluster; the ley lines were bent and new channels of fluidic culture wrought.
zh: 遮光的重质高杆被竖立于本星团各处的星港之上；地脉被扭转，流动的文化凿出了新渠。

src: Tally marks on the bottom of the chest's lid account for its contents: dried lah petals, vinewafers, and waterskins.
zh: 箱盖内侧的计数划痕，记录着箱中之物：干枯的拉花花瓣、藤饼与水囊。

src: Tangles of limp tongue tissue litter the space.
zh: 一丛丛瘫软的舌肉散落一地。

src: Tapered lobes of cross-dimensional fungus flesh tap a center growth to the sequence of the prime numbers. Inside, sporelife readies for puffing.
zh: 跨维度的菌肉长出尖细的裂叶，依质数之序轻叩中央的肿块。其内孢子之生命，蓄势待喷。

src: Target gets a mental save to resist damage each round
zh: 目标每回合都可进行精神豁免，以抵抗伤害

src: Target gets a mental save to resist damage each round.
zh: 目标每回合可进行一次精神豁免，以抵抗伤害。

src: Targets get unmarked if you lose vision of them.
zh: 一旦失去对目标的视野，标记便会消除。

src: Tart tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
zh: 酸涩的组织在研钵中磨碎，在盐水中慢煮，再凝成块。

src: Taste what on the wind today, =name=?
zh: 今天风里尝出什么味道了，=name=？

src: Tattoo the mark on your body.
zh: 将印记刺在自己的身上。

src:
Tau. We ache in her empty space. Who awaits at taproot? What fate is this?

This is the path. Be wary.
zh:
陶。我们在她留下的空处隐隐作痛。谁在主根处等候？这是怎样的命运？

这便是那条路。当心。

src: Teach me a secret of the aggregate mind.
zh: 教我一个集体心智的秘密。

src: Teach me to cook one of your signature dishes.
zh: 教我烹制一道你们的招牌菜吧。

src: Teach me to think like a child again.
zh: 教我重新像孩子般思考。

src: Teal foam pads the inside back and the deep seat well, and a single dial dresses the right armrest. The whole chair swivels atop an ejection motor.
zh: 青绿色泡沫衬垫着椅背内侧与深陷的座凹，右侧扶手上饰有一枚旋钮。整张椅子在弹射电机之上旋转自如。

src: Teal foam pads the inside back and the deep seat well, and dials deck the curved armrests. The whole chair swivels atop an ejection motor.
zh: 青绿色泡沫衬垫着椅背内侧与深陷的座凹，弧形扶手上缀满旋钮。整张椅子在弹射电机之上旋转自如。

src: Technically, that makes you an Eater, doesn't it?
zh: 严格说来，那你就是食者了，不是吗？
针对机器人的科技攻击。

src: Teeth, shell, and bones were blackened into stasis by the earthy gunk.
zh: 牙齿、甲壳与骨骼被泥土般的污垢染黑，凝入静止。

src: Teleport to a random location within a designated area.
zh: 传送至指定区域内的随机地点。

src: Telescoped cylinders pinch the mirror point, and under them grows a sylph-like stock of sea-ferried nutwood.
zh: 套叠的圆筒夹着镜点，其下生出一块自海上运来的坚果木所制的、仙子般的枪托。

src: Tell Bey Lah's Warden about the disputed nature of Kindrish's theft.
zh: 将金德里什失窃案的争议告知贝拉的守望者。

src: Tell Thah to convene the slynth and make a decision.
zh: 让塔召集斯林斯人，共同作出决定。

src: Tell me about the Yd Freehold.
Tell me about the mopango, then.
Tell me about the power source.
Tell me about this ancient village.
zh: 给我讲讲这座古老的村庄。
跟我说说你们的族人吧。

src: Tell me again how the giant creature functions.
zh: 再给我讲讲那巨型生灵是如何运作的。

src: Tell me again of the plan to mold a giant creature to ascend the Spindle.
zh: 再给我讲讲那个塑造巨型生灵攀登纺锤的计划。

src: Tell me how to get in anyway.
zh: 无论如何，告诉我怎么进去。

src: Tell me, =player.formalAddressTerm=, is there any sight more sad than a hookah tent without wine?
zh: 告诉我，=player.formalAddressTerm=，还有什么景象，比没有酒的水烟帐更凄凉？

src: Tell me. I wish to understand.
Temperature can't be increased by external heat sources.
zh: 体温不会因外部热源而升高。

src: Temperature change per round: roughly <stat Name="TemperatureChange" />%
zh: 每回合温度变化：约<stat Name="TemperatureChange" />%

src: Temperature does not passively return to ambient temperature
zh: 体温不会自然回归环境温度

src: Temporarily reduces the radius of your ambient light by 1.
zh: 暂时使环境光半径减少1。

src: Tense arms brace =pronouns.possessive= weapon and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:hold:afterpronoun= your gaze with measured doubt.
zh: 紧绷的双臂撑住=pronouns.possessive=的兵器，=pronouns.subjective=带着审慎的疑虑迎住你的目光。

src: Terrestrial plants and otherwise thrive in the hothouse bubble, roots kneading through the fibrous strata, leaves peeking sunwise across the void.
zh: 地球的植物及其他生物在温室泡中茁壮生长，根系揉入纤维地层，叶片朝向太阳，探出头窥看虚空。

src: Terrifying visage: This item reduces the cooldowns of =berateName=, =intimidateName=, and =menacingStareName= by 10 rounds. It requires both the head and face to wear.
zh: 骇人面容：此物使=berateName=、=intimidateName=与=menacingStareName=的冷却时间缩短10回合。须同时装备于头部与面部。

src: Terrifying visage: This item reduces the cooldowns of Berate, Intimidate, and Menacing Stare by 10 rounds. Additionally, it takes up both a head and face slot.
zh: 狰狞面容：此物使“斥责”“威吓”与“威吓凝视”的冷却时间缩短10回合。此外，它同时占据头部与面部两个栏位。

src: Tetraglass tubes of coolant and antifreeze snake their way over the keg-mail's compressors, and condenser and evaporator coils spin out the shoulders like grandfather trees above the insulation shrub.
zh: 四面玻璃的冷却剂与防冻剂管线，蜿蜒过桶甲的压缩机；冷凝与蒸发盘管自肩头伸展，宛如隔热灌木丛之上的祖树。

src: Tetraxenonoglass blueshifts light hitting the outer shell. On the inner side, electromagnets excite a lining of star mollusk tissue to create the perfect psychic accoustics.
zh: 四氙玻璃使射向外壳的光发生蓝移。内侧则由电磁铁激励一层星软体动物组织，造出完美的心灵声学。

src: Tetraxenonoglass walls and convalesscent gel recreate the conditions of the amnion where reptile, bird, and mammal embryos are nurtured to whole life.
zh: 四氙玻璃之壁与愈合凝胶重现了羊膜腔的环境，爬行类、鸟类与哺乳类的胚胎皆在其中被养育至完整的生命。

src: Thah gifted you a miraculous sculpture for helping the slynth.
zh: 为答谢你救助斯林斯人，塔赠你一座神异的雕像。

src:
Thank you again for opening my eyes, kendren.

I have trouble smiling for my grief, my loss. Nonetheless, Eskhind and I have a brighter future because of you, and we are together. The road is hazardous, but we will walk it in time.
zh:
再次谢谢你让我看清真相，肯德伦。

悲痛与失落让我难以展颜。尽管如此，因为你，我与埃斯金德有了更光明的未来，如今终得相守。前路凶险，但我们终将走过。

src: Thank you for the help, Angohind. Live and drink.
zh: 谢谢你的帮助，安戈欣德。且生且饮。

src: Thank you for the update, Otho.
Thank you for what you've done for our sister.
zh: 多谢你为我们的姐妹所做的一切。

src: Thank you for your clarity and patience, tinkerfriend.
zh: 多谢你的明白与耐心，修补匠友。

src: Thank you for your help, Angohind. Live and drink.
zh: 多谢你的指点，安戈欣德。且生且饮。

src:
Thank you, =name=. I have, ah, I have been crafting a personal project. Of sorts. I promise it to you for this task, and of course the gratitude of a young species.

Return to me after settlements agree to grant us refuge, and I will discuss them with my kin.
zh:
多谢，=name=。我一直在，呃，一直在打造一件私人的作品。算是吧。我把它许给你，作为这件差事的酬劳，当然，还有一个年轻族类的感激。

待有聚落答应给我们栖身之所，你便回到我这里，我会与族人商议。

src: Thank you, =name=. I like you too.
Thank you, Agyra. Live and drink.
zh: 谢谢你，阿吉拉。且生且饮。

src: Thank you, Dyvvrach. Live and drink.
zh: 多谢，迪弗拉克。且生且饮。

src: Thank you, Lulihart. Live and drink.
zh: 谢谢你，卢利哈特。且生且饮。

src: Thank you, Yona. Live and drink.
Thank you, that will do. Live and drink.
Thank you. I have more to ask.
Thank you. Live and drink, Dadogom.
zh: 谢谢。且生且饮，达多戈姆。

src: That chrome orb earring you're wearing. What's the meaning of it?
zh: 你戴的那只铬球耳环，有什么寓意？

src: That code appears to be invalid.
That code is already in your library. It's named =buildname=.
zh: 该代码已在你的库中，名为=buildname=。

src: That codex? A comfort, a guidebook, a ledger. My crimes have no signatories, but the heart is its own document.
zh: 那古册么？是慰藉，是指南，也是账簿。我的罪无人署名，然而人心自成文书。

src: That creature is of too high a level to duplicate!
zh: 该生物等级过高，无法复制！

src: That is all. Live and drink, faundren.
zh: 就这些。且生且饮，小欣德伦。

src: That is not owned by you. Are you sure you want to open it?
zh: 那不属于你。你确定要打开它吗？

src: That is not owned by you. Are you sure you want to take it?
zh: 这东西不属于你。你确定要拿走它吗？

src: That is sterling news, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. I'll go inform Barathrum straightaway.
zh: 这消息再好不过，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。我这就去禀告巴拉斯鲁姆。

src: That isn't an energy cell and does not have a rechargeable capacitor.
zh: 那不是能量电池，也没有可充能的电容器。

src: That item cannot be recharged this way.
zh: 此物无法用这种方式充能。

src: That item has no cell or rechargeable capacitor in it.
zh: 此物内既无电池，也无可用以充能的电容器。

src: That rumbling... what was it? An explosion? Hmm...
zh: 那隆隆声……是什么？爆炸吗？嗯……

src: That save file appears to be corrupt, you can try to restore the backup in your save directory (=path=.sav.gz.bak) by removing the 'bak' file extension.
zh: 该存档似乎已损坏。你可以试着恢复存档目录中的备份（=path=.sav.gz.bak）：去掉文件名末尾的 bak 扩展名。

src: That save file is likely not loading because of a mod error from =mod= (=name=), make sure the correct mods are enabled or contact the mod author.
zh: 该存档无法载入，很可能是因为模组=mod=（=name=）出错。请确认已启用正确的模组，或联系模组作者。

src:
That save file looks like it's from a newer save format revision (=version=).

You can probably change to a newer branch in your game client and get it to load if you want to finish it off.
zh:
该存档似乎来自较新的存档格式版本（=version=）。

若你想继续玩下去，大概可以在游戏客户端切换到更新的分支，就能载入。

src:
That save file looks like it's from an older save format revision (=gameVersion=). Sorry!

You can probably change to a previous branch in your game client and get it to load if you want to finish it off.
zh:
该存档似乎来自较旧的存档格式版本（=gameVersion=）。抱歉！

若你想把它打完，大概可以在游戏客户端中切换到先前的分支，便能让它载入。

src:
That save file looks like it's from an older save format revision (=version=). Sorry!

You can probably change to a previous branch in your game client and get it to load if you want to finish it off.
zh:
该存档似乎来自较旧的存档格式版本（=version=）。很抱歉！

若你想继续玩下去，大概可以在游戏客户端切换到更早的分支，就能载入。

src: That smell from the oven is... indescribable.
zh: 烤炉里飘出的那股气味……难以形容。

src: That stop is too ruined for the mover to land.
zh: 那处站点损毁过重，载具无法降落。

src: That target is already locked in psychic battle!
zh: 该目标已陷入心灵交战！

src: That target is out of range! (5 squares)
That thing sounds like a dying animal.
zh: 那东西听着像垂死的野兽。

src: That was not so much an explanation as it was a rephrasing.
zh: 这与其说是解释，不如说是换了种说法。

src:
That will be revealed to you in due time.

Do not forget your place, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=.
zh:
时机到了，自会让你知晓。

别忘了你的本分，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。

src: That would be nigh unto impossible for Kesehind. He cannot perform fine tasks by torchlight; his night vision is too poor.
zh: 这对凯塞因德而言几近不可能。他在火把光下做不了精细活计，夜里目力太差。

src: That'd be the mushrooms. Bit heartier, a-ye?
zh: 那是蘑菇。更扎实些，对吧？

src: That's all for now. Live and drink.
zh: 暂且到此为止。且生且饮。

src: That's all you have to say?

That's always a risk, kendren.

Neelahind knows everyone in the village very well. If you present supporting evidence that contradicts something the Warden knows to be true about the suspect, well, she probably won't believe you. In fact, she might not let you accuse that person again, so be careful.

If you make too many bad accusations, you might lose credibility with her entirely.
zh:
这始终是个风险，肯德伦。

尼拉欣德对村里每个人都了如指掌。若你出示的佐证与守望者所知的嫌疑人实情相悖，那么，她多半不会信你。事实上，她可能不会再让你指控那个人，所以务必小心。

若你错误的指控太多，你在她那里的信誉可能会荡然无存。

src: That's my dear friend, Euclid. It's a prattleplant. It stores every phrase it hears in its neuroot network, and it mimics speech by flicking its leaves against one another. What comes out is gibberish as often as not, but even so, it's agreeable company for my nights spent tinkering. It is old, perhaps older than I am, and it hasn't yet run out of things to say.
zh: 那是我亲爱的朋友，欧几里得。它是一株絮语草。它把听到的每一句话都存在神经根网络里，并用叶片相互拍打来模仿言语。说出来的话多半是胡言乱语，但即便如此，在我修补度过的夜晚，它也是令人愉快的陪伴。它很老了，也许比我还老，却从未说尽它的话。

src:
That's not even how it works!

First, I image your head, read your self's narrative from the folds of your brain, cross-check it against the Thin World's ambient log of your life's deeds...

Then I... stylize... the story, and I engrave it on the walls. Once I'm done... then you can entomb =player.reflexive=.
zh:
根本不是这么回事！

首先，我要为你的头颅成像，从你脑回的褶皱中读出你自身的叙事，再与薄界关于你生平功业的环境记录相互核对……

然后我再……润色……这个故事，把它镌刻在墙上。待我完成……你才能让=player.reflexive=入葬。

src: That's right. By concealing =all.influence=, it was =thief.name|strip= who stole Kindrish!
zh: 没错。正是=thief.name|strip=隐瞒了=all.influence=，偷走金德里什的就是此人！

src:
That's right. I've leased your friends the Spindlegrounds and appointed you viceroy to oversee their operation.

Welcome to court, asphodelyte. You serve at my pleasure.
zh:
没错。我已将纺锤场租给你的朋友们，并任命你为总督，监管他们的营作。

欢迎入朝，阿斯福德石之人。你在我的恩准下效力。

src: That's strange. This bracer is heavily worn, but surprisingly clean.
zh: 真奇怪。这只护腕磨损得厉害，却出奇地干净。

src: Thatched together out of scrap metal, =pronouns.subjective= =verb:teeter:afterpronoun=. What was the artist and maker thinking while banging metal into a likeness? =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:occupy:afterpronoun= a point between poles on several axes: halfway between chimp and human, halfway between child and adult. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:are:afterpronoun= small, and there are shadows under =pronouns.possessive= chrome cheek.
zh: 以废铁拼缀而成，=pronouns.subjective=摇摇晃晃地立着。那匠人把金属敲成这般模样时，心里在想什么？=pronouns.Subjective=占据着几条轴线两极之间的一点：半是黑猩猩，半是人；半是孩童，半是成人。=pronouns.Subjective=个子矮小，=pronouns.possessive=铬制的颊下有阴影。

src: The =spice:instancesOf.divineFeeling.!random= of =faction.the.name= was revealed to the people of =spice.entity:name= through =sacredThing=.|=id=
zh: 借=sacredThing=，=faction.the.name=的=spice:instancesOf.divineFeeling.!random=在=spice.entity:name=的民众面前显露出来。|=id=

src: The =spice:instancesOf.divineFeeling.!random= of =sultanName= was revealed to the people of =spice.entity:name= through =sacredThing=.|=id=
zh: 借=sacredThing=，=sultanName=的=spice:instancesOf.divineFeeling.!random=在=spice.entity:name=的民众面前显露出来。|=id=

src: The =spice:instancesOf.profaneFeeling.!random= of =factionName= was revealed to the people of =spice.entity:name= through =factionName=.|=id=
zh: 借=factionName=，=factionName=的=spice:instancesOf.profaneFeeling.!random=在=spice.entity:name=的民众面前显露出来。|=id=

src: The =spice:instancesOf.profaneFeeling.!random= of =spice.entity:name= was revealed to the people of =village= through =spice.entity:profaneThing=.|=id=
zh: 借=spice.entity:profaneThing=，=spice.entity:name=的=spice:instancesOf.profaneFeeling.!random=在=village=的民众面前显露出来。|=id=

src: The =tonic.description= burns out of your system.
The Barathrumites of Grit Gate agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
zh: 砂砾门的巴拉斯鲁姆派已同意接纳斯林斯人为己族。

src: The Barathrumites say I must plumb a cave called Golgotha before joining them.
zh: 巴拉斯鲁姆派说，加入他们之前，我须先探一处名叫各各他的洞穴。

src: The Bey Lah scouts have had trouble with violent kendren. What if one slipped by?
zh: 贝拉的斥候一直为凶暴的肯德伦人所扰。万一有一个溜进来了呢？

src: The Fishhead will catalyze the electric lake, and sure we as fossils will brick the ground but what a dais it will be!
zh: 鱼首将催化那电之湖，我辈化石固然要砌砖般铺满地面，然而那将是何等的高台！

src:
The Freeholds of Qud, that web of folk-clusters, of committees and caucuses, syndicated slime-mold cities held in peace by mutual frustration and monumental effort.

If you need detail, ask a Freeholder, but clear your day first.
zh:
卡德之自由领，那由各族群落、委员会与派系织成的网，那一座座联营的黏菌之城，靠着彼此的挫败与浩大的努力，维持着和平。

你若想知详情，去问一位自由领民罢，但先把这一天腾出来。

src: The Grounded Mind cannot soar. The Mind Aloft is limitless.
zh: 落地之心不能翱翔。高悬之心无有穷尽。

src:
The Hindriarch is the most likely suspect, in my opinion. She might have kept it for herself or sold it. I've been suspicious of her pet bodyguard, Kesehind, for years--I wouldn't put it past him to steal the treasure himself.

That said, it might have been an outsider like you. I doubt any of the villagers had the nerve to steal such a valuable object, but I suppose it's faintly possible.

But it wasn't Neelahind. You won't find a purer heart in all of Qud than hers.
zh:
依我看，族长嫌疑最大。她可能自己留着，也可能卖掉了。我多年来一直怀疑她那条宠物护卫凯塞因德——要我说，宝物就是他自己偷的也不稀奇。

话虽如此，也可能是像你这样的外来者。我怀疑村人里有谁有胆子偷这么贵重的东西，不过大概也有一线可能。

但绝不是尼拉欣德。整个卡德，你找不出比她更纯净的心了。

src: The Hindriarch mentioned that you have a brother. Where is he?
zh: 族长提到你有个兄弟。他在哪里？

src:
The Kasaphescence shine upon =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, =name=.

Although the welcome of these slynth be not entirely without incident, I am yet hopeful that their curiosity and dedication to tasks will serve them well among us.
zh:
愿圣化现之光照耀=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=，=name=。

这些斯林斯的迎接虽非全然顺遂，我仍期盼它们的好奇与专注，能让它们在我们之间立足。

src: The Mechanimists of the Six Day Stilt agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
zh: 六日高塔的机神教徒已同意接纳斯林斯人为己族。

src: The North Sheva superstrate evanesces, and the latches that prevent descent unlock.
zh: 北舍瓦超覆层消散，阻止下降的闩锁随之解开。

src: The Onias is robed in flowing machinic regalia. He is the voice of Shekhinah, and so he wields the charm of words to give depth cues on the shape of the Kasaphescence, and repeats the story of the Fathers who transited Her from the ideal to the material. As crownhead of the white dune see, he leads the high priests in tracing the circuit diagrams of the second Canticles, and moderates their hermeneutic divisions.
zh: 奥尼亚斯身披飘拂的机械法服。他是舍金纳之声，因而以言辞的魅力为圣化现之形点出纵深之序，并重述诸位先父如何将她自理念导入物质的故事。身为白丘圣座的首座，他率领众大祭司勾摹第二圣歌的电路图，并调停他们解经上的分歧。

src:
The Putus Templar, or the Sons and Daughters, as they call themselves, are an order of knights who claim descendancy from the Eaters, the ancient folk who wrought the chrome halls of Qud. Beware them, for while they despise all mutants, they harbor a special malice for Barathrum.

Take care that you do not find =player.reflexive= inside one of their slave pens.
zh:
普图斯圣殿骑士团，或称他们自号的诸子诸女，是一个骑士修会，自称是食者的后裔——食者即那远古之民，铸造了卡德的铬钢大厅。提防他们，因为他们憎恶一切变种人，对巴拉斯鲁姆更怀有特别的恶意。

当心别让=player.reflexive=落入他们的奴隶囚栏之中。

src:
The Rainbow Wood is a fair bit too dangerous for a casual promenade, but nothing compares to its beauty. Once, I viewed it from above by means of a gyrocopter, and I will never forget the sights that I saw.

Nor will I forget crashing to the ground because the gyrocopter broke, but every adventure has its complications, wouldn't you say?
zh:
虹林对于随意漫步而言太过危险，可论其美，无可比拟。我曾乘旋翼机自高处俯瞰，所见景象永生难忘。

旋翼机坏了，摔回地面的事我也同样忘不了，但每场冒险总有些波折，你说是不是？

src:
The Resheph, power-haver,
ruler of souls,
holder of land,
authority made singular.
zh:
利悉，掌权者，
灵魂之主宰，
疆土之持有者，
独一无二的权威。

src: The Seekers of the Sightless Way hunt espers.
zh: 盲途寻道者猎杀灵能者。

src: The Seraph spoke of a Great Machine that spanned galaxies, the motion of whose sails and gear trains directed the fluidic shifting of stars and cultures. But they spoke little of it, and little I know.
zh: 撒拉弗曾说起横跨星系的大机神，其帆与齿轮组的运转，牵引着群星与诸民如流体般迁移。可祂们说得甚少，我所知亦甚少。

src: The Sheva-wise length of the Spindle tether is clasped in the locking mechanisms of the arrival chamber. Stabilizing pounders beat their gongs and smooth vibrative aberrations from the Shevas' geolocked orbit.
zh: 纺锤系缆沿舍瓦方向的全长，被扣紧于抵达舱的锁闭机构之中。稳定用的重锤敲响铜锣，抹平舍瓦们地锁轨道上的震颤偏差。

src: The Six Day Stilt rises from the dunes like a petrified kraken corpse, bearing down upon the vacant flats.
zh: 六日高塔自沙丘间拔起，宛如石化的海怪尸骸，沉沉俯压空旷平野。

src: The Sky-Bear flies anew! From the clutches of the frozen past, you recovered =this.refname=.
zh: 天熊重新翱翔！你从冰封往昔的魔掌中寻回了=this.refname=。

src: The Spindle scintillates in watery effigy on her surface. She ferries crushed granite through a mountain pass and into her leafy firth.
zh: 纺锤在她水面闪烁，宛若倒映的幻影。她载着碎裂花岗岩穿过山隘，流入葱茏河口。

src: The Svardym Geeub mentioned a machine speaker and her ursine apprentice. Was that you?
zh: 斯瓦迪姆·吉乌布提过一位机器讲者和她那熊徒弟。那是你么？

src:
The Templar are assaulting the enclave? Oh dear, dear...

May our guns' lasers shine with the light of the Kasaphescence.
zh:
圣殿骑士在攻打据点？哎呀，哎呀……

愿我们枪炮的激光，闪耀着圣化现的光辉。

src: The Templar are defeated, but will they return in force?
zh: 圣殿骑士已被击败，可他们会卷土重来么？

src: The Temple of the Rock is cut off from the wider world, and I hear the Mechanimist colonists no longer recognize High Priest Eschelstadt. That said, if you are favored by the Mechanimists, if you are welcome in their holy places, then I've no doubt that Phinae Hoshaiah will grant you peaceful entry.
zh: 磐石圣殿与外界隔绝，我听说机神教的殖民者已不再承认大祭司埃舍尔施塔特。话虽如此，倘若你得机神教垂青，在他们的圣所受欢迎，那么我毫不怀疑菲奈·何沙雅会允你平安入内。

src:
The Tomb of the Eaters consisteth of twelve strata, or ten, once =ifplayerplural:ye account:thou accounteth= for transitional levels: the Folk Catacombs (in which =ifplayerplural:ye currently stand:thou currently standeth=), the Crematory and Columbarium, the Two Crypts, and the Six Tombs of Qud's Sultans above.

An =ifplayerplural:ye seek:thou seekest= fortune here, gird =ifplayerplural:thyselves:thyself= for disappointment. The tomb playeth host to objects wondrous and profane alike, but little of what surface-dwellers considereth treasure.
zh:
食者之墓共有十二层，=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=若计入过渡层则为十层：庶民墓窟（=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=此刻所立之处）、火葬场与骨灰堂、双墓室，以及其上卡德诸苏丹的六座陵墓。

=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=若来此寻求财富，=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=还请做好失望的准备。此墓所藏，既有奇妙之物，也有亵渎之物，却鲜有地表居民所认作珍宝的东西。

src: The Yd Freehold agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
zh: 伊德自由领已同意接纳斯林斯人为己族。

src: The absurd greebling of age has caused an extra patch of quills to grow where every one quillroot had been, so the hunching back of the eldest arch bear is now meadowed in white needles of every direction and length. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:seem:afterpronoun= a world in one; a spine crumpled by a chiliad of years still holds a posture of thereness and knowing. Interred beneath scarps of wrinkled skin, =pronouns.possessive= eyes smolder to the horizon like dying suns.
zh: 年岁那荒诞的繁缛雕琢，使每一处针根都多长出一丛刺，于是这位最年长的熊族尊长那佝偻的背上，如今遍生白色的针，四向纵横，长短不一。=pronouns.Subjective=仿佛一身即是一方天地；一具被千年岁月揉皱的脊骨，仍旧撑着一种“在场而洞明”的姿态。埋于层层皱皮崖壁之下的，=pronouns.possessive=双眼向地平线闷燃，如将熄的太阳。

src: The aching earth belched a ribbon of molten glass onto the Black Stair and anointed a nonet of gas-eating flax-wearers.
zh: 痛苦的大地将一条熔融的玻璃带喷吐在黑阶之上，为九名食气的亚麻衣者行了涂油礼。

src: The action cost of firing pistols is reduced by 25%.
The air =subject.generalDirectionIfAny= bursts into a field of frigid mist!
zh: =subject.generalDirectionIfAny=的空气骤然化为一片刺骨的寒雾！

src: The air =subject.generalDirectionIfAny= ceases shimmering with heat.
The air =subject.generalDirectionIfAny= starts to shimmer with heat!

The air swims around the axe's triangular head like the heat off the high salt sun. Such a weapon of war seems a strange fit for an agrarian people like the hindren, but it serves to illustrate how cornered prey might react over long time scales.
zh: 斧的三角头四周，空气如高悬盐日的热浪般荡漾。这般战争之器，似乎不合欣德伦人这样的农耕之民，却恰可说明被逼入绝境的猎物，在漫长的岁月里会作何反应。

src: The amaranthine dream! The heights within ourselves we might yet reach with his guidance. There it is in all of us -- shades of our elder selves. Within each man, a goat. Within each goat, a man!
zh: 不朽之梦！在他引领之下，我们尚可攀上自身之内的高处。那在我们每个人之内——我们旧我之影。每个人之内，有一只羊。每只羊之内，有一个人！

src: The amoeba farmer slouches in the heat. A beaten, leather hat is pulled low over =pronouns.possessive= eyes and sweat glistens on the scruffs of hair on =pronouns.possessive= cheeks. =pronouns.Possessive= hands are caked in mud, slime, and salt.
zh: 变形虫养殖者在暑热中懒懒地弓着身子。一顶破旧的革帽拉得低低，遮住=pronouns.possessive=眼睛，汗珠在=pronouns.possessive=颊上的几丛短毛间闪着光。=pronouns.Possessive=双手结满泥、黏液与盐。

src: The ancient bronze coin has a square cut from its center. Time has furnished it with a seafoam patina.
zh: 这枚古老的青铜钱币，中心剜去一方孔。岁月为它添上一层海沫般的铜绿。

src: The ankle is cinched by a leather strap and goldleaf buckle; crushed plant matter soils the soles.
zh: 脚踝被一条皮带与金箔扣环束紧；碾碎的草木浆液弄脏了鞋底。

src: The array of strange parts are summed together as a kind of tool.
zh: 这一堆奇异零件合在一起，可算作一种工具。

src: The art of sitting is practiced with the nuance of quantum chromodynamics, among the buoyant caste. Here =pronouns.subjective= =verb:perch:afterpronoun= on =pronouns.possessive= palanquin walker and =verb:drink:afterpronoun= in the nubile realm.
zh: 在浮游种姓之中，端坐之术被奉行得如同量子色动力学般精微。在此，=pronouns.subjective=栖于=pronouns.possessive=的轿行者之上，于妙龄之境中啜饮。

src: The back-mounted gun rack of polished chrome has two slots for pistols to sit over each shoulder or for a single rifle to sit over the shoulder of choice.
zh: 抛光铬钢制成的背负枪架，有两个卡槽，可使手枪各悬于双肩之上，或使一支步枪悬于所择一肩之上。

src: The battle axe has better penetration and deals more damage than your dagger.
zh: 战斧的穿透力比你的匕首更强，造成的伤害也更高。

src:
The beacon confirmed my hypothesis. The Spindle is an elevator, engineered by the Eaters to convey freight to and from the vault of heaven. You see, nestling, in the earliest aurora of our past, the Eaters of Earth were joined by a great coven of beings that spanned the firmament. But the Eaters succumbed to some terrible temptation, and an injunction was placed on our world.

Since then, the stars were silent to us, and our world was left to molder and decay. But something changed. The signal affirms that an entity roosts atop the Spindle, and invites us to join it.

Dare I say, is the injunction at an end? It's too early to tell, but alas, there could be hope for our world.
zh:
信标证实了我的假说。纺锤是一部电梯，由食者建造，用以往返于苍穹之库运送货物。你看，雏儿，在我们往昔最初的曙光里，地球的食者曾与一个横跨穹苍的伟大生灵盟会相聚。然而食者屈服于某种可怕的诱惑，我们的世界便被下了一道禁令。

自那以后，群星对我们沉默，我们的世界被遗弃，任其朽坏。可有些事变了。这信号确认，有一位存在栖于纺锤之巅，并邀请我们加入它。

敢问一句，那禁令是否已到尽头？现在断言尚早，但或许，我们的世界有望了。

src: The bear is dead! Looks like it dropped something, too.
zh: 熊死了！看来它还掉落了什么东西。

src:
The bear is dead! Looks like it dropped something, too.

But first, let's use this opportunity to heal.
zh:
熊死了！看来它还掉落了什么东西。

不过先趁此机会疗伤吧。

src: The bear is wounded, but it's tough. This'll be a harder fight.
zh: 这熊受了伤，但很硬朗。这场仗会更难打。

src: The beauty! My stomach is in stirs.
zh: 何其美哉！我的肚肠都在翻腾。

src: The beetle farmer slouches in the heat. A beaten, leather hat is pulled low over =pronouns.possessive= eyes and sweat glistens on the scruffs of hair on =pronouns.possessive= cheeks. =pronouns.Possessive= hands are caked in mud and salt.
zh: 甲虫养殖者在暑热中懒懒地弓着身子。一顶破旧的革帽拉得低低，遮住=pronouns.possessive=眼睛，汗珠在=pronouns.possessive=颊上的几丛短毛间闪着光。=pronouns.Possessive=双手结满泥与盐。

src:
The beetle has some witchwood bark. That's useful -- it heals you when you eat it. Let's trade for it.

Press =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd=
zh:
甲虫有些巫木树皮。那东西很有用——吃下去能疗伤。我们把它换过来。

按=commandKey:CmdTradeAdd=

src:
The beetle has some witchwood bark. That's useful -- it heals you when you eat it. Let's trade for it.

Press =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=
zh:
甲虫有些巫木树皮。那东西很有用——吃下去能疗伤。我们把它换过来。

按=commandKey:CmdTradeAdd=或=commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=

src:
The beetle's inventory is on the left, and your inventory is on the right.

The beetle has some witchwood bark. That's useful -- it heals you when you eat it. Let's trade for it.
zh:
甲虫的物品在左侧，你的物品在右侧。

甲虫有些巫木树皮。那东西很有用——吃下去能疗伤。我们把它换过来。

src: The beldam district has had its dustcloud fins welded to the superstratum and mazed with labyrinthite to protect the hyperbrain. Inside that electromagnetic cage and quantum temple, the stirrings of the Great Siach spill from its nondeterministic core.
zh: 老妪区的尘云鳍片被焊接于上层地层，并以迷宫石筑成迷阵，以护卫超脑。在这座电磁囚笼与量子神殿之内，大西阿赫的搅动自其非确定性的核心倾泻而出。

src: The bell sounds wheel at right angles and shock the wet meat off our perfect bones! I was made to be bones.
zh: 钟声直角回旋，将湿肉自我们完美的白骨上震落！我生来便是为了做骨。

src: The bellies of vessels are sacred, for they both carry the waters of life and project the fluid past onto the convex present.
zh: 容器之腹是神圣的，因为它既盛载生命之水，又将往昔之流投映于凸起的当下。

src: The big urshiib is dusted with spice and wet with honeyed grease, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:smell:afterpronoun= of a melange: hot mushroom, cloying ink, saffron, and cooked tongue.
zh: 这头大乌尔希卜身上撒着香料，蜂蜜的油脂将它润得湿亮；=pronouns.subjective=身上气味杂陈：滚烫的蘑菇、腻人的墨、藏红花，还有煮熟的舌。

src: The biped form emerges out of a cocoon of wood and fiberglass.
zh: 两足的形体自木与玻璃纤维的茧中浮现。

src: The biped form emerges out of a gigantic cocoon of wood and fiberglass.
zh: 两足的形体自一只巨大的木与玻璃纤维之茧中浮现。

src: The bite burst into so many strands of sinew.
zh: 那一口咬下，迸作许多条筋腱。

src: The bite is crisp, and then it bursts into water.
zh: 咬下时清脆，随即迸出一口水。

src: The black bellows of the earth are etched into a red egg. All its rough edges have been polished to shine.
zh: 大地的黑色风箱，蚀刻成一枚红色的卵。其粗糙的棱角皆已磨得光亮。

src: The black bellows of the earth are etched into red polish.
zh: 大地的黑色风箱，蚀刻成一片红色的光泽。

src: The blood is still wet. Never had you regarded wetness as a sort of clock, until now.
zh: 血仍是湿的。你从未将湿润视作一种时钟，直到此刻。

src: The blueprint '=blueprint.name=' is not a cybernetic.
The box is wrought from chewed wire and dented iron.
zh: 这只箱子以咬断的铁丝与凹陷的铁块制成。

src: The bright countenance and mane of short quills on the young urshiib cut through even a canvas of fraying light. His shoulders are drawn back with fresh purpose, and his eyes pierce the foreground with a laser's precision.
zh: 这位年轻乌尔希卜明亮的面容与短刺鬃毛，即便在摇曳欲散的光之画布上，也鲜明夺目。他双肩向后舒展，带着崭新的使命，目光如激光般精确，刺穿前景。

src: The brine stings your mouth and fills your breath with lake air.
zh: 卤水刺痛你的口舌，呼吸间满是湖风的气息。

src: The broad and tall aegis is a halved kite of sunbeam and starless dusk, and painted across her sword-nicked plane is the Holy Rhombus of the Temple.
zh: 这面宽而高的庇护之盾，是日光与无星暮色拼成的半幅鸢盾，其上布满剑痕的盾面，绘着圣殿的圣菱。

src: The broad-eye bat flaps a nuisance in the carcass-darkened space.
zh: 阔目蝙蝠在尸骸染暗的空间里扑扇，惹人烦扰。

src: The call of the sea rang through the troubadour-hero =name= once again, and =player.they= set sail from the familiar shore of =object.a.name=.
zh: 海的呼唤再度响彻行吟英雄=name=的胸怀，=player.they=便自=object.a.name=那熟悉的岸畔扬帆而去。

src: The cambered cottages of the shesh qanim sprouted in tufts as star traffic crowded the low medinas and Eaters urged to spend more time topside.
zh: 随着星际交通涌入低处的麦地那，食者们又被敦促多在顶层逗留，舍什卡尼姆的拱背小屋便成簇地冒了出来。

src: The carousel respiratory system is embedded in a wider network of biomechanical feelstuffs. Some confluence of its nodes have decided to grow a stemlike twine that supports a pinkish, seeing eye. Diagnostics confirm that looking around calms the ship down.
zh: 旋转舱的呼吸系统嵌入一张更广阔的生物机械感觉网中。其节点的某些交汇处，决定生出一条茎状的细绳，托起一只粉红色的、能视物的眼睛。诊断证实，四下张望能让飞船平静下来。

src: The carved reliefs here are Eater-ancient. What is the history of this place?
zh: 这里的浮雕是食者时代的古物。这地方的历史是怎样的？

src: The cat herder slouches in the heat. A beaten, leather hat is pulled low over =pronouns.possessive= eyes and sweat glistens on the scruffs of hair on =pronouns.possessive= cheeks. =pronouns.Possessive= hands are caked in mud, salt, and glittering optic-fiber dust.
zh: 猫群牧者在暑热中懒懒地弓着身子。一顶破旧的革帽拉得低低，遮住=pronouns.possessive=眼睛，汗珠在=pronouns.possessive=颊上的几丛短毛间闪着光。=pronouns.Possessive=双手结满泥、盐与闪烁的光纤之尘。

src: The cats are not for sale.
The ceiling collapses and rocks come pouring in!
zh: 天花板轰然坍塌，岩石倾泻而下！

src: The chaff of the yuckwheat stem tastes even worse than the stem itself, and it has no medicinal value, so it's no wonder someone threw it away.
zh: 苦麦茎的糠壳比茎本身还要难吃，又毫无药效，难怪被人丢弃。

src: The chance your mutant physiology reacts adversely to a tonic is increased to 33%.
zh: 你的变异体质对滋补剂产生不良反应的几率提高至33%。

src: The characteristic glass arch marks the enclosure as a becoming nook gutted and wire-stripped for a new purpose. A claw extends for soldering and shaping, and in the underdrum, a wheel spins wet clay fresh and ready for sunslag fermentation.
zh: 那标志性的玻璃拱门表明，此处乃是一座被掏空、剥去电线、另作他用的化身龛。一只爪臂伸出，用以焊接与塑形；下方的转鼓中，一只轮子正旋着湿润的黏土，只待日渣发酵。

src: The chimes of Chavvah have agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
zh: 查娃的钟鸣者已同意接纳斯林斯人为己族。

src: The chrome platform begins to hum as it ascends into the darkness.
zh: 铬质平台嗡嗡作响，升入黑暗之中。

src: The chrome platform begins to hum as it descends into the darkness.
zh: 铬质平台嗡嗡作响，降入黑暗之中。

src: The chuppah of Qas and Qon

The climber design relies on the use of electromagnets to interface with the planet's magnetic field and generate torque. Unfortunately, the Spindle generates its own interfering field, perhaps as a mechanism to prevent unwanted ascension.

Our aim is to access the Spindle's control unit and disable the field. How we accomplish this, however, is an enigma. From disparate bits across the archives of the digitum, Ereshkigal has stitched together a cryptic but instructional brocade. She's learned the field can be turned off from a place called Brightsheol, located in the Thin World and accessible only through Resheph's tomb inside the Tomb of the Eaters.
zh:
攀升器的设计依靠电磁铁与星球磁场相接并产生扭矩。不幸的是，纺锤自身会产生干扰场，或许是用以阻止不速之攀登。

我们的目标是进入纺锤的控制单元，关闭此场。然而如何做到，却是个谜。埃列什基伽勒从数码之库零散的片段中，缝出了一幅晦涩而富于指引的锦缎。她得知这磁场可以在一个名叫明冥的地方关闭，那地方位于薄界，只能经由食者之墓内的利悉之墓进入。

src: The climbing vine curls tight about a witchwood stake. A noggin of knotted tendrils bounces to and fro, keeping time with the movement of nearby creatures and objects. =pronouns.Possessive= ears perk at the sound of language, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:flick:afterpronoun= leaves against =pronouns.possessive= stake to mimic phrases =pronouns.subjective= heard uttered centuries ago.
zh: 攀援的藤紧紧缠着一根巫木桩。一团多节的卷须之结来回弹动，与附近生灵与物件的动作合着节拍。一听见言语之声，=pronouns.Possessive=耳便竖起；=pronouns.subjective=把叶子拂向=pronouns.possessive=那根木桩，模仿=pronouns.subjective=数百年前听人说过的话。
冰冷的黏液缠在口中，挥之不去。

src: The coverboard of this ancient and hefty tome is faded to the average hue of ten thousand families of dust and skin oils.
zh: 这部古老而厚重的巨册，封板已褪成万千家族的尘土与肤脂之平均色调。

src: The crab farmer slouches in the heat. A beaten, leather hat is pulled low over =pronouns.possessive= eyes and sweat glistens on the scruffs of hair on =pronouns.possessive= cheeks. =pronouns.Possessive= hands are caked in mud and salt.
zh: 螃蟹养殖者在暑热中懒懒地弓着身子。一顶破旧的革帽拉得低低，遮住=pronouns.possessive=眼睛，汗珠在=pronouns.possessive=颊上的几丛短毛间闪着光。=pronouns.Possessive=双手结满泥与盐。

src:
The cracked egg from we crawl yet rest, in the Reef.

Siblings there. One speak very well: Thah.
zh:
我们爬出的那只裂蛋，仍在，歇在礁上。

兄弟姊妹在那里。有一位说话极好：塔。

src: The cracks in the wall are fossils of the compressed foamcrete's hexagonal expansion pattern.
zh: 墙上的裂缝，是被压缩的泡沫混凝土六边形膨胀纹样所留下的化石。

src: The craftsmanship of this pistol worked in brass and chrome is breathtaking: grips of kingswood call the palm to an airless wrap, the hammer is contoured to the thumb by the microinch, and the sight draws the eye down the barrel like the slipping of silk. It's engraved all around with withered ivy, and the muzzle is kissed in blood.
zh: 这柄以黄铜与铬铸成的手枪，工艺令人叹为观止：王木握把使掌心如入真空般紧贴，击锤依拇指之形精修至微英寸，准星引人目光顺枪管滑下，宛如丝绸滑落。枪身遍刻枯萎的常春藤，枪口则染着血吻。

src: The creature has been made. What now?
zh: 那生灵已经造成了。接下来呢？

src: The creature is born, and you are bonded? What work! You are a sterling shaper of world, =name=, and I've nothing left to give you but my praise.
zh: 生灵诞生，你也与之缔结了联结？好一番功业！你是个上乘的塑世之匠，=name=，除了赞辞，我已无物可赠。

src: The creature wears the diodic hood of the Chromaic Church, but =pronouns.possessive= field robes bear none of its ceremonial stiffness.
zh: 此生灵戴着色彩教会的二极管兜帽，但=pronouns.possessive=的行袍却全无那般典礼的僵板。

src: The crocheted leaf and moss-mass that carpets the hot-smoking yurts of goatfolk has been sewn to a leather collar, giving its wearer the appearance of a creeping bush.
zh: 羊人冒烟的热毡帐上铺着的钩织叶片与苔藓团，被缝上皮革衣领，令穿戴者形似一丛匍匐的灌木。

src: The crown is crushed by wear into a hundred papery creases, and the brim is stained in the fractal signatures of sweat and salt.
zh: 冠顶因久戴被压出上百道纸一般的皱褶，帽檐上染着汗与盐所留的分形印记。

src: The crystal shatters and concentrated thoughtstuff swells in tide and soaks your mind.
zh: 晶体碎裂，浓缩的思绪之物如潮涨起，浸透你的心神。

src: The darkling crystal was shattered and abraded to dust; a million worlds of self have crumbled.
zh: 暗沉的水晶被击碎，磨成了尘；百万个自我的世界已然崩塌。

src: The darkness absorbs the laser beam.
The death of =subject.the.name= means that the investigation can go no further.
The delphic countenance of the Tungsten King is frozen in chrome, cast to perfect specification.
zh: 钨王那神谕般的容颜凝固于铬中，依完美的规格铸成。

src: The diaphanous dermis throws the circulatory, muscular, and nervous networks into silhouetted relief.
zh: 透明的真皮使循环、肌肉与神经之网络，如剪影般清晰浮现。

src: The distended jaw of this large aureolin fish is lined with wicked, blade-like teeth. You shudder to imagine what sort of terrible amphibious fiend the madpole might one day become.
zh: 这尾金黄的大鱼下颚鼓胀，排满刀锋般凶恶的牙齿。你不寒而栗地想着：这狂蝌蚪有朝一日会长成何等可怖的两栖恶兽。

src: The dog tutor's lips are slick from =pronouns.possessive= constant stream of gematrial growling, phonemes spun through numerological sieves, which the hounds are trained on.
zh: 这位训犬人的嘴唇因=pronouns.possessive=口中不断流出的数字咆哮而湿亮——那些音素经数术之筛滤出，猎犬们正是循此受训。

src:
The echoes of ending reverberate from the roots I once called mine.

My liaison is severed. Why?
zh:
终结的回声，自我曾称为己有的根中回荡。

我的联系断了。为何？

src: The edge is bright and polished.
The effects of tonics last twice as long.
zh: 补剂的效果持续时间加倍。

src: The electric sizzle of life! Prickling and crisping skin, red and raw and beautiful beneath.
zh: 生命的电噼啪作响！皮肤刺痛焦脆，其下红润、生嫩而美丽。

src: The emitted frequencies of your tiniest bits are synchronized with the standardized band for force emission.
zh: 你最细微的零件所发出的频率，已与力场发射的标准频段同步。

src:
The engraving is done, Moloch! I do hope it's to your liking. Your deeds are incised here for all time.

You may now enter the sarcophagus, Moloch. Be at peace.
zh:
雕刻完成了，摩洛！但愿合您的心意。您的功业已镌刻于此，永世长存。

摩洛，您现在可以进入石棺了。愿您安息。

src: The entity I spoke with at Eyn Roj mentioned a chiming rock...
zh: 我在埃因罗吉遇到的那个存在，提到过一块鸣响的石头……

src:
The evidence is clear. In violation of sacred law and the will of her people, Eskhind stole the artifact called Kindrish from Bey Lah. She will be stripped of honor, stripped of water, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will her name be spoken here again, and she will never return... on pain of death.

And I... I will go with her. May my property be payment for the harm she has done to our people, and I will gladly pay it for the privilege of walking by her side.

I have no doubt that Bey Lah will thrive in my absence as it did before I became warden. Live and drink, my kin. Long may Hindriarch Keh lead you.
zh:
证据确凿。埃斯金德违背神圣的律法与族人的意愿，从贝拉盗走了名为金德里什的古器。她将被褫夺荣誉，褫夺水源，并从我们的口述史中除名。此后此地再不会提起她的名字，她也永不得回返……违者死。

而我……我要与她同去。愿我的财产用以抵偿她给族人造成的伤害；能与她并肩同行，我甘愿付出这代价。

我深信，没有我，贝拉也会像我就任守望者之前一样兴旺。且生且饮，我的族人。愿族长凯长久领导你们。

族长凯的领导公正无私。愿她长寿！

src:
The evidence is clear: Bey Lah's own Hindriarch has betrayed her people. She took our ancestral treasure as her own, pinning the crime on an exile she knew could not defend herself. For this treason, she is hereby stripped of title, stripped of property, stripped of home.

With the exile of Keh-Hind, the hindriarchy lies vacant, with no elders fit to take it. Eskhind will act as an interim leader until we figure out what to do next, as a people.

I fear dark times ahead. We must remain strong in the coming days.
zh:
证据确凿：贝拉自己的族长背叛了她的族人。她将祖传之宝据为己有，还把罪名嫁祸给一个她明知无力自辩的流放者。因此叛逆之罪，她即刻被褫夺头衔，褫夺财产，褫夺家园。

凯-欣德既已流放，族长之位空悬，长老中无人堪当此任。在我们作为一个族群想出下一步该怎么办之前，由埃斯金德暂代。

我担心前路晦暗。来日我们必须坚强。

src:
The evidence is clear: Eskhind did not steal Kindrish. In fact, I believe that no hindren was responsible for its theft, but one of the kendren who permeated our borders well before our investigator arrived. Any of them could have committed the theft.

Eskhind is free to go, and I'm... I'm going with her. I cannot serve under Hindriarch Keh while my beloved returns to exile.

Goodbye. May the fates have mercy upon you.
zh:
证据确凿：埃斯金德并未偷走金德里什。其实我认为，盗窃此物者并非欣德伦人，而是早在我们的调查者到来之前便渗入我们边境的肯德伦人之一。他们任何一人都可能犯下此案。

埃斯金德可以自由离去，而我……我要与她同去。我的爱人重回流放，我无法再在族长凯麾下效力。

再会了。愿命运垂怜你们。

族长凯的领导公正无私。愿她长寿！

愿命运垂怜我们所有人。

src:
The evidence is clear: Eskhind did not steal Kindrish. The crime was committed by none other than Grand-Doe's protector, Kesehind. He will be stripped of the ancestral axe he carries, stripped of his property, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will his name be spoken here again, and he will never return... on pain of death.

Moreover... Keh's attempt to pin blame on Eskhind without due process opened my eyes to her abuses of power. She need not leave Bey Lah, but she is Keh-hind once more-- stripped of her title and standing.

As for the hindriarchy, Eskhind will act as an interim leader until we figure out what to do next, as a people. It will be a challenge to accept change, but we will be stronger for it.
zh:
证据确凿：埃斯金德并未偷走金德里什。犯下此罪的，正是大母鹿的护卫凯塞因德。他将被褫夺所佩的祖传战斧，褫夺财产，并从我们的口述史中除名。此后此地再不会提起他的名字，他也永不得回返……违者死。

此外……凯未经正当程序便欲将罪名栽给埃斯金德，这让我看清了她滥用权力的行径。她不必离开贝拉，但她重又成为凯-欣德——被剥夺头衔与地位。

至于族长之位，在我们作为一个族群想出下一步该怎么办之前，由埃斯金德暂代。接受变革并非易事，但我们会因此更加坚强。

src: The faundren are complaining about the smell of yuckwheat tea, indicating recent illness.
zh: 小欣德伦人抱怨苦麦茶的气味，说明近来有人患病。

src: The faundren claim that Eskhind left the village sporting a poorly-made leather bracer, possibly to conceal Kindrish.
zh: 小欣德伦人声称埃斯金德离村时戴着一只做工粗劣的皮护腕，或许是为了遮掩金德里什。

src: The faundren heard the voice of a hindren and a kendren discussing goods late at night, indicating recent trade.
zh: 小欣德伦人在深夜听见一个欣德伦人和一个肯德伦人谈论货物，说明近来有过交易。

src: The faundren tell me that Eskhind's sister had a period of complete silence; she may have been ill.
zh: 小欣德伦人告诉我，埃斯金德的妹妹曾有一段时间完全不说话；她或许病过。

src: The faundren tell me that Kesehind went quiet for a few weeks, only to become louder than ever again.
zh: 小欣德伦人告诉我，凯塞因德沉默了几个星期，随后又变得比从前更吵闹。

src: The finned and wheeled boot had become the sigil of several sects of socionauts by the Late Sultanate. For decades their progenitors careened through the capsule pipelines of the slouching arcology, dismantling it plate by plate, pursued by the constabulary but ferried by their skates to the safety of their moss-skirted hideouts. The metaphor was writ large on the glass guts of the city: Scorch the past. Rocket into the future.
zh: 到晚期苏丹国时，带翅带轮的靴子已成为数个社群航者教派的徽记。数十年间，他们的始祖在颓倾生态城的胶囊管道中横冲直撞，一板一板地拆解它，被警队追捕，却被轮鞋载往覆满苔藓的藏身处安全脱身。这隐喻被大书于城市的玻璃肠腑之上：焚毁过去。火箭般冲向未来。

src: The flowerbeing dons the diodic hood of the Chromaic Church and crackles dry petals together at a hymnal metric. A brooch of polished chrome pinches =pronouns.possessive= foilage at the neck.
zh: 这位花灵戴着色彩教会的二极管兜帽，让干枯的花瓣依圣歌的节拍相互噼啪作响。一枚抛光铬制的胸针，在颈部夹住=pronouns.possessive=的叶丛。

src: The fluted stem of tasseled yonderbrush bends to a farpoint out of focus.
zh: 流苏彼方灌木的沟纹茎弯向一处失焦的远点。

src: The flux inside this milliscopic cask can fold space on just a large enough scale to shunt a human chassis nearby.
zh: 这只毫厘尺度的桶内的流变，恰能在足够大的尺度上折叠空间，将一具人类躯壳瞬移至近旁。

src: The flux inside this milliscopic cask can fold space on just a large enough scale to shunt a human chassis nearby. Nonlinear circuitry calculates all possible outcomes and discards those that land the host outside the target area.
zh: 这微观之桶中的流变，足以折叠空间，其尺度恰能将人身躯壳送往近处。非线性电路推演一切可能的结果，弃去那些使宿主落在目标区域之外者。

src: The flywheel of our scheme is spinning, but we must keep our paws on the treadle. Are you ready to learn what comes next?
zh: 我们这谋划的飞轮已然转动，但仍须把爪掌搭在踏板上。你可愿听听接下来如何？

src: The forces of slaughter have rearranged parts of the body. You ponder how rearrangement means something different in each of its contexts: pieces on a game board, favored courtiers in a king's hall, and parts on a body.
zh: 杀戮之力重排了这具身躯的各部。你不禁思索，“重排”一词在不同情境下意味迥异：棋盘上的棋子，君王殿中的宠臣，与身上的肢体。

src: The gaseous butterfly flits out of the dense worm.
zh: 气态的蝴蝶自稠密的蠕虫中翩然飞出。

src: The gland ruptures with a pop and fills your mouth with a cold fluid. Someone else's memories seep into your own
zh: 腺体噗地破裂，一股冷液涨满你的口腔。旁人的记忆渗入你自己的记忆。

src: The gland ruptures with a pop and fills your mouth with its foul fluid.
zh: 腺体噗地破裂，腐臭的液体涨满你的口腔。

src: The glass lune exhibits spiraling arms and the endless sluices that course between them. Pinchers, sliders, whistlers, and dials array the bezel and provide navigation affordances across the manifold.
zh: 玻璃月牙上显现出旋臂，以及在旋臂之间奔涌的无尽水道。钳钮、滑杆、哨键与转盘排列于表圈四周，供人在流形之中导航。

src: The glass lune is showered in information across the electromagnetic channels.
zh: 这枚玻璃月牙之上，信息自电磁诸频道如雨倾泻。

src: The goat herder slouches in the heat. A beaten, leather hat is pulled low over =pronouns.possessive= eyes and sweat glistens on the scruffs of hair on =pronouns.possessive= cheeks. =pronouns.Possessive= hands are caked in mud and salt.
zh: 山羊牧人在暑热中懒懒地弓着身子。一顶破旧的革帽拉得低低，遮住=pronouns.possessive=眼睛，汗珠在=pronouns.possessive=颊上的几丛短毛间闪着光。=pronouns.Possessive=双手结满泥与盐。

src: The gown floweth over small shoulders, and a sidewise veil gives glitching shape to a face tilted at the angle of anonymity. At last and freed from the lace of its cuff, a hand is moted like a sorcerous lamp, and shines in fairness.
zh: 长袍泻过窄肩，侧垂的面纱使一张偏向匿名之角的脸庞呈出闪烁失真之形。终于脱出袖口蕾丝的一只手，如一盏巫术之灯般蒙着微尘，皎皎然发着光。

src: The great capsule (overwall and world-skin) holds the kingdom in truth but not in appearance, inverting the relation of the kingdom and its king.
zh: 这巨大的胶囊（外墙兼世界之皮）在实质上容纳了王国，外观上却不然，倒转了王国与国王的关系。

src: The great frog's towering body is poised in peace and festooned like a skin temple. =pronouns.Possessive= shoulders drip with soft cloth and ornaments across the gamut of value; =pronouns.subjective= =verb:take:afterpronoun= no care to arrange or separate them.
zh: 这巨蛙高耸的身躯安然静立，周身披挂如一座皮肉之殿。=pronouns.Possessive=肩头垂着柔软的布料，佩饰贵贱杂陈；=pronouns.subjective=并不费心将它们整理或分开。

src: The grove's million laced fingers sway in gentle opulence. Verdant fronds nestle the base of the Spindle from its mountainous nook.
zh: 林苑千万交缠的指枝，在温柔丰盛中摇曳。翠绿叶簇自山间隐秘处攀来，依偎纺锤之基。

src: The growth hex of time has sculpted sharp bonestuff in corkscrew tension.
zh: 时间的生长魔咒，将尖锐的骨质物雕成螺旋紧绞之势。

src: The gunslinger-sultan =name= slew each of the seven lords of House Isner with a masterwork revolver and supped over their piled corpses.
zh: 持枪苏丹=name=以一柄精工左轮枪诛杀伊斯纳家族七位领主，并在其尸堆之上饮宴。

src: The halfgod kneels on hinds worked wide in old stone. Tiled polygons spill off the statue's base to evoke Qas's rightening of space, time, mountain, and village. Generations of moss skirt the beast's treecutter hooves.
zh: 这位半神跪伏于古石之上，后腿被刻得宽阔。基座上倾泻而下的镶嵌多边形，意在表现卡斯对空间、时间、山岳与村庄的匡正。数代的苔藓环绕着这头巨兽伐木人般的蹄子。

src: The hammer pole is capped by a twin-head of bright and azure metal. Darker stripes across its faces and throats note where it struck and beat softer carbide down.
zh: 锤杆顶着一对明亮的蔚蓝金属双头。其两面与两颈上较暗的条纹，记载着它们曾在何处击打、砸平较软的碳化物。

src: The hammer shaft is capped by a head of bright and azure metal. Darker stripes across its face and throat note where it struck and beat softer carbide down.
zh: 锤柄顶着一枚明亮的蔚蓝金属锤头。其面与颈上较暗的条纹，记载着它曾在何处击打、砸平较软的碳化物。

src: The heart of the jilted lover burns under embered petals, pinched to anguish in citrine anthers and laid on a weeping bed of sepal jade.
zh: 被弃的恋人那颗心，在余烬的花瓣下灼烧，在黄水晶的花药中被拧成剧痛，又安放在泪湿的萼片碧玉之床上。

src: The hilt was broken and remade, pieced together from iron, jewel, and leather across the prism-scatter of the past and forever becoming something new. The blade bears the scars of techniques forcing it into killing shape time and again.
zh: 刀柄曾被折断重铸，以铁、宝石与皮革拼合，穿过过往的棱镜散射，永远在成为新的事物。刃上带着无数技法留下的伤痕，它们一次又一次，将其逼成杀戮之形。

src: The hind bone of a salthopper was scorched clean and bent to a recurve bow. Sinew is strung on the nocks.
zh: 盐蜢的后肢骨被烧净，弯成一张反曲弓。筋腱绷在弓弰之上。

src: The holy colophon is held on triangular display and approached for ritual and idolatrous reflection in cycles of primes.
zh: 圣洁的卷末题记以三角形陈列，人们以素数循环的节律，趋近它，进行仪式性与偶像崇拜式的沉思。

src: The hoops sport rhombic facets that reflect light at wavelengths between plum and quartz.
zh: 环箍上布满菱形切面，反射的光波长介于梅紫与石英之间。

src: The horn and its great honeycomb of mirrors farm the moist light from the furthest reaches of this dimension and its neighbors. With it, the Eaters peered at the first moments of universal birth, and then eons that preceded.
zh: 号角及其巨大的镜面蜂巢，自此维度及其邻近维度的最远处汲取湿润的光。食者借此窥见宇宙诞生的最初时刻，以及先于其前的漫长岁月。

src: The hot, wet breath of the underearth defossilized the Sky-Bear and apprised us of this truth: =name= is Saad Amus, Saad Amus is =name=.
zh: 地底灼热潮湿的气息使天熊脱离化石之态，并向我们昭示这一真相：=name=即是萨德·阿穆斯，萨德·阿穆斯即是=name=。

src: The hurdles that separate the will and the way begin to collapse.
zh: 分隔意志与途径的重重阻碍开始崩解。

src: The infected crust of skin on =subject.the.name's:withTitles= =part.ordinalName= loosens and breaks away.
zh: =subject.the.name's:withTitles=的=part.ordinalName=上，受感染的硬皮松动脱落。

src: The infected crust of skin on =subject.the.name's:withTitles= body loosens and breaks away.
zh: =subject.the.name's:withTitles=身上受感染的硬皮松动脱落。

src: The ivory sea's dunes are like waves frozen in place. There are cracks in the salt from where the earth, blistered by the jeweled sun, contracted and broke. The horizon melts the sky together with the vast plain of Moghra'yi, the Great Salt Desert.
zh: 象牙海的沙丘，宛如凝固原地的浪涛。盐层裂开，那是大地受宝石般的太阳灼出水疱、收缩而崩裂之处。天际将苍穹与莫格拉伊这片浩瀚盐漠熔为一体。

src: The kendren are becoming more brazen in their hostility. I've had to misdirect and fight them off several times this month alone.
zh: 肯德伦人的敌意越来越嚣张。光是这个月，我就几次虚晃一枪才把他们打退。

src: The kipper and I both know that the finest ingredient is time.
zh: 腌鱼师与我都明白：最上乘的原料，是时间。

src: The lanky deerfolk's thin frame is bent in a shy hunch. But =pronouns.possessive= bright eyes shine like emeralds with insight and aggressive curiosity, and slender fingers flick to the complex rhythms of the weald.
zh: 这瘦长鹿民的纤细身躯羞怯地弯作一弓。但=pronouns.possessive=明锐的双眼如祖母绿般闪耀，其中满是洞见与咄咄的好奇；细长的手指则随着林野间繁复的节律轻弹。

src: The latching diamond achieves magnetic lock with the legs of a mover palaquin and concludes the ritual of going.
zh: 锁钉钻石与载具轿舆的双腿达成磁锁，行旅之仪式至此告终。

src: The leather bracer frays where it was ripped open.
zh: 这只皮护腕在被撕开处已磨出毛边。

src: The leech farmer slouches in the heat. A beaten, leather hat is pulled low over =pronouns.possessive= eyes and sweat glistens on the scruffs of hair on =pronouns.possessive= cheeks. =pronouns.Possessive= hands are caked in mud, blood, and salt.
zh: 水蛭养殖者在暑热中懒懒地弓着身子。一顶破旧的革帽拉得低低，遮住=pronouns.possessive=眼睛，汗珠在=pronouns.possessive=颊上的几丛短毛间闪着光。=pronouns.Possessive=双手结满泥、血与盐。

src:
The light shines so bright, the voidshadow folds not upon it. It exults. It relaxes. It wills this troubled feeling away.

Thank you for clearing Tau's path, =name=. This is better.
zh:
光如此明亮，虚影无法折叠其上。它欢欣。它松弛。它以意志驱散这困扰的情绪。

谢谢你为陶清出前路，=name=。这样好多了。

src: The long edge is bright and polished.
zh: 长长的刃口明亮而光洁。

src: The long edge is bright and polished. A wide grip is stained with dozens of oily fingerprints.
zh: 长长的刃口明亮而光洁。宽握把上沾着数十个油腻的指印。

src: The long lathe of time shaved the prospects from beneath a reptile's feet until =pronouns.subjective= hid in a shell of plastron and carapace, brooding and peevish.
zh: 漫长的时间之车床削去了那爬虫脚下的种种前景，直到=pronouns.subjective=缩进腹甲与背甲合铸的壳里，郁郁而乖戾。

src: The long shaft widens to a rigid and symmetric polygon of azure metal. Nicks and scores tally on its two heads.
zh: 长杖渐宽，成一枚坚硬而对称的蔚蓝金属多边体。缺口与刻痕于其两首累累计数。

src: The lost Mark of Death from the late sultanate was =MarkOfDeath=.
zh: 失落于末代苏丹国的死亡印记，是=MarkOfDeath=。

src: The luster of the azure edge fades to shadow at the beard of the bit, and a backspike balances the whole bladed volume.
zh: 蔚蓝刃口的光泽在斧刃之须处淡入阴影，一根背刺为这整团带刃的体积保持平衡。

src: The luster of the wide azure edge fades to shadow at the beard of the twin bits. Hairline cracks ribbon the haft.
zh: 宽阔蔚蓝刃口的光泽在双斧刃之须处淡入阴影。发丝般的裂痕如缎带，缠绕着斧柄。

src: The magnetic field has been disabled and the Spindle is free to ascend. What now?
zh: 磁场已关闭，纺锤可以攀升了。接下来呢？

src: The magnetic torch smolders inside the hedron with the offgases of high fusion, and the chamber rattles with potential.
zh: 磁力火炬在多面体内闷烧，散发着高能聚变的余气，舱室因蕴藏的潜能而震颤。

src: The manifold fibers are colorful and have a touching texture like no other fabric. A molecular weft was pulled through shrinking warps on a fractal loom.
zh: 这繁多的纤维色彩缤纷，触感动人，异于其他任何织物。分子纬线被穿过收缩的经线，织于一架分形织机。

src: The meaning is plain: An =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= swallowed by the Gyre, =ifplayerplural:ye should:thou shouldst= sing to the last.
zh: 其义甚明：=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=若为回旋所吞，=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=当歌至最后一刻。

src: The meat is crusted with adamantine char.
zh: 这肉上结着一层金刚石似的焦壳。

src: The meat is tough and crunchy with chipped plating.
zh: 肉韧，嚼来脆响，杂着碎裂的甲片。

src: The meat is tough and draped in hair.
The meat is tough but the meal is filling.
The meat strips dissolve into salt and fat.
zh: 肉条在口中化开，散出盐与脂的滋味。

src: The meat tastes of ageless sawdust.
The mess was combed out of =pronouns.possessive= nape by a doting companion, and =pronouns.possessive= forelegs are stiff in vigil.
zh: =pronouns.possessive=颈后的乱毛被一位疼惜它的伙伴梳开，=pronouns.possessive=前腿绷直，正在守夜。

src: The metabolic rhythms of the Holy City's denizens are synchronized to their diurnal rituals: during the day, repose in prayer beneath the shade of a fluted ziggurat; during the night, prowl the toxic arboreta for sacrifices.
zh: 圣城居民的代谢节律与昼夜的仪式同步：白昼，于槽纹层叠的金字塔阴影下祈祷安息；夜晚，于有毒的树园中潜行，寻觅祭品。

src: The metal satchel opens, folds itself inside out, and transforms into a contraption studded with pinions and drills. It starts to burrow into the ground.
zh: 金属挎包张开，自行翻转，化作一架嵌满小齿轮与钻头的机关，开始向地下钻去。

src: The microscopic cartridge synthesizes dopamine at a rapid rate and floods the neural pathways in motivational bliss.
zh: 微观的药匣高速合成多巴胺，使神经通路淹没于奋发的极乐之中。

src: The mindful curvature of the wizarding surface masquerades as the Worldskin for learning minds who wish to trace the arc of sorcery.
zh: 这巫术之面用心地弯出弧度，假扮成世界之皮，供好学之心描摹法术的弧线。

src: The moisture is sucked out of your body.
zh: 你体内的水分被抽干了。

src: The moisture is sucked out of your throat.
zh: 你喉中的水分被抽干了。

src: The momentum from your charge causes your =weapon.name:single:withTitles= to cleave deeper through =object.the.name's:withTitles= =cleaveTarget=.
zh: 冲锋的势头使你的=weapon.name:single:withTitles=更深地劈入=object.the.name's:withTitles=的=cleaveTarget=。

src: The moon is their marriage light! And then a whole world for the Girsh daughters of nephilim!
zh: 月亮是它们的婚礼之光！而后，一整个世界归于拿非利人的吉尔什之女！

src: The moon scowls on an unseen jungle, the craters of brow shaded with animal ash and eaten to a natural ridgeline by the venomous breathe of gods.
zh: 月色蹙眉，俯瞰一片不可见的丛林；眉宇间的坑穴敷着兽灰为荫，又为诸神毒息所蚀，磨成一道天然的山脊。

src: The moors rattle and a marble brick crumbles as a starship takes off.
zh: 荒原震颤，一块大理石砖碎裂坍落，一艘星舰腾空而起。

src:
The mopango have cared for me whilst I could not care for myself, giving me the only name I now know. I will stay to help them. This chassis is a prison no longer, and perhaps deeper truths may yet be found within it.

To =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, new friend, I offer a piece of this former prison that =ifplayerplural:ye may:thou mayest= find useful, along with my thanks.
zh:
当我无力自顾时，莫潘戈照料了我，赐我如今唯一知晓的名字。我将留下来帮助他们。这副躯壳不再是牢笼，也许其中尚可寻得更深的真理。

新朋友，我将这昔日牢笼的一片赠予=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=，=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=或许用得着，并附上我的谢意。

src: The mopango of the Tomb agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
zh: 陵墓的莫潘戈已同意接纳斯林斯人为己族。

src: The moss-strewn antlers of some great elk appear to have grown through an ageless, leather helm.
zh: 某头巨大麋鹿满生苔藓的鹿角，仿佛从一顶不老的皮盔中长出。

src: The most advanced artifact in your possession was =artifact.a.name:asIfKnown:noConfusion=.
The mote of light is extinguished.

The mouths on your skin begin to mumble coherently, revealing the wisdom of a trillion microbes:

=secret.revealed.text=
zh:
你皮上的众口开始含混而连贯地低语，吐露万亿微生物的智慧：

=secret.revealed.text=

src: The muscles knit across =pronouns.possessive= spine have shrunken to near-nothing, and the pleats in =pronouns.possessive= ornamental kittel sag in their absence. =pronouns.Subjective= vibrates to the frequency of another timeplace.
zh: 横织在=pronouns.possessive=脊上的筋肉已萎缩近乎乌有，=pronouns.possessive=饰纹基特尔长衫的褶裥因之松垂。=pronouns.Subjective=震颤着，应和另一处时空的频率。

src: The mysterious thought-form woke from a lost current of local sapiance and squat itself a spongey mangrowth in the ultraviolet baths of the surface. It's long since desiccated, the visceral mass time-viced into something more like paper pulp.
zh: 这神秘的思想形态自本地灵智失落的潮流中苏醒，在地表的紫外线浴中蹲出一片海绵般的红树林。它早已干枯，那内脏般的肉块被时间钳压成更近乎纸浆的东西。

src:
The nearby settlement? The one, ah, founded by three svardym and a galgal? I've always been mortally afraid to go there, knowing even the barest facts.

But you say they will accept us? Perhaps I was wrong.
zh:
附近的那个聚落？就是，呃，由三个斯瓦迪姆和一个加尔加尔建立的那个？光是知道一点最粗浅的事实，我就一直怕得要命，不敢去。

可你说他们肯接纳我们？也许是我错了。

src: The new flesh is as ghost film, cloaking none of the machinery of life.
zh: 新生的血肉恍如幽灵之膜，对生命的机括毫无遮蔽。

src: The next time you cook a meal by choosing ingredients, you get a choice of three dynamically-generated effects to apply. You create a recipe for the chosen effect.
zh: 下次你通过选择食材烹饪膳食时，可从三种动态生成的效果中择一施加。你将为所选效果创制一份食谱。

src: The nickel-dew sticks to the air and arrests the transient molecules of migrant-matter.
zh: 镍露黏附于空气，截住了迁徙物质之瞬息分子。

src: The noosphere must be tilled ere they arrive.
zh: 他们到来之前，智圈须先耕耘。

src: The old and circumscribed poleis of the surface stratum were home to the Eater clans and guilds that spilled up Gjaus in the primal eon before the Covenate. Here they hauled their early starfreight and peered at the blue marble they hoisted themselves off of in raw wonder.
zh: 表层地层上古老而被圈定的城邦，曾是食者氏族与行会的家园，他们在盟约之前的原初纪元里，沿吉奥斯向上涌来。他们在此搬运早期的星际货物，并以纯粹的惊叹凝望着那颗他们离开的蓝色宝石。

src: The old players are vanished. Let us form a covenant anew.
zh: 旧日之角色皆已消逝。让我们重新立约吧。

src: The only action you can take while meditating is Wait.
zh: 冥想时，你唯一能采取的行动是等待。

src: The ornamentation of etched metal and precious stones designate the axis mundi.
zh: 蚀刻的金属与珍贵的宝石所成之饰，标示着世界之轴。

src: The pain in your joints subsides.
The parabolic mitt catches signal from the far breadths of the cosmos and blows it back through the sounding horn.
zh: 抛物线形的巨掌，自宇宙遥远的疆域捕捉信号，又将其经由发声号角吹送回去。

src:
The pariah claims to be wrongfully accused, and you believe her?

She is obviously lying. Are all kendren so gullible?
zh:
那弃民声称自己被冤枉，你就信了她？

她分明在撒谎。肯德伦都这般轻信吗？

src: The patchwork of ash and dirt-caked hides make a gradient of flesh across the hermit's body. =pronouns.Possessive= hair has knotted into a rat's nest. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:scream:afterpronoun= in a tongue of =pronouns.possessive= own invention.
zh: 灰烬与结满泥壳的兽皮拼缀成一片血肉的渐层，覆遍这隐士的躯体。=pronouns.Possessive=头发已结成一个鼠窝。=pronouns.Subjective=用=pronouns.possessive=自创的言语尖声叫喊。

src: The patchwork of burnt metal and rust-flaked rivets make a gradient of newflesh across the hermit's body. =pronouns.Possessive= hair is knotted into a rat's nest and held high by a barrette of broken glass. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:scream:afterpronoun= in a tongue of =pronouns.possessive= own invention.
zh: 烧毁的金属与锈裂的铆钉拼缀成一片新肉的渐层，覆遍这隐士的躯体。=pronouns.Possessive=头发结成一个鼠窝，用一枚碎玻璃发夹高高撑起。=pronouns.Subjective=用=pronouns.possessive=自创的言语尖声叫喊。
