src: The pearly carapace rounds about a handspur and can be employed to deflect melee blows.
zh: 珍珠色的甲壳围着一枚手距弯曲成圈，可用来格挡近战攻击。

src: The photovoltaic cube bakes with the warm of the High Salt Sun and stores it as quickened juice.
zh: 光伏方块沐着高盐之日的暖意炙烤，将其储为沸腾的汁液。

src: The piccoloed orb of cosmic heft houses a watergoo of starbrightness. The substanace streams against the glass, sea-like, in one moment and then clonks to the bottom the next. It gives off an air of subatomic malaise.
zh: 这个宇宙之重的短笛状球体，盛着一汪星辉的水胶。那物质时而如海浪般奔涌拍打玻璃，转瞬又咚地沉落底部。它散发出一种亚原子的倦怠之气。

src: The picture stretches into the 3rd dimension and becomes real.
zh: 画作延展至三维空间，化为真实。

src: The pig farmer slouches in the heat. A beaten, leather hat is pulled low over =pronouns.possessive= eyes and sweat glistens on the scruffs of hair on =pronouns.possessive= cheeks. =pronouns.Possessive= hands are caked in mud and salt.
zh: 养猪人在暑热中垂肩而立。一顶磨破的皮帽压得很低，遮住=pronouns.possessive=双眼，汗珠在=pronouns.possessive=面颊的短髭上发亮。=pronouns.Possessive=双手结满泥与盐的硬壳。

src: The pig meat is self-roasted and delicious.
zh: 这猪肉自烤而成，滋味绝佳。

src: The pilgrim wears a costume of humility: simple frock, wide-brimmed hat, cerulean scarf, slouched back, and weary eyes.
zh: 这朝圣者披着一身谦卑的行头：素朴的长袍、宽檐的帽子、天青的围巾、佝偻的背，与倦怠的眼。

src: The pistol is engraved with watervine hemp and encircled in saltstone. On the grip is an image of a nomad and knight in saltstone. The knight is striking down the nomad.
zh: 这柄手枪刻有水藤麻的花纹，四周镶嵌盐石。握把上有一幅盐石雕成的图：一名游牧人与一名骑士。骑士正将游牧人击倒。

src: The plant puffs up at the presence of another and basks in the soft light.
zh: 此植株见同类在侧便鼓胀起身，沐浴于柔和的光里。

src: The poison affecting =list.andList= is too strong to be cured by your nostrums.
zh: =list.andList=身上的毒性太烈，你的秘方药剂无法解除。

src: The poison affecting you and =object.the.name= is too strong to be cured by your nostrums.
zh: 你和=object.the.name=身上的毒性太烈，你的秘方药剂无法解除。

src: The poison affecting you and your companions is too strong to be cured by your nostrums.
zh: 你和同伴们身上的毒性太烈，你的秘方药剂无法解除。

src: The poison affecting you is too strong to be cured by your nostrums.
zh: 你身上的毒性太烈，你的秘方药剂无法解除。

src: The poison aqua moss brightens the metal form and attracts brass-drunk bugs.
zh: 毒性的水绿苔藓使金属之躯焕发光亮，引来醉心于黄铜的虫豸。

src: The poison begins to abate, but you still feel nauseous.
zh: 毒性开始消退，但你仍觉恶心。

src: The preacher mumbles inaudibly, encased in ice.
zh: 布道者被封在冰中，只能含糊地嚅动嘴唇，听不分明。

src: The primordial soup =subject.to.the.direction= starts reacting with the =liquid.name=.

The proof is in the petals, kendren. You want justice? Find out what really happened.

If you find evidence, Warden Neelahind will support you. Speak to her. She is loyal to Grand-Doe, but more loyal to the truth.

I will return to the village and we will sort this out. The Hindriarch will have to tolerate my presence until my name is cleared.
zh:
证据在花瓣之间，肯德伦。你要公道？那就去查明真相。

若你找到证据，守望者尼拉欣德会支持你。去和她谈谈。她忠于大母鹿，但更忠于真相。

我会回村去，我们把此事理清。在我的名字洗清之前，族长不得不容忍我的存在。

src: The protective force of the cherubim prevents =subject.the.name= from taking anything from the reliquary.
zh: 天使的护佑之力阻止=subject.the.name=从圣物匣中取走任何东西。

src: The protective force of the cherubim prevents you from opening the ark.
zh: 天使的护佑之力阻止你打开方舟。

src: The quartet of knee joint extensors gain the assistance of a synthetic fifth.
zh: 四根膝关节伸肌，得一根合成的第五根相助。

src: The quickened flax of the earth was duck-weaved in a simple square pattern and hung up on pickets.
zh: 大地上被催生的亚麻，以简单的方格纹织成帆布，挂在木桩上。
起反应的液体凝结成了=object.a.name:withTitles=。

src: The reedy guts of an ivy tangle were ripped out, laced, and gilded with an embroidered sash.
zh: 常春藤乱枝中芦苇般的内瓤被扯出、编织，并以一条绣花腰带镀金。

src: The richest of starfolk gifts were kept in vaults of diamondized zetachrome and piped-in stasis field. The perspective from the mover gives no inkling on whether the ionization of time has weakened these spacetime palisades of the Old Bank.
zh: 星民最丰厚的赠礼，被存放在钻石化的泽塔铬金库与管道输送的停滞场之中。从载具上望去，无从得知时间的电离是否已削弱了旧银行那些时空栅栏。

src: The roaming keter of Chavvah, Tree of Life
zh: 生命之树查娃的漂泊凯特尔

src: The scars of lava flow are legible as little ledges across the wide stone. The small darkling holes were once the birth craters of dissolved gases.
zh: 熔岩流淌的疤痕，在宽阔的石面上显为一道道小小的台阶。那些幽暗的小孔，曾是溶解的气体诞生的火山口。

src: The scouts have seen kendren treasure hunters about. That type will take anything not nailed down.
zh: 斥候见过一些肯德伦寻宝人在附近出没。这种人见什么拿什么。

src: The scouts heard someone doing work with tools late at night, indicating recent craft.
zh: 斥候听见有人在深夜摆弄工具干活，说明近来有人制作手艺活。

src: The scouts report that someone has taken leather from the village stores, indicating recent craft.
zh: 斥候报告说有人从村里的库房取走了皮革，说明近来有人制作手艺活。

src: The scutum was scraped dry, smashed, and ground. Bits of the tick were squeezed of its magnetic lifeblood and vialed.
zh: 盾板被刮净、砸碎、磨粉。蜱虫体内的磁质命血被挤出，装进小瓶。

src: The seat cushions are vinyl-cocooned in the hue of a frozen ocean spilling free from tidal heat. Control dials, sliders, and switches grid the flat-paneled armrest.
zh: 座垫裹着乙烯基，色如冰封之洋挣脱潮汐热而倾泻。控制转盘、滑杆与开关，布满平板扶手。

src: The security door swings closed and locks with a loud clank.
zh: 安保门缓缓合拢，伴着一声巨响锁死。

src: The security door unlocks with a loud clank and swings open.
zh: 安保门伴着一声巨响解锁，缓缓敞开。

src: The self-plucked feathers of a mountain moa were stuffed into a velvet cushion thousands of years ago and sold at the bazaar of Samech some time after.
zh: 一只山恐鸟自拔的羽毛，数千年前被填进天鹅绒坐垫，此后不久便在萨梅赫的集市上售出。

src: The shadows of tiny nebulae are crushed into the contours of a small stone.
zh: 微小星云的暗影，被压入一块小石的轮廓之中。

src: The shadows of tiny nebulae are crushed into the contours of a small stone. All its rough edges have been polished to shine.
zh: 微小星云的暗影，被压入一块小石的轮廓之中。其粗糙的棱角皆已磨得光亮。

src: The shaft widens to a rigid polygon of azure metal. Nicks and scores tally on its surface.
zh: 杖身渐宽，成一枚坚硬的蔚蓝金属多边体。缺口与刻痕于其表面累累计数。

src: The shape of the carved megalith electrifies a forgotten squadron of neurons in a crawlway of your mind, launching you into sudden intimacy with the deep past, somewhere on the cusp of first thought. Then an uncertainty obtains as to which direction on the braid of time you are remembering.
zh: 这块雕琢的巨石之形，使你脑中某条爬道里一支被遗忘的神经元小队通了电，将你骤然抛入与深古之间的亲密，处于初念的边缘之上。随后，一种不确定便盘踞而来：你究竟是沿着时间之辫的哪个方向在回忆。

src: The shining surface of quickchrome swims in shifting refraction patterns. As its light is focused, glyphs begin to appear.
zh: 速变铬的闪亮表面游移着变幻的折射纹样。光线聚焦之际，符文渐次浮现。

src: The shomer Rainwater claims that Brightsheol is the dream of a seraph who lives atop the Spindle.
zh: 雨水守者声称，明冥是居于纺锤之巅的一位炽天使的梦。

src:
The shrine depicts a significant event from the life of the ancient sultan =sultanName=:

=gospel=
zh:
此圣龛描绘了古代苏丹=sultanName=生平中的一件要事：

=gospel=

src: The sidewise ribbons of late Seeker fashion twirl in the moistening air, and with a gestureless hmmph, =pronouns.subjective= =verb:brush:afterpronoun= the dirt from =pronouns.possessive= cowl.
zh: 晚期寻道者时兴的斜向飘带在潮润的空气中旋舞，=pronouns.subjective=不着一丝手势地哼了一声，拂去了=pronouns.possessive=兜帽上的尘土。

src: The signal is a beacon of welcoming, and it originates from the top of the Spindle.
zh: 这信号是一座欢迎的信标，它发自纺锤之巅。

src:
The signal is a repeat transmission being broadcast from an unknown source. =V0tinkeraddendum= One of our tinkers, {{m|Q Girl}}, discovered it while rigging a long wave detector. Unfortunately, it's encrypted, and we do not have the means here to decrypt it. You may be of some help in this matter, however.

We've long known the location of a fully functioning {{W|baetyl}} within the bowels of the great hall {{C|Bethesda Susa}}. The Mechanimists have consecrated the site around it and built a temple there. Q Girl claims to have developed a means to decrypt the signal, but she needs the computing power of the baetyl. If you can infiltrate the Mechanimist compound, you may be able to engage the baetyl and decode the signal.
zh:
这信号是一段重复的传输，来源不明。=V0tinkeraddendum=我们的一位修补匠，{{m|Q女孩}}，在装配长波探测器时发现了它。可惜它被加密了，而我们这里没有破译的手段。不过，你或许能在此事上帮上忙。

我们早已知道，大厅{{C|毕士大-苏萨}}的腹地之中，有一块功能完好的{{W|圣石}}。机神教徒已将其周围之地奉为圣地，并在那里修建了神殿。Q女孩声称她已想出破译信号的办法，但需要借圣石的运算之力。若你能潜入机神教徒的营地，或许就能启动圣石，译出信号。

src: The sin of time has corroded our endowment...
zh: 时间之罪已腐蚀我们的禀赋……

src: The sinnorot intersect at a middle point and, plied by their golden ecliptics in the Blue Shul, heave movers to and from the heart of the North Sheva.
zh: 辛诺罗特在中点相交，由其金色黄道牵引，在蓝色会堂中把载具推送至北舍瓦之心，或自其心推出。

src: The skin of the sacred lake dampens the sorceral songs of the forest and mirrors the Great Moon, its sapphire seas and continents of ash shivering in watery projection.
zh: 圣湖之面，抑制了森林中的魔法歌声，倒映出大月，其蓝宝石般的海洋与灰烬的大陆在水的投影中颤抖。

src: The slate is touched with years of handprints and a ring of rust flakes off the top of the hinges. The door continues, though, its stubborn assertion of 'in' and 'out'.
zh: 石板上留有多年的手印，铰链顶端剥落下一圈锈屑。然而门仍在那里，固执地宣示着“内”与“外”。

src: The sloughed off skin is dull quartz and statuesque.
zh: 蜕下的皮是黯哑的石英，俨然如雕像。

src: The snail farmer slouches in the heat. A beaten, leather hat is pulled low over =pronouns.possessive= eyes and sweat glistens on the scruffs of hair on =pronouns.possessive= cheeks. =pronouns.Possessive= hands are caked in mud, mucus, and salt.
zh: 蜗牛养殖者在暑热中懒懒地弓着身子。一顶破旧的革帽拉得低低，遮住=pronouns.possessive=眼睛，汗珠在=pronouns.possessive=颊上的几丛短毛间闪着光。=pronouns.Possessive=双手结满泥、黏液与盐。

src: The snapjaw is hostile! Let's get ready for a fight.
zh: 这个豺颚人充满敌意！准备战斗吧。

src: The soft urshiib's Pale Sea eyes achieve a sort of focal paradox. They appear to focus both impossibly close, on the screws and fasteners =pronouns.subjective= =verb:sort:afterpronoun= ahead of =pronouns.objective=, and impossibly far, on the horizon of attainable thought. =pronouns.Possessive= eyelids rest low with the weariness of both tasks.
zh: 这头柔和的乌尔希卜有一双苍海色的眼睛，生就某种聚焦上的悖论。它们似乎既聚焦于近得不可能之处——=pronouns.subjective=在=pronouns.objective=跟前分拣的螺钉与扣件，又聚焦于远得不可能之处——可及之思的地平线。=pronouns.Possessive=眼睑低垂着，含着这两桩差事共同的倦意。

src: The sound bow of gleaming star bronze was cast against the perfect mouth of a rotachthon and inset with a zetachrome clapper. When tolled, the sound wave shifts in juxtaposition with the listener's subjective experience, and the rituals of being and going are announced.
zh: 这口钟的钟体以闪亮的星铜铸成，范自一座旋转器的完美钟口，并嵌有一枚泽塔铬的钟舌。钟声一响，声波便随聆听者的主观体验而错位变幻，宣告存在与逝去的仪式。

src: The space around you starts to glitch.
zh: 你周围的空间开始失真错乱。

src: The spaceship can't launch from here.
The spaceship is already traversing the void.
The spaceship's launch sequence has already begun.
zh: 飞船的发射程序已经启动。

src: The spade-nosed weasel slinks in crypt cracks and rummages through their ancient vaults. A cousin-line of symbiotic grave moss stipples the fur on =pronouns.possessive= long back in spoofed concordance with the Mark of Death.
zh: 这头铲鼻的鼬潜行于墓窟的裂隙，翻找那些古老的穹室。一线共生的坟苔如亲族般点缀在=pronouns.possessive=长背的毛上，伪作与“死亡印记”相合的纹样。

src: The spiny fruit of fracti were mashed, set over an open flame, left out to cool, and jarred for later use. Bits of spiny pulp lay suspended in the fruity aether.
zh: 断裂体的多刺果实被捣烂，架在明火上，搁凉后装罐备用。丝丝缕缕带刺的果肉悬在果味的以太中。

src: The spiraling triangle finial portrays the flowing asterism that gave the star cluster its prominence. Alpha, Bet, and Dalet emerged from the galactic nucleus and flowered, coursed o'er the same ecliptic tracks of the Great Machine, and sent a minyan of petal-beings to pray/play a future coupling into existence.
zh: 螺旋三角形的顶饰描绘了那道流动的星群，正是它使这片星团声名显赫。阿尔法、贝特与达勒特自银河核心涌现并绽放，沿着与大机神相同的黄道轨迹奔流，并遣出一个由花瓣众生组成的祈祷团，祈祷/嬉戏，以期在将来使一场结合成真。

src: The spire-garden of outworld lime fired in the exhaust of starships looms over the low dacha. O'er tiers of antipodal colonnades, pond lilies creep up bannisters and peek at themselves. This is a place of portals.
zh: 以星舰尾焰烧制的异界石灰筑成的尖塔花园，高耸于低矮的别墅之上。穿过层层对跖的柱廊，池中睡莲沿栏杆攀爬，窥看自己的倒影。此乃门户之地。

src: The stair, stage, and loop gate are cast in marble relief to their surroundings by hyperdimensional filament. The holograph vista of anotherworld temple is evanesced, and instead local lilies fill the frame.
zh: 楼梯、舞台与环门，因超维度的细丝，被铸成与周遭相衬的大理石浮雕。异界神庙的全息远景已然消散，取而代之，本地的百合盈满画框。

src: The statue of Bel wears its tremendous weight in polished marble. He wields his epochal aegis, storied for obstructing a swirling gas cloud in the starry dawn.
zh: 彼勒的雕像身披抛光大理石，仿佛负着万钧之重。他擎着那面划时代的神盾，传说当年星辰初曙之际，正是它挡住了翻涌的气云。

src: The stencil on the tin depicts an animal with claws, or are they hooves? Snoods (or horns? antlers?) pucker its nose and brow. Shaggy, knotted fur, or ruffled feathers, sheath it from the heat (or cold).
zh: 罐上的刻版画着一头带爪的兽——抑或那是蹄？鼻与额上皱着的是垂肉（还是角？鹿角？）。覆体的究竟是蓬乱打结的毛，还是挣动的羽，替它挡住那热（或那寒）？

src: The stone-dented metal of aging dusk wraps the brain in a second skull.
zh: 迟暮之黄昏，其金属被石块砸出凹痕，将大脑裹入第二层颅骨。

src: The storied eroticism of =player.name= became intimately known to =beguiled.a.name=.
The strands glisten with a frothing film.
zh: 草茎在泛沫薄膜下闪闪发亮。

src: The sultanate is dissolved. Resheph rules no longer.
zh: 苏丹国已经解体。利悉不再统治了。

src: The sun beams on soapstone with cheeks made high and proud of ochre and teeth. The shadow of a noon canopy bespeaks a treeline thicker with leaflife than any on the plateau or at all north of Moghra'yi.
zh: 日光洒在皂石之上，赭彩与齿列勾出高耸而倨傲的颧颊。正午林冠的阴影，昭示着一片比高原上任何林地都更为葱茏的树线，莫格拉伊以北更是无一能及。

src: The svardym Mak said he was born to a cacophony of static ringing his ears raw. Could it have been the signal?
zh: 斯瓦迪姆·马克说，他生来便有一片嘈杂的静电震得双耳发疼。那会是那信号么？

src: The synthetic mist called Golden Dawn ascends from its canister to atomize leafage and leave a clear view of the horizon in its wake.
zh: 名为“金色黎明”的合成薄雾自罐中升腾，雾化枝叶，在其身后留下一片清朗的地平线。

src:
The t-two sephirots. -then and -else. I cannot be -else. *I* cannot, of course. But -then? It does not seem so.

Their chimes ring at the right frequencies, others. But not so, mine.
zh:
那、那两个原质。彼化与别化。我不能是别化。当然，是“我”不能。但彼化呢？似乎也不是。

他们的鸣钟以正确的频率鸣响，其余的也是。唯独我的不然。

src: The taste is bitter and salty.
The taste is familiar on your tongue.
zh: 这滋味在你舌上似曾相识。

src: The tatters of a sweat-stained kufiya thrash in the wind from where they hang about the farmer's neck. Clasped in =pronouns.possessive= gnarled, brown hand is a curved vinereaper of iron with which =pronouns.subjective= =verb:cull:afterpronoun= moisture-swollen wafers from the viridian plant called watervine.
zh: 一条浸透汗渍的库菲亚头巾，残破的布缕垂挂在农夫颈间，在风中乱舞。=pronouns.possessive=粗节虬曲的褐色手中攥着一把弯曲的铁制藤镰，=pronouns.subjective=便用它从那种名为水藤的青绿植物上割下饱含水分的藤饼。

src: The teacher fringed in salted locks uses =pronouns.possessive= fingers to count the gematria and wheel the sacred numbers into words of meaning.
zh: 这位鬓发盐白的教师以=pronouns.possessive=手指算计格马特里亚，把神圣的数字旋成有意义的话语。

src: The threat is not over. Mark my words.
zh: 威胁尚未过去。记住我的话。

src: The tick of a firing pin against steel makes the fauna start. A chrome sight eases the arc of the parabola.
zh: 撞针叩击钢铁的一声滴答，令动物群为之一惊。一具铬制瞄具，使抛物线的弧度平缓了几分。

src: The tomb mural depicts a significant event from the life of the ancient sultan =sultanName|withCognomen#cognomen=, but it's no longer legible.
zh: 此墓壁画描绘了古代苏丹=sultanName|withCognomen#cognomen=生平中的一件大事，然已不复辨识。

src:
The tomb mural depicts a significant event from the life of the ancient sultan =sultanName|withCognomen#cognomen=:

=tombInscription=
zh:
此墓壁画描绘了古代苏丹=sultanName|withCognomen#cognomen=生平中的一件大事：

=tombInscription=

src:
The tomb mural depicts a significant event from the life of the sultan =name|withCognomen#cognomen=:

=tombInscription=
zh:
此墓壁画描绘了苏丹=name|withCognomen#cognomen=生平中的一件大事：

=tombInscription=

src: The tonics you ingested react adversely to each other. You erupt into flames!
zh: 你饮下的药剂彼此相冲。你轰然燃起烈焰！

src: The torsion of an external crank drags a rosin-slathered wheel against a metal cable, whose protestations emerge from the wooden case in a low, melodic groan.
zh: 外置曲柄一转，涂满松香的轮子便擦过金属弦，弦的哀鸣自木匣中溢出，化作低沉悠长的呻吟。

src:
The trade is uneven, so we'll have to pony up some money.

In the salt-stippled ecosystem of Qud, {{B|fresh water}} is currency. You need to drink it, too, so don't spend it all.
zh:
这笔交易并不等价，我们得掏些钱。

在卡德这片盐渍斑斑的生态里，{{B|淡水}}就是货币。你也得喝它，所以别全花光了。

src: The troubadour-hero =name= rode the tides of =player.their= passions and shipwrecked on the shores of =object.a.name=.
zh: 行吟英雄=name=乘着=player.their=情潮之浪，终在=object.a.name=的岸畔触礁。

src: The truffle is encrusted with a wine-colored char residue born of gases unknown to the world-surface. Deep, deep in the earth and across the Pale Sea, it was smoldered to succulence.
zh: 块菌的外壳结着一层酒色的焦渣，由地表世界闻所未闻的气体所生。在极深的地底、越过苍海，它曾被焖至鲜嫩。

src: The trunk column corkscrews on the radial path of light and blossoms a crown of victory laurel.
zh: 树干柱沿着光的放射路径盘旋上升，绽成一顶胜利月桂冠。

src: The tube hisses against your skin, and a hot tingling infuses your whole body.
zh: 管子在你的皮肤上嘶嘶作响，一股灼热的酥麻感浸透全身。

src: The tube hisses against your skin, and a warm feeling washes over your body.
zh: 管子在你的皮肤上嘶嘶作响，一股暖意涌遍全身。

src: The tube hisses against your skin, and your blood burns!
zh: 管子在你的皮肤上嘶嘶作响，你的血液灼烧起来！

src: The two slates are touched with years of with handprints and a ring of rust flakes off the top of all its the hinges. The doors continues, though, their stubborn assertion of 'in' and 'out'.
zh: 两片石板都留有多年的手印，各处铰链顶端剥落下一圈锈屑。然而门仍在那里，固执地宣示着“内”与“外”。

src: The umbrage of the boughs wrings the warmth from Opal's waters and leave behind a shady pool.
zh: 枝叶的荫翳榨去了欧珀河水中的暖意，只留下幽暗池潭。

src: The utensil arrives. You, to prune the fate-rhizome and free our girl. Go now and perform the motion.
zh: 器具来了。你，去修剪命运的根茎，解放我们的姑娘。去吧，去做那一举。

src: The viewing frustum fills with a rainbow mosaic of stellar candles, softened by the isles of dust across their impossible gulfs, and winking in fusil motion. As a single vista, the breadth of it staggers the conscious mind, which races to reduce the innumerable pixels to whole and platonic forms.
zh: 取景锥体内满是一幅虹彩马赛克，由群星的烛火拼成，被它们那不可思议的鸿沟间的尘埃岛屿柔化，又在梭形的运动中闪烁眨动。作为一幅完整的景象，其广阔震撼了意识；意识飞速奔忙，欲将无数的像素还原为完整而柏拉图式的形体。

src: The village of =village.name= has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
zh: =village.name=村已同意接纳斯林斯人为己族。

src: The village of Bey Lah has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
zh: 贝拉村已同意接纳斯林斯人为己族。

src: The village of Ezra has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
zh: 以斯拉村已同意接纳斯林斯人为己族。

src: The village of Joppa has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
zh: 约帕村已同意接纳斯林斯人为己族。

src: The village of Kyakukya has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.
zh: 基亚库基亚村已同意接纳斯林斯人为己族。

src: The villagers are on edge due to rumors of sore throats in the village, indicating recent illness.
zh: 村里传言有人喉咙痛，村民们都惴惴不安，说明近来有人患病。

src: The villagers of =spice.entity:name= are known throughout the =terrain.displayNameOnlyDirect|strip= for their =spice:adjectivesJudgement.!random= use of =ingredientName= in meal preparation.|=id=
zh: =spice.entity:name=的村民以烹制饭菜时对=ingredientName=的=spice:adjectivesJudgement.!random=运用，在=terrain.displayNameOnlyDirect|strip=一带远近闻名。|=id=

src: The villagers of =spice.entity:name= laid offerings at the feet of =subject.refname:Worship:long:withTitles|strip= in exchange for =spice:commonPhrases.wisdom.!random= about =sacredThing=.|=id=
zh: =spice.entity:name=的村民献供物于=subject.refname:Worship:long:withTitles|strip=足下，以换取关于=sacredThing=的=spice:commonPhrases.wisdom.!random=。|=id=

src: The vine's spirals squeeze against the pressure of a hidden eigth dimension of space (which only activates outside the density of the strangefluid they're used to being submerged in). When this happens, their cross-spits of solid argon grouse at a frequency that cankers all known earth metals.
zh: 这藤蔓的螺旋，抵着一个隐匿的第八维空间的压力而挤压（该维度唯在脱离它们素来浸没其中的奇异流体之密度时才被激活）。此时，其间固态氩的横刺以一种频率鸣响，足以蚀损一切已知的土金属。

src: The vintners say that 'one rose is fair, but five is death'. I can sell you blossoms that mean death no matter the number.
zh: 酒商们说“一朵玫瑰尚且可爱，五朵便是死亡”。我卖你的花，无论几朵，都意味着死亡。

src: The walls creak, loose objects skid about, and dust is stirred up in iridescent clouds.
zh: 墙壁吱嘎作响，松散的物件四处滑动，尘土扬起，化作虹彩云团。

src: The warming phosphor of early earth is neatly latticed by woodbrick, and functions now as a microscopic star.
zh: 早期大地的暖光磷，被木砖齐整地织成格栅，如今充作一颗微缩的恒星。

src: The weight of the thick air pushes =pronouns.objective= down onto =pronouns.possessive= stocky dumps.
zh: 厚重空气的分量，将=pronouns.objective=压在=pronouns.possessive=粗短的臀上。

src: The wet paints of earth -- clay, slag, chrome, and dye -- slouch a half-idea with material weight. The transformation is arrested through indecision or neglect.
zh: 大地湿润的颜料——黏土、熔渣、铬与染料——以物质之重压着半个构想颓然低垂。蜕变因犹豫或疏忽而被中止。

src: The whole compound rumbles around you.
zh: 整座建筑在你周围隆隆震动。

src: The whole game world is a series of contiguous maps. Our passage continues off screen. Let's follow it. Walk north.
zh: 整个游戏世界由一系列相连的地图组成。我们的通道延伸到屏幕之外。跟着它走。向北行。

src: The wind begins blowing at =newWindDesc= from the =new.direction.expanded=.
The wind calms to =newWindDesc=, blowing from the =new.direction.expanded=.
The wind changes direction from the =old.direction.expanded= to the =new.direction.expanded=.
The wind intensifies to =newWindDesc=, blowing from the from the =new.direction.expanded=.
The windy lathe of eons has rasped the plastron down to an old and smooth stone, and left the shelled friend with a sour smile.
zh: 亘古之风的车床磨去了腹甲，使其成了一块古老光滑的石头，也让这位披壳的朋友留下一抹酸涩的微笑。

src: The wire! Give it to me!

The worshippers of Shekhinah? Fascinating. I, ah, don't know what to think of that.

It may be what my kin need, now I consider it. The Canticles make little sense to me but they are, ah, compelling. More compelling than me, certainly. I will discuss this with the others.
zh:
舍金纳的敬拜者？有意思。我，呃，不知该作何感想。

细想之下，那或许正是族人所需。《圣歌》我读不太懂，但它们，呃，令人着迷。比我更令人着迷，这是肯定的。我会和其他人商量。

src: The {{R|forcefield}} in front of =subject.the.name= snaps off.
The {{electrical|electrical arc}} leaps from =source.the.name= toward something =source.to.its.direction#target=!
The {{electrical|electrical arc}} leaps from =sourceSnapshotDesc= toward something =sourceSnapshotDirectionTowardTarget=!
Theft by kendren is very common during an outbreak of disease like the one the villagers describe.
zh: 像村民们所说的那种疫病爆发时，肯德伦人行窃是极常见的事。

src: Their descendants remain and thrive, but the progenitor Nephilim have been silent for some time. Some believe that they have followed =name= to the stars.
zh: 他们的后裔仍存续兴旺，而始祖拿非利人却已沉寂多时。有人相信，他们追随=name=去了星辰。

src: Their descendants, at least, persist. No sign of the progenitors has been recorded in some time, but they may yet live.
zh: 至少他们的后裔仍在。始祖已有些时日不见记录，但或许仍活着。

src: Theirs are the shoulders of titans! Theirs are the hearts of krakens!
zh: 他们有巨人之肩，海妖之心！

src: Then I assent. The covenant is drawn.
zh: 那我应允。盟约就此立下。

src: Then I overestimated your intellect further than I realized. Get out.
zh: 那我竟是高看了你的头脑，连我自己都未曾察觉。滚出去。

src: Then I will thank you to leave as quickly as possible. I don't want the faundren to become used to our borders being permeable.
zh: 那我谢你尽快离开。我不愿小欣德伦们习惯于我们的边界可以穿越。

src: Then I... stylize... the story, and I engrave it on the walls. Once I'm finished, the sarcophagus will open, and you can lay =player.reflexive= to rest!
zh: 然后我再……润色……这个故事，把它镌刻在墙上。待我完成，石棺便会开启，您便可让=player.reflexive=安息了！

src: Then perhaps it will. Live and drink.
zh: 那么它或许会的。且生且饮。

src: Then what's to keep me from simply choosing the outcome I want?
zh: 那还有什么能阻止我随心所欲地选定结局？

src: Then you are welcome. Make comfort as you need and I will play.
zh: 那么，欢迎你。随意安坐，我来演奏。

src: Then you did not succeed, by Resheph's measure?
zh: 那么依利悉的标准，你并未成功？

src:
Then you're not of the faith =player.reflexive=, huh? Me neither. Do go inside, though. She's a beauty. Got dyed glass high in her rafters, she does. And two marvelous carvings on the wings. Plus a light-sculpture of a god. Hear the sermon, too, as you like. The high priest is persuasive, but not half as persuasive as the cathedral herself. In beauty there is power, you know.

Either way, while you're in the cathedral or on the Stiltgrounds, stay peaceful.
zh:
这么说，=player.reflexive=也不是教中人，是吧？我也不是。不过还是进去瞧瞧吧。她可是个美人。椽梁高处嵌着染色玻璃，两翼上有两幅绝妙的雕刻，还有一尊神明的光雕。想听布道也随你。大祭司能言善辩，可再善辩也不及大教堂自身的一半。美之中自有力量，你知道的。

无论如何，你在大教堂里也好，在高塔之地上也好，都要保持安宁。

src:
Then? Perhaps.. Perhaps the greater bodies whose agency I share the smaller cut from might share too the greater portion of my meal in blame.

Winding Svy? Thou art devious in symbol shape like serpent Ba'al!
Hinnom? For blooming alga thou crossed thy perch's back!
Shiftless moon?
Sun! Proud and idle, Sun! Silver father of the protoplanets! Claim mine selfhood and be done with it.

{{emote|*Barathrum weeps.*}}
zh:
那么？也许……也许我所分享其行动者之身的更大天体，我从中割出的那一小块，也该承担我这份罪责中更大的一份。

蜿蜒的斯维？汝形诡诈如符，似巴力之蛇！
欣嫩？为那繁盛之藻，汝越过了汝栖枝之背！
懒散的月？
日！骄傲而闲散的日！原行星的银色之父！夺走我的自我，一了百了罢。

{{emote|*巴拉斯鲁姆垂泪。*}}
疗愈的,医者,复原者,神迹般的

src: There =campfire.is= already =campfire.a.name= =subject.to.its.direction#campfire=. Do you want to go to =campfire.them=?
There =pool.is= =pool.a.name= that way. Do you want to go =direction.toward= and start swimming?
zh: 那边=pool.is==pool.a.name=。你想往=direction.toward=去并开始游泳吗？

src: There =pool.is= =pool.a.name= that way. Move =direction.expandedDirection= again to enter =pool.them= and start swimming.
zh: 那边=pool.is==pool.a.name=。再向=direction.expandedDirection=移动一次，即可进入=pool.them=并开始游泳。

src: There =pool.is= a dangerous-looking =pool.short= that way. Do you want to go =direction.toward= and start swimming?
zh: 那边=pool.is=一片看似凶险的=pool.short=。你想往=direction.toward=去并开始游泳吗？

src: There =pool.is= a dangerous-looking =pool.short= that way. Move =direction.expandedDirection= again to enter =pool.them= and start swimming.
zh: 那边=pool.is=一片看似凶险的=pool.short=。再向=direction.expandedDirection=移动一次，即可进入=pool.them=并开始游泳。

src: There are caves everywhere, you dolt! Scoop the surface of the marsh, or head on east to the rust wells, or wander into the Desert for all I care...
zh: 洞穴到处都是，你这蠢货！舀一舀沼泽的地表，或往东去锈井，或者闯进沙漠去，随你的便……

src: There are few voices as low as Kesehind's in our village. Witnesses report a higher-pitched voice, don't they? They would know if Kesehind were speaking.
zh: 我们村里嗓音能压得比凯塞因德更低的，寥寥无几。证人说听到的是较尖细的声音，不是吗？若是凯塞因德开口，他们定能听出来。

src: There are no more words for us, wanderer.
zh: 我们已无话可说了，旅人。

src: There are no valid targets in that square.

There are pools of convalessence there. You see, when cryogenic mist condenses, it forms a cool, luminous liquid that's restorative if you're able to bathe in it.

Oh! And in one of the ruined wards, the Alchemist keeps their shop. Who's the Alchemist, you ask? A sort of enigmatic figure -- amateur liquid-tinker, poet, merchant. Their methods aren't scientific, but they are useful if you're seeking a specific kind of liquid. Just be careful around them, =name=.
zh:
那里有一汪汪愈元液。你瞧，低温雾气凝结时，会化成一种清凉而发光的液体，若能浸身其中，便有复元之效。

哦！还有，在某座破败的病区里，炼金术士开着他们的铺子。你问炼金术士是谁？是个有些神秘的人物——业余的液体修补匠、诗人、商贩。他们的法子算不上科学，但你若要找某一类特定的液体，倒是管用。只是在他们面前要小心，=name=。

src: There are too many engravings on =object.the.name's= =part.ordinalName= to add more.
There are too many tattoos on =object.the.name's= =part.ordinalName= to add more.
There doesn't seem to be anywhere else to explore from here.
zh: 从这里似乎没有别处可探索了。

src: There doesn't seem to be anywhere else to explore.
zh: 似乎没有别处可探索了。

src: There exists a dimension known as {{O|=dimensionName=}}.
There exists a pocket dimension known as {{O|Tzimtzlum}}.
zh: 存在一个名为{{O|齐姆茨鲁姆}}的袋状维度。

src: There is a <stat Name="SwoopCrashChance" />% chance you crash to the ground (doubled if your attack is blocked by a shield).
zh: 你有<stat Name="SwoopCrashChance" />%的几率坠落地面（若攻击被盾牌格挡，则几率翻倍）。

src: There is a low, persistent hum emanating outward.
zh: 有一阵低沉而持续的嗡鸣由内向外传出。

src: There is a river just south of the village that runs an eastwardly course into the jungle. Along its bank lies a goatfolk village. There resides a mighty shaman, Mamon Souldrinker. He is in possession of a talisman of great power, an amaranthine prism that refracts the psyche of its handler in much the same way, as Mayor Nuntu has explained to me, a common prism refracts light. The thing is cursed, traveler. No man or goat may safely wield it for long. You must travel to the village and retrieve the prism from Mamon by any means necessary. Do you understand?
zh: 村南有一条河，东流入丛林。沿岸有一座羊人村落。其中住着一位强大的萨满，饮魂者玛蒙。他持有一件威力无穷的护符，乃是不朽棱镜，能折射执握者之心神，正如农图镇长对我所言，寻常棱镜折射光线一般。旅人，此物受了诅咒。无论人或羊，皆不能安然久握。你须前往那村落，不择手段，从玛蒙手中夺回棱镜。你可明白？

src:
There is a sadness in, ah... choosing pariahs. Some of my kin dreamed of belonging, and the very word is the antithesis of belonging.

But then, if wanderers look after one another, there is a belonging in that as well. Even alone, we would not be alone. I will offer this choice to the others and we will discuss it.
zh:
选择弃民，有一种悲凉，呃……族人中有人梦想着有所归属，而这个词本身，恰与归属相反。

可是话说回来，若是流浪者彼此照拂，那其中也自有一种归属。即便孤身一人，也不是孤单的。我会把这个选择告诉其他人，大家商议。

src: There is a small chance each round you're in combat that you randomly teleport to a nearby location.
zh: 你处于战斗中时，每回合都有小几率被随机传送至附近某处。

src: There is kinship from mollusk to mollusk. What secrets do they know that we do not?
zh: 软体动物之间自有亲缘。它们知晓什么，是我们不知的秘密？

src: There is little more to the slight deerkin than a bundle of spindly limbs, patchy pale-green fur, and tooth-white skin. Despite being one of the dune's more delicate creatures, =pronouns.subjective= =verb:perch:afterpronoun= on =pronouns.possessive= hooves with easy composure.
zh: 这纤弱的鹿族身上，除了一束细瘦的四肢、斑驳的淡绿皮毛与牙白色的皮肤，别无他物。虽说是沙丘间最为娇弱的生灵之一，=pronouns.subjective=却稳稳地立于=pronouns.possessive=蹄上，一派从容。

src: There is no mouth here, and yet =pronouns.subjective= =verb:scream:afterpronoun=: a stringy and sharp whine too high-pitched for ears. Unalgebraic points of wickedness sheet =pronouns.possessive= entire serpent bod, and slit eyes spy a torturous path forward.
zh: 这里并没有嘴，然而=pronouns.subjective=正在尖啸：一声细瘦锋利的哀鸣，高得人耳不能听闻。不可代数化的恶意之点布满=pronouns.possessive=整条蛇躯，竖瞳窥测着前方一条苦难的路。

src: There is no one there for you to amputate their limb.
zh: 那里没有人可供你截肢。

src: There is no one there to sting.
zh: 那里没有可刺击的对象。

src: There is no one there you can sting.
zh: 那里没有你可以刺击的对象。

src: There is no proof that she is lying.
zh: 没有证据表明她在撒谎。

src: There is no starship to enter. The docking bay is empty.
zh: 没有可进入的星舰。船坞空空如也。

src: There is no useful way to =verb= =object.the.name:single= there.
zh: 那里没有合适的方式来=verb==object.the.name:single=。

src: There is no valid last character to use.
There is nobody there you can engrave.
zh: 那里没有可供你刻印的人。

src: There is nobody there you can tattoo.
zh: 那里没有可供你纹身的人。

src: There is nothing for you to submerge in here.
zh: 这里没有可供你潜入之物。

src: There is nothing left to harvest.
There is nothing there that =object.the.name= can uplink with.
zh: 那里没有=object.the.name=可以接入的东西。

src: There is nothing there that your electrical discharge can ground into.
zh: 那里没有东西可让你的电流导入地面。

src: There is nothing there to rebuke.
There is nothing there you can attack.
zh: 那里没有可供你攻击之物。

src: There is nothing there you can build a campfire on.
zh: 此处没有可以用来建造篝火的地方。

src: There is nowhere for the =vehicleTerm= to be recalled to.
There is only darkness from an unusual source left to explore.
zh: 只剩一片源自奇异之处的黑暗可供探索。

src: There is sharp, persistent ticking emanating outward.
zh: 有尖利而持续的滴答声向外传出。

src: There is spotted dazzle on the cut hide that brings its bounded strider to pantherine selfhood.
zh: 裁下的兽皮上有斑驳的炫光，使其受缚的行者化为豹之本相。

src:
There is. Firstly, Mamon will likely have several goatfolk under his enthrallment, and they will protect him at all costs.

Secondly, take care to stay out of Mamon's reach, for his power is most potent when he may lay hands on you.

Finally, once you recover the prism, do not under any circumstances wield it. I needn't warn you of the consequences should you return to me bearing that charm.

That is all. Are you willing?
zh:
有。其一，玛蒙身边多半有数名羊人受其蛊惑，必拼死护他。

其二，当心远离玛蒙的手所能及之处，他若能将手按在你身上，法力最盛。

其三，你一旦取回棱镜，无论如何不可执握。你若带着那护符回到我这里，后果如何，我不必多言。

便是这些。你可愿意？

src: There must be a hundred gadgets here. What are you working on?
zh: 这里少说也有上百件小玩意。你在忙什么？

src: There seems to be no digital mind in =object.the.name= to dominate.
zh: =object.the.name=中似乎没有可供支配的数字心智。

src: There seems to be no mind in =object.the.name= to dominate.
zh: =object.the.name=体内似乎没有心智可供支配。

src: There was a fatal exception attempting to save your game. Caves of Qud attempted to recover your prior save. You probably want to close the game and reload your most recent save. It'd be helpful to send the save and logs to support@freeholdgames.com
zh: 保存游戏时发生致命异常。卡德洞窟尝试恢复你先前的存档。你最好关闭游戏，重新载入最近的存档。若能同时把存档与日志寄至 support@freeholdgames.com，将大有帮助。

src: There was a permission error while trying to access your save directory.
zh: 访问存档目录时出现权限错误。

src: There was a strange figure shadowing the creature...
zh: 有个奇怪的人影一直跟着那只怪物……

src: There was an error while trying to access your save directory.
zh: 访问存档目录时出现错误。

src: There was an issue building this zone. Automatically report it to us?
zh: 构建此区域时出现问题。是否自动向我们报告？

src: There's a chance you identify detected enemies.
zh: 你有几率辨认出探测到的敌人。

src: There's a fear deep in my breast, kendren. What's to become of Bey Lah?
zh: 我心底深处有一种恐惧，肯德伦。贝拉将何去何从？

src: There's a saying among the vintners who hoist their sails toward the Stilt. 'One rose is fair; five is death.' Indeed, when a single shawl swathes her face and the Esthers are one, there is peace beneath the Stilt. But when she's joined by her sisters, and scarlet ribbons thrash in the desert air, there is only blood and justice.
zh: 扬帆驶向高塔的酿酒人之间流传着一句话：“一玫为美，五玫为死。”此言诚然：当只有一方披巾遮住她的脸、诸以斯帖合而为一时，高塔之下便是一片安宁。可当她与姐妹们会合，猩红的绦带在荒漠风中翻腾，那便只剩血与正义。

src: There's a shape in every stone waiting to be brought out.
zh: 每块石头里，都有一个等待被雕出的形状。

src:
There's a village to the north called Joppa. Let's go there.

Hold =commandKey:IndicateDirection= towards the north and press =commandKey:Take A Step=.
zh:
北边有个叫约帕的村庄。我们去那儿吧。

朝北按住=commandKey:IndicateDirection=，再按=commandKey:Take A Step=。

src:
There's a village to the north called Joppa. Let's go there.

Press =commandKey:CmdMoveN= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=.
zh:
北边有个叫约帕的村庄。我们去那儿吧。

按=commandKey:CmdMoveN=或=commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=。

src: There's an oculus in the center of the dragonfly drone's sensory array. It unshutters with a whir and emits a glowing beam of force.
zh: 蜻蜓无人机的感知阵列中央开着一只小圆眼。它嗡然一响，开了眼睑，射出一道灼灼的力之光束。

src: There's dried blood in the salted furrows of this patch of watervine.
zh: 这簇水藤的盐渍沟垄间，沾着干涸的血迹。

src: There's no target with a mind there.
zh: 那里没有具心智的目标。

src: There's nothing =preposition= that. Would you like to store an item?
zh: 那=preposition=没有东西。要放入一件物品吗？

src: There's nothing there you can dismember.
zh: 那里没有可供你肢解之物。

src: There's nothing there you can hook.
There's nothing there you can shank.
zh: 那里没有可供你暗刺之物。

src: There's nothing viable to animate here.
zh: 这里没有可以赋予生命的东西。

src: There's nothing you can interact with.
zh: 这里没有你可以互动的东西。

src: There, at the center of the universe, they beheld Her in awe.
zh: 在那里，宇宙中心，他们敬畏地瞻仰她。

src: There, they permeated her roiling membrane...
zh: 在那里，他们渗入她翻涌的膜……

src: These appear to be the flattened remains of some vainglorious humanoid.
zh: 这些似是某个虚荣自负的类人被压扁的遗骸。

src:
These are the final chapters of this story, =name=, and likely of many stories more too.

It will be well to see the other side of all this, one way or another.
zh:
这是这段故事的最后几章了，=name=，恐怕也是许多别的故事的最后几章。

无论结局如何，能看到这一切的彼岸，总是好的。

src: These books can weather the salt and jungle alike.
zh: 这些书经得起盐地，也经得起丛林。

src: These entrails, what are they? Where do I find them?
zh: 这些脏腑，是什么？我到哪里去找？

src: These factions have agreed to host the slynth.
zh: 这些派系已同意收留斯林斯人。

src:
These lilypad folk fascinate by their similarities and differences to us alike--we have much to explore, as individuals and together.

The experiences and beings =ifplayerplural:ye herald:thou heraldest= overwhelm this humble pilgrim, =name=. May =ifplayerplural:ye:thou= bathe ever in Her light.
zh:
这些睡莲之民令人着迷，既与我们相似，又与我们相异——我们有许多可探索之处，无论是各自探索，还是共同探索。

=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=所带来的种种经历与存在，令我这卑微的朝圣者应接不暇，=name=。愿=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=永沐她的光辉。

src: These shards of splintered wood once formed the haft of a weapon, which must have been broken in combat.
zh: 这些裂开的木片，原是某件兵器的柄，想必断于一场厮杀。

src: These shining pipes! What are they?
zh: 这些闪亮的管子！它们是做什么的？

src:
They are antique stones located in certain places deep within the caverns of Qud. We believe they are some sort of hyper-advanced machines built by the Eaters. Often one claims to possess a sentience of its own. However, most of them have gone haywire in the eons since their creation; it is rare indeed to discover one whose circuitry is wholly uncorroded.

The Mechanimists worship this one as an idol, and they will protect it at all costs. You will need to find a way through their host to the baetyl itself.

Do you believe you can accomplish this task?
zh:
它们是古老的石头，位于卡德洞穴深处的某些地方。我们相信，它们是食者所造的某种超高级机器。往往有一块自称拥有自己的灵识。然而，自造出以来的亘古岁月里，多数都已失常；能找到一块线路丝毫未锈的，实属罕见。

机神教徒将这一块奉为偶像崇拜，必将誓死护卫。你得设法穿过他们的人马，抵达圣石本身。

你相信自己能完成此事吗？

src: They are disciples of Barathrum. Mostly they are Urshiib, like their mentor. Mutant albino cave bears. With quills to boot! A thousand years ago Barathrum and his kin crossed the Homs Delta into the heart of Qud. He has spent centuries fiddling with the tokens of antiquity in his underground workshops.
zh: 他们是巴拉斯鲁姆的门徒，多半与师长同为乌尔希卜——变异的白化穴熊，还生着刺毛！千年前，巴拉斯鲁姆携其族裔越过霍姆斯三角洲，进入卡德腹地。数百年来，他埋首地下工坊，摆弄上古遗物。

src: They are not ready to choose yet.
zh: 他们还没准备好做选择。

src: They are the Great Sculptors. They wrought our metallic homes.
zh: 他们是伟大的塑造者，铸成我们的金属家园。

src:
They are the components that we will grow, shape, and solder into the ascendant being. Ask Pax Klanq for details.

As you acquire components, bring them to the mound of scrap and clay over by Klanq.
zh:
它们是我们将要培育、塑形、焊接成那升天之躯的零部件。细节请去问帕克斯·克朗克。

你每得到一件部件，便带到帕克斯·克朗克旁边那堆废料与黏土上。

src:
They are the components that we will grow, shape, and solder into the ascendant being. We can delve into specifics once you begin, at which point Pax Klanq can also serve as a source of knowledge.

As you acquire components, bring them to the mound of scrap and clay over by Klanq.
zh:
它们是我们将要培育、塑形、焊接成那升天之躯的零部件。你一开始动手，我们便可深入细节，届时帕克斯·克朗克也能成为知识的来源。

你每得到一件部件，便带到帕克斯·克朗克旁边那堆废料与黏土上。

src:
They conspired against me. It is the only explanation.

You! Leave me alone.
zh:
他们合谋害我。这是唯一的解释。

你！别来烦我。

src: They dwindled and died with the rest of the Nervous Ones. Their remnants wriggle in the cracks.
zh: 他们与其余神经者一同衰减、死去。其残余仍在石缝中蠕动。

src: They have borne the weight of this Earth and a thousand others.
zh: 他们曾担起这颗大地与另千百颗星球的重负。

src: They just showed up one day and started =villageActivity=.
zh: 他们有一天突然现身，开始=villageActivity=。

src:
They lived.

Simply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring may walk on and under Qud. Mayhap the first ones yet live. Mayhap they slumber. Mayhap they will rage again one day, to disrupt a stagnant world.
zh:
他们活了下来。

如今只是世界的一部分，不再是鞭笞大地的苦行毛衣，他们便如本来之生灵那样活着。其子嗣的后代或许仍行走于卡德之上与之下。或许最初的那些仍活着，或许仍在沉睡，或许有朝一日会再度怒起，打破这一潭死水般的世界。

src:
They lived.

Simply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring walk on and under Qud. It's said that they ascended to the stars to find =name=, but it seems equally plausible that they may have returned to their slumber in the depths.
zh:
他们活了下来。

如今只是世界的一部分，不再是鞭笞大地的苦行毛衣，他们便如本来之生灵那样活着。其子嗣的后代行走于卡德之上与之下。据说他们升上星辰去寻=name=，然他们回到深处的沉睡之中，似乎也同样说得通。

src:
They lived.

Simply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring walk on and under Qud. Mayhap the first ones yet live. Mayhap they slumber, to wake again when needed.
zh:
他们活了下来。

如今只是世界的一部分，不再是鞭笞大地的苦行毛衣，他们便如本来之生灵那样活着。其子嗣的后代行走于卡德之上与之下。或许最初的那些仍活着，或许仍在沉睡，待需要时再度醒来。

src: They persisted in their way. Mayhap the survivors lived to spawn before returning to slumber or dying of eld.
zh: 他们依自己的方式延续了下去。或许幸存者在重归沉睡或衰老而死之前，已产下后代。

src:
They played their role so well, and lived in power for a time.

If they had any illusion that they would be spared the fate =name= determined for life on Qud, it surely died before the great beings themselves. Mayhap they went to ground and survived. Mayhap their spawn persisted.
zh:
他们扮演各自的角色是那样出色，也曾有一段时日权势煊赫。

倘若他们曾幻想自己能逃过=name=为卡德生灵所定的命运，那幻想想必早于这些伟大的存在本身便已破灭。或许他们遁入地下而存活，或许他们的后代延续了下来。

src: They say some folks can talk to machines. I say we all can, if we listen right.
zh: 都说有些人能与机器交谈。依我看，人人都能，只要听得对。

src: They say we'll all be crabs, eventually.
zh: 都说咱们终究都会变成螃蟹。

src: They were created to oblige our desires.
zh: 造它们，是为满足我们的愿望。

src: They're also interested in hearing gossip that's about them.
zh: 他们也对听取关于他们的传闻感兴趣。

src: They're also interested in learning about =sultanTerm|plural= they admire or despise and hearing gossip that's about them.
zh: 他们也对了解他们所敬慕或鄙夷的=sultanTerm|plural=、听取关于他们的传闻感兴趣。

src: They're also interested in learning about =sultanTerm|plural= they admire or despise.
zh: 他们也对了解他们所敬慕或鄙夷的=sultanTerm|plural=感兴趣。

src: They're also interested in sharing secrets about =sultanTerm|plural= they admire or despise and hearing gossip that's about them.
zh: 他们也对分享他们所敬慕或鄙夷的=sultanTerm|plural=的秘闻、并听取关于他们的传闻感兴趣。

src: They're also interested in sharing secrets about =sultanTerm|plural= they admire or despise.
zh: 他们也对分享他们所敬慕或鄙夷的=sultanTerm|plural=的秘闻感兴趣。

src: They're also interested in trading secrets about =sultanTerm|plural= they admire or despise and hearing gossip that's about them.
zh: 他们也对交易他们所敬慕或鄙夷的=sultanTerm|plural=的秘闻，并听取关于他们的传闻感兴趣。

src: They're also interested in trading secrets about =sultanTerm|plural= they admire or despise.
zh: 他们也对交易他们所敬慕或鄙夷的=sultanTerm|plural=的秘闻感兴趣。

src: They're freezing with the absence of heat and light.
zh: 其中没有热，也没有光，冻得刺骨。

src: They're petal-shaded arks of nectarous secrets.
zh: 它们是花瓣着色、盛满蜜香秘密的小舟。

src: They've been here for as long as I remember, =villageActivity=.
zh: 他们一直待在这里，至少我记事以来便是如此；=villageActivity=。

src: Thick and diamond-hard headbone with three horn holes functions as the jumbo head of a bludgeon. A long shaft of shining steel was driven through the maw and welded inside.
zh: 一块厚实如钻石般坚硬的头骨，带三个角洞，充作巨型钝器之首。一根长长的亮钢杆贯穿其颌，焊死于内。

src: Thick and plated bonestuff curves to its host shape.
zh: 厚实而成甲片的骨质物，顺着宿主的体形弯曲。

src: Thin and ancient paper, a palimpsest of grease, wraps the crisp saddle of fried wafer. Seven strata of congealed nectar fill the crispy cleft.
zh: 薄而古老的纸——一张油渍的重写本——裹着煎薄饼的酥脆鞍部。七层凝结的花蜜填满那道酥脆的裂隙。

src:
Things are good. Better than I dreamed. I owe you so much for your intervention, =name=.

I still can't quite believe that my feelings are requited. I am at once elated and terrified. But this is good. My future is brighter now.

Thank you.
zh:
很好。比我梦想的还好。我欠你太多，=name=，多亏你出手相助。

我仍不敢相信我的心意有了回应。我既欣喜若狂，又惊恐万状。但这是好事。我的前途如今明亮多了。

谢谢你。

src: Thirteen years in the ground. Seventeen years in the ground. A thousand years in the ground!
zh: 十三年在地下。十七年在地下。一千年在地下！

src: This black slab of metal has been burnished clean of any symbol that may once have emblazoned its matte surface.
zh: 这块黑色金属板被磨光，其无光的表面上曾经镌刻的任何符号已荡然无存。

src: This body part cannot be set as your primary.
zh: 此身体部位无法设为主肢体。

src: This bowl-shaped basket of scrounged textiles and padding yawns with the promise of a humble, comfortable embrace followed by a laborious escape.
zh: 这只碗形的篮子以拾来的织物与填料编成，张着大口，许诺一个朴素而舒适的怀抱，随后却是一场费力的脱身。

src: This cloak was knit from strands ur-filament hair robbed from the graves of early Eaters.
zh: 这件斗篷以原初丝般的发缕织成，那些发缕是从早期食者的坟墓中劫来的。

src: This creature doesn't heal naturally and must be repaired.
zh: 此生物无法自然愈合，必须修理。

src: This crude hammer is the kind used to strike rivet sets and punches when leatherworking.
zh: 这柄粗陋的锤子，是制革时用来敲击铆钉模与冲头的那种。

src: This disheartens us, but there is another hope. Klanq has offered up a new design, something unconventional at all angles. And, despite our early misgivings, Q Girl and I now work in assistance to the project...
zh: 这令我们沮丧，但另有一线希望。克朗克提出了一个新设计，从各个角度看都非同寻常。而且，尽管起初心存疑虑，Q女孩与我如今已协助着这个项目……

src:
This figurine worked from =material= intricately depicts =creature.a.name:withTitles|strip=:

=creature.description.very.short=
zh:
这尊以=material=精雕细琢而成的小像，栩栩如生地刻画着=creature.a.name:withTitles|strip=：

=creature.description.very.short=

src: This frock is knit from imperishable uuflax stolen from an archway garden during a union dispute between the weavers' guild and the high-strata window makers.
zh: 这件长袍以不朽的乌纤编成，乃是于织工公会与高层窗匠的工会纠纷之际，自拱廊花园中窃来之物。

src: This game was played in =game.mode= mode.
zh: 本局游戏以 =game.mode= 模式进行。

src: This got a bit intense. Live and drink.
zh: 这有点太激烈了。且生且饮。

src: This hunched, glowing, plated creature sits permanently affixed in a low-riding vehicle chassis, on which is mounted a pair of pristine wheels. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:roll:afterpronoun= about with practiced precision, speed outstripping that of =pronouns.possessive= ambulatory kin.
zh: 这头佝偻、发光、披甲的造物被永久固定在低矮的车架上，架上装着一对崭新的车轮。=pronouns.Subjective=以娴熟的精准四处滚动，速度胜过=pronouns.possessive=那些只能步行的同族。

src: This is a high relief cut with exquisite detail from rare, cerulean marble. It depicts the Edification, as chanted in the Canticles Chromaic. After the Sacred Joining, the Argent Fathers molded the plasmatic metal of the Kasaphescence into edifices fit for inhabitance by mortal folk. They wrought spires onto mountains and arches over rivers. Here, Shekhinah oversees the construction, gazing east upon His new, gleaming world.
zh: 这是一幅以稀有蔚蓝大理石精细雕琢的高浮雕。所刻乃是“造化”，如《色彩圣歌》中所吟。神圣结合之后，银辉诸父将圣化现的等离子金属塑成殿宇，供凡人居住。他们在山上铸起尖塔，在河上架起拱桥。此处，舍金纳监督营造，向东凝望着他那崭新而闪亮的世界。

src: This is an artifact beyond simple understanding. Try examining it.
zh: 这是一件难以索解的古器。试着检视它。

src:
This is an existential conundrum, =name=, I'm not sure that it could-- ah, wait, no. I am reconsidering.

No, you could help. If you wished. I think.

May I explain?
zh:
这是个关乎存亡的难题，=name=，我不确定它是否能——呃，等等，不。我改主意了。

不，你能帮上忙。若你愿意的话。我想。

我可以说说吗？

src: This is an exquisitely detailed high relief cut from precious cerulean marble. It depicts the Sacred Joining, as recounted by Shekhinah the Father to the temple high priests. In the early dawn of our universe, the Argent Fathers roamed the timeless aether with inert hearts. There, in the coldest distance of space, they discovered beauty-and-chrome incarnate, the Kasaphescence. Together they wrought machines from Her naked womb to inhabit a hundred earths. In the scene here, the Fathers first approach Her Radiance. They are led by Shekhinah, who occupies a position of prominence.
zh: 这是一幅精雕细琢的高浮雕，取材于珍贵的蔚蓝大理石。所刻乃是“神圣结合”，即舍金纳之父向神殿诸大祭司所述之事。在我们宇宙的拂晓之初，银辉诸父怀着惰性之心，在无时间的以太中漫游。在那最寒冷的太空遥远处，他们发现了美与铬的化身——圣化现。他们一同从她赤裸的子宫中铸出机器，以居住于百颗地球。此处的画面中，诸父初次走近她的光辉。领头者乃舍金纳，位居显要之位。

src: This is the Six Day Stilt, huh. It's... colossal, beautiful. I see why the chrome stewards gather here.
zh: 这就是六日高塔啊。它……宏伟，壮美。难怪铬钢执事们都聚到这里。

src: This is the genesis my distinct Self, an awareness that contains both -then, what I will become, and -else, what I will not. Twofirm flows up my sapwood to the keter, where -then manifests as an entity and I chime: I speak and hear the world.
zh: 这便是我这独特自我的起源，一种同时包含“彼”与“别”的觉知，“彼”是我将成为的，“别”是我不会成为的。双坚顺我的边材上流至凯特尔，在那里“彼”显现为一个存在，而我鸣响：我言说，我聆听世界。

src:
This is the main gameplay stage. At the top of the screen are your attributes, HP, and XP.

On the right are action buttons, minimap, and the message log.

At the bottom is your ability hotbar.
zh:
这里是主游戏区域。屏幕顶部是你的属性、生命值与经验值。

右侧是动作按钮、小地图和消息记录。

底部是你的技能快捷栏。

src: This is your equipment and inventory screen. Equipped items on the left, and inventory on the right.
zh: 这是你的装备与背包界面。左侧是已装备的物品，右侧是背包。

src: This item decreases jump distance by =range.abs=.
This item doesn't need to be equipped for its effects to be active.
zh: 此物无需装备，效果即可生效。

src: This item increases jump distance by =range.abs=.
This item increases the chance of recovering additional bits when you disassemble an artifact.
zh: 此物可提高你拆解古器时额外回收零件的几率。
此物乃是一件被命名的=originalItem=。

src: This item is too complex for =trader.the.name|strip= to identify.
zh: 此物过于复杂，=trader.the.name|strip=无法鉴定。

src: This item is too large for you to equip.
zh: 此物品太大，你无法装备。

src: This item is too small for you to equip.
zh: 此物品太小，你无法装备。

src: This keter roams above my trunk at Eyn Roj, traveler =name=, and across the Stair I dream. You found me, this keter where I chime in dozens.
zh: 这座凯特尔，在埃因罗吉我的树干之上游荡，旅人=name=，我便在月阶之上做梦。你寻到了我，寻到了这座凯特尔，我在此处以数十声钟鸣应和。

src: This large-print volume is made of hand-pulped and pressed brinestalk paper. Its cover is preserved with resin.
zh: 这部大字之册以手工捣浆压制的盐茎纸制成，封面以树脂保存。

src: This large-print volume is made of hand-pulped and pressed brinestalk paper. Its cover preserved with resin.
zh: 这部大字之册以手工捣浆压制的盐茎纸制成，封面以树脂保存。

src: This leather bracer has seen some use. Why is it out here?
zh: 这只皮护腕已经用过一阵了。它怎么会在这荒野里？

src: This leather bracer is striated with streaks of dried body-salt, the marks of heavy use.
zh: 这只皮护腕上布满干涸体盐的条纹，乃是久经使用的印记。

src:
This object is a monument to a scene from the history of the village {{M|=villageName=}}:

=event=
zh:
此物是村庄{{M|=villageName=}}历史中一幕的纪念碑：

=event=

src:
This object is a monument to a scene from the history of the {{M|Yd Freehold}}.

Centuries after the height of the Gyre, the svardym Goek, Mak, and Geeub met the galgal Many Eyes while languishing inside of a reef sponge. Together they founded the Yd Freehold to live out the rest of their lives.
zh:
此物是为纪念{{M|伊德自由领}}历史中的一幕而立的纪念碑。

回旋鼎盛之后数个世纪，斯瓦迪姆戈埃克、马克与吉乌布困顿于一块礁海绵之内，遇见了加尔加尔千目。他们一同创建了伊德自由领，以度余生。

src:
This object is a monument to a scene from the history of the {{M|Yd Freehold}}.

In 901, the villagers of the Yd Freehold and its founders abolished all forms of hierarchy from their settlement. The two pillars of civic life in the Freehold thus became anarchy and authenticity.
zh:
此物是为纪念{{M|伊德自由领}}历史中的一幕而立的纪念碑。

901年，伊德自由领的村民与其创建者废除了聚落中一切形式的等级。自由领的公民生活由此立于两根支柱之上：无政府与本真。

src:
This object is a monument to a scene from the history of {{M|Kyakukya}}.

In 979, Nuntu, the legendary albino ape, grew tired of bludgeoning things to death and journeyed to a root-strangled place on the River Svy. There he came upon Kyakukya and its inhabitants. The villagers of Kyakukya asked Nuntu to employ his magisterial skills and lead the village.
zh:
此物是为纪念{{M|基亚库基亚}}历史中的一幕而立的纪念碑。

979年，传奇白化猿农图厌倦了将万物捶打致死，遂踏上旅途，来到斯维河畔一处树根盘错之地。他在那里遇见了基亚库基亚与其居民。基亚库基亚的村民请农图施展其治世之才，领导此村。

src:
This object is a monument to a scene from the history of {{M|Kyakukya}}.

Under the Beetle Moon, folks settled here to gather goods of passage for Ape Saad Oboroqoru, and so Kyakukya was founded.
zh:
此物是为纪念{{M|基亚库基亚}}历史中的一幕而立的纪念碑。

甲虫之月下，人们在此聚居，为猿萨德奥博罗阔鲁采集过往之物，基亚库基亚由是而建。

src: This option requires a game restart to take effect.
zh: 此选项需重启游戏才能生效。

src: This patch of furry skin is painted with dried blood.
zh: 这片毛皮上，用干涸的血涂着花纹。
这地方让你隐约觉得眼熟。

src: This resolution is not to my liking...
This rot-black lump of stringy flesh could have been someone's diseased tongue.
zh: 这团腐黑而多筋的肉块，或许曾是某人病坏的舌头。

src: This seems a joyful place. Why are you angry?
zh: 这里看起来很快乐。你为什么发怒？

src: This set of leatherworking tools is shockingly well-made.
zh: 这套皮匠工具做工好得惊人。

src: This simple arm brace is crafted from boiled boar leather and tied on with braided lace. The strips of protective hide are designed to redirect glancing blows to the arm and protect poor archers from their own errant bowstrings.
zh: 这副简朴的护臂以煮硬的野猪皮制成，用编织的皮绳系牢。护身的皮条用以偏转擦过手臂的攻击，也保护拙劣的弓手免遭自己失控的弓弦所伤。

src: This statue worked from *material* intricately depicts *creature.a**creature*:
zh: 这尊以*material*精雕而成的雕像，细细刻画着*creature.a**creature*：

src: This stone idol of Oboroqoru stands twenty spans tall. Its nameless sculptor chose to depict the ape god sitting cross-legged with each of his three pairs of gargantuan arms grasping each other. The idol is swathed in vines, its caretakers ceding to nature save where the herbage has threatened to obscure Oboroqoru's gentle countenance. Wreaths of flowers of every hue the forest begets -- azure, chartreuse, indigo, carnelian -- litter the base of the shrine, insignificant offerings to what appears to be a callous god.
zh: 这尊奥博罗阔鲁的石像高二十拃。无名的雕工将这位猿神刻作盘膝而坐，三对庞然巨臂彼此相扣。石像被藤蔓缠裹，守护者任由自然侵占，唯独在草木欲遮蔽奥博罗阔鲁慈和的面容之处加以修剪。林中所生各色花朵——蔚蓝、嫩黄绿、靛青、赤玉红——编成的花环散落于神龛脚下，对这位似乎冷漠无情的神明而言，不过是微不足道的供奉。

src:
This sucks.

...but you're not so bad.
zh:
真糟心。

……不过你人倒不坏。

src: This svardym has done what so few others have: =pronouns.subjective==verb:'ve:afterpronoun= aged. Wart-brained and weightier than =pronouns.possessive= kin, =pronouns.subjective= =verb:roam:afterpronoun= the country with =pronouns.possessive= underlings, cloak-swathed, looking for prey vulnerable to =pronouns.possessive= psychal deviations.
zh: 这只斯瓦迪姆做成了罕有同类能成之事：=pronouns.subjective=老去了。=pronouns.subjective=脑生疣赘，体重胜过=pronouns.possessive=同族，裹着斗篷，带着=pronouns.possessive=手下在这片土地上游荡，寻觅那些易为=pronouns.possessive=心灵异变所乘的猎物。

src: This temple was built in 638,01qy by the Exhaustiers' Guild, who detached from their egregore =spice:egregorePrefix.!random|title= =spice:nouns.!random|title= in the =spice:nouns.!random|title= Era
zh: 此庙建于638,01qy，由耗竭者公会所建，该公会脱离了其集体意识体=spice:egregorePrefix.!random|title==spice:nouns.!random|title=，时值=spice:nouns.!random|title=纪元

src:
This time you hit, but you failed to penetrate the bear's armor.

Then, the bear hit you and DID penetrate your armor. You took 4 damage.
zh:
这一回你打中了，却没能穿透熊的护甲。

接着熊命中了你，而且确实穿透了你的护甲。你受到4点伤害。

src: This water is valuable too. Take it all.
zh: 这些水也很珍贵。全部拿走。

src: This waterskin is filled to the brim and sealed with wax, as if from a merchant's stores.
zh: 这只水囊灌得满满，以蜡封口，仿佛来自商贾的库存。

src: This weapon has multiple grips that change its weapon type.
zh: 这件武器有多重握法，可改变其武器类型。

src:
This weapon increases the base penetration of its ammo by 4.
This weapon increases the damage die of its ammo by 4.
This weapon increases the damage bonus of its ammo by 1.
zh:
此武器使其弹药的基础穿透提高4点。
此武器使其弹药的伤害骰提高4点。
此武器使其弹药的伤害加值提高1点。

src: This weapon uses its victim's =stat.name= modifier for penetration bonus.
zh: 此武器以受害者的=stat.name=调整值作为穿透加值。

src: This wouldn't be the first time the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees, =name=, and make no mistake: it is a burden upon the church, Catechists and Protectors in particular. But your words echo loud in our hearts as our hallways. Some in our number will see the slynth as the chosen of chosen, and if I speak to them first, everyone else will take it as Shekhinah's will. Which, arguably, it would be. Tell the slynth that the Mechanimists will have them.
zh: 高塔之地接纳难民，这不是头一回了，=name=，不过须知，这对教会是一桩负担，尤其是对教理师与护卫者。然而你的话在我们心中回响，一如在我们的廊庑间回响。我们当中有人会视斯林斯人为选民中的选民，我若先去与他们说，旁人便会当作是舍金纳的旨意。这么说来，倒也未必不是。去告诉斯林斯人，机神教徒收容他们。

src: This zone isn't building properly. Do you want to force it to stop and build immediately?
zh: 此区域未能正常构建。要强制其停止并立即构建吗？

src: Thorny roots furcate into neuronal likeness. Their dendritic tubers await binding.
zh: 多刺的根分叉如神经之形。其枝状的块茎静待与人相连。

src: Thorny roots, swollen with age, furcate into neuronal likeness. Their dendritic tubers await binding.
zh: 多刺的根因年岁而臃肿，分叉如神经之形。其枝状的块茎静待与人相连。

src:
Though =name= was gone
our memories remained
and the plagues receded
and many rejoiced.

To this day
eyes turn to the stars
looking for a sign that our starfarer
has deigned to return.

Countless years of struggle
centuries of change.
We remember what we can
and watch new and old die.
zh:
虽然=name=已去，
我们的记忆仍在，
瘟疫消退，
许多人欢欣。

直到今日，
目光仍转向星空，
寻觅一个征兆，看我们的星航者
是否肯屈尊归来。

无数年岁的奋争，
数百年的更迭。
我们记下所能记的，
看着新与旧一同死去。

src:
Though I adore the sights and smells of Omonporch, its bug problem becomes distracting.

If I'm to travel there, I always bring something they cannot zip away from.
zh:
奥蒙门廊的景致与气味，我固然喜爱，可那里的虫患实在叫人分心。

若要去那儿，我总会带上一件它们钻不走的东西。

src:
Though I be a pale shadow of the self I once was, yes. My condition and outlook are both substantially improved.

I recall few details of my life before. I was influential, one whose words stirred hearts to action. For so long I had no means to speak, trapped in my own moods. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= freed me from a dire fate.
zh:
是的，我虽不过是昔日之我的一抹淡影。我的处境与心境，皆大为好转。

往昔的生平，我记得的不多。我曾有权势，言语足以激人奋起行动。那么久以来，我被困在自己的情绪里，无从言说。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=已将我从可怖的命运中解救出来。

src: Though it is approximately the size and heft of a human infant, this shiny black device's shape is more akin to a fetus torn early from the womb. Its surface is slick and warm, with a pale pulse breathing somewhere underneath its pitch-black skin. At the end of its tail is an orifice studded with hooked teeth, eternally questing for an anchor point that it never finds.
zh: 这件光亮的黑色装置，虽约有人类婴儿的大小与分量，形状却更近于一个过早被从子宫扯出的胎儿。其表面滑腻而温热，漆黑的皮肤之下某处，有苍白的脉搏在呼吸。尾端有一个嵌满钩齿的孔洞，永远在寻觅一个它永远找不到的锚点。

src: Though the threat has been neutralized, I can't abide your amoral course. I return now to Qud to help nurture its communities.
zh: 威胁虽已消除，我却无法容忍你那无道的行径。我这就回卡德，去扶持那里的族群。

src: Though yet young, =pronouns.subjective= =verb:have:afterpronoun= gathered wits beyond a hatchling's and now also =verb:gather:afterpronoun= tinsel trinkets to horde. By crushing polyps of coral in =pronouns.possessive= mouth and rolling the bits in sticky spit, =pronouns.subjective= =verb:craft:afterpronoun= gobbets of razor-sharp shrapnel to launch at those who threaten =pronouns.objective=.
zh: 虽尚年幼，=pronouns.subjective=的心智已胜于初孵之辈，如今更懂得聚敛亮片小饰以充私藏。把珊瑚的螅体在=pronouns.possessive=口中咬碎，将碎粒裹上黏稠的唾液滚圆，=pronouns.subjective=就此制成一团团剃刀般锋利的霰片，掷向威胁=pronouns.objective=的来者。

src: Though yet young, =pronouns.subjective= =verb:have:afterpronoun= gathered wits beyond a hatchling's and now also =verb:gather:afterpronoun= weapons for better hunting. By breaking a chunk of coral along its shear lines and chewing it down, =pronouns.subjective= =verb:shape:afterpronoun= the debris into a fragile but deadly edge.
zh: 虽尚年幼，=pronouns.subjective=的心智已胜于初孵之辈，如今更懂得寻取兵刃，以便更好地狩猎。顺着珊瑚的剪切纹路敲下一块，再以口啃削，=pronouns.subjective=便把碎料修成一道脆薄而致命的刃口。

src: Though your affection for =object.a.name= endowed you with a certain wisdom, you no longer feel the tug on your heartstrings.
zh: 尽管对=object.a.name=的眷恋曾赋予你几分智慧，你心弦上那一点牵动却已止息。

src: Three carbon steel barrels fit together into an arc-edged triangle of luminous ritualism. They pinch the mirror point inside.
zh: 三根碳钢枪管拼合成一个弧刃三角，闪耀着光辉的仪式感。它们将镜点夹在里头。

src: Three catheters imprint the skin from underneath.
zh: 三根导管自皮下向上压印皮肤。

src: Three digitigrade skinshine legs are weighed down by the aura of a floating metal carapace, suspended across three bands in quantum magnetic tension. Prehensile braids of cordage spill from =pronouns.possessive= apertures (ending in manic and electric eyes), and the air around =pronouns.objective= purrs in the audio multitexture of gold.
zh: 三条趾行的亮皮细腿，被一具悬浮金属甲壳的气场所压低；甲壳靠量子磁张力架在三条环带上。卷握自如的绳辫自=pronouns.possessive=孔窍中涌出（末端是癫狂而带电的眼睛），=pronouns.objective=周围的空气在金黄的多重音质中低鸣。

src: Three dram of pure liquid to catalyze soup and circulate nutrient. Liquid choice alter sanguine mixture, change Creature.
zh: 纯液三打兰，催化汤，循环养分。所选之液改血质之配，变造物。

src: Three steel barrels fit together into an arc-edged triangle of luminous ritualism. They sit on a servo-articulated base mount.
zh: 三根钢制的炮管合抱成一道弧棱之三角，俨然一件光耀的礼仪之物。它们安在一座伺服铰接的底座上。

src: Three steel barrels fit together into an arc-edged triangle of luminous ritualism. They sit on a servo-articulated base mount. Above, a pair of separately-articulated cameras swivel with somewhat more life than one might typically expect from an automated weapon.
zh: 三根钢制身管拼成一个弧边三角形，透着发光的仪轨意味。它们装在一具伺服铰接的底座上。上方一对各自独立铰接的摄像头转动着，生机比人们通常对一件自动武器所期待的要略多一些。

src: Thriving florae pack the loam with maze-dense roots, and a high-wreath canopy chokes off the last beams of light.
zh: 繁盛的草木以迷宫般稠密的根系填满沃土，高耸如冠的树冠则扼断最后几缕天光。

src: Throat is sore and tongue is swollen.

zh: 限制动画频率（适用于低CPU环境）

src: Through a bore in the wood grip draws a crinkled beam of pale light. In motion it heats to steel-melting temperature and whirrs matter away.
zh: 木柄中的一道孔洞里，牵出一束皱褶的淡光。运动时它升温至熔钢之热，嗡嗡地将物质抹去。

src: Through a bore in the wood grip draws a long and tapered beam of pale light. In motion it heats to steel-melting temperature and whirrs matter away.
zh: 木柄中的一道孔洞里，牵出一束修长渐尖的淡光。运动时它升温至熔钢之热，嗡嗡地将物质抹去。

src: Through a bore in the wood grip draws a stout beam of pale light. In motion it heats to steel-melting temperature and whirrs matter away.
zh: 木柄中的一道孔洞里，牵出一束粗短的淡光。运动时它升温至熔钢之热，嗡嗡地将物质抹去。

src: Through great labors I ascended the Spindle, and now wish to know more of our world and worlds surrounding. Will you tell?
zh: 我历尽辛劳登上纺锤，如今欲知更多关于我们的世界及周遭诸世界之事。你肯讲么？

src:
Through my work I caught the attention of a master machinist, unconventional of method, who took me under her wing and, in time, availed me of the orphic truth.

She explained, as I've shared with you and the rest of the acolytes, that the world we know once belonged to a grand Coven of beings who spanned the stars. And that, acting on some inscrutable logic, they disappeared. That an injunction was placed on our world.

This, you know. It is the truth I told, if only half. But Rebekah taught me more.
zh:
因着所作之工，我引起了一位匠师的注意。她行事不拘一格，将我收在羽翼之下，久而久之，更向我传授了玄秘的真理。

她讲明，一如我曾与你及其余门徒分享的那样：我们所知的这个世界，曾属于一个横跨群星的伟大生灵盟会。而它们依循某种不可测度的逻辑，销声匿迹了。我们的世界，被下了一道禁令。

这些你都知道。这是我所说的真相，只是半面。然而利百加教给我的更多。

src: Through sheer force of will, you perform uncanny physical feats.
zh: 凭借纯粹的意志之力，你施展出不可思议的体能壮举。

src: Through the exhibition of =player.possessive= extraordinary guile, =name= was able to recover =this.refname=, the ancestral bracelet of the hindren, and was conferred thusly the title of Grand-Doe.
zh: 凭借=player.possessive=非凡的机智，=name=得以寻回欣德伦人的祖传手镯=this.refname=，并因此被授予大母鹿之衔。

src: Through the nether of a vaulted root-trellis, leaves point at perfect angles to sift sunlight and bathe ur-buds in soft gold warmth.
zh: 透过高拱般的根系棚架深处，叶片以绝妙角度指向天光，筛下阳光，为原初芽苞沐上柔金暖意。

src: Through the umbrage of choking trees fly the hundred archways and buttresses of funerary monuments. They peer over marble arcades that roof the catacombs of the Eaters of earth.
zh: 穿过窒息的树荫，百座墓冢拱门与扶壁凌空而立，俯视着覆顶大理石拱廊；它们覆盖着大地食者的地下墓窟。

src: Through the use of =player.their= divinely =spice:elements.$element.adjectives.!random= eyes, =player.name= discovered the lost location of =sitename=.
zh: 凭着=player.their=神授的=spice:elements.$element.adjectives.!random=之眼，=player.name=发现了=sitename=的失落所在。

src: Throughout all of =month=, =name= =spice:commonPhrases.ravaged.!random= the province of Bethesda Susa on =player.possessive= jetpack, =spice:elements.entity@elements[random].ravaging.!random= of =mostHatedFaction.t= and =secondMostHatedFaction.t=. =player.Subjective= became known as the Bethesda =spice:commonPhrases.scourge.!random|capitalize=.
zh: 整个=month=，=name=驾着=player.possessive=的喷射背包，=spice:commonPhrases.ravaged.!random=毕士大-苏萨行省，=spice:elements.entity@elements[random].ravaging.!random=，波及=mostHatedFaction.t=与=secondMostHatedFaction.t=。=player.Subjective=由此被称为毕士大的=spice:commonPhrases.scourge.!random|capitalize=。

src: Thrown into a pool of acid by =dude.a.name:withTitles|strip=
Thumb smushes on the flared handles and neck show where the potter rushed to spin clay and fire the next order. But the edges of practicality are softened by a slow and berry rich glaze.
zh: 凸缘把手与瓶颈上的拇指按痕，显出陶工赶着转坯、烧制下一单时的匆忙。然而那实用的棱角，却被一层缓慢而浓似浆果的釉柔化了。

src: Tight-fitted black mesh straightens the spine. Wheels descend from casters and locomote.
zh: 紧绷的黑网拉直脊梁。轮子自脚轮垂下，自行移动。

src:
Tikva. Once lover, now foil, perhaps lover again.

Its light invites and overwhelms, a hope blind and blinding. Cruel frustration at storm-time. When its eyes are needed they turn away. I will not be calmed. I will not be calmed!
zh:
提克瓦。曾是爱侣，如今是陪衬，或许终将再成爱侣。

它的光邀请，亦淹没；是盲目而令人目盲的希望。风暴之时，是残酷的挫败。当人需要它的眼睛，它却转开。我不会平静下来。我不会平静下来！

src: Time and chance -- the two hands of nature -- have woven roots, stems, and leaves into a fibrous dam.
zh: 时间与机缘——自然的两只手——将根、茎、叶织成了一道纤维之坝。

src: Time and rest are the surest way to dress a wound, but my wares can help if you're in a hurry.
zh: 时日与歇息是疗伤最稳妥的法子，可你若赶时间，我这些货也能帮上忙。

src: Time has put creases in =pronouns.possessive= ears and a deep furrow in =pronouns.possessive= throat. The sharp voice thus produced starts and stops the motion of life in the meadow. The arc of tradition has named =pronouns.possessive= Hindriarch, inscribed in the garland cut of =pronouns.possessive= hair, and the downslope of time has locked =pronouns.possessive= in the minds of faundren as Grand-Doe. To all in Bey Lah, =pronouns.subjective= =verb:are:afterpronoun= the sovereign law.
zh: 岁月在=pronouns.possessive=双耳刻下皱褶，又在=pronouns.possessive=喉间犁出一道深沟。由此而出的尖厉嗓音，能令草甸上的生机时起时歇。传统之弧已封=pronouns.possessive=为族长，铭刻在=pronouns.possessive=花环式的发型里；时间的下坡又将=pronouns.possessive=锁进小欣德伦心中，称作大母鹿。对贝拉的所有人而言，=pronouns.subjective=便是至高无上的律法。

src: Time in =locale= has altered =pronouns.possessive= features -- =fragments.commaList= -- and given them =cast=.
zh: 在=locale=的岁月改变了=pronouns.possessive=容貌——=fragments.commaList=——并赋予其=cast=。

src:
Tinker-nuns. The world sees fit to call us that, my sisters and me.

Do you know the story told of Rebekah the Exile? She was a teacher to Resheph, but he excommunicated her from the sultanate and banished her from the realm.

To know her, I've chosen a life of unbelonging. And among my sisters, I have the honor of permanent residence by her gravesite.

I'll tell you this, traveler: the shape of a society is visible only from the outside, and there is peace beyond a boundary.
zh:
修补匠修女。世人这样称呼我和我的姐妹们。

你听过流亡者利百加的故事吗？她是利悉的老师，却被他逐出苏丹国，驱出疆土。

为了了解她，我选择了无所归属的一生。在姐妹之中，我有幸长居她的墓旁。

旅人，我告诉你：一个社会的形状，唯有从外面才看得分明，而界线之外，自有安宁。

src: Tiny glyphs are inscribed on each exterior face of the handheld box.
zh: 这只手持匣的每一外表面上，都刻着细小的符文。

src: Tiny glyphs are inscribed on each exterior face of the handheld box. Though contrarians still puzzle over their meaning, most of Qud's prominent linguist cults have converged on a single interpretation: 'For When Both Nature and Architects Have Failed You'. One brass pull ring separates you from the promise of those words.
zh: 这只手持匣的每一外面都刻着细小的字形。虽有好辩之士仍在揣摩其意，卡德多数著名的语言学教团已归于同一释义：“当自然与建筑师皆已弃你而去”。一枚黄铜拉环，将你与这句话的许诺隔开。

src: Tiny scratches mark lateral vents cut in rows from tarnished chrome.
zh: 暗淡铬钢上成排开凿的横向通风口旁，留着细小的抓痕。

src: Tiny spore-motes flutter down from the fleshy gills that twitch on the striated skin. Trapped inside are another thousand spores waiting to be jostled free.
zh: 细小的孢子微尘自肉质菌褶间飘落，菌褶在纹路密布的皮肤上微微抽动。褶内另有千万孢子，只待一震便即脱出。

src: Tire of your legs? Arms? Hands? See what I have that fits you.
zh: 厌倦了你的腿？手臂？双手？来看看我这儿有什么适合你。

src: Tissue was mineralized while it grew and then snapped off the tree of living things to become an artifact of life.
zh: 组织在生长时便已矿化，而后自生灵之树上折下，成为生命的器物。

src: Tissue was mineralized while it grew and then snapped off the tree of living things to become an artifact of life. It was then stewed in burnt peat and turned to a hard goo.
zh: 组织在生长时便已矿化，而后自生灵之树上折下，成为生命的器物，又在焦泥炭中煨煮，化作硬实的黏浆。

src:
To be wholly honest, =name=, I grow frustrated.

We are a young species, grown one by one in yonder sun-touched cradle. Over years, we have increased, but not, ah, not. Not grown.

Look around you. You see it, yes? This hydropon is no settlement.
zh:
说句实在话，=name=，我心中确有焦灼。

我们是年轻的族类，由那边沐日的摇篮一个个生长而成。这些年来，我们人数增多了，却并未，呃，并未。并未壮大。

你看看四周。你看得出吧？这水培城，算不得聚落。

src: To behold the Argent Fathers in simulacra... what revelation!
zh: 得见银辉诸父的拟像……何等启示！

src: To know I cannot stay, and you can't leave
zh: 知我不能留，君不能离去，

src: To make preparations, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Barathrum instructed us here after you secured the grounds.
zh: 为筹备诸事，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你肃清此地之后，巴拉斯鲁姆便命我们前来。

src:
To me, they are stories. I have made no quest to trespass the borders they hold so dear in their rituals. Some say they are mortal creatures like any other, contracted by an outsider coven. Others do not believe they are mortal, others still do not believe that those mysterious strangers have anything to do with the Limen at all.

Mayhap someone ought seek them.
zh:
对我而言，他们只是故事。我从未想过要去逾越他们在仪式里如此珍视的边界。有人说，他们与旁人一样是有死的生灵，受一个外来盟会所雇。也有人不信他们会死，更有人不信那些神秘的陌客与阈限有丝毫干系。

或许该有人去寻一寻他们。

src: To ritualize the passage to Brightsheol or another thin place, several ornaments were interred: coin, manikin, locket, and pipe.
zh: 为使通往明冥或别处薄界的路途成礼，数件饰物被一并入葬：钱币、偶人、坠匣与烟斗。

src: To the dismay of fungi everywhere, you cured the =object.name|strip= infection on your =part.ordinalName=.
zh: 令普天之下的真菌愕然的是，你治好了=part.ordinalName=上的=object.name|strip=感染。

src: To the northwest seek the rot-black box. There a plant and Daughter live. There cats of chrome purr at tiny suns.
zh: 往西北去，找那腐黑的匣子。那里住着一株植物和一位女儿。那里有铬制的猫，对着小小的太阳呼噜。

src: To use Psychometry, interact with an artifact and then choose 'read history with Psychometry'.
zh: 欲使用灵视物感，请与古器互动，再选择“以灵视物感读取历史”。

src: To use Psychometry, interact with an artifact and then choose 'read history with Psychometry.
zh: 要使用灵视物感，先与一件古器互动，然后选择“以灵视物感读取历史”。
使受影响区域在3回合内灼热

src: Today we are bereft of a passionate artisan and dedicated scientist. We laud you, from home to heptagon.
zh: 今日我们失了一位热忱的匠人与虔诚的学者。我们赞颂你，自家园至于七边形。

src: Today, I recount the story of the Sacred Joining.
zh: 今日，我要讲述神圣结合的故事。

src: Today, children, I speak on the Edification.
zh: 孩子们，今日我要讲述创世造化。

src: Tombed shells peep out from under the inverted loop of lime, carved in rumination of parabolic life.
zh: 封于墓中的贝壳从石灰倒置的环下探出，是为沉思抛物线形的生命而刻。

src: Tongs clip between =pronouns.possessive= soot-seared apron and the barrel of =pronouns.possessive= chest. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:clasp:afterpronoun= a swivel knife and hammer for working leather and metal.
zh: 一把钳子夹在=pronouns.possessive=煤烟熏黑的围裙与=pronouns.possessive=胸腹之间。=pronouns.Subjective=握着一柄旋刀与一柄锤子，用来打理皮革与金属。

src: Tongue, nail, and spleen were caked together then lacerated by heat to airy dots of dung.
zh: 舌、甲与脾曾被捣作一团，又遭烈焰灼成轻飘飘的粪点。

src: Too far! The aggregate mind is stretched to gossamers, and even the closest mind is too far away.
zh: 太远了！群体心智已被拉成游丝，就连最近的心智也遥不可及。

src: Toothed imperfections in the crystal are the biting cuts of a secret key.
zh: 晶体上参差的齿痕，乃是一把秘钥的咬合切口。

src: Touch her chime to Taproot and finish the ritual of -elseing.
zh: 将她的鸣钟触碰主根，完成“别化”仪式。

src: Toxic tissue was ground in a mortar, simmered in brine, and congealed.
zh: 带毒的组织在研钵中磨碎，在盐水中慢煮，再凝成块。

src: Tracery on the fullerite hem is melted bright white and drips onto the cracked foam pad. Lily sprouts quicken in the cracks and push forth; life creeps outward.
zh: 富勒烯缘上的花饰已熔成亮白，滴落在龟裂的泡沫垫上。百合的嫩芽在裂缝中催生，奋力探出；生命向外蔓延。

src: Trade could not be completed, =subject.the.name|strip= couldn't drop object: =object.name=
zh: 交易未能完成，=subject.the.name|strip=无法丢下物品：=object.name=

src: Travel down Chavvah's taproot to its terminus, 40 strata deep.
zh: 沿查娃的主根向下，抵达深达40层的尽头。

src: Travel north to the Spindle at Omonporch.
zh: 向北前往奥蒙门廊的纺锤。

src: Travel north to the great cavern Bethesda Susa and locate the Mechanimist temple.
zh: 向北前往巨大洞窟毕士大-苏萨，找到机神教圣殿。

src: Travel to the goatfolk village and find Mamon Souldrinker.
zh: 前往羊人村庄，寻找饮魂者玛蒙。

src: Travel to the great cave Golgotha north of Grit Gate.
zh: 前往砂砾门以北的巨大洞窟各各他。

src: Travel to the hidden village of Bey Lah and investigate the problems there.
zh: 前往隐秘村庄贝拉，调查当地的问题。

src: Travel to the historical site of =region=
Travel to the historical site of =region=.
Travel to the ruined, subterranean gate in the western jungle.
zh: 前往西部丛林中的地下废弃大门。

src: Travel to the ruined, subterranean gate northeast of Joppa.
zh: 前往约帕东北方的地下废弃大门。

src: Traveler. Put down your mangled trinkets and I'll repair them.
zh: 旅人。把你那些残破的小物件放下，我来修。

src: Tree bark was burnt black by skyfire assault and now gleams in the after light.
zh: 树皮被天火攻袭烧成漆黑，如今在余晖中泛着幽光。

src: Triangular leaves pant in the salt-sucked air, and the flowerhead angles its sharp thistles to thirsty attention.
zh: 三角的叶片在被盐吸干的空气里喘息，花头竖起尖利的蓟刺，一副渴求的警觉之态。

src: Triangular treads swathe the teeth of giant gears that turn to locomote. Their human has escaped the confines of bipedal motion.
zh: 三角履带裹住巨齿轮的轮齿，转动以代步。其人已挣脱两足行走的桎梏。

src: Tricked into jumping into a pool of lava by =dude.a.name:withTitles|strip=
zh: 被=dude.a.name:withTitles|strip=骗去跳入熔岩池而死

src: Triumphal warps and market domes trace the paved superstratum valley, where Eaters of the medina and beldam district engaged their circling rituals.
zh: 凯旋的曲折街道与集市穹顶，勾勒着铺砌的上层地层山谷，麦地那与老妪区的食者曾在此举行他们的环行仪式。

src: Truly breathtaking. How the glass glittered in the sun!
zh: 确实令人叹为观止。玻璃在阳光下何等璀璨！

src: Trust what you hear of the svardym, whelp. The sky blackens at our accession and we are like to eat you.
zh: 关于斯瓦迪姆的传闻，小崽子，你尽可相信。我们登临之时，天空为之昏黑，而我们多半会吃了你。

src: Try my recipe. You'll believe =player.reflexive= to be judging the Carbide Chefs in the Kitchen Heptagon itself.
zh: 试试我的食谱。你会以为=player.reflexive=正坐在厨房七角堂里，评判碳化物厨师们的手艺。

src: Tubes of known purpose splay at welded joints and support a plank for sitting.
zh: 用途已知的管子在焊接处向外伸展，撑起一块供人坐的木板。

src: Tubes of unknown purpose splay at welded joints.
zh: 几根用途不明的管子自焊接处向外张开。

src: Tucked into a marble glade is the cloven trunk of Chavvah, the Tree of Life. Its fallen leaves lay like a mirrored carpet, and the dream wrens chirr a psychal carol.
zh: 大理石林间，一片空地藏着查娃——生命之树——那劈裂的树干。落叶如镜毯铺展，梦雀啁啾着心灵颂歌。

src: Tugged from the claws of one who had become a cord in time's silly carpet. I outrooted the hilts and sheathed the blades, and now I am he. I still have the nail dirt.
zh: 从一个已成时光那张愚蠢地毯里一根线的人的爪中扯来。我把剑柄连根拔出，把剑刃收入鞘中，如今我即是他。指甲里的泥还在。

src: Tussocks of fur dress skin stretched over taut muscle. Upright =pronouns.subjective= =verb:stand:afterpronoun=, but =pronouns.subjective= =verb:look:afterpronoun= ready to drop onto fours. =pronouns.Possessive= snout snarls and =pronouns.possessive= ears twitch. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:bark:afterpronoun=, and =pronouns.possessive= hyena tribeskin answer.
zh: 一簇簇毛覆在绷紧于坚实肌肉之上的皮上。=pronouns.subjective=直立着，=pronouns.subjective=却仿佛随时会扑落四足。=pronouns.Possessive=口鼻龇张，=pronouns.possessive=双耳抽动。=pronouns.Subjective=吠叫一声，=pronouns.possessive=鬣狗同族便应声回吠。

src: Twigs from the witching tree are pared and twisted to a garland for hindsun.
zh: 巫木之枝，削光并拧成一圈花冠，供后日而戴。

src: Two =subject.pluralize= come into contact and both explode!
Two almonds of glass sit in wireframe cups and resharpen the world's edges.
zh: 两枚玻璃杏仁嵌在金属丝杯托中，重新磨利了世界的棱角。

src: Two copper bulbs form a spark gap that facilitates current along a path of ionized gas. The thing snaps and sparks at you.
zh: 两只铜球构成一处火花间隙，使电流沿一条电离气体之路通行。那东西朝你噼啪爆出火花。

src: Two spitting leaf-beaks prune each other's neck and chew the weedmatter into seedpack.
zh: 两只啐吐的叶喙互相修剪着对方的脖颈，将杂草嚼成种荚。

src: Two turrets of sun-conducting chrome cap cylinders of burning gas, which straddle a metal trellis of spades girding some sort of guild mark. A 6-helix of fume, signature of the star engine this flier is wrought through, twirls toward the sky.
zh: 两座吸收日光的铬质炮塔，盖在燃气圆筒之上，圆筒跨骑于一副黑桃纹的金属格架，格架环护着某种行会印记。一道六螺旋的烟气，是此飞行器所借星火引擎的印记，向天空盘旋而去。

src: Two-faced: This item grants an additional face slot.
zh: 双面：此物额外提供一个面部栏位。

src: Ubernostrum was extracted from its injector, thickened in the acrid air, and bottled for culinary use.
zh: 万能灵药自其注射器中抽出，在辛辣的空气中浓稠起来，装瓶备作烹调之用。

src:
Ugh, ever telepathy. No requirement exists that Consortium merchants be mind-speakers, as swollen with their numbers as we are. I cannot blame you for your surprise, mind, I am simply frustrated.

Over years, I shaped something akin to a voice-box, which you hear now. I "made do", as Rokhas might say. Now what may I "make do" for you?
zh:
唉，又是心灵感应。联盟的商贩并无必须通晓心语之规，我们族人已是心语者多得泛滥了。你面露惊讶，我并不怪你，只是我自己心中烦闷罢了。

多年以来，我练出了一副类似发声器的物事，你此刻听见的便是它。正如罗哈斯所言，我“凑合着用”。那么，我能为你“凑合”些什么呢？

src: Uh, I'll come back later with it.
Um, kendren, does the yempuris phi really exist? Is it really coming to get us?
zh: 呃，肯德伦，扬普里斯φ真的存在吗？它真的会来抓我们吗？

src:
Um... thank you.

Live and drink.
zh:
呃……谢谢你。

且生且饮。

src: Unburden yourself from the weight of your chrome guilt.
zh: 卸下铬之罪愆的重担吧。

src: Uncrafted jewels and metals buy and sell for the same cost, but my art's price tag is up to me.
zh: 未经雕琢的宝石与金属，买卖同价；而我的作品标价几何，全凭我意。

src: Under a tarnished metal frame hangs a sheet of black rubber cut into pliable curtain strips.
zh: 锈蚀的金属框下垂着一片黑橡胶，被裁成柔韧的帘条。

src: Under the Beetle Moon, folks settled here to gather goods of passage for Ape Saad Oboroqoru, and so Kyakukya was founded.
zh: 甲虫之月下，人们在此定居，为猿神萨德·奥博罗阔鲁采集过路之物，基亚库基亚遂得建立。
明白了。且生且饮，阿吉拉。

src: Undulant sods finger the air thirstfully and secrete a wax meant to protect themselves from the poison flares of their far-flung dwarf sun.
zh: 起伏的草皮渴望地向空中伸出指状之叶，并分泌出一种蜡，以防护自身，抵御其遥远矮星的毒焰。
无谬的,时新的,不锈的,神谕的,如男的,如女的,无损的,不变的,确然的

src: Unerringly identify artifacts up to complexity tier <stat Name="IdentifyComplexity" />.
zh: 必能辨识复杂度至<stat Name="IdentifyComplexity" />阶的古器。

src: Unfinished schematics are obviously not for sale. Everything else is.
zh: 未完成的图纸自然不卖。其余皆可出售。

src: Unlidded eyes stare out from a whirling school of opalescent scales.
zh: 无睑的眼自一群旋游的乳光鳞片中直直望出。

src: Unnamed to the beings of the surface world are the birthing atria of the subterrane, where ultramafic rock is wetted in amniotic fluid and birthed as a world-serpent.
zh: 地表世界的生灵从未为之命名——那是地下深处的诞育之室，超镁铁质的岩石在羊水中浸润，生出一条世界之蛇。

src: Unshafted from its lanterned machine temple orbiting a star some hundred thousand light years away, the great gear looms in stasis. Dust from a hundred neighbored planet-homes tip its fluted teeth, while its bore is slick with amaranth and incense oil cultured over the lifespan of a gardened civilization.
zh: 这具巨齿轮自远在数十万光年外、绕恒星运转的灯火机械神庙中脱轴而出，悬于静止之中，岿然耸立。百颗邻近星球家园的尘埃落在它槽纹深刻的齿尖，轴孔内则滑腻地浸着苋紫色的香油——那是一个园艺文明历经一世，培育而成。

src: Up North? En't far. See them baboons, you put one's light out for me.
zh: 往北？不远。见着那些狒狒，替我送一只上路。

src:
Upon their return
what power =name= wrested
they called on allies
to distribute and dissolve.

The Freeholders,
new hollowers,
the Quetzal Council,
and other such fools.

Countless years of struggle
centuries of change.
We remember what we can
and watch new and old die.
zh:
归来之时，
=name=夺得的权势，
他们召集盟友
去分散，去瓦解。

自由领民，
新的掏空者，
魁札尔议会，
以及诸如此类的愚者。

无数年岁的奋争，
数百年的更迭。
我们记下所能记的，
看着新与旧一同死去。

src:
Upon their return, =name= participated in the dissolution and federation of all power-concentrate. Allies of the new equalizer gathered and rose, forming the Quetzal Council and other, shorter-lived managing bodies.

Since then, we have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it.
zh:
归来之后，=name=参与了一切权力集中之物的解散与联合。新平衡者的盟友汇聚而起，组成了魁札尔议会及其他存续较短的管理机构。

自那时起，我们便在日渐缩小的大地之上与之下，维系着岌岌可危的和睦。

src: Upper Crypts: Priests and Royal Families
Upset guts were turned outward and exposed to rot in the stale air.
zh: 翻腾不安的肠子被翻了出来，曝于污浊的空气中任其腐烂。

src: Ur-metal strips on the soles are magnetized by bosonic coils, producing a continuous ribbon of negative-mass bubbles that repel the wearer upward.
zh: 鞋底的原金属条被玻色线圈磁化，生出连绵不断的负质量气泡之带，将穿者向上排斥。
海胆神,海胆村长,海胆长老

src: Urchins stick to the scum-slick tissue of a cavernous mouth while soft-rayed fins drag the mammoth fish body across the ground.
zh: 海胆附着在巨口那层滑腻的浮渣组织上，软鳍则拖曳着庞然的鱼身碾过地面。

src: Use =commandKey:LookDirection= to look at the bear.
Use =commandKey:LookDirection= to look at the snapjaw.
Use text autoact interrupt indicator instead of flashing red box
zh: 以文字提示而非闪烁红框表示自动行动中断

src: Use the tattoo gun I've given you when you recover the Mark of Death. You'll want to bring a pickaxe, too, or some other instrument for digging through stone. And beware: the Tomb is a vast and ancient space, and sacred to many. I cannot speak to what you will experience there.
zh: 寻回死亡印记时，使用我给你的那把刺青枪。你还须带上一把镐，或别的什么凿石之具。还要当心：这墓地广袤古老，于许多人而言乃是圣地。我无法断言你在那里会经历什么。

src: Use your gadgets hard, don't you? I can fix them.
zh: 器械使得挺狠，是吧？我能修。

src: Utensil? That is my avocation, yes. A million sun-dead homes I've roved, a trillion more await. I'm a worm in the loam of a cosmic wood, perched on a cosmic gulf, swathed in the god-manifold.
zh: 器具？那正是我的本业，是的。我走遍百万个日死之家，另有万亿个等着我去。我是宇宙之木沃土中的一条虫，栖于宇宙的深渊之上，裹在神之流形里。

src: VERILY, THERE IS A WEALTH OF WISDOM IN THE POETRY OF THIS FACT. ONE DAY, I SHALL BE EAGER TO UNCOVER IT.
zh: 诚然，这一事实之诗意中，蕴藏着丰富的智慧。终有一日，吾将热切地将其发掘。

src:
Va'am is released. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= done something great, for good or ill.

I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for this new future.
zh:
瓦阿姆已被释放。=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=做成了一件大事，无论福祸。

我为这崭新的未来谢过=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=。

src: Vacuum tubes slice through circuit topography like rivers on a fold belt.
zh: 真空管如褶皱带上的河流，切开电路的地貌。

src: Vacuum tubes slice through circuit topography like rivers on a fold belt. Cold gas heaves through and suffuses its brass and silicone acres in a cyan glow.
zh: 真空管如褶皱带上的河流，切开电路的地貌。冷气涌过，将其间黄铜与硅胶的万顷田畴，浸染成一片青光。
