src: Vacuum tubes slice through circuit topography like rivers on a fold belt. Hot gas heaves through and suffuses its brass and silicone acres in a red glow.
zh: 真空管如褶皱带上的河流，切开电路的地貌。热气涌过，将其间黄铜与硅胶的万顷田畴，浸染成一片红光。

src: Vacuum-safe foamwood beams with the lingering scents of myrrh, star porcelain, and snow-powdered peaches.
zh: 耐真空的泡沫木梁，留有没药、星瓷与雪粉桃子的缕缕余香。

src:
Vardy! Yes.

But. Gemtle? No kill.
zh:
瓦迪！是。

但是。温柔？不杀。

src: Vast diaphanous wings painted in the furcate patterns of fractalized geometry bat the air.
zh: 巨大透明的双翼绘着分形几何的分叉纹样，拍打着空气。

src: Velvet hairs warm the radial penta-cake, and a powdery dust hovers like atmosphere. Something gleams inside =pronouns.possessive= mouth.
zh: 绒软的细毛暖着那辐射状的五角饼体，一层粉状的尘土如大气般浮着。=pronouns.possessive=口中有什么东西在闪光。
毒液令对手陷入混乱，持续<stat Name="Duration" />
毒液使对手陷入混乱<stat Name="Duration" />。
毒液令对手麻痹，持续<stat Name="Duration" />

src: Venom poisons opponents for <stat Name="Duration" /> (damage increment <stat Name="PoisonDamage" />)
zh: 毒液令对手中毒，持续<stat Name="Duration" />（伤害增量<stat Name="PoisonDamage" />）

src: Verdurous cirri mottled with thorns reach for the warmth of a body. They hug the air in desperation.
zh: 青翠的卷须缀着荆棘，伸向身躯的温暖。它们绝望地抱拥空气。

src: Very well, I will go to Bey Lah as you ask.
zh: 好吧，我依你所请去贝拉。

src: Very well, Iseppa. Live and drink.
Village life has tilted the pig and worn the hair off =pronouns.possessive= ham ass. As well, =pronouns.possessive= forehooves splay in the signature of metal tool use.
zh: 乡村生活使这头猪歪斜佝偻，磨秃了=pronouns.possessive=火腿般的臀部。此外，=pronouns.possessive=的前蹄叉开，那是使用金属工具留下的印记。

src: Visit the Mopango Settlement in the Tomb of the Eaters
zh: 拜访食者之墓中的莫潘戈聚落

src:
Visual Instrument and Sensory Augmentation (G Edition)

Data is painted back and forth between the glass lunes of visor and wristlet. Whereas the outer trim shines gold on F Edition, on this model it fades to grey.
zh:
视觉仪器与感官增强装置（G版）

数据在面甲与腕环的玻璃月牙之间来回涂抹。F版的外缘饰边闪着金光，此型号上则褪为灰色。

src: Volcanic dust pupated in its deep-earth cocoon and cracked free as grey stone. Sophists theorize it's the color of pure aether.
zh: 火山尘在深地的茧中化蛹，破茧而出，成了灰色的石头。诡辩家们推测，这正是纯粹以太的颜色。

src: Volcanic glass was fished from Fuming God Sea and chipped to shape along the Icepyres.
zh: 火山玻璃自烟神之海中打捞而出，在冰焰山脉沿途凿琢成形。
你、你、你、你是什、什么……你是……

src: WE CANNOT KNOW THE PARTICULARS. YET THE PLURALITY REASONETH THAT SOME GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS, SOME THOUGHT-MATTER OF THE CIVILIZATION BELOW, DID SPIN IN COUNTEREDICT TO THE DICTATES OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA, AND THUS WERE THE ECLIPTICS SHIFTED, AND WE CAST OUT.
zh: 其详情吾等无从知晓。然众论推断，下界文明之中，必有某道益智之流、某种思想之质，逆着机慧之律令回旋，黄道由是偏移，我等遂遭放逐。

src:
WHERE DO SOVEREIGNTY AND RIGHTNESS INTERSECT IN THY MANIFOLD?

MOREOVER, I WAS ARCHON HERE LONG ERE THOU.
zh:
在汝的流形里，主权与正当相交于何处？

再者，早在汝之前许久，吾便已是此地的执政官。

src: WILL THOU REMAIN AT THE SHEVA WITH ME, AND LEND THY HAND TO STEER THE COURSE OF THE WORLD FROM THIS LOFTY PERCH.
zh: 你可愿与我同留舍瓦，伸手襄助，自这崇高之巅，掌舵世界之航向？

src: Waist deep in a lake of =^:materials.!random=
Wait for keypress when drawing pathfinding
Wait for the bear to take a step towards you.
Wait! My name is =name=. I bring a message from Argyve of Joppa.
zh: 且慢！我名叫=name=。我带来约帕的阿尔吉夫的口信。

src: Wait! My name is =name=. I've come into possession of a data disk stamped with a peculiar sigil. Does this have meaning to your order of tinkers? Might you examine it?
zh: 且慢！我名叫=name=。我得到一张印有奇特徽记的数据盘。这对你们修补匠的教团可有意义？可否请你们一验？

src: Wait! My name is =name=. The people of =villageZeroName= recently came into possession of a data disk, onto which a strange signal was recorded. At their behest I carry the disk with me. They say your tutelage is to be my reward.
zh: 且慢！我名叫=name=。=villageZeroName=的人们近日得了一张数据盘，其上录有一段奇异的信号。应他们所托，我随身携带此盘。他们说，你们的教诲将是我的酬报。

src: Wait, why... why is Esk here? What's going on? Do you have Kindrish?
zh: 等等，为什么……埃斯克为什么在这儿？出什么事了？你拿到金德里什了吗？

src: Wait. I have more questions to ask.
zh: 等等。我还有别的问题要问。

src: Walk a few parasangs in my shoes, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and you'll wonder how you ever did otherwise.
zh: 穿上我的鞋走几帕兰桑吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=，你会奇怪自己先前怎能忍受别的。

src: Wanderer and =player.formalAddressTerm=! Have you journeyed yet to the Stilt, and seen the Sacred Well?
zh: 旅人，=player.formalAddressTerm=！你可曾启程前往高塔，见过圣井？

src: Wanderer! Do you venture northwise? Into the Great Desert and nearer the Six Day Stilt?
zh: 旅人！你要往北去吗？去大沙漠，离六日高塔更近些？

src: Wanderer, thank you! I will tell my kin of these places. We will convene and discuss, and we will, ah, choose. Please be patient in the meantime.
zh: 旅人，多谢你！我会把这些地方告诉族人。我们会聚在一处商议，然后，呃，作出选择。在此期间，还请耐心等候。

src: Warden Indrix is one of the most ferocious warriors I've ever met. Once upon a time, he and his brothers gorged themselves on the flesh of beasts by starlight, but now I count myself lucky to call him my warden. Some believe he is of sour kind, though I assure you, he's but a victim of his goatish nature.
zh: 守望者因德里克斯是我见过最凶猛的战士之一。从前，他与兄弟们曾在星光下饱食兽肉，而今我自认有幸，能称他为我的守望者。有人说他性情乖戾，我向你保证，他不过是其山羊天性的受害者罢了。

src:
Warden Neelahind attends to her duties admirably. She is not terribly assertive, but she need not be.

I'm surprised she's going along with this outsider-led investigation, but she always had a soft spot for the exile.
zh:
守望者尼拉欣德尽职令人钦佩。她不甚强势，但也不必强势。

她竟肯随这外人主导的调查行事，我颇感意外，不过她对那流放者向来心软。
守望者，我找到金德里什了。

src: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the bright stone oven, and with it comes the smell of hot spine fruit jam and roasted tail.
zh: 明亮石炉中的火噼啪作响，暖意向外辐散，随之而来的是热刺果酱与烘烤尾肉的香气。

src: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the dark electric oven, and with it comes the smell of bitter yuckwheat and boiled plasma.
zh: 暗色电炉中的火噼啪作响，暖意向外辐散，随之而来的是苦麦与沸腾等离子体的气味。

src: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the round bone oven, and with it comes the smell of leavened pastry, sweet bananas, and warm skulk.
zh: 圆骨炉中的火噼啪作响，暖意向外辐散，随之而来的是发酵糕点、甜香蕉与温热潜行者的气味。

src: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the round clay oven, and with it comes the smell of fermented tongue and congealed love.
zh: 圆黏土炉中的火噼啪作响，暖意向外辐散，随之而来的是发酵舌肉与凝结之爱的气味。

src: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the round clay oven, and with it comes the smell of steamed goat and sweet bananas.
zh: 圆黏土炉中的火噼啪作响，暖意向外辐散，随之而来的是清蒸山羊肉与甜香蕉的香气。

src: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the round crystalline oven, and with it comes the smell of cooling static. Curiously, there are no prepared meal ingredients here.
zh: 圆形晶体炉中的火噼啪作响，暖意向外辐散，随之而来的是静电冷却的气味。奇怪的是，这里并无备好的餐食食材。

src: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the round mud oven, and with it comes the smell of mulled cider and brined mushrooms.
zh: 圆泥炉中的火噼啪作响，暖意向外辐散，随之而来的是温煮苹果酒与盐渍蘑菇的香气。

src: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the thick clay oven, and with it comes the smell of hot starapple jam and toasted matz.
zh: 厚黏土炉中的火噼啪作响，暖意向外辐散，随之而来的是热星苹果酱与烤马茨的香气。

src: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the thick clay oven, and with it comes the smell of lah broth and steamed matz.
zh: 厚黏土炉中的火噼啪作响，暖意向外辐散，随之而来的是拉花高汤与清蒸马茨的香气。

src: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the thick clay oven, and with it comes the smell of scrumptious food.
zh: 厚黏土炉中的火噼啪作响，暖意向外辐散，随之而来的是美味食物的香气。

src: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the thick clay oven, and with it comes the smell of scrumptious food. Its high awning is painted with the honeys and jams of the new season.
zh: 厚重的陶炉中，炉火噼啪作响，暖意四散，随之而来的是美味佳肴的香气。其高高的遮檐上，绘着新季的蜂蜜与果酱。

src: Warted fruits are set as islands in an ocean of brine and jarred in a world glass. They rot at salt's pace now.
zh: 疣结的果实如岛屿般陈列在一片盐水的海洋里，装进一只世界玻璃罐中。如今它们随盐的节奏腐熟。

src: Warty skin and crooked bone were stretched out by an improbable row of centuries. The frog is now a looming, spine-skewed being. But =pronouns.possessive= visage peels into an affable grin and dissolves the menace of =pronouns.possessive= frame. A gigantic tongue flops out =pronouns.possessive= mouth now and again to bat something off =pronouns.possessive= steppeland back or muss the ground behind you.
zh: 生疣的皮肤与歪斜的骨骸，被一排不可思议的世纪拉伸开来。这蛙如今是个耸立而脊椎歪斜的生灵。然而=pronouns.possessive=面容却舒开成一副和善的笑，把=pronouns.possessive=身形的威吓尽数化去。一条巨舌时不时从=pronouns.possessive=嘴里甩出，拨掉=pronouns.possessive=草原般宽阔的背上的某样东西，或搅乱你身后的地面。

src: Wasn't Rebekah a healer? Why are you an order of tinkers?
zh: 利百加不是医者吗？你们为何是一个修补匠修会？

src: Water Barons don't adorn themselves with water, after all.
zh: 毕竟，水权贵族可不会拿水来装点自己。

src: Water and gas piped through the Yd to feed the plants, dwellers, and machines! Dwellers blew the glass in hues like the prism perch, to look pretty. Shared together. Joyful helping!
zh: 水与气通过管子输往伊德各处，供养植物、居民与机器！居民把玻璃吹成棱镜鲈一般的色泽，好看。同享共有。快乐地相助！

src: Water ribbons climb bone-blanched marble columns in high relief. They mount the archivolt and snake between helical rings before a sharp turn upward on the keystone. Here becomes there.
zh: 水之缎带沿着白骨般漂白的大理石柱高浮雕而上，攀过拱缘，蜿蜒穿行于螺旋环之间，至拱心石处陡然上折。此处化为彼处。

src: Water ribbons in high relief crumble off the broken marble. Pieces of the arch that once enclosed the forward motion of travelers now lie on smooth backs somewhere else.
zh: 高浮雕的水之缎带自残破的大理石上剥落。那曾环拢旅人前行之势的拱券碎片，如今平躺于别处光滑的背面。

src: Water-wealth means nothing if you cannot carry it. Need jewels?
zh: 水财若携不动，便是空谈。要珠宝吗？

src: Watervine canvas is stretched and folded over wood legs.
zh: 水藤帆布绷展并折覆于木腿之上。

src: Watervine coming in good, see? Fat wafers.
zh: 水藤长得好哩，瞧见没？肥厚的薄片。

src: Watervine farm in the lap of the marsh. You've sucked the moisture out a vinewafer, yea? We tend the plant here.
zh: 沼泽怀里的水藤农场。你吸过藤饼里的水分吧？我们就在这儿种那植物。

src: Wavecrests of slag interrupt the plane geometry of the gigantic seat, scars of index to the moment when the mystai rolled the ruby boulder it was carved from out of the hoggish earth. The splats and claw feet are burned and disarranged; the ritual of transformation never ends.
zh: 熔渣的浪脊截断了巨座平整的几何，是当年入会者将雕出此座的红宝石巨岩从贪婪如猪的土地中滚出时留下的索引之痕。靠背与爪足皆已焚毁错乱；蜕变之仪永无终时。
波函数坍缩地图生成器

src: Wax from the hives of Odrum is mixed in dye and moulded to the shape of styli. Together in the box they sample the iridescence of the world and offer the tools to expand it.
zh: 奥德鲁姆蜂巢所产之蜡，调入染料，塑成笔杆之形。盒中诸笔合而取样世间的虹彩，并赐予人拓展它的工具。

src: Wax weeps from the stubborn candles, drips onto the sconces, forms a waxfall through the tiers of bronze.
zh: 蜡自倔强的蜡烛中垂泪，滴在灯座上，沿青铜的层层枝节汇成一道蜡之瀑。

src: Waxen sprigs sag to the weight of the algebraic tubers. Each one is perfect and regular, its faces matte with sheenless platonic dew.
zh: 蜡质嫩枝在代数块茎的重压下弯垂。每一枚都完美规整，表面哑光，覆着无光的柏拉图露珠。

src:
We allied on the notion that the sultanate must be abolished for the future to flower. I was to execute the earthly plan, while Resheph continued preparations at the astronomical tier. To achieve a sort of bicameralism of action, Resheph insisted on reformatting their personality as a triumvirate, seeded from thin scans of the original archon, Rebekah, and myself.

The art of mythmaking was employed to enshrine the Resheph persona. Thus- the healer, the Coiled Lamb, and perhaps unexpectedly, the Above.
zh:
我们结盟，所凭的是这一信念：苏丹国必须废除，未来方能绽放。我负责执行尘世的计划，利悉则继续在天文层面筹备。为达成某种行动上的两院制，利悉坚持将自身人格重新格式化为三位一体，其种子取自原初执政、利百加与我的淡薄扫描。

又借神话之术，将利悉这一形象供奉起来。于是便有了——医者、盘绕的羔羊，以及也许出人意料的，至上者。

src:
We are adrift now. I will seek signs of her, or whatever she becomes. What do you care?

Do not answer.
zh:
我们如今漂泊无依了。我会寻觅她的踪迹，或她所化成的任何形态。这与你何干？

不必回答。

src: We are called slynth, a people grown one by one from a hydroponic cradle containing a cutting of water lily and empowered by sunslag. We are but a handful of generations old, and kept no written history until I was grown, ah, some number of decades ago.
zh: 我们名为斯林斯，乃是由一方水培摇篮中的一截睡莲插枝，借日渣之力，一个接一个生长而成的族类。我们不过传了寥寥数代，在我长成之前，并无任何文字史册，那是，呃，数十年前的事了。

src:
We are called the Urshiib, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

Our kind are smarter than the average bear. Sharper, too, and a bit more handy.
zh:
我们被称作乌尔希卜，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

我族比一般的熊更聪明。也更锋利，还更趁手些。

src: We are forever in their debt.

We are mopango: witnesses of the past and shepherds of the future. The Sacred Light of the Kasaphescence shineth within us, and we commune with relics of antiquity to maintain our humility and grow our wisdom.

We believe that one day, with enough knowledge, anyone who seeketh the Light shalt find it within emself. In the meantime, we work to become better and brighter as each one of us findeth a personal credo by which to live.
zh:
我们是莫潘戈：过去的见证者，未来的牧者。圣化现的神圣之光在我们心中闪耀，我们与古代遗宝交感，以保持谦卑、增长智慧。

我们相信，终有一日，凭借足够的知识，凡寻求光者皆能在自身之内找到它。在此之前，我们每个人都寻得一条个人信条以度此生，努力使自己更善、更明。

src: We are on the tips of our hooves, =name=! Any word about the slynth?
zh: 我们都踮着蹄子等着呢，=name=！斯林斯人有消息吗？

src: We are wanting in our service to our Fathers.
zh: 我们侍奉银辉诸父不够尽心。

src: We await the decision of the glowfolk. Our imaginations run with the possibilities.
zh: 我们在等辉光之族的决断。我们的想象正随着种种可能奔涌。

src: We chose our new home well.

We don't need this dagger any more, so we can trade it away.

Press =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd=
zh:
这把匕首我们已经用不着了，可以拿它去换。

按=commandKey:CmdTradeAdd=

src:
We don't need this dagger any more, so we can trade it away.

Press =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=
zh:
这把匕首我们已经用不着了，可以拿它去换。

按=commandKey:CmdTradeAdd=或=commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=

src: We find no precedent for this, yet is there space upon our crystal arms and an openness within us. It is agreed: if these slynth will be of us, we will have them here.
zh: 此事于我们无先例可循，然我们的晶臂之上尚有余地，我们心中亦存敞开之处。就此议定：若这些斯林斯人愿成为我们的一员，我们便在此接纳他们。

src: We have not come so far from the founding of =village.name= to allow these strangers in. What if they worship =village.profane=? No, we simply cannot do such a great favor for you.
zh: =village.name=立村之初的规矩，我们至今未曾背离，岂能让这些陌生人随意进来。万一他们崇拜=village.profane=呢？不，这样大的人情，我们实在给不了你。

src: We miss you, bright kin. Wherever stories are told, we will know you are there with bells on.
zh: 我们想念你，聪慧的族人。凡有故事讲起之处，我们都知你佩着铃在那儿。

src: We mopango watch the past, each of us a different facet. My charge is named Nacham, that which watcheth and understandeth not, that which speaketh and cannot be understood. Information floweth through Nacham as water through a sieve, mixed together beyond ken.
zh: 我们莫潘戈守望过去，每人各守一面。我所看护的名叫纳罕，它守望而不解，言说而不可解。信息流经纳罕，如水过筛网，混作一团，不可辨识。

src: We share the bright and now, traveler =name=.
zh: 我们共享此刻的明亮与当下，旅人=name=。

src:
We were... yes. We were close.

I can scarcely believe that she would be capable of doing such a thing. Stealing our greatest treasure? Eskhind wouldn't possibly... but if Grand-Doe says it, it must be so.
zh:
我们曾……是的。我们很亲近。

我实在难以相信她竟会做出这种事。偷走我们最大的宝物？埃斯金德不可能……但若大母鹿这么说，那一定是真的。

src: We will investigate and find the truth.
We will miss you too, Aloysius. Live and drink.
zh: 我们也会想念你的，阿洛伊修斯。且生且饮。

src: We'd all be dead without bees, you know.
zh: 你要知道，没有蜜蜂，咱们都得死。

src:
We're a vibrant community here. A circle of monks mapping the outer lattices and raising viaducts where we need to.

We remain secluded to protect ourselves. Otho and Barathrum insist on it. They are wise, and I defer to them. My collaboration with Sheba Hag does cause them worry, but they tolerate it, bless their hearts.
zh:
我们这儿是个生气勃勃的共同体。一圈僧侣测绘外层格网，需要之处便架起高架桥。

我们深居简出以自保，奥索与巴拉斯鲁姆坚持如此。他们睿智，我也听从。我与舍芭·哈格的合作确让他们担忧，但他们容忍了，真是好心肠。

src: We're not quite ready to leave yet.
zh: 我们还没准备好离开呢。

src: We're not safe yet. I can feel it.
zh: 我们还不安全。我能感觉到。

src: We're on the surface now. We can walk the whole world this way, or we can access the worldmap to fast travel.
zh: 我们已在地表了。可以这样一路走过整个世界，也可以打开世界地图快速旅行。

src:
We're watered by the river spray -- we pluck the fruit of the wood, and we hunt. The worshippers of Oboroqoru whittle and brood, too. They will pay you no mind unless you ask of them. Here you can be with friends, or muse alone. 

If it's trade goods that interest you, take a gander at Yurl's wares in the northwest corner. The odd one Crowsong's, too, if you can scry them in the bush.

I must warn you, however; cast no villain's shadow on these grounds. Warden Indrix will be watching.
zh:
我们靠河雾滋养——采林中之果，也狩猎。奥博罗阔鲁的信徒也削木、沉思。你若不问，他们不会理睬你。在这里你可与友人相伴，也可独自沉思。

你若对货物感兴趣，不妨去西北角瞧瞧尤尔的摊子。要是能在灌木丛里找到鸦歌，祂那儿偶尔也有些怪东西。

不过我得提醒你：莫在此地投下恶人的阴影。守望者因德里克斯会盯着。

我们——

我们成功了，=name=。我——

src: Wearer may take any action while sprinting at no additional penalty.
zh: 穿戴者疾奔时，可采取任何行动，而无额外惩罚。

src: Weeks old salt crystals huddle in the stem's elbowed forks.
zh: 数周之久的盐晶蜷在茎的肘状分叉里。

src: Weeks old salt crystals line the fluted valleys of a wet stalk.
zh: 数周之久的盐晶沿着一根湿茎的沟谷排列。

src: Weight of the weary years has sagged the tympana of the frogfolk and binded them to the leaf-wet earth.
zh: 倦怠岁月之重，已使蛙族的鼓膜松垂，将他们束缚于湿叶之地。

src: Welcome a-Joppa, friend. Stay peacelike, and we stay friends, hyeh? You make trouble, it's my work a-split you open like a croc.
zh: 欢迎来到约帕，朋友。你安分守己，咱们就是朋友，嗯？你要闹事，我的活儿就是像剖鳄鱼一样把你剖开。

src: Welcome back to Bey Lah, =name=. Stay as long as you like.
zh: 欢迎回到贝拉，=name=。想住多久都行。

src:
Welcome back, Detective =name=.

Everything's in order here, more or less.
zh:
欢迎回来，=name=侦探。

这里一切井然，大致如此。

src: Welcome to Grit Gate, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Care to enhance the quality of your stay with a wise purchase?
zh: 欢迎来到砂砾门，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。要不要买点好东西，为你的下榻增添几分品质？

src:
Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.

I am pleased to see that you've returned with the waydroid, though you still know little of the dangers you bear. Take this firearm as your reward. It bears the mark of our finest gunsmith, Sparafucile.

Return when you are ready to discuss the signal.
zh:
欢迎来到砂砾门。我是奥索，巴拉斯鲁姆的管事。我为我们这样的见面方式致歉，但我们不得不有所防备。卡德是个不留情面的地方。

见你带着路径机器人归来，我很欣慰，尽管你对自己所冒的凶险仍知之甚少。收下这把火器作为奖赏。它带有我们最出色的枪匠斯帕拉富奇莱的印记。

待你准备好商议信号之事，再来见我。

src:
Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.

You are worthy to study with us. Take these.

Return when you are ready to discuss the signal.
zh:
欢迎来到砂砾门。我是奥索，巴拉斯鲁姆的管事。我为我们这样的见面方式致歉，但我们不得不有所防备。卡德是个不留情面的地方。

你有资格与我们一同研习。收下这些。

待你准备好商议信号之事，再来见我。

src:
Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.

You demonstrate tremendous promise to have returned from Golgotha with such inexperience. Take this firearm as your reward. It bears the mark of our finest gunsmith, Sparafucile. Take this bracelet, as well.

Return when you are ready to discuss the signal.
zh:
欢迎来到砂砾门。我是奥索，巴拉斯鲁姆的管事。我为我们这样的见面方式致歉，但我们不得不有所防备。卡德是个不留情面的地方。

你竟能这般毫无经验地从各各他归来，足见前途无量。收下这把火器作为奖赏。它带有我们最出色的枪匠斯帕拉富奇莱的印记。这只手镯，也请收下。

待你准备好商议信号之事，再来见我。

src: Welcome to Omonporch, traveler. Enjoy your visit to my earldom. Feast your eyes upon my tall and glorious Spindle. Take in the scent of roasted musa.
zh: 欢迎来到奥蒙门廊，旅人。尽情游览我的伯爵领地吧。请一饱眼福，看我那高耸辉煌的纺锤。再闻一闻烤穆萨蕉的香气。

src:
Welcome to the Caves of Qud tutorial. We'll just be scratching the surface here, learning enough of the basics to help you get your footing.

In Caves of Qud, you play as a mutated human or true kin.

For the tutorial, we're picking mutated human.
zh:
欢迎来到《卡德洞窟》教程。我们在此只浅尝辄止，学会足够的基础知识，帮你站稳脚跟。

在《卡德洞窟》中，你扮演变异人或真族。

本次教程中，我们选择变异人。

src: Welcome, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Live and drink. =ifplayerplural:Need ye:Needest thou= a place to rest and sup? =ifplayerplural:Would ye:Wouldst= trade?
zh: 欢迎，=factionaddress:Mopango=。且生且饮。=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=需要歇脚用饭之处否？=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=愿交易否？

src: Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=, to the sole bastion of class in this wretched place.
zh: 欢迎，=player.formalAddressTerm=，来到这凄惨之地唯一的体面堡垒。

src: Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=. How may I serve you today?
zh: 欢迎，=player.formalAddressTerm=。今日有何可效劳的？

src:
Welcome, Aristocrat, to a cybernetics learning nook. You are one
step closer to the Grand Unification. Ask a question.
[[A.]] What are cybernetic implants?
[[B.]] What are the benefits of cybernetics?
[[C.]] What are the risks of cybernetics?
[[D.]] How do I install a cybernetic implant?
[[E.]] Goodbye.
zh:
欢迎，贵族，来到义体学习龛。你离大统一又近了一步。请提问。
[[A.]] 什么是义体植入物？
[[B.]] 义体有什么益处？
[[C.]] 义体有何风险？
[[D.]] 如何安装义体植入物？
[[E.]] 再会。

src: Welcome, children! Welcome to the Cathedral of Shekhinah, Our Argent Father!
zh: 欢迎，孩子们！欢迎来到舍金纳大教堂，我们的银父之家！

src: Welded bands of aging dusk shield the legs but weigh their wearer to the earth like ore.
zh: 焊接的条带，色如老去的暮色，护住双腿，却如矿石般将穿者坠向大地。

src:
Well enough. We drink the sun's rays, eat what we scavenge, rest under the shell, and it is. Enough.

I read and tinker. Some hunt. Others tend the cradle. Each day is like the next. Every so often, someone leaves.

We, ah, rarely hear from them thereafter. I hope they are all well.
zh:
尚可。我们饮日光，食拾来之物，在壳下歇息，如此而已。够了。

我读书，也摆弄些机巧。有人去打猎。有人照看摇篮。日复一日，如出一辙。偶尔，有人离去。

此后，呃，我们很少再听到他们的音讯。我盼他们都平安。

src: Well met, =name=. Please forgive the, ah, austerity of our cradle. You may sup with us at our meager camp and rest under the shade of this Palladium shell. Sorry, as well, about the crowding.
zh: 幸会，=name=。我们这摇篮简陋，还请见谅，呃。你可在我们这寒素的营地与我们同食，也可在这钯壳的荫下歇息。拥挤之处，亦请海涵。

src: Well, I should get going. Live and drink.
Well, I should go. Live and drink.

Well, good. I would give you a prize for your insight, but times have been lean.

As you say, the Hindriarch is obviously framing me. As a pariah, I am an ideal patsy for Keh. Much as I love my people, they are weak of will and do not question the Grand-Doe.
zh:
好，很好。我本想为你的洞察力给你个奖赏，可惜近来拮据。

正如你所说，族长分明是在陷害我。我是弃民，正是凯最合适的替罪羊。我虽爱我的族人，可他们意志软弱，不敢质疑大母鹿。

src: Well, you can repay the debt now. Barathrum wants you to build something. A climber. He says only you can do it.
zh: 那你现在就可还债。巴拉斯鲁姆要你造一样东西。一部攀升之物。他说唯有你能造。

src:
Well, your conscience, surely.

You wouldn't be so unethical as to manipulate the resolution of a crime to your own ends. W-would you?
zh:
嗯，自然是你的良心。

你总不至于那么不讲道德，为一己之私去操纵案件的结局吧。你、你不会吧？
体态匀称的,美丽的,秀丽的,静止的,诡异的,栩栩如生的

src:
Well. Nothing... is like Chavvah. Nothing at all.

I once thought ... my haustorium carried only lifestuff. Now I am unsure. Am I of Twofirm, now?

It's fine.

Let's... change subjects.
zh:
嗯。没有……什么能比得上查娃。没有任何东西。

我曾以为……我的吸器只输送生命之质。如今我不确定了。我如今是否属于双坚？

没事。

我们……换个话题吧。

src: Well. They en't ended you yet.
zh: 嗯。他们还没把你了结呢。

src:
Well... the light of the Kasaphescence yet glimmers through your rasping edge.

I must, then, thank you.
zh:
那么……纵然你的言辞尖刻，圣化现依然透过那锋芒闪烁。

我还是要谢谢你。

src: Were they in use when you found them?
zh: 你找到它们时，它们还在使用吗？
你受到回旋之梦的影响了吗？

src: Wet clay dresses the edge and dirt cakes the hilt.
zh: 湿黏土敷满刃口，泥垢结块于柄上。

src: Wet clay sticks to a wheel and soldering board. It's flowered with diodes, circuits, vane pumps, and magnets.
zh: 湿黏土粘附在转盘与焊接板上，其间开满了二极管、电路、叶片泵与磁铁之花。

src: Wet frog skin is pressed to the ground.
zh: 湿冷的蛙皮紧贴在地上。

src: Wet nostrils flare at the seat of =pronouns.possessive= dropped snout, and furry arms wave in unpredicted motions. =pronouns.Possessive= eyes are full of stony mischief.
zh: 湿润的鼻孔在=pronouns.possessive=下垂口鼻的基部翕张，毛茸茸的双臂以难测的节奏挥舞。=pronouns.Possessive=眼中满是冷石般的顽劣。

src: Wet rings of shuddering muscle shrink and spew body broth in peristaltic waves.
zh: 湿漉的肌肉环颤动着收缩，以蠕动的波浪喷出体液之汤。

src: Wet scales lay in flat tessellation.
zh: 湿润的鳞片平平铺叠，如镶嵌之砖。

src: Wet scood trails from =pronouns.possessive= snouts in wishbone shape, pooling on the floor. =pronouns.Subjective= retches hair knots in alternating harmonies, and =pronouns.subjective= stomps split-hooved feet in irritation.
zh: 湿漉的尸浆自=pronouns.possessive=口鼻间拖出叉骨之形，积在地面。=pronouns.Subjective=以交错的声部呕出毛结，=pronouns.subjective=又烦躁地跺着偶蹄。

src: Wet skin scintillates behind =pronouns.possessive= ears. =pronouns.Possessive= spine cambers in anticipation of its blood-fated curvature, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:poke:afterpronoun= out =pronouns.possessive= chin in emulation of =pronouns.possessive= elders. Sword grease stains =pronouns.possessive= hands.
zh: 湿亮的皮在=pronouns.possessive=耳后闪动。=pronouns.Possessive=脊背向前弓起，仿佛预知其血脉注定的弯弧，=pronouns.subjective=又学着=pronouns.possessive=长辈的样子挺出=pronouns.possessive=下巴。剑油污了=pronouns.possessive=双手。

src: Wet skin scintillates behind =pronouns.possessive= ears. =pronouns.Possessive= spine cambers in anticipation of its blood-fated curvature, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:poke:afterpronoun= out =pronouns.possessive= chin in emulation of =pronouns.possessive= elders. Wood polish stains =pronouns.possessive= hands, which =pronouns.subjective= =verb:struggle:afterpronoun= to keep dead still.
zh: 湿润的皮肤在=pronouns.possessive=耳后闪烁。=pronouns.Possessive=脊柱预先弯出其血脉注定的弧度，=pronouns.subjective=把=pronouns.possessive=下巴探出，学着=pronouns.possessive=长辈的模样。木器抛光剂在=pronouns.possessive=手上留下污迹，那双手=pronouns.subjective=正挣扎着保持一动不动。

src:
Wh-

My heart's sheen wanes to hear this of you. You abrade me, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I am scuffed.

What of my trinket, then? Did you cast it into the... "hole in the ground?"
zh:
什——

听你这么说，我心中光彩渐黯。你磨损了我，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我已伤痕斑驳。

那么，我的小玩意呢？你把它投进……“地上的窟窿”了吗？

src: Wh-what will Tau b-be after soft? You, did, did you mean... wh-what c-could you say? Tau spins within, the g-gyre spins without.
zh: 陶在软、软境之后会、会成什么？你、你可是想说……你、你能说什么？陶在内里旋转，回、回旋在外旋转。

src:
Wh-what's going on? Esk is here, a-and Grand-Doe seems very upset.

Would you please speak to her, kendren?
zh:
出、出什么事了？埃斯克在这儿，还、还有大母鹿看起来很不高兴。

你能去和她谈谈吗，肯德伦？

src: What 'interstate power'? Who are the 'Codex people'?
zh: 什么“州际权力”？谁是“法典之民”？

src: What I stole? I stole supplies to sustain myself and my sisters, nothing more, and little enough that no one would suffer for its absence. You would cut those from my hide?
zh: 我偷的？我偷的只是养活自己和姐妹的补给，仅此而已，少到谁也不会因其缺失而受苦。难道你要从我身上剥下这些来？

src: What a grand bazaar! What's in each of these tents?
zh: 好大的集市！这些帐篷里各卖些什么？

src: What a savory smell! Teach me to cook the favorite dish of =villageName=.
zh: 好香的味道！教我做=villageName=最拿手的菜吧。

src: What a savory smell! Teach me to cook the favorite dish of the Stilt pilgrims.
zh: 多么香的气味！教我烹一道高塔朝圣者最爱的菜吧。

src: What a strange fate, to pass from new sentience to outcast with no steps in between. Regardless, if it is their will and you vouch for them, that is enough for me. Tell the slynth that should they choose to wander, the wind will blow at their backs.
zh: 从新生灵智，直落到流离失所，中间竟无半步缓冲，这是何等奇异的命运。不过，既是他们的意愿，又有你为他们作保，我便足矣。告诉斯林斯，若他们选择漂泊，风将从背后相送。

src: What are you suggesting I do?
What are you working on, Iseppa?
What are you? What's your story?
What can I do for you? Need slime?
zh: 有什么能为你效劳？要黏液吗？

src: What can you tell me about Eskhind?
zh: 关于埃斯金德，你能告诉我什么？

src: What can you tell me about Grit Gate?
zh: 关于砂砾门，你能告诉我什么？

src: What can you tell me about Hindriarch Keh?
zh: 关于族长凯，你能告诉我什么？

src: What can you tell me about Kesehind?
zh: 关于凯塞因德，你能告诉我什么？

src: What can you tell me about Kyakukya?
zh: 关于基亚库基亚，你能告诉我什么？

src: What can you tell me about Yd?
zh: 关于伊德，你能告诉我什么？

src: What can you tell me about the Freehold?
zh: 关于自由领，你能告诉我什么？

src: What can you tell me about the Six Day Stilt?
zh: 你能告诉我一些六日高塔的事吗？

src: What can you tell me about the other Barathrumites?
zh: 其他的巴拉斯鲁姆派众人，你能给我讲讲吗？

src: What can you tell me of k-Goninon?
zh: 关于克-戈尼农，你能告诉我什么？

src: What color do you want to draw with?
What do you do around here, Neek?
zh: 你在这儿都做些什么，尼克？

src: What do you expect me to do, then?

What do you imagine I am saying? The aging, ineffectual leader of a village in isolation. A system that strives to forget anyone who sees the outside, no matter how much its inhabitants strive for a better tomorrow.

Bey Lah's isolationism provides ideal patsies for any crime the Hindriarch chooses to commit.
zh:
你以为我是什么意思？一个与世隔绝的村子里，年迈而无能的首领。一套竭力遗忘一切见过外界之人的制度，无论其居民多么渴盼更好的明天。

贝拉的闭关自守，为族长想犯的任何罪行都备好了现成的替罪羊。

src: What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?
zh: 关于奥蒙门廊和那位自封的伯爵，你知道些什么？

src: What do you know about Pax Klanq?
zh: 关于帕克斯·克朗克，你知道些什么？

src: What do you know about the Earl of Omonporch?
zh: 关于奥蒙门廊的伯爵，你知道些什么？

src: What do you know about the Tomb?
What do you know about the outsiders? The kendren?
zh: 你对外来者肯德伦人知道些什么？

src: What do you know of the Gyre?
What do you think about everything going on?
zh: 对眼下发生的一切，你怎么看？

src: What do you think of Klanq's presence?
zh: 你对克朗克在此驻留，作何看法？

src: What do you think of Klanq's visit?
zh: 你对克朗克来访一事，有何看法？

src: What do you think of the Freehold?
What do you think of the Yd Freehold?
zh: 你觉得伊德自由领如何？

src: What do you think of the plant you share this building with?
zh: 你对与你同住一栋楼的那株植物有何看法？

src: What do you think of the situation?
zh: 你对眼下的局势怎么看？

src: What do you want to draw?
What evidence should I be looking for?
What have we here? Approach, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and be known.
zh: 这是谁来了？上前来，=player.formalAddressTerm=，报上名来。

src: What if I accuse the wrong person?
What if I find implicating evidence for multiple suspects?
zh: 若我找到的指证性证据指向多名嫌疑人呢？

src: What if evidence indicates multiple culprits?
zh: 若证据指向多名元凶，该怎么办？

src: What if it's damaged or destroyed?
zh: 若它受损或被毁怎么办？

src: What indignity have you come to heap upon the mound, whelp? Out with it.
zh: 你又来给这土丘添什么羞辱了，小崽子？说出来。

src: What is it? Where does the signal come from, and what does it say?
zh: 是什么？信号来自何处，又说了什么？

src: What is the Limen? The Knights Liminal?
zh: 阈限是什么？阈限骑士又是什么？

src: What is the Six Day Stilt again?
zh: 六日高塔究竟是什么地方？

src: What is the Six Day Stilt?
What is the purpose of this?

What is this?

Poetry. In the exile's handwriting. Extolling love for... me, or someone very like me.

Is... is this a cruel joke? This cannot be real.
zh:
这是什么？

诗。是那位流放者的笔迹。赞颂着对……我的爱，或是某个与我极相像的人。

这……这是个残忍的玩笑吗？这不可能是真的。

src: What kind of creature are you?
What kind words. It seems so with you, too.
zh: 好暖心的话。看来你也能。

src: What manner of being are you?
What manner of jewel are our eyes, to skew light into thought?
zh: 我们的眼睛是何等宝石，竟能把光扭作思绪？

src: What mazes and mandalas could be crafted by human hands that hope to surpass what nature wrought eons before our creation?
zh: 人手所造的迷宫与曼荼罗，如何能胜过早于我们诞生亿万年的造化之功？

src: What moved the Coven to set the injunction on our world?
zh: 是什么促使盟会对我们的世界下禁令？

src:
What novelty, to shelter the mysterious Klanq! I have heard no stories of this tinker-fungus that could be described as dull, though 'calamitous' could apply to more than one.

My mind tells tales of what might be brewing in the basement, but I am quite relieved to be out here rather than down there.
zh:
收留神秘的克朗克，真是新奇！这位修补匠菌类的轶事，我一桩也没听过能称得上乏味的，不过“灾厄连连”倒不止一桩说得上。

我心里编出种种故事，猜测地下室里或许正酝酿着什么，但我宁愿待在这上头，而不是下头，实在松了口气。

src: What now? Nothing like this has ever happened before.
zh: 这又是怎么了？这样的事从未发生过。

src: What of it? Scurry on and leave me to brood.
zh: 那又怎样？快滚，让我独自琢磨。

src:
What see. Leg plant, glow crest.

Grow from sun-crungled hydropon and depart siblings.
zh:
所见即是。腿是植物，冠是辉光。

自日晒皲裂的水培摇篮中生长，与离去的兄弟姊妹同源。

src: What should I know about the Creature?
zh: 关于那造物，我该知道些什么？

src: What use is a library in this salt den? Or in the marshes, strangled by wild plants and poisoned by the glow? Wouldn't a stash of vinereapers serve us better?
zh: 在这盐窟里，要藏书楼何用？或在被野草勒颈、被辉光毒害的沼泽里？囤一批藤镰不是更有益吗？

src: What was once merely a carbide axe is now a florid work of art. Curling wires wind around the haft of the weapon as the creeping vine of a rose plant; modules and battery housing are mounted on the flat of its blade where the blossom might rest.
zh: 这曾不过是一柄碳化物斧，如今已是一件繁复华美的艺术品。蜷曲的金属丝如蔷薇的蔓藤缠绕在武器的斧柄上；模块与电池仓安装于刃面平处，恰是花朵可栖之所。

src: What was so bad about the device?
What welcome news, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=! Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.
zh: 何等喜讯，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=！来，收下这个，权作我的谢意。

src: What would there be for the Coven to return to, if life on our world was purged?
zh: 若世上生命被涤清，盟会归来，还有什么可归的？

src: What you ask may be impossible.

What you smell is Grit Gate's signature dish. The Porridge is a recipe passed down through generations of Barathrumites, and it is the food that inspired me to pursue my craft. Yes, outsiders quail at the intensity of the scent, for its flavor is as bold as its effects!

We use cuisine to channel lightning from our bodies! Other recipes may let us breathe fire, or learn the secrets of the Eaters. The Porridge is as precious a part of our legacy as the Barathrum Clock or the foaminator.
zh:
你闻到的，是砂砾门的招牌菜。这“粥”是巴拉斯鲁姆派世代相传的食谱，也是它启发我走上这门手艺。是的，外人闻到那股浓烈的气味便要畏缩，因为它的滋味与功效同样大胆！

我们靠饮食，引雷电出体！别的食谱或许能让我们喷火，或是习得食者的秘密。这“粥”之于我们的传承，与巴拉斯鲁姆钟、泡沫机一样珍贵。

src: What's that??? Some sort of creature. Take a closer look at it.
zh: 那是什么？？？某种生物。仔细看看它。

src:
What's to tell? We are outcasts, pushed to the margins by our people for the crime of harmless deviance.

It's beyond perverse to call us back just so Grand-Doe can punish us further.
zh:
有什么好说的？我们是弃民，只因无伤大雅的离经叛道之罪，便被族人逐至边缘。

大母鹿召我们回去，不过是为了进一步惩罚我们，这简直乖谬至极。

src: What's with the houseplant over there?
zh: 那边那盆室内植物是怎么回事？

src: What, you need a menu? I got goat meat and goat jerky.
zh: 怎么，还要菜单？我有羊肉和羊肉干。

src:
Whatever you choose next, feel free to return to the tutorial if you need a refresher.

Live and drink, friend!
zh:
无论你接下来选择什么，若想重温，随时可以回到教程。

且生且饮，朋友！

src:
Whatever you choose, good luck, and feel free to return here for a refresher.

Live and drink.
zh:
无论你怎么选，祝你好运；想复习的话，随时回来。

且生且饮。

src: Whelp, affix your eyes to that clam right yonder. Go step inside and find your answers.
zh: 小崽子，把眼睛钉在那边那只蛤上。走进去，自会找到答案。
当=conditions.andList=时，于半径=radius=内提供=darkvision.if:夜视:照明=。=part.statusSummary|addParens=

src: When a song of power roars out the moted forest and slides up Worldskin, the sidewise veil shields the sorceress's ears and eyes.
zh: 当一首力量之歌自微粒森林中咆哮而出，沿世界之皮滑升之时，那侧垂的面纱便护住女巫的耳与目。

zh: 隐士请教神像，望见死亡之眼时，唯有愚人才惶惶不安！有变，而无终。

src:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through the spilling of blood and terror. Uncountable lives were taken by their hand alone, all to slake age-old desires of control and might.

Perhaps hunger turned to malice, or the adoption of a greater principle, or simple boredom. Whatever the reason, =name= formed a fast alliance with the ancient plagueborn Nephilim, ascended the spire, and sealed the fate of the world below.

The Plagues of the Gyre raged unchecked.
zh:
始时，=name=与卡德诸位首领并无共通之血脉，其声名乃凭流血与恐怖而立。无数生命折于其一人之手，只为餍足那古老的控制与权势之欲。

或许是饥渴化作了恶意，或许是奉行了某种更高的信条，或许只是纯粹的无聊。无论缘由为何，=name=与远古瘟疫所生的拿非利人结成坚固同盟，登上尖塔，封定了下界的命运。

回旋之瘟疫无所遏制地肆虐。

src:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through the spilling of blood and terror. Uncountable lives were taken by their hand alone, all to slake age-old desires of control and might. Even the ancient plagueborn Nephilim fell before the hand of =name=.

At the end of their reign, =name= coerced a false compact with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, the last remaining seat of the Sultanate's power. There, by one means or another, they sealed the fate of the world below.

The Plagues of the Gyre raged. Death swept Qud.
zh:
始时，=name=与卡德诸位首领并无共通之血脉，其声名乃凭流血与恐怖而立。无数生命折于其一人之手，只为餍足那古老的控制与权势之欲。便是远古瘟疫所生的拿非利人，也倒在了=name=的手下。

在其治世之末，=name=胁迫幸存的拿非利人订下虚假之约，攀上尖塔之巅，那是苏丹国权力仅存的宝座。在那里，他们以此法或彼法，封定了下界的命运。

回旋之瘟疫肆虐，死亡席卷卡德。

src:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives taken and saved by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. Even Nephilim, once plagues of Qud, fell before the hand of =name=.

At the end of their reign, =name= called for peace with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to quiet the ghosts of the Sultanate and take to the stars.
zh:
始时，=name=与卡德诸位首领并无共通之血脉，其声名全凭功业与盟约而立。=name=所夺与所救的生命，不可胜数，仅有一部分载入了记录。便是曾为卡德之祸的拿非利人，也倒在了=name=的手下。

在其治世之末，=name=向幸存的拿非利人求和，并攀上尖塔之巅，要在那里安抚苏丹国的幽魂，而后远赴星辰。

src:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives taken and saved by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. When they spoke, even the plagues of Qud listened.

At the end of their reign, =name= made a compact with the Nephilim that they should never vex the creatures of Qud again. So done, they climbed to the top of the spire and boarded an ancient vessel, thereby to travel the star-dusted expanse.
zh:
始时，=name=与卡德诸位首领并无共通之血脉，其声名全凭功业与盟约而立。=name=所夺与所救的生命，不可胜数，仅有一部分载入了记录。他们开口之时，便是卡德之瘟疫也俯首倾听。

在其治世之末，=name=与拿非利人订下盟约，令其永不再侵扰卡德之生灵。事毕，他们攀上尖塔之巅，登上一艘古老的飞船，由此遨游那星尘遍布的苍茫。

src:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with the Reshephs previous, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives saved and otherwise changed by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. When they spoke, even the plagues of Qud listened.

At the end of their reign, =name= made a compact with the Nephilim that they should never vex the creatures of Qud again. So done, they climbed to the top of the spire, there to end the Reshephate altogether and never be heard from again.
zh:
始时，=name=与先前诸利悉并无共通之血脉，其声名全凭功业与盟约而立。=name=所救、所改的生命，不可胜数，仅有一部分载入了记录。他们开口之时，便是卡德之瘟疫也俯首倾听。

在其治世之末，=name=与拿非利人订下盟约，令其永不再侵扰卡德之生灵。事毕，他们攀上尖塔之巅，要在那里彻底终结利悉之统，自此杳无音讯。

src:
When their works began, =name= had no connection to the Sultanate. The rule of these ancient leaders had ended, but not fully: a ghost of the last Sultan yet ruled over the spire, tormenting those on and under the ground with plagues. As =name= grew mighty and challenged the rampaging Nephilim, they came to recognize the source of their shared conflict.

Seeking freedom from the reign of the Sultan, =name= struck a compact with the Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to confront and banish the cerulean ghost.

And so it proceeded.
zh:
他们的功业开始时，=name=与苏丹国并无瓜葛。这些古代首领的统治已然终结，却未尽终结：末代苏丹的一缕幽魂仍统御着尖塔，以瘟疫折磨地上与地下之众。随着=name=日益强大，向肆虐的拿非利人发起挑战，他们渐渐认清了彼此共同冲突的根源。

=name=为求摆脱苏丹的统治，与拿非利人订立了盟约，攀上尖塔之巅，要在那里对抗并放逐那苍蓝的幽魂。

事情便这样进行了下去。

src: When worn, liquid in this item doesn't count toward your encumbrance.
zh: 穿戴时，此物中的液体不计入你的负重。

src: When you charge with a cudgel and hit, you automatically daze your opponent. When you charge with an axe and hit, if you cleave their armor, they get an additional -1 penalty to their AV. If you have Dismember, your chance to dismember when charging with an axe is doubled.
zh: 以棍棒冲锋并命中时，对手自动眩晕。以斧冲锋并命中时，若你劈开其护甲，其护甲值额外-1。若你拥有肢解，则以斧冲锋时肢解的几率加倍。

src: When you charge with an axe and hit, if you cleave their armor, they get an additional -1 penalty to their AV. If you have Dismember, your chance to dismember when charging with an axe is doubled. When you charge with a cudgel and hit, you automatically daze your opponent.
zh: 你以斧冲锋并命中时，若劈开了对方护甲，对方的护甲值再受-1减值。若你拥有“肢解”，你以斧冲锋时肢解的几率翻倍。你以棍棒冲锋并命中时，自动使对手晕眩。

src: When you choose ingredients to cook with, you can choose up to three instead of two. Meals cooked with three ingredients bestow more powerful status effects.
zh: 选择食材烹饪时，你可选三种而非两种。以三种食材烹成的餐食会赐予更强力的状态效果。

src: When you fail severely during artifact examination, the artifact explodes.
zh: 检查古器时若严重失败，古器便会爆炸。

src: When you fire a missile weapon or throw something, your projectile shifts phase to pass through obstacles and reach your target.
zh: 当你发射远程武器或投掷物品时，投射物会转换相位，穿过障碍抵达目标。

src: When you suffer a mental attack while Mental Mirror is off cooldown, you gain +<stat Name="BonusMA" /> MA. If the attack then fails to penetrate your MA, it's reflected back at your attacker.
zh: 当心灵镜像不在冷却时遭受精神攻击，你获得+<stat Name="BonusMA" />心智护甲。若攻击未能穿透你的心智护甲，便会反弹回攻击者身上。

src: When you suffer a mental attack while Mental Mirror is off cooldown, you gain +<stat Name="BonusMA" /> mental armor (MA).
zh: 当你遭受精神攻击，且心灵镜像不处于冷却中时，你获得+<stat Name="BonusMA" />点心智护甲值（MA）。

src: When zoomed out to max zoom, remove the UI frame from the main gameplay screen
zh: 缩放至最远时，移除主游戏画面的界面边框
每当=subject.thisCreature==subject.verb:跳跃=时，=subject.they=可以立即再跳一次。

src: Whenever =subject.thisCreature= =subject.verb:jump=, =subject.they= may immediately jump two more times.
zh: 每当=subject.thisCreature==subject.verb:跳跃=时，=subject.they=可以立即再跳两次。

src: Whenever =subject.thisCreature= =subject.verb:take= avoidable damage, there's =tier.a.number=% chance =subject.it.does:teleport= to a random space on the map instead.
zh: 每当=subject.thisCreature==subject.verb:受到=可躲避的伤害时，有=tier.a.number=%的几率改为=subject.it.does:瞬移=至地图上的随机位置。

src: Whenever =subject.thisCreature= =subject.verb:take= avoidable damage, there's a 20-25% chance =subject.it.does:teleport= to a random space on the map instead.
zh: 每当=subject.thisCreature==subject.verb:受到=可躲避的伤害时，有20-25%的几率改为=subject.it.does:瞬移=至地图上的随机位置。

src: Whenever you begin the water ritual with a new creature, you gain 25 bonus reputation. If you purchase this power after you treat with a creature, you gain 25 bonus reputation the next time you treat with them.
zh: 每当你与新的生物行水礼，你获得25点额外声望。若你在与某生物交涉之后才习得此技艺，则下次与其交涉时获得25点额外声望。

src: Whenever you block an opponent's attack, there is a (Strength*2)-35% chance that your opponent is stunned for 1d2 rounds.
zh: 每当你格挡对手的攻击，有（力量×2）-35%的几率使对手被击晕1d2回合。

src: Whenever you buy a new mutation, you get a random one instead of a choice of three.
zh: 每当你购买新变异时，得到的是一个随机变异，而非三选一。

src: Whenever you charge an opponent with a shield equipped, you get a free Shield Slam attack against them.
zh: 每当你装备盾牌冲锋攻击对手，便可对其免费发动一次盾击。

src: Whenever you disassemble an item, you have a 25% chance to learn how to build the item. If the item was modded, you also have a 15% chance per mod to learn the mod.
zh: 每当你拆解一件物品，有25%的几率习得制造该物品的方法。若该物品经过改造，每项改造另有15%的几率习得该改造。

src: Whenever you fire a missile weapon at a target in melee range, you attempt to kick the target backwards.
zh: 每当你以远程武器射击近战范围内的目标，你会试图将目标踢退。

src: Whenever you fire at a marked target with a bow or rifle, your agility is treated as if it were 2 points higher for the purpose of determining your accuracy.
zh: 每当你用弓或步枪射击已标记的目标时，判定命中时你的敏捷视同高出2点。

src: Whenever you gain a level, and 5% of the time you explore a new map, you become inspired for two days. While inspired, the next time you cook a meal by choosing ingredients, you get a choice of three dynamically-generated effects to apply. You create a recipe for the chosen effect.
zh: 每当你升级时，以及每次探索新地图时有5%的几率，你会获得灵感，持续两天。灵感在身时，你下一次以所选食材烹饪餐食，可从三种动态生成的效果中择一施加，并为所选效果创建一份食谱。

src: Whenever you gain a level, there's a 33% chance that your genome destabilizes and you get to choose from 3 random mutations.
zh: 每当你升级时，有33%的几率令你的基因失稳，让你从3个随机变异中择一。

src: Whenever you hit an opponent with an axe, there's a 75% chance you cleave their armor, giving them a -1 penalty to their AV. This penalty can stack a number of times up to half your Str modifier, rounded up, +1 on a critical hit.
zh: 你以斧击中对手时，有75%的几率劈开其护甲，使其护甲值受到-1的减值。此减值至多叠加你力量调整值一半（向上取整）的层数，暴击时再+1。

src: Whenever you hit with a cudgel, there's a 50% chance to daze your opponent (-4 int, -4 agi, -10 movespeed) for 3-4 rounds. If you daze a dazed opponent, they're stunned for 1 round instead (cannot take actions and 0 DV).
zh: 每当你以棍棒命中，有50%的几率使对手眩晕（智力-4，敏捷-4，移动速度-10），持续3-4回合。若你令已眩晕的对手再度眩晕，则其改为被击晕1回合（无法行动，闪避值为0）。

src: Whenever you juke an opponent while wielding a short blade in your primary hand, you make a free attack. If you have Bloodletter, the attack's chance to cause bleeding is 100%.
zh: 每当你手持主手短刃闪避对手，即免费攻击一次。若你拥有放血者，该攻击致人流血的几率为100%。

src: Whenever you learn a new secret, there's a small chance you forget a secret.
zh: 每当你获知一个新秘密，都有小概率忘记一个秘密。

src: Whenever you make a cudgel attack with your primary hand, there's a 25% chance you make an additional free attack with the same hand.
zh: 每当你以主手发动棍棒攻击，有25%的几率以同一只手再免费攻击一次。

src: Whenever you make a melee attack while single-weapon fighting, immediately make a second attack for free.
zh: 每当你在单武器战斗时发动近战攻击，立即免费再攻击一次。

src: Whenever you make a melee attack while single-weapon fighting, there's a 50% chance you immediately make a second attack for free.
zh: 每当你在单武器战斗时发动近战攻击，有50%的几率立即免费再攻击一次。

src: Whenever you make a ranged attack while wielding multiple guns, you fire a shot with each of them.
zh: 当你持有多把枪进行远程攻击时，每一把枪都会各射出一发。

src: Whenever you make an offhand attack with a short blade, you immediately make another attack with that same weapon. Flurry attacks do not trigger this.
zh: 每当你以短刃发动副手攻击，立即以同一武器再攻击一次。连击不会触发此效果。

src: Whenever you manifest a new mutation, one of your choices will also cause you to grow a new limb at random.
zh: 每当你显现新变异时，其中一个选项还会令你随机长出一条新肢体。

src:
Whenever you perform the water ritual with a new creature, you gain an extra 25 reputation. If you install this implant after you treat with a creature for the first time, you gain 25 reputation the next time you treat with them.
Reputation costs in the water ritual are reduced by 20%.
You may Proselytize one additional creature.
Compute power on the local lattice increases this implant's effectiveness.
zh:
每当你与新的生物行水礼，额外获得25点声望。若你在初次与某生物结好之后才安装此植入体，则在下次与其结好时获得25点声望。
水礼所耗声望降低20%。
你可以多劝诱入教一名生物。
本地网格的算力会增强此植入体的效力。

src:
Whenever you perform the water ritual with a new creature, you gain an extra =repBonus= reputation. If you install this implant after you treat with a creature for the first time, you gain =repBonus= reputation the next time you treat with them.
Reputation costs in the water ritual are reduced by =ritualCostReduction=%.
You may Proselytize =proselytizeLimitBonus.things:additional creature=.
Compute power on the local lattice increases this implant's effectiveness.
zh:
每当你与一名新生物行水礼，你额外获得=repBonus=点声望。若你在首次与某生物交涉之后才安装此植入体，则下次与其交涉时获得=repBonus=点声望。
行水礼的声望花费降低=ritualCostReduction=%。
你可额外劝诱入教=proselytizeLimitBonus.things:名生物=。
本地网格上的算力可提升此植入体的效能。

src: Whenever you return to a map you previously visited, there's a small chance you forget the layout.
zh: 每当你返回曾到访过的地图，都有小概率忘记其布局。

src: Whenever you rifle through trash, there's a 5% chance you piece together clues and learn a random secret.
zh: 每当你翻检垃圾，有5%的几率拼凑出线索，习得一则随机的秘密。

src: Whenever you score a critical hit with a melee weapon while single-weapon fighting, the cooldowns of up to two random weapon or shield skills are immediately refreshed.
zh: 每当你在单武器战斗时以近战武器打出暴击，至多两项随机武器或盾牌技能的冷却立即刷新。

src: Whenever you spend a mutation point, the next mutation point you gain will be spent randomly.
zh: 每当你花费一点变异点数，你下一次获得的变异点数将被随机花掉。

src: Whenever you step over garbage, you astutely rifle through it and occasionally discover scrap. Additionally, you harvest extra scrap from robots you destroy.
zh: 每当你踏过垃圾，便会精明地翻检一番，偶尔发现废料。此外，你摧毁机器人时可多收获废料。

src: Whenever you use an activated ability, there's a small chance your focus slips and you dent spacetime in the local region, causing 1-2 spacetime vortices to appear. This chance increases the longer you go without using an activated ability.
zh: 每当你使用一项主动能力，都有小概率因注意力涣散而撞凹当地时空，招致1-2个时空漩涡出现。你越久不使用主动能力，这种情况发生的几率就越高。

src: Whenever you would have taken heat damage, you heal for <stat Name="HealFactor" />% of that damage instead
zh: 每当你本应受到热伤害时，改为恢复该伤害<stat Name="HealFactor" />%的生命值

src: Whenever you're about to take avoidable damage, there's =chance.a.number=% chance you blink away instead.
zh: 每当你将受到可避免的伤害时，有=chance.a.number=%的几率改为闪现离开。

src: Where can I find a cave?
Where did you get these implants?
zh: 这些植入体你是从哪儿得来的？

src: Where do I place components once they are gathered?
zh: 部件搜集齐了，该放在何处？

src: Where do you want to pour =object.the.name=?
Where is Brightsheol in relation to Qud... to Salum?
zh: 明冥与卡德……与撒伦，是怎样的关系？

src: Where is he? Tell me what happened to him.
zh: 他在哪儿？告诉我他遭遇了什么。

src: Where is the repulsive device, again?
zh: 那件令人厌恶的装置，究竟在哪儿来着？

src: Where light on light swims and dances, dark on dark rattles and jaws. There is no continuity of movement, instead the black void occasionally seems to suddenly burn into shape before blurring again. The eyes cramps at this severance, and the impression of hereness is lost again.
zh: 光与光交泳共舞之处，暗与暗相击相噬。其动毫无连贯，只见那黑色的虚空时而骤然烧出形状，随即又模糊过去。双眼因这断裂而抽紧，那“在此”之感再度失落。

src: Where may I find Lebah? I wish to know more.
zh: 我在哪里能找到利巴？我想多了解一些。

src: Where will I find him again?

Whew! You killed the snapjaw and earned some experience. It looks like they dropped a piece of equipment, too.

Press =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= and then choose a direction or press =commandKey:AdventureMouseInteract=.
zh:
呼！你杀死了豺颚人，还获得了一些经验。看来他还掉落了一件装备。

按=commandKey:CmdGetFrom=，然后选择一个方向，或按=commandKey:AdventureMouseInteract=。

src:
Whew! You killed the snapjaw and earned some experience. It looks like they dropped a piece of equipment, too.

Press =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= and then choose a direction.
zh:
呼！你杀死了豺颚人，还获得了一些经验。看来他还掉落了一件装备。

按=commandKey:CmdGetFrom=，然后选择一个方向。

src: Which passed through Her naked womb.
zh: 机器穿过她赤裸的子宫。

src:
While I appreciate your help, kendren, I would prefer that you not stay longer than you must.

The faundren might get ideas.
zh:
我虽感激你的相助，肯德伦，但还是希望你不要多留。

小欣德伦们或许会生出些念头。

src:
While at a campfire, you can cook from recipes, choose up to two ingredients to cook with, and preserve fresh foods.
Meals cooked from recipes bestow special status effects. Meals cooked with selected ingredients bestow dynamically-generated status effects.
Preserved foods are used as meal ingredients.
zh:
在营火旁，你可依食谱烹饪，可择至多两种食材入菜，亦可保存新鲜食物。
依食谱烹成的餐食会赐予特殊的状态效果；以所选食材烹成的餐食则赐予动态生成的状态效果。
保存好的食物可用作餐食食材。

src: While dashing, whenever you move in a direction, you dash toward the nearest enemy or obstacle and perform an attack.
zh: 冲刺期间，每当你向某方向移动，便会朝最近的敌人或障碍冲去并发动攻击。

src: While exploring =object.zone.name=, =name= =verb.pastTense= the fabled contraption called =item.the.basename=.
zh: 在探索=object.zone.name=时，=name==verb.pastTense=了那台传说中的机关，人称=item.the.basename=。

src: While exploring =player.zone.name=, =player.name= recovered the fabled artifact called =item.refname:withDefiniteArticle=.
zh: 在探索=player.zone.name=时，=player.name=寻回了那件传说中的古器，人称=item.refname:withDefiniteArticle=。

src: While fighting a battle to protect the practice of =spice:elements.$element.practices.!random=, =name= valorously had =player.possessive= =limb.ordinalName= dismembered.
zh: 为护=spice:elements.$element.practices.!random=之术而战之际，=name=英勇地任由=player.possessive==limb.ordinalName=被斩断。

src: While in the sunlight, you accrue starch and lignin that you can use as ingredients in meals you cook (max <stat Name="StarchServings" Unit="▶serving" /> of each).
zh: 身处日光之下时，你会积蓄淀粉与木质素，可作烹饪膳食的食材（每种至多<stat Name="StarchServings" Unit="份" />）。

src: While it's flowing, you gain +<stat Name="QuicknessBonus" /> quickness and other physical mutations gain +<stat Name="MutationBonus" /> rank.
zh: 流动期间，你获得+<stat Name="QuicknessBonus" />迅捷，其他肉体变异获得+<stat Name="MutationBonus" />等级。

src: While it's flowing, you gain +<stat Name="QuicknessBonus" /> quickness and other physical mutations gain +<stat Name="MutationBonus" Unit="▶rank" />.
zh: 肾上腺素奔流期间，你的迅捷+<stat Name="QuicknessBonus" />，其他身体变异的等级+<stat Name="MutationBonus" Unit="级" />。

src: While leading a small army in =region=,
While leading a small army through =zone.prosaic=, =player.name= demanded that a local baetyl use its powers to transmute =demand= into =reward|lower=.
zh: =player.name=率一小队人马行经=zone.prosaic=，命当地一座圣石施其伟力，将=demand=炼化为=reward|lower=。

src: While meditating, you regenerate three times as fast, and negative status effects wear out three times as fast.
zh: 冥想时，你的再生速度提升至三倍，负面状态效果的消退速度亦为三倍。

src: While meditating, you regenerate three times as fast, and negative status effects wear out three times as fast. The only action you can take while meditating is Wait. You stop meditating if you take damage in a single round exceeding (Willpower*3)-60. If you rest for 10 or more turns, you automatically begin meditating.
zh: 冥想时，你的再生速度为平时的三倍，负面状态效果消退亦快三倍。冥想时你唯一能做的行动是等待。若你单回合所受伤害超过（意志×3）-60，则冥想中断。若你连续休息10回合或更久，则自动开始冥想。

src: While operational, provides =darkvision.if:night vision:light= in radius =radius=. =part.statusSummary|addParens=
zh: 运行期间，于半径=radius=内提供=darkvision.if:夜视:照明=。=part.statusSummary|addParens=

src: While outside, you may fly. You cannot be hit in melee by grounded creatures while flying.
zh: 身处室外时，你可以飞行。飞行期间，着地的生物无法在近战中击中你。

src: While roaming the westwise jungle, =name= came upon a clan of urshiib performing a secret ritual. Because of =player.t's= coating of foul slime, they accepted =name= into their fold and taught =player.objective= their secrets.
zh: =name=在西部丛林漫游时，遇见一群乌尔希卜正在举行秘密仪式。因=player.t's=身披恶臭黏液，他们接纳=name=入群，并将秘密传授给=player.objective=。

src: While roaming the westwise jungle, =name= came upon a clan of urshiib performing a secret ritual. Because of =player.t's= disk-like eyes, they accepted =name= into their fold and taught =player.objective= their secrets.
zh: =name=在西部丛林漫游时，遇见一群乌尔希卜正在举行秘密仪式。因=player.t's=眼睛形如圆盘，他们接纳=name=入群，并将秘密传授给=player.objective=。

src: While single-weapon fighting, your melee attacks always penetrate one extra time.
zh: 单武器战斗时，你的近战攻击总会多击穿一次。

src: While spinning, you leave webs in your wake as you move.
zh: 结网期间，你每移动一步都会在身后留下蛛网。

src: While the steeple fires raged below, brave arconauts sank into the glowing depths to retrieve valuables. When their corpses were found, the sand in their pockets had been blown into glass beads. Sometime after, those beads were strung into a bracelet.
zh: 尖塔下烈火肆虐之时，勇敢的方舟航行者沉入炽亮的深处，取回珍宝。后来发现他们的尸身，口袋里的沙子已被吹成了玻璃珠。再往后，这些珠子被串成了手链。

src: While traveling alone through the Rust Wells, Resheph came across a trove of gleaming stars in a bottle. From that day forth, he always kept some stardust on his person.
zh: 利悉独自行旅穿过锈井时，偶见一堆瓶中闪烁的星辰。自那日起，他身上总带着些许星尘。

src: While traveling around =player.terrain.t=, =name= discovered =player.landmark.nearest=. There =player.subjective= befriended fungi and contracted =object.name= on =player.their= =part.ordinalName=.
zh: 行经=player.terrain.t=一带时，=name=发现了=player.landmark.nearest=。=player.subjective=于彼处与真菌结好，在=player.their==part.ordinalName=上染了=object.name=。

src: While traveling around =player.terrain.t=, =name= stumbled upon a clan of fungi performing a secret ritual. Because of =name|'s= =spice:elements.$domain.quality.!random=, they furiously rebuked =player.objective= and dissolved the =object.name|strip= infection on =name|'s= =part.ordinalName=.
zh: 行经=player.terrain.t=一带时，=name=偶遇一族真菌正行秘仪。因=name|'s=的=spice:elements.$domain.quality.!random=，它们愤然斥退=player.objective=，并化解了=name|'s==part.ordinalName=上的=object.name|strip=感染。

src: While traveling in =zone.prosaic=, =name= performed a sacred ritual with =object.a.name=, imbuing =object.them= with life and arranging =object.them= =spice:elements.$domain.babeTrait.!random=. Many of the local denizens declared it a miracle.
zh: =zone.prosaic=旅途中，=name=与=object.a.name=举行神圣仪式，赋予=object.them=生命，并将=object.them=排列成=spice:elements.$domain.babeTrait.!random=。当地许多居民称此为奇迹。

src: While traveling in =zone.prosaic=, =name= performed a sacred ritual with =object.a.name=, imbuing =object.them= with life and arranging =object.them= =spice:elements.$domain.babeTrait.!random=. Many of the local denizens declared it a miracle. Some weren't so sure.
zh: =zone.prosaic=旅途中，=name=与=object.a.name=举行神圣仪式，赋予=object.them=生命，并将=object.them=排列成=spice:elements.$domain.babeTrait.!random=。当地许多居民称此为奇迹，也有人对此将信将疑。

src: While traveling near Bethesda Susa, Resheph lost control of his chariot and drove it off a cliff. Luckily, a local physician named Rebekah came to his rescue. Moved by her kindness, Resheph enrolled at a nearby hospice as her apprentice.
zh: 利悉行旅至毕士大-苏萨附近时，战车失控，连人带车坠下悬崖。幸有名唤利百加的本地医师前来相救。感其仁心，利悉入附近一所济病院，充任她的学徒。

src: While traveling through =player.zone.name=, =name= stopped at a tavern in =landmark.nearest=. There =player.subjective= lost a bet and bashfully drank a dram of lava. Miraculously, =player.subjective= left the tavern unharmed.
zh: 途经=player.zone.name=时，=name=在=landmark.nearest=的一间酒馆歇脚。在那里，=player.subjective=赌输了，羞赧地饮下一打兰熔岩。所幸神迹降临，=player.subjective=毫发无伤地离开了酒馆。

src: While traveling through =region=, =spice.entity:name= stopped at a market in =location=. At an obscure shop, =spice.entity:subjectPronoun= purchased =itemDescription|article= =itemType= and named it =itemName=. Then =spice.entity:subjectPronoun= went to a nearby tavern and lost =itemName= =spice:commonPhrases.lostInTavern.!random=. =spice.entity:subjectPronoun|capitalize= cursed the tavern and left =location=.
zh: 行旅穿过=region=时，=spice.entity:name=在=location=的集市驻足。于一家偏僻小铺，=spice.entity:subjectPronoun=购得=itemDescription|article==itemType=，为之取名=itemName=。随后=spice.entity:subjectPronoun=往附近一家酒馆，=itemName=竟就此失落：=spice:commonPhrases.lostInTavern.!random=。=spice.entity:subjectPronoun|capitalize=诅咒那酒馆，离=location=而去。

src: While traveling through =region=, =spice.entity:name= stopped at a tavern in =location=. There =spice.entity:subjectPronoun= lost =spice.entity:possessivePronoun= prized =itemName= =spice:commonPhrases.lostInTavern.!random=. =spice.entity:subjectPronoun|capitalize= cursed the tavern and left =location=.
zh: 行旅穿过=region=时，=spice.entity:name=在=location=的一家酒馆驻足。就在那里，=spice.entity:subjectPronoun=把=spice.entity:possessivePronoun=珍爱的=itemName=失落了，=spice:commonPhrases.lostInTavern.!random=。=spice.entity:subjectPronoun|capitalize=诅咒那酒馆，离=location=而去。

src: While traveling through =terrain.t=, =name= stopped at a tavern near =landmark.nearest=. There =subject.they= wisely declined to play a game of dice and instead supped on a nourishing serving of Eaters' nectar.
zh: 行经=terrain.t=时，=name=在=landmark.nearest=附近的一处酒肆驻足。=subject.they=明智地谢绝了掷骰之戏，转而啜饮一份滋养的食者花蜜。

src: While traveling through =terrain.t=, =player.name= stopped at a tavern in =landmark.nearest=. There =player.subjective= won a bet and triumphantly drank a dram of sunslag. =player.Subjective= =player.verb:were= quickened and left the tavern at an untrackable pace.
zh: 途经=terrain.t=时，=player.name=在=landmark.nearest=的一间酒馆歇脚。在那里，=player.subjective=赌赢了，得意地饮下一打兰日渣。=player.Subjective==player.verb:变得=迅捷，以无从追踪的速度离开了酒馆。

src: While visiting an obscure =spice:professions.$profession.guildhall=, =name= met with a group of =spice:professions.$profession.plural= and commissioned what came to be known as =item.the.basename=.
zh: =name=造访一座默默无闻的=spice:professions.$profession.guildhall=时，遇见了一群=spice:professions.$profession.plural=，并委托打造了后来被人唤作=item.the.basename=之物。

src: While visiting an obscure =spice:professions.$profession.guildhall=, =player.name= met with a group of =spice:professions.$profession.plural= and commissioned what came to be known as =item.refname:withDefiniteArticle=.
zh: =player.name=造访一座默默无闻的=spice:professions.$profession.guildhall=时，遇见了一群=spice:professions.$profession.plural=，并委托打造了后来被人唤作=item.refname:withDefiniteArticle=之物。

src: While wandering around =player.terrain.t=, =name= stumbled upon a clan of machine folk. Because of =player.name's|strip= =spice:elements.$element.quality.!random=, they accepted =player.objective= into their fold and helped =player.objective= Become by installing =cybernetic.a.name|strip=.
zh: =name=行经=player.terrain.t=时，偶遇一族机械之民。因=player.name's|strip=的=spice:elements.$element.quality.!random=，他们纳=player.objective=入其行列，并为其植入=cybernetic.a.name|strip=，助=player.objective=成身。

src: While wandering in the jungle near Kyakukya, =name= dreamed =player.subjective= orbited a darkling star and in its vast accretion disk piled the building blocks of self. From then on, =name= kept a starless, triangular prism on =player.possessive= person.
zh: =name=在基亚库基亚附近的丛林漫游时，梦见=player.subjective=绕着一颗幽暗星辰运行，在其广阔吸积盘中堆起自我的基石。从此，=name=将一枚无星的三角棱镜贴身带在=player.possessive=身上。

src: While wielding a long blade in your primary hand, you gain +<stat Name="DVBonus" /> DV.
zh: 主手持长刃时，你的闪避值+<stat Name="DVBonus" />。

src: While wielding a long blade in your primary hand, you gain +<stat Name="HitBonus" /> to hit.
zh: 主手持长刃时，你的命中+<stat Name="HitBonus" />。

src: While wielding a long blade in your primary hand, you gain +<stat Name="PenBonus" /> to your penetration rolls but -<stat Name="HitPenalty" /> to hit.
zh: 主手持长刃时，你的穿透判定+<stat Name="PenBonus" />，但命中-<stat Name="HitPenalty" />。

src: White and black shag sheds off =pronouns.objective=, and =pronouns.possessive= paws tap the ground with a working itch.
zh: 黑白相间的长毛自=pronouns.objective=身上脱落，=pronouns.possessive=爪子带着干活的痒意踏地。

src: White fur and skin-crimps hatch from the corners of =pronouns.possessive= shy eyes. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:run:afterpronoun= a spare bolt over =pronouns.possessive= knuckles, ready to fix a wanting chromeling for the thousandth and first time rather than chat with another person.
zh: =pronouns.possessive=羞怯的双眼，眼梢处生出白毛与细褶。=pronouns.Subjective=把一枚备用螺栓在=pronouns.possessive=指节上转着，宁可第一千零一次去修一只出了毛病的铬灵，也不愿与人闲谈。

src: White lips hang from =pronouns.possessive= hooded and overly jawed face in the asymmetry of disappointment. =pronouns.Possessive= brow crunches the softness out of =pronouns.possessive= color-sucked eyes. =pronouns.Subjective= looks at =pronouns.possessive= newchildren with a mixture of sharp fondness and disgust. To =pronouns.objective=, they are small puppets; their limbs must be curled around their joints with loving precision, or they are splayed open by their own wills, useless and broken.
zh: 白色的双唇挂在=pronouns.possessive=眼睑低垂、颌骨过大的脸上，垂成一派不对称的失望。=pronouns.Possessive=眉峰将=pronouns.possessive=褪尽颜色的双眼中的柔软碾尽。=pronouns.Subjective=望着=pronouns.possessive=新子们，眼光里掺着尖锐的慈爱与厌恶。在=pronouns.objective=看来，它们不过是小小的傀儡；其四肢须以满怀爱意的精准蜷绕于关节之上，否则便会被自身的意志掰得四散摊开，无用而破碎。

src: Who am I? Mak. That's all you get. I'll not waste the honey of my mouth on idle inquiries.
zh: 我是谁？马克。你只配知道这些。我口中的蜜，不浪费在闲问上。

src: Who am I? Who are you? What does it matter? You and I are nothing, the most insignificant afterthoughts of an amaranthine shade.
zh: 我是谁？你是谁？有何要紧？你我皆无物，不朽之影最微不足道的余念罢了。
巴拉斯鲁姆派到底是什么人来着？
普图斯圣殿骑士团是什么人？
这些巴拉斯鲁姆派是什么人？

src: Who are you? Get out of my work space!
zh: 你是谁？滚出我的工作间！

src: Who are you? What are the seraphim?
Who are you? What are you?
Who are you? What? Please, do not disturb me.
zh: 你是谁？什么事？请不要打扰我。

src:
Who cares?

Can one? Maybe.
Can I? Surely not.
Can YOU? Well.
Prove it.
zh:
谁在乎？

人能吗？或许。
我能吗？肯定不能。
你能吗？嗯。
证明给我看。

src: Who do you think stole Kindrish?
zh: 依你看，是谁偷走了金德里什？

src: Who is Non Moloch, from before?
zh: 先前所说的“非摩洛”是谁？

src: Who is the man camped near the graveyard?
zh: 营地扎在墓地附近的那个男人是谁？

src:
Who knows? I've wondered it myself. Sometimes she'll catch my eye, when the moon's silver-bright, and she's there bearing down on the flats.

Whatever she is, she's gigantic. And old. Real old. Way older than the cathedral the Mechanimists built inside her.
zh:
谁知道呢？我自己也曾纳闷。有时月色银亮，她会入我眼帘，沉沉压在平原之上。

不管她是什么，总之庞大无比，又古老，非常古老。比机神教徒在她腹中建起的大教堂古老得多。
克-戈尼农是谁，或是什么？

src: Who thumps my crystal arms, and kicksofts me at windfall? I feel you here, friend.
zh: 谁在捶打我晶体的臂膀，又在风落之时软踢我？朋友，我感到你在这里。

src: Who ventures into the Great Salt Desert, and nearer the Six Day Stilt?
zh: 何人胆敢闯入大盐漠，逼近六日高塔？

src: Who would you like to beguile?
Who would you like to proselytize?
Who's preserved the skins and innards of this still one? Was it the dry air of Moghra'yi? Or the doting persistence of human ritual? Does it matter?
zh: 是谁保存了这位静者的皮囊与脏腑？是莫格拉伊的干燥空气？还是人类仪礼那份殷勤的执着？这又有什么要紧？

src:
Who, I?
Only a fool, tra la,
only a remnant scrap.

Only left-behind,
only madness,
only an echoing gyre.
zh:
谁，我吗？
不过一个愚者，啦啦，
不过一块残存的碎屑。

不过是被遗下的，
不过是疯癫，
不过是一道回响的回旋。

src: Who, indeed? Who ever was =name=? Dare we hang such hopes and fears on so tiny and distant a figure? Will it bear the weight?
zh: 谁？究竟谁曾是=name=？我们怎敢把这许多希冀与恐惧，寄于如此渺小遥远的一个身影？它承得起这份重量吗？

src: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. Now? No one knows.
zh: 谁？在命运与意志使其不凡之前，不过是无足轻重之人。如今呢？无人知晓。

src: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. They died without title, or perhaps did not die at all. Tales abound, and thus far no one has stepped forth to renounce or affirm them.
zh: 谁？在命运与意志使其不凡之前，不过是无足轻重之人。他们死时无名无号，或许根本未曾死去。传说纷纭，迄今无人站出来否认或证实。

src: Whoever stole Kindrish didn't steal from the village stores. These chests are simply packed with dried lah, vinewafers, and waterskins.
zh: 偷走金德里什的人并没有动村库。这些箱子里满满当当地装着拉花干、藤饼和水囊。

src:
Whoever this was, they had some books. All books can be read in game.

Books with {{Y|white}} titles are generated and usually contain nonsense, but the nonsense can occasionally be useful.

Books with {{W|gold}} titles are more valuable: they are handwritten by in-world beings and contain interesting takes on the world.
zh:
不管这人是谁，他都有几本书。所有书都能在游戏里阅读。

{{Y|白色}}书名的书是随机生成的，内容多半是胡言乱语，不过这些胡话偶尔也能派上用场。

{{W|金色}}书名的书更珍贵：它们出自游戏世界中人的手笔，对这个世界有着有趣的见解。

src: Whole worlds are carved in bas relief, simulacra of the motley lives of ash-dreaming Eaters. Palm leaves lift pyramids into the star-ribboned sky, and the water of life pours over the lip of an oinochoe.
zh: 整个世界被雕于浅浮雕中，皆是沉浸灰烬之梦的食者斑驳一生的摹像。棕榈叶托举金字塔，直入星带飘舞的天空，生命之水自双耳酒瓶的唇沿倾泻。

src: Whole worlds are threaded in three-dimensional filigree, simulacra of the motley lives of ash-dreaming Eaters. Palm leaves lift pyramids into the star-ribboned sky, and the water of life pours over the lip of an oinochoe.
zh: 整个世界被缀成立体的金丝镂花，皆是沉浸灰烬之梦的食者斑驳一生的摹像。棕榈叶托举金字塔，直入星带飘舞的天空，生命之水自双耳酒瓶的唇沿倾泻。

src: Why are you dressed like an apothecary?
zh: 你为什么穿得像个药剂师？

src: Why are you here, in Kyakukya?
Why are you hiding in the bush?
Why are you offering me sympathies?
Why are you selling goods in such a remote and dangerous place?
zh: 你为何在如此偏远危险的地方卖货？

src: Why are you speaking to me? You have work to do.
zh: 你为何同我说话？你有活要干。

src: Why are you staring at my mouth?
Why are you talking to me?
Why are you the color of coral? And why did the brick road outside only appear after I ate the Eater's fleshcap?
zh: 你为何通体珊瑚色？还有，我吃下食者的肉菇之后，外头的砖路为何才冒出来？

src: Why ascend the Spindle then? For what purpose?
zh: 那你为何还要攀上纺锤？所为何事？

src: Why did you come to Omonporch?
zh: 你们为何来到奥蒙门廊？

src: Why did you leave Bey Lah?
Why did you tell me Eskhind had a brother?
zh: 你为何告诉我埃斯金德有个弟弟？

src:
Why do some creatures seem to prefer when we assume their likenesses while others hate it? As a zoologist, this question has interested me for some time. To address it, I must first draw a distinction between 'natural mimicry', where certain humanoids have developed animal and plant likenesses on a biological level, and 'unnatural mimicry', enacted in the forms of clothing and other decorative adornments. As for the former, it appears all creatures exhibit kinship toward humanoids who look like them in the biological sense. The latter scenario is the interesting one.

It's tempting to draw the divide between mammals and non-mammals, but the truth is more complicated than this. It's true that the only creatures who seem to take outright offense at mimicry are mammals, but there are documented cases of mammals accepting the mimic. For example, fork-horned helms endear their wearers to both antelopes and goatfolk.

On the contrary, ape fur clothing and puma chitin vests inflame apes and cats, respectively. The important detail here is the context in which the clothing is made. Poachers hunt apes and pumas specifically for their prized fur and chitinous shells, and being reasonably social creatures, both species take offense at the flaunting of these trophies. Birds, on the other hand, seem to know that feather harvesting can be (although isn't always) done without proving fatal for the bird in question, though another hypothesis points to birds' specific appreciation of plumage regardless of context.

Unshelled reptiles seem to have few qualms with mimicry, perhaps believing the mimics to be truly reptile in part. Mollusks, trees, and insects all tend to identify with shell-bearers, leaf-donners, and firefly-symbiotes, respectively.

Without exception, however, all creatures seem to detest the practice of wearing the severed faces of their kin. Curious.
zh:
为何有些生灵似乎喜欢我们模仿它们的样貌，另一些却对此深恶痛绝？我身为动物学家，对此问题已感兴趣多时。要解答它，首先须区分“自然拟态”与“非自然拟态”：前者是某些类人生物在生物层面演化出动物或植物特征；后者则借衣物及其他装饰来实现。就前者而言，似乎所有生灵都会亲近那些在生物意义上与自己相像的类人生物。真正有趣的是后者。

人们很容易把界线划在哺乳动物与非哺乳动物之间，但事实更为复杂。的确，似乎唯有哺乳动物会明显因拟态而恼怒；然而也有哺乳动物接纳拟态者的记录。例如，戴上叉角头盔，便能令羚羊与羊人都对佩戴者心生亲近。

反之，猿毛衣物和美洲狮甲壳背心，却分别会激怒猿与猫科动物。关键在于这些衣物如何制成。偷猎者专为珍贵毛皮与甲壳捕猎猿和美洲狮；这两种生灵颇具社交性，自然会因他人炫耀这些战利品而愤怒。鸟儿似乎知道，采集羽毛可以不致鸟丧命（虽非总是如此）；不过另一种假说认为，鸟儿无论缘由如何，都格外欣赏羽饰。

无甲爬行动物似乎不怎么介意拟态，或许它们多少真把拟态者当成爬行动物。软体动物、树木和昆虫则往往认同穿壳者、披叶者和萤火虫共生者。

然而无一例外，所有生灵似乎都厌恶佩戴同类被割下的脸。真是耐人寻味。

src: Why do some of you have wheels?
zh: 你们中为何有些人装着轮子？

src:
Why do we speak strangely? Why =ifplayerplural:do ye:dost thou= speak strangely?

Is not all speech strange?
zh:
我们为何说话古怪？=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=又为何说话古怪？

难道天下言语不都古怪么？

src: Why do you believe the Coven now returns?
zh: 你为何相信盟会如今将归？

src: Why do you call it "your" village?
Why do you call me Saad?
Why do you care about Bey Lah?
Why do you owe... "prickles"... a debt?
Why do you remain here? Please, finish your business.
zh: 你为何还留在这儿？请把你的事办完吧。

src: Why do you speak so strangely?
zh: 你们为何说话这么古怪？

src: Why don't I see myself out?
Why don't you go there yourself?
Why don't you retrieve it yourself?
Why have you asked me to return?
Why is an exile standing in my village? Are you trying to play me for a fool?
zh: 一个流放者为何站在我的村里？你是想把我当傻子耍吗？

src: Why is this village populated with =faction.formattedName=?
Why purge all life? Aside from the immorality of it, nothing would remain.
zh: 为何要涤清一切生命？姑且不论其不义，那样便什么也不会剩下了。

src:
Why should you believe me? Well, why should you believe Keh? Ayvah, think about this!

I'm not asking you to give me your unconditional trust, understand? Only to extend to me the same level of trust you give Keh. Is that not reasonable? Is that not just?
zh:
你为什么该信我？好，那你为什么该信凯？艾瓦，好好想想！

我并不要你无条件地信任我，明白吗？只要你给我与凯同等的信任。这不合理吗？这不公正吗？

src: Why would you put mushrooms in cider?
zh: 为什么要往苹果酒里放蘑菇？

src: Why wouldn't an outsider bring their own leather? It would better disguise Kindrish. It seems a lot of work to find and raid our leather stores.
zh: 外人为何不自带皮革？那样更能掩饰金德里什。去翻找并劫掠我们的皮革库存，似乎太费功夫了。

src:
Why, =name=, Brightsheol treated you well. There is a new gravity about you; your proverbial boots ring louder in the Annals with each step.

I imagine you're off to Teach's study? They're already at work down there.
zh:
哎呀，=name=，明冥待你不薄。你身上添了一种新的分量；你那出了名的靴声，每踏一步，在《编年史》里便更响一分。

我猜你是要去教习的书房吧？他们已在下头忙开了。

src: Why, this arrow is covered with blood!

Why, this place is Grit Gate! O the vaulted halls, the glint of chrome, the gentle hum of chain turret emplacements!

There's nowhere like Grit Gate in the whole of Qud, =player.formalAddressTerm=. I've journeyed in my comparatively short time, but I always return here. The very air buzzes with knowledge, as well as quite a few other things.
zh:
嗨，这里就是砂砾门！啊，穹顶的厅堂，铬的流光，链式炮塔的轻轻嗡鸣！

整个卡德再没有哪处比得上砂砾门，=player.formalAddressTerm=。相较而言我游历的时日不长，但总会回到这里。连空气都嗡嗡作响，满是知识，还有不少别的东西。

src:
Why? A lifetime of vexation. Born to a cacophony of static ringing the ears raw. Thousands of my kinfolk cut down by that porphyric wasp fools called Lamb. A millenium of hot stinking sun and disgusting brine lice for supper.

Misery obtains on this pond, whelp. By Chavvah if you start beaming like a sunray and yodeling at the Beetle Moon, I'll eat you where you stand.
zh:
为何？一生的烦恼。生于一片静电的喧嚣，震得耳朵生疼。我成千上万的族人，被那群唤作盘羔的紫斑黄蜂蠢货砍倒。一千年酷热腥臭的太阳，晚饭是令人作呕的咸水虱子。

这池塘上苦难遍布，小崽子。凭查娃起誓，你若敢像阳光一样笑逐颜开，对着甲虫之月吆喝歌唱，我就当场把你吃了。

src:
Why? Why did I leave a single parasang square piece of land upon which I was expected to live my entire life, forever obeying a woman whose sole qualification of rule is her gender and age? Why did I leave a place where we eat the same damned soup for nine out of ten meals and the height of occupational versatility is leatherworking?

The question isn't why I left, it's why I'm the only one who chose to do so, why none of my pleas were convincing to the hindren I love. If we would just open the borders, it would never have come to this.
zh:
为什么？为什么我要离开那方圆不过一帕拉桑的土地，那里指望我终生居住，永远听命于一个唯一的执政资格便是性别和年纪的女人？为什么我要离开一个十顿饭里有九顿喝同一锅该死的汤、营生的花样至多不过制革的地方？

问题不在我为何离开，而在为何只有我选择离开，为何我的恳求没能说服我所爱的欣德伦人。只要肯打开边界，事情本不会落到这步田地。

src: Wh—no! No! What? No, that's not possible! Ayvah, what an absurd idea!
zh: 什——不！不！什么？不，那不可能！艾瓦，多荒唐的想法！

src: Wide airfoil fin-flaps beat at the wind.
zh: 宽阔的翼状鳍瓣拍击着风。

src: Wide-sheet petals span above a snapjaw's height and thrice as wide. =pronouns.Possessive= stamen looks like a bundle of saltback tongues, and =pronouns.possessive= scent is describable as 'sweaty animal'. Several thorn-touched rhizome pods fidget near =pronouns.possessive= stem like a clutch of eager children.
zh: 宽板似的花瓣张在比一个豺颚人还高、三倍还宽的地方。=pronouns.Possessive=雄蕊看去如同一束盐背兽的舌头，=pronouns.possessive=气味只可形容为“汗湿的野兽”。数枚带刺的根茎荚在=pronouns.possessive=茎旁扭动，宛如一窝急切的孩童。

src: Wielded weapons blocked by this shield have a 10% chance to be disarmed.
zh: 被此盾格挡的手持武器，有10%几率被缴械。

src:
Will I?

Your prediction warms little against the chill wind of the Gyre. My future is free. My future is murky. I am freshly tender from the burn of your hand.

I feel I had rather not encounter you for a time. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
zh:
我会吗？

你的预言，在回旋的寒风面前，几无暖意。我的未来自由。我的未来模糊。我刚被你的手灼伤，仍然刺痛。

我想，我宁愿暂时不再遇见你。且生且饮，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

src: Will continue to lose Move Speed and gain AV until Move Speed penalty reaches -80.
zh: 移动速度将持续下降、护甲值将持续上升，直至移动速度减益达到-80。

src: Will go berserk the next time <gametext>=subject.they= =subject.verb:deal=</gametext> damage in combat.
zh: 下一次在战斗中<gametext>=subject.they= =subject.verb:造成=</gametext>伤害时，将陷入狂暴。

src: Will prefer to attack creatures who are bleeding.
zh: 更倾向于攻击正在流血的生物。

src: Will return to normal operations dazed if damage is taken.
zh: 若受到伤害，将在眩晕中恢复正常运作。

src: Will wake up dazed if damage is taken.
zh: 若受到伤害，将在眩晕中醒来。

src: Will you inherit leadership of Joppa from your father?
zh: 你会从令尊手里接掌约帕的领导之位吗？

src: Will you resign your charge and swear to unvex the beings of this world?
zh: 你愿辞去职责，立誓不再扰害这世间众生吗？

src: Will you sing and work with me, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
zh: 你愿与我一同唱着干活吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

src: Willowy: This item weighs much less than normal.

Wind off the Great Desert cools a touch and gives up moisture. Just enough. A tongue can taste a hundred kinds of wind, y'know?

Anywhile, that's where my wandering mind goes. More's about Joppa I say speak to our Elderfriend. Irudad. Up northwise the path.
zh:
大沙漠吹来的风稍稍凉下来，就会吐出水分。刚刚好。你知道吗，舌头能尝出上百种风的味道？

总之，我这心思又飘远了。想多了解约帕，就去找我们的长老朋友伊鲁达德说话。沿路往北走。

src: Wind presses a fringed thawb and neckdress against a human form. The fabric is embroidered to rhyme with patterns in the salt and star-cut sky.
zh: 风将一件缀着流苏的长袍与颈饰压贴在一具人形之上。织物上的刺绣与盐中的纹路、星空所裁的苍穹相互应和。

src: Wind presses a sunbleached thawb and neckdress against a humanoid form. The fabric is embroidered to rhyme with patterns in the salt.
zh: 风将一件晒褪了色的长袍与颈饰紧贴在一具人形之上。织物上所绣的花样，与盐地中的纹路彼此押韵。

src: Wind-nosy stigma and style reach from the pocket of a gallant bloom.
zh: 探风的柱头与花柱，自一朵昂然盛放之花的囊中伸了出来。

src: Wine, cheese, bread. =player.FormalAddressTerm=, tell me, is there anything else you truly need?
zh: 酒、奶酪、面包。=player.FormalAddressTerm=，告诉我，你当真还需要别的什么吗？

src: Wire, twine, and thread tangle from spools strapped to =pronouns.possessive= vest. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:sport:afterpronoun= a ruffled cloak of unknown fashion.
zh: 铁丝、麻线与棉线自缚在=pronouns.possessive=背心上的线轴间缠结垂落。=pronouns.Subjective=披着一件褶边披风，式样前所未见。

src: Wired metal squares a cabinet of drawers and burners for toasting, pickling, and freeze-drying.
zh: 金属丝网围成一具柜橱，内设抽屉与炉头，可烘烤、腌渍与冻干。
