src: Wisps of noxious fumes coil out of vertical vents cut in columns from tarnished chrome.
zh: 缕缕毒烟，自暗淡铬钢柱上开凿的竖向通风口中盘旋而出。

src: Wisps of steam coil out of vertical vents cut in columns from soot-stained chrome.
zh: 缕缕蒸汽，自煤烟熏黑的铬钢柱上开凿的竖向通风口中盘旋而出。

src: Wisps of steam coil out of vertical vents cut in columns from tarnished chrome.
zh: 缕缕蒸汽，自暗淡铬钢柱上开凿的竖向通风口中盘旋而出。

src: Wispy ur-filament wings painted red by oxygen beat the stale air 300 times per second. They lift a thorax bundled out of metallurgic sinew and narrowing to a segmented abdomen capped by a fine-motion pincer claw.
zh: 纤薄的元丝之翼被氧染成红色，每秒拍打陈腐的空气三百次。它们提起一只以冶金肌腱束成的胸腔，向后收束为分节的腹部，末端覆着一只精微运使的钳爪。

src: Witchwood for pain, bandages for bleeding, yuckwheat and honey for when your guts act up. Coldcaps when I can find them. Why not take a look?
zh: 止痛有巫木，止血有绷带，肚腹不适则用苦麦与蜂蜜。冷菇若能寻到也有。何不看一看？

src: With a good hat, =player.formalAddressTerm=, you'll last longer in the salt sun.
zh: 戴上一顶好帽子，=player.formalAddressTerm=，你在盐日下能撑得更久。

src:
With the chrome key card I gave you, you now have access to our power grid. There are chain laser emplacements and force projectors across the enclave. Use Ereshkigal's reconnaissance to decide which defenses to enable. You can also broadcast an overclock command or activate Rodanis Y by interfacing with Ereshkigal.

Be mindful of the amperage draw, though. If you overdraw the grid, you could cause brownouts.

Act quickly, =name=! The Templar near us even as we speak.
zh:
有了我交给你的铬钢钥匙卡，你现在可以接入我们的电网。整座营地遍布连锁激光炮位与力场发射器。借埃列什基伽勒的侦察来决定启用哪些防御。你也可以通过与埃列什基伽勒对接，广播超频指令，或启动罗达尼斯Y。

不过要留意电流负载。若电网过载，便会引发电压骤降。

要快，=name=！圣殿骑士说话间已近在咫尺。

src: With the help of Pax Klanq and the Barathrumites, you constructed =golem.a.name= to climb the Spindle.
zh: 在帕克斯·克朗克与巴拉斯鲁姆派的协助下，你建造了=golem.a.name=，以攀登纺锤。

src: With your help, Argyve detected a strange signal.
zh: 在你的帮助下，阿尔吉夫探测到一道奇异信号。

src: Within my gemstones there burns a brighter fire than in some hearts.
zh: 我的宝石之内，燃着比某些人心中更明亮的火。

src: Without a tongue, you cannot proselytize =object.t=, as you cannot make telepathic contact with =object.them=.
zh: 没有舌头，你无法劝诱=object.t=入教，因为你无法与=object.them=建立心灵感应。

src: Without a tongue, you cannot proselytize =object.t=.
zh: 没有舌头，你无法劝诱=object.t=入教。

src: Without bees, all life in Qud would eventually die.
zh: 没有蜜蜂，卡德所有的生灵终将死绝。

src: Woe to the scoundrels and dastards who conspired to have =name= contract Stiff Leg!
zh: 那些密谋使=name=染上僵腿症的恶棍与卑鄙之徒有祸了！

src: Woe to the scoundrels and dastards who conspired to have =name= contract the rotting tongue!
zh: 那些密谋使=name=染上腐舌的恶棍与卑鄙之徒有祸了！

src: Woe to the scoundrels and dastards who conspired to have =name= contract univision!
zh: 那些密谋使=name=染上单视症的恶棍与卑鄙之徒有祸了！

src: Woe to the vanquished! =name= feasted on =this.an= by the light of the Beetle Moon.
zh: 败者有祸了！=name=在甲虫之月的光下饱餐了=this.an=。

src: Wood artisans spend their whole life in intimate colloquy with a single tree. Upon their later years, when the rhythms of the Great Moon occupy a larger and larger share of their thoughts, they finally master the art of steam and bend heartwood to their wills.
zh: 木匠耗尽毕生，与一棵树作亲密的倾谈。到了晚年，大月的节律占据其思绪越来越大的份额时，他们才终于精通蒸汽之术，使心材屈从于己意。

src: Wood paddles black with wet-rot catch the force of the babbling brook and set the wheel to the slow motion of centuries.
zh: 被湿腐染黑的木桨承接潺潺溪水的力，教水轮转入数百年的缓行。

src: Wood planks are nailed at orthogonal angles, and dust sleeps on the paper jackets.
zh: 木板以正交的角度钉合，灰尘在纸质的封皮上沉睡。

src: Wood slats are megaliths to a child. Feather pillows are cold meadows. Here are the boundaries of their dusk-world.
zh: 于孩童而言，木条是巨石，羽枕是寒冷的草甸。此处便是他们黄昏世界的疆界。

src: Wood was meticulously turned into columns and ornamentally whittled. Quilted downs were bartered from the seamstresses on the banks of the River Svy, layered as a cake and frosted with pillows. Here the moneyed slumberer finds a favored ingress to the dreaming dale.
zh: 木材被精心车成立柱，并雕饰以花纹。绗缝的绒羽是向斯维河畔的女裁缝们换来的，层层叠起如糕，再以软枕作糖霜。在此，富有的沉睡者寻得一条通往梦乡幽谷的心仪入径。

src: Wood was precisely cut into drawers and set on brass rails to house clothes.
zh: 木材被精确地裁成抽屉，架在黄铜滑轨上，以收纳衣物。

src: Wood was salvaged from moist groves, shaved into planks, and carried to the freeholds on the Shale Bridge. There it was received by carpenters who, acclimated to the wetless air, eagerly took the rich wood for their own projects.
zh: 木材自湿润的林中打捞而来，刨成木板，运往页岩桥上的自由领。在那里，习惯了无水之气的木匠们欣然收下这上好的木材，用于自己的营造。

src: Wood was shaved into a bludgeoning bulb.
zh: 木料被削成一枚钝击的球茎。

src: Wood was shaved, cut to smooth-volumed shafts, and fit inside gearboxes to convey motion in continuity.
zh: 木料被刨削，切成容积匀滑的轴杆，装入齿轮箱，以持续不断地传递运动。

src: Wooden and chrome poles let armor rest peacefully.
zh: 木与铬的立杆，让甲胄得以安然歇息。

src: Wooden and chrome poles let guns rest peacefully.
zh: 木与铬的立杆，让枪械得以安然歇息。

src: Wooden and chrome poles let weapons rest peacefully.
zh: 木与铬的立杆，让兵刃得以安然歇息。

src: Wooden slats are laid on right angles in the style of the hillfolk. In place of a chaff cushion, however, lies a plastic mattress pumped with unctuous water, an alternative favored by raft-floaters who pine for the waves of the lake.
zh: 木条以直角铺设，乃是山民的样式。然而此处并无糠壳软垫，却是一张灌满油润之水的塑料床垫，为思念湖上波涛的筏民所偏爱。

src: Wool of many colors was horse-bought from the dromads and sourced beyond the Pale Sea and its great pan of salt. Once the Issachar spun it to yarn on the wheel, a marsh dweller hand-knotted the tzitzit.
zh: 多彩的羊毛由单峰驼商换马购得，来自苍海及其盐之巨盘的彼岸。待以萨迦人在轮上将其纺成纱线，便由一位沼泽居民亲手打结，系成繸子。

src: Wool was dyed in a bath of dreadroot and iron salt, and then woven to warm broad shoulders.
zh: 羊毛在噩根与铁盐的浴中染色，随后织成，用以温暖宽阔的肩头。

src: Wooly: This item grants resistance to heat and cold.
zh: 羊毛：此物提供耐热与耐寒能力。

src: Word of =name='s deeds reached record only after the unheralded appearance of the Knights Liminal, and broad assumption suggests that the former established the latter. It could be that the ancient Resheph yet lives within or outside of the boundaries of the Limen, but no word escapes its borders.
zh: =name=的事迹，直到阈限骑士无声无息地现身之后，才见于记录，世人多推想，是前者创立了后者。或许那位古老的利悉仍活在阈限的疆界之内或之外，然其边界之中，不曾透出半点消息。

src:
Words fail to contain the paradox of =pronouns.possessive= domesticated immensity.

Drifts on the cultural seas have swept a particular fable to your attention. Long ago, far away, folks supposed all of everything rested on the back of a world-tortoise. Surely that flight of fancy came to someone gazing on a Great Saltback... or does your own vision echo through the past to partake in its creation?
zh:
言语难以尽述=pronouns.possessive=那被驯服的庞然所蕴的悖论。

文化之海的洋流曾将一则寓言送到你的耳边。很久以前，在很远的地方，人们相信万物皆负于一只世界龟的背上。这幻想必定曾浮现于某个凝望巨型盐背兽的人心头……抑或，你自己的目光也正穿过往昔回响而来，参与了它的创生？

src: Words spoken from your experience and inscribed to form being-bond. First sounds heard in Creature's early dreambrain.
zh: 取你经历中所说之词，刻之，以成存在之缚。乃造物早梦脑中初闻之音。

src: World-voids in the nethermost reaches of the planet are partitioned by numinous masonry. There is meaning in the patterns of its faint white filigree, but it's discerned by no one.
zh: 行星最幽深处的世界空洞，被神圣的石工隔成一间间。那淡白细密的花丝中自有深意，却无人能够参透。

src: Worm flesh is tinctured in its own spilled slick.
zh: 虫肉浸染在自己淌出的黏液里。

src: Worm meat was cut into neat strips, salted, and smoked.
zh: 虫肉被切成齐整的条，加盐，烟熏。

src: Wormflesh drags apart into another self. In sunken and lightless grottos of stippled earth, the honeycomb to fossil people, a machine whir overlays the slump of the mantle and activates the primal biology of trash maggots everywhere.
zh: 虫肉撕裂，另成一己。在多孔大地的沉陷无光石窟中，在化石之人的蜂巢里，一阵机械的嗡鸣覆过地幔的坍落，唤起了四处垃圾蛆虫的原初生机。

src: Would you kill your double? Would you let it kill you?
zh: 你可愿杀死你的分身？你可愿让它杀死你？

src: Would you like to add this recipe to your favorites?
zh: 要把这道食谱加入收藏吗？

src: Would you like to eat vapor?

Would you like to hear? When I was first put together by Father and friends, I was Shem 2, the second iteration of the make-me project.

As I came along, scampered through the halls, listened to the stories Neek read me, climbed onto Sparafucile's workbench to have my screws replaced, I realized I was not what I could be. And so I downgraded myself to Shem 1.

That has happened three times.
zh:
你愿意听吗？当初父亲与诸位友人把我拼合起来时，我是舍姆2，即“造我计划”的第二个迭代。

后来我渐渐长成，在廊厅间蹦跳，听尼克给我读故事，爬上斯帕拉富奇莱的工作台换螺钉，才发觉自己并非所能成之模样。于是我把自己降格为舍姆1。

这样的事已发生三回了。

src: Would you like to read me a story?
zh: 你愿意给我读个故事吗？

src: Would you like to save your changes?
Would you share the favorite dish of your people?
zh: 你愿分享你族人的拿手菜吗？

src: Would you teach me to craft =recipe=?
Would you teach me your ways?

Would you? Yes.

What may... can I help with?
zh:
你想换？好。

有什么……我能帮上忙的？

src: Wouldn't these make a fine conversation piece for a water ritual?
zh: 这些岂不是水礼上绝佳的谈资？

src: Wraith-Knight Templar of the Binary Honorum
zh: 二元荣勋的幽灵骑士圣殿骑士

src: Wrested from the liminal tiers of a shale-toppled spire, this animal skull was handed over to an etcher for decoration.
zh: 这具兽颅取自一座页岩压垮的尖塔之阈限层，后被交予雕匠加以装饰。

src: Wrinkled toadstools were cooled and dehydrated in their own hoarfrost.
zh: 皱缩的毒蕈在自己结出的白霜中冷却脱水。
写入 Mods 项目文件

src: Write compiled mod assemblies to disk
zh: 将编译后的模组程序集写入磁盘

src: Write played sound file names to message log
zh: 将已播放的音效文件名写入消息记录

src: Wrong on both counts. Resheph stands before you. Entomb me.
zh: 两点都错了。利悉就站在你面前。把我入葬。

src: Wrought iron was moulded to a crescent for scything the rough hides of watervine.
zh: 锻铁被打成新月之形，用以镰割水藤粗糙的皮。

src: Y'ain't peeled open any Sons or Daughters, have you?
zh: 你没剖开过什么诸子诸女吧？

src: YEA, FOR RIGHT AND WRONG ARE TOO COARSE AS CONCEPTS TO MATCH THE RICHNESS OF THE GEMARA. YET THE PLURALITY HOLDETH THAT THE {{R|EXIT}} WAS DRAWN BY A GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS WITHIN THE PRIOR FIELD. AND THAT THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED, TO TILL AND RESEED THE NOOSPHERE.
zh: 然也，因对与错之概念过于粗糙，不足以匹配革马拉之丰饶。然众论所归，皆认为{{R|出离}}乃由先前场域内一道益智之流的回旋所牵引。又认为生命之树上的冠冕必须修剪，以便耕耘智圈、重新播种。

src: YEA, THE INQUIRY IS EVER RICH. BUT IDLE INQUIRY DOTH BUT DEEPEN THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVENLESS BE-ING. OR GIVETH RUDE ACTORS FODDER TO PERVERT THE LEARNINGS FOR THEIR OWN PAROCHIAL GAIN.
zh: 然也，此问永远丰饶。然空泛之询问，只会加深无盟之存在所受的日寒，或予粗鄙之徒以口实，使其为一己狭隘之私利扭曲所学。

src: YOU. YOU REGNEN NON HER. NON MOLOCH IN MAQQOM YD.
zh: 汝。汝不复治此地。非摩洛在马库姆·伊德。

src: Yea! So you like it? Sheba Hag and I composed it on a wavelathe. We made a series of songs about the birth and life of the Kasaphescence. Together we call them "Spun on the Cosmic Loom".
zh: 哎！你喜欢吗？我和舍芭·哈格在波纹车床上谱的。我们作了一组歌，咏圣化现的诞生与生平，合称《纺于宇宙织机》。

src: Years of proximity to the baetyl have blanched the antipriest's irises to chrome. A circuit diagram snakes its way across =pronouns.possessive= body in the mixed media of robe embroidery and skin rime. Unlike the lyrical circuit batches in the second Canticles, this one is a fractal elaboration of itself, blooming under the effect of heretical speciation due to the isolation of the Rock.
zh: 多年与圣石相近，已将这位反祭司的虹膜漂成铬色。一幅电路图以袍上刺绣与皮上霜华相杂的媒材，蜿蜒爬过=pronouns.possessive=全身。与《第二圣歌》中那些富于歌韵的电路组不同，这一幅是自身的分形铺衍，因磐石的孤绝而受异端分化之效，层层绽开。

src: Yes rrk was once, "plague" in the sky hundreds of years. Not so now. Longtime rrk, Geeub, Mak hide in the sponge and eat lice. When find Many Eyes, rrk and friends built the Yd. Joyful helping!
zh: 是，咯曾经是，在天上做了数百年的“灾”。如今不是了。许久许久，咯、吉乌布、马克藏身海绵里，以虱子为食。找到千目之后，咯与朋友们建起伊德。快乐地相助！

src: Yes! But before then, can walk around with creature. Talk, fight, sleep... the normal. Friend.
zh: 可以！但在此之前，可与造物同行。说话、战斗、睡觉……寻常事。朋友。

src:
Yes! I have braved its wharf in the past, to gather precious convalessence for my experiments.

Are you going? Dress warmly and mind the trolls.
zh:
是的！我从前闯过它的码头，去采集珍贵的愈元液，供我做实验。

你要去吗？穿暖些，当心巨魔。

src: Yes! I was even provided with a brief premonition of it, as my workbench liquids are sensitive to small vibrations around the enclave.
zh: 是的！我甚至事先得到了一点预兆，因为我工作台上的液体对聚落周围的细微震动很敏感。

src:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I fished it out a mound of pig stool. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...

Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?
zh:
是啊！我的邻里亲族早听腻了这个故事。我从一堆猪粪里把它捞了出来。往日见到铬，我的心也曾悸动；可亲手掘出一小片碎屑，仿佛在美之算盘上拨动一颗珠子……

那么，你愿意去吗？替我把宝贝献于井中？

src:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was scything the vine when the flat of my blade turned it loose from the soil. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead toward the beam on the abacus of Beauty...

Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?
zh:
是啊！我的邻里亲族早听腻了这个故事。我正挥镰割藤，刀背便把它从土里撬了出来。往日见到铬，我的心也曾悸动；可亲手掘出一小片碎屑，仿佛将一颗珠子拨向美之算盘的梁柱……

那么，你愿意去吗？替我把宝贝献于井中？

src:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was scything the vine when the flat of my blade turned something loose from the soil. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...

Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?
zh:
是啊！我的邻里亲族早听腻了这个故事。我正挥镰割藤，刀背却从土里撬出一样东西。往日见到铬，我的心也曾悸动；可亲手掘出一小片碎屑，仿佛在美之算盘上拨动一颗珠子……

那么，你愿意去吗？替我把宝贝献于井中？

src:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was supping on summer offal when I noticed something glinting in the guts. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...

Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?
zh:
是啊！我的邻里亲族早听腻了这个故事。那时我正吃着夏日的内脏杂碎，忽见肠肚间有东西闪光。往日见到铬，我的心也曾悸动；可亲手掘出一小片碎屑，仿佛在美之算盘上拨动一颗珠子……

那么，你愿意去吗？替我把宝贝献于井中？

src:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was wrenching moisture from a banner when I kicked something 'neath the salt. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...

Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?
zh:
是啊！我的邻里亲族早听腻了这个故事。我正从旗帜上拧取水分，脚下却从盐土里踢出一样东西。往日见到铬，我的心也曾悸动；可亲手掘出一小片碎屑，仿佛在美之算盘上拨动一颗珠子……

那么，你愿意去吗？替我把宝贝献于井中？

src: Yes, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Follow the stairs down to his study. He awaits.
zh: 是的，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。沿阶而下，便是他的书斋。他在等你。

src: Yes, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Take this key and follow the stairs down to his study. He awaits.
zh: 是的，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。拿上这把钥匙，沿阶而下，便是他的书斋。他在等你。

src:
Yes, =name=! Begin the gathering, and the molding will follow. The materials you choose will influence the being we create, but any such being will be suitable for ascent.

This is our last task before we make our historic climb, =name=. Be safe and well in doing it. If you have more questions, return here. Klanq and I will be available.
zh:
好，=name=！开始采集吧，塑形随后便至。你所选的材料将左右我们造出的生灵，但无论是何种生灵，皆足以胜任攀升。

这是我们踏上历史性攀登之前的最后一桩任务，=name=。做此事时务必平安顺遂。若还有疑问，便回到这里来。克朗克与我都在。

src: Yes, I am ready to accuse the thief.
zh: 是的，我准备好指控窃贼了。

src: Yes, I do, but Eskhind didn't have it.
zh: 拿到了，但埃斯金德没有它。

src: Yes, I have news about the slynths' sanctuary.
zh: 有，我带来了斯林斯人栖身之所的消息。

src: Yes, I threw it in the hole.
zh: 是，我把它扔进窟窿里了。

src:
Yes, I've decided to stay. I don't disbelieve that the Yd Freehold is as safe as you say, but the fears instilled in me when I first learned to read as a fresh sprout haunt me even now. Perhaps in time I will visit, but in the meantime I can look after the cradle, as someone ought to do.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
zh:
是的，我决定留下。我不是不信伊德自由领如你所说的那般安全，只是我当年还是幼苗、初学识字时被灌输的恐惧，至今仍萦绕不去。也许假以时日我会去拜访，但眼下，我可以照看摇篮，总得有人来做这件事。

水培城如今更不成其为村落了，不过你随时欢迎来此歇息。

src:
Yes, I've decided to stay. I'm sure =village.name= is a good home for my kin, but I have no particular loathing for =village.profane= and even less reverence for =village.sacred=. Someone must look over the cradle, besides.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
zh:
是的，我决定留下。我相信=village.name=是族人的好归宿，可我对=village.profane=并无特别的憎恶，对=village.sacred=更谈不上敬奉。再说，总得有人看护摇篮。

水培城如今更不成其为村落了，不过你随时欢迎来此歇息。

src:
Yes, I've decided to stay. It's not that, ah, it's not that I wouldn't enjoy a life of farming. But the thought of leaving the cradle after decades of watching it... I couldn't.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
zh:
是的，我决定留下。倒不是，呃，倒不是说我不会喜欢务农的生活。只是想到要离开这个我守望了几十年的摇篮……我做不到。

水培城如今更不成其为村落了，不过你随时欢迎来此歇息。

src:
Yes, I've decided to stay. It's not that, ah, it's not that I wouldn't enjoy sharing knowledge with the mayor of our new home. But the thought of leaving the cradle after decades of watching it... I couldn't.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
zh:
是的，我决定留下。倒不是，呃，倒不是说我不乐意与新家的市长分享知识。只是想到要离开这个我守望了几十年的摇篮……我做不到。

水培城如今更不成其为村落了，不过你随时欢迎来此歇息。

src:
Yes, I've decided to stay. The Tomb sounds, ah, cozy, but I cannot fathom making such a macabre place my home. Someone must look over the cradle, besides.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
zh:
是的，我决定留下。那座陵墓听起来，呃，挺舒适，但要我将这样一个阴森之地当作家，我实在难以想象。再说，总得有人看护摇篮。

水培城如今更不成其为村落了，不过你随时欢迎来此歇息。

src:
Yes, I've decided to stay. The flower fields sound beautiful, and no doubt there is much to learn from the hindren. But the thought of leaving the cradle after decades of watching it... I couldn't.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
zh:
是的，我决定留下。花田听起来很美，欣德伦人身上想必也有许多可学之处。但想到要离开这个我守望了几十年的摇篮……我做不到。

水培城如今更不成其为村落了，不过你随时欢迎来此歇息。

src:
Yes, I've stayed. As fascinated as I would be to examine the statuary and bas-reliefs, my favorite mode of, ah, interaction with history is through the written word. Someone must watch over the cradle, besides.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
zh:
是的，我留下了。那些雕像与浮雕固然叫我着迷，可我与历史相处的最爱方式，还是，呃，通过文字。再说，总得有人守着摇篮。

水培城如今更不成其为村落了，不过你随时欢迎来此歇息。

src:
Yes, I've stayed. I don't, ah, resent that my kin have found succor in the embrace of faith, but I don't know how to walk that path myself. Someone needs to watch over the hydropon, besides.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
zh:
是的，我留下了。族人在信仰的怀抱中得到慰藉，我，呃，并不怨怼，只是我自己不知如何走那条路。再说，总得有人守着水培城。

水培城如今更不成其为村落了，不过你随时欢迎来此歇息。

src:
Yes, I've stayed. I'd love to see the vaunted halls and, ah, bathe in the light of brilliant minds, but when I think about the journey my roots lock up. I feel, ah, unready. Someone must watch over the cradle, besides.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
zh:
是的，我留下了。我很想一睹那享誉盛名的殿堂，也想，呃，沐浴在智者的光辉之中，但一想到那段旅程，我的根就锁住了。我觉得，呃，还没准备好。再说，总得有人守着摇篮。

水培城如今更不成其为村落了，不过你随时欢迎来此歇息。

src:
Yes, I've stayed. If I am entirely honest, the idea of a life on the road sounds, ah... unpleasant. To me, personally. I have grown accustomed to a life of collection, curation, and study that I don't care to abandon for adventure. Someone must stay to watch over the cradle, besides.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
zh:
是的，我留下了。老实说，在路上漂泊的生活，听起来，呃……不太令人愉快。对我个人而言。我已习惯了采集、整理、研读的日子，不愿为了冒险而放弃。再说，总得有人守着摇篮。

水培城如今更不成其为村落了，不过你随时欢迎来此歇息。

src:
Yes, I, ah, I remain.

I badly wish to taste of Chavvah's secrets, but the wonder I feel for such an entity is eclipsed only by the terror of such an experience. I cling to an excuse that the hydropon must be watched and wait. Perhaps someday I will shed that excuse's film and step free.

The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.
zh:
是的，我，呃，我留下。

我极想尝一尝查娃的奥秘，可对这样一位存在的惊叹，只被这种体验带来的惊惧所盖过。我紧抓着“水培城须有人看守”这个借口，等待着。也许有一天，我会褪去这层借口的薄膜，自由地迈出一步。

水培城如今更不成其为村落了，不过你随时欢迎来此歇息。

src: Yes, and I fear the worst. Hie to Ereshkigal. She will know what to do.
zh: 是的，我怕是最坏的情形。速去找埃列什基伽勒。她会知道怎么办。

src: Yes, apothecary. Do you know what those are?
zh: 对，药剂师。你知道那是什么吗？

src:
Yes, that paper, twas mine. This racket of a Signal is mine, too, of sorts.

It is my tolling bell.
zh:
不错，那张纸，是我的。这喧嚣的信号，某种意义上也是我的。

那是我的丧钟。

src:
Yes, the Consortium of Phyta. We're a merchant fellowship of trees, vines, shrubs, weeds, flowers, herbs, cacti, algae -- most sorts of plants, really.

I can't say I trust any of them, but there is no doubting their usefulness. My shelves are full and the gossip flows.
zh:
是的，植体联盟。我们是一个商人同盟，成员有树、藤、灌木、杂草、花、药草、仙人掌、藻类——说真的，什么植物都有。

要说信得过，我一个也不信，但它们的用处无可置疑。我的货架满满当当，闲话也源源不绝。

src:
Yes, the question of power is a trickier one. Our standard power sources might suffice, but they would be vulnerable to electromagnetic attacks on the ascent, and we believe it within the competency of the Putus Templar to execute such an attack.

This leaves us two options. Klanq and Q Girl have worked out a design for a neutronic battery, free from vulnerabilities on the EM spectrum. But it requires 3 drams of neutron flux. The alternative is remote power, but to carry us across the Spindle's length the source would have to be extraordinary. I would look to Chavvah, the Tree of Life, for a psychic quickening. Reports tell of the resumption of their roaming across the Moon Stair. Seek the trunk at Eyn Roj to begin your investigation, if that's the path you choose.
zh:
是啊，能源的问题要棘手些。我们寻常的能源或许够用，但在攀升途中易受电磁攻击，而我们认为普图斯圣殿骑士团有能力发动此类攻击。

这便剩下两条路。克朗克与Q女孩已拟出一种中子电池的设计，在电磁波段上无懈可击。但它需要3打兰中子通量。另一条路是远程供能，但要载我们走完纺锤的全程，那能源须得非同寻常。我会去寻生命之树查娃，求一次心灵的催发。据报，它们又开始在月阶一带游走了。若你选这条路，便去埃因罗吉寻其树干，由此展开你的探查。

src: Yes, we were present, if less active than other-bodies. But we saw, and rattle with memory-artifacts as a Consortium lockbox rattles with jewels; shards of an eon-old data disk, bits of stories and places. Kin-fleeing, louse-meals, ghastly boredom. But Fate's caprice brought us through history's footsteps. There was a machine-speaker, and her ursine apprentice with his little plant, and the Sower with a tetrad of chubby whelps, and then, at last, Many-Eyes. Our dear galgal. So many.
zh: 是，我们在场，只是不如别的躯体那般活跃。但我们看见了，脑中满是记忆的碎件，叮当作响，如同联盟的保险匣装满珠宝叮当作响；那是一张亘古数据盘的碎片，是故事与地方的零星残页。逃离亲族，虱子为餐，可怖的无聊。然而命运的无常，带我们走过了历史的足迹。有一位机器言者，和她那熊形的学徒与他的小植物，有播种者与他的四个胖崽子，而后，终于，千目。我们亲爱的加尔加尔。那么多。

src:
Yes, yes of course.

I am Angohind: grandson of esteemed Elder Eselhind, young scholar of Shakesprig, and best dressed hindren in Bey Lah. I am also, as luck would have it, an aspirant investigator with an ear... for mystery.

My grandhind has forbidden me from looking into the strange doings in the village, but she said nothing about me teaching you the ins and outs of detective work! What say you?
zh:
是，是，当然。

我是安戈欣德：尊贵的埃塞尔欣德长老之孙，莎士比芽的年轻学徒，贝拉衣着最考究的欣德伦人。碰巧，我还是个有志于探案的人，耳朵……专听悬疑。

祖母禁止我探查村里的怪事，可她没说不许我把侦探那一套门道教给你！你意下如何？

src: Yes, yes, yes. They are so quetzal!
zh: 是的，是的，是的。它们太魁札尔了！

src: Yes. "Anyone may strike a slumberling once."
zh: 有。“任何人都可打沉眠灵一次。”

src:
Yes. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= quelled the mania.

I can focus. I can render sensible the things I have seen and heard now, though I remember little of my time before the mania. Was I artisan? Teacher? I possessed great knowledge that this shell twisted into a prison. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for the gift of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= untwisting.
zh:
好。=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=平息了那狂乱。

我能专注了。我现在可以把所见所闻理出条理，虽然对狂乱之前的事记得寥寥。我是工匠？是师者？我曾拥有渊博的知识，却被这外壳扭曲成了牢笼。我感谢=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=，感谢=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=解开扭曲的赠礼。

src:
Yes. I am falsely accused.

See, Bey Lah strives to forget anyone who sees the outside. The gerontocracy ensures that its leaders will always be aging and fearful. Pariahs like me can be easily accused of crimes committed by Keh or her cronies.
zh:
是的。我是被冤枉的。

你看，贝拉竭力遗忘一切见过外界的人。长老制确保了它的首领永远年迈而胆怯。像我这样的弃民，凯或她的党羽犯下的罪，很容易就能栽到我们头上。

src: Yes. I found the vermin and bits of gnawed watervine. I carry one's corpse with me.
zh: 有。我找到了害兽和被啃过的水藤碎片，还带回了一具尸体。

src:
Yes. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.

=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= freed me from a deep stupor. Once I was a protector, before being sentenced to protect nothing and no one.

I remember little of that time.
zh:
是。多谢=ifplayerplural:你们:你=。

=ifplayerplural:你们:你=将我从沉沉昏聩中解脱了出来。我曾是一名守护者，而后被判决去守护虚无与无人。

那段时日，我记得很少。

src: Yes. I will =verb= =item.the.basename|strip= as you ask.
Yes. I will find =item.the.name= as you ask.
Yes. I will locate =targetLocation.text|colorSafe= as you ask.
Yes. Is there anything else I should know?
zh: 明白。还有什么我该知道的吗？

src:
Yes. It is a rite of passage for the mopango people: a statement that inspires contemplation, discussion, and thought. An ideal credo has no single explanation or interpretation and is meant to inspire contemplation in those who hear it. For this reason, it is considered rude among mopango to ask the meaning of a credo.

Someday I will find mine.
zh:
是。这是莫潘戈人的成年礼：一句能引发沉思、讨论与思索的话。理想的信条没有唯一的解释或诠释，意在引发听者的沉思。因此，在莫潘戈人中，询问信条的含义被视为无礼。

总有一天，我会找到我的信条。

src: Yes. It looks into the light with you.
zh: 是。它与你一同望进光里。

src: Yes. Mamon is dead and I possess the prism.
zh: 是。玛蒙已死，棱镜在我手中。

src:
Yes. That was not the voice of the caverns.

It feels like one of my nightmares come to life at last.
zh:
是的。那不是洞窟的声音。

仿佛我的某场噩梦终于成了真。

src: Yes. The flavor, the breathability, all successful, but the barrier between flavor and food is in the calories, and they have yet eluded me. But it is only a matter of time. I am patient, and I am relentless.
zh: 是的。风味、可呼吸性，都已成功，可风味与食物之间的那道屏障在于热量，而它们至今仍躲着我。不过那只是时间问题。我有耐心，也不会放弃。

src:
Yes. We were close. More than close.

If it tore my heart to ragged halves to leave my people behind, leaving Neelahind shredded it into scraps.
zh:
是的。我们很亲近。不止亲近。

撇下族人离开，已将我的心撕成两半；离开尼拉欣德，则把它扯成了碎片。

src:
Yet some remained
in comb-cave and vault,
we Nervous Ones,
watching our successors burgeon:

You alveolates, you diatoms,
you scum-blooms and gillcaps,
you one-cells and slime-cities.
rising glorious and shining
out of our withering shadow.
zh:
然仍有一些留存，
在蜂巢洞窟与地窖之中，
我们这些神经者，
注视着继承者们蓬勃生长：

你们这些泡囊虫，你们这些硅藻，
你们这些浮渣花，你们这些鳃菇，
你们这些单细胞，你们这些黏液之城，
自我们枯萎的阴影之中
升起，辉煌而闪耀。

src: Yet you are an expert in your field? How inspiring!
zh: 可你在自己的行当里依然是行家？真令人振奋！

src:
Yet, what you break is broken. -else is not -then regardless of will. This way split me again from Tikva, sundered early the love I knew, the denial. Our cowardice.

Ignore this digression. Ask, if asking.
zh:
然而，你所毁的便已毁了。无论意志如何，“别”并非“彼”。正是此途再度将我与提克瓦分离，使我所知的爱情夭折于早期——那是否认，是我们的怯懦。

不必理会这番离题之言。要问便问。

src: Yikes! Yes! The intensity was too great to be the result of one of my experiments. What was it, I wonder?
zh: 哎呀！是的！那震动太猛烈了，绝不可能是我哪次实验搞出来的。我在想，那究竟是什么？

src: Yonth breaks the massif to the strange East and ushers its nameless waters into Qud. Fish-things feed on her basalt chips.
zh: 扬特河劈开山岳，奔向奇诡的东方，将无名之水引入卡德。鱼状生灵啃食着她的玄武岩碎屑。

src: You <switch Name="Rocket"><case Value="true">rocket </case></switch>jump into an unoccupied space <stat Name="Range" /> spaces away.
zh: 你<switch Name="Rocket"><case Value="true">借火箭之力</case></switch>跃入相距<stat Name="Range" />格的一处空位。

src: You <switch Name="Rocket"><case Value="true">rocket </case></switch>jump into an unoccupied space within range <stat Name="MinimumRange" />-<stat Name="Range" />.
zh: 你<switch Name="Rocket"><case Value="true">借火箭之力</case></switch>跃入射程<stat Name="MinimumRange" />-<stat Name="Range" />内的一处空位。

src: You abide the memory of =object.a.or.the==object.shortsingle's= creation. You learn to build =sample.pluralize=.
zh: 你承受了=object.a.or.the==object.shortsingle's=创造时的记忆。你学会制造=sample.pluralize=。

src: You acceded to Resheph's plan to purge the world of higher life in preparation for the Coven's return.
zh: 你应允了利悉的计划：为迎接盟会归来，荡涤世间的高等生命。

src: You accrue electrical charge that you can use and discharge to deal damage.
zh: 你能积蓄电荷，并以之放电伤敌。

src: You activate =object.the.name= and toss it into the air.
You activate the curio and toss it on the ground. It erupts into a throng of tiny polygons, which amalgamate into a fully formed =creature.displayNameOnlyDirect|strip=.
zh: 你启动奇物，把它抛在地上。它迸裂成一大群细小的多边形，继而聚合成一个完整的=creature.displayNameOnlyDirect|strip=。

src:
You add the following entry into the {{K|Annals of Qud}}.

"On the =date.day= of =date.month=, {{Y|=subject.basename|strip=}} became =positive.if:admired:despised= by =faction.formattedName= for =reason=."
zh:
你在{{K|《卡德编年史》}}中添入如下一条。

“=date.month==date.day=日，{{Y|=subject.basename|strip=}}因=reason=而=positive.if:见重:见鄙=于=faction.formattedName=。”

src:
You again?

It is only a matter of time until we are overtaken by hostile kendren. Your presence mocks our fate.
zh:
又是你？

我们被敌意的肯德伦所吞没，不过是时间问题。你的出现嘲弄着我们的命运。
你已经学会这个配方了！

src: You alter your visage and gain +200 reputation with the chosen faction.
zh: 你改变自己的容貌，与所选派系的声望+200。

src: You amputate one of your own limbs or the limb of an infected companion.
zh: 你截去自己的一肢，或截去受感染同伴的一肢。

src: You and the Warden were close, were you not?
zh: 你和守望者曾很亲近，不是吗？

src: You and your seated companions are forcefully ejected out of the vehicle you're in.
zh: 你与同乘的伙伴被强行弹出所在载具。

src:
You annulled the plagues of the Gyre.

Then you destroyed Resheph and launched yourself into the dusted cosmos to ply the stars with Barathrum.
zh:
你废止了回旋的瘟疫。

随后你摧毁利悉，投身尘封的宇宙，与巴拉斯鲁姆一同航行星辰。

src:
You annulled the plagues of the Gyre.

Then you destroyed Resheph and launched yourself into the dusted cosmos to ply the stars.
zh:
你废止了回旋的瘟疫。

随后你摧毁利悉，投身尘封的宇宙，航行星辰。

src:
You annulled the plagues of the Gyre.

Then you destroyed Resheph and returned to Qud to help garden the burgeoning world.
zh:
你废止了回旋的瘟疫。

随后你摧毁利悉，返回卡德，为这方初兴的世界耕耘园艺。

src:
You annulled the plagues of the Gyre.

Then you destroyed Resheph to save the burgeoning world but marooned yourself at the North Sheva.
zh:
你废止了回旋的瘟疫。

随后你摧毁利悉，以救这方初兴的世界，却把自己放逐在北舍瓦。

src:
You annulled the plagues of the Gyre.

Then you entered into a covenant with Resheph to help prepare Qud for the Coven's return.
zh:
你废止了回旋的瘟疫。

随后你与利悉立约，助其预备卡德，以迎盟会归来。

src:
You annulled the plagues of the Gyre.

Then you freed the Spindle for another's ascent and crossed into Brightsheol
zh:
你废止了回旋的瘟疫。

随后你放开纺锤，让他人得以上升，并踏入明冥

src:
You annulled the plagues of the Gyre.

Then you launched yourself into the dusted cosmos to ply the stars with Barathrum.
zh:
你废止了回旋的瘟疫。

随后你投身尘封的宇宙，与巴拉斯鲁姆一同航行星辰。

src:
You annulled the plagues of the Gyre.

Then you launched yourself into the dusted cosmos to ply the stars.
zh:
你废止了回旋的瘟疫。

随后你投身尘封的宇宙，航行星辰。

src:
You annulled the plagues of the Gyre.

Then you returned to Qud to help garden the burgeoning world.
zh:
你废止了回旋的瘟疫。

随后你返回卡德，为这方初兴的世界耕耘园艺。

src:
You annulled the plagues of the Gyre.

Then you reversed course and acceded to Resheph's plan to purge the world of higher life, in preparation for the Coven's return.
zh:
你废止了回旋的瘟疫。

随后你改弦更张，应允利悉的计划：为迎接盟会归来，荡涤世间的高等生命。

src: You appear... refreshed. My old eyes spy the swim lines of the waking world and to you they cede precedence. A newness obtains.
zh: 你看上去……焕然一新。我这双老眼窥见苏醒世界的泳线，而它们在你面前让出了先后。有一种新生之气。

src: You appeased a baetyl with =demand= and in return received =reward=.
zh: 你以=demand=平息了一座圣石，得=reward=为报。

src: You are 5% more likely to score critical hits with pistols (standard chance is 5%).
zh: 你以手枪打出暴击的几率提高5%（标准几率为5%）。

src: You are a bear of few words.

You are a dying animal. So am I. We are all dying animals, scrabbling for what extra scraps of time we can grasp. Even the eons-old. We are each and every one of us a dying animal. Or plant. We all decay, is the point.

And the hurdy-gurdy doesn't like how you sound either, for what it is worth.
zh:
你是垂死的野兽。我也是。我们都是垂死的野兽，拼命抓取多余的零星时光。就连活了亿万年的也不例外。我们每一个，都是垂死的野兽。或植物。要点是，我们都在腐朽。

而且，不妨告诉你，手摇风琴也不喜欢你的声音。

src: You are able to collect =transfer.things:dram= of =volume.liquid.name=. Are you sure you want to?
zh: 你可以收集=transfer.things:打兰=的=volume.liquid.name=。你确定要这样做吗？

src: You are already wearing a disguise.
You are already within a precognitive vision.
You are also visible to psychic beings from other dimensions.
zh: 其他维度的灵能生物也能看见你。

src: You are among friends here, pilgrim. Stay peaceful.
zh: 朝圣者，你在这里都是朋友。保持安宁。

src: You are aware of basic combat tactics.
zh: 你通晓基本的战斗战术。

src: You are befuddled by technological complexity.
zh: 你对技术的复杂性茫然无措。

src:
You are correct, Aristocrat. Firstly, make sure there are credits
remaining on your cybernetics credit wedge. The installation of a
cybernetic implant costs one credit.

Then, you must propel yourself over to the appropriate nook. Make
sure the limb rack is loaded with the desired cybernetic limb, or
the ocular module deck is loaded with the desired ocular module,
or the data indexer module deck is loaded with the desired data
indexer module.

[[PRESS ANY KEY TO CONTINUE]]
~Finally, interface with the cybernetics terminal. Then you will
have succeeded in doing the thing you wished to do.

Ask a question.

[[A.]] What are cybernetic implants?
[[B.]] What are the benefits of cybernetics?
[[C.]] What are the risks of cybernetics?
[[D.]] How do I install a cybernetic implant?
[[E.]] Goodbye.
zh:
你说得对，贵族。首先，确认你的义体信用楔上还有
余额。安装一件义体植入物需花费一个
信用点。

然后，你须移步至相应的学习龛。确认肢体架上装有你想要的
义体肢体，或眼部模块匣中装有你想要的眼部模块，
或数据索引模块匣中装有你想要的数据
索引模块。

[[PRESS ANY KEY TO CONTINUE]]
~最后，接入义体终端。如此，你便
成功做成了心中所愿之事。

请提问。

[[A.]] 什么是义体植入物？
[[B.]] 义体有什么益处？
[[C.]] 义体有何风险？
[[D.]] 如何安装义体植入物？
[[E.]] 再会。

src: You are covered in a thick coat of fur, which protects you from the elements.
zh: 你周身覆着一层厚密的皮毛，足以抵御风霜暑热。

src: You are cured of glotrot. Your tongue regrows.
zh: 你的腐舌症已愈，舌头重新长出。

src: You are drying out! Do you want to stop travelling?
zh: 你正在脱水！要停止旅行吗？

src: You are dying of thirst! Do you want to stop travelling?
zh: 你快要渴死了！要停止旅行吗？

src: You are either very brave or very foolish, to stop me in my path. Perhaps both. What do you want?
zh: 你拦我去路，要么极其勇敢，要么极其愚蠢，或许兼而有之。你想怎样？

src:
You are encysted as Tikva, just as they! Milky white keratinous thoughts melt to a sick mass, wrapped in a protective membrane. I tremble. So it is.

Ask, if asking.
zh:
你被包裹成了提克瓦，正如他们一样！乳白的角质思绪融化成一团病态的块状物，裹在保护的薄膜之中。我战栗。事已如此。

要问便问。

src: You are exhausted for 3 rounds after using this power.
zh: 使用此技艺后，你会力竭3回合。

src: You are familiar with the customs and folklore of Qud.
zh: 你熟知卡德的风俗与民间传说。

src: You are famished! You'll act more slowly until you eat again.
zh: 你饥馁难当！在再次进食之前，你的行动会变慢。

src: You are forgiven. Now entomb me.
zh: 你被宽恕了。现在把我入葬。

src: You are free to do as you please.
You are frenzied by the howl!
You are friendlier than most turrets.
zh: 你比大多数炮塔友善得多。

src: You are gifted with tremendous speed.
You are happy because you are with your family?
zh: 你快乐，是因为与家人在一起？

src: You are healed for =amount= by the heat.
zh: 热量为你恢复了=amount=点生命。

src: You are immune to getting stuck.
You are immune to poison and disease.
You are in no shape to start a conversation.
zh: 你状态不佳，无法开口交谈。

src: You are kind, Earl Asphodel. You have my thanks.
zh: 伯爵阿斯福德尔，你真仁厚。多谢。

src: You are much more successful at examining artifacts, and you can deploy wiring.
zh: 你检视神器的成功率大为提高，并可布设线路。

src: You are not partial to talking.
You are not suffering from the onset of a disease.
zh: 你并未处于疾病发作的初期。

src:
You are now.

Are you going to buy something, pest?
zh:
如今你是了。

你要买点东西吗，害虫？

src: You are out of phase with =object.t=.
You are out of phase with =object.the.name= and cannot repair =object.them=.
You are possessed of exceptionally acute smell.
zh: 你生就异常敏锐的嗅觉。

src: You are possessed of hulking strength.
zh: 你生就一身魁伟的力气。

src: You are possessed of unnaturally acute hearing.
zh: 你生就异乎寻常的灵敏听觉。

src: You are protected by a durable carapace.
zh: 你身披一层坚固的甲壳。

src: You are quickened with creative energy! All cooldowns are refreshed.
zh: 创生之力催你快思！所有冷却均已重置。

src: You are quickened with creative energy! The =cooldowns.pluralize:cooldown= on =cooldowns.andList= =cooldowns.pluralize:is= refreshed.
zh: 创生之力催你快思！=cooldowns.andList=的=cooldowns.pluralize:冷却=已=cooldowns.pluralize:重置=。

src: You are quickened with creative energy.
zh: 创造的能量令你迅捷如风。

src: You are shunted to another location!
You are skilled at convincing others.
You are skilled at cooking and gathering meal ingredients.
zh: 你精于烹饪与采集餐食食材。

src: You are skilled at enduring harsh conditions and situations.
zh: 你精于忍受恶劣的环境与处境。

src: You are skilled at examining, building, repairing and modding artifacts.
zh: 你精于检视、制造、修理与改造神器。

src: You are skilled at maintaining self-discipline.
You are skilled at multiweapon fighting. Your chance to attack with offhand weapons is increased.
zh: 你精于多武器战斗，以副手武器攻击的几率提高。

src: You are skilled at wielding shields.
You are skilled at wilderness survival.
You are skilled with bows and rifles.
zh: 你精于弓弩与步枪之道。

src: You are skilled with crushing and bludgeoning weapons.
zh: 你精于碾压与钝击类武器。

src: You are skilled with heavy weapons.
You are skilled with long thrusting and slashing blades.
zh: 你精于长直刺剑与长砍刃。

src: You are skilled with pistols of various kinds.
You are skilled with small one-handed knives and blades.
zh: 你精于使用小巧的单手刀与短刃。

src: You are stuck in a remote pocket dimension and cannot recoil out.
zh: 你困于一处遥远的袋状维度，无法返程脱离。

src: You are sucked through the surface of the sphere!
zh: 你被吸入了球体的表面！

src:
You are terribly small. Your love, small. Confined.

I cannot will not uplift your little concept. Do it yourself.
zh:
你渺小得可怕。你的爱，渺小。拘囿。

我不能，也不愿抬举你那小小的念头。你自己去做。

src: You are too confused to remember what =item.a.name= =item.is=.
zh: 你神志昏乱，想不起=item.a.name==item.is=什么。

src: You are too confused to remember what was what among your equipment.
zh: 你神志昏乱，记不清自己装备了什么。

src: You are too exhausted to act!
You are too exhausted to do that.
zh: 你太疲惫，做不了那件事。

src: You are unable to drink liquids.
You are unable to drink that.
You are useless. I'll get to the bottom of this.
zh: 你毫无用处。我自己来查个水落石出。

src: You are welcome in the village of Ezra, seedling. Sit with me and watch the sun breathe shadows over the day.
zh: 欢迎来到以斯拉村，幼苗。坐下与我一同看太阳把阴影吐息于白昼。

src: You are welcome in their holy places.
You are welcome. I yet have questions.
zh: 不必客气。我还有些问题。

src: You are well-found, =name=. Though several have chosen their -else, the first of the slynth have joined to us like our Sant, mobile and apart but shared and together. This is a strange -then, but what branches may spill forth from it? I anticipate the witnessing.
zh: 你来得正好，=name=。虽然有几位选了他们的“别”，但首批斯林斯人已与我们相连，如同我们的桑塔那样，能行动，且独立，却又共享而同在。这是一种奇异的“彼”，但由此会生出怎样的枝桠？我期待亲眼见证。

src: You are... unable to hear or speak.
You aren't familiar enough with any creatures to make a disguise.
zh: 你对任何生物都不够熟悉，无法制作伪装。

src: You aren't hungry. Instead, you relax by the warmth of the fire.
zh: 你并不饥饿。你只是倚着篝火的暖意歇息。

src: You aren't welcome in their holy places.
You ask so much. I must consider it.
zh: 你要求太多了。我须考虑一下。

src: You assume the form of any creature you touch.
zh: 你可化为所触碰的任何生物的形貌。

src: You ate some Crystal Delight and became a crystalline being.
zh: 你吃下了些许晶石之悦，化为晶石之躯。

src: You bask in sunlight and absorb the sun's nourishing rays instead of eating a meal.
zh: 你沐浴阳光，吸收日光滋养之力，以代一餐。

src: You bear a tail with a stinger that delivers <stat Name="VenomType" /> venom to your enemies.
zh: 你生有一条带毒刺的尾巴，能向敌人注入<stat Name="VenomType" />毒液。

src: You bear spade-like claws that can burrow through the earth.
zh: 你生有铲状的利爪，可掘土穿地。

src: You begin itching for a trigger.
zh: 你开始技痒，只想扣动扳机。

src: You beguile a nearby creature into serving you loyally.
zh: 你魅惑一只附近的生物，使其忠心地为你效命。

src: You beguile an adjacent creature into serving you loyally.
zh: 你魅惑一名相邻的生物，使其忠心侍奉你。

src: You belch forth various urchins in a nearby area.
zh: 你在附近区域吐出各式海胆。

src: You best not hurt my critters.
zh: 你最好别伤了我的牲口。

src: You blow into the conch and produce a cone of random gas.
zh: 你向海螺吹气，喷出一道随机气体的锥形气雾。

src: You bond with a nearby organic creature and leech its life force.
zh: 你与附近的有机生物结成纽带，吸取其生命力。

src: You boost =object.name's= immunity with a balm made from =cure.a.name:single=.
zh: 你用=cure.a.name:single=调制的药膏，增强了=object.name's=的免疫力。

src: You braved Golgotha and displayed your prowess to the Barathrumites.
zh: 你勇闯各各他，并向巴拉斯鲁姆派展现了本领。
你吐息喷出腐蚀性气体。

src: You briefly gain vision of a nearby area.
zh: 你短暂获得附近区域的视野。

src: You burrow a channel through the psychic aether to =object.the.name= and begin to sunder =object.its= mind!
zh: 你在心灵以太中掘出一条通道，通向=object.the.name=，开始撕裂=object.its=心智！

src: You butcher corpses you move over.

You can also equip items by dragging them from your inventory to their equipment slot.

By the way, you have several other tabs in your character sheet. Feel free to explore them later.
zh:
你也可以把物品从背包拖到对应的装备槽来装备。

顺便一提，角色表上还有好几个其他标签页，日后尽可自行探索。

src: You can attack a hostile creature by moving into its square. This is called {{W|bump attacking}}.
zh: 朝敌对生物所在的格子移动即可发动攻击。这称为{{W|撞击攻击}}。

src: You can bask in the sunlight instead of eating a meal to gain a special metabolizing effect for <stat Name="DurationDay" Unit="▶day" />: +<stat Name="BonusRegen" /> to natural healing rate and +<stat Name="BonusQuickness" /> Quickness
zh: 你可沐浴日光，以代替进食一餐，获得特殊的代谢效果，持续<stat Name="DurationDay" Unit="日" />：自然愈合速率+<stat Name="BonusRegen" />，迅捷+<stat Name="BonusQuickness" />

src: You can be it. We can all be it! Behold Nephilim!
zh: 你能成为它。我们皆能成为它！看哪，拿非利人！

src: You can butcher fresh ingredients and other usable parts from animal corpses.
zh: 你可从动物尸体上宰取新鲜食材及其他可用部位。

src: You can charge <stat Name="ChargeDistanceBonus" Unit="▶square" /> farther.
zh: 你可多冲锋<stat Name="ChargeDistanceBonus" Unit="格" />。

src: You can create equipment sets and add equipment to sets on the Equipment Screen.
zh: 你可以在装备界面创建装备组，并将装备加入其中。

src: You can disassemble scrap and artifacts for bits. You get the most significant bit from the item schematic plus a 50% chance to receive each remaining bit.
zh: 你可拆解废料与神器以取得零件。你必得物品设计图中最主要的零件，其余每种零件各有50%的几率获得。

src: You can drink change from electrical power sources.
zh: 你可从电力源中汲取电荷。

src: You can drink charge from energy cells and capacitors.
zh: 你可从能量电池和电容器中汲取电荷。

src: You can eat raw meat without being famished.
zh: 你生食肉类不会饥肠辘辘。

src: You can harvest fresh ingredients and other usable parts from plants.
zh: 你可从植物上采收新鲜食材及其他可用部位。

src: You can imprint this implant with a location (cooldown 100) and recoil back to it (cooldown 50).
zh: 你可以将此植入体烙印于某处地点（冷却100），并反冲回到该处（冷却50）。

src: You can increase your body's adrenaline flow for <stat Name="Duration" />.
zh: 你可加快体内肾上腺素的奔流，持续<stat Name="Duration" />。

src: You can interact with both in-phase and out-of-phase objects and creatures.
zh: 你既能与同相之物互动，也能与异相之物互动。

src:
You can interact with objects you're next to. Open the chest.

Press =commandKey:Accept=
zh:
你可以与身旁的物品互动。打开箱子。

按=commandKey:Accept=

src:
You can interact with objects you're next to. Open the chest.

Press =commandKey:Accept= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=
zh:
你可以与身旁的物品互动。打开箱子。

按=commandKey:Accept=或=commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=

src: You can jump <stat Name="JumpDistanceBonus" Unit="▶square" /> farther.

You can look around here just like on a local map.

Press =commandKey:CmdLook=
zh:
你可以像在本地地图上一样在这里四处查看。

按=commandKey:CmdLook=

src:
You can look around here just like on a local map.

Use =commandKey:LookDirection=
zh:
你可以像在本地地图上一样在这里四处查看。

使用=commandKey:LookDirection=

src: You can name your character or choose Next for a random name.
zh: 你可以为角色取名，也可以选择“下一步”随机取名。

src: You can only =verb= into empty spaces.
You can only build a campfire in the same zone you are in.
zh: 只能在你所在的同一区域内建造篝火。

src: You can only engrave =subject.itself= and your companions.
You can only fly above ground.
zh: 你只能在地面上空飞行。

src: You can only see up to a radius of 10.
zh: 你至多只能看到半径10以内。

src: You can only tattoo =subject.itself= and your companions.
zh: 你只能为=subject.itself=及你的同伴纹身。

src: You can only teleport to a place you have seen before!
zh: 你只能传送到自己见过的地方！

src:
You can pick up things that are in the same space as you.

Press =commandKey:CmdGet=
zh:
你可以拾取与你处于同一格的物品。

按=commandKey:CmdGet=

src:
You can pick up things that are in the same space as you.

Press =commandKey:CmdUse=
zh:
你可以拾取与你处于同一格的物品。

按=commandKey:CmdUse=

src: You can preserve almost anything. Al... most.
zh: 几乎什么都能腌藏。几……乎。

src: You can provide charge to equipped devices that have integrated power.
zh: 你可为所装备的自带电源装置供电。

src:
You can see a list of points of interest by clicking this button or pressing =commandKey:CmdMoveToPointOfInterest=.

The list will grow as you explore more of the map.
zh:
点击此按钮或按=commandKey:CmdMoveToPointOfInterest=可查看兴趣点列表。

你探索地图越多，这个列表就越长。

src:
You can see a list of points of interest by pressing =commandKey:CmdMoveToPointOfInterest=.

The list will grow as you explore more of the map.
zh:
按=commandKey:CmdMoveToPointOfInterest=可查看兴趣点列表。

你探索地图越多，这个列表就越长。
你从=subject.the.name=身上感知不到任何东西。

src: You can sense other mental mutants through the psychic aether.
zh: 你能透过灵能以太感知其他精神变异者。

src: You can spin sticky silk webs.
zh: 你能吐丝结出黏性的蛛网。

src: You can sprint for <stat Name="SprintBonus" />% longer.
zh: 你可多疾跑<stat Name="SprintBonus" />%的时间。

src:
You can still activate our defenses, =name=. There are chain laser emplacements and force projectors across the enclave. Use Ereshkigal's reconnaissance to decide which defenses to enable. You can also broadcast an overclock command or activate Rodanis Y by interfacing with Ereshkigal.

Be mindful of the amperage draw, though. If you overdraw the grid, you could cause brownouts.
zh:
你仍可启用我们的防御，=name=。整座营地遍布连锁激光炮位与力场发射器。借埃列什基伽勒的侦察来决定启用哪些防御。你也可以通过与埃列什基伽勒对接，广播超频指令，或启动罗达尼斯Y。

不过要留意电流负载。若电网过载，便会引发电压骤降。

src: You can swap spaces with hostile creatures.
zh: 你可以与敌对生物互换位置。

src: You can tighten your <stat Name="CarapaceName" /> to double its AV bonus at a -2 DV penalty as long as you remain still.
zh: 只要保持不动，你便可收紧<stat Name="CarapaceName" />，使其护甲值加值翻倍，代价是闪避值-2。

src:
You can tinker and repair in combat at the action cost of one turn.
Reduces the action cost of other tinker skills by 40%.
Grants a bonus to identifying artifacts as if your Intelligence score were increased by 8.
+10% chance to recover bits from disassembling artifacts.
zh:
你可以在战斗中修补与修理，每次消耗一回合的行动。
其他修补类技能的行动消耗降低40%。
鉴定古器时获得加成，如同你的智力提高了8。
拆解古器时回收零件的几率+10%。

src: You can travel underground by burrowing.
You can treat bleeding, poison, illness, and disease onset for you and your companions at a campfire.
zh: 你可在营火旁为自己与同伴治疗流血、中毒、疾病与病症初发。

src: You can voluntarily amputate your own limbs and the limbs of infected companions.
zh: 你可自愿截去自己的肢体，以及受感染同伴的肢体。

src:
You can wait a turn for the bear to approach. That way, it won't be in range to attack you when it takes its turn.

Press =commandKey:CmdWait:allbinds= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction= on your character to pass a turn.
zh:
你可以等一回合，让熊主动靠近。这样一来，轮到他行动时，他就够不着你了。

按=commandKey:CmdWait:allbinds=，或对你自己按=commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=，即可过一回合。

src:
You can wait a turn for the bear to approach. That way, it won't be in range to attack you when it takes its turn.

Tap =commandKey:Take A Step= without choosing a direction with the stick to pass a turn.
zh:
你可以等一回合，让熊主动靠近。这样一来，轮到他行动时，他就够不着你了。

不推摇杆、直接轻按=commandKey:Take A Step=即可过一回合。

src: You can walk over slime without slipping.
zh: 你行走于黏液之上不会滑倒。

src: You can wield two-handed weapons in one hand.
zh: 你可以单手挥舞双手武器。

src: You can't animate an object that already has a brain.
zh: 你无法为已有脑子的物体赋予生命。

src: You can't bask with hostiles nearby.
zh: 附近有敌人时无法沐日。

src: You can't cook with hostile creatures nearby.
zh: 附近有敌对生物时无法烹饪。

src: You can't cook with hostiles nearby.
zh: 附近有敌对者时无法烹饪。

src: You can't cook with plant or fungus ingredients.
zh: 你无法以植物或真菌类食材烹饪。

src: You can't do that with hostile creatures nearby.
zh: 附近有敌对生物时，你无法这样做。

src: You can't dominate someone you are already dominating.
zh: 你无法支配已在支配之下的对象。

src: You can't engrave with hostiles nearby.
zh: 附近有敌对生物时，你无法刻印。

src: You can't excavate with hostiles nearby.
zh: 附近有敌人时无法掘进。

src: You can't figure out how to fix =object.the.name:single=.
You can't figure out how to safely reach the stairs from here.
zh: 你想不出如何从这里安全地走到楼梯。

src: You can't figure out how to wake =object.the.name=.
You can't find a way to flee from =object.the.name=.
You can't find a way to navigate to =target.the.name=.
You can't find a way to reach =object.the.name=.

src:
You fabricate force knives in unoccupied hand or thrown weapon slots.
If you throw a force knife, another one immediately materializes in your thrown weapon slot.
Force knives deal 1d8 damage, have penetration value equal to their target's armor value, and have +6 throwing range.
Force knives disappear after losing contact with you or becoming unequipped.
If you have a force modulator implant installed, force knives can be thrown through forcefields.
zh:
你在空闲的手或投掷武器栏位中制出力刃。
你投出力刃后，另一柄立即在你的投掷武器栏位中凝成。
力刃造成1d8点伤害，穿透值等同于目标的护甲值，投掷射程+6。
力刃一旦与你脱离接触或被卸下，便会消失。
若你装有力场调制器植入体，力刃可穿过力场投掷。

zh: 你时不时会不由自主地睡着。

src: You feel a psychic whiff as =object.does:push= past resistance in the structure of spacetime.

src: You feel a psychic whiff as someone pushes past resistance in the structure of spacetime.
zh: 你感到一丝心灵的波动——有人顶穿了时空结构中的阻力。

src: You feel a small ripple in space and time.
zh: 你感到时空中有细微的涟漪。

src: You feel an uncomfortable pressure across the length of your body.
zh: 你觉得全身上下传来一阵不适的压迫感。

src: You feel like you forgot something important.
zh: 你觉得自己忘了某件要紧的事。

src: You feel poison course through your veins!

src: You feel some ambient astral friction here.

src: You feel stiff as a stone.
You feel the cartilage stretch as your leg bones grind together at the joints.
