src: You feel the soup slosh around your stomach.
zh: 你觉得那汤在胃里晃荡。
你生出一种令人不安的矛盾心绪。

src:
You feel unusually amorous for about half a day, during which time you'll fall in love with the first thing you look at.
If you inject someone else, they'll fall in love with you and follow you around for 3000-3600 rounds. There's a 1% failure rate for every level higher they are than you.
zh:
约半日之内，你会异常多情，其间你将爱上目光所及的第一样事物。
若你为他人注射，对方将爱上你，并跟随你3000-3600回合。对方每比你高一级，便有1%的失败几率。
你感到自己的骨头裂了。

src: You felt it too! Every. rock. moved. Wooooooow! It's sort of like a community dance we all performed together. Mafeo. Sparafucile. The chromelings. The rocks. Everyone else.
zh: 你也感觉到了！每。块。石头。都动了！哇啊啊啊！就好比我们大家一起跳了一场社区舞。马费奥。斯帕拉富奇莱。铬灵们。石头们。其他所有人。

src: You fetched a trinket for an old man.
zh: 你替一位老人找来一件小玩意。

src: You fetched another trinket for an old man.
zh: 你又替一位老人找来一件小玩意。

src: You fill a nearby area with frosty webs.
zh: 你以霜结的蛛网充满附近区域。

src: You fire 5 shots with your heavy weapon, sweeping over a 90 degree cone. Your heavy weapon is reloaded before each shot.
zh: 你以重型武器射出5发，扫过90度扇形区域。每发射击前，你的重型武器都会重新装填。

src: You fire <stat Name="Shots" /> shots with your heavy weapon, sweeping over a <stat Name="ConeWidth" /> degree cone. Your heavy weapon is reloaded before each shot.
zh: 你以重武器射出<stat Name="Shots" />发子弹，扫过一片<stat Name="ConeWidth" />度的扇形区域。每次射击前，你的重武器都会自动装填。

src: You fire at a marked target with no accuracy penalty (the accuracy of your weapon still matters). Then your target is unmarked.
zh: 你向已标记的目标射击，且无命中惩罚（武器本身的精度仍然有效）。随后目标的标记解除。

src: You fire at a marked target. For each penetration on each shot that hits, your target bleeds 1 point of damage per round (save: 20 + max damage of the weapon). Then your target is unmarked.
zh: 你向已标记的目标射击。每发命中的射击每击穿一次，目标每回合流失1点生命（豁免：20+武器的最大伤害）。随后目标的标记解除。

src: You fire at a marked target. If your shot penetrates, your target is suppressed and can't move for 3-5 rounds. Then your target is unmarked.
zh: 你向已标记的目标射击。若射击击穿，目标将被压制，3-5回合内无法移动。随后目标的标记解除。
你发射手枪的速度加快25%。

src: You flush with the warming draught!
zh: 一口暖酒下肚，你浑身发热！

src: You flush with understanding of the =object.isplural:artifacts':artifact's= past and determine =object.them= to be =object.a.name:single=.
zh: 你对=object.isplural:这些古器的:这件古器的=往昔豁然贯通，断定=object.them=是=object.a.name:single=。

src: You focus your ambient light into a laser beam.
zh: 你将周身的环境光凝聚成一道激光束。

src: You found and returned a discarded love poem.
zh: 你找回并归还了一首被丢弃的情诗。

src: You found the hindren pariah Eskhind and her sisters inside a hollowed out tree.
zh: 你在一棵中空树内找到了欣德伦弃民埃斯金德与她的姐妹们。

src: You freed the Spindle for another's ascent and crossed into Brightsheol.
zh: 你放开纺锤，让他人得以上升，并踏入明冥。

src: You gain +<stat Name="QuicknessBonus" /> Quickness for <stat Name="QuicknessDuration" /> rounds, then you become sluggish for 10 rounds.
zh: 你获得+<stat Name="QuicknessBonus" />迅捷，持续<stat Name="QuicknessDuration" />回合，随后陷入迟钝，持续10回合。

src: You gain <stat Name="DamageAbsorbFactor" /> charge per point of electrical damage taken.
zh: 你每受到1点电击伤害，便获得<stat Name="DamageAbsorbFactor" />点电荷。

src: You gain a +1 bonus to your DV. Additionally, Juke's cooldown is reduced to 20.
zh: 你的闪避值获得+1加值。此外，“闪躲”的冷却时间缩短为20。

src: You gain a +2 bonus to your DV.
You gain a +5 bonus to your DV when flinching away from missile attacks.
zh: 被投射攻击逼得闪避时，你的闪避值获得+5加值。

src: You gain a skill whose cost is between 0 and 50 SP.
zh: 你获得一项花费介于0至50技能点之间的技能。

src: You gain a skill whose cost is between 51 and 150 SP.
zh: 你获得一项花费介于51至150技能点之间的技能。

src: You gain a skill whose cost is greater than 151 SP.
zh: 你获得一项花费超过151技能点的技能。

src: You gain a special metabolizing effect for <stat Name="DurationDay" Unit="▶day" />.
zh: 你获得一种特殊的代谢效果，持续<stat Name="DurationDay" Unit="日" />。

src: You gain access to a whole skill tree.
You gain access to dueling stance. While wielding a long blade in your primary hand, you get +2 to hit with long blades and short blades.
zh: 你获得决斗架势。主手持长刃时，你的长刃与短刃攻击命中+2。

src: You gain access to every schematic for a single class of artifacts.
zh: 你获得某一类古器的全部图纸。

src: You gain access to the precise hit point, armor, and dodge values of biological creatures.
zh: 你可得知生物类造物精确的生命值、护甲与闪避数值。

src: You gain access to the precise hit point, armor, and dodge values of robotic creatures and you automatically identify artifacts.
zh: 你可得知机械类造物精确的生命值、护甲与闪避数值，并自动鉴识古器。

src:
You gain access to the precise hit point, armor, and dodge values of robotic creatures, biological creatures, and structures.
You automatically identify artifacts.
Staircases and other up/down map transitions are always revealed to you.
zh:
你可获知机械生物、有机生物与建筑的确切生命值、护甲值与闪避值。
你自动鉴定古器。
楼梯及其他上下地图的转换点始终对你显现。

src:
You gain access to two stances.
Aggressive stance: With a long blade in your primary hand, your long blade and short blade attacks gain +1 to your penetration roll but -2 to hit.
Defensive stance: While wielding a long blade in your primary hand, you gain +2 DV.
zh:
你获得两种架势。
进攻架势：主手持长刃时，你的长刃与短刃攻击穿透判定+1，但命中-2。
防守架势：主手持长刃时，你获得+2闪避值。

src: You gain an additional Back equipment slot.
zh: 你获得一个额外的背部装备栏位。

src: You gain an additional Floating Nearby equipment slot.
zh: 你获得一个额外的近身悬浮装备栏位。

src:
You gain an additional left and right missile weapon slot.
You cannot wear equipment on your back.
zh:
你获得一个额外的左侧与右侧远程武器栏位。
你无法在背部穿戴装备。

src:
You gain an extra thrown weapon slot.
When you perform a throw, you throw from all your thrown weapon slots at once.
zh:
你获得一个额外的投掷武器栏位。
你投掷时，会同时从所有投掷武器栏位投出。

src: You gain either a permanent +1 bonus to a random attribute or one mutation point.
zh: 你获得永久+1的随机属性加成，或一点变异点数。

src: You gain either a permanent +2 bonus to a random attribute or two mutation points.
zh: 你获得随机一项属性永久+2，或获得两点变异点数。

src: You gain one extra mutation each time you buy this, but the mutations don't manifest right away.
zh: 每购买一次此项，你便多获得一个变异，但这些变异不会立即显现。

src: You gain the ability to see in the dark.
zh: 你获得在黑暗中视物的能力。

src: You gain total visibility in a radius of 10 spaces around you, blocked only by force fields and spacetime anomalies.
zh: 你在周身10格半径内获得完全视野，仅被力场与时空异常所阻。

src: You gain total visibility in a radius of <stat Name="Radius" /> around you, blocked only by force fields and spacetime anomalies.
zh: 你获得周身半径<stat Name="Radius" />范围内的全视野，仅被力场与时空异常所阻。
你获得了变异{{w|污水括约肌}}！

src: You garrote an adjacent creature's mind and control its actions while your own body lies dormant.
zh: 你扼住相邻生物的心神，操控其行动，而自身躯体陷入休眠。

src:
You gather some fixings: =ingredients.andList=.

You toss them in a pot and stir.
zh:
你收集了一些食材：=ingredients.andList=。

你把它们丢进锅里搅拌。

src:
You gather whatever you can find for your meal: =ingredients.andList=.

You toss them in a pot and stir.
zh:
你搜罗能找到的食材来做饭：=ingredients.andList=。

你把它们丢进锅里搅拌。
你生成<gametext>=maxDecoys.a.or.x.things:全息诱饵=</gametext>，皆为你的幻影。

src: You generate a forcefield around yourself.
zh: 你在自己周身生成一层力场。

src: You generate a pyrokinesis field around yourself, dealing damage and setting things on fire for 3 rounds.
zh: 你在自身周围生成一片火控力场，造成伤害并使周围事物燃烧3回合。

src: You generate a wall of force that impedes the movement of robots.
zh: 你生成一道力场之墙，阻碍机器人的行动。

src: You generate a wall of force that protects you from your enemies.
zh: 你生成一堵力场之墙，护你免受敌人侵害。

src: You generate an electromagnetic pulse that disables nearby artifacts and machines.
zh: 你产生一道电磁脉冲，使附近的古器与机械失效。

src: You get +1 to hit with short blades. Also, the action costs of attacking with a short blade in your primary hand is reduced by 25%.
zh: 你使用短刃时命中+1。此外，以主手持短刃攻击的行动消耗降低25%。

src: You get +2 to hit with axes.
You get +2 to hit with cudgels.
You get no satiation from foods that aren't meat.
zh: 非肉类的食物无法令你饱腹。

src: You get used to the nicks and burns, after years working with spark and solder.
zh: 与火花和焊锡厮磨多年，磕碰与烫伤也就惯了。

src:
You go and run at Q Girl and tap all the gadgets and tap her on the head.
Then you sneak by Otho's office.
Then you hug Shem -1 and you drag them to the library and read to them. Sometimes Barathrum and Hortensa are in there, and they smile at you.
Then you get hungry and you roll toward the kitchen. You slurp honey from the vase and Dardi glares at you. You say, "I'm just 'jidding'."
Then you climb the pipes and whisper to Aloysius, "Live and drink, live and drink, live and drink."
Then you pat the chromelings on their heads. You say to Ereshkigal, "boom boom boom boom boom I love you."
Then you sneak into storage and pat all the chromelings on their heads.
You take a nap in the peptic chair.
Then you get a bright idea and go back to your room to write it in your notebook.
zh:
你跑去冲着Q女孩，拍遍所有小玩意儿，再拍拍她的脑袋。
然后你悄悄走过奥索的办公室。
然后你抱抱舍姆-1，把它拖到藏书室读书给它听。有时巴拉斯鲁姆和霍腾萨也在里头，对你微笑。
然后你饿了，就朝厨房滚过去。你从花瓶里舔蜂蜜，达尔迪瞪你。你说：“我只是‘开顽笑’。”
然后你爬上管道，对阿洛伊修斯悄声说：“且生且饮，且生且饮，且生且饮。”
然后你拍拍铬灵们的脑袋。你对埃列什基伽勒说：“砰砰砰砰砰我爱你。”
然后你溜进储藏室，拍拍所有铬灵的脑袋。
你在消化椅上打个盹。
然后你灵光一闪，回房间把它记在笔记本里。

src: You gorge on the succulent meat. It's tastier than usual.
zh: 你大快朵颐那鲜嫩的肉。比平常更美味。

src: You grab an opponent's limb with the heel of your axe.
zh: 你以斧跟勾住对手的一条肢体。

src: You harvest it, you keep it.
You harvest plants you move over.

You have a few options now. You can roll with it and continue in this world where Mehmet's been revenge-slain. The early game will be a bit harder, but the main quest is not impacted.

You can start over and play the tutorial again, for the "normal" ending, which you were about to reach.

Or, since you were near the end anyway, you can start a new game and begin your journey proper!
zh:
现在你有几个选择。你可以顺其自然，在梅赫梅特已被复仇杀害的这个世界里继续下去。前期会稍难一些，但主线任务不受影响。

你可以重新开始，再玩一遍教程，看看你原本即将抵达的“正常”结局。

或者，既然你本来就快到结尾了，可以直接开一局新游戏，正式踏上旅程！

src: You have a flash of insight and scribe =object.a.name:long=.
zh: 你灵光一现，将=object.a.name:long=誊录下来。

src: You have a great deal of nerve to speak to me after what you've done.
zh: 你做了那些事，竟还有脸来同我说话。

src: You have an agility-based chance to disarm your opponent when you score a hit with a pistol.
zh: 以手枪命中时，你有一定几率缴去对手的武器，几率取决于你的敏捷。

src: You have an extra set of arms.
You have an extra set of legs.

You have completed the ritual of -elseing. You have set bright Tau free.

Yes, =name=. I will turn my chimes Spindleward to tune, then vibrate at our verve frequency. I will power your starclimb.

Be vested to tell whoever you must that Chavvah has made this commitment.
zh:
你已完成“别化”之仪。你让明亮的陶得了自由。

是的，=name=。我将把我的钟鸣转向纺锤之方调音，再以我们的活力频率震动。我会为你们的登星之旅供能。

请务必告知该告知之人：查娃已立下此诺。

src: You have contracted Ironshank! You feel the cartilage stretch as your leg bones grind together at the joints.
zh: 你染上了铁胫症！你感到软骨被拉扯，腿骨在关节处相互摩擦。

src: You have contracted glotrot! Your tongue begins to bleed as the muscle rots away.
zh: 你染上了腐舌症！舌肌开始腐坏，舌头渗出血来。

src: You have contracted monochrome! Color starts to seep out of the world.
zh: 你染上了单色症！色彩开始自世间流失。

src: You have done much for =village.name=, =name=, and your request befits your stature. If these slynth will join us in =village.activity= and if they can come to cherish =village.sacred= as we do, then they are welcome here.
zh: 你为=village.name=做了许多事，=name=，你的请求也与你的身份相称。倘若这些斯林斯人愿与我们一同从事=village.activity=，倘若他们能如我们一般珍重=village.sacred=，那么这里欢迎他们。

src: You have gained the activated ability {{Y|=abilityName=}}.
You have grown bold beyond your station. What you have asked of us you have not earned. If you must ask again, become worthier first.
zh: 你已僭越本分了。你所求于我们的，你尚未挣得。若要再求，先使自己更配得上。

src: You have lost the use of your =part.ordinalName=.

You have me helpless. That poem is my clumsy expression of a deep truth that frightens me. It is a risk that I lacked the strength to take or leave.

My heart quails in your hands, kendren.
zh:
你把我弄得无计可施了。那首诗是我对一个令我惊惧的深切真相的笨拙表达。那是一场冒险，我既无力去冒，也无力放弃。

我的心在你手中战栗，肯德伦。

src:
You have my gratitude for this exoneration, kendren. This worked out better than I expected thanks to you.

I'll admit, I would have preferred to avoid becoming Hindriarch, but I'm hoping to bring my people to a more Democratic form of governance. Then I can vote myself out.
zh:
肯德伦，我感谢你为我洗清冤屈。多亏了你，结果比我预想的还好。

我承认，我宁可不当族长，但我希望带领族人走向更民主的治理方式。到那时，我便能投票把自己罢免。

src: You have no =liquid.name|strip= to supply =host.the.name= with.
You have no =liquid.name|strip= to supply =object.the.name= with.

zh: 你当前没有进行中的任务。

src: You have no artifacts to give.
zh: 你没有可以赠予的古器。

src: You have no artifacts to offer that are not important.
zh: 你没有可投入井中的非重要古器。

src: You have no artifacts to offer.
zh: 你没有可投入井中的古器。

src: You have no bodily tether to recoil.
zh: 你没有可供返程的躯体之系。

src: You have no cells that fit.
You have no containers to fill.
zh: 你没有可供灌注的容器。

src: You have no containers to pour from.
zh: 你没有可供倒出液体的容器。

src: You have no existing saved games.
You have no followers that can enter =object.the.name=.
zh: 你没有可以进入=object.the.name=的追随者。

src: You have no infectable body parts.
zh: 你没有可供感染的部位。

src: You have no items that require charging.
zh: 你没有需要充能的物品。

src: You have no medicinal ingredients with which to treat =object.name's= =effect.description=.
You have no medicinal ingredients with which to treat =object.name's= illness.
zh: 你没有可用来医治=object.name's=疾病的药材。

src: You have no medicinal ingredients with which to treat the poison coursing through =object.the.name=.
zh: 你没有可用来解除=object.the.name=体内奔涌之毒的药材。

src: You have no more ammo for =object.the.name=.
zh: 你没有可供=object.the.name=使用的弹药了。

src: You have no right to sovereignty here.
zh: 你在此处并无主权可言。

src: You have no shield to raise.
You have nothing that meets the requirement of the =selection=.
zh: 你没有任何符合=selection=要求的物品。

src: You have nowhere available to collect that.
zh: 你没有可用来收集的地方。

src: You have prophetic visions in your sleep?
zh: 你睡梦中会有预知的幻象？

src: You have recovered the use of your =part.ordinalName=.
You have run out of {{B|water}}! Do you want to stop travelling?
zh: 你的{{B|水}}已经喝完了！要停止旅行吗？

src:
You have severed the hand outstretched to me. Why?

What have you done? What am I to do?
zh:
你斩断了向我伸出的手。为何？

你做了什么？我该怎么办？

src: You have so many data disks.
You have spent too many attribute points!
zh: 你花费的属性点数过多！

src: You have spent too many mutation points.
zh: 你使用的变异点数过多。
你还有未用完的属性点数。
你有未使用的变异点数。

src: You have wilted! You'll move and regenerate slower until you eat or bask in the sunlight again.
zh: 你枯萎了！在进食或重新沐浴阳光之前，你的移动与再生都会变慢。

src: You haven't provided the mound with all the necessary materials.
zh: 你尚未给土堆备齐所需的全部材料。
你听见远处传来一声咔哒。

src: You hear a loud click from across the room.
zh: 你听见房间另一头传来一声响亮的咔哒声。

src: You hear a muffled grunting coming from inside the block of ice.
zh: 你听见冰块之中传来含混的咕哝声。

src: You heat a nearby area with your mind, dealing damage and setting things on fire for 3 rounds.
zh: 你以心念加热附近区域，造成伤害并使周围事物燃烧3回合。

src: You heat a nearby area with your mind.
zh: 你以心智加热附近区域。

src: You helped Chavvah, the Tree of Life, complete the ritual of -elseing and sever one of its entity-chimes forever.
zh: 你帮助生命之树查娃完成“别化”仪式，永远斩断了它的一枚实体鸣钟。

src: You hold the =faction.rankTerm= of =rank= among them.
zh: 在他们之中，你居于=faction.rankTerm=之位（=rank=）。

src: You howl and send nearby snapjaws into a frenzy.
zh: 你仰天长嚎，使附近的豺颚人陷入狂乱。

src:
You hunger and thirst at one-half the normal rate.
Metabolic effects from meals last twice as long.
zh:
你的饥渴速度减半。
餐食的代谢效果持续时间延长一倍。

src:
You hunger and thirst at one-sixth rate.
Metabolic effects from meals last six times as long.
You suffer no penalty for becoming famished.
zh:
你的饥渴速度降为六分之一。
餐食的代谢效果持续时间延长为六倍。
你不会因饥馁而受到惩罚。

src: You ignite a small fire with your mind.
zh: 你以心念点燃一簇小火。

src: You imagine they will thrive here at the Stiltgrounds, among the faithful?
zh: 你以为他们在高塔之地、在信众之中能够兴旺吗？
你将生命注入了=object.a.name=。为何如此？

src: You increase your body's adrenaline flow for <stat Name="Duration" />.
zh: 你加快体内肾上腺素的流动，持续<stat Name="Duration" />。

src: You installed =cybernetic.isPlural:some:a= cybernetic =cybernetic.basename= and came one step closer to the Grand Unification.
zh: 你植入了=cybernetic.isPlural:若干:一枚=义体=cybernetic.basename=，离大统一又近了一步。
你与=object.t=建立接口，并解锁了=object.them=。

src: You invented a mouthwatering dish called {{|=recipe.name=}}!
zh: 你发明了一道名为{{|=recipe.name=}}的美味佳肴！

src: You invoke a concussive force around yourself. Creatures are pushed away from the center of blast, stunned, and dealt crushing damage in up to 3 increments.
zh: 你在周身激发一股冲击之力。生物被推离爆心、晕眩，并至多分3次受到挤压伤害。

src: You invoke a concussive force in a nearby area, throwing enemies back and stunning them.
zh: 你在附近区域召出一股震荡之力，将敌人击退并震晕。

src: You invoke a concussive force in a nearby area. Creatures are pushed away from the center of blast, stunned, and dealt crushing damage in up to 3 increments.
zh: 你在附近区域激发一股冲击之力。生物被推离爆心、晕眩，并至多分3次受到挤压伤害。

src: You invoke a repelling force in the surrounding area, throwing enemies back.
zh: 你在四周激起一股排斥之力，将敌人击退。

src: You involuntarily release electromagnetic pulses, deactivating robots and artifacts around yourself.
zh: 你会不由自主地释放电磁脉冲，使周围的机器人与古物失效。

src: You jump into an unoccupied square within range 2. You cannot jump over a square occupied by a creature, unless you have an ability (such as flight) that augments your jump.
zh: 你跃入射程2以内的一处空格。除非你拥有能增强跳跃的能力（如飞行），否则不能越过有生物占据的格子。

src: You knock an opponent down with your shield and deal them damage.
zh: 你以盾牌将对手撞倒，并对其造成伤害。

src: You know auntie Eskhind's little sister, Liihart? She's always been quiet, but she didn't talk at all for, uh, two whole weeks before they left!
zh: 你知道埃斯金德姨妈的小妹利哈特吗？她一向安静，可在她们离开之前，她居然整整两个星期一句话都没说！

src: You know how to make starapple jam? If not, you can buy it from me.
zh: 你可知道怎么做星苹果酱？不会的话，可以向我买。

src: You know why I'm here, Slog.
zh: 你知道我为何而来，斯洛格。

src: You know, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I once had an traveler from Yawningmoon tell me my shop smelled of home. Now I want to visit! Hah!
zh: 你知道吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我曾听一位来自月启之地的旅人说，我这铺子闻着像故乡。如今我倒想去看看了！哈！

src: You know, Grand-Doe spent some late nights working on something she wouldn't talk about. I wonder what that was.
zh: 你知道吗，大母鹿好几个深夜都在忙些什么，却不肯说。真不知那是什么。

src: You know, bees communicate by dancing. Got a whole language.
zh: 你知道吗，蜜蜂靠跳舞交流。自成一套语言呢。

src: You lack a developed sense of pain.
You launched yourself into the dusted cosmos to ply the stars with Barathrum.
zh: 你投身尘封的宇宙，与巴拉斯鲁姆一同航行星辰。

src: You launched yourself into the dusted cosmos to ply the stars.
zh: 你投身尘封的宇宙，航行星辰。

src: You lay your hand upon =object.t= and draw forth =object.its= passcode. You enter the code and =object.does:unlock=.
zh: 你将手按在=object.t=上，抽出=object.its=密码。你输入密码，=object.does:解锁=。

src: You let inspiration guide you toward a mouthwatering dish.
zh: 你任灵感引路，朝着一道令人垂涎的菜肴而去。

src: You look dangerous. Ever go hunting for parts?
zh: 你看着挺凶险。可曾去猎过零件？

src: You look... refreshed. Thank you, =name=. Take this polygel we recently recovered from the Palladium Reef.
zh: 你看上去……焕然一新。多谢，=name=。收下这份我们近日从钯礁寻回的多凝胶吧。

src: You lose sight of your mark.
zh: 你跟丢了所标记的目标。

src: You lose your way beneath a dense canopy of spores.
zh: 你在浓密的孢子华盖下迷失了方向。

src: You lose {{rules|1}} point of Willpower permanently.
You maintain your balance and kick the eel away.
zh: 你稳住身形，一脚将鳗踢开。

src: You maintain your balance and shake the eel off.
zh: 你稳住身形，将鳗甩了下来。

src: You make a melee attack with a short blade in either your primary hand (preferred) or offhand. If you hit, the attack gets +2 to penetration rolls for each negative status effect your opponent suffers from.
zh: 你以主手（优先）或副手的短刃发动一次近战攻击。若命中，则对手身上每有一种负面状态效果，此次攻击的穿透判定便+2。

src: You make an attack with a cudgel at an adjacent opponent with +1 to your penetration roll.
zh: 你以棍棒攻击相邻的对手，穿透判定+1。

src: You make an attack with a cudgel at an adjacent opponent. If you hit, you automatically daze them for 3-4 rounds.
zh: 你以棍棒攻击相邻的对手。若命中，则自动使其眩晕3-4回合。

src: You make an attack with a short blade in your primary hand, looking for a weak spot in your opponent's armor. If you hit, you penetrate exactly once and hobble them (-50% movespeed for 16-20 rounds).
zh: 你以主手短刃攻击，寻找对手护甲的破绽。若命中，则恰好击穿一次，并使对方跛行（移动速度-50%，持续16-20回合）。

src: You make an attack with a short blade in your primary hand, looking for a weak spot in your opponent's armor. If you hit, you penetrate exactly once and hobble them.
zh: 你以主手短刃发动一次攻击，探寻对手护甲的破绽。若命中，则恰好穿透一次，并使其绊倒。

src: You make an attack with every weapon-wielding limb, including extra limbs granted by mutation or technology.
zh: 你以每一条持武器的肢体各发动一次攻击，包括由变异或科技赋予的额外肢体。

src: You make an axe attack against an opponent. If you hit and penetrate, you dismember one of their limbs at random and they start bleeding.
zh: 你以斧对对手发动一次攻击。若命中并穿透，便随机肢解其一条肢体，并使其开始流血。
你在修理=object.the.name:single=上取得了一些进展。

src: You make some progress understanding =snapshot=. =snapshotDoesSeem= to be =object.a.name:single=, and you think =object.it.is= probably a variety of =sample.basename:asIfKnown=; you believe you would be able to recognize an ordinary =sample.one.of.those= now.
zh: 你对=snapshot=的了解有所进展。=snapshotDoesSeem=是=object.a.name:single=，你认为=object.it.is=多半是=sample.basename:asIfKnown=的一种；你相信现在能认出一件普通的=sample.one.of.those=了。

src: You make some progress understanding =snapshot=. =snapshotDoesSeem= to be =object.a.name:single=.

You make some progress understanding =snapshot=. You think =object.it.is= probably a variety of =sample.basename:asIfKnown=, and you believe you would be able to recognize an ordinary =sample.one.of.those= now.
zh: 你对=snapshot=略有所悟。你认为=object.it.is=大概是某种=sample.basename:asIfKnown=，并相信自己现在能辨认出普通的=sample.one.of.those=。

src: You manipulate light to your advantage.

zh: 你可魅惑的随从上限增加=amount.cardinal==amount.pluralize:名=。
你可魅惑的随从上限减少=amount.cardinal==amount.pluralize:名=。
你可劝诱入教的随从上限增加=amount.cardinal==amount.pluralize:名=。
你可劝诱入教的随从上限减少=amount.cardinal==amount.pluralize:名=。

src:
You may activate this item to start dashing.
 While dashing, whenever you move in a direction, you dash up to 20 spaces toward the nearest enemy or obstacle and perform an attack.
 For every three spaces you dash, you get +2 to hit and +2 to penetration rolls.
zh:
你可启用此物，开始冲刺。
冲刺期间，每当你向某一方向移动，你会朝最近的敌人或障碍物冲刺至多20格，并发动一次攻击。
每冲刺三格，你的命中检定与穿透检定便+2。

src: You may activate this power and then later revert to the point in time when you activated it.
zh: 你可发动此技艺，日后再回到发动之时的时间点。

src: You may block an additional attack per round per shield.
zh: 你每回合每面盾牌可多格挡一次攻击。

src: You may build items from high-tier schematics and you get 1 free schematic.
zh: 你可依高阶设计图制造物品，并免费获得1张设计图。

src: You may build items from low-tier schematics and you get 1 free schematic. You can also recharge energy cells and capacitors.
zh: 你可依低阶设计图制造物品，并免费获得1张设计图。你亦可为能量电池与电容器充能。

src: You may build items from medium-tier schematics and you get 1 free schematic.
zh: 你可依中阶设计图制造物品，并免费获得1张设计图。

src: You may choose not to make offhand attacks in exchange for mastery with a single weapon.
zh: 你可选择放弃副手攻击，以换取对单一武器的精通。

src: You may communicate with others through the psychic aether.
zh: 你可借灵能以太与他人交流。

src: You may deploy missile weapons as static turrets.
zh: 你可将远程武器部署为固定炮塔。

src: You may enter the vortex to teleport to a random location in Qud.
zh: 你可进入涡旋，传送至卡德境内的随机地点。

src: You may fire missile weapons through the forcefield.
zh: 你可以隔着力场发射远程武器。

src: You may focus the light into a laser beam, temporarily reducing the radius by 1.
zh: 你可将光凝聚成激光束，暂时使半径减少1。

src: You may focus the light into a laser beam, temporarily reducing the radius of your ambient light by 1.
zh: 你可以将光聚焦成一道激光束，暂时使你的环境光半径减少1。

src: You may identify this for =cost= =cost.pluralize:dram= of fresh water.
zh: 你可以用=cost==cost.pluralize:打兰=淡水请人鉴定此物。

src: You may ingest one additional tonic without it reacting adversely to the tonic you have already ingested.
zh: 你可多服用一剂补剂，而不会与已服下的补剂产生不良反应。

src: You may lay down grenades as mines or set them as bombs.
zh: 你可将手榴弹布设为地雷，或设为炸弹。

src: You may not learn this skill if you already have =skill.name=.
zh: 若你已拥有=skill.name=，则无法学习此技能。

src: You may not learn this skill if you have =mutation.name=.
zh: 若你拥有=mutation.name=，则无法学习此技能。

src: You may not learn this skill until you have =mutation.name=.
zh: 在你拥有=mutation.name=之前，无法学习此技能。

src: You may not learn this skill until you have =skillname=.
zh: 在你拥有=skillname=之前，无法学习此技能。

src: You may not teleport =object.the.name= with Teleport Other!
zh: 你无法以“传送他人”传送=object.the.name=！

src: You may not {{Y|w}}alk into a hostile creature!
zh: 你不可{{Y|走}}入敌对生物所在之处！

src: You may only mark one target at a time.
zh: 你一次只能标记一个目标。

src: You may only select a visible square!
You may only select an explored square!
zh: 只能选择已探索的方格！

src: You may only teleport into an empty square!
You may open security doors and use some secure devices by touching them.
zh: 触碰后，你可以打开安全门并使用部分安全设备。

src: You may phase through solid objects for brief periods of time.
zh: 你可在短暂时间内穿越实体物件。

src: You may recharge =object.isplural:one of :==object.indicativeDistal= for {{C|=cost.cardinal=}} =cost.pluralize:dram= of fresh water.
zh: 你可以用 {{C|=cost.cardinal=}} =cost.pluralize:打兰=淡水为=object.isplural:其中之一:==object.indicativeDistal=充能。

src: You may repair =multiple.if:those:this= for {{C|=cost=}} =cost.pluralize:dram= of fresh water.
zh: 你可以用 {{C|=cost=}} =cost.pluralize:打兰=淡水修好=multiple.if:那些:这个=。

src: You may repair broken items with Bits.
zh: 你可用零件修复损坏的物品。

src: You may sprint for an additional 10 turns.
You may tighten your <stat Name="CarapaceName" /> to receive double the AV bonus at a -2 DV penalty as long as you remain still.
zh: 只要保持不动，你便可收紧<stat Name="CarapaceName" />，获得双倍的护甲值加成，代价是闪避值-2。

src: You may walk freely over webs.
zh: 你可在蛛网上自由行走。

src:
You missed, then the bear attacked and missed.

Attack again.
zh:
你打空了，随后熊攻过来，也没打中。

再攻击一次。

src: You molt power beams across the spectrum of light and matter.
zh: 你蜕出遍布光谱与物质的能量光束。

src: You monster! You monster! How dare you!
zh: 你这怪物！你这怪物！你怎敢！

src: You move fast <switch Name="PowerSkate"><case Value="true">and leave behind a fiery exhaust</case><default>for a short duration</default></switch>.
zh: 你<switch Name="PowerSkate"><case Value="true">疾速移动，并在身后留下炽热的尾焰</case><default>疾速移动一小段时间</default></switch>。

src: You move one space at no action cost, swapping spaces if there's a creature in the target space.
zh: 你不耗行动地移动一格；若目标格内有生物，则与其互换位置。

src: You muse over the =numShared.pluralize:secret= with =object.name|strip= and gain some insight.
zh: 你与=object.name|strip=一同细思=numShared.pluralize:秘密=，颇有所悟。

src: You must be dead? Is that truly the only way?
zh: 你说我一定是死了？真的只有这一条路吗？

src: You must grant ME alone access to the Gemara Sophia, and all other knowledge of the cosmos and Coven you possess. In this new accord, we shall be peers, and the onworlders agents of our schemes.
zh: 你必须仅允许我一人查阅智慧革马拉，以及你所知的关于宇宙与盟会的一切其他知识。在这新的盟约中，我们为平辈，而世间之人乃我们谋划的代理。

src: You must grant me and my cohort at Grit Gate access to the Gemara Sophia, and all other knowledge of the cosmos and Coven you possess. In this new accord, we shall be peers all of us.
zh: 你必须允许我与砂砾门的同伴查阅智慧革马拉，以及你所知的关于宇宙与盟会的一切其他知识。在这新的盟约中，我们皆为平辈。

src: You must have a short blade equipped in your primary hand to hobble.
zh: 你必须在主手装备一把短刃才能施展绊倒。

src: You must have a short blade equipped to shank.
zh: 你必须装备短刃才能暗刺。

src: You must have an axe equipped in your primary hand to dismember.
zh: 你必须在主手装备一把斧才能肢解。

src: You must have an axe equipped in your primary hand to use Hook and Drag.
zh: 你必须在主手装备一把斧才能使用钩拽。

src: You must have an axe or a weapon capable of dismemberment equipped in order to perform a field amputation.
zh: 你必须装备一把斧，或能够肢解的武器，才能进行野外截肢。

src: You must make a selection before advancing.
zh: 你须先做出选择才能继续。

src: You must select a location within =range.things:tile=!
zh: 你必须选择=range.things:格=以内的位置！

src: You must wait =turns.things:turn= before using =object.this= again.
zh: 你必须等待=turns.things:回合=，才能再次使用=object.this=。

src: You muster your will and shake off some of your confusion.
zh: 你凝聚意志，摆脱了部分混乱。

src: You muster your will and shake off your confusion.
zh: 你凝聚意志，摆脱了混乱。

src: You nearly mistake it for a boulder, and then you spot a crease in =pronouns.possessive= hide as =pronouns.subjective= =verb:draw:afterpronoun= a slow, hibernative breath. Suddenly you understand the saying among pig farmers: always fear large rocks.
zh: 你险些将它错认作一块巨石，随即却见=pronouns.possessive=皮上有一道褶皱微微收拢——=pronouns.subjective=正吸一口缓慢的、冬眠似的长气。你忽然懂得了养猪人之间那句老话：永远要提防大石头。

src: You need =hasAny.if:another:a= free =slotType= slot to equip that!
zh: 你需要=hasAny.if:再有一个:一个=空闲的=slotType=槽位才能装备！

src: You need a dram of =liquids.either.or= to desecrate a shrine.
zh: 亵渎圣龛需要一打兰的=liquids.either.or=。

src: You need a new hat, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Or a helmet, if that's the life you lead.
zh: 你该换顶新帽了，=player.formalAddressTerm=。或者换顶头盔，若你过的是那种日子。

src: You need another =shortBy.cardinal= free =bodyPartType.type= slots to equip that!
zh: 你还需要=shortBy.cardinal=个空闲的=bodyPartType.type=槽位才能装备！

src: You need another =shortBy.cardinal= free =slotType= slots to equip that!
zh: 你还需要=shortBy.cardinal=个空闲的=slotType=槽位才能装备！

src: You need another free =bodyPartType.type= slot to equip that!
zh: 你还需要一个空闲的=bodyPartType.type=槽位才能装备！

src: You need at least =amount= charge to generate a discharge.
zh: 你至少需要=amount=点电荷才能放电。

src: You need sunlight to bask in.
You need {{C|=cost.cardinal=}} =cost.pluralize:dram= of fresh water to charge =object.isplural:one of :==object.indicativeDistal=.
zh: 你需要 {{C|=cost.cardinal=}} =cost.pluralize:打兰=淡水，才能为=object.isplural:其中之一:==object.indicativeDistal=充能。

src: You need {{C|=cost=}} =cost.pluralize:dram= of fresh water to repair =multiple.if:those:that=.
zh: 修好=multiple.if:那些:那个=需要 {{C|=cost=}} =cost.pluralize:打兰=淡水。

src: You note the location of =note.text.plain= in the {{W|=locationPath= > Named Locations}} section of your journal.
zh: 你在日志的{{W|=locationPath= > 命名地点}}栏记下了=note.text.plain=的所在。

src: You note the location of =note.text.plain|title|initLowerIfArticle= in the {{W|=locationPath= > Historic Sites}} section of your journal.
zh: 你在日志的{{W|=locationPath= > 史迹}}栏记下了=note.text.plain|title|initLowerIfArticle=的所在。

src: You note the location of =note.text.plain|title|initLowerIfArticle= in the {{W|=locationPath= > Ruins with Becoming Nooks}} section of your journal.
zh: 你在日志的{{W|=locationPath= > 含化身龛的废墟}}一栏记下了=note.text.plain|title|initLowerIfArticle=的位置。

src: You note the location of =note.text.plain|title|initLowerIfArticle= in the {{W|=locationPath= > Ruins}} section of your journal.
zh: 你在日志的{{W|=locationPath= > 废墟}}栏记下了=note.text.plain|title|initLowerIfArticle=的所在。

src: You note the location of =note.text= in the {{W|=locationPath= > Artifacts}} section of your journal.
zh: 你在日志的{{W|=locationPath= > 古器}}栏记下了=note.text=的所在。

src: You note the location of =note.text= in the {{W|=locationPath= > Baetyls}} section of your journal.
zh: 你在日志的{{W|=locationPath= > 圣石}}栏记下了=note.text=的所在。

src: You note the location of =note.text= in the {{W|=locationPath= > Lairs}} section of your journal.
zh: 你在日志的{{W|=locationPath= > 巢穴}}栏记下了=note.text=的所在。

src: You note the location of =note.text= in the {{W|=locationPath= > Merchants}} section of your journal.
zh: 你在日志的{{W|=locationPath= > 商人}}栏记下了=note.text=的所在。

src: You note the location of =note.text= in the {{W|=locationPath= > Natural Features}} section of your journal.
zh: 你在日志的{{W|=locationPath= > 自然地貌}}栏记下了=note.text=的所在。

src: You note the location of =note.text= in the {{W|=locationPath= > Oddities}} section of your journal.
zh: 你在日志的{{W|=locationPath= > 奇物}}栏记下了=note.text=的所在。

src: You note the location of =note.text= in the {{W|=locationPath= > Settlements}} section of your journal.
zh: 你在日志的{{W|=locationPath= > 聚落}}栏记下了=note.text=的所在。

src: You note the location of some forgotten ruins in the {{W|=locationPath= > Ruins with Becoming Nooks}} section of your journal.
zh: 你在日志的{{W|=locationPath= > 含化身龛的废墟}}栏记下了某处被遗忘的遗迹的所在。

src: You note the location of some forgotten ruins in the {{W|=locationPath= > Ruins}} section of your journal.
zh: 你在日志的{{W|=locationPath= > 废墟}}栏记下了某处被遗忘的遗迹的所在。

src: You notice some ruins nearby. Would you like to investigate?
zh: 你注意到附近有些遗迹。要前去调查吗？

src: You notice some strange ruins nearby. Do you want to investigate?
zh: 你注意到附近有些奇怪的废墟。要前去探查吗？

src: You now have =total= feet of copper wire.
You now know the location of an {{C|oddly-hued}} glowpad merchant.
zh: 你已知晓一株{{C|异色}}辉垫商贩所在之处。

src: You now know the location of {{M|Hamilcrab's shop}}.
zh: 你已知晓{{M|哈米尔蟹的店铺}}所在之处。

src: You now owe =trader.t= =owe= =owe.pluralize:dram= of fresh water.
You occasionally peck at your opponents.
You only know your general state of health and not your precise number of hit points.
zh: 你只知自己大致的健康状况，而不知确切的生命值。

src: You only manifest mental mutations, and all of your mutation choices when manifesting a new mutation are mental.
zh: 你只会显现精神变异，且每次显现新变异时，你所面对的选项全为精神变异。

src: You only manifest physical mutations, and all of your mutation choices when manifesting a new mutation are physical.
zh: 你只会显现身体变异，且每次显现新变异时，你所面对的选项全为身体变异。

src: You open the box and expose the compressed foamcrete to air. It starts to expand.
zh: 你打开盒子，让压缩泡沫混凝土接触到空气。它开始膨胀。

src: You pass over ground terrain and cannot be attacked by ground creatures in melee.
zh: 你凌驾于地面之上，地面生物无法对你发动近战攻击。

src: You peer into your near future.
zh: 你窥视自身不远的未来。

src: You persuade an intelligent creature to join you.
zh: 你说服一名有智慧的生物加入你。

src:
You picked up the odd trinket automatically because it is an artifact.

Press =commandKey:CmdCharacter= to investigate it.
zh:
你自动拾取了这件古怪的饰物，因为它是古器。

按=commandKey:CmdCharacter=查看它。

src:
You picked up the odd trinket automatically because it is an artifact.

Press =commandKey:CmdInventory= to investigate it.
zh:
你自动拾取了这件古怪的饰物，因为它是古器。

按=commandKey:CmdInventory=查看它。

src: You pony up =available= =available.pluralize:dram= of fresh water, and now owe =trader.the.name|strip= =owe= =owe.pluralize:dram=.
zh: 你额外付出=available==available.pluralize:打兰=淡水，如今欠=trader.the.name|strip==owe==owe.pluralize:打兰=。

src: You pony up =difference= =difference.pluralize:dram= of fresh water to even up the trade
zh: 你额外付出=difference==difference.pluralize:打兰=淡水，以补足这笔交易

src: You pour water on yourself rather than drinking it to quench your thirst.
zh: 你以淡水浇淋己身，而非饮用，来解渴。

src: You poured the raw entropy of the universe on the ground and caused the space around you to glitch.
zh: 你将宇宙的原初熵泼洒在地面上，令你周围的空间失真错乱。

src: You poured the raw entropy of the universe onto things and caused them to glitch into other things.
zh: 你将宇宙的原初熵泼洒在万物之上，令它们幻变成了别的事物。

src: You power equipped devices that have integrated power.
zh: 你为已装备、自带电源的装置供电。

src: You produce a viscous slime that you can spit at things.
zh: 你分泌一种黏稠的黏液，可向目标吐去。

src: You produce ambient light within a radius of <stat Name="Radius" />.
zh: 你在半径<stat Name="Radius" />范围内生成环境光。

src: You project your mind into an adjacent robot and control its actions while your own body lies dormant.
zh: 你将心神投入相邻的机器人，操控其行动，而自身躯体陷入休眠。

src: You provoke waking dreams with your gaze.
zh: 你以凝视引发白日梦魇。

src: You puff spore and spread Klanq.
zh: 你喷出孢子，播撒克朗克。

src: You quickly pass back and forth through time creating multiple copies of yourself.
zh: 你在时间中疾速往返穿梭，造出自身的多个分身。

src:
You read one of the few legible excerpts from =title|color:Y=:

"=sentence="
zh:
你读到了=title|color:Y=中寥寥可辨的节选之一：

“=sentence=”

src: You read the history of artifacts by touching them, learning what they do and how they were made.
zh: 你触摸古器即可读取其历史，得知其功用与制造之法。

src: You really think Keh stole the treasure?
zh: 你真认为是凯偷了宝物？

src: You rebuke a robot into wandering away or joining you.
zh: 你斥退一台机器人，使其游荡离去或加入你。

src: You rebuke robots as if you were 5 levels higher.
zh: 你斥退机器人时，如同自己高出5级。

src: You rebuked Resheph and returned to Qud to help garden the burgeoning world.
zh: 你斥退利悉，返回卡德，为这方初兴的世界耕耘园艺。

src: You receive no accuracy penalties for firing pistols while running.
zh: 奔跑时开枪，你不受命中惩罚。

src: You receive no penalty to your DV while sprinting and can jump without interrupting your sprint.
zh: 疾跑时你的闪避值不受惩罚，且可在不中断疾跑的情况下跳跃。

src: You recharge an energy cell or capacitor with tinkering bits.
zh: 你用修补零件为一枚能量电池或电容器充能。

src: You recover the Mark of Death of the late sultanate.
zh: 你寻回了末代苏丹国的死亡印记。

src: You recovered the ancestral bracelet of the hindren, =this.refname=.
zh: 你寻回了欣德伦人的祖传手镯=this.refname=。

src: You recovered the lost aegis of House Yish, =this.refname=.
zh: 你寻回了伊什家族失落的庇护之盾=this.refname=。

src: You recovered the masterwork pistol and legendary ode to vengeance, the =this.refname=.
zh: 你寻回了这柄精工手枪，一阕复仇的传奇颂歌——=this.refname=。

src: You reflect mental attacks back at your attackers.
zh: 你将精神攻击反射回攻击者。

src: You reflect the shameful countenance of nearby creatures.
zh: 你映出周围生物那羞惭难堪的面容。

src:
You regain hitpoints naturally as turns pass. You can pass a few turns by waiting, or if there are no hostile creatures around, you can {{W|rest until healed}}.

Press =commandKey:CmdWaitUntilHealed=
zh:
随着回合流逝，你的生命值会自然恢复。你可以等待若干回合；若周围没有敌对生物，也可以{{W|休息至痊愈}}。

按=commandKey:CmdWaitUntilHealed=

src: You regenerate <stat Name="Quills" /> at the approximate rate of <stat Name="RegenRate" /> per round.
zh: 你以约每回合<stat Name="RegenRate" />的速率再生<stat Name="Quills" />。
你通过吸收热量来再生。

src: You regenerate hit points at one-fifth the usual rate in the daylight.
zh: 在日光下，你恢复生命值的速率仅为平常的五分之一。

src: You regulate your body's release of adrenaline.
zh: 你能调节体内肾上腺素的分泌。

src: You rejoiced in a drop of nectar.
zh: 你因一滴琼浆而欢喜无量。

src: You release a burst of <stat Name="GasName" /> around yourself.
zh: 你在自身周围释放一团<stat Name="GasName" />。

src: You release a burst of confusion gas around yourself
zh: 你在周身迸发一阵迷惑气体

src: You release a burst of corrosive gas around yourself
zh: 你在周身迸发一阵腐蚀性气体

src: You release a burst of defoliant around yourself
zh: 你在周身迸发一阵落叶剂

src: You release a burst of fungicide around yourself
zh: 你在周身迸发一阵杀菌剂

src: You release a burst of glitter around yourself
zh: 你在周身迸发一阵闪粉

src: You release a burst of glitter around yourself.
zh: 你在周身迸发一阵闪粉。

src: You release a burst of normality gas around yourself
zh: 你在周身迸发一阵常态气体

src: You release a burst of plasma around yourself
zh: 你在周身迸发一阵等离子体

src: You release a burst of poison gas around yourself
zh: 你在周身迸发一阵毒气

src: You release a burst of sleep gas around yourself
zh: 你在周身迸发一阵催眠气体

src: You replenish yourself by absorbing sunlight through your hearty green skin.
zh: 你的青翠皮肤坚韧强健，吸纳日光，以滋养自身。

src: You require about two-thirds more water than usual.
zh: 你所需的水量比常人多出约三分之二。

src: You restored functionality to one of the four strange entities in the Tomb.
zh: 你修复了古墓中四个奇异存在之一的功能。

src: You return. Have you succeeded in decoding the signal?
zh: 你回来了。信号破译成功了吗？

src: You returned from the Tomb of the Eaters after successfully disabling the Spindle's magnetic field.
zh: 你成功关闭纺锤的磁场，从食者之墓返回。

src:
You rifle through trash, with a <switch Name="RiflingSkills">
              <case Value="TrashDivining"><stat Name="Chance" />% chance to piece together clues and learn a random secret</case>
              <case Value="Scavenger">chance to scavenge scrap from the pile</case>
              <case Value="Scavenger,TrashDivining">chance to scavenge scrap from the pile and a <stat Name="Chance" />% chance to piece together clues and learn a random secret</case>
              </switch>.
zh:
你翻检垃圾堆，有<switch Name="RiflingSkills">
              <case Value="TrashDivining"><stat Name="Chance" />%的几率拼凑出线索，习得一则随机秘密</case>
              <case Value="Scavenger">几率从垃圾堆中拾得废料</case>
              <case Value="Scavenger,TrashDivining">几率从垃圾堆中拾得废料，并有<stat Name="Chance" />%的几率拼凑出线索，习得一则随机秘密</case>
              </switch>。

src: You ruminant people are impossible. I will find Eskhind myself.
zh: 你们这些反刍的族人真是不可理喻。我自己去找埃斯金德。

src: You saw the fate before you and held it close. We had not your sight; please forgive us. We love you so.
zh: 你看见了摆在眼前的命运，并把它紧紧抱住。我们没有你那样的眼力；请宽恕我们。我们如此爱你。

src: You say plurality. Are there other interpretations?
zh: 你说“众论所归”。还有别的解释吗？

src: You scramble down a craggy ledge.
zh: 你手脚并用，爬下嶙峋岩阶。

src: You see, =name=, when I, a young bruin, crossed the Homs Delta with my flood-fleeing clan and into the western reach of Qud, the plagues of the Gyre were already ascendant. We took root at our new hearth, in the chrome grottos where we urshiib find natural peace, and by the providence of my elders, I was able to study the tinkering craft.
zh: 你看，=name=，当年我还是只年轻的小熊，随着躲避洪水的族群渡过霍姆斯三角洲，进入卡德西境之时，回旋的瘟疫已然势头正盛。我们在新的炉边扎下根来，就在乌尔希卜一族自然得享安宁的铬色洞窟之中；凭着长辈的庇佑，我得以研习修补之术。

src: You seem more irritated than usual.
You sense a subtle psychic disturbance.
zh: 你感到一丝细微的心灵扰动。

src: You sense your imminent demise. Would you like to return to the start of your vision?
zh: 你感到自己死期将至。要回到幻象的开端吗？

src: You set a target temperature and are heated or cooled each round until you reach it.
zh: 你设定一个目标温度，每回合受热或受冷，直至达到该温度。

src: You set a target temperature of =target=.
You shake the water from your addled brain, but someone else's thoughts have already taken root.
zh: 你从昏沉中振作起来，可他人的念头早已在你心中扎根。

src: You shame a nearby creature, giving it -4 to DV, to-hit, Ego, and Willpower, and -10% to Quickness.
zh: 你羞辱附近的一名生物，使其闪避值、命中、自我与意志-4，迅捷-10%。

src:
You share the pessimism of my kin, and several of the priests as well. My heart hears you, but listen to my words, and maybe you will come to feel as I do.

To devalue wisdom is to devalue the Kasaphescence. She shines in the void, refracting light, illuminating those around her. So does the written wisdom of our elders.

The machinery of chromium is complex in its divinity. Don't we do a disservice to our Fathers when we remain ignorant of it, of our past, of our future? Don't we deserve the joy of knowing? Bless Eschelstadt II, first Child, for he believes as I do.
zh:
你与我的亲族一般悲观，几位祭司亦然。我的心听见了你，但请听我一言，或许你也会渐渐与我同感。

贬低智慧，便是贬低圣化现。她在虚空中闪耀，折射光芒，照亮周遭万物。我们先辈所留下的文字智慧，亦复如是。

铬的机枢，其神圣之处何等繁复。我们若对它、对我们的过去、对我们的未来一无所知，岂不是辜负了诸父？我们岂不配享知晓之乐？愿埃舍尔施塔特二世，首位圣子，蒙福，因他与我所信相同。

src: You shift spacetime in the local region.

You should be proud, Detective =name=.

The hand of justice can be harsh, but it is fair. You have been its agent here.
zh:
你该感到自豪，=name=侦探。

正义之手或许严厉，却是公平的。你便是它在此处的使者。

src: You should view the tooltip before equipping the axe.
zh: 装备战斧前，你应该先查看提示框。

src: You shoulder your weapons more effectively. Heavy weapons count for half their weight toward your encumbrance.
zh: 你扛持武器更为得法。重型武器计入你负重时只算一半重量。

src: You slew your bonded kith =object.a.name:withTitles=, violating the covenant of the water ritual and earning the emnity of all.
zh: 你杀死了与你缔结水礼的亲友=object.a.name:withTitles=，背弃水礼之约，招致众人切齿之恨。

src: You smell roasted boar nearby. Would you like to investigate?
zh: 你闻到附近有烤野猪肉的香气。要前去调查吗？

src: You solved the mystery of the chewed-up watervine and warned the villagers of Joppa of the Girsh.
zh: 你查明了水藤遭啃食之谜，并警告约帕村民吉尔什来袭。

src: You sound very unsure of yourself.
You speak aloud. You're not telepathic?
zh: 你是出声说话的。你不是心灵感应者吗？

src: You spend a turn to draw a bead on a target and mark it.
zh: 你花费一回合瞄准目标并加以标记。

src: You spend a turn to draw a bead on a target and mark it. Whenever you fire at a marked target with a bow or rifle, your agility is treated as if it were 2 points higher for the purpose of determining your accuracy. You may only mark one target at a time. Targets get unmarked if you lose vision of them.
zh: 你花费一回合对目标瞄准并将其标记。每当你以弓或步枪射击已标记的目标时，判定命中率时你的敏捷视同高出2点。你同一时间只能标记一个目标。若你失去对目标的视野，其标记即消失。

src: You spew a pool of liquid from your space into a nearby area.
zh: 你从所在之处向附近区域喷涌一汪液体。
你吐丝结出黏稠的蛛网。

src: You spit a puddle of <stat Name="Liquid" />.
You spit a puddle of corrosive acid.
zh: 你吐出一滩腐蚀性酸液。

src: You spoke with the Barathrumites at their enclave in Grit Gate.
zh: 你在砂砾门的据点与巴拉斯鲁姆派交谈。

src: You spoke with the baetyl at the Temple of the Rock and decoded the mysterious signal.
zh: 你在磐石圣殿与圣石交谈，并破译了神秘信号。
你发现巨型{{R|苹果酒}}泣孔。
你长出一朵{{C|发光的霜菇}}。

src: You stand not at the foot of a wintry knoll but beneath a mountain of muscle, swathed in blanched fur, that must be nature's crowning jewel. Cast from the mold of the great apes (or perhaps the exemplar from which those apes were molded), the living god differs only in that =pronouns.subjective= =verb:bear:afterpronoun= not two but six arms, each of which might be the fleeced bole of an ancient yew. =pronouns.Possessive= fists are of proportions that suggest the might with which hoary gods beat the mountains into shape when the earth was young. However, =pronouns.possessive= aspect bears not a shred of that divine fury; =pronouns.subjective= =verb:don't:afterpronoun= rage but instead =verb:sit:afterpronoun= in contemplation of eons.
zh: 你并非立在一座冬日小丘的脚下，而是置身于一座肌骨之山下——它裹着苍白的毛皮，必定是自然最冠冕的珍宝。它铸自巨猿的模具（或许巨猿正铸自它这具范本），这活生生的神祇唯一的不同，在于=pronouns.subjective=生着六条手臂而非两条，每条都堪作一株古紫杉覆满绒毛的树干。=pronouns.Possessive=双拳之大，令人想见那些苍古的神祇在大地尚年轻时挥拳将群山塑造成形的伟力。然而=pronouns.possessive=神情中没有半分那样的神怒；=pronouns.subjective=并不咆哮，只是静坐，沉思万古。

src: You stare down a nearby opponent and send them fleeing in terror.
zh: 你瞪视附近一名对手，令其惊惧奔逃。

src: You stare down an opponent and send them fleeing in terror.
zh: 你怒目逼视对手，使其惊恐逃窜。

src: You start a campfire for cooking meals and preserving foods.
zh: 你生起一堆营火，用以烹饪膳食、保存食物。

src: You start dashing in a plume of flame and smoke.
zh: 你在烈焰与烟尘中开始冲刺。

src:
You start to metabolize the meal, gaining the following effect for the rest of the day:

{{W|=effect.details=}}
zh:
你开始消化这餐，在今日余下的时间里获得以下效果：

{{W|=effect.details=}}

src:
You start to metabolize the meal, gaining the following effect for the rest of the day:

{{W|=effect=}}
zh:
你开始消化这顿餐食，并在今日余下的时间里获得以下效果：

{{W|=effect=}}

src: You staunch the wounds of =object.the.name=, though some are too deep to treat.
zh: 你止住了=object.the.name=的血，不过有些伤口太深，无法处理。

src: You staunch your wounds, though some are too deep to treat.
zh: 你止住了自己的血，不过有些伤口太深，无法处理。

src: You stop assuming this creature's form.
zh: 你不再化为此生物的形态。

src: You stop meditating if you take damage in a single round exceeding <stat Name="DamageThreshold" />.
zh: 若你单回合所受伤害超过<stat Name="DamageThreshold" />，便会中止冥想。

src: You strain to part the veil of time in order to use psychometry on =object.the.name:single=, but you are too confused.
zh: 你勉力掀开时间之幕，想对=object.the.name:single=使用灵视物感，但你过于混乱。

src: You strain to part the veil of time in order to use psychometry on =object.the.name:single=, but your psyche is too exhausted.
zh: 你勉力掀开时间之幕，想对=object.the.name:single=使用灵视物感，但你的心灵已过度疲惫。

src: You strike me as an Aristocrat who knows the value of artisanal organs.
zh: 我看你像是个懂得手工脏器价值的贵族。

src: You strike with your stinger, automatically hitting, penetrating, and applying your <stat Name="VenomType" /> venom.
zh: 你以毒刺出击，必定命中并穿透，同时注入你的<stat Name="VenomType" />毒液。

src: You stumble upon some flattened remains.
zh: 你无意间发现了一些被压扁的残骸。

src: You stumbled upon some flattened remains.
zh: 你无意间发现了一些被压扁的残骸。

src: You submerge yourself in a body of water.
zh: 你将自身没入一片水域。

src: You suffer 50% more damage from bludgeoning attacks, falling, and other sources of concussive damage.
zh: 你受到钝击、坠落及其他冲击类伤害时，所受伤害多出50%。

src: You suffer from powerful psionic migraines that render your head extremely sensitive.
zh: 你饱受强烈的灵能性偏头痛折磨，头部因此变得异常敏感。

src: You suffer no movement penalty while wielding a heavy weapon.
zh: 持重型武器时，你不受移动惩罚。

src: You sunder spacetime, sending things nearby careening through a tear in the cosmic fabric.
zh: 你撕裂时空，将附近之物卷入宇宙经纬的裂口，翻滚而去。

src: You sunder spacetime, teleporting to a random location in Qud.
zh: 你撕裂时空，传送至卡德境内的随机地点。

src: You sunder the mind of an enemy, leaving them reeling in pain.
zh: 你撕裂敌人的心智，令其痛苦不堪，步履踉跄。

src: You swell with inspiration to cook a mouthwatering meal.
zh: 你灵感涌动，渴望烹制一顿令人垂涎的美餐。

src: You swoop down to attack a target on the ground, using one turn to attack and one to return to the air.
zh: 你俯冲而下，攻击地面上的目标，攻击耗费一回合，重返空中耗费一回合。

src: You take 15% less damage from heating and cooling effects. Additionally, the severities of effects that change your temperature are reduced by 15%.
zh: 你受到的加热与冷却效果伤害减少15%。此外，改变你体温的效果，其强度降低15%。

src: You take 25% less damage from poison.
zh: 你受到的毒素伤害减少25%。

src: You take half damage from poison.
zh: 你受到的毒素伤害减半。

src: You tap into the aggregate mind and steal power from other espers.
zh: 你触及群体心智，从其他灵能者那里窃取力量。

src: You tarry on the future's boundary with abandon, utensil. Throw your brick if you dare.
zh: 你肆无忌惮地在未来的边界上徘徊，器具。有胆便扔你的砖。

src: You tattoo the mark of death on =object.the.name's:withTitles= =part.ordinalName=.
You tear open the tender muscle fibers of your tongue.
zh: 你撕裂了舌上柔嫩的肌纤维。
你会不受控制地四处闪现。

src: You teleport an adjacent creature to a random nearby location.
zh: 你将一名相邻的生物传送至附近的随机地点。

src: You teleport and bring creatures along with you.
zh: 你可传送自身，并携带周围生物同行。

src: You teleport back to a programmed location.
zh: 你传送回已设定的地点。

src: You teleport back to the programmed location.
zh: 你传送回已设定的地点。

src: You teleport to a nearby location and bring everyone within radius <stat Name="TeleportRadius" /> along with you
zh: 你传送至附近某处，并带上半径<stat Name="TeleportRadius" />范围内的所有人同行

src: You teleport to a nearby location and bring everyone within radius <stat Name="TeleportRadius" /> along with you.
zh: 你传送至附近某处，并带上半径<stat Name="TeleportRadius" />以内的所有生物同行。

src: You teleport to a nearby location near your leader.
zh: 你传送至首领附近的某处。

src: You teleport to a nearby location.
You teleport to a random, explored space on the map.
zh: 你传送至地图上随机一处已探索的空格。

src: You teleport to any explored space on the map.
zh: 你传送至地图上任一已探索的空格。

src: You teleport to the tethered location.
You terrify adjacent, hostile creatures into fleeing from you for <stat Name="Duration" />.
zh: 你恫吓相邻的敌对生物，使其惊惶逃离你，持续<stat Name="Duration" />。

src: You think Keh stole the treasure?

You thrived at the performance of a pruning motion, utensil. Now store yourself until Fate reshapes you.

The end.
zh:
你擅长修剪之举，器具。如今且收起自己，待命运将你重塑。

完了。

src: You tighten your =carapace.name=. Your AV increases by {{G|=tightFactor=}}.
You tinker <stat Name="An" /> <stat Name="TurretName" /> in an adjacent space.
zh: 你在相邻的空格中修造<stat Name="An" /><stat Name="TurretName" />。

src: You toss =ingredients.andList= into a pot and stir.
You touch the chiming rock. White noise carries on a distant wind.
zh: 你触碰鸣响之石。白噪随远风而来。

src: You touched the chiming rock and attuned to Chavvah, the Tree of Life.
zh: 你触碰了鸣响之石，与生命之树查娃心意相通。

src: You tower over every other frog I've seen. Are you svardym?
zh: 你比我见过的所有青蛙都高大。你是斯瓦迪姆吗？

src: You travel far and wide, do you not? You have the air of a traveling hero! From the epics. As such, you have seen many settlements, likely ingratiated yourself to some.
zh: 你走遍天下，对吧？你有传奇中游历英雄的风采！既如此，你想必见过许多聚落，说不定还结交了几处。

src: You travel on the world map at <stat Name="WorldMapTravelSpeed" />x speed.
zh: 你在世界地图上的行进速度为<stat Name="WorldMapTravelSpeed" />倍。

src: You try to boost =object.name's= immunity with a balm made from =cure.a.name:single=, but it is ineffective.
zh: 你试图用=cure.a.name:single=调制的药膏增强=object.name's=的免疫力，但毫无效果。

src: You try to cure =object.name's= disease onset, but cannot affect =object.them=.
zh: 你试图治愈=object.name's=的发病初兆，但无法触及=object.them=。

src: You try to cure =object.name's= disease onset, but your limbs pass through =object.them=.
zh: 你试图治愈=object.name's=的发病初兆，但你的肢体穿过了=object.them=。

src: You try to cure =object.name's= illness, but cannot affect =object.them=.
zh: 你试图治愈=object.name's=的疾病，但无法触及=object.them=。

src: You try to cure =object.name's= illness, but your limbs pass through =object.them=.
zh: 你试图治愈=object.name's=的疾病，但你的肢体穿过了=object.them=。

src: You try to cure the poison coursing through =object.the.name=, but cannot affect =object.them=.
zh: 你试图解除=object.the.name=体内奔涌之毒，但无法触及=object.them=。

src: You try to cure the poison coursing through =object.the.name=, but your cures are ineffective.
zh: 你试图解除=object.the.name=体内奔涌之毒，但你的解药毫无效用。

src: You try to cure the poison coursing through =object.the.name=, but your limbs pass through =object.them=.
zh: 你试图解除=object.the.name=体内奔涌之毒，但你的肢体穿过了=object.them=。

src: You try to push through the normality lattice, but it snaps back into place.
zh: 你试图穿过常态晶格，却被弹回原处。

src: You try to push through the normality lattice, but it snaps back into place. You wince in pain.
zh: 你试图穿过常态晶格，却被弹回原处，痛得蹙起眉头。

src: You try to staunch the wounds of =object.the.name=, but cannot affect =object.them=.
You try to staunch the wounds of =object.the.name=, but your limbs pass through =object.them=.
zh: 你试图为=object.the.name=止血，但你的肢体穿过了=object.them=。

src: You turn things to stone with your gaze.
zh: 你以凝视将万物化为石头。

src: You uncannily avoid your demise, and your life is restored.
zh: 你神乎其神地躲过了死劫，生命得以恢复。

src: You valiantly defended Grit Gate from an attack by the Putus Templar.
zh: 你英勇守卫砂砾门，击退普图斯圣殿骑士团的袭击。

src: You violated the Pauli exclusion principle.
zh: 你违背了泡利不相容原理。

src: You violated the covenant of the water ritual and killed your bonded kith. You are cursed.
zh: 你违背水礼之约，杀死了与你缔盟的亲友。你受到了诅咒。

src: You visited a coterie of Tomb-dwelling mopango.
zh: 你拜访了一群栖居于墓中的莫潘戈人。

src: You visited the historic site of =regionName=.
You walked the Coral Path and convinced Pax Klanq, mushroom prodigy, to fabricate a battery of Q Girl's design.
zh: 你走过珊瑚之路，说服天才蘑菇帕克斯·克朗克制造Q女孩设计的电池。
你曾是另一块鸣钟的爱侣？

src: You were cured of glotrot and your tongue regrew.
zh: 你的腐舌症痊愈，舌头重新长出。

src: You were cured of ironshank and your leg bones softened.
zh: 你的铁胫症痊愈，腿骨软化了下来。

src: You were cured of monochrome and your vision returned to color.
zh: 你的单色症痊愈，视界重归斑斓。

src: You were perfect in every iteration.
zh: 你在每一次迭代中皆完美无缺。

src: You were responsible for the plagues then?
You will be happier this way.
You will find a way. Live and drink.
zh: 你会想出办法的。且生且饮。

src: You will no longer autoget any type of =object.name=.
You will not auto-attack =target.the.name= because =target.it.is= not hostile to you.
zh: 你不会自动攻击=target.the.name=，因为=target.it.is=对你并无敌意。
你现在会重新自动拾取=object.pluralName=。

src: You will phase back in in =duration.things:round=.
zh: 你将在=duration.things:回合=后回归实体。

src: You wish you had burned such a vital truth?
zh: 如此要紧的真相，你竟想把它烧掉？

src: You woke from a fitful dream.
You woke from a peaceful dream.
You would suborn your will to Ptoh?
zh: 你要把你的意志奉给普托？

src: You! Are you come to attend his waking dream? Nor do I have cloven hooves, but, yes, a cloven mind.
zh: 你！可是来赴他的白日梦魇？我并无分蹄，然，是的，我有分裂之心。

src:
You'll be able to explore the world freely after the tutorial.

For now, let's visit Joppa.
zh:
教程结束后，你就能自由探索世界了。

现在，我们先去约帕看看吧。

src: You'll be back, =player.formalAddressTerm=, provided you don't blow =player.reflexive= up.
zh: 你会再来的，=player.formalAddressTerm=，只要你别把=player.reflexive=炸飞。

src: You'll have to pony up =difference= =difference.pluralize:dram= of fresh water to even up the trade. Agreed?
zh: 你得额外付出=difference==difference.pluralize:打兰=淡水才能补足这笔交易。同意吗？

src: You're a chromeling... that speaks? Can you understand me?
zh: 你是个会说话的……铬灵？你能听懂我的话吗？

src: You're a member of the Consortium of Phyta, right? What do you know about the Earl of Omonporch?
zh: 你是植体联盟的一员吧？关于奥蒙门廊的伯爵，你知道些什么？

src: You're a seeker of the Sightless Way?
You're back. Have you found the exile and retrieved our treasure?
zh: 你回来了。可找到那流放者，取回我们的宝物了？

src:
You're being a bit annoying, so I suppose both of us have our burdens to bear.

Perhaps we should do some trading and move on with our lives, hmm?
zh:
你有些烦人，想来你我各有各的重担要背。

或许我们该做完买卖，各奔前程，嗯？

src: You're going to collapse from exhaustion in =duration.things:round=.
zh: 你将在=duration.things:回合=后因疲惫倒下。

src:
You're going to the Thin World? I confess to some measure of envy.

I have dreamt many times of disappearing into a cool ocean of information, shaking the cruft of my physical form from newly-freed quills. If that came of my waking life, would I then dream as chore-doing Iseppa in her chambers? Perhaps it's best I don't know.
zh:
你要去薄界？不瞒你说，我有几分羡慕。

我多次梦见自己消失于一片清凉的信息之海，从刚刚解脱的翎羽上抖落这副肉身的累赘。若这竟在醒时成真，那我是否会转而梦见自己仍是闺房中操持琐务的伊赛帕？或许还是不知道的好。

src: You're in a pocket dimension with no worldmap.
zh: 你身处一处没有世界地图的口袋次元。

src: You're just trying to keep dear Esk informed, then? Or could it be that you're wondering if that home may be Bey Lah?
zh: 这么说，你只是想让亲爱的埃斯知道消息？还是说，你在琢磨那个家会不会就是贝拉？

src: You're lost! Regain your bearings by exploring your surroundings.
zh: 你迷路了！请探索周围环境，重新辨明方向。

src: You're much nicer than most turrets I meet.
zh: 你比我遇到的大多数炮塔和善多了。

src: You're much worse at examining artifacts.
zh: 你检查古器的能力大幅降低。

src: You're not talented enough to draw that.
zh: 你的绘画技艺还不足以画出那个。

src: You're one of the founders of this freehold, aren't you?
zh: 你是这自由领的奠基人之一，对吧？

src: You're rather civil for a turret.
zh: 作为炮塔，你相当彬彬有礼。

src: You're ready to continue the journey on your own, but don't hesitate to play the tutorial again if you need a refresher.
zh: 你已经可以独自继续旅程了，不过若是想复习，别犹豫，再玩一遍教程。

src: You're saying that what evidence I choose to show will affect the outcome of the case?
zh: 你是说，我选择出示哪些证据，会影响案件的结局？

src: You're standing in my light! What do you want?
zh: 你挡着我的光了！有何贵干？

src: You're the Warden. You tell me.
You're too confused to do that.
zh: 你太过混乱，无法这么做。

src: You're too famished to travel long distances.
zh: 你饥饿难耐，无法长途跋涉。

src: You're very thoughtful, as turrets go.
zh: 就炮塔而言，你很深思熟虑。

src: You're welcome, Gyamyo. Live and drink.
zh: 不客气，贾米奥。且生且饮。

src: You've a twin across the boundary of the future, where new life blooms in rot. Are you with them?
zh: 在未来的界线那边，你有一个孪生者，新生在腐烂中绽放。你与他们同在吗？

src:
You've found our treasure? I'll admit, kendren, I'm very impressed.

Take this as thanks, and... well. I suppose you've earned your stay for a while. Just try not to give the faundren any ideas.
zh:
你找到我们的宝物了？不瞒你说，肯德伦，我印象深刻。

请收下，权作谢礼，还有……罢了。你想必已挣得在此暂住的资格。只是莫给小欣德伦们出什么主意。

src:
You've found our treasure? I'll admit, kendren, I'm very impressed. Take this as thanks.

That said, the exile must answer for her crimes. There is further reward for you if you see this case through to the end.
zh:
你找到我们的宝物了？不瞒你说，肯德伦，我印象深刻。请收下，权作谢礼。

话虽如此，流放者必须为其罪行交代。你若将此案办到底，另有赏赐。

src:
You've found our treasure? Thank you, kendren!

Please take this reward, we set it aside for just this purpose. I apologize if it's too little. Thank you so much, again.
zh:
你找到我们的宝物了？谢谢你，肯德伦！

请收下这份酬谢，我们正是为此留存的。若嫌太少，还请见谅。再次深深谢谢你。

src: You've got to respect a machine. Machines bite harder than any croc.
zh: 对机器须存敬畏。机器咬起人来，比鳄鱼还狠。

src: You've wasted enough of my time. Prepare to die.
zh: 你浪费我的时间够多了。受死吧。

src:
You. I roil to see you. I welcome you. I churn.

Do you know this weight, I wonder? Can you?
zh:
是你。我见你，心潮翻涌。我欢迎你。我激荡不已。

你可识得这份重量？我在想。你能吗？

src: Your =attribute.statCapDisplayName= isn't high enough to buy =powerEntry.name=!
Your =bodyPartType|lower= is too damaged to do that!
zh: 你的=bodyPartType|lower=受损过重，无法这么做！

src: Your =part.ordinalName= =part.is= too damaged to do that!
zh: 你的=part.ordinalName==part.is=受损过重，无法这么做！

src: Your Charge range is increased by 4 spaces.
Your DV bonus in defensive stance is increased to +3.
zh: 防守架势的闪避值加值提升至+3。

src: Your Jump range is increased by 4 spaces.
Your Quickness is permanently increased by {{rules|=boost=}}.
zh: 你的迅捷永久提升了{{rules|=boost=}}点。
你的肾上腺素开始涌动。

src: Your arms shrink into your torso.
zh: 你的双臂缩入躯干之中。

src: Your attack fails to penetrate =object.the.name's:withTitles= mental defenses.
zh: 你的攻击未能突破=object.the.name's:withTitles=的精神防御。

src: Your base quickness score is reduced by 10.
Your carbine is as fine an instrument as I have ever wielded.
zh: 你的卡宾枪，是我所用过的最精良的器具之一。

src:
Your chance of becoming lost in ruins is reduced by 30%.
Your chance of becoming lost in other terrain is reduced by 10%.
These effects do not stack with the bonuses of a compass bracelet.
zh:
你在废墟中迷路的几率降低30%。
你在其他地形中迷路的几率降低10%。
这些效果不与罗盘手镯的加成叠加。

src: Your chance to block with a shield improves to 75%.
zh: 你以盾牌格挡的几率提升至75%。

src: Your chance to block with shields is increased by 25%.
zh: 你用盾牌格挡的几率提高25%。

src: Your chance to strike with each of your offhand weapons is increased by 20%.
zh: 你以每件副手武器出击的几率提高20%。

src: Your chance to strike with each of your offhand weapons is increased by 35%.
zh: 你以每件副手武器出击的几率提高35%。

src: Your chance to strike with each of your offhand weapons is increased by 50%.
zh: 你以每件副手武器出击的几率提高50%。

src: Your chime is cracked and ribboned on inside with starless clouds. Why?
zh: 你的钟鸣内里破裂，缠着无星之云的缕缕丝带。这是为什么？

src: Your chime shines with such painful light.
zh: 你的鸣钟闪着如此刺痛的光。

src: Your concentration slips and the channel between you and =object.the.name= dissipates into aether.
zh: 你的专注一懈，你与=object.the.name=之间的通道消散于以太。

src: Your concentration slips and the channel dissipates.
zh: 你的专注一懈，通道消散了。

src: Your crimeclothes? There was a codex about crimes and punishments near the bedroll in your study. What was it?
zh: 你的罪衣？你书房铺盖旁有一部讲罪与罚的古册。那是什么？

src: Your face bears a sightly <stat Name="BeakName" />.
zh: 你的面上生着一只颇为雅致的<stat Name="BeakName" />。

src: Your focus returns to the present.
Your focus slips, causing you to dent spacetime in the local region.
zh: 你的专注一懈，本地区域的时空被你压出了一个凹痕。

src: Your friends may lease the Spindle, as we agreed.
zh: 你的朋友们可以租下纺锤，一如我们所议。

src: Your full natural healing rate applies in combat.
zh: 你在战斗中亦可享有完整的自然愈合速率。

src: Your genome has already undergone this transformation.
zh: 你的基因组已经历过此种转化。

src: Your genome is irritable and unpredictable.
zh: 你的基因急躁而难以捉摸。

src: Your hair is a quasar of red ochre and indigo.
zh: 你的头发是赭红与靛蓝交织的类星体。

src: Your hair is so gray! How long have you lived in Grit Gate?
zh: 你的头发这样灰白！你在砂砾门住了多久了？

src: Your head is too sensitive to wear that.
zh: 你的头部太敏感，戴不了那个。
你的生命值已降至 {{C|=threshold=%}} 以下！

src: Your health is too weak to do that.
zh: 你的体力太弱，无法这样做。

src: Your hear a swelling thpthp sound.
zh: 你听见一阵渐强的噗噗声。

src: Your heart sang at the sight of =object.a.name=.
zh: 你一见到=object.a.name=，心中便欢歌不已。

src: Your home is on your back, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.
Your joints stretch much further than usual.
zh: 你的关节能伸展到远超常人的幅度。

src: Your legs ache at the joints.
Your legs bones are nearly fused at the joints.
zh: 你的腿骨在关节处几乎熔合。

src: Your limbs suddenly feel perversely round and bumpy before they shrink back into your body.
zh: 你的四肢忽然变得诡异圆凸，随后缩回体内。

src: Your mind begins to morph but the physiology of your brain restricts it.
zh: 你的心智开始蜕变，然而脑的生理构造拘限了它。

src: Your mockery disgusts me. You disgust me. I will not be calmed, Tikva!
zh: 你的嘲弄令我作呕。你令我作呕。我不会平静下来，提克瓦！

src: Your mod configuration has changed, do you want to apply your changes and restart the game?
zh: 你的模组配置已更改。是否应用更改并重启游戏？

src: Your mutant physiology reacts adversely to the tonic. You erupt into flames!
zh: 你的变异体质与这药剂相冲。你轰然燃起烈焰！

src: Your name is pronounced as the pause between two words, friend. How do I know this?
zh: 朋友，你的名字读作两个词之间的停顿。我如何得知？
你的天生护甲值提升至1。

src: Your new pet is ready to love.
zh: 你的新宠物已经准备好爱你了。

src: Your opponent gets a chance to resist the move and a chance to break free at the start of their turn.
zh: 对手有机会抗拒这次移动，并在其回合开始时有机会挣脱。

src: Your penetration bonus in aggressive stance is increased to +2, but your to-hit penalty is increased to -3.
zh: 进攻架势的穿透加值提升至+2，但命中惩罚提升至-3。

src: Your pistol is as fine an instrument as I have ever wielded.
zh: 你的手枪，是我所用过的最精良的器具之一。

src: Your precognition is about to run out. Would you like to return to the start of your vision?
zh: 你的预知即将耗尽。要回到幻象的开端吗？

src: Your precognitive visions last twice as long.
zh: 你的预知幻象持续时间延长一倍。

src: Your psychic glimmer represents how noticeable you are in the vast psychic aether. As your mental mutations increase in level, so does your psychic glimmer and the frequency, strength, and number of those who desire to absorb your mind.
zh: 你的灵能微光，代表你在浩瀚的灵能以太中有多惹眼。随着精神变异等级提升，你的灵能微光也会增强，觊觎你心智者的出现频率、实力与数量亦随之增长。

src: Your quickness increases as your temperature increases and decreases as your temperature decreases.
zh: 你的迅捷随体温升高而提高，随体温降低而下降。

src: Your seat is unable to eject.
Your sense of self is pulled apart by what feels like a billion years of geologic pressure.
zh: 你的自我之感被扯开，仿佛承受了十亿年的地质压力。

src: Your shield bears resemblance to a Templar's Aegis.
zh: 你的盾牌很像圣殿骑士的神盾。

src: Your short blade attacks that penetrate have a 75% chance to cause your opponent to bleed (0-1 damage per turn. toughness save; difficulty 20 + your Agi modifier). The opponent saves to stop bleeding each round, and the save difficulty decreases by 1 each round. This effect can stack a number of times equal to 1 plus your Agi modifier.
zh: 你的短刃攻击在击穿时，有75%的几率使对手流血（每回合0-1点伤害；坚韧豁免，难度20+你的敏捷调整值）。对手每回合通过豁免即可止血，且豁免难度每回合降低1。此效果可叠加的次数等于1加你的敏捷调整值。

src: Your skin must be kept moist with fresh water.
zh: 你的皮肤须以淡水时时润泽。

src: Your skin, hair, and eyes are absent of pigment.
zh: 你的皮肤、毛发与双眼皆无色素。

src: Your stomach swells with a burning sensation.
zh: 你的胃里腾起一阵灼烧之感。

src: Your thirst is mine, my water is yours.
zh: 你的渴意归我，我的水归你。

src:
Your throw range is increased by 2.
When you throw something at a target inside your throw range, your throwing accuracy is 100%.
zh:
你的投掷射程增加2。
向投掷射程内的目标投掷物品时，你的投掷命中率为100%。

src: Your throw range is increased by 3 and your throw variance is halved when throwing at a target inside your throw range.
zh: 你的投掷射程增加3，且向射程内目标投掷时，投掷偏差减半。

src: Your to-hit bonus in dueling stance is increased to +3.
zh: 决斗架势的命中加值提升至+3。

src: Your tongue begins to bleed as the muscle rots away.
zh: 舌肌开始腐坏，舌头渗出血来。

src: Your tracking of your mark has been disrupted.
zh: 你对所标记目标的追踪被打断了。

src: Your twinblades are works of art. Where did you get them?
zh: 你这对双刃堪称艺术品。是从哪儿得来的？

src: Your type of creature may not buy =subject.mutationTerm|pluralize=.
Your vitality depends on your temperature; at higher temperatures, you are more lively. At lower temperatures, you are more torpid.
zh: 你的活力随体温而变：体温愈高，愈是敏捷有力；体温愈低，愈是迟滞麻木。

src: Your weapons' percentage-based effects are 3X as likely to occur, including the base chance for critical hits.
zh: 你的武器基于百分比的效果，发生概率变为三倍，含暴击的基础概率。

src: Your will would have been suborned to Ptoh.
zh: 你的意志本会被普托所奴。

src: Your willful acts sometimes dent spacetime.
zh: 你任性妄为之时，有时会撞凹时空。
你的言语鼓舞同伴的士气。

src: Your {{W|Acid Resist}} determines how much acid damage you ablate. At 100, you are immune to acid damage.
zh: 你的{{W|抗酸性}}决定你能削减多少酸蚀伤害。达到100时，你免疫酸蚀伤害。

src: Your {{W|Agility}} determines your accuracy with both melee and ranged weapons and your chance to dodge attacks.
zh: 你的{{W|敏捷}}决定你使用近战与远程武器的命中率，以及闪避攻击的几率。

src: Your {{W|Agility}} score determines your accuracy with both melee and ranged weapons and your ability to dodge attacks.
zh: 你的{{W|敏捷}}决定你使用近战与远程武器的命中率，以及你闪避攻击的能力。

src: Your {{W|Armor Value (AV)}} measures how well protected you are against physical attacks that hit you. The higher your score, the fewer times an opponent's attack will penetrate your armor and do damage to you.
zh: 你的{{W|护甲值（AV）}}衡量你抵御命中你的物理攻击的能力。此值越高，对手的攻击穿透你的护甲并造成伤害的次数越少。

src: Your {{W|Cold Resist}} determines how much cold damage you ablate and how insulated you are from effects that reduce your temperature. At 100, you are immune to cold damage and your temperature cannot be reduced.
zh: 你的{{W|抗寒性}}决定你能削减多少寒冷伤害，以及你对降低体温效果的隔绝程度。达到100时，你免疫寒冷伤害，且体温无法被降低。

src: Your {{W|Compute Power (CP)}} scales the bonuses of certain compute-enabled items and cybernetic implants. Your base compute power is 0.
zh: 你的{{W|算力（CP）}}会按比例提升某些算力驱动物品与义体植入物的加成。你的基础算力为0。

src: Your {{W|Dodge Value (DV)}} measures how likely you are to be hit by physical attacks. The higher your score, the less likely an opponent's attack will hit you. Your DV is modified by your Agility modifier.
zh: 你的{{W|闪避值（DV）}}衡量你被物理攻击命中的可能性。此值越高，对手的攻击越难命中你。你的DV受敏捷调整值影响。

src: Your {{W|Ego}} determines the potency of your mental mutations, your ability to haggle with merchants, and your ability to dominate the wills of other living creatures.
zh: 你的{{W|自我}}决定精神变异的强度、与商人讨价还价的本领，以及支配其他生物意志的能力。

src: Your {{W|Ego}} score determines the potency of your ability to haggle with merchants, and your ability to dominate the wills of other living creatures.
zh: 你的{{W|自我}}决定你与商人讨价还价的能力，以及支配其他生物意志的能力。

src: Your {{W|Ego}} score determines the potency of your mental mutations, your ability to haggle with merchants, and your ability to dominate the wills of other living creatures.
zh: 你的{{W|自我}}决定精神变异的强度、你与商人讨价还价的能力，以及支配其他生物意志的能力。

src: Your {{W|Electrical Resist}} determines how much electrical damage you ablate and how resistive you are to electric current. At 100, you are immune to electrical damage and you do not conduct electricity.
zh: 你的{{W|抗电性}}决定你能削减多少电击伤害，以及你对电流的阻抗程度。达到100时，你免疫电击伤害，且不再导电。

src: Your {{W|Heat Resist}} determines how much heat damage you ablate and how insulated you are from effects that increase your temperature. At 100, you are immune to heat damage and your temperature cannot be increased.
zh: 你的{{W|抗热性}}决定你能削减多少高温伤害，以及你对升高体温效果的隔绝程度。达到100时，你免疫高温伤害，且体温无法被升高。

src: Your {{W|Intelligence}} determines your number of skill points and your ability to examine artifacts.
zh: 你的{{W|智力}}决定你的技能点数，以及检视古器的能力。

src: Your {{W|Intelligence}} score determines your number of skill points and your ability to examine artifacts.
zh: 你的{{W|智力}}决定你的技能点数，以及检视古器的能力。

src: Your {{W|Mental Armor (MA)}} measures how well protected you are against mental attacks. The higher your score, the less likely an opponent's mental attack will penetrate your defenses and harm you. Your MA is modified by your Willpower modifier.
zh: 你的{{W|心智护甲（MA）}}衡量你抵御精神攻击的能力。此值越高，对手的精神攻击越难穿透你的防御并伤及你。你的MA受意志调整值影响。

src: Your {{W|Move Speed}} measures how fast you walk or fly.
zh: 你的{{W|移动速度}}衡量你步行或飞行的快慢。

src: Your {{W|Quickness}} measures the speed you perform every action you take.
zh: 你的{{W|迅捷}}衡量你执行每一个动作的速度。

src: Your {{W|Strength}} determines how much melee damage you do (by improving your armor penetration), your ability to resist forced movement, and your carry capacity.
zh: 你的{{W|力量}}决定近战伤害（力量越高，护甲穿透越强）、抵抗强制移动的能力以及负重上限。

src: Your {{W|Strength}} score determines how effectively you penetrate your opponents' armor with melee attacks, how much damage your melee attacks do, your ability to resist forced movement, and your carry capacity.
zh: 你的{{W|力量}}决定近战攻击穿透对手护甲的效果、近战攻击造成的伤害、你抵抗强制位移的能力，以及你的负重上限。

src: Your {{W|Temperature}} measures how hot or cold you are. Being too cold can reduce your Quickness and prevent you from taking physical actions. Being too hot can set you aflame and cause damage every round.
zh: 你的{{W|体温}}衡量你当前的冷热。过冷会降低你的迅捷，并使你无法进行肉体动作。过热会使你着火，并每回合造成伤害。

src: Your {{W|Toughness}} determines your number of hit points, your hit point regeneration rate, and your ability to resist poison and disease.
zh: 你的{{W|坚韧}}决定你的生命值上限、生命值回复速度，以及抵抗毒素与疾病的能力。

src: Your {{W|Toughness}} score determines your number of hit points, your natural healing rate, and your ability to resist poison and disease.
zh: 你的{{W|坚韧}}决定你的生命值上限、自然痊愈速度，以及你抵抗毒素与疾病的能力。

src: Your {{W|Willpower}} modifies the cooldowns of your activated abilities, determines your ability to resist mental attacks, and modifies your hit point regeneration rate.
zh: 你的{{W|意志}}影响主动技能的冷却时间，决定你抵抗精神攻击的能力，并影响生命值回复速度。

src: Your {{W|Willpower}} score modifies the cooldowns of your activated abilities, determines your ability to resist mental attacks, and modifies your natural healing rate.
zh: 你的{{W|意志}}影响主动技艺的冷却时间，决定你抵抗精神攻击的能力，并影响你的自然痊愈速度。

src: Yurl is a harmless cucumber vine. They came to Kyakukya a few years ago after the last Consortium chandler, a wicked little hyacinth named Plysago, suffered something of an... accident. In Tarotep's defense, Plysago shouldn't have berated someone with claws so close in resemblance to pruning shears. At any length, Yurl stocks a plethora of goods; you will be satisfied with your visit.
zh: 尤尔是一株无害的黄瓜藤。几年前，上一任联盟蜡烛商——一株名叫普莱萨戈的恶毒小风信子——遭遇了一场……意外，之后尤尔便来到基亚库基亚。为塔罗特普辩一句：普莱萨戈不该去训斥一个爪子酷似修枝剪的人。无论如何，尤尔货品繁多，你此行定会满意。

src: Yurl, a sentient cucumber vine, puts =pronouns.possessive= roots down in a squat clay pot on the floor of =pronouns.possessive= hut. Myriad wares rest on oaken shelves throughout the room, and with =pronouns.possessive= tendrils Yurl =verb:exhibit= them to interested customers by crawling along an iron trellis. You notice that Yurl =verb:creep= toward products almost before you think of them; the gift of telepathy affords the sprightly vine a distinct advantage as a chandler.
zh: 尤尔是一株有知觉的黄瓜藤，=pronouns.possessive=根扎在=pronouns.possessive=小屋地面上一只矮胖的陶盆里。满室的橡木架上陈列着无数货物，尤尔以=pronouns.possessive=卷须沿铁格架爬行，将它们展示给有意购买的客人。你会发现，几乎在你想到某件货物之前，尤尔便已朝它爬去；心灵感应之赋，使这株活泼的藤蔓在杂货商一行中占尽优势。

[[{{C|By Daughter Erinna}}]]

In rainbow reverie I wandered the wide territories of Qud,
modulo the Moon Stair and the Tree of Life.
My dreamself knew to avoid the place,
where numbers go to die.

Something unseen there tightens to a point,
breaks time's abelian promise,
and urges crystal on to palisade her weeping gulf.

The artifacts of plant and time,
crust and fuzz with lossy compression,
doze in moonlit marble beds,
touched by august muzzles.
The past is unwritten as the future,
And what is left, broken and changed,
to be tended by the point Colossi and their swarm.

They'd erase me, too.
I'm mere rust on the vine's fronds,
I'm a dead girl in graveside flowers,
Peering a powerless eye at the machine function that writes my gospel.

But black bodies radiate,
A feeling sense obtains,
Swings in orbit and Becomes.
On the trauma of a Nothing,
Soul-things take root.

We invent so many Nothings,
Zero engines, annihilators,
Mappers of the nullspace.
But Nothings have a cost,
Promise externalities,
Trees grow best beside the dead.
zh:
[[{{C|埃琳娜之女作}}]]

彩虹幻梦间，我漫游卡德广袤疆土，
避开月阶与生命之树。
梦中的我知道该绕过那处——
数字走向死亡之所。

某种不可见之物在那里收紧成一点，
打破时间阿贝尔式的允诺，
催促水晶筑起栅墙，
围住它哭泣的深渊。

植物与时间的遗物，
覆满结壳与绒毛，压缩而失真，
在月光照耀的大理石床上沉睡，
受庄严的吻触碰。
过去未曾写定，未来亦然；
剩下的一切，残缺而改变，
交由点之巨像及其群集照料。

他们也会将我抹去。
我不过是藤蔓叶上的锈迹，
是墓旁花丛中的死去少女，
无力凝望那写下我福音的机器运作。

然而黑色躯体仍在辐射，
感觉由此生起，
在轨道上摇摆，遂告成形。
空无的创伤之上，
灵魂之物扎下根来。

我们创造了如此多的空无：
零引擎、湮灭者、
虚空绘图者。
然而空无自有代价，
允诺外部效应；
树木在死者身旁长得最好。
