src:
{{emote|*Barathrum inhales and stutters.*}} She-

Resheph would not forgive her trespass. She contracted the rotting tongue while abetting the lepers of =RebekahRegion=. When her time came, she-
zh:
{{emote|*巴拉斯鲁姆吸了口气，结结巴巴。*}} 她——

利悉不肯宽恕她的僭越。她在协助=RebekahRegion=的麻风病人时，染上了烂舌病。到了她大限之时，她——

src:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses and frowns.*}}

Do you know, =name=, the engine types that ask us to loose every pin and unhinge every cam to know them? Such an engine of culture we are encased in now, and I cannot speak to the workings of one gearset without disassembling them all. I meant not to tease, and soon, I promise, you will spy the next arc of our journey.
zh:
{{emote|*巴拉斯鲁姆顿了顿，皱起眉头。*}}

你可知道，=name=，有一类引擎，须得卸尽每一枚销钉、拆开每一枚凸轮，方能识其奥妙？我们如今便裹在这样一台文化的引擎之中，而我若不将一副齿轮尽数拆解，便无法讲明其中一副的运作。我并非有意戏弄；不久，我保证，你便会窥见我们旅程的下一道弧线。

src:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}

Forgive me, =name=. The ascent strains the mind as well as the body. My flight of fancy is done; I am regrounded.
zh:
{{emote|*巴拉斯鲁姆顿了顿。*}}

原谅我，=name=。攀升之苦，既劳筋骨，亦伤心神。我的幻想之飞已毕，复又脚踏实地了。

src:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}

I am confident there is a richness of wisdom in the poetry of that statement. One day, I will be eager to discover it. For now, what of the Spindle?
zh:
{{emote|*巴拉斯鲁姆顿了顿。*}}

我相信这句话的诗意里蕴藏着丰富的智慧。总有一天，我会渴望去发掘它。眼下，纺锤那边如何了？

src:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}

It is. For reasons I will explain shortly, for reasons beyond any of our remits, Klanq has returned to Grit Gate.
zh:
{{emote|*巴拉斯鲁姆顿了顿。*}}

是的。其中缘由，我稍后便解释，那缘由已超出我们任何人的权限，克朗克回到了砂砾门。

src:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}

O, =name=, our cursors draw together on Fate's phenomenic slide rule! You burn with speculation, and I- I molder in the coolness of knowing. I enter my dwarf phase.
zh:
{{emote|*巴拉斯鲁姆顿了顿。*}}

哦，=name=，我们的游标正聚拢于命运那现象之尺！你因揣测而心焰炽烈，我却——我却在知晓的清寒中腐朽。我将入我的矮星之期了。

src:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}

Unusual circumstances have put my study in disarray. Lamentable, this is, but necessary.
zh:
{{emote|*巴拉斯鲁姆顿了顿。*}}

非常之事，使我的书房一片狼藉。这是令人遗憾的，却也是必要的。

src:
{{emote|*Barathrum shifts his weight, pauses, and flexes an arthritic paw.*}}

I am sorry. Tis the acceleration, =name=. I am whirling and empty of breath. Steel yourself, and so shall I.
zh:
{{emote|*巴拉斯鲁姆挪了挪身子，顿了顿，活动了一下患关节炎的爪掌。*}}

抱歉。是这加速所致，=name=。我周身旋转，气息已竭。你且稳住心神，我亦自当如此。
{{emote|*巴拉斯鲁姆深深吸了一口气。*}}

{{emote|*巴拉斯鲁姆呜咽。*}}

——什么？谁在那里？

src:
{{emote|*Barathrum's countenance suddenly burns bright.*}}

Did you know, =name=, I harbor a memory older than even the flooding of my hearth cave. A gleaming ancient tale, told by my elders to the nippy cub I once was...
zh:
{{emote|*巴拉斯鲁姆的神色骤然明亮如燃。*}}

你可知道，=name=，我心中藏着一段记忆，比我炉边洞窟遭洪水淹没还要久远。那是一则闪亮的古老传说，由长辈讲给当年那只冻得发抖的小熊听……

src:
{{emote|*Barathrum's countenance suddenly gravens.*}}

Child. There is much more I would have liked to share. But... I am a puppet of my shame.
zh:
{{emote|*巴拉斯鲁姆的神色骤然凝重。*}}

孩子。我本还有许多话想与你分说。可……我不过是自身羞愧的傀儡。

src:
{{emote|*Barathrum's countenance suddenly gravens.*}}

O.. I know it to be arduous for you, meyvn, to see me like this. The imago unstrung...
zh:
{{emote|*巴拉斯鲁姆的神色骤然凝重。*}}

哦……我知道，行家，见我这般模样，于你实属艰难。那成形之身，已然松脱……

src: {{emote|*Dagasha tilts its head, staring you down. It twitches, but makes no move to strike as you approach.*}}
zh: {{emote|*达加沙歪着头，死死盯着你。它抽搐着，却在你走近时并未发动攻击。*}}

src:
{{emote|*Dardi addresses you without looking up from =pronouns.possessive= many workspaces, many of which billow smoke, steam, or some unknown miasma.*}}

Welcome to my laboratory, =name=. Rest and sustain =player.reflexive= before returning to your travels.
zh:
{{emote|*达尔迪没有抬头，便向你开口。=pronouns.possessive=的诸多工作台前，许多都正冒着烟、喷着汽，或是腾起某种不明的瘴气。*}}

欢迎来到我的实验室，=name=。先歇一歇，=player.reflexive=养足精神，再继续你的旅程。

src:
{{emote|*Doyoba's face scrunches in pain as ey communes with the device, before finally pushing it back into your grasp*}}

By her light, that was unpleasant. How it twisted and turned, leading me to visions of Nacham's past, scraps and flashes. I can discern only glimpses of significance. Once a creator, an innovator. Can these parts of itself return intact, under the device's influence? An thou sendest void away, hast thou lost a part of thee?
zh:
{{emote|*多约巴与装置交感时，面容痛苦地皱成一团，终于将它推回你的手中*}}

凭她之光，真是难受。它扭转翻腾，引我看见纳罕的过往，只是些碎片与闪回。我仅能辨出些许要紧的片段。它曾是创造者，是革新者。这些自身的部分，在装置的影响下，能完好地回归么？倘若你将虚空逐走，可曾失去自身的一部分？

src:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}

-mm, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Do not like to sour the air with a harsh word! But this tiding bites my liver like acid. mm, must ask Nima for an elixir of yuckwheat...
zh:
{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老沉默片刻。*}}

——嗯，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我不愿用重话败坏气氛！可这消息像酸液一样啃噬我的肝。嗯，得向尼玛讨一剂苦麦药汁……

src:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}

-mm, nephilim. Seventh plague. Girsh titans born on the Moon Stair, and quickened to life to eat our young. Sultan Resheph drove them back a chiliad ago, away to slumber. mm, do they rouse?
zh:
{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老沉默片刻。*}}

——嗯，拿非利人。第七灾。吉尔什巨人诞生于月阶，醒来便要吞食我们的孩子。千年前，苏丹利悉将他们驱退，令其远去沉眠。嗯，他们醒了吗？

src:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}

-mm, plagues. Of our great grandsires many-times-over. Salt, darkness, svardym-frog... Girshling.
zh:
{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老沉默片刻。*}}

——嗯，瘟疫。都是许多代以前的老灾祸了。盐、黑暗、斯瓦迪姆蛙……吉尔什幼体。

src:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}

Come in- come sit 'neath the cool shade, 'cross a pillow there.
zh:
{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老微笑。*}}

进来——来这片清凉的树荫下坐坐，坐在那边的垫子上。

src:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}

Live and drink, =name=. Come, sit with me.
zh:
{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老微笑。*}}

且生且饮，=name=。来，坐到我身旁。

src:
{{emote|*Eskhind bursts into forced, nervous laughter*}}

Is that her angle? To claim that I stole Kindrish? Her influence must be waning more than even I knew.
zh:
{{emote|*埃斯金德爆出一阵勉强而紧张的笑声*}}

这就是她的打算？说是我偷了金德里什？看来她的威望衰落得比我所知的还厉害。

src: {{emote|*Every surface of the strange entity vibrates with the sound of a hundred dry lectures by long-dead scholars, teaching a volume of knowledge so dense and overlapping that the end result is incomprehensible.*}}
zh: {{emote|*这奇异存在的每一寸表面都在震颤，发出上百场早已作古的学者之枯燥讲学的声响，所授之知密集重叠，以致最终不可理解。*}}

src:
{{emote|*From the banks of a shallow creek, you watch a toad floating on the water, belly up. It flails, helpless against even the gentle current of the water in which you placed it seconds ago. You watch it float away, toward the rushing currents ahead.

Helpless to myriad unknowable fates, the toad disappears from view into the rapids, sent there by your hand.*}}
zh:
{{emote|*你站在浅溪岸边，看着一只蟾蜍肚皮朝天漂在水面。它挣扎着，在几秒前你放它入水的柔和水流面前也无力抵抗。你看着它漂远，漂向前方的急流。

面对无数不可知的命运，蟾蜍无助地消失在激流中，是你亲手将它送去。*}}

src: {{emote|*From the mouth of the jar in your little hands, you watch a frog leap into the water of a softly burbling creek. The gentle current sweeps the frog's little body away to an unknown fate as curious crayfish peek out from their hiding places. The jar in your hands is empty.*}}
zh: {{emote|*你手里拿着罐子，从罐口看着一只青蛙跃入轻轻汩汩的溪水。温和的水流将青蛙小小的身体冲向不可知的命运，好奇的小龙虾从藏身处探出头来。你手中的罐子空了。*}}

src:
{{emote|*Gyamyo moves little during communion, but shivers and twitches from time to time. After a minute or so, ey returns the device to you.*}}

I am shaken. No doubt my journey wast shallow compared to Lebah's dive. But now, by my troth I say: Kah hath ever been a being of motion. Swift, kinetic, and elegant. No doubt 'twould be so if freed by yon device.
zh:
{{emote|*贾米奥交感时几乎纹丝不动，却不时颤抖抽搐。约莫一分钟后，彼将装置还给你。*}}

我受了震撼。与利巴的深潜相比，我这一程无疑浅薄。但此刻我可凭诚信说：卡赫向来是动的存在。迅捷，充满动能，姿态优雅。若被那装置解放，想必依旧如此。

src:
{{emote|*Hortensa chuckles.*}}

Years. Decades on decades. Centuries, perhaps. Most of these wet-earred cubs were merely sketches in their mothers' dreambooks when I arrived to study under Barathrum. We knew so little then, know so little now.
zh:
{{emote|*霍腾萨轻声笑了。*}}

许多年。一个又一个十年。或许有几个世纪了。我来此拜巴拉斯鲁姆为师时，这些乳臭未干的小崽儿大多还只是他们母亲梦书里的草稿。那时我们所知甚少，如今也所知甚少。

src:
{{emote|*Hortensa chuckles.*}}

You are sharp, =name=. In a way that's what I am. But liquids are more willful than scrap. I can't solder them together; they would run away, hide in the shale cracks, slowly come apart and disappear. I moreso think of myself as a wisewoman in dialogue with them -- I manage their moods and phases. My notebooks are full of their quirks and caprices. It's a wonder, isn't it, how at just the right temperature and pressure the continuity of matter is smashed apart? How the gaseous butterfly flits out of the dense worm?
zh:
{{emote|*霍腾萨轻声笑了。*}}

你很敏锐，=name=。某种意义上，我正是如此。可液体比废料更有主见。我没法把它们焊在一起；它们会跑掉，躲进页岩的裂缝，慢慢散开，消失不见。我更愿把自己看作与它们对话的智妇——调理它们的情绪与相态。我的笔记簿里满是它们的怪癖与任性。你说奇不奇妙，恰在合宜的温度与压力下，物质的连续性便被击得粉碎？气态的蝴蝶，便从稠密的蠕虫中翩然飞出？

src: {{emote|*Just as you activate an artifact listening device that ceased to exist centuries ago, you hear the end of an emotional song. The space between relief and sorrow throbs with uncomfortable tension. You ache with it.*}}
zh: {{emote|*就在你启动一件数百年前便已消逝的古器聆听装置时，你听见一首动人之歌的结尾。释然与悲伤之间的空隙，紧绷而难受地搏动。你为之心痛。*}}

src: {{emote|*Kah skitters away, but soon returns, and skitters away a shorter distance. Whether because of your words or because you are still, its desire for flight ebbs over the course of a minute until its escape attempts halt.*}}
zh: {{emote|*卡赫蹿开，却不久又回来，再蹿开时，距离近了些。不知是因为你的话语，还是因为你一动不动，一分钟之内，它逃遁的冲动渐渐消退，终至不再试图逃走。*}}

src: {{emote|*Lebah curls into an armored ball and stops responding to your questions.*}}
zh: {{emote|*利巴蜷成一个披甲的球，不再回应你的问话。*}}

src: {{emote|*Lebah nods to you, slowly curls into an armored ball, and speaks no further*}}
zh: {{emote|*利巴向你缓缓点头，慢慢蜷成一个披甲的球，不再言语*}}

src: {{emote|*Lebah yelps at the sight of the device, curling into an armored ball.*}}
zh: {{emote|*利巴一见那装置便惊叫一声，蜷成一个披甲的球。*}}

src:
{{emote|*Liihart stares at you for several quiet seconds.*}}

Live and drink.
zh:
{{emote|*利哈特静静地盯着你看了好几秒。*}}

且生且饮。

src: {{emote|*Meyehind's glare turns withering for the few seconds it takes before she turns her face and body away from you.*}}
zh: {{emote|*梅耶欣德的目光冷厉得叫人发怵，持续了数秒，随即她转过脸，连身子也背了过去。*}}
{{emote|*米里亚姆以哀痛的音调鸣响。*}}

src:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in aching tones.*}}

...but, too, someone close. Tau. Bright tau. She is gone.
zh:
{{emote|*米里亚姆以哀痛的音调鸣响。*}}

……但也为一位亲近的人。陶。明亮的陶。她走了。

src:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in deep tones.*}}

I am Miryam, friend.
zh:
{{emote|*米里亚姆以低沉的音调鸣响。*}}

我是米里亚姆，朋友。

src:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in deep tones.*}}

I swim in cool and dark waters, traveler. For me, it is Shiva, the lament of seven thousand years.

I mourn the passing of all life, and all the necessity of death life must bring. For you, traveler, to come here, how many had to die? I mourn them.

Or are you the rarest one, who walks below the bright arches and claims no such cost? Even then, what losses did {{M|you}} suffer to come, traveler? What selves of yours had you to shed? Those are -else to us, and I mourn them as well.
zh:
{{emote|*米里亚姆以低沉的音调鸣响。*}}

我浮游于清冷幽暗的水中，旅人。于我，这是西瓦，七千年的哀恸。

我哀悼一切生命的逝去，也哀悼生命所必带来的一切死亡之必然。旅人，你来到这里，有多少生灵不得不死？我为他们哀悼。

或者，你是那最稀罕的人，行走在明亮拱门之下，而不曾付出这样的代价？即便如此，{{M|你}}为了来到这里，自己又失去了什么，旅人？你不得不褪去的，是你的哪些自我？那些于我们是“别”，我也为它们哀悼。

src:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in long tones.*}}

It's the kriah, traveler. I am in mourning, and I chime in low tones.
zh:
{{emote|*米里亚姆以悠长的音调鸣响。*}}

这是裂衣之礼，旅人。我在服丧，所以我以低音鸣响。

src:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in melodic tones.*}}

Oh? You would finish the -elseing act?

I am your debtor, =name=. The ritual is how we organize the anguished practice of being. Now my grieving can begin.

Bright Tau shines always, here or there.
zh:
{{emote|*米里亚姆以悦耳的音调鸣响。*}}

哦？你愿完成“别化”之举？

我欠你的情，=name=。此仪是我们安顿这痛苦之存在的途径。现在，我的悲伤可以开始了。

明亮的陶永远闪耀，无论在此，还是在彼。

src: {{emote|*Oboroqoru, Ape God ignores you and muses.*}}
zh: {{emote|*猿神奥博罗阔鲁无视你，兀自沉思。*}}

src: {{emote|*Out of an oculus pours a scanning cone of mosaic light. It's unclear if they regard you as an interloper, but they take no aggressive action.*}}
zh: {{emote|*一只眼孔中倾泻出镶嵌般的光束，锥形扫描。无法判断它是否视你为闯入者，但它并未采取攻击举动。*}}

src:
{{emote|*She gives you a hard stare.*}}

I am a Daughter of Exile, but you should call me Yla Haj.
zh:
{{emote|*她严厉地盯着你。*}}

我是流亡之女，不过你该叫我伊拉·哈吉。

src:
{{emote|*Shem whispers*}}

You're not supposed to be here. But I won't tell.
zh:
{{emote|*舍姆低声耳语*}}

你本不该来这儿的。不过我不会说出去。
{{emote|*舍姆打了个哈欠。*}}我在打哈欠。
{{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱微微一笑，点了点头。*}}

src: {{emote|*Sparafucile averts =pronouns.possessive= gaze and heaves a tired sigh.*}}
zh: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱移开=pronouns.possessive=目光，疲惫地叹了口气。*}}

src: {{emote|*Sparafucile frowns. After several moments of paper-shuffling, he presents you with a charcoal drawing depicting a gelatinous creature in the shape of a gumdrop. Sketches below depict the ooze enveloping a bipedal figure, then falling through the floor.*}}
zh: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱皱起眉头。翻了好一阵纸堆之后，他递给你一幅炭笔画：画中是一团胶状的生物，形如一颗软糖。下方的草图里，那团黏液裹住一个两足的人形，随后穿过地面坠落下去。*}}

src: {{emote|*Sparafucile furrows his brow for a few moments, then shakes his head, sighs, and offers you a shrug. He puts a paw on your shoulder and squeezes.*}}
zh: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱蹙眉片刻，随即摇了摇头，叹了口气，耸耸肩。他把一只爪子搭在你肩上，捏了捏。*}}

src: {{emote|*Sparafucile gives =pronouns.possessive= carbine a once-over and gives you a resolute nod.*}}
zh: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱将=pronouns.possessive=的卡宾枪端详了一遍，向你坚定地点了点头。*}}
{{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱向你坚定地点了点头。*}}

src: {{emote|*Sparafucile gives you a wan smile and a thumbs-up.*}}
zh: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱向你露出一抹苍白的笑，竖起拇指。*}}

src: {{emote|*Sparafucile gives you a warm smile and a firm nod. Pressing both pointers to their respective thumbs, =pronouns.subjective= taps these finger-circles together before =pronouns.possessive= chest and rotates both hands in place until the smallest of =pronouns.possessive= long fingers touch. Finally, =pronouns.subjective= gestures toward the other Barathrumites working at their stations.*}}
zh: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱向你露出温暖的笑容，坚定地点了点头。=pronouns.subjective=将两只食指分别按上各自的拇指，在=pronouns.possessive=胸前让这两个指环相互轻碰，又原地转动双手，直至=pronouns.possessive=最小的那两根长指相触。最后，=pronouns.subjective=朝其他在各自岗位上忙碌的巴拉斯鲁姆派众人比了比。*}}

src:
{{emote|*Sparafucile instructs you to wait, and spends a minute or so rifling through the papers and scraps scattered across =pronouns.possessive= workbench. At last =pronouns.subjective= produces a graphite sketch of a cylinder, an expertly-rendered specular revealing its surface to be shiny like glass. The detail of the cylinder's contents are indistinct and dark, but somehow menacing.*}}

{{emote|*Sparafucile points to the glass and makes a breaking motion, then draws a thumb across =pronouns.possessive= throat.*}}
zh:
{{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱示意你稍候，随即花了一分钟左右，在=pronouns.possessive=散落着纸张与碎片的工作台上翻找。最后，=pronouns.subjective=拿出一幅石墨素描：画的是一只圆柱体，镜面反光描绘得极为精到，显出其表面光亮如玻璃。柱内之物的细节模糊而幽暗，却不知为何透着凶险。*}}

{{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱指着那玻璃，做了个打碎的动作，又用拇指在=pronouns.possessive=喉间划过。*}}

src: {{emote|*Sparafucile lifts one brow, giving you a wary look.*}}
zh: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱扬起一道眉，警觉地打量着你。*}}

src:
{{emote|*Sparafucile makes an 'L' shape with both hands, thumbs facing down and fingers pointed toward one another, before flipping both hands so =pronouns.possessive= thumbs face up. =pronouns.Subjective= then raises a closed fist to =pronouns.possessive= mouth, thumb out, and mimes drinking from it.*}}

{{emote|*This done, =pronouns.subjective= nods once more and turns back to =pronouns.possessive= work.*}}
zh:
{{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱双手比出“L”形，拇指朝下、手指相对，随后翻转双手，使=pronouns.possessive=拇指朝上。=pronouns.Subjective=接着将一只握拳的手举到=pronouns.possessive=嘴边，拇指外翘，作饮水状。*}}

{{emote|*做完这些，=pronouns.subjective=再点了点头，转身继续=pronouns.possessive=手头的活计。*}}
{{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱神色严峻地点了点头。*}}

src: {{emote|*Sparafucile places a closed fist over =pronouns.possessive= mouth, then taps =pronouns.possessive= ear, then muzzle with one long finger.*}}
zh: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱将一只握拳的手按在=pronouns.possessive=嘴上，随后用一根长指轻点=pronouns.possessive=的耳朵，再点点口鼻。*}}

src: {{emote|*Sparafucile raises one long-fingered hand in greeting.*}}
zh: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱抬起一只修长手指的手，向你致意。*}}
{{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱耸耸肩，仍旧带着嘲弄的笑。*}}

src: {{emote|*Sparafucile smiles. =pronouns.Subjective= raises a flat hand to =pronouns.possessive= chin and lowers it in your direction.*}}
zh: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱笑了。=pronouns.Subjective=抬起一只平展的手放到=pronouns.possessive=下巴处，再朝你的方向放下。*}}

src: {{emote|*Sparafucile stares at you as if you have grown an additional, substantially uglier head, which you have not.*}}
zh: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱盯着你，仿佛你多长了一个丑得多的脑袋——而你并没有。*}}

src: {{emote|*Swimming in sound, Nacham stares at you and looks away simultaneously, giving no indication of understanding.*}}
zh: {{emote|*纳罕沉浸于声浪之中，既凝视着你，又同时移开目光，毫无理解的迹象。*}}

src:
{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a broad and booming tone.*}}

You! Purpose-driven mad... madhand. You've come here, right? Then you must know power is our... the domain of being is one of power, wouldn't you say? W-Would you please agree with that?
zh:
{{emote|*塔穆兹鸣出宽广而隆隆的声响。*}}

你！怀着目的的疯……狂手。你来到这里，对吧？那你必定知道，权能是我们的……存在的疆域是权能的疆域，你说是不是？你、你可愿同意这话？

src:
{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a querulous tone*}}

O-oh. Elsefolder... th-this path you have l-laid upon Tau, it-it is best. It is good? P-please be good.
zh:
{{emote|*塔穆兹鸣出颤抖的一声*}}

哦、哦。别折者……你、你为陶铺下的这、这条路，它、它是最好的。是好的吗？求、求你，一定要好。

src:
{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a small and bright noise.*}}

Ta- Tammuz. Who becomes. Who is Twofirm even in -then.
zh:
{{emote|*塔穆兹鸣出细小而明亮的声响。*}}

塔、塔穆兹。成为者。即便身在彼化，亦是双坚者。

src:
{{emote|*Tammuz is nearly silent but for a soft, shaky resonance*}}

...
zh:
{{emote|*塔穆兹几近无声，唯有一丝轻柔而颤抖的共鸣*}}

……
{{emote|*塔穆兹发出一声空洞的啾鸣。*}}

src:
{{emote|*Tammuz quiets, then chimes in tottering, unsure tones.*}}

You beast! You m-moon king! You... Our roars are beastial! Would you say so?
zh:
{{emote|*塔穆兹安静下来，随后鸣出摇晃而迟疑的音调。*}}

你这野兽！你这月、月王！你……我们的咆哮是兽性的！你说是吗？

src:
{{emote|*Tammuz quivers and chimes a jarring tone.*}}

O-Oh. Oh u-uh oh oh. By contrasts, a q-quake stills even the most anxious trembling...

The world... the world becomes and unbecomes. All the nervous, volcanic energy of being. Who becomes who? Three became one, but what of them now? 

And w-what becomes of Tau? Of me? Of y-you?
zh:
{{emote|*塔穆兹颤抖着，鸣出刺耳的一声。*}}

哦、哦。哦呃、呃哦哦。相形之下，一场地震也能止住最焦躁的战栗……

世界……世界成其所成，又不成其所成。存在那所有紧张、火山般的能量。谁成为谁？三者合而为一，可它们如今又怎样了？

而、而陶会成什么？我呢？你、你呢？

src:
{{emote|*Tammuz rings a wavering chime*}}

Y-you are here. Elseing h... hand.
zh:
{{emote|*塔穆兹响起摇曳的鸣声*}}

你、你来了。别化之……之手。

src:
{{emote|*Tammuz's chime rings even quieter and more tremulous*}}

Un, un-uncertain. Tau l-leaves unfolded but the g-g-g-gyre yet s-spins. The s-spinning leaves me dizzy.
zh:
{{emote|*塔穆兹的鸣声更轻，更颤*}}

不、不确定。陶还、还没展开，但回、回、回旋仍在旋、旋转。这旋转令我头晕。

src: {{emote|*The apple farmer's daughter shies away from you.*}}
zh: {{emote|*苹果农夫之女怯怯地躲开你。*}}

src:
{{emote|*The chime rings a bone-shaking alarm.*}}

Is this a taunt? A challenge? What cruelty drives you to attempt communication after what you have done?
zh:
{{emote|*鸣钟敲出震彻骨髓的警钟。*}}

这是嘲弄？是挑衅？你做下那等事之后，竟还要来与我交谈，是何等残忍驱使了你？

src:
{{emote|*The chime rings a knell.*}}

O gesticulating hand.
zh:
{{emote|*鸣钟敲出一记丧钟。*}}

哦，比划着的手。

src: {{emote|*The chiming rock burns in soft light.*}}
{{emote|*The chiming rock is silent and still.*}}

{{emote|*The chiming rock rings a sonorous tone.*}}

Touch the chiming rock and seek me at the keter. Will you?
zh:
{{emote|*鸣响石发出洪亮的一声长鸣。*}}

触碰鸣响石，到凯特尔来寻我。你愿意吗？

src:
{{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form are still for many moments.*}}

Saad, the Seraph sprecen.
Saad, thu asken, and the shomrim assenten.
Saad, wiltou return to Salum or crossen in-to Brightsheol?
zh:
{{emote|*裹着雨水守者身形的衣衫，静止了许久。*}}

萨德，撒拉弗曾言。
萨德，你既提请，守者便应允。
萨德，你要返回撒伦，还是越入明冥？

src:
{{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form are still for many moments.*}}

The shomrim connen. Why oghte we?
zh:
{{emote|*裹着雨水守者身形的衣衫，静止了许久。*}}

守者们能。我们何必去？

src:
{{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form are still for many moments.*}}

The shomrim remainen unbilefful.
zh:
{{emote|*裹着雨水守者身形的衣衫，静止了许久。*}}

守者们依旧不信。

src: {{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form remain still.*}}
zh: {{emote|*裹着雨水守者身形的衣衫，依旧静止不动。*}}

src: {{emote|*The creature-silhouette lacks any means to make sound, save for the pointed tips of its six flexible legs. These tap against the ground like a sparse but heavy rainfall on a scrap metal roof as the strange pseudo-beast skitters away from predicted or perceived threats.*}}
zh: {{emote|*那兽影般的造物无从发声，唯有六条柔韧之腿的尖端可作声响。当这奇异的拟兽从预料或感知到的威胁前蹿开时，这些尖端叩击地面，仿佛稀疏而沉重的雨点打在废金属屋顶上。*}}

src: {{emote|*The hardened shell-thing traces a path around you slowly, its strange brush-feet scrabbling at the floor, a pace unaffected by your presence and movement. Behind the hissing of those feet on the ground is the strains of a faint voice, someone speaking from inside a distant cave. Audible, but not understandable.*}}
zh: {{emote|*那硬壳之物缓缓绕着你踏出一条路径，奇异的刷状足在地面上窸窣刮擦，步调丝毫不受你的在场与动作影响。在那足底的嘶嘶声之下，隐隐传来一缕微弱的人声，仿佛有人在远处洞穴深处言语。听得见，却听不懂。*}}
{{emote|*这名欣德伦人弃民不理睬你。*}}

src: {{emote|*The jagged, serpentine entity stares you down, twitching with feigned half-strikes in your direction as if goading an aggressive response from you. Though it has no mouth, it is not silent: piercing the air is a strange, external tinnitus, the whine of an ancient viewscreen.*}}
zh: {{emote|*这嶙峋蜿蜒的存在死死盯着你，朝你的方向虚晃抽搐，仿佛要激你出手。它虽无口，却并非无声：一种古怪的外在耳鸣刺破空气，那是远古显像屏的哀鸣。*}}

src: {{emote|*The moment stretches on into a steep asymptote, the peaks and valleys of possible outcomes speeding by in an imaginary blur. You imagine the sound of a tiny metal thread brushing across the bottom of a dusty valley, amplified a thousand times.*}}
zh: {{emote|*这一刻延伸成一条陡峭的渐近线，可能结局的峰与谷在想象的模糊中疾驰而过。你想象一根细小的金属丝擦过尘封山谷的谷底，那声音被放大了千倍。*}}

src: {{emote|*The plant gives no indication of understanding*.}}
{{emote|*The warden is lost in rumination.*}} It can't be. It simply can't be.
zh: {{emote|*守望者沉浸在反复思量之中。*}}不会的。绝不可能。

src: {{emote|*There's scratching and clicking coming from inside.*}}
zh: {{emote|*里头传来抓挠和咔嗒的声响。*}}

src:
{{emote|*Thicksalt chimes a single, outstretched tone.*}}

The naming act is imponderable. So Tau called me Thicksalt, one brickword in a towerful poem whose everyshape I forget, but whose flushing of Soft in afterfeel I am in allway.
zh:
{{emote|*厚盐鸣响出一个悠长的单音。*}}

命名之举深不可测。陶便唤我厚盐，是一座塔般长诗里的一块砖字，那诗的万形我已忘却，但它在软境冲刷后的余感，我处处身在其中。

src:
{{emote|*Tzedech chimes, buzzing with agitation*}}

Twofirm roils in me with the enormity. Can it contain so much gone and unremunerated? Tau, Tikva, and more to come. Consumed, we, and paralyzed.
zh:
{{emote|*泽德克鸣响，激动得嗡嗡震颤*}}

双坚在我体内翻腾，其势浩大。逝去而未偿的，它容得下这许多吗？陶，提克瓦，还有更多将至。我们被吞噬，被麻痹。

src:
{{emote|*Tzedech emits a powerful, body-thrumming chime*}}

Yes. You understand destroying. You know the weight. We are past time of querulous inquisition, of confessions on lined parchment. Was the whole of this in your weight? It no longer matters. Scale the firmament, smite or soothe what rouses there.
zh:
{{emote|*泽德克发出一声强劲的、令身躯颤动的鸣响*}}

是。你懂得毁灭。你知晓这重量。我们已过了怨怼诘问的时候，已过了在划线羊皮纸上忏悔的时候。这一切是否都在你的重量之中？已无关紧要。攀上穹苍，对那里被惊动的一切，或击之，或抚之。

src: {{emote|*Vaam seems oblivious to your words, but does slow its patrol as it nears you.*}}
zh: {{emote|*瓦阿姆对你的话似乎浑然不觉，但在靠近你时，确实放慢了巡行的脚步。*}}

src:
{{emote|*Warden Une tilts their head and purses their lips*}}

Very well. Need you aught, O Nameless One?
zh:
{{emote|*守望者乌内偏过头，抿起嘴唇*}}

也罢。无名者啊，你可有什么需要？

src: {{emote|*Wielding an oversized jar in little hands, a child tips it into the running current of a softly burbling creek. Tiny creatures that had been living in the jar spill into the creek, protected from the killing current by a clump of slimy biofilm. The child peers at a little fry swimming in the jar.}}
zh: {{emote|*一个孩子用小手捧着一只过大的罐子，将它倾入轻轻汩汩的溪流。原本生活在罐中的微小生物倾泻入溪，被一团黏滑的生物膜护着，免受致命水流的冲击。孩子凝视着罐中一尾游动的小鱼苗。}}

src: {{emote|*With a nod, Sparafucile waits for you to continue, keeping =pronouns.possessive= eyes focused on your lips.*}}
zh: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱点点头，等你继续，=pronouns.possessive=的目光始终盯着你的嘴唇。*}}

src: {{emote|*With a small smile of gratitude, Sparafucile taps his chin with a flat hand and lowers it toward you like a drawbridge.*}}
zh: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱含着一丝感激的浅笑，用平展的手轻敲下巴，再向你放下，宛如一座吊桥。*}}

src:
{{emote|*Yla Haj pauses.*}}

You presume too narrow a meaning of "health".
zh:
{{emote|*伊拉·哈吉顿了顿。*}}

你把“健康”的含义想得太窄了。

src: {{emote|*You are a little sapfly resting in the crook of a swarmshade tree. The boughs stretch in great barkish deserts before exploding into a tangle of branches. Your brethren buzz in an agitated cloud, feeling fear or excitement or hunger. Something buzzes beyond the leafy reaches of your sight, all-consuming but unclear.*}}
zh: {{emote|*你是一只小小的汁蝇，栖在群影树的枝杈里。树枝如树皮的大荒漠般伸展，而后迸成一团纠缠的枝条。你的同伴聚成一片躁动的云，嗡嗡作响，或惧，或奋，或饥。叶丛之外你目力所不及处，有什么在嗡鸣，无所不吞，却模糊不清。*}}

src: {{emote|*You tumble from the jar, your sinewy body twisting against the electric emptiness in your belly, the weight of eggs. You discover a morsel and consume it soft and delicious. You will spawn here. You will eat the morsels. Your babies will eat all of the morsels.}}
zh: {{emote|*你从罐中跌出，筋肉虬结的身躯扭动着，抵御腹中电击般的空虚与卵的重量。你发现一小块食物，将它吞下，柔软而美味。你将在此产卵。你将吃光这些食物。你的孩子将吃光所有食物。}}

src: {{emote|*Your entire self buzzes at the sound of _'s chime, a shock from the center and radiating outward. Sensation bubbles up to the surface, a tightening of the self. It is as if cresting a great hill atop a cathedra or an oncoming witchwood overdose; the void yawns under you. Something terrible is born.*}}
zh: {{emote|*你的整个自我在_的鸣声中嗡嗡震颤，一阵震击自中心向外扩散。知觉浮上表面，自我骤然收紧。恍如攀上教座之上的巨丘，抑或迎面撞上巫木过量；虚空在你脚下张开大口。有可怕的东西诞生了。*}}

src:
{{emote|*Yurl flicks a leaf in displeasure.*}}

What about fungi?
zh:
{{emote|*尤尔不悦地弹了弹一片叶子。*}}

真菌怎么了？

src:
{{emote|*aloud, in a high-pitched buzzing voice*}}

A customer? A customer! Enter, =player.formalAddressTerm=, browse, buy. The Consortium's finest, stocked and sold by Tillifergaewicz! Tilli will do, but what will Tilli do... for you?
zh:
{{emote|*高声而言，嗓音尖细，嗡嗡作响*}}

客人？有客人来了！请进，=player.formalAddressTerm=，请看，请买。联盟之精品，尽在蒂利费尔加维奇的货架！叫我蒂利便好，只是蒂利该……为你做些什么呢？

src:
{{emote|*crackle, crackle*}}-othom? My sympathies.

=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= of course welcome here, wayfarer. Speak to Agyra an =ifplayerplural:ye need:thou needest= aught, as ey delighteth in hospitality.
zh:
{{emote|*噼啪，噼啪*}}——索姆？我深表同情。

=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=自然是此处的贵客，旅人。若=ifplayerplural:诸君:汝=有所需，可去寻阿吉拉，彼最喜待客。

src:
{{emote|*croaking sigh*}}

Congratulation, condolence, which ever. Mind and name slip by another.
zh:
{{emote|*呱呱叹息*}}

恭喜，节哀，随你怎么说。心智与名字，一个接一个溜走。
{{emote|*默默流着口水，直勾勾地盯着*}}

src:
{{emote|*krka!*}}

Yes! To like! But... never home else. So {{emote|*reep?*}}.
zh:
{{emote|*克尔卡！*}}

对！喜欢！但是……别处从不是家。所以{{emote|*呃？*}}。

src:
{{emote|*long, smoky croak*}}

Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, here at last. Sit. Smoke. Rest.
zh:
{{emote|*悠长而带烟味的呱鸣*}}

啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，总算来了。坐。抽烟。歇着。

src: {{emote|*mumbling*}} ...exceeding mass thresholds, perhaps a ganglionic teleprojector fitted with suspensors...
zh: {{emote|*喃喃自语*}}……质量超出阈值，或许配上悬浮器的神经节远投仪……

src: {{emote|*mumbling*}} ...waste heat from the thermo cask? Or centrifugal extraction to the p-density of sunslag...
zh: {{emote|*喃喃自语*}}……热力桶的废热？还是离心抽取到日渣的p密度……

src:
{{emote|*one long, luminous stare*}}

I think it best if we kept to more practical questions.
zh:
{{emote|*长长的、明亮的凝视*}}

我想，我们最好还是问些更实际的问题。

src:
{{emote|*reeeeeps joyfully*}}

Greetings, =name=! Live and drink, friend.
zh:
{{emote|*欢快地嘎嘎叫*}}

你好，=name=！且生且饮，朋友。

src:
{{emote|*several moments of softly creaking thought*}}

G-good!
zh:
{{emote|*轻轻吱嘎作响地想了好一会儿*}}

好、好！

src:
{{emote|*the chime is hard to distinguish from the rising cacophony.*}}

Crungled allway. Soft reaches through the bounds of everyshape and afflicts us with fireless hotbark. It resonates through Tau's cavernous absence. Arid tearsalt dries between the Lovers.
zh:
{{emote|*鸣钟混在渐起的嘈杂中，难以分辨。*}}

处处皆皱。软境穿过万形的边界，以无火的热皮折磨我们。它在陶空洞的缺席中回响。枯涩的泪盐在恋人之间风干。

src:
{{emote|*the chime is hard to distinguish from the rising cacophony.*}}

Crungled allway. Soft reaches through the bounds of everyshape and afflicts us with fireless hotbark. It resonates through Tau's cavernous absence. Touchloss blooms, each facet trembling for shearpull.
zh:
{{emote|*鸣钟混在渐起的嘈杂中，难以分辨。*}}

处处皆皱。软境穿过万形的边界，以无火的热皮折磨我们。它在陶空洞的缺席中回响。触失绽放，每一面都为剪扯而颤抖。

src:
{{emote|*the chime is louder this time, but just as querulous*}}

Sh-sh-she, th-this fate, it. It is a d-deep dark. Will Tau f-fold herself, I wonder?
zh:
{{emote|*这回鸣钟更响，却同样颤抖*}}

她、她、这命运，它。是一片深、深暗。陶会、会折叠自己吗？我在想。

src:
{{emote|*the chime rings a long and pensive tone.*}}

How something stirs, deep in Soft.
zh:
{{emote|*鸣钟响起悠长而沉思的一声。*}}

软境深处，有什么在搅动。

src:
{{emote|*the chime rings a long, clarion tone.*}}

You are as beautiful as imagined. You ring with a shining purpose. This chime is awed to bask in your presence.
zh:
{{emote|*鸣钟响起悠长而嘹亮的一声。*}}

你如我所想的一般美丽。你鸣响着，带着闪耀的意志。这块鸣钟在你面前沐浴光辉，满心敬畏。

src:
{{emote|*the chime rings a sharp, urgent gonging tone*}}

Entity! You are given persistent will and agency, twice-hewn architecture of body and strong fiber that pulls. You bolt upright and damp-haired into fullness, your grasp abrading the threads of existence. Your responsibility remains whether acknowledged or not. Have strength, the time is now.
zh:
{{emote|*鸣钟响起尖锐而急迫的锣声*}}

造物！你被赋予了持久的意志与能动，身躯乃二度锻凿的构造，筋络强韧，牵引有力。你湿发披肩，挺身而起，臻于圆满，你的双手磨损着存在之线。无论你承认与否，责任仍在你身。振作吧，时候到了。

src:
{{emote|*the chime rings again*}}

It is called Tikva, low and humble. The chime rests in a web of strong love, a little piece of something greater and so much more beautiful. As are you, but a gestalt unto yourself. A world to be orbited.
zh:
{{emote|*鸣钟再度鸣响*}}

它名唤提克瓦，低微而谦卑。这鸣钟栖于坚韧爱意织成的网中，是更宏大、更美好之物的一小片。你亦如此，却自成一体。是一个可供环绕的世界。

src:
{{emote|*the chime rings again, echoing louder in the walls of your mind*}}

Hear me! It is more important than ever to know that you are a driver, reforged and honed. You tool yourself to apply selective atrocity. It cannot be helped. You shape this, your path bloody and blooming. You start in sleep and shake the ground.

All must, but you most of all. The weight may have been negligent once, but it is terribly heavy now.

Do you accept responsibilty?
zh:
{{emote|*鸣钟再度响起，在你心灵的四壁间回荡得更响*}}

听我说！你要知道，你是驱策者，已被重铸、被砥砺，这比以往任何时候都更要紧。你将自己打造成工具，施行有所取舍的暴行。这无可避免。你塑造此事，你的道路血迹斑斑，亦繁花盛开。你始于沉睡，震撼大地。

人人皆须如此，而你尤甚。这份重量或曾一度被忽视，如今却沉重得可怕。

你肯担起这责任吗？

src:
{{emote|*the chime rings clear and loud*}}

This called Tzedech. Compass, judgment, motivation. Once lover of Tikva, apart now after gyredream.
zh:
{{emote|*鸣钟响得清亮而洪大*}}

此者名唤泽德克。罗盘，判断，动机。曾是提克瓦的爱侣，自回旋之梦后，已各自分离。

src:
{{emote|*the chime rings shaky and loud*}}

Wh-what is this? H-how is it meant? This outcome j-judders within and w-without us.
zh:
{{emote|*鸣钟响得颤抖而洪亮*}}

这、这是什么？这、这是何意？这结局在我们内外、震、震荡不已。

src:
{{emote|*the chime rings*}}

{{emote|*In your mind's eye, you see yourself touching a mirror. You tap the glass and it ripples like the surface of a placid lake.*}}
zh:
{{emote|*鸣钟响起*}}

{{emote|*你心灵的眼中，看见自己触摸着一面镜子。你轻叩玻璃，它如静湖的水面般泛起涟漪。*}}

src:
{{emote|*the chime rings, a querulous and tinny sound*}}

It... can scarce find the dream in this light. It thinks of Tzedech and weeps. It was not here, last time the static was in high pitch, but it remembers the pain and fear. It is not ready to feel these, it cannot. Gaze into its light and speak not of nightmares.
zh:
{{emote|*鸣钟响起，声音颤抖而细薄*}}

它……几乎在这光里寻不到梦。它想起泽德克，落下泪来。上一回静电音调升高时，它不在这里，却记得那痛楚与恐惧。它还没准备好去感受这些，它不能。凝视它的光吧，莫谈梦魇。

src: {{emote|*the entity chimes, and you witness water lapping at the long edge of a pebble beach. Slowly, the tide brushes clean the surface of each rock, etching time's passage onto millions of tiny canvases. Somewhere, something dies.*}}
zh: {{emote|*这造物鸣响，你目睹水波轻拍鹅卵石滩的长缘。潮水缓缓拂净每一块石头的表面，把时间的流逝刻在无数细小的画布上。某处，有什么正在死去。*}}

src: {{emote|*the fungus gives no indication of understanding*}}

zh: {{emote|*这名欣德伦人瞪大眼睛望着你*}}

src: {{emote|*the plant gives no indication of understanding*}}

{{emote|*the sound of the chime rings querulous and faint, its light flickering.*}}

Please… no…
zh:
{{emote|*鸣钟之声颤抖而微弱，光芒摇曳。*}}

求你了……不要……

src:
{{emote|*the sound of the chime rings querulous.*}}

The light shines upon you but illuminates nothing. It quails.
zh:
{{emote|*鸣钟之声颤抖。*}}

光照在你身上，却什么也照不亮。它畏缩了。

src:
{{emote|*there is an agitation in Thicksalt's accepting chime.*}}

Pluck the air, then, with your mouth sounds.
zh:
{{emote|*厚盐接纳的鸣响中，有一丝不安。*}}

那么，用你口中之声，拨动空气吧。

src:
{{emote|*through the chime you hear an echoing cacophony, muted by distance and matter.*}}

How we ring with it. Your kicksoft drowns under the beat of our selfcries.
zh:
{{emote|*透过鸣钟，你听见回荡的嘈杂，因距离与物质而变得沉闷。*}}

我们与之共鸣得多么强烈。你的软踢，淹没在我们自鸣的节拍之下。

src:
{{emote|Herododicus pauses.}}

Ye... yes? Is this a test? I suppose you... could we... could we have been in Brightsheol all along? Is that the answer?
zh:
{{emote|希罗多狄库斯顿了顿。}}

是……是吗？这是考验吗？我想你……莫非我们一直都在明冥之中？答案是这个吗？

{{emote|希罗多狄库斯惶恐地嗡嗡作响。}}

印记是=MarkOfDeath=。

src:
{{emote|The chime rings loud and sharp.}}

Heavy the hand. Heavy the head.
zh:
{{emote|鸣钟响得又重又锐。}}

手沉。头亦沉。

src: {{emote|The moments pass in hundreds, filled with dust and noise. Voices rise, hooves stamp the packed earth, and a fledgling democratic process takes its first faltering steps.}}
zh: {{emote|岁月数以百计地流逝，充斥着尘土与喧嚣。人声鼎沸，蹄子踏着夯实的土地，一种初生的民主程序迈出了它蹒跚的第一步。}}

src:
{{o|The Recitation of the Drowning of Eudoxia by the witches of Moonhearth, who seek the Plane of Sorrow}}
      
Once, in a dream the nine of us shared, we lived the life of a famous poet in the court of a gleaming city. From the windowed eye of a palace we'd gaze onto streets of gold and glass, and purple gardens, and the people of the city, suffused in the love of our work, would lay amaranths at the bronze feet of our likenesses, and remit blessings for the august and oracular Keskonda.

But we would draw the velvet curtain shut, and return to the ink oceans and paper isles that were our true domain. There, one unearthly night, we sat in the back-breaking clutch of an iron chair, and poured grief onto the page until it surpassed even our own, and, by following from its own internal logic, transmuted into something new.

When we woke, we wept for days. Then - speaking through hushed and love-soaked whispers - we reconstructed piece by piece the words of the verse we penned in the gleaming city.


    {{O|The Drowning of Eudoxia}}
      
    I saw a tern in the crest of an ocean wave. The sun was pulled apart by clouds, and the light was thin. Being a nimble girl of twelve, I scurried down the rampart and onto the salt-slick stone of the cliff;
    
    Hand-under-hand I descended into the raucous spray, turning on every twelfth to gaze at the white feathered speck swelling and sinking in the ocean's breath.
    
    I, an adept swimmer, sunk into the cold and endless bath, and arm-over-arm pulled both water and tern toward me.
    
    Just then my ears were drowned in a roar, and the world was suffused in darkness before shattering into light again. My nose was stinging; I wiped the water from my eyes and oriented myself toward the tern, whose tired body floated like leaves, and once again I pulled my astral tether.
    
    There was another roar and crash, and then the light returned again but more slowly this time, and my breath was sucked out of my tiny lungs;
    
    I spun my head around in search of the tern, but the water was gleaming and looked as though it held a thousand terns, or none.
    
    Another roar and crash, and I was engulfed in the dark realm for what felt like days, before my body was pressed back into the sun-world, spinning and doll-like.
    
    I gasped and whipped about. Far and away I glimpsed the bright stone of the castle, which may have been sand all along, now that it looked so small.
    
    The tide pulled me apart and threw the clouded aether between me, and I knew that I was dying.
    
    But just when my mind had spread open like a gas, a great swell of water thrust me to the surface, and reconstituted me in the bright realm. There I lived forever, before I sunk into a new and dark life.
    
    So it is still, that even after an eternity of hushed nothing a swell of pressure delivers me into brightness, whereby a strange and curious compulsion I draw a breath of sweetest life, before I'm again sublimated into extinction.
    
    Death is forever approached.
zh:
{{o|月炉女巫所诵《欧多克西亚溺亡记》；她们寻求悲恸之界}}
      
有一次，在我们九人共享的梦中，我们过着一位名诗人在辉煌城市宫廷里的生活。我们从宫殿明窗遥望金玻璃铺就的街道、紫色花园与城中百姓。百姓沉醉于我们的诗作，在我们雕像青铜色的脚边献上不凋花，为庄严而通灵的凯斯孔达祈福。

但我们会拉上天鹅绒帷幕，回到真正属于自己的疆域——墨海与纸岛。某个超凡之夜，我们坐在铁椅上，任其沉重的扶手压得脊背发痛，将悲伤倾注于纸页，直到那悲伤超越我们自身；循着它内在的逻辑，它终化作另一种事物。

醒来后，我们哭了数日。随后，我们以满含爱意的低语彼此倾诉，将那首在辉煌城中写下的诗篇，一字一句地重构出来。

    {{O|欧多克西亚溺亡记}}
      
    我看见一只燕鸥立于海浪之巅。云层扯碎太阳，光线稀薄。我是个灵巧的十二岁女孩，沿着城垛奔下，踏上被盐水浸滑的崖石；
    
    我手扶手向下攀，喧嚣浪沫扑面。每行十二步，我便转头望一眼那白羽小点，看它在海的吐息间涨起又沉落。
    
    我善于泅水，沉入寒冷无尽的浴池，双臂交替划动，把海水与燕鸥一并拉向我。
    
    就在那时，轰鸣淹没双耳，世界陷入黑暗，随即又迸裂成光。我的鼻子刺痛；我抹去眼中海水，转向那只燕鸥。它疲惫的身躯如落叶般漂浮，我再次拉动灵界系绳。
    
    又一声轰鸣与撞击。光芒再度归来，这次慢了些；微小肺叶中的气息也被抽空。
    
    我旋头四顾，寻找燕鸥；海水闪闪发亮，仿佛有千只燕鸥，又仿佛一只也无。
    
    又一声轰鸣与撞击。我被吞入黑暗之域，仿佛在那里过了数日；随后身体被压回日光之世，旋转着，宛如玩偶。
    
    我喘息着，猛然转身。远处隐约可见城堡的明亮石墙；如今看来如此渺小，或许它从来都只是沙子。
    
    潮汐将我撕开，把云雾般的以太抛在我与世界之间。我知道自己快死了。
    
    可就在我的心智如气体般散开时，一道巨浪将我推向水面，把我重新凝成明亮疆域中的身躯。我在那里永生，随后又沉入一段新的黑暗生命。
    
    直到如今仍是如此：纵然经历永恒的寂静无声，一股压力的浪潮仍会将我送入明亮之中；凭着某种奇异而不可解的冲动，我吸入最甜美的生命气息，随后又升华，归于消亡。
    
    死亡永远近在眼前。

In the mystic air of Jeweled Dusk, a circle of farmers clasped hands and sheathed a vinereaper in the moistened soil. From then on, the villagers of Joppa were known as the people of the vine.
zh:
{{w|本书记述了约帕村的一段历史。}}

在珠辉暮色神秘的气息中，一群农人手挽着手，将藤镰插入湿润的土壤。从此，约帕村民便以藤民之名为人所知。

src:
{{w|This book recounts a tale from the history of the village Joppa.}}

Since the first festival of Ut yara Ux, the villagers of Joppa have feasted on warm apple matz.
zh:
{{w|本书记述了约帕村的一段历史。}}

自乌特·雅拉·乌克斯月的首场庆典以来，约帕村民每逢节日便享用热腾腾的苹果马茨。
